# Chapter 1022: It was all Heaven's Will

Realizing he had been schemed against, Ying Wu Xie fell into cold despair and gave up completely.

With a soft explosion, Ying Wu Xie's soul and Fang Yuan's immortal zombie body instantly self-detonated.

The immortal zombie's dao marks and Ying Wu Xie's soul became fuel for Spring Autumn Cicada.

Spring Autumn Cicada activated!

Fang Yuan was pale with shock!

"What is going on! Spring Autumn Cicada is filled with my special will, how could Ying Wu Xie activate it?"

"Did this change occur because I defied Star Constellation Immortal Venerable's intention to destroy sovereign immortal fetus Gu?"

Fang Yuan suddenly remembered an arrangement left by Shadow Sect.

The ghost face and the red lotus in the River of Time.

"Prepare for the worst. If he succeeds in rebirth, what will happen to me?" As Fang Yuan thought, his vision blurred.

Ying Wu Xie reacted in shock: "The River of Time? How did Spring Autumn Cicada activate, and how did my consciousness replace Fang Yuan's inside it?"

A huge wave ruthlessly crashed towards Spring Autumn Cicada.

A bitter-looking ghost face floated from the River of Time, opening wide to spit out a red lotus.

The red lotus opened up and obstructed the fatal wave.

A formless suction then carried Spring Autumn Cicada, containing Ying Wu Xie's will, into the center of the red lotus.

There, another will in Spectral Soul Demon Venerable's likeness sat cross-legged in mid-air, smiling bitterly at him.

"Our main body left you as a last resort in the River of Time?" Ying Wu Xie's will asked joyfully after a stunned pause.

"Nothing could be done, did you think I was willing?" Ying Wu Xie said anxiously. "What is going on? Schemed against by Fang Yuan, I thought I was doomed. Why am I in the River of Time? I didn't use Spring Autumn Cicada, so why did it activate?"

Spectral Soul Demon Venerable's will sighed: "Watching from this Red Lotus true inheritance, I realized: you entered here and Spring Autumn Cicada activated because heaven's will aided you."

"Hasn't heaven's will always obstructed us? Why would it suddenly help?" Ying Wu Xie asked.

"Lacking your memories, you lack my knowledge. Heaven's will never obstructed us out of dislike, nor helped us from pity. The way of heaven is impartial—taking away surpluses while replenishing deficits. Thus all things balance and restrict each other. Fierce beasts have natural predators, and even rank nine venerables have limited lifespans."

Spectral Soul Demon Venerable's will paused, then continued: "The way of humans is the exact opposite—reducing deficits and building surpluses. The strong desire to become stronger. The rich seek greater wealth, beauties desire more beauty, and the long-lived want eternal life. Human avarice is boundless and never satisfied, opposing heaven's will."

"I understand somewhat. Heaven's will helped me because I failed. Fang Yuan is now a complete otherworldly demon who broke free of restrictions. Left unchecked, he will severely disrupt the balance of heaven and earth. So heaven's will shifted targets, using me to stop his plan. But how could it activate Spring Autumn Cicada? That Immortal Gu was refined by Fang Yuan." Ying Wu Xie was puzzled.

Spectral Soul Demon Venerable's will replied: "This was heaven's will all along. I realized it just now. Fang Yuan obtaining Spring Autumn Cicada was arranged by heaven's will. It chose him as a tool to rebirth and ruin our main body's plan!"

"Reflecting on Bai Ning Bing's information, Fang Yuan acted unusually starting from Qing Mao Mountain, all along the way, he clearly has not used Spring Autumn Cicada just once."

"Spring Autumn Cicada is only rank six and has a failure rate, yet he succeeded repeatedly. Aside from when we helped him, he never failed once, even though Spring Autumn Cicada lowers luck. Heaven's will secretly assisted him, enabling him to rise from mortal to Gu Immortal in mere years, drawing our main body's attention to be chosen as a tool against heaven's will."

Spectral Soul's will nodded: "Right! Our main body failed primarily due to Fang Yuan. We wanted to use him, but he was already heaven's will's tool."

"Regardless of how many times Fang Yuan reborn, before his first, our main body had likely succeeded. We refined sovereign immortal fetus Gu and may have reached a heaven-defying level! Because of this, heaven's will spared no effort aiding Fang Yuan, sending him back to destroy our plan."

"Fang Yuan is intriguing. As an otherworldly demon, he qualifies to rebirth and alter the past, whereas ordinary people cannot escape fate. Yet not being a complete otherworldly demon, he remained manipulable by heaven's will. He thought he refined and used Spring Autumn Cicada independently, but that was never true. Spring Autumn Cicada was infused with heaven's will from the moment Fang Yuan obtained it. Deceived by heaven's will, he never sensed anything amiss. Just like now, I wish to impart all my knowledge to you, but your will can bear very little."

"Heaven's will influenced Fang Yuan heavily, but he ultimately followed his inner desires, seizing sovereign immortal fetus Gu instead of destroying it."

"He became a chess piece no longer bound by the rules. Unwilling to tolerate this, heaven's will activated Spring Autumn Cicada to use you against him."

"Yet heaven's will won't let you reclaim sovereign immortal fetus Gu after rebirth. You won't easily alter the situation, so don't be impatient and ruin this final chance."

Ying Wu Xie asked: "Then what should I do?"

"Zombie Alliance and Shadow Sect are destroyed, and our main body is in danger. But our immortals left behind arrangements. Use them to rebuild Shadow Sect."

"Your will can hold no more. Rebuild Shadow Sect and save our main body. Crucially, inform our main body of this truth. Upon your rebirth, this Red Lotus true inheritance will reset and I will forget everything. You will be the sole person who knows!"

"Remember, the tallest tree faces the gale, and soil nearest water is swept away first. Laying low to amass strength against heaven's will was correct. Having succeeded once, we can succeed again! Take care!"

# Chapter 1023: Ying Wu Xie Rebirths

Howling wind buffeted 'Fang Yuan' as he jolted awake mid-flight, blurting: "I was reborn!"

Stopping, Ying Wu Xie looked around and realized he was en route to Yi Tian Mountain.

He was under ten thousand li from his destination.

"Fang Yuan intentionally lent me Fixed Immortal Travel so I would bring his Gu worms back and grant him victory!"

"Reborn, I know Yi Tian Mountain's scenery and can teleport there directly with Fixed Immortal Travel to take revenge on Fang Yuan!"

Ying Wu Xie gritted his teeth: "Heaven's will is truly sinister. Even if I rush over, Fang Yuan has already used sovereign immortal fetus Gu. At most, I could only injure his weakened state."

"What a pity! Returning to when I escaped the dream realm would let me turn things around. But heaven's will refused, unwilling to let my main body gain sovereign immortal fetus Gu."

"With the outcome decided, I must follow my main body's instructions and retreat!"

"I need not target Fang Yuan; he will draw heaven's will's focus. If he survives, I can use him as material to refine sovereign immortal fetus Gu again, saving immense effort."

"I must rebuild Shadow Sect! I can use Tai Bai Yun Sheng and Hei Lou Lan, but must keep them from meeting Fang Yuan."

Ying Wu Xie gritted his teeth, turning around and leaving.

"Why hasn't Ying Wu Xie arrived?" After waiting long, Fang Yuan's heart sank.

"Did he see through my arrangements and escape my control?"

"If Ying Wu Xie doesn't come, the special will in my Gu worms won't activate, and they will detonate once the time limit expires! I must reach him quickly, persuading or subduing Tai Bai Yun Sheng and Hei Lou Lan to aid me."

Fang Yuan still possessed Attitude Gu, the best evidence to convince Hei Lou Lan.

Fang Yuan inspected his Gu worms.

The highest ranking was the legendary Attitude Gu. He also had wisdom path Unravel Mystery and soul path Change Soul.

"Must I chase Ying Wu Xie on foot while he has Fixed Immortal Travel? Or could I first subdue the dream path Gu worms on his original body, including movement types?"

"I have no choice but to try." Fang Yuan looked up at Ying Wu Xie's body in the sky.

At the next moment, Ying Wu Xie's body self-destructed.

At this sight, Fang Yuan's pupils shrank and he rapidly retreated.

Because he recognized this was a dream realm!

Once the eighteen hours expired, he would self-detonate into a dream realm.

The detonated dream realm expanded rapidly.

Fang Yuan fled seven hundred li until he escaped the dream realm's expansion.

A giant dream realm spanning a thousand li manifested before him, filling his vision.

Fang Yuan's heart leapt: "Thankfully, I ignored Star Constellation Immortal Venerable and didn't destroy sovereign immortal fetus Gu. Otherwise, my soul would be trapped in this dream realm until death!"

Ying Wu Xie's body was immensely valuable, possessing dream path Gu worms capable of Lead Soul Into Dream.

Above all, Fang Yuan coveted Spectral Soul. Even weakened, capturing him would allow soul searching for vast secrets and cultivation experience.

Now, all of this was submerged within the dream realm.

"I can't stay; this commotion will certainly draw Southern Border Gu Immortals."

He headed toward where Tai Bai Yun Sheng had fled with his body.

"Fang Yuan, you had better explain yourself, or we are enemies!" Hei Lou Lan demanded coldly.

Tai Bai Yun Sheng waved his hands: "Calm down! Let Fang Yuan explain."

Ying Wu Xie looked at them sincerely: "I was hit by his killer move, not just trapped in the dream realm. Most of my Gu worms are locked; only killing him can undo it."

"Yet you used Fixed Immortal Travel! Without our Gu tracking, I would have thought you abandoned us and fled Southern Border!" Hei Lou Lan pressed.

"That was a desperate measure. You saw me fail and suffer heavy injuries the first time. Why would I abandon you? In such danger, we must unite to survive," Ying Wu Xie said persuasively.

Ying Wu Xie cut her off: "Enough! We leave with Fixed Immortal Travel now. My identity is exposed to Heavenly Court—Hu Immortal blessed land is unsafe, so we must relocate its resources."

Fang Yuan sprinted rapidly.

He noted joyfully that despite its pale, tender look, his body possessed incredible defense. Scraping branches left no marks, and sharp rocks crumbled beneath his feet without impeding him.

To Fang Yuan's disappointment, he found no traces of Ying Wu Xie, Tai Bai Yun Sheng, or Hei Lou Lan.

# Chapter 1024: Fang Yuan Borrows Gu

"Running so long without rest, yet no fatigue at all! Most importantly, without using a single Gu worm."

Fang Yuan began feeling the uniqueness of this new body.

Dao marks made Gu Masters' physical bodies extraordinary, endowed with unique traits.

"Created from rank nine sovereign immortal fetus Gu, this body holds abundant dao marks. At minimum, its strength path dao marks surpass my previous accumulation!"

Looking around, Fang Yuan's gaze froze, he stared in focus.

He saw traces of battle.

"It seems Tai Bai Yun Sheng and Hei Lou Lan clashed with Gu Immortals here while carrying my body."

Fang Yuan repeatedly tested his physical resilience by dropping from increasing heights without injury. At three hundred and thirty meters, Fang Yuan ended his experiment.

From this height, he felt evident pain, leaving a slight red bruise where he landed.

"Three hundred and thirty meters isn't my body's limit?" Fang Yuan was shocked.

"Reaching this level purely with my body and no defensive Gu is rare even among Gu Immortals!"

Without defensive Immortal Gu, he held only Unravel Mystery, Change Soul, and Attitude Gu.

Reaching the battlefield traces, Fang Yuan squatted to investigate.

"It seems to be them." Fang Yuan stood up, frowning.

Suddenly, a figure descended from the sky like a comet.

With a loud crash, he landed before Fang Yuan.

"Who is it?!" Fang Yuan shouted coldly with gleaming eyes.

"I am Huo Kong Dong. Did you come from Yi Tian Mountain?" the flame-clad person asked rudely.

Fang Yuan's expression darkened as Change Soul Immortal Gu's aura flared: "You came at a good time. Did you see any suspicious individuals while flying?"

Sensing Change Soul Immortal Gu's aura, Huo Kong Dong realized Fang Yuan was formidable and softened his tone.

Though a lone cultivator, Huo Kong Dong had joined Southern Border's Chai clan.

Huo Kong Dong thought: "Suspicious individuals? You're running around stark naked in broad daylight—you're the most suspicious one!"

After a brief silence, he replied: "There is no one else within a hundred li, sir."

"Damn it!" Fang Yuan roared, his expression twisting into ruthless bloodlust.

Clenching his fists, he gritted his teeth: "They escaped! But even to the ends of the earth, I will find you and repay this humiliation a thousandfold!"

Observing him, Huo Kong Dong surmised: "He was likely stripped of his Gu in an ambush. He has a fierce temper and is furious—I should be cautious."

"I didn't delve deep into Yi Tian Mountain, see for yourself!" Fang Yuan turned to leave.

Displeased, Huo Kong Dong moved to block him, but Fang Yuan paused: "Wait! You're Huo Kong Dong of Chai clan?"

Fang Yuan gave an unsightly smile: "Good, I'm old friends with your ninth supreme elder. Has he completed his battlefield killer move myriad flash fire?"

"Heh, his grandfather grounded him for harassing Fairy Yi Yi... heh! Once I settle this, I'll look for him." Fang Yuan stretched out his hand: "Lend me some Gu worms."

"Ah?" Huo Kong Dong was shocked.

"What? You're a grand Gu Immortal—why so stingy over a few mortal Gu?" Fang Yuan asked impatiently.

Huo Kong Dong thought: "Ninth elder's secluded cultivation is only an excuse for harassing Fairy Yi Yi. Knowing that, he must truly be ninth elder's friend. I may have joined Chai clan, but I'm only an outsider lone cultivator, while ninth elder is the first supreme elder's grandson. Refusing his friend Gu worms would definitely anger him."

Handing over his Gu worms, Huo Kong Dong asked, "Might I know your name, brother?"

"I am Dong Fang Xiong Ji." Fang Yuan waved his hand.

Huo Kong Dong stared, thinking: "Dong Fang Xiong Ji? He is indeed ninth elder's notorious friend, infamous in Southern Border for being petty, stingy, and vengeful. But he doesn't look like this? Oh! He has no clothes, so he had to change his appearance. I can forget about getting these Gu back, but sending him away is a blessing."

# Chapter 1025: Dark Night, Cold Winds

Fang Yuan flew like a fireball draped in flames and trailing black smoke, cutting a striking figure across the sky.

Against Huo Kong Dong, Fang Yuan's meager arsenal would put him at a severe disadvantage.

Yet through superb acting, he defused danger and scammed four rank five Gu.

Another advantage was that despite its high rank, attitude Gu only expended mental energy.

Freshly revived, Fang Yuan had far less immortal essence than his original accumulation.

"Unfortunately, attitude Gu isn't mine; I must eventually return it to Hei Lou Lan." Fang Yuan felt deep regret.

Though he had revived in a new body, his soul remained the same.

The airtight alliance agreement strictly bound members in both body and soul.

Thus, despite changing bodies, Fang Yuan still could not violate it.

"The alliance agreement's effect is split between body and soul; I am now only half an alliance member."

"Even so, the backlash is severe; my soul could never endure it."

"Hmm... this body must have quite a lot of wisdom path dao marks!"

In this body, thoughts spun rapidly, inspiration bursting forth at the slightest shift.

"I no longer need wisdom path Gu worms to replenish my thoughts!" Fang Yuan nearly teared up.

"As long as a person is alive, there would be a great variety of thoughts in their mind, this is not strange. But my speed of producing thoughts is much faster than normal. I could sustain even the rate of consumption under the light of wisdom for a long time!"

"Beyond wisdom path, I also have plenty of fire path dao marks!" Fang Yuan observed the flames on his body, eyes flashing.

Flames enveloped his body, flaring higher than a man's forearm.

Other than fire cape Gu, Fang Yuan also 'borrowed' a rank five flying smoke Gu.

Trailing thick black smoke, he flew at speeds matching mortal killer moves.

Fang Yuan realized: "I don't just have fire path dao marks, but also dao marks suited for flight."

This way, Fang Yuan's flying quasi-grandmaster attainment level could be displayed.

His battle strength rose rapidly because of just one Gu worm!

Still, his battle strength was weak; facing Southern Border immortals required attitude Gu to deceive them.

"I must avoid battle, catch Ying Wu Xie, and regroup with my allies," Fang Yuan planned.

With Yi Tian Mountain engulfed in dreams, Ying Wu Xie would avoid it, leaving Fang Yuan's will unactivated.

After the time limit was up, Fang Yuan's Gu worms would self-detonate.

But as long as Fang Yuan controlled the situation, it could still be resolved.

With his allies' help, he could retrieve his Gu and swap souls back.

Returning to his body, he could command his Gu and extract the special will.

Ying Wu Xie's soul produced different thoughts from Fang Yuan's, preventing him from using Fang Yuan's Gu worms.

Time was pressing, Fang Yuan needed to hurry.

But despite this, Fang Yuan could not catch his target.

As the sky turned dark, his heart sank.

"Sigh!" He exhaled at the sky, abandoned the pursuit, and rapidly retreated.

Fang Yuan was taking a huge risk in searching for them.

The refinement's massive fallout had slain many immortals and would draw countless investigators.

"Ying Wu Xie didn't pursue me. Was he obstructed by Southern Border immortals, or did he uncover my scheme?" Fang Yuan wondered.

"Shadow Sect surely left contingencies across Zombie Alliance's regional branches. Did Ying Wu Xie head for them?"

"Worst-case, how do I stop him from seizing my assets under my identity?"

"Dang Hun Mountain and Luo Po Valley now reside in Hu Immortal and Star Form blessed lands. Even without knowing the terrain, he could teleport directly there with Fixed Immortal Travel!"

"A land spirit should detect a swapped soul, but Spectral Soul's split soul could easily deceive them..."

Where had Ying Wu Xie, Tai Bai Yun Sheng, and Hei Lou Lan gone?

Fixed Immortal Travel!

Jade green light dissipated, Ying Wu Xie left Southern Border, returning to Central Continent.

"Ma... master?" Before he looked around, a meek voice could be heard.

"It is me." Ying Wu Xie raised his head, replying nonchalantly.

Looking around, his lips curled into a smile.

# Chapter 1026: Given to Feng Jin Huang

"Master, please speak the secret code." That timid voice spoke again.

Ying Wu Xie spoke: "Heaven has nine layers."

That voice continued: "The land has five regions."

Ying Wu Xie spoke: "Throughout the ages."

The voice continued: "Ruling over all beings!"

Kneeling heavily with a thud, a sobbing voice called: "Shi Nu pays respects to master."

"Stand up," Ying Wu Xie chuckled, signaling the kneeling rockman Gu Immortal.

He emitted a strong rank seven Gu Immortal aura.

Rather than teleporting to Hu Immortal blessed land, Ying Wu Xie had traveled to this secret base.

Tempered by battle and receiving Spectral Soul's will, Ying Wu Xie had partially regained his memories and composure.

He had experienced rebirth and thus already knew Fang Yuan's arrangements.

Unable to use his Gu worms, Fang Yuan's fake will in his mind would influence his thoughts with the slightest carelessness.

Despite a dazzling array of mortal and Immortal Gu, Ying Wu Xie could only use Fixed Immortal Travel.

Thus, he used Fixed Immortal Travel to arrive here first and prepare.

"First take me to the underground core." Ying Wu Xie instructed.

"Yes, master." Gu Immortal Shi Nu quickly responded.

The two descended through twisting tunnels into an underground chamber.

Ying Wu Xie peered ahead, vaguely discerning a soul sphere bobbing within the soil.

This soul sphere was Bo Qing's soul.

Infested with water path dao marks from tribulations, Bo Qing's soul was merely stabilized by the core's earth path marks.

After half an hour.

"Where is this?" Tai Bai Yun Sheng came out of Ying Wu Xie's immortal aperture.

"This isn't Hu Immortal blessed land?" Hei Lou Lan soon followed.

Ying Wu Xie nodded: "Right, we've returned to Central Continent's Earth Abyss. The rockmen were evacuated; this is master's secret base."

"No wonder you placed Star Form blessed land here—master had already arranged this location," Tai Bai Yun Sheng smiled.

"So Fang Yuan's second blessed land is in Earth Abyss," Ying Wu Xie noted.

"Purple Mountain True Monarch?" Hei Lou Lan's eyes narrowed as she stared at Ying Wu Xie. "Why didn't you go directly to Hu Immortal blessed land?"

Ying Wu Xie calmly replied: "My identity is exposed; Heavenly Court's Gu Immortals know about me. Using information path methods, Heavenly Court would have already instructed the ten great ancient sects to surround Hu Immortal blessed land!"

"Returning directly would walk into a trap, so I came here first to scout intelligence."

"Then what did you find out?" Hei Lou Lan asked.

Ying Wu Xie sighed: "The ten great ancient sects have surrounded Hu Immortal blessed land, ready to strike."

Tai Bai Yun Sheng gasped: "Dang Hun Mountain is still there—what do we do?"

Ying Wu Xie sneered: "Hu Immortal blessed land is lost for now; I will reclaim it eventually. Priority is... ahh!"

Ying Wu Xie froze, a look of sudden shock overtaking his face.

"What happened?" Tai Bai Yun Sheng quickly asked.

Ying Wu Xie showed Fixed Immortal Travel's corpse bitterly: "Activating it under lingering battle damage destroyed it!"

Ying Wu Xie raged inwardly: "Fixed Immortal Travel self-destructed? Fang Yuan must have planted a method. Damn it! He schemed to lure me to Yi Tian Mountain and planted self-destruction! His other Gu worms will surely follow suit."

"I must borrow Immortal Gu to suppress his worms before the special will detonates them all!"

Ying Wu Xie looked grim: "We have huge trouble. I must act quickly before my other Gu worms suffer the same fate!"

"Rest here while I handle this—master left more than just this stronghold!" Ying Wu Xie departed.

Meanwhile in Central Continent, Tian Ti mountain.

"We have broken through! We have broken through!"

"Hahaha, Hu Immortal blessed land is finally ours!"

Central Continent's Gu Immortals stormed excitedly into Hu Immortal blessed land.

"Empty, how could it be empty!"

"Where is Dang Hun Mountain? Where did Dang Hun Mountain go?"

"Are you Lord Feng Jiu Ge?" Hu Immortal land spirit appeared before Feng Jiu Ge with large watery eyes.

Feng Jiu Ge was slightly taken aback: "I am."

"Master took everything he needed and gifted this blessed land to your daughter, Feng Jin Huang," the land spirit stated.

"What? Fang Yuan was faster than us?!"

Feng Jiu Ge's sweeping gaze immediately silenced the murmurs.

# Chapter 1027: Nine-five Sovereign Immortal Aperture (1/2)

Going back a while ago in time.

Failing to catch Ying Wu Xie, Fang Yuan halted midair, dejected.

Fang Yuan did not know he had actually succeeded once, before heaven's will and Spring Autumn Cicada ruined it.

Any plan could fail; even Shadow Sect and Spectral Soul's tens of thousands of years of deductions had collapsed.

Fang Yuan attempted to guess Ying Wu Xie's situation.

Naturally cautious, Fang Yuan considered defeat before victory, always preparing for the worst-case scenario.

"Then, what would be the worst situation?" Fang Yuan floated in the night sky, asking himself.

The worst scenario was Ying Wu Xie seeing through traps and seizing Fang Yuan's assets in both blessed lands.

As Spectral Soul's split soul with deep foundation, Ying Wu Xie might easily detect the arrangement. Crucially, a massive dream realm now engulfed Yi Tian Mountain.

Refusing to leave things to chance, Fang Yuan halted the pursuit and landed on a nearby mountain.

Resting on a pine branch, Fang Yuan activated connecting heaven Gu.

He had borrowed four mortal Gu from Huo Kong Dong.

Connecting heaven Gu and divine sense Gu granted access to treasure yellow heaven.

Fang Yuan inspected all four Gu worms before carefully activating them.

Before activating it, however, Fang Yuan froze in utter shock upon inspecting his aperture.

He sent his consciousness into his immortal aperture again.

Frowning with a tense body, an unbelievable immortal aperture appeared before him!

"Had I not seen it myself, I'd never believe such an immortal aperture existed!" Fang Yuan was awestruck.

In fact, he had already been mentally prepared.

Even without knowing every detail, Fang Yuan knew sovereign immortal fetus Gu possessed extraordinary power!

Fang Yuan had interacted with a rank nine Immortal Gu before.

That was wisdom Gu.

He lacked the ability to even refine wisdom Gu!

He could only utilize the light of wisdom, like smelling a sumptuous feast without eating.

He recently encountered his second rank nine Immortal Gu.

Sovereign immortal fetus Gu.

This time, he didn't just smell it—he devoured the supreme meal whole!

"Spectral Soul's sovereign immortal fetus Gu holds profound mysteries." This thought had lingered in Fang Yuan's mind since rebirth.

Failing to catch Ying Wu Xie, he needed to prepare for the worst, aiming to enter treasure yellow heaven via connecting heaven Gu.

Now, he inspected his immortal aperture for the first time.

With just one glance, he was extremely stunned!

Its abnormal landscape shattered centuries of cultivation common sense.

Though only a rank six blessed land, its space was colossal.

Most rank six blessed lands spanned only two to four thousand square kilometers.

Even high-grade blessed lands like Tai Bai Yun Sheng's reached at most six thousand square kilometers.

Ten extreme physiques like Hei Lou Lan produced super grade blessed lands, capping out at thirteen thousand square kilometers.

# Chapter 1028: Nine-five Sovereign Immortal Aperture (2/2)

Every layer of his immortal aperture had over 33500km2 of space!

A single layer vastly exceeded a ten extreme super grade aperture.

Fang Yuan found that his immortal aperture had ten layers.

Adding them up, ten layers amounted to over 335000km2 of space!

"My blessed land possesses grotto-heaven traits? Even Lang Ya blessed land lacks partitions, yet my rank six aperture splits into five areas!"

The second through tenth layers lacked soil and earth, lying completely empty.

The central area featured the most fertile soil and varied terrain.

The southern area had many peaks, moist and foggy.

The northern area had huge grasslands with strong winds.

The eastern area was a sea of countless islands resembling a giant chessboard.

The western area was desolate and hot, consisting mainly of desert.

"Doesn't this layout mirror the world's five regions? Southern Border, Eastern Sea, Central Continent, Northern Plains, Western Desert..." Fang Yuan muttered inwardly.

These nine barren layers were devoid of soil, colored red, orange, yellow, green, azure, blue, purple, white, and black respectively.

"Aren't the immemorial nine heavens arranged in these exact colors? But Ren Zu and his ten children caused seven to collapse, scattering their fragment worlds. Now, only white and black heaven remain."

"Nine heavens, five regions, nine-five... sovereign. Is this why it's called sovereign immortal fetus Gu?"

His previous lives had yielded only high and medium grade apertures.

"News of this immortal aperture must not leak. Once exposed, I will face endless enemies wanting me dead."

The superior the nine-five sovereign immortal aperture, the deeper his enmity with Spectral Soul and Shadow Sect!

"And, in the five hundred years of my previous life, did Shadow Sect and Spectral Soul succeed?"

"I should connect to treasure yellow heaven first." Fang Yuan cleared his mind.

He used connecting heaven Gu and divine sense Gu, easily 'finding' treasure yellow heaven.

Soon, a smooth mirror formed within Fang Yuan's sovereign immortal aperture, revealing treasure yellow heaven inside.

In a short time, he found Little Hu Immortal.

Following Fang Yuan's prior instructions, Little Hu Immortal had kept her connecting heaven Gu open the entire time.

Fang Yuan knew Hu Immortal blessed land would inevitably be besieged by Central Continent immortals.

Hu Immortal blessed land retained only Dang Hun Mountain, several stone nests, and numerous hairy man slaves.

Its cave held wisdom Gu and the sword path Gu seized from Bo Qing.

"Is it master?" Little Hu Immortal asked joyfully.

"It's me." Fang Yuan answered.

Fang Yuan instructed Little Hu Immortal to execute Plan B, Section C.

Little Hu Immortal cried: "Master, do you not want me anymore? I will be obedient!"

Fang Yuan chuckled: "Don't worry, Plan B, Section C was recently revised. Follow it, and the other party will not truly accept you."

She followed this plan and contacted Lang Ya land spirit.

Fang Yuan had already informed Lang Ya land spirit beforehand in his capacity as Lang Ya Sect's external supreme elder.

Lang Ya land spirit promptly dispatched rank six hairy man Gu Immortals through a stargate to Hu Immortal blessed land.

Forming Heavenly Giant Solor, they hoisted Dang Hun Mountain into an aperture and retreated through the stargate.

Lang Ya land spirit then employed special methods to coax wisdom Gu into an aperture, completing the evacuation.

Circumstances forced him to expose wisdom Gu to Lang Ya land spirit.

Once wisdom Gu was safely relocated, Fang Yuan contacted Star Form blessed land and transferred Luo Po Valley to Lang Ya blessed land as well.

Even if Ying Wu Xie targeted the mountains, Lang Ya Sect would now bear the brunt.

# Chapter 1029: Vital Immortal Gu, Dog Shit Luck

"The relocation of Hu Immortal and Star Form blessed lands is settled." Fang Yuan finally breathed a sigh of relief.

Viewing bodies as mere flesh, Fang Yuan cared only about three vital matters:

First, his original body's Gu worms.

Second, the cultivation resources accumulated across Hu Immortal and Star Form blessed lands.

Third, the relations with Hei Lou Lan, Tai Bai Yun Sheng, Lang Ya land spirit, Spirit Affinity House, Immortal Crane Sect and others.

He pondered: "Fixed Immortal Travel should have self-destructed by now, with the other Gu worms following suit. How will Ying Wu Xie handle this?"

"Reclaiming those Gu worms is almost hopeless. Meanwhile, the resources in Hu Immortal and Star Form blessed lands have already been moved. Hu Immortal blessed land is lost to Central Continent immortals, while Star Form blessed land lies hidden in Earth Abyss. That leaves only the third matter: Hei Lou Lan, Tai Bai Yun Sheng, and the rest."

With True Yang Building's destruction exposed, Ying Wu Xie would shoulder Heavenly Court's wrath in his stead.

Though her allies were dead, Hei Lou Lan remained a Great Strength True Martial immortal. Coupled with her past-life identity as Spirit Affinity House's fairy, her strong luck, and her formidable character, she could not be underestimated.

Though Tai Bai Yun Sheng possessed only two Immortal Gu, both were top-grade worms of immense utility.

Fang Yuan immediately attempted to contact Hei Lou Lan and Tai Bai Yun Sheng through treasure yellow heaven.

Though he reached their wills in the market, their bodies remained unreachable.

Lacking other options, he shelved the attempt for now and contacted Lang Ya land spirit.

"Lad, you finally contacted me!" Lang Ya land spirit called out in great excitement.

Yet upon seeing Dang Hun Mountain, Luo Po Valley, and especially wisdom Gu, he was dumbfounded.

Lang Ya land spirit urged: "Contribute these treasures to the sect! I will reward you with vast sect contribution points!"

For the moment, Fang Yuan could not use wisdom Gu.

He had revived in a living body, unlike his former immortal zombie form.

As a living being, bathing in the light of wisdom would drain his precious lifespan.

Considering this, Fang Yuan told Lang Ya land spirit: "First supreme elder, donating these three treasures is impossible, but we can cooperate. I can lend Dang Hun Mountain, Luo Po Valley, and wisdom Gu for the sect's use. The sect must safeguard them and compensate me tenfold if any mishap occurs. In addition, you must reward me with sect contribution points."

He shook his sleeve, shooting out a ball of mud.

The mud ball expanded to elephant size, then reshaped itself into Ni Jian.

Though Fang Yuan's appearance had completely changed, Ni Jian's intuition told him this youth was the culprit!

"It's you! You demon, you forced my grandfather's death and slaughtered my entire clan!"

As he said this, Ni Jian charged towards Fang Yuan.

Snorting coldly, Fang Yuan waved his arm, conjuring surging clouds to obscure the area as he swiftly retreated.

"Gu Immortals possess endless methods. To think they could still track me down."

"Halt!" Qi Zai shouted, forming an eagle claw with his right hand and sweeping ferociously at the clouds and mist.

The thick clouds and mist instantly dispersed.

Facing Fang Yuan, Qi Zai opened his mouth and inhaled.

An enormous suction gripped Fang Yuan's body, drastically reducing his speed.

By then, the mudman Ni Jian had already closed in.

Yet the next instant, Fang Yuan's figure dispersed into clouds and mist.

Unfazed, Qi Zai looked to his right and flicked a finger.

Mortal killer move — Divine Flick.

A thumb-sized qi pellet shot toward Fang Yuan too swiftly to dodge.

This time, his real body was exposed.

A thick, translucent qi current began revolving around Ni Jian's waist, multiplying his speed several times over.

Covered in lion fur armor, Fang Yuan was unharmed by the divine flick, which had merely forced him to appear.

"A qi path Gu Immortal...." He thought to himself.

Swaying lightly as he pounced forward, he raised hands coated in cold white frost.

Fang Yuan lightly struck Ni Jian's body with his palms.

White frost quickly coated Ni Jian, drastically reducing his speed and shattering the translucent qi current around his waist.

Though Fang Yuan had Immortal Gu, being rank seven, they could not be used lightly.

Seeing Ni Jian's rank six battle strength toyed with, Qi Zai's expression sank as he repeatedly used divine flick to unleash countless qi pellets.

Snorting, he changed tactics, making a cutting motion toward Fang Yuan from afar.

With each gesture, a blade of qi instantly formed.

Lion fur armor could only endure two slashes before Fang Yuan reinforced it, coating its surface in sticky, black, oil-like liquid.

"This guy... what path does he cultivate?"

The mortal killer moves Fang Yuan used all showed signs of dao mark amplification.

But the killer moves already covered many paths like wind path, cloud path, dark path, strength path and other paths!

# Chapter 1041: Scaring Himself

"As far as I know, historically only Reckless Savage Demon Venerable could do this!"

Historical records stated he could transform into countless things, his dao marks shifting at will.

Battlefield killer move — Qi Lockdown.

Immediately, the surrounding air immobilized, sealing the area into a translucent temporary battlefield.

Fang Yuan immediately deployed Xue Song Zi's signature move, battlefield killer move snow domain.

Seeing Fang Yuan still at ease, Qi Zai lost patience and took the lead in activating his Immortal Gu.

Fang Yuan sighed, activating rank seven sword escape Immortal Gu.

Immediately, he seemed to turn into a sharp sword, piercing the air and flying away.

"In the past, I could only sigh in dismay. But you are unlucky—not long ago, I completed the immortal killer move I spent three years designing."

Aura burst from his body, surrounding him and Qi He before penetrating the qi grand lion.

The qi grand lion roared in pain, eyes red as it charged toward Fang Yuan.

Under Qi Zai's immortal killer move, the qi grand lion moved at astonishing speed!

Within minutes, the qi grand lion carried the two Qi clan Gu Immortals and caught up to Fang Yuan.

Qi Zai activated his Immortal Gu again, summoning the yin qi rope.

The yin qi rope coiled and flew towards Fang Yuan, rapidly getting closer.

Flying sword Gu!

Fang Yuan pointed as his Immortal Gu shot out.

Flying sword Immortal Gu was peerlessly sharp, slicing the yin qi rope to pieces.

Qi Zai was shaken and shocked: "Why does he have another rank seven sword path Immortal Gu?"

Naturally vigilant and prone to overthinking, the more Qi Zai analyzed, the more shocked he grew, scaring himself!

# Chapter 1042: If Heaven's Will Finds Trouble, Cut Down the Trouble!

Fang Yuan was also frowning deeply.

Though flying sword Gu had destroyed the yin qi, it recovered instantly.

"Flying sword Gu is strong, but it cannot overcome an obstacle that disperses and gathers at will," Fang Yuan realized.

Fang Yuan activated this rank seven Immortal Gu again, flying into the sky.

"Heh, he is very vigilant." Qi Zai snorted coldly.

Through the clashes, Fang Yuan gradually deduced several details.

"The rank six Gu Immortal beside him is behaving strangely, she is likely a newly ascended Gu Immortal. She calls the rank seven Gu Immortal great-uncle, the two of them should be blood related family members."

"This rank six Gu Immortal is no threat. If she could attack, she would have disrupted me long ago, yet she has sat idle throughout this battle."

He thought: "Is that the Five Regional Mountain Range ahead? That's his plan! I cannot let him escape into it."

He was very familiar with Southern Border, the Five Regional Mountain Range was his hope.

Qi Zai watched grimly as Fang Yuan entered the Five Regional Mountain Range.

Hesitating before deciding, Qi Zai told Qi He: "Stay here under the qi grand lion's protection. Once I kill him, I'll return for you."

"Great-uncle, be careful!" Qi He said hurriedly.

Qi Zai nodded, air currents blasting behind him as he pursued Fang Yuan into the Five Regional Mountain Range.

Upon entering the mountain range, he felt a powerful repulsive force trying to push him out.

Created to replicate regional walls, entering the Five Regional Mountain Range subjected Gu Immortals to the same severe resistance.

Both stopped flying, proceeding on foot across the Five Regional Mountain Range.

In Central Continent's Earth Abyss, Ying Wu Xie checked treasure yellow heaven. Ying Wu Xie analyzed: "Hmm? Did Lang Ya land spirit just send dark limit Immortal Gu to Fang Yuan via treasure yellow heaven?"

"This Gu conceals aura from heaven's will. Hehe, indeed. If I am targeted, Fang Yuan's situation is even worse—he's probably facing Gu Immortals right now."

Fighting in the Five Regional Mountain Range left Fang Yuan heavily injured, but his lower cultivation allowed freer movement, enabling him to escape Qi Zai.

Seeing Fang Yuan escape and his own condition worsening, Qi Zai had no choice but to return.

Exiting the Five Regional Mountain Range, he saw Qi He.

"Great-uncle, you're finally back! I was so worried about you." Seeing Qi Zai, she quickly went up to him.

Qi Zai felt warmth, but his expression hardened as he scolded: "Foolish! I told you to stay with the qi grand lion. Why come here? It's dangerous!"

Her steps paused as she walked over with lowered head, apologizing: "I... I am sorry..."

Qi Zai grunted: "That man was heavily injured and barely escaped. If I see him again, I will definitely not... urgh!"

A dark flying sword had pierced his forehead, its tip protruding from the back of his head.

Qi He morphed back into Fang Yuan, who smiled faintly at Qi Zai.

He was dead.

# Chapter 1043: Surprising Discovery

Exhaling, Fang Yuan pulled flying sword Immortal Gu from his opponent's forehead.

This was because of the immortal killer move dark assassination!

It provided extraordinary concealment, leaking none of its aura to escape detection.

Its only weakness was a limited range—the user had to be within a hundred paces.

Thus, Fang Yuan used familiar face to approach Qi Zai for a lethal strike.

To lower Qi Zai's guard, Fang Yuan had purposely sustained injuries during their battle.

"Had you not pursued me so relentlessly, I wouldn't have risked killing you. Now, let's see why you were so insistent on hunting me."

Fang Yuan reached out and extracted Qi Zai's soul from his corpse.

Confirming the soul was harmless, he stored it in his aperture.

Soul search!

While searching the soul, Fang Yuan used familiar face to take on Qi Zai's appearance.

Disguised as Qi Zai, he stored the corpse and flew out of the Five Regional Mountain Range.

Entering the Five Regional Mountain Range had led to a shocking discovery.

His body was unaffected by the Five Regional Mountain Range!

Inside the mountain range, Fang Yuan had moved completely unhindered.

His confusion turned to joy as he realized: "Tao Zhu created this range imitating regional walls. If I can move freely here, can I pass them as well?"

"My body was formed from rank nine sovereign immortal fetus Gu. If treated as an Immortal Gu, that explains my free passage."

The five regional walls targeted Gu Immortals, not Immortal Gu.

"If this guess is correct, why rush to refine Fixed Immortal Travel?" Fang Yuan thought as he flew toward the regional wall.

Refining Fixed Immortal Travel required unobtainable light of the immemorial era, while his first earthly calamity was less than two months away.

With a foundation surpassing the ten extreme physiques, the power of his tribulations would be terrifying.

"I should abandon Fixed Immortal Travel and rush to Lang Ya blessed land to prepare for tribulations..."

# Chapter 1044: Ancient Cloud Beasts, Disaster Follows After Great Fortune?

Central Continent, Earth Abyss.

"My main body designed sovereign immortal fetus Gu to cross regional walls freely and disguise its aura as any region's native!"

Southern Border.

Sword escape Immortal Gu activated!

Zero obstruction!

# Chapter 1045: Fortuitous Encounter or Trouble?

The regional wall ahead suddenly turned deep blue.

Fang Yuan had crossed Southern Border's miasma regional wall and entered Eastern Sea's blue water regional wall.

Midway, Fang Yuan's expression changed, eyes widening in wonder.

He discovered that inside this blue water regional wall, his aura was mysteriously changing.

His Southern Border aura continuously faded while an Eastern Sea Gu Immortal aura steadily strengthened.

"Can this new body not only pass the five regional walls, but also adapt my aura to match the region?"

Emerging from the blue water regional wall, his aura fully matched an Eastern Sea immortal's.

Glancing at the pursuing cloud beasts, Fang Yuan sighed and activated familiar face to assume a new disguise.

Sword escape Immortal Gu was activated, gradually getting distance from the ancient cloud beasts.

Fang Yuan stopped sword escape Immortal Gu and continued flying with mortal killer moves.

As Fang Yuan glanced back worriedly, a blood-red light shot over from the southeast.

Soaring across the horizon, the blood-red light sensed Fang Yuan, slowed, and rapidly approached him.

He immediately changed direction, flying away from the approaching red light.

"Who is this person?!"

# Chapter 1046: Battle of Chase and Escape in Eastern Sea (1/3)

But once he took action, everyone was shaken.

Fang Yuan floated in the air, sneering without speaking.

"Zhou Li, what are you afraid of?" The third rank seven Gu Immortal stepped forward, waving his long sleeves.

"I have few Immortal Gu now..." Just then, Fang Yuan sensed something and paused, looking behind him.

The group of ancient cloud beasts was already within sight.

Seeing the group of ancient cloud beasts, Fang Yuan felt joy rather than irritation.

Tang Song gritted his teeth: "Soon! Once I capture you alive with this move, I'll deal with you personally."

# Chapter 1047: Battle of Chase and Escape in Eastern Sea (2/3)

"Don't think of leaving!" he shouted, pursuing Fang Yuan like lightning.

# Chapter 1048: Battle of Chase and Escape in Eastern Sea (3/3)

The phantom waves carrying Tang Song and Liu Qing Yu surged forward, engulfing Fang Yuan.

Fang Yuan felt a strong sense of pressure.

Though merely phantom images, the waves felt like a colossal tsunami devouring him.

Without the waves carrying them, the three immortals stopped moving.

Zhou Li unleashed an unstoppable tsunami that swallowed everything, outpacing sword escape Immortal Gu.

Fang Yuan's rank seven flying sword Immortal Gu proved ineffective against the phantom waves, just like against cloud beasts and mud monsters.

The three immortals saw that Fang Yuan did not evade, floating calmly with hands behind his back.

The three immortals shuddered, crying out mentally: "Oh no! He is fearless—is this where they are ambushing us?"

He even dispelled his defensive killer move, lion fur armor, before the three immortals.

Half a month later.

Looking back, the vague figures of ancient cloud beasts appeared in the regional wall. Fang Yuan sighed, activating sword escape Immortal Gu to fly northeast.

Fang Yuan did not know the exact location of Lang Ya blessed land.

Lang Ya land spirit had refused to reveal its location, only arranging a rendezvous point.

Three days later, Fang Yuan reached the meeting point, but found no one.

# Chapter 1049: Selling a Human Slave

Lang Ya blessed land, Black Hair Continent.

Lang Ya blessed land was arguably the world's greatest hairy man paradise.

The blessed land contained four continents: three sea-bound continents, and the smallest floating aloft—Cloud Cover Continent, a sacred realm hairy men longed to reach.

Steel Thread City's trading market, among the most renowned on Black Hair Continent, bustled with clamor.

Today, at the market's southeast corner, a burly, muscular hairy man stepped onto a stage.

Kang Ba was a well-known slave merchant who commanded a massive trade.

"Quiet, everyone." Kang Ba raised his hands to calm the crowd. "Without wasting time, I present the first slave. Bring him out!"

"Move it!" Behind the stage, a muscular black-haired hairy man yanked a chain.

At the chain's end was a slave covered in flesh-baring wounds.

It was Fang Zheng, who was interrogated earlier!

Standing up, he glared at the black-haired hairy man with stubborn defiance.

"Asking for a beating? Move!" Laughing, the hairy man reached out an arm thicker than Fang Zheng's leg and hoisted him by the neck.

Stepping onto the stage, the hairy man threw Fang Zheng down at the center.

Kang Ba pointed at Fang Zheng, announcing: "This slave is a rare breed, acquired with great difficulty!"

"He isn't weak—he has rank five cultivation!" someone gasped, noticing Fang Zheng's faint aura.

Kang Ba laughed: "You guess wrong—this slave is not a hairy man, but a purebred human!"

"He is a human?"

Hairy men dominated Lang Ya blessed land. Shock spread—most had only ever heard rumors of humans.

"Stand up properly." Kang Ba hooked his finger.

A formless force seized Fang Zheng's body, forcing him to stand on the stage.

Fang Zheng had never seen so vast a crowd of hairy men before.

Across the five regions, humans ruled and variant humans barely survived. Yet here, hairy men ruled and humans were suppressed!

Kang Ba feigned fury: "Who do you think I am? I trade with complete honesty. Look at him!"

Kang Ba stepped forward and clamped his fingers around Fang Zheng's chin and lips.

"Inspect him!" With a sharp rip, Kang Ba shredded Fang Zheng's shirt.

Fang Zheng shuddered, left stark naked before the crowd of hairy men.

Fang Zheng gritted his teeth, eyes blazing with fury and humiliation, wishing he could slaughter every hairy man present.

Kang Ba chuckled, prodding Fang Zheng's groin: "This still works! He can sire an endless supply of slaves."

Burning with humiliation, Fang Zheng would have bitten his tongue to commit suicide had Kang Ba not immobilized him.

"I will buy this slave," a distant voice called.

Turning toward the voice, the crowd saw a black-furred female hairy man gazing lustfully at Fang Zheng.

"Kang Ba, heal this slave, clean him up, and send him to my home tonight."

"As you command, beautiful, mighty city lord!" Kang Ba kowtowed in delight.

Fang Zheng shut his eyes, losing all hope in life.

Suddenly, thunder roared as the world trembled.

A five-colored light surged from Cloud Cover Continent, illuminating all of Lang Ya blessed land.

Drawn by the spectacle, the hairy men looked up in curiosity and awe, completely forgetting Fang Zheng.

# Chapter 1050: Recovering From Injuries

That day, brilliant light burst from Cloud Cover Continent.

Lang Ya land spirit's personality shift transformed everything.

Imitating the imperial court contest, the land spirit ordered the three continents to compete and select elite candidates for Cloud Cover Continent.

Black Hair King decreed: "This auspicious immortal miracle warrants a martial competition. The winner may choose a treasure from our treasury!"

Soon, half a month later.

Steel Thread City had an esteemed guest.

Steel Thread City Lord received this guest personally, as he was a fellow city lord.

"Steel Thread City Lord, you surely know why I've come," Hua Feng City Lord smiled, gesturing behind him. "The king's martial competition allows only three representatives per region. With slots limited, let us contest between ourselves to decide who goes!"

After several rounds, Hua Feng City swept every match, leaving Steel Thread City winless.

Hua Feng City Lord drank leisurely with a laugh, while Steel Thread City Lord frowned heavily: "Hua Feng City Lord brought true elites. If we get swept, the humiliation will spread, and we'll live beneath Hua Feng City's shadow for years."

"Only one match remains. Steel Thread City Lord, send your fighter," Hua Feng City Lord urged.

An elder secretly transmitted to Steel Thread City Lord: "City Lord, someone can salvage our reputation."

The elder continued: "City Lord, remember that rank five human slave you bought?"

Steel Thread City Lord transmitted bitterly: "Inappropriate! This contest with Hua Feng City Lord is an open matter of reputation. If this human slave wins, he must enter the martial competition. Won't the king reprimand me for sending a human instead of hairy men?"

The city lord had visited that slave, 'Fang Yuan', nearly every night since buying him, displeasing many higher-ups.

The elder replied: "Don't worry, City Lord. The king values talent above all, even employing snowman and featherman elders. If Fang Yuan loses, he takes the blame. If he wins, our reputation is saved, and sending him to the competition will surely earn the king's favor."

Steel Thread City Lord eyed the elder, thinking: "Scheming old fox! You only propose this because I neglected your nephew. If we win, Fang Yuan is sent away; if we lose, I must execute him for blame. Win or lose, I lose Fang Yuan."

Thus, she swapped fighters and briefed Fang Zheng.

After learning of the reason, Fang Zheng walked onto the stage.

"A rank five Gu Master!" Sensing the aura, Hua Feng City Lord grew instantly vigilant.

He smiled: "By the rules, my side chooses this round. Having tested combat strength, we cannot discard our hairy man traditions—this round will be Gu refinement!"

Steel Thread City Lord warned Fang Zheng: "Win at all costs—lose, and you pay with your life."

Fang Zheng heard this and was expressionless.

Humiliated endlessly, Fang Zheng had endured the city lord's unrestrained nocturnal lusts, leaving him wishing for death.

He yearned to die, but enslaved and controlled, even suicide was denied him.

In his mind, there was a thought: "Do I still want to live? I might as well surrender and die!"

Just then, a voice echoed in his mind: "Idiot! A real man endures humiliation and swallows his pride—this is nothing. If you have guts, take vengeance later and carve your tormentors to pieces. That is true greatness!"

"Who are you?!" Fang Zheng was shocked, he screamed out loud.

Opposite him, Hua Feng City's final Gu Master took the stage.

Assuming Fang Zheng addressed him, he puffed his chest: "I am Mao Shi Ba!"

Under everyone's gazes, the contest started.

Mao Shi Ba was Hua Feng City's strongest Gu Master, highly skilled in both combat and Gu refinement.

In contrast, Fang Zheng's Immortal Crane Sect cultivation focused on enslavement path, leaving him with rudimentary refinement skills.

Midway through, Mao Shi Ba built an immense lead, leaving Fang Zheng behind.

"Am I going to lose? Death is a release anyway," he sighed internally.

"Bullshit!" At this time, the voice spoke again.

The voice berated: "How can a real man falter before such a petty setback?"

"You... Fang Yuan?!" Fang Zheng recognized the voice.

"My main body is dead, leaving only this will. Watching my brother wallow without seeking vengeance disgusts me!"

Accustomed to communicating with souls, Fang Zheng conversed easily with the will.

Sensing Fang Zheng's hostility, Fang Yuan's will laughed: "If you hate me, why use my name?"

The will continued: "Refusing to reveal your real name under torture shows you still feel shame and hatred. Why not seize this chance to grow stronger? Winning enters you into the martial competition, freeing you from slavery and restoring your freedom!"

"I want vengeance and freedom too, but defeat is certain!" Fang Zheng replied furiously.

Fang Yuan's will laughed: "Follow my instructions and you will surpass Mao Shi Ba to win."

Stunned, Fang Zheng asked: "What scheme is it this time?"

"Hmph," the will snorted. "None of the hairy man Gu Immortals who killed me will escape. Avenge me!"

"Why should I help a monster who slaughtered our clan?!" Fang Zheng raged.

"No time to squabble. Add the three golds into the cauldron: profound gold, ice gold, then tear gold."

Fang Zheng gritted his teeth; despite hating Fang Yuan, this guidance offered his sole hope of surviving.

Within minutes, their laughter died as they stared at Fang Zheng in shock.

Raising his right hand, he displayed the Gu worm refined before their eyes.

"I won!" He breathed in deeply, declaring loudly.

Someone called out: "Look, the rainbow light from Cloud Cover Continent is fading!"

From the rainbow light, a figure walked out.

"It seems you've recovered," Lang Ya land spirit smiled at him.

"Yes," he nodded. "Thanks to first supreme elder."

This person was naturally Fang Yuan!

Lang Ya land spirit laughed: "To thank me, simply give me Dang Hun Mountain, Luo Po valley, or wisdom Gu."

Fang Yuan smiled: "Giving is impossible, but we can trade. What price will first supreme elder offer?"

"Ugh." Lang Ya land spirit's laughter stopped: "This..."

He was hesitant, awkwardness was written all over his face.

---

# Chapter 1051: Three Supreme True Inheritances

Fang Yuan was willing to trade, but what could Lang Ya land spirit offer?

Lang Ya land spirit started to pace around.

The previous land spirit would have traded instantly, but this new incarnation held entirely different priorities.

"The white-haired spirit stemmed from obsession with space escape Gu, caring only for refining Gu and nurturing refinement experts. But this black-haired spirit aims to make hairy men dominant—I can exploit that," Fang Yuan thought, patiently waiting as the spirit paced.

As Fang Yuan expected, the land spirit wrestled with himself before agreeing to trade.

"First supreme elder, the trade must suit both of us. If your offers cannot match my expectations, I'm afraid..." Fang Yuan purposely probed.

Lang Ya land spirit glared grumpily: "Don't worry! Lang Ya Sect's treasures rival those three things!"

Saying so, he handed Fang Yuan an information path Gu worm.

Shaking his head silently, Fang Yuan channeled primeval essence from his immortal essence and sent his consciousness into the bookworm.

The contents made his heart race with excitement.

Having spent considerable time recuperating in Lang Ya blessed land, Fang Yuan now faced an imminent aperture calamity.

Ying Wu Xie, Hei Lou Lan, Hu Immortal blessed land, and Fixed Immortal Travel paled in comparison—surviving this calamity was paramount!

Calamities and tribulations periodically strike an immortal aperture, intensifying with the depth of its foundation.

Though empty and unmanaged, Fang Yuan's immortal aperture possessed immense space, a deep time path foundation, and immunity to regional boundary restrictions. Far surpassing the ten extreme physiques combined, the tribulations he faced would be unprecedentedly perilous.

With only days remaining before the calamity, Fang Yuan felt deeply uncertain.

With his Immortal Gu lost, destroyed, or held by Ying Wu Xie, Fang Yuan was greatly weakened.

"How is it?" Lang Ya land spirit smiled and said.

Lang Ya land spirit said: "Lang Ya Sect has three foundations. First is my refinement path true inheritance. Second is Giant Sun Immortal Venerable's luck path true inheritance. Thirdly, the theft path true inheritance left by Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable. When my main body was alive, I had refined Gu for these two venerables, the payment I requested were one of each of their true inheritances."

"Of the three, Thieving Heaven's is least valuable, as my main body returned part of the payment. However, Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable's true inheritances all come in pairs. If you are lucky, after getting this true inheritance, and if the other true inheritance is not obtained yet, you might get clues to the second true inheritance."

"Only otherworldly demons can inherit most of Thieving Heaven's legacies. As an otherworldly demon, you could claim the paired inheritance if it remains available."

Having witnessed formless hand's power, Fang Yuan knew theft path methods could steal others' Immortal Gu, reaping massive spoils from battles.

Moreover, key methods Fang Yuan relied on—unfamiliar face, vaguely familiar face, and familiar face—were Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable's immortal killer moves.

"Giant Sun left only three true inheritances. Because I refined Eighty-Eight True Yang Building, this inheritance is far more valuable."

"Giant Sun's three true inheritances encompass his luck path methods: self luck, all living beings' luck, and heaven and earth luck. Self luck is here. The all living being's luck true inheritance was inside Imperial Court blessed land. As for the heaven and earth luck true inheritance, it is in Longevity Heaven."

Connect luck, break luck, and divert disaster Immortal Gu belonged to all living beings' luck, though the cultivation details were lost with Imperial Court blessed land.

"With divert disaster Immortal Gu, I could mimic Imperial Court blessed land and expel my calamities and tribulations." Fang Yuan knew luck path was immensely helpful against tribulations.

Even without Gu like divert disaster Immortal Gu, having higher luck would weaken his calamities and tribulations, allowing Fang Yuan to handle them much more easily.

"Fang Yuan, I suggest taking the self luck true inheritance; your luck seems terribly bad," Lang Ya land spirit said.

Lang Ya land spirit continued: "Actually, the true inheritance that suits you best is the first. Do you know refinement path's two styles?"

Lang Ya land spirit continued: "They are the hairy man heaven and earth style and the human isolation style. We hairy men refine Gu by using heaven and earth dao marks to create the optimal environment, raising the success rate."

"Both venerables sought my help because the hairy man heaven and earth style yielded far higher success rates."

"My main body conceptualized an immortal killer move using Old Immortal Kong Jue's true inheritance: immortal tribulation tempering aperture!"

"Immortal tribulation tempering aperture?" Fang Yuan's eyes gleamed with keen interest.

Lang Ya land spirit smiled proudly and continued explaining.

Immortal tribulation tempering aperture was formed from several Immortal Gu and over a hundred thousand mortal Gu.

Its ingenious concept treated the blessed land or grotto-heaven as the refinement target, connecting the immortal aperture with the five regions to steer calamities and tribulations into tempering the aperture itself.

"Immortal aperture calamities and tribulations are bizarre and difficult to handle, but this killer move restricts the types that occur. Lang Ya blessed land was placed at Crescent Lake because the region possessed abundant water and refinement path dao marks."

"Using immortal tribulation tempering aperture induced water and refinement calamities, granting the aperture corresponding dao marks upon passing."

Hearing this, Fang Yuan recalled Spectral Soul using myriad tribulations to refine sovereign immortal fetus Gu.

"Immortal tribulation tempering aperture shares a very similar concept with Spectral Soul's method. Given Shadow Sect's spies in Lang Ya blessed land, perhaps Spectral Soul's method originated from it?"

"Alright, you have Luo Po valley, Dang Hun Mountain, and wisdom Gu, while I have three true inheritances. We can trade one-for-one—which do you want?" Lang Ya land spirit asked.

This time, it was Fang Yuan's turn to decide.

What should he choose?

# Chapter 1052: Listed on the Board, Heavenly Court's Pursuit

Central Continent, Hu Immortal blessed land.

Fairy Zi Wei slowly opened her eyes.

Exhaling, she dispelled her wisdom path killer move and descended from the air.

"Greetings, Ancestor Zi Wei." On the ground, the long-waiting Feng Jin Huang respectfully knelt upon seeing Fairy Zi Wei.

Your father has stunning talents and is astonishingly gifted, he is someone who will leave a deep mark in history, what's more, he repays kindness and hatred, he is loyal and righteous. I understand why he requested this of you."

But that will be my bottom line, I hope that you two will not become too persistent and commit a huge mistake."

Feng Jin Huang lowered her head: "I shall engrave your words in mind, ancestor."

Inside, Fairy Zi Wei's main body sat conferring with two Heavenly Court Gu Immortals.

It resolved into a will, several Immortal Gu, and several beads of immortal essence.

Storing them into her aperture, Fairy Zi Wei reviewed the will's deductions.

Moments later, she opened her deep, dark eyes and said calmly: "We have already found clues to Fang Yuan."

Meanwhile, on the banks of Central Continent's Pot River.

In Wind Cloud Manor's territory, Ying Wu Xie risked remaining for three days despite being wanted across Central Continent.

Glancing at the Gu worm in Ying Wu Xie's hand to confirm its target, the green grass puppet haughtily droned: "Master was invited to Ancestor Kong Kong's treasure appraisal event and could not come. To see him, wait three more days."

"Lacking patience? Then don't wait; I'll inform Master immediately," the green grass puppet spoke indifferently.

"I will wait," Ying Wu Xie smiled. "Having waited three days, three more do no harm. But after six days total, I must abandon this transaction."

Once the grass puppet disappeared from sight, three Gu Immortals emerged from the surroundings and gathered around Ying Wu Xie.

Shi Nu sighed helplessly: "Refining Fixed Immortal Travel requires the light of the immemorial era. And the light of the immemorial era, such a rare Gu refinement material, is one of the treasures of Wind Cloud Manor. We have no choice but to put up with them."

Ying Wu Xie coldly snorted, but did not speak.

To rescue his main body, he had to cross the regional wall; unlike Fang Yuan, Fixed Immortal Travel was practically essential for him to do so.

He thought: "With Spring Autumn Cicada sealed, Heavenly Court is investigating me. Once Fixed Immortal Travel is refined, I must rush to Northern Plains! Perhaps I can even make use of the power to conveniently get rid of Fang Yuan. Hmm? No, considering the time, tomorrow should be the day Fang Yuan has his earthly calamity. The earthly calamity of sovereign immortal aperture won't be easy to pass. Heaven's will cannot affect Fang Yuan, but can still make arrangements to deal with him. Most likely, not only will there be calamities and tribulations, there could also be human disasters."

# Chapter 1053: Fang Yuan Undergoes Tribulation (1/5)

"To think I am back here again." Fang Yuan sighed inwardly, descending from the sky.

Located at the northernmost end of Northern Plains, it was known as the northern icy plain.

Originally a grassland, the entire terrain had been utterly destroyed into a void of nothingness by a devastating battle between experts.

Afterward, the victor, Reckless Savage Demon Venerable, transformed into an immemorial desolate ice phoenix, exhaling absolute profound ice to freeze and restore this place.

Earlier, Hei Lou Lan had chosen this place to undergo her immortal ascension.

The icy plain held Reckless Savage Demon Venerable's strength path and transformation path true meaning. When Gu Masters of those paths ascended here, dao mark resonance caused that true meaning to manifest within the earthly calamity.

Upon destroying the earthly calamity, the ascendant would receive an infusion of true meaning, equivalent to Reckless Savage Demon Venerable's direct guidance.

"Strength and transformation path Gu Masters only receive Reckless Savage's true meaning during ascension. With immortal tribulation tempering aperture, I might replicate it."

After talking with Lang Ya land spirit, he realized there was a high possibility of success.

"Hei Lou Lan barely passed her ascension by sacrificing Immortal Gu. My aperture's calamity will be far more terrifying!"

"This immortal aperture's massive tributary of the River of Time forces me to undergo tribulation every two months in the outside world. After this calamity, I need to find some time path methods to modify the tributary of the River of Time in my immortal aperture."

Fang Yuan exhaled as his body shook, a mystical change occurring in his immortal aperture.

"Immortal aperture, fall here!" Fang Yuan gritted his teeth, mystical light shining in his eyes.

With a loud sound, his vision shifted, placing him inside his immortal aperture.

Five regions, nine heavens.

Only all sorts of Gu worms were placed in here.

At this moment, countless Gu worms flew around Fang Yuan, resembling a giant black cloud.

Fang Yuan could move freely within the aperture, which connected to external heaven and earth qi to stabilize itself.

Where Fang Yuan had stood, he had vanished; placed on the ice and anchored in space, the immortal aperture was invisible.

Yet the next moment, when Fang Yuan opened the entrance of the immortal aperture, everything changed.

Instantly, the surroundings rumbled and glaciers shook as endless heaven and earth qi rushed through the entrance into the immortal aperture.

At the same time, the tributary of the River of Time fused with the external River of Time, greatly slowing the aperture's rate of time.

A sudden sensation informed Fang Yuan that the calamity was coming.

Because the immortal aperture was placed outside and time slowed, Fang Yuan could clearly sense the calamity approaching at a 'slower' rate.

Rich in experience, he began organizing his Gu worms upon seeing the heaven and earth qi.

Within minutes, the arrangements were complete; Fang Yuan promptly injected immortal essence, activating the Gu worms.

Immortal Gu flew up one by one, shining with bright lights while floating in the sky.

The lights weaved together, resonating with the Gu worms outside.

A huge blue image formed, engulfing the immortal aperture and expanding outside to cover a vast area of the icy plain.

Immortal killer move — Immortal Tribulation Tempering Aperture!

Over ten thousand immortal essence beads were expended, yet this was just the start!

With mostly rank seven core Immortal Gu, Fang Yuan's green grape immortal essence drained rapidly.

Thankfully, he had obtained many immortal essence stones from Lang Ya land spirit and even borrowed Heavenly Essence Treasure Imperial Lotus.

Fifteen minutes later, the killer move finished, consuming sixty percent of Fang Yuan's immortal essence.

"This expenditure far exceeds Lang Ya land spirit's estimate. But as he mentioned, the cost varies with the immortal aperture itself."

He felt that the calamity was close.

Fang Yuan retrieved his Gu worms, closed the entrance, and waited patiently inside the immortal aperture.

An hour later, the calamity descended.

The immortal aperture shook as heaven and earth qi surged from every direction.

Within the aperture, the internal heaven and earth qi clashed, instantly forming a blizzard.

Wild snow and fierce winds instantly transformed the immortal aperture into an icy world.

Seeing this, Fang Yuan was overjoyed: "Did the immortal tribulation tempering aperture method work?"

As the blizzard rampaged through the aperture, snow monsters formed one after another.

"Snow monster calamity? Slash!" Fang Yuan thought, floating behind a barrier of Gu worms as he fired flying sword Immortal Gu.

Flying sword Gu pierced a snow monster's head and exited the back.

In an instant, it flew back to Fang Yuan.

The snow monster howled, its head wound healing instantly as it continued charging at Fang Yuan.

Like mud monsters and cloud beasts, snow monsters were troublesome opponents, hard to kill unless their core was destroyed.

Flying sword Gu alone could not be effective.

"But I am using a sword path killer move," Fang Yuan smiled coldly.

The snow monster ran a few steps before collapsing into a pile of snow, its core destroyed as if its bones had melted.

Sword path killer move — Sword Marks Targeting Death!

# Chapter 1054: Fang Yuan Undergoes Tribulation (2/5)

"I can obviously reverse refine these Immortal Gu. And to reverse refine them from rank seven to rank six will be much easier than promoting them to rank seven from rank six. But don't you find it a waste? More importantly, reverse refinement takes time, and your tribulation is nearing. It won't be ready in time. You might as well use this killer move."

Lang Ya land spirit had provided this killer move to Fang Yuan before the tribulation. Sword marks targeting death expended dao marks from the Immortal Gu, carving them onto targets to destroy their weak spots.

The sharp sword light plunged into the blizzard, piercing straight through the storm.

Drawing an arc through the sky, the sword light pierced a desolate beast snow monster's chest and back before returning to Fang Yuan.

The desolate beast snow monster laughed as its wounds healed, but before it could move, its body collapsed into a pile of snow.

Within a breath, dozens of small snow monsters emerged from the pile.

Standing only ten to twenty feet tall, these snow monsters posed no threat.

Another sword marks targeting death!

The move was extremely effective, destroying desolate beast snow monsters in one hit.

Ten-to-twenty-foot snow monsters could be handled by rank one or two Gu Masters. Sixty-foot ones were desolate beasts rivaling rank six Gu Immortals, while seventy-foot ones matched rank seven Gu Immortals.

Fang Yuan's expression focused.

Observing closely, he noticed the small snow monsters spawned from dead desolate beasts were growing in size.

These snow monsters were growing stronger!

"If they keep growing, will they become sixty-foot desolate beasts?" Not daring to be careless, Fang Yuan stopped using Flying Sword and waved his hands, releasing countless dark vortexes.

A catastrophe befell the snow monsters, killing them in droves.

Yet more soon spawned from the smaller snow monsters' corpses.

Fang Yuan killed dozens of snow monsters, but over a hundred came back up!

Observing carefully, he saw that while the respawned snow monsters were more numerous, they were much smaller.

Forming a guess, Fang Yuan unleashed thousands of green wind blades around him.

The wind blades descended like a vast net, engulfing the snow monsters on the ground.

The desolate beast snow monsters remained intact, but the small ones were sliced to pieces.

Fang Yuan activated investigative Gu, his eyes shining as he observed the battlefield.

"As expected, ten-foot snow monsters cannot produce more upon dying." Confirming his guess, he relaxed slightly.

Soon, inspiration struck: "Is this because of the blizzard?"

Splitting his focus, he activated over a hundred mortal Gu within a few breaths.

A domain of darkness formed beneath his feet, creating a dark veil.

This was Hei Cheng's battlefield killer move — Dark Veil.

Once dark veil was used, the surrounding blizzard weakened.

As expected, the small snow monsters' growth slowed down.

However, the blizzard intensified as if enraged, compressing the dark veil until it shrunk to Fang Yuan's feet and collapsed with a bang.

"Desolate beast snow monsters spawn endlessly, and smaller ones strengthen in the blizzard. Isolating it is futile. I must eliminate them all directly," Fang Yuan concluded.

He realized this earthly calamity was not only vast and prolonged, but far stronger than the ten great catastrophes!

As desolate beast snow monsters multiplied, sword marks targeting death could no longer kill them quickly enough.

Due to the sheer number of small snow monsters, Fang Yuan had to use mortal killer moves to cull them.

"Thankfully, these snow monsters cannot fly. Despite the blizzard, holding the high ground keeps the initiative with me."

Just as that thought crossed his mind, a loud eagle screech pierced his ears.

Fang Yuan raised his head, his expression turning dark—this was bad!

Iron crown eagles made of snow formed within the blizzard.

An eagle flapped its wings, charging ferociously at Fang Yuan.

Fang Yuan swiftly turned, unleashing sword marks targeting death at the eagle.

Yet three more iron crown eagles soon formed, circling to surround him.

# Chapter 1055: Fang Yuan Undergoes Tribulation (3/5)

Three iron crown eagles charged at Fang Yuan.

Sword marks targeting death!

The killer move failed to activate, the backlash causing blood to trickle from his mouth.

The iron crown eagle in front of him pounced.

Cranes flew out of the spirals.

With pure white feathers, graceful forms, and beautiful cries, these were desolate beast nine palace cranes.

Killing one indeed brought an infusion of true meaning, making his eyes shine with excitement.

Amid falling snow and wild winds, Fang Yuan battled the nine palace cranes.

Fang Yuan resolved to end this as soon as possible.

"In this situation, I must use the third sword path killer move!"

Immortal killer move — Triple Layered Sword Wave.

Just as Fang Yuan was about to strike the snow monsters, a colossal figure descended.

# Chapter 1056: Fang Yuan Undergoes Tribulation (4/5)

"It's only my first earthly calamity, yet there are so many desolate beast snow monsters and even an ancient ruin bat..." Fang Yuan looked up bitterly.

The colossal ancient ruin bat cast a shadow over Fang Yuan and the countless snow monsters.

Sword path killer move — Triple Layered Sword Wave.

Shining with silvery-white light, the waves were razor-sharp and possessed terrifying offensive power.

Severed by the third sword wave, the ancient ruin bat 'slimmed down', its massive body shrinking considerably.
