In an instant, Fang Yuan's state of mind was scattered.

After a momentary daze, Fang Yuan snapped to awareness, his unfocused eyes turning sharp.

"Taking in too much true meaning is like a snake trying to swallow an elephant—I could burst and die!" Realizing this, cold sweat dripped down Fang Yuan's forehead.

"I have little immortal essence left, thankfully, the ancient ruin bat is already dead..."

Fang Yuan floated in the sky, looking down.

The ruin bat's corpse hit the ground, disintegrating into snow.

Yet a hundred desolate beast snow monsters and countless smaller ones roamed the ground, while seventy-foot-tall ancient desolate snow monsters began emerging!

Two ancient ruin bats started to form in the blizzard.

Fang Yuan shook, his expression ashen as he cursed internally: "I might as well die! What sort of earthly calamity is this? Even heavenly tribulations aren't this terrifying!"

Gritting his teeth, Fang Yuan shot out like an arrow to seize the initiative.

Just then, a new blizzard began descending from the sky.

Several carriage-sized snowballs hurtled toward him, but thanks to his quasi-grandmaster flying attainment, Fang Yuan dodged in time.

Fang Yuan's heart sank. Obstructed by the snowballs, his strike would be delayed; once both ancient ruin bats formed, he would surely fail the tribulation!

While Fang Yuan faced dire peril in his immortal aperture, another person was also undergoing tribulation on the icy plain.

This was a Gu Master's immortal ascension, with heaven and earth qi coalescing into the tribulation.

"Master, save me!" the Gu Master cried, helplessly watching death descend beneath the onslaught of frost lightning.

At the crucial moment, a figure stepped before the ascending Gu Master.

The frost lightning that overwhelmed the Gu Master proved fragile as paper before this person.

"This is merely the flying frost jumping lightning tribulation, not even one of the ten great catastrophes." Gu Immortal Chu Du remained expressionless, regarding the lingering frost lightning with regret.

"In the northern icy plain, strength path ascensions trigger Reckless Savage's true meaning, causing strength and transformation path attainments to soar."

"The stronger the tribulation, the more true meaning gathers. I nurtured you disciples specifically to obtain Reckless Savage's true meaning during your ascensions, allowing my strength path attainment to rise."

"So that's it," the Gu Master realized. "This is the help Master spoke of when accepting me as a disciple?"

Before Chu Du could reply, a loud rumble echoed from afar.

"Hmm?" Chu Du looked over to see distant space shattered like a mirror, revealing Fang Yuan battling ancient ruin bats inside his immortal aperture.

"This?!" Chu Du's body shook, his eyes were shining immediately.

# Chapter 1057: Fang Yuan Undergoes Tribulation (5/5)

Chu Du.

Known as Domination Immortal, a legendary person in Northern Plains' Gu Immortal world!

Their eyes locked across the distance in an instant!

Clad in a white robe and injured, Fang Yuan's gaze was piercing; his surging battle intent resembled a divine sword, making even Chu Du frown.

"Someone is undergoing tribulation? That ancient ruin bat manifested through the tribulation carries Reckless Savage's true meaning! He actually has a method to replicate immortal ascension and extract Reckless Savage's true meaning for himself!" Chu Du's shock instantly turned to joy.

"Domination Immortal Chu Du!" Fang Yuan was shocked. "He's assisting an ascension, clearly after Reckless Savage's true meaning. Seeing this, he will definitely come after me!"

"As long as I can get his method, why would I need to bother with raising disciples for immortal ascension? I can undergo tribulations myself and draw in Reckless Savage's true meaning, the tribulations would be stronger and I would obtain even more true meaning, that would be best! I must, I must get this method!!" Chu Du screamed in his mind, he shot towards Fang Yuan like a flash of lightning.

"Huh?" Chu Du reached toward Fang Yuan in the immortal aperture, but a sword light shot at him first.

He reacted quickly, but Fang Yuan was even faster!

Instantly, Fang Yuan unleashed sword marks targeting death and fired flying sword Immortal Gu.

Chu Du chuckled, extending his right arm to snatch Flying Sword.

Boom!

A massive strength path phantom hand compressed the air like a rampaging mountain, swiftly grabbing flying sword Immortal Gu.

Chu Du's strength path phantom hand was visibly far stronger and more agile than his.

Snatching flying sword Immortal Gu, Chu Du clenched his fist, directly sealing it.

Fang Yuan instantly felt his connection to flying sword Immortal Gu weaken severely.

Chu Du frowned almost imperceptibly, opening his fist to find a trace of blood in his palm.

It was the killer move sword marks targeting death's effect.

"Hand over the method and I will spare your life. Hmm?" Chu Du began, but looking up, his expression changed.

At the crucial moment, Fang Yuan severed his lower body, refining it into a pool of blood with a blood path killer move.

The blood fused into the aperture's breach, instantly sealing the spatial crack.

Chu Du swiftly attacked with his strength path giant hand.

A moment too late, he missed his chance. The giant hand slammed empty ground like a meteor, gouging a crater dozens of meters wide.

Chu Du flew to the spot where the immortal aperture had been placed, looking grim. He lacked any method to breach it.

"Damn it! Why did I encounter Domination Immortal?" Severely injured, Fang Yuan floated inside his immortal aperture with only his upper half remaining, having refined his lower body.

Gu worms suppressed the intense pain, allowing Fang Yuan to face the two ancient ruin bats with calm composure.

"I must kill these two ruin bats immediately!" Fang Yuan gritted his teeth, his expression ruthless.

Triple layered sword wave!

He unleashed the killer move repeatedly, crashing waves against the ancient ruin bats.

Ugh!

Blood spurted from Fang Yuan's seven orifices as dizziness nearly caused him to faint.

To protect his aperture walls, Fang Yuan desperately intercepted every attack from the ancient ruin bats.

Eventually, a gust of wind blew, bringing a flash of clarity back to his dazed eyes.

He had slain one ancient ruin bat, leaving just one more.

Licking his dry lips, his paper-pale face contorted as he charged the ancient ruin bat again.

Facing a single ancient ruin bat, Fang Yuan felt less pressure, making rational decisions to counterattack.

Eventually, the heaven and earth qi settled. Fang Yuan slew the third ancient ruin bat; no more formed, and Chu Du remained outside.

"The calamity has ended. I survived!" Fang Yuan looked down weakly at the frozen landscape, where countless growling desolate snow monsters glared up at him.

"My aperture contains no resources yet, so I'll leave these snow monsters be." Fang Yuan flew to the first heaven.

He needed to heal his injuries while preparing for battle.

# Chapter 1058: Blood Asset Immortal Gu

Three days later, inside the sovereign immortal aperture.

After passing the tribulation, Fang Yuan had stayed in the first layer of the nine heavens to heal.

Fang Yuan was submerged hundreds of feet beneath a vast lake of blood.

He was gravely injured; with his lower body severed, only his upper torso floated in the blood lake.

After three days, a faint blood-colored silhouette of his legs and lower body began taking shape.

Suddenly, Fang Yuan opened his eyes.

"Blood path body refinement, restore my immortal body!" Fang Yuan shouted internally as countless thoughts collided.

Mobilized by his thoughts, tens of thousands of mortal Gu shone with dazzling light.

A rank six Immortal Gu rose from Fang Yuan's body.

Blood path Immortal Gu — Blood Asset!

Blood asset Immortal Gu protected materials and Gu worms during refinement, recovering a portion if refinement failed.

In ordinary hands, this Gu was limited to refinement path; but as a blood path grandmaster, Fang Yuan could display its full power and apply it far beyond its original limits.

Spinning rapidly above Fang Yuan's head, blood asset Immortal Gu drained the vitality from the blood lake.

After purification, a visible stream of life force resembling translucent water poured into Fang Yuan's body.

Infused with vitality, the translucent silhouette of his lower body began solidifying into physical form.

In the blink of an eye, Fang Yuan's severe injuries healed, his flesh fully restored!

Fang Yuan shot from the blood lake like an arrow, hovering in midair.

Scanning the area, he nodded in satisfaction: "This body from sovereign immortal fetus Gu is truly profound. Having non-conflicting dao marks of every path is miraculous. I can use healing methods of any path with full effect. Otherwise, how could I recover from such grievous injuries in just three days?"

Fang Yuan reached out, and blood asset Immortal Gu shot from the lake like a meteor into his palm.

Admiring the Immortal Gu for a moment, Fang Yuan placed it against his chest.

Blood asset Immortal Gu settled onto his chest, transforming into a red pearl tattoo.

"In my previous five hundred years, I failed to find a single blood path Immortal Gu and had no choice but to refine Spring Autumn Cicada. Had I possessed it back then, I would have achieved far more and faced the encirclement of the ten great ancient sects with confidence."

With blood path grandmaster attainment, Fang Yuan lacked only a blood path Immortal Gu.

With it, he could readily adapt his mortal killer moves into immortal ones, causing his battle strength to surge!

Stowing blood asset Immortal Gu, Fang Yuan thought: "Three days have passed without an attack; Chu Du evidently lacks methods to breach an immortal aperture."

Though unable to breach the sovereign immortal aperture, Chu Du could easily guard the area outside.

Desperate for Reckless Savage's true meaning, how could a strength path Gu Immortal like Chu Du ever surrender such an opportunity?

"I'm trapped here for now. If I pack up my immortal aperture and use Sword Escape, can I outrun Chu Du's pursuit?"

"Sword escape Immortal Gu is fast but flies in a straight line, needing to stop to turn. That works against ordinary Gu Immortals, but against Domination Immortal, I need an immortal killer move."

"I have sword escape Immortal Gu, but my sword path attainment is too low. Blood path offers more hope. I must adapt mortal moves to create a blood path movement killer move using blood asset Immortal Gu as the core!"

# Chapter 1059: Dog Shit Splits Luck

Western Desert, on a certain trail.

Sounds of fierce combat echoed around a sandy dune as bandits clashed with caravan guards.

Some featherman Gu Masters guarded the goods on the ground, while others took flight to battle the bandits.

The bandits soon held the upper hand with minimal losses, while the caravan suffered heavy casualties.

Han Li lay among the goods, his body covered in blood and his face charred.

"Damn it! Am I going to die here today?" Despair gripped Han Li.

"Run!"

With defeat certain, the caravan members fled for their lives.

"Why aren't you running?" a featherman Gu Master asked, approaching Han Li.

Han Li gasped, unsure what to do; he recognized this featherman Gu Master as the caravan leader.

"Though your cultivation is low, you are far superior to those fleeing humans!" The featherman leader sighed, patting Han Li's shoulder.

With glowing hands, he patted Han Li three times, instantly healing his injuries!

"The power of a rank four Gu Master!" Shocked, Han Li went to thank him, but the leader had already charged back into battle.

Whoosh—!

Everyone looked over as someone screamed: "Oh no! A golden thread tornado!"

The fast-moving tornado swept in from the distance, closing in on the battlefield.

The tornado struck, sweeping away a helpless Han Li along with several feathermen and mounds of cargo.

Swept into the vortex, Han Li's vision spun wildly; tossed about like a petal in the raging winds, he was in mortal danger.

With a sudden impact against rock or cargo, he blacked out immediately.

"Young man, you're finally awake," an old man sitting beside him said faintly.

"Who are you?" Han Li asked in a daze, looking around to find himself on the sand amid scattered rocks, corpses, and cargo.

"If I did not save you, how could you survive?" The old man smiled.

The old man nodded approvingly: "Before becoming an immortal, I was just like you. That tornado was caused by my defeat against Tian Jin... Before dying, I will bestow my life's true inheritance upon you."

Central Continent.

Inside Broken Sword Valley.

Outside Broken Sword Valley, Hong Yi spotted a frenzied mob of Gu Masters rushing his way, including rank three and four experts.

Paling, Hong Yi quickly dodged out of their path.

Overhearing snippets from the passersby soon explained the commotion to him.

"I heard there is a rank four sword qi Gu."

"A rank four Sword Qi Gu?!" Hong Yi's heart leaped with envy.

He quickly ran into the valley.

"Rank four wild Gu are exceedingly rare; even if I found one, it would be too dangerous to catch," Hong Yi thought, exploring the valley carefully.

Moving away from the crowd, he spotted something shocking in an ordinary spot.

It was a common caterpillar molting.

Hong Yi was stunned before recognizing the scene, overjoyed: "Such luck! I arrived right as the insect becomes a Gu. Its aura is... so strong! Rank four or rank five?"

Unable to wait for the caterpillar to finish molting, Hong Yi quickly grabbed it.

A moment later, he succeeded in refining a strange rank five sword path Gu—black, palm-sized, and shaped like a miniature iron sword sheath.

Rank five sword sheath Gu!

"What's the use of this Gu? Even with a rank five Gu, my primeval essence can't activate it." Hong Yi sighed, when suddenly, a sword path Gu flew from a nearby bush and settled into the sword sheath Gu in his hand.

Hong Yi was shocked, at once he was speechless.

Southern Border, on a nameless small mountain.

It was night time, a huge rainstorm was pouring down.

"Shang Xin Ci, your life ends here today." A muscular man walked toward the peak, hands behind his back.

Beside her stood Shang Xin Ci, her silky hair cascading and skin pale as snow.

Seeing him approach, Shang Xin Ci smiled bitterly: "Shang Bi Xi, to think it was really you. Why must you fight to the death with me?"

Shang Bi Xi laughed: "Father, elder brother, and Chao Feng are dead. Once you die, eighth brother becomes clan leader!"

"Lady Xin Ci, why waste words on this scumbag!" Ye Fan frowned, his tone dripping with utter hatred and disgust toward Shang Bi Xi.

"I will not leave!" Ye Fan shouted: "Lady Xin Ci, you saved me. A drop received in need is repaid with a whole spring—how could I abandon you?"

"At peak condition, I'd have to be wary of you. But with your primeval essence exhausted, you're no threat. Hahaha." Shang Bi Xi laughed, stepping toward Shang Xin Ci.

Shang Xin Ci shut her eyes, giving up futile resistance.

One thought emerged in her mind: If only I could see him one last time before dying.

Shang Xin Ci opened her eyes in confusion, only to see Shang Bi Xi standing motionless a few steps ahead.

Stiff as a statue, an expression of fear was frozen on his face.

"Hmph, disregarding kinship for mere wealth and authority, you are truly a disgrace to Shang clan!" A female immortal appeared.

"You are?" Shang Xin Ci was shocked.

The female immortal looked at Shang Xin Ci approvingly, saying warmly: "Don't be afraid, I am Shang clan ancestor Shang Qing Qing. From now on, you will be Shang clan leader."

---

# Chapter 1060: Pot River, Luck Inspection

Resembling a long jade belt, Pot River lay in eastern Central Continent.

Ying Wu Xie stood on the bank of Pot River, waiting for Feng Chan Zi.

Meanwhile, Hei Lou Lan, Shi Nu, and Tai Bai Yun Sheng hid nearby, guarding Ying Wu Xie.

"Spring Autumn Cicada is sealed, leaving me watched by heaven's will. It can influence my emotions and plot attacks against me. I cannot give heaven's will time to prepare. If Feng Chan Zi does not appear soon, I must leave."

Ying Wu Xie made up his mind.

Just then, a green figure flew rapidly over Pot River toward Ying Wu Xie.

"It is that rank six level grass puppet avatar!"

Seeing Ying Wu Xie, the grass puppet avatar said arrogantly: "The light of the immemorial era is with me, but Master said the earlier price won't do—you must add thirty percent!"

"What? Another thirty percent?"

Ying Wu Xie was furious, but had no choice. The light of the immemorial era was essential to refine Fixed Immortal Travel, with no alternatives.

After a brief silence, Ying Wu Xie nodded: "I agree."

The grass puppet avatar snorted: "Then let's trade."

Ying Wu Xie was well prepared; both sides transacted quickly.

Though Ying Wu Xie suffered a huge loss and paid a steep price, obtaining the light of the immemorial era left him overall pleased.

The grass puppet avatar said, "Master only traded because he lost a bet to Lang Zi Qiu and wanted to recoup his losses. Remember this: my master definitely did not give the light of the immemorial era to you!"

Concealing their traces, Shadow Sect's group flew a hundred thousand li and rested in a nameless forest.

"The important thing is, how many refinement attempts will this portion of light allow?" Hei Lou Lan got straight to the point.

"This portion of light of the immemorial era can last for nine refinement attempts," Ying Wu Xie said, pausing.

He secretly activated an Immortal Gu in his body.

Rank six luck inspection Immortal Gu!

This investigative Gu worm could inspect a person's luck.

Ying Wu Xie's eyes shone as he looked above him.

An illusory luck pillar appeared in Ying Wu Xie's eyes.

Ying Wu Xie was taken aback: "Eh? Why did my luck suddenly improve so much?"

When he had inspected his luck earlier, it was terrible, continuing to decline due to Spring Autumn Cicada's drawback.

But now, it was much better than his initial assessment!

"Earlier, Shadow Sect invaded Lang Ya blessed land and took part of Refinement Cauldron, accidentally destroying Dog Shit Luck Immortal Gu. Lang Ya land spirit prepared to re-refine it and apparently succeeded recently. Perhaps he already lent Dog Shit Luck to Fang Yuan."

"Fang Yuan originally connected his luck equally with several people. After the battle of Yi Tian Mountain, his body is mine while his soul remains his—both tied to the connected luck."

"When he uses Dog Shit Luck Immortal Gu to raise his luck, it flows down to Ye Fan, Han Li, Hong Yi, and Hei Lou Lan. Since their luck connects to my body, I benefit as well."

"No wonder I waited so long with slim hopes, only for Feng Chan Zi to suddenly lose a bet to Lang Zi Qiu and trade with me to recoup his losses!"

Upon reflection, Ying Wu Xie realized Fang Yuan's immense value!

"His immortal aperture faces tribulations every two months; he must have used Dog Shit Luck to weaken the earthly calamity. This way, I benefit too! I don't need to go to Northern Plains to borrow luck from Longevity Heaven!"

"Even knowing this strengthens his enemies, he has no choice. The sovereign immortal aperture's tribulations defy logic, forcing him to do everything possible to survive every crisis! However... But there, Reckless Savage's true meaning replaced a portion of heaven's will, greatly reducing the danger. Hmph, survive this—I will reclaim your body one day!"

After a brief rest in the nameless forest, Ying Wu Xie and the others resumed their journey.

He was pressed for time.

Not only was his main body's remnant soul in constant danger within the dream realm, he also had to seize this good luck to refine Fixed Immortal Travel while success chances were highest!

Northern Plains, northern icy plain.

"Master, how long must we stay here?" the newly advanced strength path Gu Immortal asked meekly.

Standing on the icy plain, Chu Du gazed at his handprint on the ground and sighed.

"I was too rash earlier. Why did I attack without thinking?"

"It's not too late to salvage the situation. Maybe we can talk? Right, I still hold his sword path Immortal Gu—a valuable bargaining chip!"

# Chapter 1061: Blood Torrent

Northern Plains.

Inside the sovereign immortal aperture's first layer of heaven.

Fang Yuan opened his eyes slowly, his pupils flashed.

"I'll keep its original name—blood torrent." At Fang Yuan's will, the Gu worms scattered around him.

Hundreds of mortal Gu circled around him.

Blood Asset Immortal Gu resided in his chest, its red insignia glowing with burning heat.

Suddenly, dazzling blood-red light shot from Fang Yuan's chest.

The blood-red light surged skyward, turning into a vast stream of blood.

Within the river of blood-red light, Fang Yuan was completely concealed. Even if enemies attacked, they would not know which part of the river to target.

After flying for a while, Fang Yuan stopped moving.

The river of blood-red light vanished, leaving Fang Yuan standing alone.

"This river can be even faster if I add more mortal Gu," Fang Yuan concluded from the experience.

"But no matter how many mortal Gu I add, the linear speed cannot match sword escape Immortal Gu."

Sword Escape was rank seven, while Blood Torrent used only rank six Blood Asset; naturally, its speed was inferior.

"Inferior linear speed was expected and is not a problem. I deduced this immortal killer move to change directions while traveling, compensating for Sword Escape Immortal Gu's flaw. By using Blood Torrent and Sword Escape Immortal Gu alternately, I can barely deal with Chu Du," Fang Yuan reasoned.

As a strength path Gu Immortal, Chu Du excelled in offense, recovery, and battle endurance, but strength path typically lacked speed.

Though he had deduced Blood Torrent, he still needed to practice and refine it through use.

In the ensuing days, Fang Yuan practiced using Blood Torrent alongside Sword Escape Immortal Gu.

As he practiced and modified the move, he stopped adding mortal Gu to Blood Torrent, instead removing certain Gu worms.

"I need Blood Torrent to pair with Sword Escape for rapid direction changes—too many mortal Gu only make activation clumsy. Not only does it waste time and complicate activation, the minor speed increase is negligible."

"It is ready enough. Time to pack up the immortal aperture and see if I can escape Chu Du."

Using Blood Asset Immortal Gu as the core alongside mortal killer moves from his past life's five hundred years, he created three blood path killer moves: life staking blood print, blood healing lake, and blood torrent.

Though his sovereign immortal aperture was secure and hard to attack, Fang Yuan had to be wary of Chu Du gathering reinforcements or setting up an immortal battlefield on the icy plain.

Having made up his mind, Fang Yuan hesitated no longer.

At his will, the entire immortal aperture started shaking.

As the tremors intensified, the immortal aperture world began to shrink.

Shrinking at incredible speed, it vanished in an instant. Fang Yuan opened his eyes, back outside on the northern icy plain.

Focusing his mind, Fang Yuan scanned the area and quickly spotted Chu Du.

Domination Immortal Chu Du!

As Fang Yuan expected, Chu Du had remained rather than leaving.

But the unexpected thing was Chu Du's attitude.

"Wait, please wait!" Chu Du did not attack, smiling warmly as he spoke in a gentle tone without killing intent.

Fang Yuan snorted: "Are you being polite after resorting to brute force?"

"I was too rash earlier," Chu Du apologized. "Seeing your tribulation impacted my cultivation so deeply that I lost reason. It was truly shameful."

Fang Yuan eyed Chu Du vigilantly while probing the surroundings with various methods.

Seeing Fang Yuan silent, Chu Du initiated: "Friend, I don't want to be enemies. I only want the method to draw out Reckless Savage's true meaning. I hope we can make a deal."

"A deal?" Fang Yuan's eyes shone with brilliance as he mused: "It's not impossible, provided you make a worthy offer."

Fang Yuan added: "But before any transaction, we must settle the score for your attack interfering with my tribulation!"

"I will definitely satisfy you with compensation!" Chu Du replied earnestly.

Even Fang Yuan was shocked — Was this still the Domination Immortal?

But thinking about it, Fang Yuan's alertness towards Chu Du rose.

A man who could swallow his pride was truly formidable; anyone underestimating him would be a fool.

"If you want to compensate me, return Flying Sword Immortal Gu to prove your sincerity," Fang Yuan stated.

---

# Chapter 1062: Chu Du's Weakness

Hearing Fang Yuan demand Flying Sword Immortal Gu back, Chu Du smiled: "Once our transaction concludes, I will not only return Flying Sword Immortal Gu, but also provide satisfactory compensation."

Naturally, he had to keep Flying Sword Immortal Gu for now as his best leverage to restrain Fang Yuan.

Fang Yuan had already anticipated this answer, and his expression chilled: "Chu Du, you lack sincerity! Forget this matter, then."

With that, he activated Sword Escape Immortal Gu, piercing the air like a sword and instantly vanishing into the distance.

"Friend, please wait." Chu Du's expression changed, he quickly chased.

Fang Yuan flew straight toward the sky; before long, Chu Du appeared several li behind him.

Looking back, Fang Yuan sensed an extremely complex Gu worm aura around Chu Du.

It was a rank seven strength path movement killer move, even faster than Sword Escape Immortal Gu in a straight line!

Fang Yuan's heart sank, this situation was bad for him.

"Chu Du must have nurtured more than one Gu Master to ascend. Over the last century, he secretly gained so much of Reckless Savage's true meaning that his strength path attainment grew deep enough to invent such killer moves."

"If Sword Escape Immortal Gu won't work, let's try Blood Torrent."

Fang Yuan willed Sword Escape to stop, his body slowing as it drifted on inertia.

Blood-red light flashed, enveloping him completely and transforming into a river of blood.

Immortal killer move — Blood Torrent, activated successfully!

Fang Yuan turned around and flew towards his left side.

"If Chu Du catches up, I will have to stop and negotiate the transaction with him."

As Fang Yuan prepared for the worst, Domination Immortal Chu Du surged ahead with incredible force, flying straight past him!

After overshooting by more than ten li, Chu Du gradually slowed to a halt.

Next, he turned around and gradually gained speed, charging at Fang Yuan.

Accelerating steadily, his speed soon surpassed Sword Escape Immortal Gu's linear flight.

Eyes flashing, Fang Yuan immediately used Blood Torrent to change direction.

With the situation overturned, Fang Yuan's thoughts churned and he decided to stop.

Escaping Chu Du was now easy; as long as he stayed vigilant, he could safely shake him off.

"Interesting." Fang Yuan muttered, deciding to negotiate with Chu Du.

Seeing Fang Yuan stop, Chu Du felt immense joy and halted as well.

As Chu Du flew over, Fang Yuan raised his hand: "Stop. Let's talk with this distance between us."

Fang Yuan said: "Brother Chu is truly remarkable—what an eye-opener! What killer move is that? Even my Sword Escape Immortal Gu couldn't compare."

"This killer move is called body strength travel. Created with great effort, it boosts my speed using my immortal body's strength path dao marks. Its weakness is that I can only travel forward, unable to turn mid-flight or move backward. I have not practiced enough with it and panicked today—it was truly shameful." Chu Du said, candidly conceding his weakness with an open-minded disposition that invited respect.

Fang Yuan nodded solemnly: "Brother Chu is so powerful, who in Northern Plains could force you to use this move to retreat?"

"I will thank your praise! Northern Plains' Gu Immortal world is extremely deep, I only have a bit of reputation, but the more I cultivate, the more I realize my insufficiency. There are definitely more than five rank eight Gu Immortals in Northern Plains. Among rank sevens, you are one of the experts who make me wary. To my shame, I do not even know your name or background." Chu Du smiled bitterly.

When Chu Du first saw Fang Yuan undergoing tribulation in the immortal aperture, Chu Du had acted, but Fang Yuan was even faster and more resolute!

His aura alone was bizarre. When Chu Du first saw him in the immortal aperture, he was rank six, yet now he exuded a rank seven aura.

Still, he was definitely a Northern Plains Gu Immortal.

Short as the pursuit was, Chu Du had failed to catch Fang Yuan!

Strength determined everything, so Chu Du now treated Fang Yuan as an equal.

After a brief silence, Fang Yuan said slowly: "Actually, a transaction is not out of the question..."

Chu Du remained silent and listened, eyes burning with enthusiasm as if flames blazed in his pupils.

Unable to hold back, Chu Du asked: "I believe my wealth will certainly satisfy you."

Fang Yuan looked at him: "Didn't you attend the recent Northern Plains auction?"

Chu Du froze, asking probingly: "So you attended the auction as well?"

"That's right," Fang Yuan admitted openly. "During the auction, I even made use of you"—though the second remark remained only in his mind.

"Just say what you want," Chu Du pressed.

Fang Yuan sighed: "I simply haven't decided what to trade with Brother Chu yet."

Chu Du frowned, his tone deepening: "Sir, did you stay behind simply to toy with me?"

"Brother Chu, don't be angry—of course not!" Fang Yuan said immediately. "Every Gu Immortal faces looming tribulations and countless needs. I simply haven't determined how to trade to gain the greatest benefit for my cultivation. Give me some time to consider it carefully, and I will reply to Brother Chu."

With a grim expression, Chu Du pondered briefly and nodded helplessly: "Alright."

---

# Chapter 1063: Transformation Path!

Chu Du remained in place, watching Fang Yuan vanish over the horizon.

"Was letting him go the right choice?" Chu Du wondered, gaze flickering.

"Still, judging by his attitude, he seems sincere about trading. Otherwise, why stay to talk rather than just leaving?"

His greatest confidence stemmed not from Fang Yuan's attitude, but the flying sword Immortal Gu in his hands.

"This is a rank seven Immortal Gu!"

Even a legendary figure like Chu Du possessed few rank seven Immortal Gu.

Retrieving the battlefield killer move's components, Fang Yuan returned to Lang Ya blessed land via the Immortal Gu formation.

"With Dog Shit Luck's protection, encountering Chu Du defies common sense. Was someone scheming against you?" the Lang Ya land spirit asked bluntly upon seeing Fang Yuan.

Fang Yuan frowned, he had considered this question long ago.

"With Dog Shit Luck's protection, my luck shouldn't be bad. Was the earthly calamity so fierce that all my luck was consumed countering it?" Fang Yuan surmised, though he could not tell the land spirit.

"Perhaps connecting luck with so many people diluted it," Fang Yuan mused. Aloud, he said: "First supreme elder is right—someone was plotting against me!"

Shadow Sect, Heavenly Court, and Northern Plains' Huang Jin tribes were all likely to plot against him.

The Lang Ya land spirit sighed, full of worry: "Maybe no one is plotting against you. Don't forget, you belong to Lang Ya Sect. Our blessed land is already exposed and has suffered multiple attacks. We recently lost two Gu Immortals; this place's value is enough to incite many experts and factions."

Fang Yuan felt relieved; having the land spirit suspect this suited him far better.

"Thanks to First Supreme Elder's Gu worms, I survived this tribulation. They were a tremendous help, and I return them now," Fang Yuan said, willing countless Gu to fly out of his immortal aperture.

Steering the topic away, Fang Yuan said: "Immortal tribulation tempering aperture was especially effective. Fortunately, I was slightly faster than Chu Du."

Collecting and inspecting each Gu worm, the land spirit asked regretfully: "Are you truly unwilling to sell Dang Hun Mountain and Wisdom Gu to me?"

Originally, the land spirit had offered three true inheritances for Dang Hun Mountain, Luo Po Valley, and Wisdom Gu.

Fang Yuan sold Luo Po Valley to the land spirit in exchange for three rank six Immortal Gu: Dog Shit Luck, Blood Asset, and Dark Limit. His debt cleared, he borrowed numerous Gu to patch his weaknesses—most notably those for immortal tribulation tempering aperture and triple layered sword wave.

Reluctant to refuse too bluntly, Fang Yuan chose his words carefully: "I don't intend to sell them yet, but if circumstances demand it in the future, I will trade them with First Supreme Elder."

Fang Yuan waved his hand, quickly adding: "Per our agreement, I'll leave both treasures in Lang Ya blessed land for the sect to use rather than taking them. Rest assured, First Supreme Elder."

Lending Wisdom Gu meant the land spirit would feed it, solving a huge problem for Fang Yuan.

Keeping Dang Hun Mountain outside his immortal aperture was also preferable.

Famous mountains, rivers, and secluded domains of heaven and earth heavily burdened heaven and earth qi.

Crucially, Shadow Sect knew Dang Hun Mountain and Luo Po Valley well; teleporting directly into Fang Yuan's aperture via Fixed Immortal Travel would be disastrous.

After a long talk, Fang Yuan retrieved many cultivation resources stored with the land spirit.

These included eerie fire dragon pythons, regretful spiders, dragonfish, and arrow bamboo forests from Hu Immortal and Star Form blessed lands—revenue sources second only to guts Gu.

Chu Du?

He was just a backup plan for Fang Yuan.

Though they had exchanged information path Gu worms to communicate, Fang Yuan was free of any binding restrictions; future transactions would depend entirely on his whim.

To Fang Yuan, Reckless Savage's true meaning was far more valuable than a rank seven Immortal Gu!

# Chapter 1064: I am a transformation path Gu Immortal

Why did Fang Yuan choose transformation path?

After the battle of Yi Tian Mountain granted him a living body, Fang Yuan had pondered the critical question of which path to pursue.

Between Ying Wu Xie, Shadow Sect's remnants, Heavenly Court, Central Continent's ten ancient sects, and Northern Plains' Huang Jin tribes, Fang Yuan had countless enemies.

After Yi Tian Mountain, his secrets were laid bare—Spring Autumn Cicada, his otherworldly demon identity, and the destruction of Imperial Court blessed land were almost completely exposed.

Right now, Fang Yuan needed high battle strength.

Yet blood path was taboo, strength path was declining, and wisdom and star paths lacked direct battle strength—plus, despite having inheritances, he had lost his accumulated Immortal Gu.

Only as he grasped the profoundness of this body did his confusion clear, revealing fresh hope.

He realized his body bore over a thousand dao marks across all paths.

Most importantly—his dao marks did not interfere with each other, nor did they weaken one another!

This was Sovereign Immortal Fetus Gu—a rank nine Immortal Gu and the culmination of tens of thousands of years of preparation by Spectral Soul Demon Venerable and Shadow Sect.

With just this point, he could cultivate every path!!

Fang Yuan quickly calmed down.

Yet cultivating every path was a fantasy requiring vast time, resources, and absolute safety.

Lacking the foundation to create his own path, Fang Yuan could only pursue an existing path, cultivating at most a second one alongside it.

That was — transformation path!

Known as the 'path that projected every path', transformation path allowed Gu Immortals to transform into forms of metal, light, sword, and all other paths.

Yet transformation path had a persistent flaw: when Gu Immortals transformed into other beings, they had to cleanse those dao marks to prevent them from conflicting.

For Fang Yuan, Sovereign Immortal Fetus Gu let his dao marks coexist harmoniously, granting him unrestrained transformation without conflicting marks.

Better still, once he cultivated transformation path, his secret of having non-conflicting dao marks would be completely concealed.

After transforming, he would gain amplification effects for those paths: turning into a sword path beast would provide sword path dao marks to heavily empower sword path Immortal Gu.

Though his transformation path attainment was modest, he had Reckless Savage's true meaning!

Facing danger in the future, he could transform into other beings to deceive enemies; if his identity was exposed, he could conceal himself and roam the world safely.

"From now on, I am a transformation path Gu Immortal!"

A long, clear rainbow road extended outward from within Shang Liang Mountain.

A splendidly dressed girl walked along the rainbow road, appearing before the crowd.

It was Shang Xin Ci.

"An illegitimate daughter with meager cultivation became Shang clan leader! Fate truly toys with people—incredible."

Shang Xin Ci slowly walked on the clear rainbow road.

Her robes fluttering under watchful gazes, she ascended steadily into the sky.

Clouds gathered in the sky, light was shining brightly, gathering into a throne.

Looking up, everyone admired Shang Xin Ci's peerless, elegant disposition.

"Today, you are Southern Border's protagonist," muttered Shang Qing Qing, who had supported Shang Xin Ci's rise.

"After the battle of Yi Tian Mountain, Southern Border has fallen into its greatest turmoil in centuries. Can this girl truly lead Shang clan, maintain stability, or even expand?" Shang Tan Mo asked.

Shang Qing Qing smiled: "I chose Shang Xin Ci not for her ability, but for her heart and magnanimity. Her character grants her an undeniable charisma that is exceedingly rare. Look at the peak—her subordinates weep with joy, utterly loyal and trusting toward her. Though recruited from varied, chaotic backgrounds, they are now completely united."

Zhou Quan was silent.

Once Zhou clan's leader, he had become a vagrant until Fang Yuan forced him to serve Shang Xin Ci.

Seeing Shang Xin Ci take her seat on the cloud throne, Zhou Quan was dazed.

Thinking of Fang Yuan, a complex smile surfaced: "Black and white demons, should I thank you? With the young miss as Shang clan leader, my Zhou clan has hope of rising again!"

Yet Zhou Quan reconsidered: "Reviving my clan must wait. The young miss faces immense internal threats; I cannot leave."

He glanced toward Shang Bu Li and Wan Qian Shan.

Of Shang Yan Fei's five great generals, only Shang Bu Li and external elder Wan Qian Shan survived Yi Tian Mountain.

"With these two holding sway, they could turn her into a puppet. She struggles to win full clan support."

Wei De Xin, the pregnant widow of Wei clan's leader skilled at training guards, had sought only to protect her husband's sole bloodline. Coerced by Fang Yuan, Wei De Xin trained an elite unit as head of her guard.

"Regardless, as her steward, I must act in her interest. She needs manpower; we cannot let the three demonic path brothers—Xiong Tu, Xiong Huo, and Xiong Feng—leave." Zhou Quan's eyes flashed as he looked at them.

"To prevent the remaining generals from making her a figurehead, we must recruit new blood. Xiao Yan... ...is a great choice! He possesses outstanding strength and shared close ties with Wei Yang and the young miss." Wei De Xin looked at Xiao Yan in the crowd, planning her next move.

Shang Xin Ci delivered a succinct inaugural speech that left everyone pondering.

As thunderous cheers and applause erupted, Shang Xin Ci slowly stepped away from the spotlight.

Vanishing from the sky, Shang Xin Ci reappeared directly inside her inner city mansion.

Knowing it was no time to rest, she summoned her aides:

Xiao Lan, Xiao Die, Wei De Xin, Zhou Quan, Xiong Tu, Xiong Huo, and Xiong Feng.

Ye Fan strode along the road with bright eyes and an imposing aura.

Bravely defending Shang Xin Ci had earned him Shang Qing Qing's approval, granting him an immortal's superb inheritance.

Standing outside, he straightened his posture and prepared to knock.

He heard Shang Xin Ci's voice: "Upon taking leadership, the first thing I want to do is address a matter: I want to use Shang clan's power to revoke Black Demon Brother Fang Zheng's arrest warrant! And of course... Sister White Demon's as well."

Ye Fan froze in a daze, his raised finger halting in midair.

While Shang Xin Ci addressed her subordinates, Shang Qing Qing and the other Gu Immortals discussed Southern Border's affairs in Living Treasure blessed land.

"Southern Border's Gu Immortal world will face decades of unrest," Shang clan's first supreme elder stated.

He looked around, continuing: "Right now, our clan has three matters."

"First, Zombie Alliance have vanished mysteriously over the five regions, the same goes for Southern Border's Zombie Alliance branch. They occupied many resources, Shang clan can take them over."

"Second, righteous path forces are blockading the giant dream realm covering Yi Tian Mountain for joint research."

"Third, the sole survivor of Yi Tian Mountain's gambling contest, Gu Immortal Gua Lao, inherits immense resources. We must control him!"

"I've been monitoring treasure yellow heaven, and frankly..." Shang Qing Qing began, before her expression shifted in shock: "What happened? Treasure yellow heaven closed!"

# Chapter 1073: Wisdom is Hard to Use

Treasure yellow heaven came from Daoist Countless Treasures.

In the Medieval Antiquity Era, Daoist Countless Treasures fused a yellow heaven fragment into his grotto-heaven, creating treasure yellow heaven.

"Why do you think that treasure yellow heaven closed suddenly?"

"Oh no, we are pursuing the resources from the Yi Tian Mountain bet, but now they are trapped in treasure yellow heaven."

"Could treasure yellow heaven's heavenly spirit be trying to embezzle that massive fortune?"

Shang clan's first supreme elder shook his head: "The heavenly spirit does not care about that bet. If it were corrupt, treasure yellow heaven would never have its reputation and status. There has never been a single case of corruption in treasure yellow heaven's history. However, there have been a few instances of it closing."

Unable to survive an upcoming tribulation, Daoist Countless Treasures absorbed an immemorial yellow heaven fragment into his immortal aperture, escaping all future tribulations at the cost of his freedom.

After absorbing that initial fragment, treasure yellow heaven could only expand further by absorbing additional yellow heaven fragments.

Occasionally, people had sold immemorial yellow heaven fragments to the heavenly spirit.

Upon obtaining one, the heavenly spirit would close treasure yellow heaven and focus entirely on absorbing it to expand.

"Barring any surprises, this should be the case now as well," Shang clan's first supreme elder surmised.

With its immense history and unfathomable treasury, Heavenly Court was able to produce a substantial fragment of immemorial yellow heaven.

For treasure yellow heaven to close, the yellow heaven fragment had to be so massive that the heavenly spirit was forced to focus entirely on absorption.

Heavenly Court's vast wealth allowed it to expend a large yellow heaven fragment, completely thwarting Ying Wu Xie's plan to save himself!

"Damn it! Heavenly Court actually pulled this!" Ying Wu Xie's face was ruthless, veins popping across his clenched fists as his teeth ground together audibly.

Though furious, Heavenly Court's heavy-handed move left him watching helplessly.

Heavenly Court had sold the fragment cheaply at immense cost solely to eliminate Ying Wu Xie.

Without treasure yellow heaven, Ying Wu Xie could no longer sell any of his Immortal Gu.

Even worse, Iron Crown Eagle Strength Immortal Gu remained stuck inside.

Without immortal materials from transactions, how could he continue refining Gu?

With treasure yellow heaven closed while the spirit absorbed the fragment, reopening would take time; historically, the shortest closure lasted over two months.

Lang Ya blessed land.

Fang Yuan's appearance had changed, he became an immortal zombie again.

Fang Yuan's plan was simple: his soul exited his body and entered a strength path immortal zombie corpse.

Fang Yuan had obtained these strength path immortal zombie corpses from Blazing Heaven Demoness as a failsafe for the life-and-death immortal aperture.

Stored in Star Form blessed land, he retrieved them from Lang Ya land spirit after Yi Tian Mountain.

Immortal materials were secondary; wisdom Gu was what mattered.

Fang Yuan stared at wisdom Gu for a long time, but it remained motionless, emitting no light of wisdom.

"Using substitute immortal zombie bodies failed; I cannot draw out the light of wisdom."

Fang Yuan was not surprised at this.

Wisdom Gu only responded to Fang Yuan as a whole; both his original body and soul were required to draw out its light.

"That means the most direct method is simply taking back my original body?" Fang Yuan thought.

His original body was still an immortal zombie.

Without needing alterations, it was suitable to bathe in the light of wisdom.

"Ying Wu Xie has vanished... He likely possesses Spring Autumn Cicada, Fixed Immortal Travel, and other Immortal Gu, with Hei Lou Lan and Tai Bai Yun Sheng aiding him."

"Thus, refining Fang Zheng into a blood deity is all the more necessary."

Formed from sovereign immortal fetus Gu, Fang Yuan's new body had no parents and shared no bloodline relations in this world.

But Fang Yuan still wanted to refine Fang Zheng into a blood deity.

The blood deity refined using Fang Zheng could counter Fang Yuan's body.

Even if he failed to recover his original body, Fang Yuan could use Fang Zheng's blood deity to regain wisdom Gu's acknowledgement.

Observing Fang Yuan's tests on wisdom Gu, Lang Ya land spirit sighed in deep regret at the results.

Fang Yuan looked toward Lang Ya land spirit with concern: "Does First Supreme Elder have any method to use wisdom Gu?"

Lang Ya land spirit glared petulantly: "The simplest method is raising your cultivation to rank nine and directly refining wisdom Gu!"

Fang Yuan smiled bitterly: "I know that method too. Are there other ways?"

"There is one pseudo-method: feeding it lifespan Gu continuously might eventually obtain its acknowledgement. If it works, wisdom Gu becomes mine, and you'd have to give it to me regardless." Lang Ya land spirit smiled to himself at the thought.

"You think I wanted to?!" Lang Ya land spirit stomped his feet: "Land spirits cannot lie! Damn it, why did I reveal my motives again? You accursed fellow!"

# Chapter 1074: Spy Exposed

Fang Yuan shook his head, sighing.

Feeding wisdom Gu was simply too costly for Fang Yuan.

"Lifespan Gu is hard to find; even Immortal and Demon Venerables desire it. Blazing Heaven Demoness was plotted against and killed by Spectral Soul, who surely seized her wealth already! Even with Spectral Soul's failure, the remnants of Shadow Sect and Zombie Alliance still possess immense wealth!"

"Activating wisdom Gu expends lifespan, and feeding it requires lifespan Gu. For now, I should let Lang Ya land spirit feed it."

With each tribulation growing progressively stronger, Fang Yuan was too worried about his next earthly calamity to care about wisdom Gu.

"Even if wisdom Gu acknowledges Lang Ya land spirit, it is fine. With my status, I can still use it through his methods for some sect contribution points."

Undisappointed, Fang Yuan asked Lang Ya land spirit for one thing before leaving: an information path mortal Gu recording the refinement of change form Immortal Gu.

"That refinement was bizarre—the tribulations were absurdly strong! Tell me if you discover anything," Lang Ya land spirit instructed.

"I will do my best," Fang Yuan replied, privately suspecting the tribulations were amplified by sovereign immortal fetus Gu.

Besides researching the tribulations, Fang Yuan aimed to investigate Lang Ya Sect for any remaining traitors.

Returning to his post on Cloud Cover Continent, Fang Yuan flew down to the cloud city and landed.

The hairy man leader respectfully reported that the sixth city lord had long been waiting in Fang Yuan's guest room.

The sixth city lord was Gu Immortal Sixth Hair, guardian of the sixth cloud city.

Wary, Fang Yuan entered the guest room to meet Sixth Hair.

"Greetings, Second City Lord. I am Sixth Hair, here to seek your guidance in combat," Sixth Hair paid respects and said.

Fang Yuan's expression remained unchanged, but his gaze turned ice-cold.

For although Sixth Hair spoke aloud, he was secretly transmitting a completely different message:

"Fang Yuan, I come representing Lord Ying Wu Xie to make a deal!"

Ying Wu Xie!

Shadow Sect!

Sixth Hair was the spy!!

"You are too polite. As fellow sect members, there is no need for guidance—we can certainly spar," Fang Yuan smiled warmly.

He invited Sixth Hair to sit down before taking his own seat.

"Is he sincere, or is this a trap or probe by Lang Ya land spirit? After all, I am bound by an alliance agreement."

His expression shifted, eyes sharp like daggers and filled with killing intent as he coldly transmitted: "What guts, Sixth Hair! If true, I will turn you over to First Supreme Elder for judgment!"

# Chapter 1075: Simple Words can Turn a Snake into a Dragon

Sixth Hair looked at Fang Yuan and laughed fearlessly.

Sixth Hair said: "I set up an Immortal Gu formation concealing us from Lang Ya land spirit and suppressing the alliance agreement. Test it if you like."

Having joined Lang Ya Sect, Fang Yuan was bound by its alliance agreement and could not act freely.

Speaking with a spy like Sixth Hair breached the agreement.

Fang Yuan tested it and indeed suffered no backlash from minor agreement breaches.

With a deep gaze, Fang Yuan said: "It seems you truly are a spy in Lang Ya Sect. What transaction do you want?"

"Ying Wu Xie and I share deep enmity; exposing their spy to approach me means they need something desperately. Interesting... let's see what he is planning," Fang Yuan thought.

"To speak the truth, Lord Ying Wu Xie is in dire straits with his survival at stake, or I would never have contacted you," Sixth Hair said.

Fang Yuan spoke calmly: "Ying Wu Xie has all my Gu worms and the aid of Tai Bai Yun Sheng and Hei Lou Lan. How could he reach such a state? I refuse to believe it."

Sixth Hair shook his head: "Your special will detonated your Gu worms; even after desperate preservation, only thirty percent remain."

Hearing that, Fang Yuan was fully certain Sixth Hair was indeed Shadow Sect's spy in Lang Ya Sect.

Having admitted their weakness, Sixth Hair changed tone: "Before the deal, let me show our sincerity with free intel. It concerns your future cultivation—more accurately, your very life and death!"

Fang Yuan snorted coldly: "No need to boast of its value. I can assess it myself when I see it."

"Fang Yuan, do you know what heaven's will is?" Sixth Hair asked.

"Heaven's will?" Fang Yuan asked in confusion.

Sixth Hair said: "Guided by heaven's will, you swapped souls with Lord Ying Wu Xie and seized sovereign immortal fetus Gu. What you did not know is that Old Man Yan Shi's eleventh extreme physique had a fatal flaw: any soul residing in it falls into deep sleep and loses its memories. Though the slumber flaw was removed, the physique still caused continuous memory loss over time. Consequently, Lord Ying Wu Xie constantly lost memories and could only rely on the killer move lead soul into dream."

Saying this, Sixth Hair took out an information path mortal Gu.

"This letter Gu records the events surrounding Yi Tian Mountain, take a look," Sixth Hair said, tossing the Gu worm to Fang Yuan.

Finding no issues upon inspection, Fang Yuan activated the Gu, and scenes of Yi Tian Mountain surfaced in his mind.

He found that he was indeed lacking many crucial memories.

After checking multiple times, Fang Yuan calmly stated with a deep gaze: "I seem to have lost memories, but how do I know this isn't fabricated?"

After a long silence, Sixth Hair spoke: "Everyone knows you possess Spring Autumn Cicada and underwent rebirth. But despite your secrets, your understanding is far shallower than ours."

"Heaven's will is omnipresent across the five regions and nine heavens. The way of heaven takes surpluses to replenish deficits, emphasizing balance. The way of humans does the opposite, taking deficits to accumulate surplus—a fundamental conflict."

"Thus, past venerables and legendary figures all suffered suppression by heaven's will, with tribulations and lifespan Gu serving as its trump cards. Fang Yuan, you have faced two tribulations: an earthly calamity and an Immortal Gu refinement. Both were abnormally terrifying because sovereign immortal fetus Gu possesses boundless potential that surpasses past venerables. Consequently, heaven's will is extremely wary and seeks to kill you before you grow further."

Fang Yuan's heart shook.

Since the tribulations, he had been considering this question.

And now, Sixth Hair gave him the answer.

"Heaven's will..." Fang Yuan muttered internally, thinking about this phrase.

Sixth Hair sighed: "My main body, Spectral Soul, formed Shadow Sect and Zombie Alliance, plotting a hundred thousand years to refine sovereign immortal fetus Gu, only to fail. This was heaven's will at work—unleashing countless enemies led by Heavenly Court. And you, Fang Yuan, were the hidden assassin of our human tribulation!"

"What do you mean?" Fang Yuan squinted with keen interest, acutely sensing these words would trigger a massive transformation in his situation.

Sixth Hair knew that once spoken, these words would eliminate Fang Yuan's greatest blind spot regarding heaven's will, potentially sparking an unstoppable rise.

Fang Yuan was currently like a blindfolded python trapped in a swamp, thrashing aimlessly in the mud.

With this knowledge, the blindfold fell away, revealing the vast world beyond the swamp.

With clear direction and awareness, the python would raise its head, summon massive storms, become a dragon, and roam the world freely!

Though mere words, to Fang Yuan they represented an immeasurably valuable qualitative transformation.

# Chapter 1076: Transactions with Shadow Sect (1/3)

Inhaling deeply, Sixth Hair continued: "Snatching sovereign immortal fetus Gu at the crucial moment was not merely your own doing, but guided by heaven's will. Even using Spring Autumn Cicada to rebirth was part of heaven's will's scheme to send you back and ruin Shadow Sect's grand plan!"

Sixth Hair laughed coldly, feeling bleak inside: "Having just undergone tribulation, Lang Ya blessed land still retains much heaven's will. Exposing its scheme has drawn its fury upon me. Yet blessed lands and grotto-heavens are independent worlds outside the five regions, beyond its control. With tribulations over, its fury is utterly useless!"

Fang Yuan did not deny it, stating expressionlessly: "Continue."

Sixth Hair continued urgently: "Heaven's will was hidden inside Spring Autumn Cicada itself—proving every one of your rebirths was manipulated by it!"

"Every activation of Spring Autumn Cicada was heaven's will's best chance to deepen its influence over you. Reduced to a mere sliver of will without a body and focused on navigating the River of Time, you could never anticipate such manipulation."

"After rebirth, you focused on leveraging your foresight to cultivate. Yet those past experiences and opportunities you relied upon were subtly guided by heaven's will. Those fortuitous encounters were bait from heaven's will, grooming you into a tool to reach Yi Tian Mountain and ruin Shadow Sect's plan."

"We deduced that before your first rebirth, Shadow Sect had succeeded. But heaven's will refused to let my main body become a venerable again. Bo Qing failed in the past precisely because he was a split soul. Revived with sovereign immortal fetus Gu, my main body could never have been eliminated by heaven's will. Thus, it plotted to send you back in time, using you to change the past and remodel the future!"

Fang Yuan interjected: "Why did heaven's will choose me?"

"Only an otherworldly demon can alter the past. Even Red Lotus Demon Venerable merely damaged fate Gu, unable to harm heaven's will."

"You are not the only otherworldly demon, but given your circumstances and experience, you were the most suitable tool at the time," Sixth Hair replied.

Seeing Fang Yuan remained outwardly unmoved despite being shaken, Sixth Hair cursed inwardly and asked again:

"Spring Autumn Cicada is only rank six with a high failure rate. Why did you succeed every time?"

"Not every time—I failed the last activation." Fang Yuan suddenly froze.

This was the strongest evidence proving heaven's will's hand!

His amnesia had spared this memory: he used Spring Autumn Cicada only because an unavoidable strike from Heaven Overseeing Tower forced him to.

Yet earlier, Heaven Overseeing Tower had already vaporized the Great Strength True Martial immortal zombie.

By Sixth Hair's logic: with that zombie destroyed, the ten extreme formation broke, preventing Gu refinement. Shadow Sect's plan failed and Hei Lou Lan was absent, so heaven's will abandoned its tool, causing Fang Yuan's activation of Spring Autumn Cicada to fail.

Refusing defeat after heaven's will abandoned Fang Yuan, Shadow Sect used the Red Lotus true inheritance to aid his rebirth, altering the past so their plan could proceed.

"You don't know I failed my last activation?" Fang Yuan looked at Sixth Hair.

Then he waved his hand: "Never mind, continue."

Sixth Hair calmed himself and continued: "Using an otherworldly demon was brilliant; assuming you had nothing to do with heaven's will deceived even my main body."

"After Three Kings blessed land, Old Man Yan Shi discovered you possessed Spring Autumn Cicada and were a reborn individual. Old Man Yan Shi shielded you from deductions, ultimately redirecting Feng Jiu Ge's Central Continent group to Luo Po Valley."

"Fang Yuan, you are on the Demon Judgment Board, hunted by the ten ancient sects and Heavenly Court. Lord Ying Wu Xie is the mirror of your future! Heavenly Court Gu Immortals, however, surrender their apertures to Heavenly Court, leaving them free of tribulations, operating via phantom apertures, and hibernating to preserve lifespan."

"Despite our deep enmity, our fates are intertwined. If Lord Ying Wu Xie falls to Heavenly Court, all your secrets and ties to him will be exposed. Heavenly Court will hunt you down as heaven's will's enforcers across every region. Fang Yuan, you and Ying Wu Xie share the same rope; if he dies, you will follow soon enough!"

Deeply moved, Fang Yuan said: "You are right. I think... we can have a fruitful transaction."

# Chapter 1077: Transactions with Shadow Sect (2/3)

"How shall we trade, and what do you need?" Fang Yuan asked amiably.

"We will trade for your immortal materials from Falling Heavenly River; Earth Trench materials are tainted by heaven's will. Here is our list." Sixth Hair produced an information path mortal Gu.

After reviewing it, Fang Yuan asked: "I have most of these, but as a Lang Ya Sect member, can't you obtain them from the sect inventory?"

Fang Yuan nodded: "True. I can provide these materials, but how will they reach Ying Wu Xie with treasure yellow heaven closed?"

Sixth Hair continued: "Without treasure yellow heaven it is more troublesome, but we can still send these to Lord Ying Wu Xie. Zombie Alliance constructed a five-region super Gu formation across its branches before the Yi Tian Mountain battle. "Immortal Gu." Sixth Hair answered, having a calm expression.

"Interesting, very interesting." Fang Yuan clapped and smiled.

Fang Yuan smiled: "I want all my surviving Immortal Gu back, plus Hei Lou Lan's Self Strength and Tai Bai Yun Sheng's Man as Before and Landscape as Before."

Sixth Hair considered it briefly before nodding: "I can make the decision to agree to that."

Controlling Tai Bai Yun Sheng and Hei Lou Lan, Ying Wu Xie could force them to yield their Gu; escaping danger was paramount.

Fang Yuan said again: "We will trade at the same time, bring your Immortal Gu, I will pay the immortal materials."

At this time, Sixth Hair showed a difficult expression: "As a matter of fact, it will take some time for you to see the Immortal Gu. You are aware of the situation in the five regions. Dark Flow Giant City sank into Earth Trench to avoid being ransacked; retrieving the Immortal Gu from its super Gu formation will take time. Provide the refinement materials first; the faster we refine, the longer Lord Ying Wu Xie can endure."

Fang Yuan heard this and sneered internally: "Sixth Hair is speaking both truth and lies at once, earlier, he said Ying Wu Xie is in grave danger, now he is indicating that Ying Wu Xie can last for some time."

On the surface, Fang Yuan's expression turned stiff, he rejected: "No, impossible. If I pay immortal materials and you do not hand me the Immortal Gu, wouldn't I be a fool?"

"Don't worry about this. I have prepared an information path immortal killer move to restrict both sides, none of us can break it." Sixth Hair had a sincere expression.

Fang Yuan laughed: "You broke Hei Lou Lan's alliance agreement—would I be foolish enough to accept an information path pledge from you?"

"How about this?" Sixth Hair quickly thought of a new idea: "I can use information to exchange for a portion of the immortal materials first, how about that? This information and these secrets have immense value to you. Don't you want Shadow Sect's experience dealing with heaven's will, or secrets about otherworldly demons and Lang Ya blessed land?"

Fang Yuan spoke, but instead asked a question: "I don't understand something. Since there is a super Gu formation, why aren't Ying Wu Xie and the rest using the super Gu formation to escape directly?"

Sixth Hair explained: "The super Gu formation can only transport immortal materials. Immortal zombie bodies count as materials, but living Gu Immortals with apertures cannot be transported. Methods like Fixed Immortal Travel are unique, Stargate Gu is too limited, and living people cannot easily enter another's aperture."

# Chapter 1078: Transaction with Shadow Sect (3/3)

In the hall, Fang Yuan let out a hearty laugh.

After extensive probing, he finally understood the boundaries of this transaction.

"Fang Yuan, why are you laughing?" Sixth Hair's foreboding grew.

"Because I am happy. The formation transporting immortal materials is enough! Forget information—my first condition is my original body. Hand it over," Fang Yuan stated.

Sixth Hair's expression changed.

He knew about wisdom Gu.

Reuniting his body and soul would allow Fang Yuan to use wisdom's light and wield Wisdom Gu once more.

"Oh... so you know about wisdom Gu." Fang Yuan rubbed his chin.

"Immortal Gu and information can be sold, but the body... never!" Sixth Hair refused firmly.

Fang Yuan's mood instantly flipped: "Then there's nothing to discuss. Goodbye!"

Fang Yuan stood and waved his hand, dismissing Sixth Hair.

Fang Yuan snorted and walked out the door, leaving Sixth Hair behind.

Sixth Hair hurried after him: "Transactions require willing parties! If we fall, you follow!"

Fang Yuan retorted: "You're right. But so what if I follow? At most, I die."

Catching up, Sixth Hair urged: "Fang Yuan, who believes such lies? Would you ever accept death? With Shadow Sect around, we draw countless enemies away from you! Without us, how long can you last? You think you can deal with heaven's will? Even my main body failed after a hundred thousand years of planning! With a common enemy ahead of us, why are you like this?"

"Noisy!" A sword wave appeared around Fang Yuan.

Rank seven Immortal Gu Wave Sword!

Forced back, Sixth Hair panicked: "Careful! Don't use Immortal Gu—it will ruin my arrangements. If Lang Ya land spirit discovers us, we're both finished!"

Fang Yuan sneered, walking ahead: "The body is non-negotiable; without it, forget the rest! You have three days to discuss it with Ying Wu Xie."

Sixth Hair's expression turned savage, teeth gritted and killing intent surging: "Fang Yuan, don't go overboard!"

"So what? I won't be the first to die—I can live safely in Lang Ya blessed land for a long time. But you? Without Ying Wu Xie, Spectral Soul remains trapped in the dream realm; the great Demon Venerable will die before me!" Fang Yuan laughed, vanishing through the door.

Less than half a day later, Sixth Hair returned.

"Lord Ying Wu Xie agreed." Sixth Hair glared at Fang Yuan, itching to tear him apart.

"We trade bodies one-for-one first," Fang Yuan said. "If you tampered with it, beware my future methods as a reborn individual..."

Sixth Hair gritted his teeth, holding up three fingers: "We trade bodies first, then only two more deals—three sessions total!"

Three days later in Lang Ya blessed land, the two made their transaction.

"Next is Immortal Gu. I want all of mine back, along with Self Strength, Man as Before, and Landscape as Before," Fang Yuan said.

Sixth Hair looked curious: "For so many Immortal Gu, do you have enough immortal materials?"

Fang Yuan laughed: "Of course."

A few minutes later.

"You arbitrarily slashed the trade quantity! These materials aren't even enough for thirty percent of the Gu!!" Sixth Hair screamed.

"We can negotiate. What do you mean changed it myself? I am being very sincere!" Fang Yuan smiled faintly.

Fang Yuan relented slightly, but still profited the most from this.

The third transaction.

"What?! We agreed on three transactions, why extend it to ten?!"

Fang Yuan simply brushed it off: "I won't die first anyway. Once Ying Wu Xie falls, Spectral Soul's main body follows. That vast dream realm consumes souls rapidly, after all..."

Next, he fainted on the spot.

Sixth Hair's figure appeared in the soul water, kneeling remorsefully: "Lord, I made a huge mistake! When Fang Yuan faced the tribulation, if only I hadn't used..."

"I already said it wasn't your fault. My own trump card boosted my luck, allowing Fang Yuan to exploit it," Ying Wu Xie transmitted directly into Sixth Hair's mind.

Yet Fang Yuan did not want Ying Wu Xie dying so quickly.

If Ying Wu Xie died leaving clues for Heavenly Court's Gu Immortals, disaster would soon reach Fang Yuan.

Having Ying Wu Xie draw enemies ahead was far better, letting Heavenly Court and Shadow Sect weaken each other while Fang Yuan observed from the sidelines.

# Chapter 1080: Flying Bear Transformation

Several days later, Lang Ya blessed land.

Two figures cut through the air before suddenly stopping.

"This desolate area is suitable for our spar," the figure ahead remarked leisurely.

"Brother Fang is right," agreed the hairy man Gu Immortal behind him, Twelfth Hair, grinning brightly.

Compared to other Lang Ya Sect hairy man Gu Immortals, Twelfth Hair was special.

Prioritizing battle strength, Lang Ya land spirit gave Twelfth Hair Beast Enslavement Immortal Gu to nurture him as a pillar of combat strength.

Fang Yuan and Twelfth Hair both descended to the ground.

"Twelfth brother, please." Fang Yuan gestured with his hand.

Bam.

# Chapter 1083: Feeding Immortal Gu

Most of Fang Yuan's attention was on his immortal aperture.

Swarms of light path mortal Gu carried the flowing light fruits into the sky.

Piercing through successive layers of heavens, the fruits eventually reached the highest layer.

Fang Yuan's sovereign immortal aperture comprised five regions and nine heavens.

The flowing light fruits self-detonated one after the other.

Flowing light fruits were essentially condensed aurora light.

Attitude Gu was rank eight; though its feeding intervals were long, each session demanded a vast quantity of flowing light fruits.

The fundamental requirement was increasing light path dao marks in his immortal aperture.

Fortunately, Lang Ya land spirit handled feeding rank nine Wisdom Gu.

Fang Yuan had already fed calamity beckoning Gu with the black blood of the six headed snake.

Southeast of super force Guan tribe, and northwest of Liu tribe.

# Chapter 1085: Trip to Tai Qiu

The location pointed out by Lang Ya land spirit was Tai Qiu!

Lang Ya land spirit pointed at the Gu worm: "This map records Tai Qiu's topography and the distribution of various beast groups. But there is a huge flaw, this map was created a long time ago, there will definitely be many changes in Tai Qiu after all these years."

Lang Ya land spirit continued: "You are familiar with Tai Qiu, a human Gu Immortal, and have change form Immortal Gu. I intend to send you there with this map..."

Before he finished speaking, Fang Yuan stood straight and declared without hesitation: "First supreme elder only needs to command! Serving the sect in such an important matter is my honor!"

Lang Ya land spirit laughed heartily, patting his shoulder: "Good! The sect won't mistreat you. On this trip, act according to the circumstances. "Three marked locations show the corpses of immemorial desolate beasts. Prioritize scouting them; setting up the teleportation Gu formation at one of those spots would be ideal."

Fang Yuan nodded, patting his chest in assurance: "Rest at ease, First Supreme Elder. I will prepare and set off immediately!"

Fang Yuan brought nearly all his Immortal Gu and his immortal zombie body within his spacious sovereign immortal aperture.

"Though my sovereign immortal aperture is independent of the outside world, carrying Spring Autumn Cicada and snow monsters filled with heaven's will guarantees obstructions on the way to Tai Qiu. Just like when I was hurrying back from Southern Border, I met the cloud beasts, was pursued by Qi Zai and so on."

"Heaven's will cannot act directly outside calamities or tribulations, so it will surely influence others to kill me. I will deal with whatever comes!"

With a flash of bright light, a young Gu Immortal appeared in central dragon elephant plain.

His figure shot upwards like an arrow.

# Chapter 1086: Speed!

Minutes later, Fang Yuan had already left dragon elephant plain.

He saw a huge field of clouds in front of him.

Flying into the thick cloud cover, he prepared his killer move. Thoughts flickering, he activated countless Gu worms in his immortal aperture.

Large numbers of mortal Gu swirled like a storm, creating a bloody tornado in the sovereign immortal aperture.

Rank six blood asset Immortal Gu!

Assisted by the swirling mortal Gu, it formed the immortal killer move Blood Torrent.

Blood-red light surged from Fang Yuan's body, liquefying into a river of blood.

The blood carried Fang Yuan, tearing through the clouds at rapid speed.

Leaving dragon elephant plain earlier, he had avoided using killer moves within that righteous super force's territory.

A long bloody trail stretched out, hidden by thick clouds and invisible from outside.

Before long, Fang Yuan pierced completely through the massive cloud field.

Outside of the cloud layer, Fang Yuan stopped using blood torrent.

Blood path drew universal hostility, and Fang Yuan wished to avoid attracting trouble.

Especially when heaven's will was locked onto him!

While clouds provided cover, Fang Yuan would not risk using Blood Torrent in open skies.

He activated sword escape Immortal Gu.

Fang Yuan flew forward like a sword.

The biggest factor of this trip was — Speed! Speed! Speed!

"Heaven's will takes surpluses to replenish deficits, viewing me as an eyesore. Yet it must follow heavenly rules and remains limited."

"It cannot act freely, only attacking directly during calamities and tribulations. Normally, it must engineer situations to kill me."

"Shadow Sect and Spectral Soul are the best models against heaven's will. They are my enemies, but superior in some aspects—I must abandon bias and learn from them!"

"Besides, I hold a huge advantage over Shadow Sect—I am a complete otherworldly demon!"

"Shadow Sect members must constantly use self will to cleanse heaven's will's subtle influence."

"But as a complete otherworldly demon, heaven's will cannot influence me at all!"

Suddenly, there was a growl filled with pain and fear.

An ancient desolate beast fled for its life, pursued by a wild rank seven Immortal Gu.

The two entered Fang Yuan's vision.

In front was a horned six-winged pegasus, pursued by the wild Dragon Centipede Immortal Gu.

Seven li long, the Dragon Centipede possessed a dragon head, countless churning legs, and a bronze shell gleaming with golden luster.

This unique rank seven Dragon Centipede Immortal Gu hunted ancient desolate beasts and desolate plants for food.

As Fang Yuan flew straight forward, the pair appeared directly ahead, blocking his path.

"Something happened after all!" Fang Yuan snickered internally.

Though possessing their own will, wild Immortal Gu had low intelligence and were easily influenced by heaven's will.

As an ancient desolate beast, the horned six-winged pegasus had higher intelligence, making it harder for heaven's will to influence.

Fleeing in panic, however, it took only a slight nudge from heaven's will to alter its escape route.

These two were here to block Fang Yuan's path!

Fleeing for its life, the pegasus would try its best to crush all obstacles ahead.

The Dragon Centipede's gaze also locked onto Fang Yuan.

His aura was weaker than the pegasus, but his rank seven Sword Escape emitted a strong sword path aura.

Its countless limbs bore sword path dao marks like blades, capable of shredding ancient desolate beasts to pieces.

Fang Yuan's reaction was at lightning speed.

He instantly stored Sword Escape, causing its aura to vanish.

Though confused, the Dragon Centipede remained focused on him, having encountered many prey in its life that could conceal their aura.

Fang Yuan's body shook, as countless figures appeared.

Convergence of enslavement and strength path, immortal killer move — Myriad Self!

Countless Fang Yuans scattered across the sky like a school of fish fleeing a whale.

Even more confused, the Dragon Centipede slowed down for a moment.

Next, its seven-li-long body lashed out like a whip.

Countless strength path phantoms of Fang Yuan were destroyed.

The horned six-winged pegasus also crushed many of Fang Yuan's phantoms as it fled.

Seeing the pegasus escaping, the Dragon Centipede refocused its attention on it.

Locked in pursuit, the two quickly vanished from Fang Yuan's sight.

Fang Yuan lightly let out a breath of air.

Fang Yuan activated Sword Escape again, flying into the sky, leaving.

# Chapter 1087: A Goat Explores Tai Qiu

Heaven's will needed time to lay out traps.

Heaven's will could think and plot.

This was because of Star Constellation Immortal Venerable.

Shadow Sect's intel revealed heaven's will had grown far craftier after Star Constellation Immortal Venerable.

Thus, Fang Yuan was not purely flying straight ahead.

He curved and took detours, moving forward in arcs.

Change form Immortal Gu!

One day later, Tai Qiu.

This was the final location marked on Fang Yuan's map.

"But this thousand snakes haze tree isn't dead yet!" Fang Yuan's gaze turned dark and wary.

# Chapter 1089: Formation Path Great Grandmaster

Leaping agilely under cover of smoke and dust, the fire swallowing monkey broke away from the beast tide toward the immemorial desolate beast's corpse.

From the appearance, it resembled an elephant corpse.

Tattered grey-blue skin draped over dried flesh, its skeleton forming a giant tent.

# Chapter 1126: Verge of Death

Swoosh!

# Chapter 1128: Hei Fan's Four Treasures (1/2)

Fang Yuan gathered Feng Jun's corpse.

Next, the pavilion's stone pillars radiated with pure white light.

Fang Yuan's gaze returned to the center of the wall.

It was a ball of ants.

Once the mortal ants were refined and set aside, a single Gu remained in his hands.

# Chapter 1129: Hei Fan's Four Treasure (2/2)

Refining Immortal Gu required immortal essence rather than primeval essence.

Glancing at the heavenly spirit, Fang Yuan refined the Gu with immortal essence.

The refinement went smoothly; the queen ant-like rank seven Immortal Gu cooperated without resistance.

Still, as a rank seven Gu, it heavily expended his green grape immortal essence.

Fang Yuan took it out, it was indeed a piece of ice.

This was a famous Gu among time path Immortal Gu.

By expending immortal materials, Gu Immortals could parallel refine Year Gu continuously.

Like amber or fossilization, the ice sealed the year Immortal Gu into hibernation without leaking its aura.

He noticed flowing water sealed at the bottom of the ice.

Inspecting it again, he saw Year Gu occupied only a fraction; flowing water filled the rest, as if sealed within the ice.

"To be given such treatment, is this flowing water a rank nine immortal material that surpasses rank eight?" Fang Yuan had a bold guess.

Taking it out, it was a rank five information path mortal Gu.

The details of Hei Fan's true inheritance recorded inside were of immense value!

It produced black ant mortal Gu to harvest nutrients from all sorts of immortal materials for itself.

If too many black ants were destroyed, After Immortal Gu would starve, as it could only spawn one worker ant each month.

Enlightened, Fang Yuan continued reading the information on the ice.

The ice was a novel rank eight material crafted by Immortal Bing Ren to seal the two Immortal Gu.

The other Immortal Gu was the flowing water.

This was the greatest treasure within Hei Fan's true inheritance!

It was named Years Flow Like Water, it was rank eight!

Yet as a rank six Gu Immortal, Fang Yuan already possessed three rank eight Immortal Gu.

Attitude Gu, wisdom sword Gu, and now Years Flow Like Water.

Rank eight Years Flow Like Water had a single effect: producing Year Gu.

The more immortal essence expended, the more Year Gu produced—even immortal-level Year Gu.

First, it had low usage requirements: even rank six Gu Immortals using green grape immortal essence could produce Year Gu, albeit in smaller quantities than with rank seven or eight essence.

Second, Years Flow Like Water was easy to feed, consuming the water of the River of Time just like Year Gu and Spring Autumn Cicada.

However, Years Flow Like Water had a flaw.

Once unsealed, Years Flow Like Water would leak its aura, luring year beasts to attack.

Year beasts were common in the River of Time, spanning desolate, ancient desolate, and immemorial desolate tiers.

The food of year beasts was year Gu.

While immortal-level Year Gu held immense attraction for year beasts, Years Flow Like Water—which could endlessly produce them—was hundreds or thousands of times more alluring!

For this reason, Hei Fan had sealed Year Gu and Years Flow Like Water in the inheritance without exposing a trace of their auras.

Or more accurately, the immortal killer moves!

# Chapter 1130: Usage of Hei Fan's Gu

Descriptions of countless immortal killer moves unfolded before Fang Yuan.

These killer moves mostly used Year Gu and After Gu as cores, while a few utilized rank eight Years Flow Like Water.

With only rank six cultivation, his green grape immortal essence could not activate Years Flow Like Water, unlike Attitude Gu which only required mental energy.

Despite massive essence costs, Bountiful Year boosted resource production throughout the aperture for an entire year.
