That was finding a method to delay calamities and tribulations in his immortal aperture.

"Days pass like years!" His eyes flashed, he saw his target.

Using immortal-level Year Gu as core and numerous supplementary Day Gu, this killer move slowed time in the immortal aperture.

As the name implied, a single day in the immortal aperture would be extended to the length of a year.

However, Hei Fan cautioned that extending one day into a year was purely theoretical, with actual effects varying greatly by circumstance.

"Months pass like years."

It also slowed time in the immortal aperture, stretching one month into the duration of a year. The core remained immortal-level Year Gu, with Month Gu as supplementary Gu.

Alongside Days Pass Like Years and Months Pass Like Years, there were two other moves: Years Pass Like Months and Years Pass Like Days.

The former two slowed time in the immortal aperture, while the latter two accelerated it.

Slowing time spaced out tribulations; instead of facing them every two months, decades could pass before the next.

From now on, Fang Yuan could choose when to undergo tribulations—delaying or hastening them gave him a huge advantage.

"Right now, I do not need to slow my aperture's time. I should undergo tribulations to gain dao marks and raise my cultivation. With Chu Du's help, I have a high chance of passing," Fang Yuan thought.

"The Immortal Gu are here, but acquiring enough mortal day and month Gu will take time."

Immortal killer move — Hundred Years Harmony!

Using year Gu and information path mortal Gu, it established an alliance agreement lasting a hundred years.

"I can use this with Chu Du. After all, our current alliance agreement was solely arranged by him and is not reliable," Fang Yuan quickly thought.

"Oh, endless trouble? What move is this?"

Using After Immortal Gu, it allowed a Gu Immortal to delay their current tribulation until the next, facing both together.

Delaying a tribulation angered heaven's will, greatly strengthening subsequent ones.

"It is not a routine method and can only be used in emergencies, but it is definitely useful," Fang Yuan thought, surprised and delighted.

Anger heaven's will?

He could not care less.

Heaven's will was already bent on killing him; Fang Yuan's very existence was the greatest cause of its anger.

As Shadow Sect's spy who had struck a deal with Fang Yuan, Sixth Hair remained completely fearless, knowing no one would believe Fang Yuan if exposed.

"Elder Fang Yuan, I know why you came, but you will be disappointed this time," Twelfth Hair declared, puffing out his chest in confidence.

Fang Yuan smiled: "Then I look forward to Brother Twelfth's victory."

In a flash, the immortals found themselves in Tai Qiu.

Before advancing far, Fang Yuan spotted his target.

"An immature falling star hound?" Fang Yuan noted with slight surprise as the hairy man Gu Immortals charged forward.

The falling star hound howled, lowering its hill-like body and bursting forward at incredible speed.

Twelfth Hair clapped, sending expanding blue light from his hands to form a blue lake in the sky.

Water spewed from the lake as three desolate beasts emerged from its depths.

The three desolate beasts charged the falling star hound, clashing fiercely atop the giant grass.

Twelfth Hair directed the three desolate beasts to draw the falling star hound's attention, while the other hairy man Gu Immortals hid in the giant grass, attacking from afar.

Though immature, the falling star hound fought these hairy man Gu Immortals evenly.

He thought: "I am here, heaven's will, how will you deal with me this time?"

# Chapter 1135: Don't Be A Disturbance

With a loud boom, the falling star hound crashed into the diamond bear.

Though only a desolate beast, the diamond bear possessed a robust body that blocked the falling star hound like a wall.

Meanwhile, five or six killer moves shot from the giant grass, striking the falling star hound's body.

The falling star hound cried in pain as the attacks tore open its flesh.

Despite prolonged attacks that tore its flesh open, the falling star hound was only lightly injured.

As an ancient desolate beast, even an immature infant possessed incredible defense and recovery abilities.

"After treasure yellow heaven opened, Twelfth Hair bought a diamond bear and a golden-white tiger. But his choice is questionable; the diamond bear alone is sufficient. That way, the falling star hound would be more distracted and wary, weakening its attacks as it defended. Hmm?"

Twelfth Hair slipped up, leaving an opening when the diamond bear shifted away.

"Damn it!" With furious eyes, Twelfth Hair immediately moved the chestnut yak to fill the gap.

The falling star hound growled, slamming the chestnut yak away.

Breaking free from the encirclement, the falling star hound charged into the grass.

The next moment, he vanished, reappearing beside another hairy man a thousand steps away.

The one who saved him was Sixth Hair.

Fang Yuan snorted coldly, hiding killing intent in his gaze as he looked at Sixth Hair.

Failing to kill the Gu Immortal, the falling star hound was quickly intercepted by the diamond bear and golden-white tiger. Soon, the chestnut yak arrived to reform the encirclement.

These hairy man Gu Immortals seemed to share the same immortal killer move: whenever one was targeted, the others could teleport him to a comrade's side.

"Even if I cannot break it, killing these hairy man Gu Immortals is very easy. My movement speed far exceeds theirs; sword marks targeting death and dark assassination could easily slaughter them. In fact, flying sword Immortal Gu alone is enough. Of course, Sixth Hair hiding his strength is another matter. The actual situation will depend on how the fight develops."

As the falling star hound gradually weakened, the hairy man Gu Immortals felt the pressure ease.

However, a change occurred right at this moment!

An eagle hound suddenly appeared in the center of the battlefield. With one claw swipe, the diamond bear fell! With one beak peck, the chestnut yak was blinded! With a flap of its wings, fierce winds blew the golden-white tiger back dozens of steps. The falling star hound curled up into a ball, whimpering in fear.

"Where did this ancient desolate beast come from?" The hairy man Gu Immortals were shocked.

"Not—not just one!" Soon, five eagle hounds emerged from the grass, while three flew in the sky.

Out of nowhere, eagle hounds had completely encircled the hairy man Gu Immortals.

"How—how did this happen?" Twelfth Hair's pupils shrank to pinpricks, completely stunned!

"Oh? Heaven's will, this is your ambush... incredible indeed," Fang Yuan laughed inwardly.

"Twelfth Hair, it seems you have all failed. According to our earlier agreement, it is time for me to act," Fang Yuan said plainly amidst the silence.

Twelfth Hair's heart leaped in burning rage as he screamed at Fang Yuan: "Are you out of your mind?! What are you talking about? Open your damned eyes and look at our situation!"

Fang Yuan's lips curled slightly.

A strength path giant hand materialized, slamming the eagle hound closest to Fang Yuan into the ground.

Dust and smoke rose.

The eagle hounds turned their attention toward Fang Yuan, wary of this powerful enemy.

From within the dust cloud, Fang Yuan's voice sounded: "Alright, I accept this present. Everyone, please back away and don't disturb me."

# Chapter 1136: Eagle Hounds

Eagle hounds!

They had wolf bodies, eagle heads, and winged backs. Black feathers covered their heads, necks, and wings, while grey fur coated their canine bodies and four limbs. Their dao marks were predominantly dark path.

As for why this falling star hound roamed near the teleportation Gu formation, the answer was clear: heaven's will!

Floating midair, Fang Yuan looked down at the giant beast below.

Its ferocity stirred, the beast opened its beak wide with a furious screech, flapping its wings and springing from its hind limbs to charge ferociously at Fang Yuan.

Fang Yuan sneered, shouting: "Beast, lie down."

Boom!

A strength path giant hand descended from the sky, slamming onto the ground like a jar lid.

With a thunderous crash, the ancient eagle hound's head was slammed violently into the ground.

With unforgiving momentum, Fang Yuan delivered three more resounding slams, burying the ancient eagle hound almost entirely into the ground.

Under everyone's gaze, Fang Yuan slowly raised his head toward the sky.

Several eagle hounds hovered in the air, among them the second ancient desolate beast.

The next instance, his figure appeared behind the ancient eagle hound.

Myriad self first style, giant hand!

The hairy men watched as Fang Yuan slammed the ancient eagle hound down like a ball, crashing heavily into the ground.

Just as Fang Yuan moved to pursue it, his expression suddenly changed.

In his eyes flashed a scene of the future —

As he charged down, a third ancient eagle hound suddenly ambushed him.

The image flashed in an instant, however Fang Yuan fully trusted it.

This was the effect of his pre-activated immortal killer move—Three Breaths Future Vision!

A time path killer move from Hei Fan's true inheritance, Three Breaths Future Vision used After Immortal Gu to reveal events three breaths ahead.

Fang Yuan did not panic; instead, his eyes shone with satisfaction.

"Sure enough, heaven's will's arrangement wouldn't be so simple, there was actually an ambush!"

Sword marks targeting death!

With a sharp, clear sound, the ancient eagle hound was intercepted by sword marks targeting death.

"To block sword marks targeting death, does this ancient eagle hound have wild Immortal Gu?"

# Chapter 1137: Transformation Path Gu Immortal

The third ancient eagle hound had Immortal Gu.

He intended to take down all these eagle hounds!

"My sovereign immortal aperture is very big!" Fang Yuan's lips curled up.

"As for the wild Immortal Gu on that ancient eagle hound, I will take it as well. Since it blocked sword marks targeting death, let me see what kind of exemplary defensive Immortal Gu it is."

Fang Yuan clapped, choosing his personal creation and most practiced offensive method.

Convergence of enslavement and strength path — Myriad Self!

The next instant, vast numbers of strength path phantoms filled the sky.

Using familiar face to disguise himself as an ordinary strength path phantom, Fang Yuan blended into the myriad self army.

Fang Yuan succeeded as groups of the myriad self army besieged the third eagle hound from all directions.

But with bloodstained conqueror's robe, there was not much injury.

A transformation path Gu Immortal who cultivated an eagle hound transformation had transformed too frequently or stayed transformed too long, losing their wisdom and memories and turning into a special ancient eagle hound.

Though the ancient eagle hound was troublesome, Fang Yuan held the dominant position from the start, and the hounds could not threaten him.

Immortal killer move — Year Beast Summoning.

Surging waves rolled endlessly in the river as an enormous beast leaped out!

# Chapter 1138: End of Battle

"According to Hei Fan's true inheritance, year beasts have twelve forms. I was quite lucky to summon a chicken year beast this time," Fang Yuan assessed inwardly as he sized it up.

It swept its gaze across the battlefield before fixing on Fang Yuan.

Fang Yuan held the greatest appeal to it, for it smelled the scent of year Gu on him.

Overjoyed, the chicken year beast raised its head and inhaled.

An enormous air current surged as the chicken year beast inhaled every mortal year Gu like a dragon swallowing water.

"Kill it and I will give you far more." Fang Yuan pointed at the crucial ancient eagle hound.

The chicken year beast's gaze sharpened as it snapped its head toward the target.

Flapping its wings, the chicken year beast charged with speed surpassing even the ancient eagle hound.

Though lacking Immortal Gu, this chicken year beast's physical constitution was far stronger than the ancient eagle hound's.

Hidden within the myriad self army, Fang Yuan's true body quietly approached a desolate beast eagle hound.

Fang Yuan attacked suddenly as a strength path giant hand manifested, slamming down upon an eagle hound.

"Die!"

Fang Yuan soared into the sky, flanking the ancient eagle hound alongside the chicken year beast.

After several rounds of fighting, the results were lackluster.

Fang Yuan directed the chicken year beast to retreat and guard the unconscious eagle hounds.

Fang Yuan and the ancient eagle hound battled once again.

But this time, the situation was different from before.

"This is truly troublesome. Giant hand is too slow to hit, and while sword path killer moves connect, their effect is mediocre. Using poison spit simply wastes immortal essence—ancient eagle hounds are extremely resistant to poison!"

Immortal killer move — Luck Whirlwind!

Luck whirlwind!

Fang Yuan had no choice but to stop.

# Chapter 1139: Deadly Situation

But as a wisdom path grandmaster, I can use this foundation to develop this aspect and achieve a breakthrough."

"'Regardless, this is genuine rank seven battle strength." Sixth Hair's eyes twitched as he looked at the chicken year beast. 'Fang Yuan is only rank six, but possesses rank seven strength. Adding another rank seven force... I must report this to Lord Ying Wu Xie!'""

The snowmen melted from the flying salt almost as soon as they appeared. Heaven's will was actively trying to minimize Fang Yuan's gains from the calamity.

Waves of Reckless Savage's true meaning entered his mind, rapidly raising his attainment.

But right at this moment!

Immemorial desolate beast!

# Chapter 1140: The Sliver of Hope to Survive

The surrounding area was frost white in color.

"A battlefield immortal killer move I've never seen before... It seems mostly formed of cloud path..."

Fully vigilant after the initial shock, Fang Yuan rapidly analyzed the situation.

"Setting aside the killer move, there are nine Gu Immortals and an immemorial dragon beast!" Fang Yuan observed the nine figures.

This group was far too powerful; he was nowhere near their match.

"Moreover, I have stayed inside Lang Ya blessed land almost continuously, shielded from wisdom path deductions by Dark Limit and other methods. Deducing my whereabouts so accurately should be nearly impossible! Where did these Gu Immortals come from? Central Continent?"

"Could this be an illusion created by the battlefield killer move?" Fang Yuan speculated.

Eyes flashing with sharp light, Fang Yuan decisively activated sword escape Immortal Gu and charged toward the Gu Immortals.

Closing in, Fang Yuan stopped with three breaths future vision and bloodstained conqueror's robe active; pointing his finger, sword light shot out.

Immortal killer move — Sword Marks Targeting Death.

A rank seven female Gu Immortal beside him grabbed his shoulder: "You can't handle this move, let me."

As she spoke, she pointed a finger, conjuring an ice mirror in midair.

Sword marks targeting death's light struck the ice mirror, but failed to pierce it and was reflected away.

"She can redirect my killer move!" Fang Yuan's heart chilled as he quickly steered sword marks targeting death back toward its target.

A second rank seven Gu Immortal stepped forward with a deep bellow, instantly condensing an ice spear in his hand.

Drawing his arm back like a bow to full stretch, he hurled the spear toward Fang Yuan.

Unable to dodge, Fang Yuan knew bloodstained conqueror's robe alone could not stop the strike, immediately conjuring a strength path giant hand.

Hurled backward, thick ice encased Fang Yuan's body, freezing his spurted blood and damaging his blood asset Immortal Gu.

"The two rank seven Gu Immortals are not illusions. What about the others then?" Fang Yuan swallowed his blood and clapped, using the killer move myriad self.

His thoughts raced as he realized: "No, I still have a chance of survival!"

That chance lay with the upper extreme heavenly eagle.

The upper extreme heavenly eagle was an immemorial desolate beast, though currently an infant with only ordinary desolate beast strength.

However, Hei Fan's true inheritance contained time path killer moves that could accelerate the eagle's aging and force it to mature rapidly!

With this, Fang Yuan would have rank eight battle strength.

Capable of traversing grotto-heavens, the space path immemorial eagle had a high chance of breaking through this battlefield killer move.

"Hold on! I must endure until the upper extreme heavenly eagle reaches rank eight!" Fang Yuan immediately shifted his battle tactics.

# Chapter 1141: Refusal to Listen or Believe

Within the sovereign immortal aperture, the time path killer move had already quietly activated.

Under the killer move's effect, the upper extreme heavenly eagle's internal time sped up countless times, maturing it rapidly.

Needing numerous heavenly crystals daily just to fill its stomach, with a full day passing every breath, its hunger was ravenous.

Continuously casting myriad self, the once-powerful killer move was now Fang Yuan's only means of stalling for time.

Disguised through familiar face among the sea of strength path phantoms, he had remained undetected by the enemy Gu Immortals.

However, his green grape immortal essence reserve was rapidly dwindling.

Growing rapidly, the eagle already radiated the aura of an ancient desolate beast, having consumed over half of the heavenly crystal eagle nest.

"The enemy has numbers and endless killer moves. If my breakthrough with the upper extreme heavenly eagle fails, I'll be struck down immediately. There is no second chance—I must succeed on the first try!"

Right then, Fang Yuan heard a chuckle by his ear.

"Heehee, found you."

Fang Yuan's hair stood on end; disregarding exposure, he instantly activated sword escape Immortal Gu!

Almost simultaneously, frost condensed where he had stood, rapidly forming a pavilion-sized block of thick ice.

"Thank you, great-grandma," the female Gu Immortal said joyfully. "Though I couldn't see through his disguise, every activation of his phantom killer move leaked aura. No matter how well hidden he was, repeated use gave him away."

"Good! Let me see where you can escape!" Another rank seven Gu Immortal shouted, directly charging towards Fang Yuan.

"Die!" The rank seven Gu Immortal clenched his fists, instantly two ice spears condensed in his hands.

"A close combat Gu Immortal?!" Eyes flashing with sharp light, Fang Yuan swiftly retreated.

Yet Sword Escape failed to shake the enemy off.

Fang Yuan's pupils contracted upon noticing a thin layer of grey clouds clinging to his body.

This rank seven Gu Immortal was very powerful with outstanding fighting skill.

Blood asset Immortal Gu was heavily injured!

Fragmentary ice and snow dao marks coated Fang Yuan's wounds, hindering healing while bone-chilling cold slowed him down.

The sovereign immortal body's disadvantage appeared for the first time!

Having non-conflicting dao marks caused Fang Yuan to be easily injured.

"Die!" The enemy attacked fiercely, thrusting his right ice spear at Fang Yuan's forehead while secretly stabbing the left toward his heart.

Blood torrent!

Fang Yuan abruptly switched killer moves, twisting unpredictably to dodge the strike.

"Blood path!" a rank six Gu Immortal blurted in shock.

The dual-spear Gu Immortal surged with heightened killing intent, lunging forward once more.

His momentum broken, Fang Yuan barely held out before the enemy found an opening and thrust a spear through his heart.

Man as Before!

Fang Yuan activated man as before Immortal Gu to instantly heal his fatal wounds.

Then using dark assassination, he shot towards the enemy's head.

In an instant, Fang Yuan had established his victory!

Next instant, Fang Yuan saw a bizarre sight: the enemy's head was not flesh and blood, but composed entirely of grey clouds.

The grey clouds scattered and reformed. Shaking his new head, the dual-spear Gu Immortal laughed: "Not bad! Normally I'd be dead, but we are inside grey cloud battle puppet, an immortal battlefield!"

Fang Yuan's pupils shrunk to pin-size.

Not knowing the battlefield killer move's mechanics had caused a severe misjudgment.

"Grey cloud battle puppet is truly a formidable killer move," Fang Yuan exhaled, his body riddled with wounds.

"Naturally! It was created by Lady Earth Mother!" the dual-spear Gu Immortal declared proudly.

Fang Yuan checked his immortal aperture; the upper extreme heavenly eagle had already matured into an immemorial desolate beast.

The heavenly crystals were depleted, and it was rapidly starving to death.

Fang Yuan quickly dispelled the killer move affecting the eagle and attempted to feed it other foods.

"Damn it! I was so occupied with the enemy that I had no time to monitor the eagle's condition." Fang Yuan's heart sank to rock bottom.

His final trace of hope was gone.

"Young man, state your name. You are a worthy adversary; after my passing, this battle will be remembered with pride by my descendants." The dual-spear Gu Immortal pressed forward.

Fang Yuan revealed a confident smile: "My name is unimportant, but my identity is. I am a supreme elder of Lang Ya blessed land, part of a variant human force. Given the world's situation, we variant humans should not fight amongst ourselves. Snowmen, rockmen, and hairy men must help one another, not engage in infighting that only pleases our enemies!"

"How do you know..." The dual-spear Gu Immortal was stunned.

"What Lang Ya blessed land! You are clearly human, not a hairy man! Do you think I'm blind?!" The dual-spear Gu Immortal furiously thrust his spears.

Though Fang Yuan exposed their identities, they refused to listen or believe him.

# Chapter 1142: Bluffing, Deceiving

"Variant humans are truly stubborn... or is this heaven's will at work? Hmph!" Gaze turning dark, Fang Yuan neither dodged nor retreated as the dual-spear Gu Immortal charged.

Opening the entrance to his sovereign immortal aperture, he released a gigantic beast.

An immemorial upper extreme heavenly eagle possessed terrifying rank eight battle strength!

"Enough, dispel grey cloud battle puppet."

"Do you truly believe grey cloud battle puppet can still trap him?"

Assorted fruits were set before everyone, and rockman servants soon served each person a large bowl of wine.

Immemorial desolate beast, rank eight battle strength!!

# Chapter 1144: Refining Gu, Grand Commotion

A couple snuggled by the window, looking out at the snowy landscape.

His wife's smile faded slightly as she frowned: "Truth be told, I regret it a little. I would rather your cultivation were lower."

"How could your husband have low cultivation? Rest assured, once we refine fortune rivalling heaven Immortal Gu, I am confident in passing this myriad tribulation. Then our future will be boundless, and I can stay with you forever." The old man's gaze sharpened, revealing an extraordinarily powerful aura.

After a long silence, the old man spoke: "Let us begin."

Old Ancestor Xue Hu and Lady Wan Shou began refining fortune rivalling heaven Immortal Gu!

That day, dazzling lights shot skyward from Snowy Mountain blessed land, impossible to conceal!

Feng Xian grotto-heaven.

"Even without fortune rivalling heaven Gu, he remains Northern Plains' number one expert. Our priority is capturing Fang Yuan. Heavenly Court has deduced and confirmed he is in Northern Plains!" Prince Feng Xian laughed, his eyes gleaming coldly.

Bai Zu grotto-heaven.

"Alone, I cannot match Old Ancestor Xue Hu. Having just founded Bai Zu tribe after years of planning, I cannot act rashly."

"Unless Yao Huang and the others make a move... until then, I should concentrate on invading Hei Fan grotto-heaven."

Meanwhile, in the underground icy plain, "Elder Fang Yuan, please enter. This is our tribe's sacred ground—Earth Mother Altar!" Shi Shi Cheng respectfully guided him.

Following Lang Ya land spirit's arrangements, Sixth Hair and the others negotiated the alliance, while Fang Yuan toured the area to familiarize himself with variant human life.

"Elder Fang Yuan, didn't you ask why there is soil beneath the northern icy plain? You will understand once you enter," Xue Er giggled.

Entering Earth Mother Altar, Fang Yuan stared at two statues enshrined in the center.

A female human immortal was hugging a rockman Gu Immortal's arm, both gazing blissfully into the distance as if they had shared a charmed life.

"This is our tribe's twenty-seventh first supreme elder, Shi Mu, and beside him is his wife, our revered Lady Earth Mother—a human Gu Immortal," Shi Shi Cheng introduced.

Xue Er added: "Lady Earth Mother's love transcended race. Grieved by the rockmen's lack of land, she chose to die shortly after Lord Shi Mu's passing. For future generations, her dao marks and blessed land formed this underground soil, granting rockmen a foundation for survival."

Fang Yuan firmly stared at this couple's statues.

He actually recognized this Earth Mother whom the rockmen and snowmen revered!

Fang Yuan recognized Earth Mother only because he had soul-searched Hei Cheng.

Earth Mother was Hei tribe's missing Hei Feng Yue, Old Ancestor Hei Fan's most beloved granddaughter!

"Who could have expected Hei Feng Yue disappeared because she loved a rockman Gu Immortal? This would never have been accepted by Northern Plains' human Gu Immortals."

Xue Er had been secretly watching Fang Yuan; seeing no disgust or anger on his face, she felt delighted.

Gazing at the statues, she said with clear intent: "I believe love has no boundaries! Whether rockmen or humans, both have the right to love and coexist!"

A beautiful white figure flashed across his eyes.

"The five hundred years of my first life..." His gaze turned deep and serene.

"We were forced by circumstances to fight you. The northern icy plain was once pure ice; only through Lady Earth Mother did earth qi gather to create this soil."

"However, when a Gu Immortal undergoes tribulations here, it consumes earth qi, destabilizing the plain and shrinking our living area."

"This is my fault. Had I known, I would not have undergone my calamity in the northern icy plain!" Fang Yuan replied earnestly.

"It is best that the misunderstanding is resolved," Shi Shi Cheng said.

Just then, Shi Shi Cheng's expression changed, followed closely by Xue Er's.

"Lights are soaring from Snowy Mountain blessed land; intelligence says Old Ancestor Xue Hu has begun refining fortune rivalling heaven Gu," Shi Shi Cheng said heavily.

Xue Er turned to Fang Yuan: "Elder Fang Yuan, as a reborn otherworldly demon who used Spring Autumn Cicada and destroyed Eighty-Eight True Yang Building, do you know if Old Ancestor Xue Hu succeeds in refining fortune rivalling heaven Gu?"

---

# Chapter 1145: Rank Eight Determines The Situation

Humanity was overwhelmingly dominant, while variant human tribes barely survived in isolated corners like this. Naturally, they were inclined to ally.

As discussions progressed, Sixth Hair leaked nearly all intelligence on Fang Yuan to gain their trust.

Thus, the snowmen and rockmen understood Fang Yuan's extraordinary status.

Inside Earth Mother Altar, prepared for Xue Er's question, Fang Yuan smiled bitterly: "Though I had Spring Autumn Cicada, I have already lost that mystical Gu. Since my rebirth, the world has changed drastically. As you know, I caused Eighty-Eight True Yang Building to collapse."

Fang Yuan rubbed his nose and sighed: "Being reborn, I knew some secrets. Though lacking Huang Jin bloodline, I entered the Imperial Court contest to reap benefits from Eighty-Eight True Yang Building. My plan was to visit repeatedly for continuous gains. But plans cannot keep up with changes; accidents forced me to adapt, ultimately causing Eighty-Eight True Yang Building's collapse!"

Fang Yuan shook his head helplessly: "Who would want to be hunted by the world's Gu Immortals? It was truly an accident."

"Thus, I had no choice but to take refuge in Lang Ya blessed land and eventually join Lang Ya Sect. Living there, I realized variant humans are in no way inferior to humans. Their sincerity, trust, and loyalty far surpass deceitful humans. Although the five regions are vast, the living space of variant humans is shrinking by the day—this is unjust. Heaven's will permits all living beings to exist, variant humans and humans should indeed co-exist."

"Yet Elder Fang Yuan hasn't answered my question," Xue Er noted, too sharp to be easily misled.

"I was just getting to that." Fang Yuan coughed. "Eighty-Eight True Yang Building's destruction was unintended. In fact, before my rebirth, it never fell!"

"Northern Plains changed too much because of me: the building fell, and Ma Hong Yun was captured by Old Ancestor Xue Hu. Before my rebirth, Old Ancestor Xue Hu never attempted to refine fortune rivalling heaven Gu," Fang Yuan added.

Xue Er pursed her lips: "Then the outcome is unpredictable? If Old Ancestor Xue Hu refines fortune rivalling heaven Gu, Northern Plains' human Gu Immortals will grow even stronger."

Fang Yuan probed: "Do you intend to stop him?"

"Of course not!" Shi Shi Cheng shook his head. "We absolutely cannot interfere."

"Indeed. We live peacefully here; why expose ourselves to offend a rank eight expert who controls Snowy Mountain blessed land and numerous demonic experts?" Xue Er shook her head.

Fang Yuan nodded silently, pondering inwardly.

"These variant humans are truly extraordinary. The Gu Immortals I met these past few days are all elites, outstanding in both battle strength and foresight. They would excel even among Northern Plains' human Gu Immortals, far outstripping those from Hei Fan grotto-heaven. Fortunately, I possess rank eight battle strength!"

"I wonder what expressions they would have if they knew my upper extreme heavenly eagle was already dead?" Fang Yuan thought with amusement.

He had forcibly accelerated its growth, but lacking heavenly crystals, it had nearly starved to death.

By temporarily boosting its vitality with blood path methods upon releasing it, he had thoroughly intimidated the variant humans, surviving and overturning the situation through sheer deception.

Yet the upper extreme heavenly eagle was like a setting sun's dying glow; moments after returning to his immortal aperture, it died.

Fortunately, the upper extreme heavenly eagle possessed a marvelous trait: upon dying, it produced an egg that would hatch into its rebirth.

Though Fang Yuan lost the immemorial desolate beast upper extreme heavenly eagle, he gained its egg and its giant immemorial corpse.

First of all, Fang Yuan was dissatisfied with this eagle, as commanding it required disguising himself with Hei tribe bloodline.

Secondly, forced growth introduced many flaws. Possessing rank eight battle strength and great pride, how could such an immemorial being obey a mere rank six Gu Immortal?

With the new egg, Fang Yuan could use Hei Fan's true inheritance to tamper with its memories and ensure it hatched completely loyal to him.

Old Ancestor Xue Hu was openly refining fortune rivalling heaven Gu; the refinement path Gu formation's light shot into the heavens, shining brightly for seven days and nights before dissipating.

After the shock, Northern Plains' Gu Immortal world strangely quieted down.

This was because Heavenly Lord Bai Zu, Yao Huang, Five Elements Grandmaster and Prince Feng Xian had not responded yet. Without these rank eight Gu Immortals speaking up, even if the other rank six and rank sevens clamored, it would be of no use.

# Chapter 1146: Four Races Alliance

Four incense sticks burned, smoke curling into the air as Gu Immortals stood solemnly in four distinct camps.

Shi Zong stepped forward amidst drumbeats, speaking loudly: "I, Gu Immortal Shi Zong of the rockman tribe, am willing to join the four races alliance. From today onwards, the four races shall be united, we shall share fortune and woe together."

He activated his immortal essence, causing changes in the Earth Mother Altar.

The curling smoke surged toward Shi Zong, coiled around him for a dozen breaths, and completely merged into his body.

"Adding information path dao marks! It seems to be an ancient method..." Fang Yuan pondered.

Gu Immortals took turns stepping forward to receive the information path dao marks, joining the four races alliance.

Time passed, Fang Yuan gradually understood some of the mechanics.

"This isn't an orthodox information path method, but earth path achieving information path effects—just like my time path killer move, Hundred Years Harmony."

Fang Yuan's heart sank as he thought of this.

Breaking this alliance agreement in the future would be troublesome. Unable to resolve it with information path, he would likely need earth path methods.

"Elder Fang Yuan, it's your turn," Twelfth Hair reminded warmly from the side.

Ever since news spread of his immemorial upper extreme heavenly eagle, the hairy men treated Fang Yuan with reverence.

Fang Yuan nodded and stepped forward without hesitation, letting the incense smoke imprint onto his body just as Shi Zong had done.

Seeing him truly join the alliance, the immortals relaxed their worries, and Xue Er smiled even more sweetly.

Similarly, he joined this four races alliance out of situational necessity and to borrow its strength for his cultivation.

"Humans hold absolute dominance; what can these four allied variant human tribes accomplish?"

"In my first life, there was no news of these snowmen and rockmen—they were either wiped out or remained hidden. Lang Ya blessed land never formed a sect and was eventually destroyed by Heavenly Court. In contrast, the inkmen flourished."

Thinking of this, Fang Yuan stole a glance at Mo Tan Sang.

"This man is quite formidable," Fang Yuan appraised.

Sensing Fang Yuan's gaze, Mo Tan Sang turned back and smiled with sincere warmth.

His smile was so deeply deferential that he was practically bowing in subtle flattery.

Fang Yuan sneered inwardly while returning the smile outwardly.

"Truly formidable." Fang Yuan's own acting skills were exceptional, but Mo Tan Sang was his equal.

"The world is vast and full of extraordinary talents; I cannot underestimate these figures," Fang Yuan reminded himself, his mind remaining completely calm.

Fortunately, none of the four tribes possessed a wisdom path Gu Immortal.

After the alliance was formed, Fang Yuan's loss was obvious.

He could no longer undergo tribulations in the northern icy plain.

Tribulations consumed earth qi, damaging the rockmen's homeland—which was why they had deployed grey cloud battle puppet.

Establishing trade with the rockman and snowman tribes elevated his monthly earnings to new heights.

The rockmen in particular desired guts Gu even more than humans did.

Fang Yuan also sold Hei Fan grotto-heaven resources to the rockmen, snowmen, and inkmen for massive profits, making Sixth Hair worry and fume inwardly.

It was time to bid farewell!

Fang Yuan smiled warmly: "This alliance is of utmost importance, so I must personally report back to Lang Ya land spirit. Rest assured, I will return. We are friends made from fighting, and I have grown fond of this place."

Fang Yuan was interested in the snowman Gu Immortals' ice and snow path Immortal Gu and killer moves.

When a variant human Gu Immortal struggled with tribulations, they would need his time path killer move to slow their aperture's time.

Fang Yuan could then seize the opportunity to demand Immortal Gu.

Hei Fan had obtained numerous Immortal Gu this way in the past.

Unaware that the handsome youth before her harbored sinister schemes, Xue Er lowered her head with a conflicted, hesitant expression upon seeing him prepare to leave.

Soon, resolve filled her eyes; raising her head, she handed Fang Yuan an item.

"Elder Fang Yuan, take this as my farewell gift to you." Xue Er tried to stay calm, but her voice still trembled.

Fang Yuan glanced at the item—it was an ice tear!

---

# Chapter 1147: Making Chu Du Change Sides?

Though not an immortal material, ice tears were precious and prized by Gu Masters and Gu Immortals alike.

Snowmen rarely showed emotion, making their tears exceedingly rare; whenever shed, they instantly condensed into ice tears.

To human Gu Immortals, ice tears were precious Gu refinement materials.

That was — a token of love!

Snowmen traditionally exchanged ice tears upon marriage, an act of profound significance.

"An ice tear." Fang Yuan's eyes brightened as he held it up for closer inspection.

"Don't, don't look at it like that, put it away..." Xue Er whispered anxiously. With so many onlookers, displaying it openly was sure to draw attention!

Sure enough, surprised murmurs from the Gu Immortals quickly followed.

"I've heard of this peculiar Gu material long ago and now finally seen it in person. Thank you Xue Er, this is a fine gift. Maybe I should refine it into a Gu worm?" Fang Yuan said cheerfully.

Ignoring her reaction, Fang Yuan continued: "Though one drop is rather little; having more would be wonderful. It is truly a pity there are no ice tear transactions."

The shy blush on Xue Er's face vanished into ashen pale. Lowering her head further, her vision blurred as tears formed.

"This fool!" Unable to watch any longer, Bing Zhuo cursed inwardly and stepped forward.

Xue Er raised her head with her back to Fang Yuan, calling out: "Brother Bing Zhuo!"

Swallowing his words, Bing Zhuo changed the subject: "Elder Fang Yuan, I gained much from our battle. Next time, let us spar properly again!"

He emphasized 'spar' with a heavy, teeth-grinding tone.

Fang Yuan smiled and patted Bing Zhuo's shoulder: "I promise we will spar again when opportunity arises. Everyone, I shall take my leave. No need to see me off; we will meet again. Hahaha."

Laughing heartily, he strode away in his white robe and long black hair, handsome and utterly carefree.

Bing Zhuo gnashed his teeth, itching to chop Fang Yuan to pieces.

"This won't do! Once he is far enough, I must send a letter explaining the true meaning of the ice tear!"

The return journey to Lang Ya blessed land was entirely smooth and uneventful.

When they met again, Lang Ya Sect's first supreme elder treated Fang Yuan with a drastically changed attitude.

"You inherited Hei Fan's true inheritance, and really have an immemorial upper extreme heavenly eagle? Bring it out!" Lang Ya land spirit asked excitedly.

Fang Yuan smiled wryly and produced the upper extreme heavenly eagle's corpse.

Lang Ya land spirit was stunned on the spot.

Fang Yuan explained the entire sequence of events.

"You starved a magnificent immemorial desolate beast to death?! You... fortunately, the egg remains. That is the upper extreme heavenly eagle's special trait."

Recovering his senses, Lang Ya land spirit stared eagerly at Fang Yuan: "Sell this upper extreme heavenly eagle egg to me; let us make a deal!"

Fang Yuan laughed: "I can sell this egg!"

Fang Yuan added: "However, you likely lack the heavenly crystals to raise it. Even treasure yellow heaven rarely sells them."

"Naturally. Heavenly crystals only form in grotto-heavens or the immemorial nine heavens—they are rare, precious rank eight immortal materials! Right now, only black heaven and white heaven remain from the immemorial nine heavens while the number of rank eight Gu Immortals have always been few. Moreover, among these rank eight Gu Immortals, some are unable to produce heavenly crystals."

Lang Ya land spirit then grinned: "No need to worry. Lang Ya blessed land was once a grotto-heaven that produced heavenly crystals, and my main body hoarded a massive stockpile from the immemorial nine heavens."

"In that case, I can rest easy. I will sell it to you," Fang Yuan agreed.

Lang Ya land spirit laughed: "As you are one of us, I won't let you lose out. Choose freely among luck path, Thieving Heaven, or Long Hair true inheritances!"

Fang Yuan frowned: "I have little interest in those. Besides, isn't that price far too low for rank eight battle strength?"

Lang Ya land spirit fumed: "Then name your price! What will it take?"

Fang Yuan smiled, stressing: "This is rank eight battle strength!"

Lang Ya land spirit retorted: "It is rank eight battle strength, but it must be fed! Do you have heavenly crystals? Even if raised, will it obey you? Otherwise, with even a fraction of its strength remaining, it would have crushed an ant trying to enslave it to death!"

Fang Yuan smiled: "Then I'll use sect contribution points for heavenly crystals to raise it. As a Lang Ya supreme elder and four races alliance member, I will naturally step forward whenever the sect needs me."

Stumped, Lang Ya land spirit pointed at Fang Yuan's nose and snapped: "You rascal! You never intended to sell it at all and were just toying with me!"

Fang Yuan adopted a solemn look: "How could I surrender rank eight battle strength so easily? But I would never intentionally trouble First Supreme Elder—the price was simply too low."

Lang Ya land spirit sighed and relented, knowing Fang Yuan had a point.

The eagle had reverted to an egg, which disappointed him, but Fang Yuan was bound by both Lang Ya's oath and the four races alliance. Knowing Fang Yuan's personality, the land spirit felt somewhat reassured.

"An ambitious rascal like you would never surrender rank eight battle strength! But exchanging sect contribution points for Lang Ya's heavenly crystals won't be easy! Heavenly crystals are rank eight immortal materials—despite your wealth of contribution points, you still cannot afford them!" Lang Ya land spirit gloated happily.

Lang Ya land spirit then offered another mission: "Aren't you close with Domination Immortal Chu Du? Recruit him into Lang Ya Sect and turn him from the humans to join us, and I'll award you another thousand contribution points!"

# Chapter 1148: Temporary Rest

Fang Yuan's divine sense was roaming in treasure yellow heaven.

Finding a merchant selling slippery soil, after buying the slippery soil, Fang Yuan browsed further and purchased several other types of soil.

Having achieved his goal, Fang Yuan withdrew his divine sense, transporting the soils into the sovereign immortal aperture.

Directing his strength path immortal zombies, he scattered the soils across various areas of Mini Southern Border.

The sovereign immortal aperture had few earth path dao marks across its vast five regions and nine heavens, leaving Mini Southern Border with a scarce share.

"But this does not solve the underlying issue!"

"These soils will eventually degrade into ordinary dirt as their earth path dao marks dissipate."

"Only by undergoing tribulations or absorbing an earth path Gu Immortal's dao marks to increase my own can I resolve this," Fang Yuan understood.

Unable to face his fifth earthly calamity in the northern icy plain, Fang Yuan could choose Southern Border or other earth-rich regions, hoping for an earth path calamity.

Successfully passing an earth path earthly calamity would alleviate his problem.

With the soil distributed, Fang Yuan refocused on soul-searching the captive Gu Immortals.

Feng Jun's luck path true inheritance and Chen Le's concealment method were quite impressive, piquing Fang Yuan's interest.

"In about three days, I will finish searching these souls' memories and know everything about them."

He left the cloud city, moving towards Luo Po Valley.

There, his soul left his body for grueling soul path cultivation.

Using Dang Hun Mountain and Luo Po Valley, Fang Yuan had increased his soul foundation dozens of times over!

However, he was still not confident of placing his soul into his original body.

"Even if my soul foundation increases, avoiding Shadow Sect's possible hidden methods remains difficult."

Once he could use wisdom Gu, his strength would grow explosively!

"I have wisdom Gu and the strength path immortal zombie body, I just need that final key!" Fang Yuan sighed helplessly.

Thus, Fang Yuan stayed in Lang Ya blessed land for seven days.

Fang Yuan completed soul-searching the nine captives, spent half his contribution points on heavenly crystals, and posted several Gu refinement missions.

Seven days later, he left Lang Ya blessed land for Eastern Sea!

# Chapter 1149: Desiring the Information Path Inheritance

Gale-force winds blew, carrying the salty scent of seawater.

Sitting atop a cloud, Fang Yuan traveled swiftly while inspecting an information path mortal Gu in his hand.

This mortal Gu was from Bing Zhuo.

The spear-wielding, close-combat snowman Gu Immortal wrote that the ice tear held significant meaning for the snowman tribe: beyond being a Gu refinement material, it was a token of love.

"Hmph." Fang Yuan smiled coldly, crushing the information path mortal Gu in his hand.

How could Fang Yuan not know what the ice tear meant to snowmen?

Sometimes, acting ignorant allows someone to have more options.

Accepting the ice tear meant accepting Xue Er's love, but rejecting it would damage his cooperation with the snowmen and rockmen.

"Marrying Xue Er would bind me to the snowman tribe through a marriage agreement. Between Lang Ya Sect, Chu Du, and the four races alliance, my freedom is already heavily restricted. Adding a marriage agreement would only bring more trouble."

"Under the northern icy plain, the rockmen possess the rank eight immemorial rock dragon, while the snowmen lack rank eight battle strength. Thus, they want me to marry Xue Er so they can contend evenly with the rockmen."

"If I marry Xue Er—or even just accept her feelings—it means siding with the snowmen, inevitably entangling me in their conflict with the rockmen."

But the rockman tribe gave Fang Yuan more benefits.

Why would Fang Yuan ruin his relationship with the rockmen and reduce his profits over a woman?

Fang Yuan left Northern Plains for Eastern Sea to avoid these Gu Immortals and avert countless future problems.

"I am merely using these variant humans, but our ties are deepening. I need room to maneuver and retreat freely," Fang Yuan reminded himself.

Furthermore, Lang Ya land spirit intended to recruit Chu Du, threatening Fang Yuan's position.

Though Lang Ya land spirit had assigned him this mission, Fang Yuan delayed it; he was not foolish enough to earnestly recruit Chu Du.

"Eastern Sea information path inheritance..." Fang Yuan thought to himself.

This was one reason he had come to Eastern Sea.

Ideally, this information path inheritance would provide a method to break free from his alliance agreements.

Several days later.

Eastern Sea, turbulent flow sea area.

"Spare me, I surrender!" Covered in wounds, Liu Qing Yu knelt on the ground, devoid of fighting will.

A rank seven lone immortal, he had just been collaborating with three rank six companions.

Yet they were ambushed in the turbulent flow sea area, and his three invited rank six allies were already dead.

Their enemies were four mysterious Gu Immortals.

The highest among them possessed a rank seven aura, but was a rockman Gu Immortal.

The other three were rank six: a bold, beautiful female immortal, a kindly old man, and an ordinary-looking immortal zombie.

All were formidable experts, but strangely to Liu Qing Yu, their leader was neither the rockman, the female immortal, nor the old man—it was the ordinary rank six immortal zombie!

"Oh? Surrendering, hehe, you know your place." Rubbing his chin, the rank six immortal zombie chuckled.

That's right, it was Ying Wu Xie!

"Hmph, a spineless coward, no wonder he was not my match. We should kill him and give Shi Nu some earth path dao marks." Hei Lou Lan was covered in orange flames.

Expressionless, the rockman Gu Immortal Shi Nu looked at Ying Wu Xie and said slowly, "I will listen to master."

"No, no!" Liu Qing Yu cried in frantic helplessness. "Though I am a rank seven Gu Immortal, my Immortal Gu are only rank six. But fairy, you have rank seven Immortal Gu and so many fire path killer moves—no wonder I couldn't defeat you!"

Ying Wu Xie laughed, waving his hand: "Right now, my Shadow Sect needs members, I will give you a chance to live. Do not resist, I will use an immortal killer move to make the alliance agreement!"

"Thank you, Lord, for sparing my life! Thank you, Lord!" Overjoyed, Liu Qing Yu wept and kowtowed continuously.

"From now on, you are a member of Shadow Sect, get up." After making the alliance agreement, Ying Wu Xie smiled.

"This place is remote and surrounded by islands—why come to this specific one?" Ying Wu Xie asked, suspecting their location was exposed.

Liu Qing Yu smiled bitterly. "Lord, it is a misunderstanding; I was merely seeking a place to rest. To explain from the beginning: in this turbulent flow sea area, I found clues to an information path true inheritance..."

Back then, Liu Qing Yu had pursued the blood path demonic immortal for information path inheritance clues. Ultimately, he killed the man without gaining anything, while the other two rank seven Gu Immortals grew suspicious of him instead.

Reflecting on it, he suspected Fang Yuan the most, believing the information path true inheritance clues were in his hands.

Unable to let it go, Liu Qing Yu led a group of Gu Immortals into the turbulent flow sea area to search for clues or wait for Fang Yuan.

Ying Wu Xie's expression shifted abruptly. "Wait, what did that suspicious Gu Immortal look like?"

# Chapter 1150: Turbulent Flow Sea Battle (1/2)

Liu Qing Yu repeated his words from before.

Ying Wu Xie's expression turned grim very quickly.

During his Eastern Sea battle with Liu Qing Yu, Tang Song, and Zhou Li, Fang Yuan had inevitably revealed some methods.

"Flying sword Immortal Gu, sword escape Immortal Gu..." Ying Wu Xie pondered.

Ying Wu Xie grew certain that the Gu Immortal Liu Qing Yu fought was Fang Yuan.

"What a coincidence to learn of Fang Yuan like this. Hehe, heaven's will!" Ying Wu Xie looked up at the sky.

Hei Lou Lan soon calmed down and transmitted, "Your analysis makes sense, but guessing Fang Yuan's identity doesn't prove he'll come here. Just for an information path true inheritance? The crucial clue is gone, and even if he has it, why would he necessarily come here and run into us?"

Ying Wu Xie smiled coldly. "You don't understand heaven's will. Earlier, it tried to obstruct Fang Yuan by luring him with this information path true inheritance, but the vigilant and crafty Fang Yuan avoided the trap. Heading straight to Northern Plains was a wise move that completely wasted heaven's will's arrangements in the turbulent flow sea area."

"Now, Fang Yuan has gained immense strength from Hei Fan's true inheritance. But bound by Lang Ya Sect, the four races alliance, and Chu Du, he has an urgent need for information path methods. Thus, he is likely to follow the clues here to claim this information path inheritance," Ying Wu Xie continued.

Hei Lou Lan's eyes flashed with realization. "You mean Liu Qing Yu is heaven's will's reminder to us?"

"Exactly. Liu Qing Yu seemed to arrive by chance, but he was subconsciously guided by heaven's will to our island—it's too coincidental. Seeing that its earlier trap can no longer stop a much stronger Fang Yuan, heaven's will wants to use us against him!" Ying Wu Xie sneered at the sky.

"Then we can seize this chance to ambush Fang Yuan. Aren't you trying to reclaim the sovereign immortal body?" Hei Lou Lan transmitted.

She soon scoffed in reply, "Only a child would believe that. Would you really give up my battle strength?"

"How will you handle Fang Yuan? He possesses rank eight battle strength," Hei Lou Lan asked.

Ying Wu Xie replied, "I won't fight him; the immemorial upper extreme heavenly eagle is too difficult to handle."

"We can succeed if we use that secluded domain of heaven and earth, can't we?" Hei Lou Lan pressed.

Ying Wu Xie rejected the alluring suggestion: "Even using that place, my goal cannot be achieved. I need to capture Fang Yuan alive with fresh materials; that domain would only temporarily neutralize the upper extreme heavenly eagle's threat."

"Ignoring the big picture is shortsighted. Just as Fang Yuan bypassed the information path inheritance earlier, saving my main body will give us the greatest advantage. With my limited memories, fighting Fang Yuan now falls right into heaven's will's trap. We leave Eastern Sea! But before going, we'll leave a little gift for Fang Yuan. Hehehe." Ying Wu Xie chuckled via transmission.

A day later.

"I'm finally here... turbulent flow sea area." Standing on a cloud, Fang Yuan looked down at the sea and sighed.

Taking a deep breath, Fang Yuan unleashed a surging aura of Immortal Gu.

Immortal investigative killer move — Qi Luck Sensation!

Obtained from Feng Jun and powered by qi luck Immortal Gu, this move sensed closely luck-connected individuals.

"Oh? They are nearby in the turbulent flow sea area?"

# Chapter 1151: Turbulent Flow Sea Battle (2/2)

Five Gu Immortals moved across the sea's surface.

Huge waves surged as Fang Yuan surfaced and revealed himself.

"I finally found you... Ying Wu Xie!" Fang Yuan smiled ruthlessly.

"You are?" Suddenly, Ying Wu Xie's body shook.

Activating luck inspection Immortal Gu, he saw Fang Yuan's towering luck matching his and Hei Lou Lan's.

Connect luck Immortal Gu!

Ying Wu Xie had used Connect Luck on Hei Lou Lan, who was in turn luck-connected to Fang Yuan.

Fang Yuan's appearance could change, but his luck was unconcealed.

Seeing that luck, Ying Wu Xie recognized Fang Yuan!

"Quick, the ancient battle formation!" He shouted loudly, panicking.

Coordinating swiftly, the other three immortals instinctively activated the ancient battle formation, Omni-directional Travel.

Swoosh, the four immortals disappeared completely.

Only one person was left behind.

"That formation may be strong, but with qi luck sensation, I can track them down. For now, I'll kill this one first!"

Fang Yuan turned his attention toward Liu Qing Yu.

"Killing and soul-searching him will yield intel on Ying Wu Xie's group!" With that, Fang Yuan attacked.

Sword mark targeting death!

At once, he used an extraordinary sword path killer move.

Sword light surged as Liu Qing Yu scrambled to dodge the strike.

A few rounds in, Liu Qing Yu was thoroughly disadvantaged.

As a lone cultivator with rank seven cultivation, he had only two rank six Immortal Gu and a handful of mediocre self-deduced killer moves.

After another dozen rounds, Fang Yuan had almost completely understood Liu Qing Yu's methods.

"Follow me if you dare!" Desperately dodging Fang Yuan's strike, Liu Qing Yu turned into a green rainbow, fleeing into the turbulent flow sea area.

"Too naive," Fang Yuan sneered, pointing toward Liu Qing Yu's escape route.

Immortal killer move — Year Beast Summoning!

A snake year beast tore through space, abruptly blocking Liu Qing Yu.

Liu Qing Yu was obstructed and could not escape anymore.

Using sword escape Immortal Gu, Fang Yuan effortlessly caught up from behind and attacked.

Fatally struck, Liu Qing Yu's body self-detonated as his soul shattered into fragments.

Fang Yuan quickly acted, but he only salvaged a portion.

Liu Qing Yu's immortal aperture sank into the sea, forming a blessed land as heaven and earth qi surged into it.

The remnant soul began dissipating via Shadow Sect methods; despite trying multiple techniques, Fang Yuan could not halt its self-destruction.

Fang Yuan quickly soul searched.

Fortunately, Fang Yuan saw the scene where Liu Qing Yu and Ying Wu Xie set up their trap.

"It seems Ying Wu Xie knew he couldn't fight my rank eight battle strength and laid a trap instead. He has truly grown."

After some commotion, the immortal aperture fully formed into a blessed land.

This was a rare chance to enter the blessed land!

# Chapter 1152: Obtaining Five Light Mountain

Quack, quack!

Inside Liu Qing Yu's blessed land, a dorky duck was quacking at Fang Yuan.

This land spirit had formed from heavenly power following Liu Qing Yu's death.

Though the duck only quacked, the words translated clearly into meaning within Fang Yuan's mind.

"The condition to inherit Qing Yu blessed land and become its owner is actually this..." Fang Yuan's eyes flashed with pleasant surprise.

It was — the whereabouts of the crucial clue to the information path inheritance.

"The clue to the information path inheritance is carved on flying sword Immortal Gu." Fang Yuan presented flying sword Immortal Gu and explained the situation to the duck land spirit.

A moment later, the duck land spirit circled Fang Yuan, affectionately pecking at his white shoes.

Fang Yuan was now the owner of the blessed land!

# Chapter 1158: City Well

One day, when she was sleeping, she met a miniman.

The miniman was crying, Boundless Forest Samsara asked him why.

The miniman wept: "I was the tallest in my tribe, proud and brave. Today I tried to climb a mountain, only to find it was actually a person. Seeing that giants like you exist brought me to tears!"

From then on, Boundless Forest Samsara and the miniman were inseparable friends.

Boundless Forest Samsara asked: "Miniman, where is your family? Why have I never seen them?"

The miniman led her to a well: "My former home is inside."

Boundless Forest Samsara leaned over the well and peered inside.

Next, she shouted: "Ah, there are so many minimen."

"Your family is here? Why leave them?" Boundless Forest Samsara asked.

The miniman shook his head: "They exiled me, thinking I was a monster."

"Oh? Why is that?" Boundless Forest Samsara was curious.

The miniman answered sadly: "I told them our world was just a well and the outside was vast. But they refused to believe me and called it nonsense."

"I told them the mountain on our city's edge was merely a tiny mound, so they accused me of spreading lies."

"Which mountain is it?" Boundless Forest Samsara asked.

"That's Miniscule Mountain." The miniman pointed.

Boundless Forest Samsara giggled: "You call that a mountain? It can fit in my palm!"

Boundless Forest Samsara shouted into the well, throwing the minimen inside into panic.

Boundless Forest Samsara's breathing became a tornado inside the well.

Her saliva turned into a massive rainstorm within the well.

Her words roared like thunder, nearly bursting the minimen's eardrums.

Exhausted, Boundless Forest Samsara slumped outside: "Why can't these minimen leave the well and see the world like you?"

The miniman sighed: "They believe the sky is round, the mountain is tall, and life is simply this."

"Then why did you climb out?" Boundless Forest Samsara asked with wide, curious eyes.

The miniman smiled bitterly: "Because I realized how insignificant I was, so I left to see how big the world is."

Fang Yuan circled City Well, his eyes flickering brightly.

His immortal essence consumption was correspondingly amplified.

Anyone entering City Well was trapped unless they recognized it and knew how to escape.

Fang Yuan wanted to take this City Well for himself.

This secluded domain of heaven and earth would greatly aid in developing his immortal aperture.

Pulling mountain Immortal Gu!

But City Well only shook slightly.

"Pulling mountain Gu is effective, but I need an immortal killer move to relocate City Well."

Only Zhou Li and Tang Song had complete corpses, Fang Yuan put them into the sovereign immortal aperture.

Though Ding Qi had self-detonated, his blood path immortal aperture remained behind.

The other deceased Gu Immortals also left behind their immortal apertures.

Fang Yuan looted the ownerless blessed lands, leaving those with land spirits for later.

After dozens of adjustments, Fang Yuan shifted the bubble into another current.

A hundred dao marks boosted an Immortal Gu's power by ten percent, a thousand doubled it, and sixteen thousand amplified it by sixteen times!

Crucially, despite this amplified power, his immortal essence expenditure remained unchanged.

Following ice and snow path, luck path ranked second with fifteen thousand dao marks!

Below luck path were qi path and sound path dao marks.

Both had around thirteen thousand.

Next were twelve thousand blood path dao marks, obtained from Hei Fan grotto-heaven's blood path Gu Immortal, Zheng Tuo.

Fang Yuan realized that all his other categories exceeding ten thousand dao marks came from rank seven Gu Immortal corpses.

Below those were transformation path and strength path, totaling nine thousand, nearly ten thousand.

The lowest quantities, like phantom path, numbered around a hundred—the baseline dao marks intrinsic to the sovereign immortal fetus.

"I mainly fight with strength, sword, and time path methods, supplementing them with familiar face and blood asset Immortal Gu."

"My five grandmaster attainments are in wisdom, strength, star, blood, and transformation path."

His paths with over ten thousand dao marks barely matched his primary combat methods and attainment levels.

Fang Yuan's original cultivation plan had focused on transformation path.

Joining the alliance obstructed this, as avoiding northern icy plain tribulations prevented him from drawing out Reckless Savage's true meaning or gaining transformation path dao marks.

"It seems most rank seven Gu Immortals possess ten thousand or more dao marks in their main path."

"Yet after only four earthly calamities, I have sixteen thousand ice and snow path dao marks, nearly ten thousand in transformation and strength path, and additional gains in wood, wind, and food paths—totaling thirty thousand from calamities alone."

Even devoid of resources, the sovereign immortal aperture held such immense fortune that every earthly calamity reached maximum potency.

Furthermore, as a complete otherworldly demon, heaven's will sought every way to kill him, maximizing the power of each calamity.

He had survived his first four calamities in extreme peril, but immense risk brought massive gains.

"Though my development and methods misalign, my dao mark growth is undeniable. At this rate, each calamity and tribulation will elevate my foundation terrifically!"

Having verified his dao marks, Fang Yuan took out his Immortal Gu to inspect them with Perceivable Dao.

Unfortunately, though the starry water coated the Immortal Gu, Fang Yuan yielded no results.

He realized: "Mortal Gu bear dao marks, but Immortal Gu hold Great Dao fragments. Perceivable Dao inspects dao marks, not Great Dao fragments."

Next, Fang Yuan inspected various immortal materials using perceivable dao Immortal Gu.

"Inspecting pure information path materials consumes less essence, while other materials have conflicting dao marks that increase expenditure."

"Using it on myself incurs no extra cost because my dao marks are non-conflicting."

At this realization, Fang Yuan's expression turned solemn.

His sovereign immortal body's non-conflicting dao marks were both a blessing and a curse.

While ordinary Gu Immortals' dao marks mitigated different paths' attacks, Fang Yuan endured full damage—or amplified damage if his dao marks matched the incoming path.

He was better suited for long-range battles, where distance allowed him to think and evade.

"It cannot inspect Immortal Gu, and inspecting materials causes dao mark conflict. Overall, its utility is limited," Fang Yuan concluded.

# Chapter 1162: Soul Path Trap

With testing complete, it was time for Fang Yuan to resume soul cultivation.

Sovereign immortal aperture, Mini Southern Border.

Controlling a strength path immortal zombie, Fang Yuan had it fly carrying immortal essence and perceivable dao Immortal Gu.

Moments later, it descended onto a small mountain.

Fang Yuan named this mountain Heaven Sealing Mountain.

The strength path immortal zombie entered the mountain's interior, reaching the center of the sealing Gu formation.

Fang Yuan's original immortal zombie body stood six meters tall with eyes shut, bearing miniature bat wings, a green face, and sharp fangs.

Fang Yuan had the strength path immortal zombie activate perceivable dao Immortal Gu, sending starlight flowing like water over the immortal zombie body.

Seeing the result, Fang Yuan snorted mentally: "Something was done to it after all!"

Ying Wu Xie had left ten thousand soul path dao marks in the immortal zombie body, exceeding Fang Yuan's original strength path dao marks.

Storing the Immortal Gu, Fang Yuan opened a slit in the formation and made the strength path immortal zombie extract something from its body.

A Gu Immortal soul shrieked as it was dragged out.

Despite the soul's resistance, the well-prepared Fang Yuan forcefully stuffed it into the body.

Soon after, Fang Yuan activated the sealing Gu formation.

The immortal zombie body had lain motionless like a statue, but once the soul entered, it began to shake.

Suddenly the trembling ceased, and the immortal zombie body opened blood-red eyes!

Bound by the Gu formation and previous soul preparations, the immortal zombie body struggled weakly, unable to stand.

The soul shrieked shrilly: "What did you do to me?! My soul is melting! You vicious fiend, I only have my soul left and you still won't spare me!"

"Souls melt upon entry..." Fang Yuan probed further using various methods.

"An amazing soul path method—the soul couldn't even last a moment!" Fang Yuan gasped, commanding the strength path immortal zombie to reach in and pull the soul back out.

Suddenly, a ghostly face surfaced on the immortal zombie's chest, cackling loudly at Fang Yuan!

A burst of immense strength forced the strength path immortal zombie three steps back.

The captive soul had completely melted away, leaving nothing behind.

After several checks, Fang Yuan used perceivable dao Immortal Gu to reinspect his body.

"What? The soul path dao marks didn't decrease—they increased by two thousand!" Fang Yuan was shocked.

It not only trapped entering souls, but melted them to replenish its expenditure and grow even stronger!

"Truly impressive! Probing with souls is useless unless I can directly target the soul path dao marks; otherwise, I only strengthen the trap!"

Despite obtaining perceivable dao Immortal Gu, Fang Yuan still needed information path methods to break his alliance restrictions.

"Finding an information path Immortal Gu to break alliances is one option, but I cannot ask Lang Ya Sect for help without compromising secrecy."

Turning his attention from the sovereign immortal aperture, Fang Yuan refocused on soul cultivation.

However, witnessing the trap in his original body made him waver on continuing soul cultivation.

Cultivating enough soul foundation to overcome the trap was viable with Luo Po Valley, but would require immense time and effort.

"The information path issue must wait; my fifth earthly calamity approaches."

This earthly calamity was different from the previous four.

Previously, Fang Yuan used immortal tribulation tempering aperture in the northern icy plain. Unable to return there now, he had to find a new tribulation site.

What location should he choose?

Days later, Chu Du sent a letter offering tribulation assistance in exchange for Reckless Savage's true meaning.

Fang Yuan was suddenly in a bind!

# Chapter 1163: Chu Du versus Heavenly Lord Bai Zu

Northern Plains, Hei Fan grotto-heaven.

Chu Du hovered in midair, radiating Immortal Gu aura as his immortal essence depleted rapidly.

"Open!"

The ground several meters ahead fractured under the power of his immortal killer move.

The shaking subsided, leaving a massive trench tens of thousands of feet long.

Carving an artificial Earth Trench with raw strength alone, Chu Du truly stood as a renowned expert of Northern Plains!

Looking into the distance, he surveyed Hei Fan grotto-heaven.

When he took it over from Fang Yuan, it was barren and thoroughly ransacked. Now, it featured mountains and rivers, with prudently distributed resources.

"Initial development is complete. In the future, Hei Fan grotto-heaven's output will far surpass my own immortal aperture."

"Judging by the time, Liu Guan Yi should be undergoing tribulation. Hmm?!"

Chu Du's expression froze as his sharp gaze pierced the sky, catching a twisted figure laboriously squeezing into Hei Fan grotto-heaven.

"Who is it? You dare invade my grotto-heaven!" Chu Du shouted, flying forward like a gust of wind.

Once inside, the figure smiled at Chu Du: "Domination Immortal, your junior talent is quite good. In such short time, you have already claimed ownership here."

Chu Du did not rebuke him, stating with a grave expression: "It is you, Heavenly Lord Bai Zu."

The invader was none other than Heavenly Lord Bai Zu, one of Northern Plains' rank eight Gu Immortals!

"Chu Du, you are astute. If you back off, I will not make things hard for you; I was once a lone cultivator myself," Heavenly Lord Bai Zu urged calmly.

Chu Du's lips curled up, he directly attacked!

Chu Du destroyed Heavenly Lord Bai Zu in a single move, leaving a massive pit where he had stood.

"You expect to seize Hei Fan grotto-heaven with just an illusion?" Chu Du snorted, turning his head.

Space distorted behind him as a small centipede entered Hei Fan grotto-heaven from outside.

The distortion quickly vanished, and the centipede assumed Heavenly Lord Bai Zu's exact appearance.

"Impressive method," the second Heavenly Lord Bai Zu praised. "You attacked without warning and without leaking any Immortal Gu aura—is this your immortal killer move, formless strength?"

Ignoring the question, Chu Du retorted, "Even with rank eight cultivation, seizing Hei Fan grotto-heaven will not be easy."

Countless distorted figures materialized around Chu Du as swarms of centipede Gu flooded into Hei Fan grotto-heaven, each taking Heavenly Lord Bai Zu's form.

Instantly, over ten thousand figures of Heavenly Lord Bai Zu surrounded Chu Du.

"Mere illusions are useless, no matter how many!" Chu Du raised his right hand, spreading his fingers before clenching them into a tight fist.

Immense strength erupted in all directions, instantly obliterating every figure of Heavenly Lord Bai Zu.

"You made many preparations indeed." Another figure of Heavenly Lord Bai Zu came from afar.

Chu Du's pupils contracted; while this Heavenly Lord Bai Zu was still not the main body, it differed from the earlier illusions.

Chu Du could sense the aura of Immortal Gu upon him.

An intense battle unfolded across Hei Fan grotto-heaven's sky.

After over ten rounds of combat, Heavenly Lord Bai Zu's clone was defeated.

Soon, a second clone joined the battle; equipped with Immortal Gu and immortal essence, it proved stronger than the first.

Chu Du grew fiercer fighting both enemies. After ten more rounds, he gained the upper hand, but just as he prepared a fatal strike, a third clone appeared.

Chu Du's expression changed, he realized something was amiss!

# Chapter 1164: Fifth Earthly Calamity

"Heavenly Lord Bai Zu can infiltrate grotto-heavens, but his main body cannot enter—he can only dispatch clones."

"Hei Fan grotto-heaven is vast, and without the brass bell heavenly spirit that Liu Guan Yi destroyed, I cannot monitor the entire realm or know how many clones have entered!"

"Whenever I am about to destroy a clone, another intervenes. He clearly has more than three formed and ready for battle. Once I gain the advantage and prepare the finishing blow, new clones intervene to save them—he is definitely stalling for time!"

Though unable to deduce his motive, Chu Du knew one thing for certain—he could not fight at the enemy's pace.

With that in mind, Chu Du erupted, his body expanding into a ten-meter giant.

Immortal killer move — Battle Strength Transpiration!

Raising his right palm to the sky and his left toward the ground, he chanted softly, "Try this move—Heaven and Earth Combined Strength."

Immobilized, Heavenly Lord Bai Zu's three clones felt the entire world crushing down on them with unparalleled, restrictive strength from all directions.

Just as the three clones were about to burst, the fourth, fifth, and sixth clones arrived to rescue them.

Boom boom!

With two deafening blasts, Chu Du smashed the first two clones to dust, though their Immortal Gu and immortal essence were missing rather than destroyed.

"What an amazing killer move—it attacks, defends, and immobilizes multiple targets!" The surviving clone felt lingering fear.

Heavenly Lord Bai Zu's clones retreated, activating their defensive killer moves in preparation.

Boom boom boom.

The next moment, the clones abruptly self-detonated without warning.

Inside, Chu Du enveloped the entire grotto-heaven in his mysterious killer move.

Heavenly Lord Bai Zu smiled: "Interesting. It seems I must enter personally to deal with Chu Du."

A profound white centipede figure flew from his body and burrowed into space, instantly creating a huge distorted shadow in Hei Fan grotto-heaven.

Heavenly Lord Bai Zu strode forward into the shadow.

"Want to come in?" Chu Du laughed, stomping his feet.

A strength path leg shot out and kicked the distorted shadow, repelling Heavenly Lord Bai Zu.

Heavenly Lord Bai Zu showed a grim expression: "I need twenty breaths to enter, giving Chu Du ample time to stop me, while clones self-detonate instantly..."

With Chu Du entrenched in total defense, Heavenly Lord Bai Zu found this well-fortified grotto-heaven difficult to breach.

"Heavenly Lord Bai Zu is attacking Hei Fan grotto-heaven?" Fang Yuan exhaled as he held Chu Du's distress letter.

His worry was lifted.

Although Chu Du was his ally, using the grotto-heaven's defenses to contest Heavenly Lord Bai Zu provided Fang Yuan with great advantages.

Lang Ya land spirit wished to recruit Chu Du. If successful, Chu Du's entry would undermine Fang Yuan's status; if it failed, Fang Yuan's ties to variant humans would be exposed, creating a disastrous situation.

Now, however, Chu Du was pinned down defending Hei Fan grotto-heaven against Heavenly Lord Bai Zu, unable to leave.

Fang Yuan praised mentally: "Heavenly Lord Bai Zu arrived just in time to resolve a massive problem for me!"

Fang Yuan replied using an information path mortal Gu.

In the letter, he expressed sympathy and promised assistance under the alliance agreement, but cited his approaching tribulation as reason to delay.

Chu Du quickly replied with understanding, noting that managing Heavenly Lord Bai Zu's invasion was feasible and he had already rallied allies, urging Fang Yuan to resolve his matters quickly and assist.

A few days later.

Fang Yuan departed Lang Ya blessed land via the super Gu formation's teleportation.

He rushed straight to Earth Trench, selecting a suitable spot to place his immortal aperture.

Fang Yuan chose this location specifically for its abundant earth path and dark path dao marks.

Fang Yuan successfully activated this immortal killer move.

Soon, the fifth earthly calamity formed.

The sky darkened as a massive skeletal shadow blanketed half the sky.

Cackling, the skeleton opened its mouth and spat a dark current resembling a black python.

The dark current surged forward, corroding the soil on contact and instantly melting it into foul-smelling puddles of black, rotten water.

Earthly calamity — Corrosive Dark Current!

Lacking specific defensive counters against the corrosive dark current, Fang Yuan relied on powerful offensive methods to fight it.

The skeleton spewed wave after wave of corrosive dark current toward Fang Yuan like seas of snakes.

However, bolstered by Hei Fan's true inheritance and various time path killer moves, Fang Yuan appeared distressed while carefully preserving strength for contingencies.

"Huff..." Fang Yuan sighed deeply, looking at the black, corroded ground before him.

Second, their alliance agreement forbade him from ignoring Chu Du's calls for help.

Fourthly, securing Hei Fan grotto-heaven would let Fang Yuan relocate his storage pool there to produce heavenly crystals and re-hatch the upper extreme heavenly eagle.

However, he was not in a rush to act.

Southern Border, Sun Crown Mountain.

"Who else?" Ye Fan demanded arrogantly, standing atop a boulder with arms crossed over his chest.

Opposite him, a group of Gu Masters were shivering, hesitating.

"Ye Fan, you were expelled by your clan and are a lone cultivator like us. Why make life difficult for our kind?" one Gu Master pleaded.

Ye Fan sneered: "Can you truly call yourselves lone cultivators? Plundering, bullying the weak, and slaughtering mortals— You are vicious fiends and demonic cultivators, not lone cultivators!"

Since taking control of Sun Crown Mountain and Silent Flow Mountain, Bai Ning Bing had reined in the demonic cultivators without issuing evil orders.

Yet his attention was wholly captured by the central woman.

Dressed in white with silver hair, deep blue eyes, and snow-pale skin, her cold countenance failed to hide peerless beauty.

She was reclining on a bamboo chair with closed eyes, relaxing as four snowmen carried her.

In appearance, Bai Ning Bing was a divine beauty; only Shang Xin Ci rivaled her looks.

A demonic Gu Master scrambled toward Bai Ning Bing with a fawning look, crying out: "Boss White Demon, we fought desperately while waiting for you. You have finally arrived!"

Shock gave way to outrage; Ye Fan's favorable first impression of Bai Ning Bing was completely replaced by burning fury.

Bai Ning Bing smiled faintly, extending a jade finger toward Ye Fan.

"What move is this? My defensive killer move couldn't block it at all?!" Ye Fan was utterly shocked.

"What cultivation does White Demon possess? Methods bestowed by Lady Shang Qing Qing were completely useless—will I die here?" Ye Fan's heart shook.

He had vastly underestimated Bai Ning Bing's overwhelming power, but quickly regaining his composure, his battle intent surged in the face of despair.

Lang Ya blessed land.

Ma Hong Yun shouted: "No! No! Spare me! I'm going to die!"

The lightning ball entered his chest.

Sparks engulfed him; Ma Hong Yun's eyes rolled back as blood leaked from his mouth.

He fainted again, after a while, the lightning vanished.

"I failed again." Lady Wan Shou's vision darkened, intense dizziness nearly causing her to collapse.

Disregarding her injuries, she forced herself to continue healing Ma Hong Yun.

Ma Hong Yun had to be alive for the lightning refinement to work.

"Hmm? His cultivation actually rose by a rank." While healing him, Lady Wan Shou discovered an anomaly.

"Is it from the lightning refinement? Relic Gu were used, which can raise a Gu Master's cultivation level."

"Dear, are you alright?" Old Ancestor Xue Hu arrived just then.

"No need to worry." Though still pale, Lady Wan Shou smiled at Old Ancestor Xue Hu: "I just need to rest a while to recover."

Fang Yuan floated in the air, breathing heavily as he surveyed the battlefield.
