# Chapter 1180: Heaven and Human Path, Grandmaster Discusses Dao

Some days ago.

Longevity Heaven.

Inside Giant Sun's grotto-heaven, golden light enveloped the Four Desolations and azure hue covered the Eight Extremities.

At the center, an Immortal Gu House shot white light skyward, humming in resonance with all Longevity Heaven.

Rank eight Immortal Gu House, Calamity Luck Altar.

Eight Longevity Heaven Gu Immortals stood at the center of Calamity Luck Altar's nine corners, concentrating intently on operating it.

A seated Gu Immortal resisted the might of Calamity Luck Altar.

A ring flew around his body, emitting light in five colors.

"Five Elements Grandmaster, you cannot overturn this inside Calamity Luck Altar! Surrender, and you may survive when our Four Desolation Immortals awaken," Heaven Extremity snorted.

The Gu Immortal trapped at the center of Calamity Luck Altar was one of Northern Plains' five rank eight existences—Five Elements Grandmaster!

Five Elements Grandmaster laughed loudly: "The rank eight Immortal Gu House is nothing impressive! You Eight Extremities channeled Longevity Heaven, yet haven't even breached the first layer of my five elements ring. Heaven Extremity, you have the face to ask me to surrender?"

Heaven Extremity sneered: "You know nothing of Calamity Luck Altar's mystical power! Its true ability reverses calamity and luck into an unceasing cycle. This is the profundity of heaven and earth luck—how could a lone cultivator understand?"

Giant Sun Immortal Venerable's luck path comprised three parts: self luck, all living beings' luck, and heaven and earth luck.

Created in Giant Sun Immortal Venerable's later years, heaven and earth luck was profound, deciphering the mysteries of the world. Unable to break through alone, Five Elements Grandmaster had snuck into Longevity Heaven to steal the heaven and earth luck inheritance.

"I have long known of Giant Sun Immortal Venerable's three rank eight Immortal Gu Houses, including Calamity Luck Altar. But what constitutes reversing calamity and luck?" Five Elements Grandmaster asked after pondering.

Heaven Extremity spoke: "Ancestor Giant Sun purposely left Calamity Luck Altar here to defend Longevity Heaven. It turns calamities into good luck. Your invasion was our human calamity, but Calamity Luck Altar transforms this difficulty into fortune. You will end up contributing to Longevity Heaven's eternal existence."

"Brilliant!" Five Elements Grandmaster's eyes shone as he asked, "If human calamities work like this, what about earthly calamities and heavenly tribulations?"

"We reverse them as well; tribulations cause no damage and instead nourish Longevity Heaven," Heaven Extremity said proudly.

Five Elements Grandmaster's eyes widened: "Longevity Heaven has absorbed no fragments of the immemorial nine heavens, yet relies solely on Calamity Luck Altar to pass all its calamities and tribulations?"

Five Elements Grandmaster asked humbly: "Please teach me, Heaven Extremity."

Heaven Extremity sighed: "Why do humans face tribulations? In truth, even desolate beasts and plants endure them, like the thousand snakes haze tree facing tribulation lightning."

"Tribulations originate from heavenly principles. Heaven takes surpluses to replenish deficits, emphasizing balance; whatever disrupts this equilibrium faces calamities and tribulations."

"Endowed with great intelligence, humans pose a greater threat; Gu Immortals managing their own small worlds draw heaven's direct suppression."

"What is calamity? What is luck?" Heaven Extremity suddenly asked.

Enlightened, Five Elements Grandmaster spoke immediately: "I understand. Heaven takes surpluses to replenish deficits—calamity takes away surpluses, while luck replenishes deficits."

Heaven Extremity raised his eyebrows: "Correct, that is exactly so! Ancestor Giant Sun was immensely talented, creating luck path targeting heavenly principles. Self luck true inheritance replenishes oneself. All living being's luck takes others' surpluses to replenish oneself, while heaven and earth luck takes heaven and earth's surpluses to replenish oneself."

"So that's it." Five Elements Grandmaster sighed deeply: "No wonder Giant Sun Immortal Venerable never joined Heavenly Court."

"If heaven cannot use tribulations to destroy Longevity Heaven, it will use human calamities," Heaven Extremity continued. "And you, Five Elements Grandmaster, were subconsciously influenced by heaven's will to become the human calamity sent to destroy Longevity Heaven! What a pity that a great rank eight like you was influenced by heaven's will unknowingly."

"Hahaha, I have learned much!" Five Elements Grandmaster laughed grandly. "Even if heaven's will influences me, so what? This is also my own intention! Man will triumph over heaven—heaven's will can never match the will of humans. Throughout human history, we were once weak and humiliated everywhere, yet today we are world overlords, suppressing variant humans and all other life beneath our feet! The human race disrupts balance the most, yet with ten venerables in history and countless Gu Immortals overturning mountains and rivers, what can heaven do?"

Heaven Extremity's laughter faded: "It seems you frequently read The Legends of Ren Zu, Five Elements Grandmaster."

"Of course. The Legends of Ren Zu contains Ren Zu's human path true inheritance! Every high-level Gu Immortal seeks to benefit from it. Only after reading The Legends of Ren Zu did he create all living being's luck, subsequently ascending to Immortal Venerable before creating heaven and earth luck," Five Elements Grandmaster continued.

He added: "I am a native Northern Plainsman. Though lacking Huang Jin bloodline, I greatly admire Giant Sun Immortal Venerable. Human path triumphs over heaven path; Giant Sun's luck path deeply draws upon human path! Humanity's rise cannot be defied—even heaven cannot match it! Do you agree?"

Five Elements Grandmaster smiled lightly: "Humanity's trend is obvious, but can you see Northern Plains' trend clearly?"

Five Elements Grandmaster said calmly yet loudly: "Right now, Northern Plains' demonic path is rising while the righteous path declines. Eighty-Eight True Yang Building's collapse allowed many lone and demonic cultivators to gain strength. Heavenly Lord Bai Zu personally established Bai Zu tribe, introducing a new bloodline to the righteous path."

"Giant Sun's hereditary monarchy was overly restrictive. Northern Plains belongs to all Northern Plainsmen, not him alone. A man's death is like an extinguished candle. Giant Sun's influence has lasted long enough—it is time for change!"

"Nonsense!" Heaven Extremity raged, and the other seven extremities berated him angrily.

Five Elements Grandmaster remained tranquil: "Your fury stems from fear. The Huang Jin tribes dominated and ruled Northern Plains under Giant Sun, but their decline has begun. They appear strong but are rotten within, riddled with conflicts. Meanwhile, among Northern Plains' rank eight Gu Immortals, how many possess Huang Jin bloodline?"

"Old Ancestor Xue Hu is demonic path, I am a lone immortal, Heavenly Lord Bai Zu converted to the righteous path, and Gong tribe's Prince Feng Xian lacks Huang Jin bloodline. Yao Huang alone upholds the Huang Jin tribes' reputation!"

# Chapter 1181: Sudden Changes, Benefits are Key

Five Elements Grandmaster continued: "Eighty-Eight True Yang Building was a forewarning, and Bai Zu tribe's creation is a clear sign. The Huang Jin tribes' influence is fading."

Heaven Extremity forced a stiff smile: "Impressive, Five Elements Grandmaster. You want us to ride this trend rather than be wiped out—imitating Gong tribe by adopting lone and demonic cultivators and recruiting a rank eight like yourself?"

Liu tribe's base camp.

Xuan Bai blessed land.

Chou Lao Wu and Hao Zhen, who had killed Bai Zu Wei, were punished mildly and spared.

# Chapter 1182: Leaving Hei Fan Grotto-Heaven

Inside a Gu formation.

Fang Yuan sat quietly on the ground.

Chu Du and the wills of Pang Shan and Not Immortal stood before the formation.

"Start." Chu Du said plainly.

Assuming human shapes, the wills of Not Immortal and Pang Shan nodded, activating their Immortal Gu.

One rule path Immortal Gu — No.

The other was also a rule path Immortal Gu, top ten on the Mystical Gu List—Care.

Timing his move, Chu Du activated the Gu formation, fusing the power of Immortal Gu No and Care into it.

The light pillar enveloped Fang Yuan completely, without any leakage.

"It is ready." Chu Du reminded.

Fang Yuan said: "You won't believe what lies beneath the northern icy plain. I nearly died there..."

He spoke quickly, detailing his tribulation in the northern icy plain and the terrifying human calamity he faced.

He revealed the secret of the icy plain's snowman and rockman tribes to Chu Du.

"To think such a powerful variant human force lay hidden in the desolate northern icy plain!" Chu Du was astounded.

When the black and red lights faded and the formation halted, Fang Yuan stood up and stepped out.

Bound by alliance pacts, he was forbidden from exposing snowman and rockman secrets.

Yet with Immortal Gu No and Care, Fang Yuan breached the alliance pact harmlessly!

"Thanks to these two Immortal Gu, I could explain this to you," Fang Yuan feigned relief, sighing deeply to himself.

Of course, he had withheld some information from Chu Du.

For example, Fang Yuan did not expose Lang Ya blessed land.

Chu Du said heavily: "It seems we can no longer undergo tribulations in the northern icy plain."

"Indeed." Fang Yuan nodded, carefully avoiding further mention of the four races alliance.

With the Gu deactivated, breaching the alliance pact again would trigger lethal backlash.

They could not completely remove Fang Yuan's alliance restrictions.

After concluding their talk, Chu Du stored the two Immortal Gu and the two wills in his immortal aperture.

He and Fang Yuan then exited the underground cave, returning to the surface of Hei Fan grotto-heaven.

Multitudes of rockmen, feathermen, and minimen were laboring away.

Spotting Fang Yuan and Chu Du, Hao Zhen quickly greeted them: "Greetings to first and second supreme elders."

Though initially reluctant, Fang Yuan received special treatment from Chu Du, with a loose, unrestrictive Chu Sect alliance agreement.

Chu Du inquired about development; Hao Zhen reported they were relocating resources, with Fang Yuan having contributed a large share.

After parting from Hao Zhen and flying for a while, Fang Yuan said to Chu Du: "Alright, no need to see me off."

Chu Du looked worried: "Slowing your aperture's time to delay tribulations is safest. Undergoing tribulation so soon carries huge risk."

Fang Yuan smiled: "Gains require risks. Besides, with you around, I will seek your help if sudden danger arises."

Chu Du looked apologetic: "With Chu Sect newly created and facing strong enemies and unrest, I cannot accompany you. Have you chosen a tribulation location?"

"Not yet, I must consider it." Fang Yuan shook his head.

Chu Du opened the grotto-heaven's entrance.

"See you." Fang Yuan stepped out of the grotto-heaven, flying away without looking back.

Decisive and uncontrollable, Fang Yuan departed, leaving Chu Du unable to press for the aperture tempering method.

As Fang Yuan left Hei Fan grotto-heaven, Bai Ning Bing reached Jade Pot Mountain in Southern Border.

"Why did you bring me here?" Bai Ning Bing asked directly.

Leading the way, Ying Wu Xie smiled back: "Shadow Sect's arrangements here have formed an Immortal Gu. We will retrieve it to boost your battle strength for the bet of the Five Xiangs."

# Chapter 1184: Annexing Han Dong Blessed Land

Looking around, Fang Yuan saw abundant fish, prawns, aquatic insects, and mortal Gu, while beach crevices held seashells, mussels, and seaweed.

But what was most abundant was a type of snake.

These pinkish-red snakes were small and delicate, the largest thumb-sized and smaller ones only a few centimeters.

This was a spirit snake.

Gu Immortal Han Dong specialized the most in this transformation.

This was Han Dong's blessed land.

Han Dong had been one of the Traveling Three Elites, dying here during Dong Fang Chang Fan's possession revival.

By the time Fang Yuan and the others arrived back then, Han Dong had already died here.

As Fang Yuan floated in the sky, a pinkish-red spirit snake slithered toward him.

The hissing translated into words in Fang Yuan's ears: "Who are you? Why did you invade my home? Quickly leave, you are not welcomed here!"

Fang Yuan smiled lightly: "I want to be your master. What are the conditions?"

This spirit snake was the land spirit, formed after Han Dong's death by fusing his obsession with heavenly power.

Using familiar face, Fang Yuan returned disguised as Lu Qing Ming. Circling outside, Fang Yuan stored the upper extreme heavenly eagle and used familiar face to become Lu Qing Ming.

He came back and waited for a while, before the blessed land's entrance opened.

Deceived by familiar face, the land spirit readily acknowledged him as master.

Fang Yuan changed his tone: "Wonderful. Upon reflection, I will give this blessed land to that friend from earlier."

Fang Yuan left briefly, dispelled familiar face, and returned in his original appearance.

Very successfully, the spirit snake acknowledged him as master.

Then Fang Yuan added even more distressing words: "Since you acknowledge me as master, cooperate to assimilate this blessed land into mine."

Stunned and frantic, the spirit snake cried: "What? Why must we do that? If we do that, I will disappear!"

"I know that. But fusing it into my blessed land lets me skip calamities and tribulations, which helps me," Fang Yuan continued.

The pinkish-red spirit snake remembered something and cried: "To annex my blessed land, you must be at least a transformation path master!"

"I primarily cultivate transformation path, I am a grandmaster!" Fang Yuan replied mockingly.

The spirit snake drooped in defeat, lowering its head: "Fine, as the owner, you can do whatever you want. I will cooperate."

There were many restrictions and requirements in this.

Firstly, a smaller immortal aperture could not engulf a bigger one.

Secondly, dead apertures could not devour others.

Finally, annexing immortal apertures demanded corresponding attainment: master in that path for rank six, grandmaster for rank seven, and great grandmaster for rank eight.

Once these requirements were met, another's immortal aperture could be devoured into one's own!

First, the annexed aperture's resources were completely transferred over without any need for relocation.

Southern Border, Jade Pot Mountain.

Ying Wu Xie's group arrived at the interior of the mountain.

Pausing as if sensing something, Ying Wu Xie looked at the empty space: "We are here. This is a rank six immortal aperture left by a Shadow Sect strength path Gu Immortal."

Ying Wu Xie turned to Hei Lou Lan: "This is for you. With your strength path attainment, you can annex this immortal aperture and bypass your upcoming calamities and tribulations."

Hei Lou Lan's expression changed.

With the Great Strength True Martial Physique of the ten extremes, her calamities and tribulations were immensely powerful.

Annexing an immortal aperture resolved her problem, but sacrificed her future potential for short-term benefits.

She hesitated, but eventually gritted her teeth, walking forward.

Ying Wu Xie nodded inwardly, understanding her feelings: "In cultivation, pursuing long-term potential is unwise. If you cannot survive the upcoming tribulation, there is no future to speak of. Don't worry, this blessed land holds no fewer strength path dao marks than a ten extreme physique tribulation. Shadow Sect's methods exceed imagination, though how much you absorb depends on your fortune. Because the annexing of others' immortal apertures will often result in a reduction of dao marks gained to some extent. It is far less than stuffing a Gu Immortal's corpse into your immortal aperture directly and allowing it to break down naturally."

Thinking of Fang Yuan, Ying Wu Xie added in his mind: "Of course, the sovereign immortal body is exempt."

# Chapter 1186: Ice Soul Immortal Gu

Though Hei Lou Lan gained abundant resources and alleviated her greatest weakness, her dao mark gains were minimal.

Making an estimation, it was less than thirty percent of the immortal aperture's dao marks.

Because of her ten extreme physique, surviving those skipped tribulations would have yielded vastly more dao marks.

"Even if I am unwilling, trapped in this abyss, it is not up to me..." Hei Lou Lan sighed internally.

Noting Hei Lou Lan's gloomy expression, Ying Wu Xie smiled inwardly: "Alright, let's keep moving."

Through the white wall of ice, the immortals could see countless hearts inside.

Hei Lou Lan's expression shifted: "Not just ice hearts, but twin ice hearts—a rank seven immortal material in such quantity!"

Ying Wu Xie sighed: "Jade Pot Mountain is unremarkable on the surface and easily overlooked; even Shadow Sect found it by chance. Naturally, however, ice hearts do not form here in such quantities. My Shadow Sect's Gu Immortals had secretly set up a Gu formation to turn this place into a Gu breeding ground."

"Ice heart Gu were previously nurtured and harvested here, but one ice heart Immortal Gu has now fully matured. Bai Ning Bing, come retrieve this wild Immortal Gu using the method I taught you."

"Alright!" Bai Ning Bing said without hesitation.

Following Ying Wu Xie's instructions, she placed both hands against the frost-covered wall of ice.

Lacking any defensive methods, Bai Ning Bing's hands froze instantly as thick frost crept up her arms.

Frost energy surged through her body, stiffening her limbs and freezing her thoughts.

As Bai Ning Bing endured the freezing cold, a change occurred within the wall. As expected, a change occurred in front of Bai Ning Bing.

Inside the ice wall, the blue ice hearts began shaking, the vibrations growing steadily more intense.

Moments later, the ice wall cracked with a loud snap, spiderweb fissures plunging into its depths.

The aura of Immortal Gu leaked out.

Bai Ning Bing could not move.

Completely frozen, frost energy permeated her entire body as she neared death.

Yet her dying state strongly attracted the wild Immortal Gu breaking from the ice.

This wild Immortal Gu flew over slowly, entering Bai Ning Bing's hold.

Baby-fist sized, the Immortal Gu resembled a white spider whose back bore blue markings shaped like a screaming ghost.

Rank six ice soul Immortal Gu!

Bai Ning Bing focused her mind, opening her phantom aperture's entrance.

Ice soul Immortal Gu directly flew in.

As the phantom aperture closed, Ying Wu Xie acted immediately to heal Bai Ning Bing, dragging her back from death.

"Good. With ice soul Immortal Gu trapped in your aperture, refining it will be extremely easy." Ying Wu Xie clapped and smiled.

Hei Lou Lan's eyes shined: "I understand—ice soul Immortal Gu is drawn to Bai Ning Bing because of her Northern Dark Ice Soul Physique!"

"He has learned how to lead, improving rapidly..." Before Hei Lou Lan could dwell further, Ying Wu Xie waved: "We're leaving! Next, we take Bai Xiang grotto-heaven!"

Northern Plains.

"I skipped too few calamities and tribulations," Fang Yuan sighed discontentedly.

Endless battles in Hei Fan grotto-heaven exposed his biggest flaw: a low cultivation level that made green grape immortal essence inefficient.

As Fang Yuan's identity grew more complex, his dangers escalated.

Having failed to wipe out Shadow Sect in Eastern Sea, Ying Wu Xie's rapid growth brought Fang Yuan immense pressure.

Thus, he would rather sacrifice his future potential and raise his battle strength rapidly.

"Without the present, how can there be a future?"

"Yet Han Dong weathered two heavenly tribulations and over twenty earthly calamities. Annexing his aperture only advanced me by four earthly calamities."

"Is the sovereign immortal aperture too large, diluting the effect of skipping calamities and tribulations from annexation?"

"This is not fast enough. Reaching rank seven as soon as possible will drastically boost my sustained battle strength and financial growth."

"If only Han Dong blessed land is not enough, I will have to annex more immortal apertures."

"Furthermore, annexing blessed lands grants me all their dao marks without loss. Any shortfall can simply be made up by killing more Gu Immortals!"

Thinking of this, Fang Yuan had a ruthless light flashing in his eyes.

Natural tribulations yielded true meaning but grew his battle strength too slowly, unsuited to his perilous situation. Annexing apertures to rapidly elevate cultivation maximized his immediate survival odds.

# Chapter 1187: Fang Yuan's Cultivation Opportunity

Immortal killer move — Days Pass Like Years!

Countless Gu worms flew about, expending green grape immortal essence as brilliant light flooded the entire sovereign immortal aperture.

The tributary of the River of Time in the sovereign immortal aperture manifested visibly to the naked eye.

"I succeeded. Time in the aperture has slowed, drastically lengthening the interval between tribulations." Confirming the killer move's success, Fang Yuan retracted his concentration.

Right now, he was inside his cloud city in Lang Ya blessed land.

Annexing blessed lands bypassed calamities regardless of time flow, removing the need for frequent tribulations.

The most important thing now were blessed lands.

Where could he find more blessed lands?

Fang Yuan first thought of Hu Immortal blessed land and Star Form blessed land in Central Continent.

Central Continent was perilous; both Heavenly Court and the ten sects sought his death.

Fang Yuan thought of Luo Po Valley.

He turned his thoughts to Eastern Sea instead. Fang Yuan thought of Eastern Sea next.

In Eastern Sea's turbulent flow sea area, City Well contained numerous Gu Immortal blessed lands.

The most alluring one was Ding Qi blessed land.

Ding Qi, a rank seven blood path Gu Immortal, had self-detonated without leaving resources, Immortal Gu, or a soul, but his immortal aperture remained.

Even though Fang Yuan could annex his immortal aperture, he did not do so on the spot.

First, Ding Qi's land spirit demanded the completion of the blood path Immortal Gu recipe 'Blood Revenge'—a task Fang Yuan could have finished swiftly with the light of wisdom. Without the light of wisdom, completing Ding Qi's blood revenge recipe would cost far too much time.

"I am a blood path grandmaster, annexing a rank seven blessed land is no issue in attainment level. But a smaller immortal aperture cannot devour a bigger one—what defines 'bigger'?"

"Beyond that lies another issue: the land spirit's acknowledgment."

"Ding Qi land spirit's condition is hard to satisfy right now. If I use force, the land spirit and blessed land will be destroyed, triggering winds of assimilation."

Moreover, traveling to Eastern Sea's turbulent flow sea area would consume too much time, and heaven's will might plot to keep Fang Yuan from obtaining City Well.

Reflecting further, Fang Yuan identified another constraint on annexing immortal apertures.

It was attainment level.

Unlike Spectral Soul Demon Venerable, who possessed high attainment in every path to effortlessly absorb blessed lands into the sovereign immortal aperture, Fang Yuan was limited.

"Did Shadow Sect refine sovereign immortal fetus Gu specifically to devour immortal apertures?"

Spectral Soul had methods to harvest a slain immortal's dao marks or annex their aperture to skip calamities.

Fang Yuan's gaze subconsciously drifted southward.

There lay the giant dream realm and a trace of Spectral Soul's remnant soul, which Ying Wu Xie's group was desperately trying to save.

"Attainment level... dream realm... Southern Border!" Fang Yuan shuddered as realization struck.

"My cultivation opportunity is in Southern Border. It is there..."

Snowy Mountain, first peak.

An energetic Lady Wan Shou appeared before Ma Hong Yun once more.

Ma Hong Yun's hair stood on end as he screamed, "You are here to shock me again, you want to shock me again!"

"Good that you know." Lady Wan Shou smiled, pushing the lightning ball in her hand towards him.

"His cultivation rose again? He even lasted thirty percent longer against the lightning refinement," Lady Wan Shou observed with a frown.

"This is troublesome. The more lightning refinements Ma Hong Yun undergoes, the stronger his resistance grows and the higher the failure risk. Should I change the refinement method? No! If I change it now, I must overhaul the entire Immortal Gu recipe, rendering half our gathered materials unusable. Snowy Mountain cannot bear such costs anymore."

Lady Wan Shou sighed to herself, feeling extremely worried.

# Chapter 1188: Crazed Demon Agreement

Some days later.

Northern Plains, Crazed Demon Cave.

"Liu Guan Yi, we have been waiting for you!" Not Immortal came to the first layer, welcoming Fang Yuan and Chu Du.

A moment later, they saw Pang Shan.

Fang Yuan asked: "How will we establish the Crazed Demon Agreement?"

"We must descend to the third last layer. Moving is difficult for me, so I will not go with you," Pang Shan said vaguely.

Soon, Fang Yuan passed through a cavern entrance into the third last layer of Crazed Demon Cave.

His vision was covered by bright glorious lights.

Fang Yuan drew a deep breath: "The light of dao marks! Only quasi-rank nine immortal materials radiate such light. The dao marks here are so dense that every speck of soil and rock is a quasi-rank nine immortal material?!"

Not Immortal laughed: "Brother Liu makes sense, but these immortal materials have chaotic dao marks, they cannot be used."

Not Immortal ceased laughing: "The dense dao marks do more than emit light—they create a battlefield-like environment. Moving is arduous. Brother Liu, why not try?"

Chu Du rubbed his nose, admitting: "He's talking about me—I spent three years recovering from that injury. Don't underestimate these dao marks; each step is treacherous! Here's a trick: stick close to dao marks matching your own path to minimize obstruction."

Not Immortal stepped forward first to demonstrate the path. Not Immortal stepped forward first: "I will go first, Brother Liu, watch carefully."

Not Immortal moved vigilantly. The first ten steps were easy and calm, but the next ten grew difficult. After twenty steps, his movements stiffened under an invisible weight. By thirty steps, he was drenched in sweat. Stopping at the forty-second step, he panted and asked Fang Yuan: "Brother Liu, did you catch that?"

Chu Du snorted: "Think I'm scared? Watch closely!"

Before finishing his words, he strode forward along the local dao marks.

Soon, Chu Du misstepped. The light of dao marks flared beneath him, making him grunt and spit out a mouthful of blood.

Chu Du misstepped, spitting blood, yet persevered forward at an agonizing crawl.

He reached thirty-eight, then thirty-nine steps, before grinding to a halt on the fortieth.

A shocked Not Immortal stared wide-eyed at Chu Du: "Domination Immortal, you actually improved so much since last time! I am ashamed—having stayed in Crazed Demon Cave and walked here hundreds of times more than you, I only managed forty-two steps."

Chu Du laughed heartily, waving his hand: "Enough flattery. Let's see Brother Liu's performance."

Fang Yuan understood inwardly: "These two are purposely probing me."

"If I perform poorly and offer no help, they might not even establish the Crazed Demon Agreement with me!"

With Limitless Demon Venerable and the secret of eternal life at stake, Fang Yuan resolved to put on a good show and display his strength.

With gleaming eyes, Fang Yuan took a deep breath and firmly stepped forward.

But at the next moment, Fang Yuan's expression changed.

Fang Yuan's bewilderment deepened: "Why do I feel no obstruction? Over ten steps in, it feels like walking on normal ground."

Fang Yuan quickly guessed this was due to his sovereign immortal body.

"Chu Du and Not Immortal face pressure from conflicting dao marks between their bodies and this dense environment."

"Unattached to killer moves, these non-offensive dao marks cannot influence me at all!"

Not Immortal and Chu Du's expressions changed mildly.

"This Liu Guan Yi is so strong!" Not Immortal was astounded.

"Nearly twenty steps in and he moves so calmly! My first attempt was an agonizing struggle," Chu Du recalled, his pride taking a beating.

He couldn't help wondering: "Is Liu Guan Yi an even greater transformation path genius than I am in strength path? Does he have higher attainment?"

Actually, Fang Yuan was trying his best to conceal himself.

He pretended to be panting, like he was very tired.

Halting at the twentieth step, Fang Yuan smiled: "I am about the same as you, Brother Chu."

Chu Du looked at him meaningfully: "Brother Liu, you have not gone all out."

Fang Yuan smiled bitterly: "I am barely holding on—any further and I will spit blood!"

Chu Du's smile turned more bitter: "Truth be told, I started spitting blood by the tenth step on my first visit."

# Chapter 1189: Huge Rise in Cultivation Level

Fang Yuan's heart jumped—he realized his performance had gone overboard.

"Let's continue moving and set the alliance agreement first!" Not Immortal smiled, his attitude much warmer.

Eventually, they came to a rock.

"A newcomer?" the rock suddenly spoke as smoke rose from it and vanished.

The rock turned into a skinny, short Gu Immortal.

"This is one of the Three Crazed Demon Eccentrics, wisdom path Gu Immortal Secret Schemer," Chu Du introduced.

Concealing his expression, he greeted as if hearing it for the first time: "Hello, I am Liu Guan Yi of transformation path."

A day later.

At the first layer, Not Immortal tried to urge them: "Brother Liu, Brother Chu, leaving so soon? Won't you stay for a few more days?"

"No." Chu Du smiled bitterly. "You know Northern Plains' situation—Chu Sect allied with Bai Zu tribe, and the righteous path is gathering forces to deal with us."

Not Immortal sighed: "These are worldly affairs. Fame and reputation—will they remain after death? In The Legends of Ren Zu, when Verdant Great Sun entered the door of life and death, reputation Gu abandoned him at pacifying soul lake. Only eternal life is worthy of our pursuit."

Chu Du looked resolute: "I promised someone I would make strength path flourish. If I cannot achieve it, I will not live in peace!"

"Brother Liu, you have great potential, why not stay here?"

Fang Yuan smiled: "I came to sign the Crazed Demon Agreement. Now that it is done, I have other matters to settle."

"The third last layer is no problem, though I cannot assess the deeper layers. Derivation Gu is at the bottom, but guarded by the Three Crazed Demon Eccentrics, I cannot act alone." Fang Yuan felt it was a pity.

Fang Yuan and Chu Du said goodbye to Not Immortal, before flying towards the sky.

Chu Du admitted with a bitter smile: "I feel great pressure too. Even allied with Bai Zu tribe, our enemies outmatch us dozens or hundreds of times over! Yet they are divided, bound to their territories, and constrained by righteous rules and reputation... we still have a chance."

"When are they coming?" Fang Yuan asked the crucial question.

Chu Du looked at him: "Pardon my presumption, Brother Liu, but has your transformation path reached great grandmaster attainment level?"

"What? Not yet." Fang Yuan replied.

"If not great grandmaster, you are at least quasi-great grandmaster," Chu Du said with great confidence.

Chu Du chuckled: "Higher attainment eases exploration here. Not Immortal was shocked by my progress because my strength path attainment recently saw a qualitative leap."

Fang Yuan knew that he was trying to ask about the killer move immortal tribulation tempering aperture.

Knowing what Chu Du meant, Fang Yuan feigned ignorance: "Oh, I see."

Disappointment flashed deep in Chu Du's eyes.

Chu Du swallowed his disappointment rationally. In this situation, he had to deepen cooperation with Fang Yuan, not strain their relationship.

Halfway through the journey, he parted with Chu Du.

Flying southwest for several days, Fang Yuan landed on an ordinary-looking mound.

"According to Xue Song Zi's memories, this is the place." Fang Yuan surveyed the area, confirming his location.

Pinpointing the blessed land, he summoned the upper extreme heavenly eagle. "Found it!" Fang Yuan's eyes shined, he summoned the upper extreme heavenly eagle.

Circling briefly, the upper extreme heavenly eagle pierced through space, carrying Fang Yuan into the new blessed land.

Because its former owner had cultivated earth path, the blessed land was covered in rotten black mud.

From time to time, desolate giant mud monsters surged from the soil like black tidal waves.

A small mudman with a strand of green grass on its head floated toward Fang Yuan.

Looking down at the mud, Fang Yuan muttered: "To claim the blessed land, I must defeat five desolate mud monsters at once? Heh, easy."

After annexing this earth path blessed land, his Mini Western Desert gained a huge swamp.

For the next month, Fang Yuan traveled everywhere, locating and annexing blessed lands.

The upper extreme heavenly eagle displayed immense value, Fang Yuan easily got into blessed lands to explore them.

His targets came from searching captive souls like Dong Fang Chang Fan, Xue Song Zi, and Hei Cheng.

Fang Yuan's cultivation soared as he repeatedly skipped calamities and tribulations, steadily expanding the space and resources within the sovereign immortal aperture.

By the time he returned to Lang Ya blessed land, he had already passed two heavenly tribulations, standing as a rank six Gu Immortal a mere three earthly calamities away from his third!

# Chapter 1190: Blood Plain Martial Competition

Northern Plains, Feng Xian grotto-heaven.

Rank eight Gu Immortal Prince Feng Xian sat silently with closed eyes.

Suddenly, Prince Feng Xian opened his eyes.

"I failed again, unable to deduce any trace of Fang Yuan," Prince Feng Xian muttered.

"I am merely mimicking wisdom path, not truly cultivating it; deducing Fang Yuan's true location is beyond me," Prince Feng Xian sighed.

"Lord Feng Xian, Gong tribe seeks an audience," a yellow-clad female Gu Immortal entered the hall and reported.

"Gong tribe is here? Hmph." Prince Feng Xian frowned: "Not meeting them."

"But Gong tribe's Gu Immortal brought the Longevity Edict." Le Yao hesitated.

Prince Feng Xian smiled lightly: "So what if they have the Longevity Edict? It commands the Huang Jin bloodline, not me."

Le Yao pouted: "But Lord, as spies in Northern Plains, you are still Gong tribe's son-in-law and external supreme elder. Won't openly defying it cause trouble?"

Prince Feng Xian laughed: "Longevity Heaven is an unfathomable rank nine grotto-heaven built on Giant Sun's foundation—Northern Plains' equivalent of Heavenly Court! This time, Longevity Heaven ordered all Huang Jin righteous super forces to attack Bai Zu tribe in a unified battle against outside forces. The collapse of Eighty-Eight True Yang Building, Bai Zu tribe's rise, and Chu Sect have constantly crossed Longevity Heaven's bottom line. They will never seek my aid—Yao Huang is their only choice!"

Just as Prince Feng Xian analyzed, the Longevity Edict was passed through every Huang Jin tribe over several days before reaching Yao Huang.

Yao Huang received the Longevity Edict with aged hands, sighing deeply to himself.

"This Longevity Edict still ended up with me after all."

To counter the rank eight Heavenly Lord Bai Zu, the Northern Plains righteous path forces needed a rank eight Gu Immortal of their own.

Thus, Longevity Heaven had only one possible choice: rank eight refinement path Gu Immortal Yao Huang!

In truth, Yao Huang was reluctant to involve himself in this mess.

Currently, he was busy trying to refine resurrection from the dead Immortal Gu!

"I should go talk to Heavenly Lord Bai Zu first." Yao Huang sighed, storing his immortal aperture and flying into Northern Plains' white heaven.

Receiving Yao Huang's invitation, Heavenly Lord Bai Zu hesitated briefly before agreeing to meet and discuss the matter.

"Friend, what do you think?" Yao Huang smiled and asked.

"Sigh, to tell the truth, I never expected it to reach this point." Heavenly Lord Bai Zu waved his hand, feeling gloomy over the situation.

His motive was very simple, he wanted to take down Hei Fan grotto-heaven.

Yet Chu Du's strength and cunning exceeded Bai Zu's expectations, worsening the situation until Bai Zu could no longer back out.

Yao Huang smiled: "Old friend, do you understand now? Leading a righteous path force isn't easy; even as rank eight Gu Immortals, we cannot act freely."

"I do. But having worked so hard for these results, I'm unwilling to give up just yet," Heavenly Lord Bai Zu said openly.

Yao Huang fell silent before replying: "I don't want to interfere either, but I cannot help it—Longevity Heaven's token is already in my hands."

Heavenly Lord Bai Zu sighed deeply: "Then we can only fight now."

Yao Huang waved his hand: "That is inevitable, but there is no rush. Though I lead this effort, Longevity Heaven oversees everything. They are watching patiently; fighting now resolves nothing. We should let the juniors clash first."

Heavenly Lord Bai Zu pondered and nodded: "Then in that case, let's decide a date for a martial competition."

"Alright." Yao Huang thought: "Blood Plain is a good choice of location, how about there?"

"That is good." Heavenly Lord Bai Zu agreed instantly.

After finalizing the Blood Plain martial competition, the two Gu Immortals left white heaven and returned to their tribes.

News of the Blood Plain martial competition soon spread across Northern Plains and beyond.

Both sides gathered strength: the righteous path Huang Jin tribes selected only elites, while Bai Zu tribe and Chu Sect recruited outside experts in extensive preparation.

# Chapter 1191: Begging

Central Continent, deep in Earth Abyss.

His guest was Shi Lei, a peak rank seven expert known as the Immortal Monkey King.

An information path Immortal Gu hovered above the garden, circling without landing.

Shi Lei's golden eyes shone: "It's an Immortal Gu from my sect. Brother Yang, please let it in."

After inspecting it, Shi Lei's expression changed slightly.

Shi Lei remarked: "Northern Plains immortals are battle maniacs. Hei tribe was just destroyed, and now all the Huang Jin tribes are attacking Chu Sect and Bai Zu tribe."

"Chu Sect?" Yang Feng was confused.

Shi Lei patted his head: "Oh, I nearly forgot. Heavenly Court ordered us to attack Star Form blessed land now."

"What, Heavenly Court has confirmed Fang Yuan won't come?" Yang Feng asked in surprise.

Ever since Ying Wu Xie's group escaped Heavenly Court, Fairy Zi Wei had relentlessly searched for Fang Yuan's traces.

Though Fang Yuan's body remained hidden, Fairy Zi Wei had forcefully deduced Star Form blessed land's existence.

When Star Form blessed land recently faced a calamity, Fang Yuan decisively ignored it.

Recognizing Fang Yuan's resolve, Fairy Zi Wei resolved to destroy it before it could benefit him.

Spirit Affinity House.

"Senior sister, you're amazing to refine even this type of Gu!" Qin Juan cried excitedly, holding the Gu with both hands.

With snow-white skin and long golden eyebrows, Feng Jin Huang smiled: "This is nothing much."

"Senior sister, oh no!" A chubby-faced Gu Master ran over in a fluster.

Feng Jin Huang smiled: "No need to worry, I'm here. What happened?"

Taking a deep breath, Sun Yao said: "Zhao Lian Yun is coming!"

"Zhao Lian Yun?" Qin Juan looked worriedly at Feng Jin Huang: "She inherited Thieving Heaven's true inheritance and has rivaled you since joining the sect. She wants to contest the next generation fairy position of Spirit Affinity House with you, why is she coming here?"

Feng Jin Huang's smile faded: "I don't know either. Let's go meet her and ask."

The three left the room, meeting a girl.

Feng Jin Huang asked first: "Junior sister Zhao, what business brings you to me?"

Zhao Lian Yun hesitated for a moment, determination shone in her eyes.

At the next moment, she knelt down.

Feng Jin Huang was also quite shocked: "Junior sister Zhao, why are you doing this?"

"I really have no alternative. Please save Ma Hong Yun!" Zhao Lian Yun pleaded, tears streaming down her smooth cheeks.

"Who is Ma Hong Yun? Stand up and tell me, don't kneel." Feng Jin Huang stepped forward to help Zhao Lian Yun up.

But Zhao Lian Yun refused, brushing away Feng Jin Huang's hands while sobbing: "Right now, only you can help me, senior sister Feng Jin Huang!"

Southern Border, Gu Yue village.

Clenching his fists and gritting his teeth, Fang Yuan said to the two before him: "Uncle, aunt, you took my parents' inheritance. I need primeval stones now, can't you help me?"

Aunt snorted shrilly: "That's not true, your parents' inheritance is with your brother. He has A grade aptitude and a far brighter future. Your parents would have done the same if alive."

"Fang Yuan," Uncle said calmly, "I know you want primeval stones to refine Gu. But do you know how great the risks are? You are simply too young. Discard these unrealistic thoughts and do your duties. With your C grade aptitude, stop dreaming and live realistically."

After a brief silence, he said: "I understand now."

He turned around and walked out.

Starlight reflected in Fang Yuan's pupils, glowing with vibrant life.

"Since I transmigrated to this world, I must achieve something. So what if I have C grade aptitude? I will definitely succeed!"

Fang Yuan did not notice a figure quietly following behind, watching everything unfold.

Yet this Fang Yuan held deep maturity and experience.

Under his watch, the entire dream realm faded like thick mist, gradually vanishing away.

In the real world, Fang Yuan slowly opened his eyes, muttering: "To think... I could re-experience what happened in my previous life."

# Chapter 1192: Concession

Central Continent, Spirit Affinity House.

"Zhao Lian Yun might be an otherworldly demon, but she has deep love in her." Looking out the window into the distant courtyard, Fairy Bai Qing gazed at the kneeling Zhao Lian Yun.

Walking over, Feng Jiu Ge looked skyward, saying plainly: "Dear, can't you tell? Someone is guiding Zhao Lian Yun."

Fairy Bai Qing's gaze flashed: "Do you mean Xu Hao and Li Jun Ying?"

Xu Hao and Li Jun Ying were Feng Jiu Ge's main opponents in Spirit Affinity House.

Feng Jiu Ge admitted: "I sent Xu Hao on that mission to sideline them, but they benefited instead."

"Huang Er had no rivals for the fairy position, but Zhao Lian Yun is sharp and effective—truly a worthy rival."

"Zhao Lian Yun's kneeling plea is likely Xu Hao's doing. To save her lover, she must compete for the fairy position to command Spirit Affinity House's power. If Huang Er gives in, she loses the position; if she refuses, it breeds trouble."

Fairy Bai Qing smiled: "Our sect's signature Immortal Gu is Love, valuing emotion. Xu Hao doesn't expect Zhao Lian Yun to succeed. But once Huang Er rejects her, others will sympathize with Zhao Lian Yun."

Xu Hao desperately sought to have Zhao Lian Yun defeat Feng Jin Huang and become fairy, enabling him to leverage her power and allies against Feng Jiu Ge.

"Xu Hao made a good move. Whichever choice Huang Er makes, she loses. In fact, to contest the position, she must reject Zhao Lian Yun," Feng Jiu Ge said plainly.

"Then we let her continue kneeling here?" Fairy Bai Qing asked.

Feng Jiu Ge smiled: "Don't worry, she won't stay long—this is merely a show."

Fairy Bai Qing shook her head: "Zhao Lian Yun is in agony, yet resolute. Do you think Xu Hao told her the truth? She believes her only hope of saving her lover lies in Huang Er withdrawing. She will definitely keep kneeling."

Feng Jiu Ge remained silent, looking at the sky and paying Zhao Lian Yun no heed.

Qin Juan kicked a stone along the path angrily: "Zhao Lian Yun is so annoying! Is this how one begs? Demanding you forfeit the fairy contest—she's completely shameless!"

Calming a little, Qin Juan worried for Feng Jin Huang: "Senior sister must be troubled. Zhao Lian Yun posed a difficult dilemma. If we agree, we forfeit the fairy position. Every generation's fairy in Spirit Affinity House must be acknowledged by everyone!"

"Hehehe." Walking in front, Feng Jin Huang suddenly laughed lightly to herself.

Standing on the slope, Feng Jin Huang looked up at the stars in the sky.

Next, she spoke: "I will not concede."

Her tone was plain, but Sun Yao and Qin Juan could hear her unwavering determination.

She continued: "Though Zhao Lian Yun is pitiful, becoming the next fairy is my goal. This is the path I chose, and I will not change it for anyone!"

Northern Plains, Lang Ya blessed land, Fang Yuan was inside his own dream realm.

In Gu Yue village, a young Fang Yuan stood before the Gu Yue clan leader.

"You want me to deliberately give in and lose to Fang Zheng tomorrow?!" Fang Yuan growled with wide eyes.

Gu Yue clan leader sighed: "Fang Yuan, Fang Zheng has lived trapped in your shadow for too long. He challenged you to overcome his childhood trauma, defeat you, and obtain the heart of an expert."

Fang Yuan lowered his head, gritting his teeth: "Clan leader, seeking me out in secret proves I have the strength to defeat him."

"Indeed. You successfully refined that Gu, but Fang Zheng has A grade aptitude and guidance from elders; he merely lacks experience," Gu Yue clan leader said.

"A grade aptitude... hehe." Fang Yuan raised his head, smiling mockingly at the clan leader.

"Your decision?" Gu Yue clan leader looked down expressionlessly with an imposing air.

Fang Yuan turned around and walked away.

He left with one sentence: "I'll do it."

The clan leader watched in silence, his gaze darkening: "He conceded so easily; he must have other plans. To be safe, I should preemptively weaken him."

# Chapter 1193: Gong Wan Ting

Dawn.

An enormous hall parted the clouds, descending above the grassland like a world ruler.

Grand and magnificent, the hall was coiled by lightning serpents as countless thunderbolts rained beside it.

Inside the hall, Nu Er Gu laughed heartily: "Loud Thunder Hall is truly powerful! Anchored by this hall in the blood battle competition, our Nu Er tribe will slaughter the enemy. Hahaha!"

Covering her ears, a girl frowned and shouted: "Enough, Nu Er Gu, stop with the thunder! It's deafening—do it again and I'll turn you into a toad."

The girl waved her hand: "Behave. We shouldn't stand out—Yao, Guan, and Liu tribes are closer to Chu Sect; if we overexert ourselves, they'll merely reap the benefits."

"Hmm? Gong tribe is arriving too." Amplified by Loud Thunder Hall, the girl's gaze pierced the distance, spotting another Immortal Gu House.

It was Gong tribe's Golden Dawn Hall, shining with brilliant golden radiance.

Seeing a female Gu Immortal standing at Golden Dawn Hall's entrance, Nu Er Gu frowned: "Why her?"

"Gong Wan Ting?" Nu Er tribe's girl exclaimed in surprise, before adding, "Come with me."

Nu Er tribe's Gu Immortals immediately flew out from Loud Thunder Hall to Golden Dawn Hall's entrance.

The girl greeted cordially: "Elder sister Wan Ting, I hope you have been well."

Gong Wan Ting smiled lightly: "Good day, little sister Nu Er Qian."

Then a third Immortal Gu House appeared, adding to the spectacle.

Yao tribe's Yao Yuan Ying flew out from the Immortal Gu House, greeting Gong Wan Ting first before Nu Er Qian.

Nu Er Gu secretly transmitted to Nu Er Qian: "Great-aunt, Gong tribe came prepared. Dispatching Gong Wan Ting completely overshadows Yao tribe, despite them holding the Longevity Edict."

Nu Er Qian replied: "Gong Wan Ting is Prince Feng Xian's wife; even Yao Huang treats her with courtesy. Yet Yao tribe sent Yao Yuan Ying. Gentle and specialized in healing rather than combat, it seems Yao tribe has no intention of putting in much effort either."

Next, Huang Jin tribes appeared one after the other.

Liu tribe, Ye Lui tribe, Chanyu tribe, Meng tribe, Yuan tribe, Nian Er tribe, Murong tribe, Guan tribe.

"Greetings to Fairy Gong Wan Ting." The Gu Immortals of various tribes all paid their respects to Gong Wan Ting.

Beyond her battle strength as a righteous path leader, her status as Prince Feng Xian's wife commanded undisputed respect.

"With Fairy Gong Wan Ting present, how could I presume to hold this edict?" Defying expectations, Yao Yuan Ying directly handed over the Longevity Edict.

Gong Wan Ting, however, refused with a smile.

Only upon Yao Yuan Ying's third offer did Gong Wan Ting reluctantly accept.

Upon taking it, she immediately placed it at the center of Golden Dawn Hall's entrance plaque.

Gong Wan Ting continued: "Everyone, please enter the hall. My tribe has prepared wine and delicacies."

# Chapter 1196: Sword Heart Clarity

"His killer move is too formidable. Fifteen fragments working together increased the difficulty countless times, but with a hundred, he has achieved complete dominance."

The righteous path alliance and the Chu-Bai Zu alliance had already fought over ten battles.

Initially, Chu Du astutely sent the young Xue Wu Hen, who won three consecutive battles to widespread awe.

Gong Wan Ting countered with Nian Er Ping Zhi, who slew renowned demonic expert Granny Yin with sword heart clarity.

Gong Wan Ting then negotiated a temporary ceasefire with Chu Du, setting rules for exchanging corpses.

When battles resumed, righteous immortals from Yuan, Meng, and other tribes clashed with Chu Du's side, which fielded Hao Zhen, Chou Lao Wu, and Bai Zu tribe immortals.

As veteran Gu Immortals, both sides traded wins and losses with varying injuries, but suffered no deaths.

Seeing the stalemate, Gong Wan Ting pondered briefly before sending Ye Lui Qun Xing.

Finally, Chu Du spoke: "Alright, this battle is our loss."

Immortal Wang retreated with a shameful expression.

Ye Lui Qun Xing did not pursue the kill; Immortal Wang still possessed defensive capability, allowing Chu Du time to intervene.

Reverting to human form, Immortal Wang approached Chu Du, saying heavily: "Ye Lui Qun Xing's killer move is extremely ingenious. Its essence cost is minimal, and the star fragments generate strong magnetic attraction; discerning its mysteries would be difficult for anyone except a star path Gu Immortal."

"The fragments are swift, creating invisible forces that skewed my movements and made me lose control repeatedly. He was weakest in his first fight, but now a hundred star fragments form a battle array. Later challengers will lose advantages and find it very difficult against this array."

Chu Du patted Immortal Wang's shoulder: "Say no more, it is enough that you returned safely."

This simple gesture moved Immortal Wang almost to tears.

"Who will fight next!" Ye Lui Qun Xing called out.

"He refuses to retreat and seeks a fifth battle!" Chu Du's expression shifted, killing intent flashing in his eyes.

Chu Du found himself in the awkward position of having no experts to deploy.

While Golden Dawn Hall brimmed with righteous experts, Chu Du's side—a newly formed alliance of Bai Zu tribe and his sect—was severely undermanned.

# Chapter 1202: Arrogance Concealed Under Beauty

"What, no one wants to fight? Are you out of people already?" Ye Lui Qun Xing seized the chance to mock them.

Just then, his eyes brightened as an information path Gu arrived via treasure yellow heaven.

"Wonderful! Elder Liu Guan Yi's timing is perfect." Chu Du scanned the information, his brows relaxing immediately.

"Chu Sect's second supreme elder?"

A multicolored cloud sped forward, bearing a youthful Gu Immortal standing proudly at the front.

He wore a white robe, its wide sleeves fluttering in the wind.

With long black hair, snow-white skin, sharp brows, and bright eyes, he smiled faintly in an unfettered manner, striking in his extraordinary handsomeness.

Fang Yuan, however, internally was shaking his head.

Fang Yuan estimated low odds of killing him. Though ancient sword dragon form matched Unfettered Scholar's power, his stamina was limited—green grape immortal essence could not compare to red date immortal essence.

Powering rank seven Immortal Gu took at least a hundred and thirty green grape beads to match the effect of a single red date bead.

As he pondered this, Fang Yuan spoke: "I won't fight."

The immortals were stunned.

"Why won't you fight—are you afraid?" Immortal Wang sneered from behind.

Chu Du looked at Fang Yuan silently, his gaze asking why he refused to fight.

Fang Yuan sneered at Ye Lui Qun Xing: "He is too weak—I can kill him with spit. Why use an ox-cleaver for a chicken? Fighting him insults my status."

A young Gu Immortal immediately shouted: "You dare not fight, yet talk big! How can you gauge Lord Qun Xing's might? You aren't being proud—you're just terrified!"

# Chapter 1203: Shameless

"Afraid or not, everyone can see you don't dare," a Bai Zu tribe Gu Immortal sneered.

"This weakling?"

Yet Fang Yuan declared: "Look, he truly fears me! Even without me fighting, he was terrified, lost his cool, and had no choice but to flee."

Ye Lui Qun Xing's steps slightly paused.

Disappointed inwardly, Fang Yuan mocked outwardly: "Ye Lui Qun Xing, time to scram."

Ye Lui Qun Xing waved to Ye Lui Hui Hong and smiled at Fang Yuan: "Since you finally stepped up, how could I flee? I only need a brief rest after five hard battles."

Fang Yuan laughed: "Rest as much as you want—take two or three days, or two or three years!"

Finally, Ye Lui Qun Xing recovered and walked to the stage, standing opposite Fang Yuan.

"Liu Guan Yi, I..." Before Ye Lui Qun Xing could speak, Fang Yuan's body erupted in dazzling silver light.

The next instant, a silver ancient sword dragon shot out from the light.

It bore a sharp horn, its gaping maw densely lined with sharp fangs.

"So despicable!"

# Chapter 1204: How Could It Be Seen Through?!

Ye Lui Qun Xing had a great fright as he quickly retreated!

"This shameless guy!" he cursed inwardly. Every time he thought Fang Yuan was shameless, Fang Yuan's next move completely redefined it.

The distance between Fang Yuan and Ye Lui Qun Xing was rapidly shrinking.

Retreating, Ye Lui Qun Xing shouted and pushed toward the charging ancient sword dragon.

Brilliant blue light erupted from his hand as a star fragment shot out like a meteor toward Fang Yuan.

Fang Yuan roared and arced gracefully through the air, nimbly dodging past the incoming star fragment with inches to spare.

With a sharp crack, Fang Yuan's tail swung and smashed the bypassed star fragment.

The ancient sword dragon's tail was even deadlier than its claws, capable of smashing dark inkstone, let alone this star fragment.

Seeing Fang Yuan respond so astutely, Ye Lui Qun Xing grew disappointed and accelerated his retreat.

Clapping repeatedly, blue light coated his hands as star fragments shot out one after another.

Starting thumb-sized, they regained their original size midair and accelerated, kicking up powerful gusts of wind.

Fang Yuan used his horn, claws, body, and tail to shatter every star fragment.

He did not give Ye Lui Qun Xing any opportunity to accumulate power.

Chu Du slightly frowned.

Fang Yuan wisely targeted the weakness of Ye Lui Qun Xing's immortal killer move by smashing star fragments, but this reduced his speed.

Ye Lui Qun Xing had already stabilized himself.

Snorting, he struck out rapidly, scattering star fragments in all directions rather than directly at Fang Yuan.

Hesitating, the ancient sword dragon's offensive slowed.

Though brief, Fang Yuan's hesitation cost him the opportunity as dozens of star fragments filled the battlefield.

Ye Lui Qun Xing's advantage had started to accumulate.

Encircled by star fragments, Fang Yuan attacked frantically regardless of injury, yet failed to break through the layers of encirclement.

Ye Lui Qun Xing relaxed as more star fragments multiplied, surrounding Fang Yuan and orbiting steadily around himself.

"Liu Guan Yi, your arrogant boasting was just to make me retract my star fragments and deploy them again."

"A deep scheme, nearly convincing everyone of your arrogance. Unfortunately, I am not the same person I was years ago."

"Years ago, I patched this weakness in my killer move. Your methods cannot restrain me."

"Now, what are you going to use to resolve this situation?"

Stroking his beard with a brightening smile, Ye Lui Hui Hong reminded Ye Lui Qun Xing: "Be careful of his dragon breath. It is the ancient sword dragon's strongest weapon, yet he hasn't breathed out once."

Looking at his orbiting star fragments, Ye Lui Qun Xing thought: "A hundred star fragments protect me. Even Chu Du could only hold me briefly, let alone this Liu Guan Yi. Dong Fang Chang Fan, you might have passed away, but let me sustain the reputation of myriad star fireflies for you. After all, my immortal killer move had received your guidance."

Just as most Gu Immortals felt the battle was decided, a sudden change occurred!

Sword escape Immortal Gu!

Suddenly, Fang Yuan activated rank seven sword escape Immortal Gu.

In ancient sword dragon form, his transformation dao marks converted to sword path, reaching ten thousand when combined with sword eyebrows Immortal Gu.

Sword dragons lacked strong ranged attacks, but their burst of speed from a stationary state was astonishing.

Combining the ancient sword dragon, sword escape Immortal Gu, and ten thousand sword path dao marks, Fang Yuan vanished instantly.

Before anyone could react, he crossed the entire battlefield and appeared before Ye Lui Qun Xing!

Ye Lui Qun Xing's victorious smile froze as his pupils shrank to pinpricks, staring in terror at the gigantic sword dragon head filling his vision!

"Impossible! My star fragments' trajectories derive from myriad star fireflies, how could he see through them?!"

This was Ye Lui Qun Xing's final thought in life.

# Chapter 1206: Becoming Rank Seven!

Fang Yuan had already put the blood battle martial competition out of his mind.

He would never surrender Ye Lui Qun Xing's immortal aperture; even if he could not annex it now, he could do so in the future.

Regarding the righteous path's demand for Ye Lui Qun Xing's corpse and soul, Fang Yuan considered it and was willing to return only the body.

His focus was the immortal aperture, and the soul could be searched for Ye Lui tribe's secrets before yielding Lang Ya Sect contribution points.

"The priority now is to test whether I can annex this immortal aperture."

Using teleportation formations to leave Blood Plain far behind, Fang Yuan arrived over an ordinary grassland. After inspecting and not finding anything wrong, Fang Yuan took out Ye Lui Qun Xing's corpse.

The pitiful fellow's head had already been sliced off entirely.

Fang Yuan treated the headless corpse with temporary measures, ensuring the immortal aperture was preserved.

Fang Yuan had already extracted and properly sealed Ye Lui Qun Xing's soul.

Releasing his seal, Fang Yuan threw the corpse onto the grassland.

Several breaths later, there was turbulence in heaven and earth qi.

The immortal aperture began to land on the ground, causing a huge commotion.

Unsurprisingly, the immortal aperture's entrance opened before Fang Yuan.

The ground protruded upward as a basin-sized star core floated before Fang Yuan.

Resembling a dark blue crystal ball, this azure star core was the blessed land's land spirit.

Amidst soundless communication, Fang Yuan learned about this blessed land's ownership condition.

To ordinary Gu Immortals, this condition was quite difficult.

The land spirit required seeing the true, complete version of the immortal killer move, myriad star fireflies.

"My luck is unstoppable, hahaha." Fang Yuan immediately presented the complete contents of myriad star fireflies to the land spirit.

After a while, Fang Yuan became this blessed land's master.

"Now is the most crucial moment. Let's see if I can annex this blessed land."

Fang Yuan rested for a while before beginning.

Based on predecessor experiences, annexing an immortal aperture required fulfilling three main conditions.

First, annexing an immortal aperture required specific attainment level.

Second, a smaller immortal aperture could not engulf a bigger one.

Third, dead apertures could not be annexed.

Fang Yuan satisfied two conditions to annex Qun Xing blessed land, but one remained somewhat ambiguous.

A smaller immortal aperture could not engulf a bigger one—the question was, what defined small and big?

If judged by cultivation level, where rank six was small and rank seven big, Fang Yuan could not annex Qun Xing blessed land.

If based on aperture foundation, Fang Yuan's sovereign immortal aperture far surpassed Qun Xing blessed land and could devour it.

Fang Yuan had already wanted to test this and verify it.

Bold and skilled, Fang Yuan began testing, annexing Qun Xing blessed land with the land spirit's help.

The process was smooth beyond expectations.

Annexing Qun Xing blessed land added an enormous star fragment plain and bypassed numerous calamities and tribulations, officially advancing Fang Yuan from rank six to rank seven.

Rank seven Gu Immortal!

"From this moment on, I am a rank seven Gu Immortal. I have finally become a rank seven..."

Fang Yuan was filled with emotions.

Across five hundred years in his first life, he had only reached rank six second heavenly tribulation—now knowing heaven's will had deliberately suppressed his cultivation.

Through countless fortuitous encounters, effort, and perseverance, Fang Yuan had finally broken through heaven's will's restrictions to reach rank seven.

At this moment, the sovereign immortal aperture began to produce red date immortal essence.

He could also merge his accumulated green grape immortal essence into red date immortal essence.

"Using green grape immortal essence for rank seven Immortal Gu adds at least thirty percent extra cost. Merging them into red date immortal essence avoids that wasteful loss."

"With reserves of red date immortal essence, I will no longer fear battles of attrition. The crisis when Heavenly Lord Bai Zu attacked Hei Fan grotto-heaven will be completely behind me!"

# Chapter 1207: Doing Something Bad

"Hah!" Hao Zhen flew to the sky and spat out a thunderbolt.

Admitting defeat, a pale-faced Hao Zhen returned: "I am ashamed, I could not live up to your expectations."

"Supreme Elder, you are our strongest expert, but you cannot easily take the stage. I think you need to call back Elder Liu," Immortal Wang suggested.

Their relationship was built on mutual benefit and equal status.

Lang Ya blessed land, inside a secret room in a cloud city.

Fang Yuan was sitting cross-legged on a prayer mat, his divine sense entering his immortal aperture.

He was merging green grape immortal essence into red date immortal essence.

"Chu Du sent another letter about Murong Gang... this is already the sixth." Fang Yuan's attention shifted slightly.

He tossed the information path mortal Gu aside, disinterested in even replying.

What blood battle martial competition, I don't give a f*ck!

Screw off.

"The blood battle martial competition does not match my interests."

"With the sovereign immortal aperture, I can annex apertures to skip tribulations and raise my cultivation. A bloody shortcut, but... I like it."

"I want chaos, the more chaos, the better!"

"There is also Lang Ya Sect and the four races alliance—how would Northern Plains react if they knew? Regretfully, alliance agreements still bind me."

Fang Yuan only worried the world was not chaotic enough; sinister, dangerous thoughts surged in his mind.

Fang Yuan had first thought of going to Southern Border.

Lately, he had adjusted his cultivation plan, spending nearly all his time and energy refining dream path mortal Gu.

It was all preparation for Southern Border's giant dream realm.

Yet on second thought, the opportunity presented by the blood battle martial competition was simply too rare.

Furthermore, Southern Border's righteous path had tightly defended the giant dream realm with a super Gu formation, leaving no opening currently.

He was going to do something bad.

# Chapter 1208: With the Murder Weapon in Hand, Killing Intent Surges

Northern Plains, Bone Burial Field.

Gu Immortal Liu Yong was paying close attention.

Possessing the Huang Jin bloodline, he was a rank six enslavement path Gu Immortal of Liu tribe.

"Hmm? An information Gu from the tribe?" His brows rose and his eyes gleamed, sensing something interesting was coming.

His consciousness quickly entered his immortal aperture to inspect the information path Gu worm.

The message detailed Fang Yuan's strength and ancient sword dragon transformation, emphasizing how shameless, devious, and scheming he was.

Fang Yuan's 'Liu Guan Yi' persona had gained immense notoriety; throughout Northern Plains, even Prince Feng Xian and Heavenly Lord Bai Zu knew of him, and word had reached other regions like Central Continent.

Liu Yong was pondering this when a huge explosion suddenly erupted.

"What is going on?!" The tremors knocked the giant skull beneath Liu Yong off its skeleton's neck.

Liu Yong quickly floated into the air, staring in bewilderment: "The defensive Gu formation is under attack? Someone dares attack Liu tribe's territory!"

An ancient sword dragon!

It had pale white eyes, a sky-piercing horn, gleaming scales, and chilling fangs that made Liu Yong shudder.

"Oh? A Liu tribe member is here? My luck is pretty good." The ancient sword dragon spoke in human tongue, its eyes radiating intense killing intent.

"Liu, Liu Guan Yi?!" Liu Yong was stunned.

Though his name signified 'courage,' Liu Yong was utterly gutless now, stammering with a trembling tongue: "Liu, Lord Liu, why are you at my Liu tribe..."

"Of course it is to..." Fang Yuan purposely dragged his words out.

"Is, is to what?" Liu Yong asked.

Fang Yuan replied not with words, but with dragon breath.

Powered by dragon breath Immortal Gu, the ancient sword dragon's breath shot out like white light!

Liu Yong's upper body blew up.

The two halves of his corpse landed on the ground, his pre-death expression still frozen with wide-open eyes.

"Useless fellow. But the Huang Jin tribes have been in power for too long; internal rot is unavoidable, just like the ten great ancient sects," Fang Yuan analyzed.

An hour later, six unconscious bone armor hounds lay inside Fang Yuan's sovereign immortal aperture.

These desolate beast hounds came at a good time, as Fang Yuan needed their faeces to feed dog shit luck Immortal Gu.

Finally, Fang Yuan temporarily sealed the immortal aperture still hidden within Liu Yong's corpse.

This enslavement path immortal aperture was suited for Fang Yuan to annex.

And also, Liu Yong's soul.

Though severely weakened by the dragon breath and at Fang Yuan's mercy, it was still alive.

Fang Yuan quickly realized: "Liu Yong was an enslavement path Gu Immortal; since enslavement relates to soul path, manipulating desolate beasts requires a strong soul foundation."

Fang Yuan quickly left the scene of the crime.

"The next location, Liu tribe's jade light pit."

Fang Yuan licked his lips, showing excitement in his eyes.

Having just committed murder, he had no intention of retreating—he was off to strike again!

As the saying goes — With the murder weapon in hand, killing intent surges.

With soaring battle strength from the ancient sword dragon transformation, Fang Yuan grew increasingly unrestrained.

# Chapter 1209: Looting Another Place

Still in ancient sword dragon form, he activated sword escape Immortal Gu and flew rapidly.

"My speed is top tier in Northern Plains. Though inferior to Hui Feng Zi, Chu Du's body strength travel is now far below mine."

"I destroyed Bone Burial Field and killed Liu Yong, who alerted his tribe before dying. As a super force, Liu tribe will definitely pursue me."

"However, Liu tribe's available fighters are tied to the blood battle or resource points. Dispatching experts capable of dealing with Liu Guan Yi will take time."

Because of attitude Gu.

Skinny with a sharp face and beady eyes, his expression showed anxiety and rage.

Liu Chang's battle strength rivaled Ye Lui Qun Xing's; cultivating light path, he specialized in extreme speed and movement.

While the siblings interacted, more Liu tribe Gu Immortals arrived.

Using an investigative method, one quickly discovered Fang Yuan's traces: "He escaped that way, let's chase him!"

The other two Gu Immortals were dazed: "How long will that take? If we don't chase now, we'll never catch him!"

"Brother is the best." Liu Luo was joyous.

The two Liu tribe Gu Immortals looked at each other with bitter expressions.

# Chapter 1210: Wanted by the Entire Righteous Path

"According to Liu Yong, Liu tribe would send Liu Chang after me. But as a light path immortal, I cannot annex his aperture. Why take the risk?"

Still in his ancient sword dragon transformation, Fang Yuan flew west.

Using the super teleportation Gu formation, he went to another corner of Northern Plains.

Liu Guan Yi's notoriety surged after he raided Liu tribe, killed Liu Yong, and looted Bone Burial Field and the jade light pit, news quickly spreading across Northern Plains.

The righteous path was furious; hearing this, Gong Wan Ting questioned Chu Du and blamed the Domination Immortal.

Over at Chu Sect, they were also surprised and shocked.
