Immediately, Chu Du declared that Liu Guan Yi acted entirely on his own. To prove his innocence and Chu Sect's stance, Chu Du announced on the spot that Liu Guan Yi was expelled from the sect, no longer its second supreme elder.

"So resolute," Fang Yuan noted, holding Chu Du's letter Gu.

In the letter, Chu Du politely explained that the situation forced the expulsion, privately hoping they could still cooperate in the future.

Between the tribulation tempering aperture and the Crazed Demon Agreement, Chu Du needed to maintain secret ties.

But publicly, the two were enemies.

Meanwhile, Heavenly Lord Bai Zu and Yao Huang issued warrants denouncing Fang Yuan's demonic acts.

Fang Yuan's plan to disrupt Northern Plains failed, and Liu Guan Yi was now universally wanted.

"Chu Du, Heavenly Lord Bai Zu, Yao Huang, they are truly not easy to scheme against."

Meanwhile, he was already planning to head to Southern Border.

While still monitoring Northern Plains' developments, Fang Yuan shifted his focus toward the giant dream realm.

# Chapter 1211: Stepping Into Southern Border

After over ten days of travel, the huge green regional wall appeared before Fang Yuan.

Suddenly, Fang Yuan's expression changed.

He sensed that dark limit Immortal Gu's power was rapidly weakening.

"Someone is deducing about me again!" Fang Yuan realized.

He quickly used dark limit Immortal Gu, resisting the deduction's power.

Thankfully, Fang Yuan possessed wisdom path grandmaster attainment and dark limit Immortal Gu to defend himself.

However, dark limit Immortal Gu required prolonged rest between activations before it could be used again.

Fang Yuan had to pace its usage to avoid being caught unprotected.

Liu tribe.

Three Liu tribe Gu Immortals inside the Gu formation expended their immortal essence to maintain its operation.

A moment later, the Gu formation stopped, and the three Gu Immortals rested.

"Failed again?" Outside the Gu formation, rank seven light path expert Liu Chang paced, speaking with disappointment.

"We have failed Lord Liu Chang and are deeply ashamed." The three Liu tribe Gu Immortals sighed, lowering their heads with grim expressions.

Liu Chang snorted, his tone cooling: "Our formation only mimics wisdom path deductions. I will seek Tian Xia Xin's help."

"That is the case?" Liu Chang's expression became darker.

He muttered: "He is a transformation path Gu Immortal specializing in the ancient sword dragon; how can he possess such methods? Though transformation path allegedly projects all paths, it is far more likely that the demon Liu Guan Yi has helpers. Domination Immortal Chu Du... even though he expelled Liu Guan Yi, I do not believe that he would do nothing. These demonic path or lone immortals are nothing good!"

Fang Yuan successfully passed the licorice regional wall.

His sovereign immortal aperture passed through without any obstruction.

Next, Fang Yuan entered Eastern Sea's blue water regional wall.

Passing through into Eastern Sea, his aura completely shifted to that of an Eastern Sea Gu Immortal.

Entering Eastern Sea, Fang Yuan took his time and rested in Qing Yu blessed land.

Fang Yuan rested while Dark Limit recovered; inside the isolated blessed land, external deductions failed without consuming its power.

Once dark limit Immortal Gu was ready, Fang Yuan promptly cast it on himself.

Replenished, he departed Qing Yu blessed land for the turbulent flow sea area.

Navigating the chaotic currents cost several days, but he eventually entered City Well.

There were many immortal apertures inside City Well.

Using the upper extreme heavenly eagle, Fang Yuan entered and annexed several blessed lands.

He passed two more tribulations, but gains were limited since his attainment in water path was merely ordinary.

Weeks later, Fang Yuan traversed Eastern Sea's blue water regional wall and Southern Border's miasma regional wall, entering Southern Border.

"I heard long ago that righteous path Gu Immortals sealed Yi Tian Mountain with a massive Gu formation. I should scout it first." Fang Yuan had no clear way into the giant dream realm yet.

"Someone is deducing me?" Sensing Dark Limit's power dip mid-flight, Fang Yuan found it laughable.

Separated from Northern Plains by two regional walls, his risk of being deduced was extremely low.

In Northern Plains' Myriad Bean Garden, Gu Immortal Tian Xia Xin duly refunded half the payment to Liu Chang.

Liu Chang looked incredulous and grim: "What? Even you failed to deduce it?"

Tian Xia Xin smiled bitterly: "Wisdom path deductions are not omnipotent. I did my best; my apologies."

"Liu Guan Yi, you had better pray we never cross paths!" Liu Chang swore, his eyes icy with murderous intent.

"Oh, they stopped. After paying a heavy price for nothing, they had to give up," Fang Yuan chuckled.

# Chapter 1212: Burning Soul Bursting Luck!

Fang Yuan had transformed his appearance from a human into a male monkey.

That's right, in front of him was the super dream realm.

Yet the giant dream realm was fully hidden by the righteous path's formation; to the naked eye, it appeared as merely a verdant mountain.

"My strongest investigative method, three breaths future vision, cannot penetrate this super Gu formation. It must contain numerous Immortal Gu."

"Chi clan's first supreme elder, Chi Qu You, set up this formation. As a formation path great grandmaster, his masterpiece is the three tune nine pool formation. Still, this super formation clearly exhibits the layered, nested style of his three tune nine pool formation."

"The formation is only partially active, keeping its Immortal Gu dormant to conserve immortal essence."

"Even so, I cannot breach this formation alone with thirteen righteous path Gu Immortals stationed inside!"

"The defenses are too tight. Brute force is impossible; I need a clever plan to enter and use unravel dream."

"What should I do?" Fang Yuan was troubled.

Inside Bai Xiang grotto-heaven, Bai Ning Bing glared at the spirit with equal frustration.

"I conquered the thirty halls and cleared every obstacle, yet you refuse to acknowledge me as master?" Bai Ning Bing demanded with an icy stare.

Sitting on the steps, the spirit took a deep drag from his cigar and exhaled: "Youths these days are so hasty. When you came here, I said that if you get through the thirty halls, I will meet you. I did not say that I will acknowledge you as master. Getting here just means that you have the initial qualifications to accept the following test."

"What is the following test?" Bai Ning Bing asked coldly.

"Retrieve an immortal material," the Bai Xiang heavenly spirit chuckled eerily.

The heavenly spirit sighed: "Millennia ago, an immortal material stored in the Thirty Heavenly Halls broke through the ceiling and escaped."

Taking another puff, the spirit said: "I want you to subdue that flame, hidden deep in the western sea. Normally, you cannot find it because it can fuse with sea water completely, but once in a while, it will float to the surface and frolic around. That is your best chance to catch it."

Following the heavenly spirit's directions, Bai Ning Bing reached the western coastline.

After lying in wait for over ten days, Bai Ning Bing finally spotted the opportunity.

Flying into the air, he saw the immortal material mentioned by the spirit.

It was a small lump of flames.

The glowing orange fire took the shape of a flying dragon, darting about erratically.

"Radiant dao marks and immense vitality—a rank nine immortal material!"

Bai Ning Bing had not expected the test to demand a rank nine immortal material!

Far beyond his capabilities, Bai Ning Bing risked using his Immortal Gu to contact Ying Wu Xie outside.

"I told you not to contact me; if the heavenly spirit discovers this, it will cause trouble," Ying Wu Xie said.

"I ran into trouble. I must retrieve a rank nine immortal material—a cluster of orange-yellow flames..."

At his description, Ying Wu Xie's expression changed: "Its dao mark light resembles flying dragons, and seawater flees from it in fear?"

"Indeed. A massive, expanding void has parted the sea around the flame down to the seabed," Bai Ning Bing added.

Ying Wu Xie's voice shook: "As recorded in The Legends of Ren Zu, this is the human flame—Raging Wave Rising Dragon Fire!"

Pausing, Bai Ning Bing asked: "What should I do then?"

Ying Wu Xie sighed: "At your level, subduing a wild flame is impossible. But since Bai Xiang once tamed this one, there is hope. I have three methods for you to try."

First, there was luck!

Ying Wu Xie's immortal killer move — Burning Soul Bursting Luck.

Before Bai Ning Bing left, Ying Wu Xie had used Connect Luck to link their fortunes.

To help Bai Ning Bing subdue the rank nine flame, Ying Wu Xie could only bolster their connected fortunes!

On the other hand, near the giant dream realm.

"Oh? Movement!" Disguised as a monkey, Fang Yuan ducked behind the branches.

Two Gu Immortals appeared beneath his tree.

"Brother Luo, thank you for this." A Gu Immortal said.

"I can bring you in, but if you are discovered, it has nothing to do with me," the other replied.

# Chapter 1213: Immortal Opportunity Business

Overhearing their exchange, Fang Yuan's ears perked up.

The two immortals investigated him, but Fang Yuan's familiar face was far beyond their detection.

One said: "Brother Luo, don't worry. After hearing Lady White Rabbit, I only wanted to experience the rumored dream realm myself. Though I, Jiao Lei Zi, am a lone cultivator, I keep my promises. Since I promised you and made an information path agreement, I would not do something out of line."

"Only your reputation convinced us to meet you," the Luo clan Gu Immortal said. "Follow me, and claim you are delivering an Immortal Gu."

"Interesting." Fang Yuan retreated into the foliage, eyes gleaming with excitement.

"Does he think dream realms are so simple? Without specialized dream path methods, what opportunities could there be?"

"Could I use this opening to enter the defensive formation and access the dream realm?" Fang Yuan pondered.

Waiting until Jiao Lei Zi emerged from the formation, Fang Yuan shadowed him to a secluded peak. Turning to Fang Yuan, he asked: "Friend, you have followed me for a while—is there a problem?"

"Pardon the intrusion," Fang Yuan greeted politely, explaining his intent.

Claiming to be a curious lone cultivator, Fang Yuan asked to use Jiao Lei Zi's channel into the dream realm.

"Word spreads fast if even outsiders know," Jiao Lei Zi remarked with an unsuspicious, helpless smile.

"Seeking an immortal opportunity is only natural. As a middleman, I will take you to Lady White Rabbit," Jiao Lei Zi offered.

After less than a day's travel, Jiao Lei Zi brought Fang Yuan before Lady White Rabbit.

The sight of Lady White Rabbit's establishment surprised Fang Yuan.

She had erected a mortal Gu House on a mountain peak, with numerous demonic and lone immortals streaming in and out.

"We only do dream realm business here, you came to the right place!"

"I have many reliable channels into the dream realm, depending on the price you pay."

"The higher the price, the faster you enter to find your immortal opportunity!" Lady White Rabbit said.

Just then, a female Gu Immortal approached the counter. Lady White Rabbit's smile warmed as she brushed past Fang Yuan: "Sister Miao Yin, here for another opportunity?"

The woman nodded: "I feel entering from another location might yield different results."

Fang Yuan exited the mortal Gu House and bid Jiao Lei Zi farewell.

# Chapter 1214: Situation of Southern Border

Beyond his expectations, this dream realm "immortal opportunity business" was thriving on a scale far grander than anticipated.

Judging by the bustling Gu House and Lady White Rabbit's words, any demonic or lone cultivator willing to pay could enter the righteous path's formation and explore the dream realm.

"The righteous path encircled this dream realm but cannot safely explore it, already losing authoritative rank seven experts, including Luo clan's third supreme elder..."

"Having suffered heavy losses, they know the perils of careless exploration, so they use this scheme to fleece resources from demonic and lone cultivators. And if any accidents happen, they would not need to waste any of their members to deal a huge blow to these non-righteous members, it is truly killing two birds with one stone."

"For this business to operate openly on such a scale, the righteous path must have reached a consensus; Lady White Rabbit is clearly backed by Southern Border's righteous forces. One clan is not enough, there are at least six or seven clans working together to result in this fearless stance."

Yet even if this method granted entry into the formation, it could not satisfy Fang Yuan's true needs.

First, he required extended, repeated access to explore the giant dream realm.

Second, he needed a cover identity that allowed him to remain stationed there even if anomalies arose.

Trapped inside the formation, he would be fish on the chopping block—especially since he lacked heavenly crystals to feed the upper extreme heavenly eagle.

"If this path fails, should I kill a righteous path Gu Immortal and infiltrate using familiar face?"

Fang Yuan shook his head, discarding the unrealistic notion.

First, righteous clans employed methods like life tablet Gu, soul lantern Gu, or blood rope Gu.

Killing one would trigger an instant reaction unless he had information path methods to deceive them.

Thus, killing someone and replacing them was not feasible.

Pondering his options, he returned to the mortal Gu House.

Lady White Rabbit's eyes lit up: "Have you decided to pursue your immortal opportunity?"

Fang Yuan smiled bitterly: "Fairy White Rabbit, that price would deplete my savings. For now, I only wish to purchase information about Southern Border."

Fang Yuan said, handing Fairy White Rabbit a rank six immortal material.

"Use this," Fairy White Rabbit replied, handing him an information path mortal Gu.

Super dream realm, righteous path Gu formation.

"We meet again, Fairy Miao Yin. Do you remember me?" A Qiao clan Gu Immortal asked as he led her into the Gu formation.

Their entry was observed by two righteous path Gu Immortals at the formation's core.

"They grow bolder by the day! Once every seven days was not enough; now they bring people in every day or two."

"Luo clan's two immortals at least bring reputable figures, but Qiao clan's Gu Immortals are utterly shameless and greedy. This Miao Yin is a demonic path member, in the past, she had destroyed two important resource points of my Ba clan, and even injured four Ba clan Gu Immortals who chased her!"

Gu Immortal Ba Quan Feng said angrily.

Beside him was another Ba clan Gu Immortal.

Thousands of years old, his cultivation stood at the brink of rank eight.

Possessing peak rank seven battle strength, he was publicly recognized across Southern Border as the number one expert beneath rank eight—Old Treeman Ba De!

Ba De said slowly: "Calm down. Though Qiao clan ranks at the bottom, they are backed by Wu clan through marriage alliances."

Hearing of Wu clan, Ba Quan Feng's anger faded, but he still continued: "Qiao clan is a righteous path force, yet for millennia they have been at Wu clan's beck and call—just a dog raised by Wu clan!"

"Wu clan is too overbearing! With two rank eight Gu Immortals, they act fearlessly, partnering with six other clans to run an immortal opportunity business in the dream realm. What do they think of the remaining six clans, including us? This super Gu formation was created together using all our Immortal Gu!"

Ba De shook his head: "Wu clan's actions will attract even more clans to join. After all, we know it is not yet time to explore the dream realm. This method yields greater profits and benefits us."

"Ah, why is that?" Ba Quan Feng asked quickly.

"There are advantages and disadvantages. Though they gain cultivation resources, we gain leverage. With enough evidence, Ba clan will hold the advantage when we contest this in the future. When dividing the dream realm, we will claim a larger share. Little Feng, look ahead—it cannot be explored now, but what about the future? The dream realm is the true treasure." Ba De sighed.

"Wu clan is so domineering and has two rank eight Gu Immortals to our one. If they remain unyielding then, we cannot stop them," Ba Quan Feng said angrily.

"Wu clan's first supreme elder is dying, which will plunge them into prolonged turmoil. With only one rank eight left, can Wu clan remain on top?" Ba De smiled meaningfully.

Ba Quan Feng stared wide-eyed: "So rumors that Wu clan's first supreme elder has exhausted her lifespan are true? Impossible, how can such a huge force lack lifespan Gu?"

"Wu clan's first supreme elder used other lifespan extension methods when young, leaving behind complications. Lifespan Gu is now useless to her." Ba De sighed: "Her death will shift Southern Border's entire situation, giving our clans a chance to strike at their vast resources."

# Chapter 1215: Wu Clan's Conflict

Wu Du Xiu slowly opened her eyes.

Wu Du Xiu knew that she was very close to dying.

Lying in bed and looking outside, her heart was filled with tranquility.

Turning her head with difficulty, Wu Du Xiu saw a familiar figure through the curtains.

"You are here." Wu Du Xiu spoke faintly with much difficulty.

The visitor knelt respectfully and bowed deeply: "I am here to meet you, mother."

He was an ordinary-looking middle-aged man with sharp eyebrows and a dark, gloomy aura.

Wu Du Xiu said: "I called you to tell you something. You have a younger half-brother born in Eastern Sea. I will pass all of Wu clan to you, while my personal inheritance will go to him. Do you understand?"

The middle-aged man kowtowed: "This child understands."

Wu Du Xiu paused before saying: "You may leave."

"I will take my leave!" the middle-aged Gu Immortal said carefully, rising slowly and stepping back before leaving and softly shutting the door.

"Can't that bastard stay in Eastern Sea for good? Why must he return and fight me for the inheritance?"

The middle aged Gu Immortal flew into a rage.

"Master, please calm down and mind your health," a hunchbacked rank seven Gu Immortal quickly urged.

The middle-aged Gu Immortal roared: "Mother wants to give her wind path Immortal Gu to that bastard! Without them, other clans will still bully us!"

"I don't need clan resources, I want her rank eight Immortal Gu! With strength, what can I not obtain?"

"Master, we could just eliminate him!" The hunchbacked rank seven Gu Immortal stepped forward, making a chopping motion.

The middle aged Gu Immortal stopped walking.

Frowning deeply, he turned to the rank seven Gu Immortal: "You mean..."

"Right, first supreme elder has only two sons: you and the Eastern Sea bastard. If we kill him, her entire inheritance becomes yours, doesn't it?" The hunchbacked Gu Immortal smiled sinisterly.

"If mother finds out, I'm finished!" Recalling his mother's methods, even with rank eight cultivation, the middle-aged Gu Immortal could not help trembling.

But the hunchback persisted: "Master, you cannot think like that. He is already rank seven; what happens once he inherits first supreme elder's Immortal Gu?"

The hunchback smiled sinisterly: "Master, you hesitate only out of fear that failure will invite first supreme elder's wrath. In truth, we need not act ourselves. Other clans covet our position. Leaking his travel route will lure them to strike, letting us profit greatly."

The middle-aged Gu Immortal's eyes shone: "Excellent plan! Xu Tuo, you are indeed my greatest aide. Once I become first supreme elder, I will reward you richly."

"Master, there is no time, should I go prepare now?"

"Yes, go ahead. I trust your handling of this."

Leaving the Immortal Gu House, Xu Tuo's eyes flashed with dark cunning.

"Hmph! After so much effort, I finally swayed Wu Yong. Even if leaking the illegitimate son's whereabouts leads to a pursuit, Wu Yong's protection will shield my true identity from exposure."

Xu Tuo was a Ba clan Gu Immortal planted as their highest-ranking spy.

Wu Du Xiu's illegitimate son, Wu Yi Hai, was a famed rank seven lone cultivator in Eastern Sea.

Killing Wu Yi Hai would not only weaken Wu clan and damage Wu Yong's reputation, but also sow internal suspicion and chaos.

Some days later.

Three Gu Immortals were passing through the miasma regional wall.

"Young master, we are almost through the miasma regional wall. This is the final hurdle; once out, they will have fewer chances to attack," an elderly Gu Immortal said solemnly.

Another young-looking Gu Immortal said: "Once through, we are safe. Meeting your mother will repay all this hardship a thousandfold!"

Uncle Zhang smiled: "Don't worry, young master. First supreme elder prepared everything for you in advance. We have an immortal killer move to cleanse your qi, converting you into a Southern Border Gu Immortal. From now on, you can undergo tribulations and absorb heaven and earth qi in Southern Border without issue."

Despite his fame in Eastern Sea, cultivating alone had taught him its hardships and vulnerabilities. Relying on a super force was something he welcomed gladly.

As he pondered this, dragon breath resembling sword light suddenly struck towards his face!

# Chapter 1216: Regional Wall Ambush

The dragon breath was so sharp that needles seemed to prick Wu Yi Hai's face before it even struck.

With a sharp metallic clang, a small golden shield formed before Wu Yi Hai in the nick of time.

The sword light dragon breath struck the golden shield, instantly shattering it as the residual force shot toward Wu Yi Hai's face.

Reacting swiftly, Wu Yi Hai shouted and activated a transformation path killer move.

Light flashed, and Wu Yi Hai was replaced by a huge tortoise.

The dragon breath struck the shell, gouging a deep mark.

"What formidable dragon breath! The horned divine tortoise possesses top-tier shell defense even in Eastern Sea." Wu Yi Hai was shocked: "This enemy is stronger than all previous ambushers! Now it depends on Uncle Zhang and Brother Leng."

As a transformation path Gu Immortal, Wu Yi Hai's horned divine tortoise form was swift underwater, but far slower on land.

While Wu Yi Hai pinned his hopes on them, Uncle Zhang was coughing up blood.

"Inside this regional wall, killer moves are weakened, yet this dragon breath broke my defense and marked the tortoise shell—how terrifying!"

While Uncle Zhang spat blood, Brother Leng flew forward.

In an instant, he transformed into a lightning flash giant wolf.

It charged forward along the trail carved by the dragon breath.

Within a few breaths, Uncle Zhang suppressed his injuries as bright light enveloped him.

Instantly, he became a golden sword teeth tiger twice the size of the lightning flash giant wolf.

Transformation path Gu Immortals held a distinct combat advantage within the five regional walls.

Knowing the tortoise's sturdy defense, Uncle Zhang gave Wu Yi Hai instructions and charged after the lightning flash giant wolf.

Soon, Uncle Zhang saw the lightning flash giant wolf running back!

Streams of sword light dragon breath pursued the wolf as dragon roars echoed through the thick purple miasma.

"Don't fight, retreat." Brother Leng saw the golden tiger and spoke human words.

A sword dragon penetrated the dark purple miasma, appearing before them.

It had silver-white scales, a sky-piercing horn, sharp claws, and the aura of numerous Immortal Gu!

"A wild ancient sword dragon?!" Uncle Zhang stared in disbelief.

The dragon moved through the regional wall as if feeling no resistance or pressure.

Uncle Zhang did not hesitate, he turned around and fled.

Soon, they regrouped with Wu Yi Hai's horned divine tortoise form.

Informed of the situation, Wu Yi Hai transmitted: "Avoid fighting it! It may have been lured here to drain our immortal essence and strength!"

"Retreat while displaying sufficient strength. Once a wild beast realizes prey is tough, it gives up."

Focusing on defense over offense, they let the ancient sword dragon trail behind, spewing sword light dragon breath.

"I have an immortal killer move to pacify the beast, but I must switch forms first."

They agreed that Brother Leng and Uncle Zhang would defend while Wu Yi Hai changed transformations to appease the dragon.

Wu Yi Hai carefully changed back to human form.

Sheltered behind them, he purged his transformation dao marks before activating another killer move.

"Almost ready, my immortal killer move is... uh!" Wu Yi Hai's joy turned into a gasp.

An immortal killer move had just pierced the golden tiger's head, killing Uncle Zhang instantly.

Sword path killer move — Dark Assassination!

The ancient sword dragon accelerated with terrifying speed, flashing like silver lightning.

"We fell for their trap! Oh no!!"

Turning around, he saw Wu Yi Hai's shattered head spilling brain matter. The ancient sword dragon seized the headless corpse and stuffed it into its immortal aperture.

# Chapter 1217: Cultivation Level Rises Again

Brother Leng's eyes nearly popped out in horror.

"How can this be? It has an immortal aperture—it's not wild, but a Gu Immortal's transformation!"

The ancient sword dragon roared as it charged at him.

Inside the regional wall, the giant wolf moved sluggishly, while the unimpeded sword dragon held total initiative.

Spotting a flaw, the sword dragon blasted breath into the giant wolf's stomach.

Pressing its assault, the dragon riddled the wolf with holes, reverting it to human form in death.

The ancient sword dragon swiftly cleaned the battlefield with practiced ease.

Stashing the two corpses into its aperture, the dragon destroyed all traces and flew off.

Instead of returning to Southern Border, the dragon flew east, traversing the miasma and blue water regional walls into Eastern Sea.

Finding a nameless sea area, it placed Wu Yi Hai's aperture there.

Once the blessed land formed and opened, the dragon flew inside.

Wu Yi Hai's blessed land was an ocean inhabited mainly by sea turtles, tortoises, corals, and seagulls.

Soon, the land spirit appeared before the dragon.

The sea turtle land spirit set a rather difficult ownership requirement.

The ancient sword dragon could only leave this blessed land temporarily.

Returning outside and confirming the area was safe, the sword dragon resumed human form.

Who else could it be but Fang Yuan?

From Lady White Rabbit's intelligence, he had learned of Wu Yi Hai's situation.

Though an internal Wu clan dispute, Wu Du Xiu's involvement magnified it into a major affair.

With Wu Yi Hai's route leaked, Fang Yuan acutely sensed a prime opportunity!

Clearly, Wu Yi Hai was an ideal target to disguise as and replace.

First, as an illegitimate son, Wu Yi Hai had no life tablet Gu or soul lantern Gu.

Thus, Fang Yuan killing him would unlikely alert Wu clan.

Second, living as an Eastern Sea lone cultivator, almost no one in Wu clan knew his appearance or habits.

Thus, disguising as him with familiar face carried little risk of exposure for a long time.

He found a deserted island and rested in it.

He spent his resting time modifying the killer move Blood Light Spirit Suppression.

Finally, he created a simplified version centered around Blood Asset Immortal Gu!

Entering Wu Yi Hai's blessed land via the upper extreme heavenly eagle, Fang Yuan subdued the land spirit with Blood Light Spirit Suppression.

With the land spirit subdued, Fang Yuan annexed the blessed land into his sovereign immortal aperture.

This advanced his calamities and tribulations significantly.

Under Fang Yuan's careful preservation, the sea turtle land spirit remained intact and entered his aperture alongside the blessed land.

With this settled, Fang Yuan crossed the regional walls back into Southern Border.

In Southern Border, he placed Brother Leng and Uncle Zhang's apertures, annexing their blessed lands.

Inspecting himself, Fang Yuan found that annexing three rank seven blessed lands had pushed his cultivation past the first grand tribulation.

Next, Fang Yuan did not go to Wu clan immediately.

He soul-searched Wu Yi Hai to learn everything about his life.

Rather than secluding himself, Fang Yuan sought out Lady White Rabbit for further intelligence.

Wu Yi Hai's disappearance had spread throughout Southern Border.

While Wu clan stayed silent, other forces speculated that Wu Yi Hai was dead, though the culprit remained unknown.

Namely, that Wu Yong had murdered his half-brother to seize Wu Du Xiu's inheritance.

Wu Yong chose to remain silent, clarifying nothing.

"Interesting." Fang Yuan sensed deep undercurrents as countless forces and Gu Immortals secretly clashed in this hidden contest.

With Wu Du Xiu dying, rank eight Wu Yong had always lived in her shadow, leaving his abilities widely questioned.

"If I appear now, what will happen?" The thought sent a chill down Fang Yuan's spine.

# Chapter 1218: Du Xiu, Yong

Surveying the situation, Fang Yuan knew it was not yet time for 'Wu Yi Hai' to appear.

First, his search of Wu Yi Hai's soul remained incomplete.

Secondly, Wu Du Xiu was not dead yet.

Who knew what methods Wu Du Xiu possessed to verify her son's identity?

Finally, danger lurked in all righteous path forces, Wu clan included.

Wu Yong had motive and was likely to eliminate Wu Yi Hai.

Just like this, Fang Yuan continued to cultivate.

He continued soul-searching Wu Yi Hai while gathering intelligence on the outside world.

Half a month later, Wu Du Xiu summoned Wu Yong and several Wu clan supreme elders to her residence.

On her deathbed, Wu Du Xiu spoke with unprecedented clarity: "I have three regrets in life."

"First, I failed to exterminate the Seven Fierce Gorge Ghosts, only destroying their den."

"Second, I failed to find enough dry clear qi to refine eight-faced prestige wind Gu."

"The third regret..."

Saying this, Wu Du Xiu paused.

"Is that I never saw my son Yi Hai. Back then I killed his father, but directed that hatred at an innocent child. I wanted to make amends, but it is too late."

Leaning against her headboard, she waved weakly to Wu Yong.

Wu Yong stepped forward and knelt reverently before her.

Wu Du Xiu looked at her eldest son and finally smiled: "Yong Er, you did well, I am not disappointed."

"Entrusting Wu clan to you, I can rest at ease," Wu Du Xiu continued.

"Yi Hai could not come, so I leave these Immortal Gu to you. You cultivate wind path as well; cherish them."

"Mother, I don't want your Immortal Gu, I just want you to live!" Wu Yong sobbed.

"Silly child, who can avoid death? Even mighty Immortal and Demon Venerables die in the end. Eternal life is merely a fool's fantasy."

With that, Wu Du Xiu's Immortal Gu flew from her immortal aperture toward Wu Yong.

Her body shone with white light as countless specks drifted from her shriveled frame.

A moment later, the bed was empty. The legendary rank eight Wu Du Xiu had vanished from the world.

"First supreme elder—!"

Long after, he slowly raised his head, no longer crying, his expression firm as steel.

"Restrain your grief. Mother is gone, but we must continue spreading Wu clan's glory across Southern Border!" Wu Yong's plain tone carried immense authority.

Amidst the heavy atmosphere, the Gu Immortal elders paid respects in unison: "We pay respects to first supreme elder!"

With legendary Wu Du Xiu dead, her rank eight son Wu Yong became Wu clan's next first supreme elder.

News from Wu clan spread across Southern Border's Gu Immortal world at lightning speed.

Qing Yang Mountain.

Two Qiao clan Gu Immortals stood at the peak, gazing toward Wu clan.

Qiao clan's first supreme elder sighed: "Wu Du Xiu is dead, and Wu Yong takes over plagued by rumors of fratricide. This is our opportunity. Everyone thinks we are Wu clan's lackeys, but with them in turmoil, we finally have our chance to act. Our long-term marriage alliances give us the best justification!"

"Wu Yong seems ordinary, but he remains a rank eight Gu Immortal," Qiao Si Liu said.

She was Qiao clan's pride and one of Southern Border's three great fairies.

Qiao clan's first supreme elder laughed: "Liu Er, this is why I called you here. We will continue our marriage alliance with Wu clan."

Qiao Si Liu's body shook: "I understand, I am willing to contribute to the clan."

"Yet if I marry Wu Yong, I cannot sway a rank eight commanding all of Wu clan..." Qiao Si Liu hesitated.

"Not with him." Qiao clan's first supreme elder smiled.

"Then who else?" Qiao Si Liu was visibly confused.

"Wu Yi Hai."

"Wu Yi Hai?"

"That's right, he approached us a few days ago."

Seven days later.

Wu clan held a grand funeral on Divine Wind Mountain.

Righteous path forces, lone immortals, and select demonic experts were all invited.

Before everyone's eyes, Wu Yong suddenly erupted: "Men, capture this clan traitor!"

"What?!" Shocked, Xu Tuo tried to resist, but it was too late.

"Master, what are you doing?! I am your most loyal servant!" Xu Tuo screamed.

Wu Yong sneered, pointing at Xu Tuo: "A loyal servant indeed! You betrayed me, leaking my brother's route to fiends who attacked him. My poor brother was murdered by your wicked cabal before I could even meet him!"

Wu Yong sighed toward the sky, tears streaming down his face.

# Chapter 1229: Love Gu (1/2)

Ren Zu stopped and turned, seeing a snowman run toward him.

The snowman said: "Oh Ren Zu, I finally found you! I am the strongest in my tribe, and I want to disprove the claim that snowmen fear fire. But I heard that there is a fourth type of fire in this world, called the fire of love. Once it burns, it can turn all life forms in this world into cinders. I don't believe it. Hearing you recently obtained love Gu, I came to test it."

"Fire of love?" Ren Zu was surprised, he was hearing it for the first time.

He summoned love Gu and asked: "Oh Gu, can you emit the fire of love?"

Love Gu replied: "I can, and I cannot."

Curious, Ren Zu and the snowman asked: "What do you mean by can and cannot?"

Love Gu explained: "I am necessary, but I alone am not enough—two hearts are required."

"Two hearts?" The snowman grew concerned, pulling her heart from her chest.

The snowman said: "This is my heart of domination; unfortunately, I only have one."

Ren Zu said: "Don't worry, I have a heart too."

Thus, right now, he took out the heart of discontent.

The heart of discontent was dry and weak, its blood spent in Ordinary Abyss to grow the trees of achievement.

Love Gu flew in and out of both the hearts of discontent and domination.

Soaring into the sky, it said: "To summon the fire of love, let these two hearts clash."

The snowman and Ren Zu brought their hearts together.

The sparks grew rapidly, turning into a blazing flame.

The fire of love caught Ren Zu's heart of discontent, instantly reducing it to ashes.

Love Gu said: "Love comes at a price; it demands sacrifice."

The snowman laughed: "Thankfully you have two hearts, Ren Zu, or you would be dead!"

Enveloped by the fire of love, the heart shone ever brighter.

The snowman scoffed: "This fire of love is all show—it lacks the heat, heaviness, and chaos of the other three fires."

Saying so, she returned the heart of domination to her chest.

Instantly, flames engulfed her body, melting her like snow under the sun.

Zhao Lian Yun ignored his reaction, continuing: "We survived because of Love Gu, but the others lacked such protection. Even the Immortal Gu Houses were nearly destroyed, let alone ordinary Gu Immortals. If reinforcements never come, how long do we wait?"

Facing this point, Bu Zhen Zi pondered before replying heavily: "That is possible. But even without immediate reinforcements, Central Continent's ten great ancient sects will dispatch a second wave."

Disregarding his words, she replied: "Even if reinforcements arrive, how long will it take, what price will they pay, and will mishaps strike again? This is Northern Plains, not Central Continent."

Zhao Lian Yun exhaled: "In short, I won't wait any longer."

"You must wait whether you want to or not," Bu Zhen Zi retorted angrily.

Tears welling in her eyes, Zhao Lian Yun looked away: "If Hong Yun is killed in the meantime, what then? Can you guarantee his safety?"

Bu Zhen Zi countered: "Even if you refuse to wait, how will you rescue him? Even if you defeat the other peak lords, Ma Hong Yun is held at the first peak—you must still face Old Ancestor Xue Hu!"

"I know," Zhao Lian Yun clenched her fists, voice sharpening. "Yet as you said, we must get past a dozen other peak lords before reaching him. We can get rid of them first, in any case, rank eight Gu Immortals cannot act against us in this Gu formation! With this, once our reinforcements arrive, we can directly attack the first peak, saving time and energy."

Bu Zhen Zi's expression darkened with rage: "Frankly, this super Gu formation strengthens the enemy and suppresses us. If we leave, it will forcibly scatter us to other peaks. Can you fight alone? Mu Ling Lan and I carried the previous battle; what can three rank sixes like you accomplish?"

After a brief silence, Zhao Lian Yun raised her head: "Then I will use Love Gu again!"

Bu Zhen Zi scoffed: "Do you think you can control Love Gu? Even Giant Sun Immortal Venerable couldn't refine it back then."

"How will I know without trying?" Zhao Lian Yun persisted.

As Bu Zhen Zi started to scoff, Zhao Lian Yun silently prayed: "Love Gu, please show your might and take the five of us to another peak!"

Love Gu did not even budge, as if it was dead.

Unwilling to give up, Zhao Lian Yun continued begging in her heart.

Just as Bu Zhen Zi noticed her stillness and moved to speak, Love Gu's aura surged from her body, cloaking her in brilliant radiance.

The other four immortals watched in wide-eyed shock at the sight.

The swirling light around Zhao Lian Yun then moved on its own, spreading toward the other four Gu Immortals.

The space behind Bu Zhen Zi ruptured into a black hole, its immense suction dragging him inside!

Even as a rank seven Gu Immortal, Bu Zhen Zi was powerless to resist and vanished instantly into the void.

The same phenomenon befell the others, leaving the hall completely empty and silent in the blink of an eye.

"We've left the ninth snowy peak!" Bu Zhen Zi thought in shock, surveying his surroundings as soon as he landed.

He was inside another large hall, but unlike the previous decorated hall with its feminine aura, this one was majestic and grand, radiating masculine vigor.

"Which snowy peak is this?" Bu Zhen Zi wondered.

Suddenly, his expression changed as he cursed: "Damn it!"

He was alone in the hall; the other four Gu Immortals were nowhere to be seen.

He composed himself: I was overthinking things. Otherworldly demon or not, how could Zhao Lian Yun control Love Gu? It remains completely fickle and unpredictable.

Just then, an inky black shadow crept along the floor, launching a silent attack.

Instincts flaring, Bu Zhen Zi leaped back to dodge.

Yet the shadow struck like a viper, lunging toward his feet within a breath.

In the nick of time, Bu Zhen Zi activated his phantom path specialty, turning intangible.

The shadow passed harmlessly through him, landing behind.

# Chapter 1255: Zhao Lian Yun's Death?

Twelfth peak.

Immortal killer move — Life Locking Silver Chain!

"Little girl, you are annoying!" Zhao Da Niu roared, straining his arms to shatter the chains, but no matter how much strength he used, he could not break them.

"Then take this." Zhao Da Niu smiled malevolently, activating rising heaven bull qi.

Zhao Da Niu shattered life locking silver chain with his killer move, regaining his freedom.

Zhao Lian Yun and Shi Zheng Yi were struck by the air wave again, collapsing and coughing blood, unable to stand.

"Damn it!" Shi Zheng Yi tried to climb up, but his body was on the verge of breaking apart.

Her injuries were worse than Shi Zheng Yi's.

Backlash from the shattered life locking silver chain, combined with Zhao Da Niu's immortal killer move, had gravely worsened her injuries.

Darkness.

"This is the feeling of death?"

"Let me just sink. Once I die, I won't have to feel this exhaustion and anguish anymore."

At the crucial moment, love Immortal Gu displayed its might again, instantly killing Zhao Pu!

Northern Plains, in the depths of Earth Trench.

"Ying Wu Xie, where will you hide now?!" Fang Yuan's sword dragon roared in the Earth Trench, his murderous voice resounding everywhere.

From within the darkness, a giant city slowly rose up.

"I have waited quite some time," Ying Wu Xie spoke, his gaze tranquil and tone indifferent.

"Hmph! Shi Nu is dead. You think you four and this mortal Gu house can fight me?" Fang Yuan sneered.

"What if you add me?" A second figure appeared atop Dark Flow Giant City.

It was Shadow Sect's spy in Lang Ya Sect, refinement path Gu Immortal Sixth Hair!

Fang Yuan disregarded Sixth Hair's strength, but both were Lang Ya Sect members bound by an information path alliance agreement.

"Die!" Fang Yuan swung his dragon tail, directly charging forward.

Dark Flow Giant City retreated as a battlefield killer move activated and swarms of yaksha octopuses closed in.

Fang Yuan rampaged forward, but dared not use dragon breath carelessly lest he kill Sixth Hair.

# Chapter 1265: Nightmare Demonic Colts

A large herd of equine desolate beasts galloped toward Fang Yuan.

"Dream path desolate beast nightmare demonic colt!"

Nightmare demonic colts were dream path desolate beasts, so rare in this era that Fang Yuan assumed they had not appeared.

With these nightmare demonic colts, Fang Yuan could use their flesh to refine numerous dream path mortal Gu, and even dream path Immortal Gu!

Unable to capture the beasts alive, Fang Yuan slew them for their corpses.

After slaughtering the beast groups, Fang Yuan took some time to break the battlefield killer move and wreck Dark Flow Giant City.

However, much time had been lost, and Ying Wu Xie's group had already escaped.

Sixth Hair had remained behind, like Shi Nu, to hold back Fang Yuan.

He looked at Fang Yuan fearlessly: "Do you dare kill me?"

"Once I kill Ying Wu Xie, you can wallow in despair." Fang Yuan ignored him and surged out of the trench.

Since Omni-directional Travel could not be used continuously, Fang Yuan caught up to Ying Wu Xie as they fled toward Snowy Mountain blessed land.

Lead soul into dream!

Fang Yuan was hit again.

However, this dream realm was unexpectedly deep; he had to use unravel dream to break free and return to reality.

Ying Wu Xie laughed: "I sacrificed all those nightmare demonic colts earlier. Did you think dream path immortal materials were so easily taken? Take my advice and stop chasing—continue, and you will lose your life even with the upper extreme heavenly eagle."

Inside the dream.

Southern Border, dawn.

The young Fang Yuan was sitting beside a simple bed.

Gu Master Big Beard lay on the bed, already on the verge of death.

"Fang Yuan, thank you for the medicinal herbs," Gu Master Big Beard spoke weakly.

Feeling suffocated by grief, Fang Yuan sobbed: "Uncle Big Beard, you will get better."

Gu Master Big Beard shook his head: "I know my injuries. Don't cry, child, crying is of no use to us."

"This world is too big, while we are too small."

"As a child, I wanted to be a grand hero like those legendary righteous figures. As a youth, a clan leader. In adulthood, I was satisfied becoming a clan elder. Exiled in middle age, I felt living alone was fine so long as I could raise my Gu worms and sustain myself."

"Do you know what I want now?"

Fang Yuan wept softly: "What?"

"I just want to lie quietly in a peaceful room and recall the past until death takes me." Gu Master Big Beard wore a self-mocking expression.

"Then... should I leave?" Fang Yuan asked, at a loss.

"Leave. Let me be alone; I don't want others to see me dying," Gu Master Big Beard said.

Fang Yuan slowly stood up and hesitantly walked to the door.

Gu Master Big Beard spoke again: "You must have read The Legends of Ren Zu, the chapter where the miniman walks out of Ordinary Abyss."

"We are all minimen, and we all want to walk out of Ordinary Abyss."

"You must continue on, Fang Yuan."

"Continue living, continue persevering."

"It is a pity all my Gu were destroyed in battle. This advice is my only gift to you. For minor characters like us, crying is useless and shouting is unheard; we can only persevere on our own."

"Persevere until you accomplish great feats, become extraordinary. Either that, or embrace death."

# Chapter 1266: I love him!

"Did we win?" Zhao Lian Yun struggled with great effort to climb out of the blood pool.

Fortunately, Zhao Pu was dead, and the blood drain immortal killer move afflicting them also dissipated.

Nearby, Yu Yi Ye Zi breathed heavily, leaning against the wall to stand.

Seeing Zhao Lian Yun, the young Gu Immortal was dazed and turned pale: "Lian... Fairy Lian Yun... your face... your body..."

Looking down at herself, the first thing she saw was her hands.

Zhao Lian Yun's heart jolted—she had unknowingly become an elderly woman!

"What's happening?" Zhao Lian Yun was shocked.

Yu Yi Ye Zi said heavily: "It is likely love Gu. Love Gu consumed your lifespan to unleash the terrifying power that killed Zhao Pu outright!"

"Don't worry, as Spirit Affinity House's fairy, the sect will provide lifespan Gu to restore your youth," Yu Yi Ye Zi consoled.

"I will continue going forward!"

"You cannot continue!" Shocked, Yu Yi Ye Zi rushed over and grabbed Zhao Lian Yun's arm.

"Love Gu might consume your lifespan again, and you will die!" Yu Yi Ye Zi urged.

"So what if I die?" The aged Zhao Lian Yun smiled faintly at the young Yu Yi Ye Zi.

He stood in silence, watching her hunched back as she walked out of the hall with heavy, aged steps.

"Fine, I'll follow you—at worst, this life will be paid to you!"

Separated by the fate reversing sacrificial refinement formation, Zhao Lian Yun arrived alone at another snowy peak.

Stepping into the hall, Zhao Lian Yun found it ruined from intense fighting.

"This is Snowy Mountain's eighth peak. I fought its owner, Xiao Fei Fei, and we are both wounded."

"Be careful not to get hit. Her immortal killer move causes the target to continuously lose their memories."

Just as he finished speaking, a strange ray of light struck Zhao Lian Yun's forehead.

"No!" Mu Ling Lan called out. "Each lost memory will surface in your mind first. Defend with Immortal Gu, but do not use killer moves—that is far more dangerous! If you forget a killer move mid-activation, you will suffer severe backlash. Endure until I heal my injuries and recover enough strength to fight!"

She retreated to a corner, protecting herself with Immortal Gu as the killer move took effect.

Memories began to surface in her mind...

Inside Eighty-Eight True Yang Building.

"To think you are an otherworldly demon lurking beside Ma Hong Yun! Daring indeed, but unfortunately... you met me." Giant Sun's will exuded intense killing intent.

But the next moment, Ma Hong Yun stood in front of Zhao Lian Yun.

He spread his arms, shielding Zhao Lian Yun behind him.

"Boy, you dare protect an otherworldly demon?" Giant Sun's will asked, his expression turning ice-cold.

"What otherworldly demon! I only know she is Lady Xiao Yun—without her, I would already be dead!" Ma Hong Yun tried his utmost to defend Zhao Lian Yun.

"No, Lady Xiao Yun is innocent, you must not harm her!" Ma Hong Yun was utterly determined to protect her.

However, Giant Sun's special will disregarded Ma Hong Yun, directly attacking Zhao Lian Yun.

"No—!" In desperate panic, Ma Hong Yun cried out, throwing his arms around Zhao Lian Yun to shield her in his embrace.

In that moment, Zhao Lian Yun realized she had hopelessly fallen in love with foolish Ma Hong Yun.

Then, they started to disappear one by one.

"No, stop it!" Tears filled Zhao Lian Yun's face as she called out with incomparable sorrow.

Xiao Fei Fei's voice transmitted: "Hehehe, struck by my killer move, you will lose your most precious memories. In pain? No matter—the more you forget, the more relaxed you'll feel. You might even smile. Hehehe..."

The memories disappeared, a smile suddenly appeared on Zhao Lian Yun's face.

"Don't smile! This is Xiao Fei Fei's sinister killer move—it kills while you smile. The longer you smile, the more easily you will lose your life," Mu Ling Lan urgently warned.

After long preparation, he unleashed his killer move to devastating effect!

"Ahh! You..." Having exposed herself while attacking Zhao Lian Yun, Xiao Fei Fei was fatally struck unprepared, perishing miserably.

Zhao Lian Yun still wore a smile, but she was no longer dazed.

Two streams of translucent tears dripped down her face.

Aged, with blurry eyes and white hair, she could only transmit her voice with Gu worms.

"What should I do?"

"I have forgotten almost everything about him, even his appearance."

"I only remember his name."

"I only remember...."

"That I love him."

# Chapter 1269: Rank Eight Miniman

"Xue Hu, take this!" Wei Ling Yang pointed his right hand, shooting a grand beam of light toward Old Ancestor Xue Hu.

Rank eight Gu Immortal!

# Chapter 1270: Sub and Main Fate Reversing Sacrificial Refinement Formation

Using an immortal killer move, the miniman called out: "Big, big, big."

He appeared as an unimpressive, disheveled old man, distinct only by messy purple hair that made him resemble a beggar.

"Lady Wan Shou and the rest will follow behind, Central Continent's Gu Immortals further back, and the rank eight experts at the very end."

# Chapter 1271: Implicating Fang Yuan

"If this continues, we will lose this Immortal Gu House and our lives!" Bi Chen Tian gritted his teeth. "We retreat!"

Lacking Immortal Gu Houses of their own, Old Ancestor Xue Hu and Purple Mountain True Monarch could not stop Edge Link Camp from charging away.

The entirety of Snowy Mountain blessed land was rumbling intensely.

With a loud rumble, the snowy peaks began breaking apart.

Snowy Mountain blessed land completely collapsed into a mere framework as winds of assimilation began to blow.

# Chapter 1272: What is that?

After the Battle of Yi Tian Mountain, Fang Yuan had tested this body's limits.

Not just a metal tree, even a metal hill crashing into him would leave him intact.

This was the sovereign immortal body's innate physique, derived from dao marks rather than Gu worms.

"Inside Reverse Flow River, no one can use Gu worms!"

"Meanwhile, my sovereign immortal body is exceptionally sturdy and packed with dao marks."

"Ying Wu Xie!"

He moved his limbs, swimming forward like a swordfish.

As Snowy Mountain collapsed and Reverse Flow River poured out, Fang Yuan did not know Purple Mountain True Monarch had awakened.

Still viewing Old Ancestor Xue Hu as the main enemy, he deduced Ying Wu Xie's ties to Snowy Mountain were tenuous; otherwise, Xue Hu would have assisted during the Battle of Yi Tian Mountain.

But he met Bi Chen Tian.

Sustained in the earlier battle rather than the river, his injuries were hard to heal due to the conflicting dao marks of a rank eight Gu Immortal.

But Bi Chen Tian did not recognize Fang Yuan.

Fang Yuan was in his sovereign body; only his original appearance had been publicized across the five regions by Heavenly Court.

Bi Chen Tian stood on the turtle's shell, warily watching Fang Yuan's movements.

Fang Yuan watched him alertly, keeping his distance.

Despite possessing the sovereign immortal body, Fang Yuan knew better than to think he was the strongest in Reverse Flow River.

Given rank eight Gu Immortals' deep foundations, Fang Yuan did not want to fight Bi Chen Tian for now.

"You are a Central Continent Gu Immortal?"

"I am a Northern Plains Gu Immortal with a grudge against Old Ancestor Xue Hu."

Bi Chen Tian's frown eased slightly: "Old Ancestor Xue Hu is also my enemy."

Bi Chen Tian remained vague, offering Fang Yuan little intelligence.

Knowing he could learn nothing more from Bi Chen Tian, Fang Yuan decided to leave.

A fist-sized object washed down the river, landing on Fang Yuan's face.

Soft and tiny like a jellyfish, it stuck to Fang Yuan's forehead.

"What is this?" Stunned, Fang Yuan moved to pull it away.

Just then, Bi Chen Tian shouted: "Be gentle, don't crush it!"

"Oh?" Fang Yuan was surprised, wondering what could make a rank eight Gu Immortal nervous.

# Chapter 1273: Affection Immortal Gu

This was an Immortal Gu.

"This Immortal Gu seems to be... affection Gu?" With his broad knowledge, Fang Yuan quickly deduced what Gu it was.

Bi Chen Tian grew anxious—affection Gu was crucial to Central Continent's Gu Immortals.

Unlike fragile Gu that shattered on impact, affection Gu's soft body allowed it to survive collisions.

Its jellyfish body was battered, bearing a terrifying injury covering nearly a quarter of its size.

Bi Chen Tian suppressed his anxiety, cupping his fists: "Friend, this Gu belongs to Central Continent. Hand it over, and you will gain Central Continent's friendship."

Fang Yuan squinted: "I can consider that, but you must tell me what Gu this is."

Bi Chen Tian answered: "This is affection Gu, a wisdom path Gu worm."

Thus, he placed affection Immortal Gu into his shirt pocket.

Unable to open his immortal aperture inside Reverse Flow River, he had to carry it with him.

Seeing this, Bi Chen Tian's heart sank: "Friend! Return that Immortal Gu! We are not enemies; we can trade according to our needs."

Fang Yuan looked at Bi Chen Tian: "We can trade, but not here."

# Chapter 1274: Fighting Rank Eight in the River

Bi Chen Tian was prone to anticipating worst outcomes; seeing Fang Yuan would not yield the Immortal Gu, his killing intent rose!

"I am a rank eight Gu Immortal; even without Immortal Gu, how could my dao mark foundation lose to a rank seven?"

Thinking this, Bi Chen Tian plunged into the river, swimming toward Fang Yuan.

Sneering internally, Fang Yuan charged toward Bi Chen Tian as well.

Despite the raging torrent, both had extraordinary bodies and quickly met in the middle.

Fang Yuan weaponized his entire body, striking with his head, knees, elbows, and varied jabs.

Though forced onto the back foot, Bi Chen Tian relied on his formidable foundation and resurfacing close-combat skills to fight Fang Yuan to a standstill.

"This rank eight Gu Immortal's foundation is truly profound. Wanting to kill a rank eight in Reverse Flow River was wishful thinking."

"How can this be? This person is on par with me?!"

Though undefeated, his primary goal was eliminating the grave threat, Ying Wu Xie.

"Even if I cannot win, I must pin him here. When my companions arrive, we can encircle him together. I cannot let him escape!"

"In that case, don't blame me for being ruthless!" Fang Yuan's eyes flashed coldly.

Hit by the strike, Bi Chen Tian gasped, sending bubbles floating upward.

Fang Yuan clamped his arms onto him like pincers, dragging Bi Chen Tian down.

Bi Chen Tian instantly swam until he was directly above Fang Yuan.

# Chapter 1275: Kicking a Rank Eight Great Expert

His grasp having failed, Fang Yuan raised his arms and grabbed upward.

His left arm missed, but his right seized Bi Chen Tian's leg.

Obstructed, Bi Chen Tian lashed his other leg toward Fang Yuan's head like a fierce dragon.

Fang Yuan promptly raised affection Immortal Gu in defense.

Bi Chen Tian wanted to curse, his leg stopped.

Gaining a moment to react, Fang Yuan jerked his head back and inverted his body in the water.

In the next moment, Fang Yuan's eyes flashed; he blocked Bi Chen Tian's kick with one leg while driving his other into a vital spot.

"Ah!"

Fang Yuan's kick landed squarely on Bi Chen Tian's crotch.

His face instantly stiffened and his eyes bulged, nearly gasping out his last remaining oxygen.

As a rank eight great expert with superhuman endurance, Bi Chen Tian forcefully endured the pain and paddled toward the surface.

Fang Yuan kicked again.

With a flushed face and bloodshot eyes, Bi Chen Tian abandoned surfacing and sought only to kill Fang Yuan!

"Who would fight you to the death?" Fang Yuan let go, kicking Bi Chen Tian away.

The recoil pushed Fang Yuan back, creating distance from Bi Chen Tian.

Once freed, a dazed Bi Chen Tian gave up on Fang Yuan and swam to the surface to catch his breath.

Having escaped Bi Chen Tian, Fang Yuan slowed down to recover stamina.

He continued to swim ahead, trying to find Ying Wu Xie.

"Fang Yuan, is that you?"

At the mention of Purple Mountain True Monarch, Tai Bai Yun Sheng showed admiration: "Yes, we should meet up with master."

He was sitting on Old Ancestor Xue Hu's shoulder.

Old Ancestor Xue Hu swam, scanning around to find something in Reverse Flow River.

Hearing Purple Mountain True Monarch's words, he snorted: "You do nothing yet complain? Don't you have wings? Why don't you fly out of Reverse Flow River?"

Just as Fang Yuan had reverted from dragon form, Purple Mountain True Monarch—a rank eight miniman Gu Immortal—became a miniman again inside Reverse Flow River.

"You think I don't want to? But Reverse Flow River is affected by some power and is very chaotic; I cannot leave. Hehe, who created this Gu formation for you?" Purple Mountain True Monarch asked.

"It must be him, beyond my expectations," Old Ancestor Xue Hu said. "He is a member of Longevity Heaven!"

Purple Mountain True Monarch said: "Longevity Heaven is definitely after Ma Hong Yun and Zhao Lian Yun. They must be in front."

"I need to find my wife!" Old Ancestor Xue Hu said.

Purple Mountain True Monarch patted his shoulder: "Then we must push forward. Lady Wan Shou was beside Ma Hong Yun when swept away by the river; she should be near them."

Black Extremity remained at the formation's center, manipulating it to direct Reverse Flow River, while Flood Extremity guarded outside, preventing intruders from approaching the light pillar.

# Chapter 1276: Perseverance of the Miniman

Black Extremity shook his head: "This is not control. The fate reversing sacrificial refinement formation merely dug a channel for Reverse Flow River. By digging the riverbed, we can only influence its course."

Black Extremity instructed further: "When collecting Reverse Flow River, open your immortal aperture to receive the flow. As a water path Gu Immortal, you have a big advantage."

Flood Extremity worried: "What if Reverse Flow River changes direction? Are there truly no Gu worms in this world that can control it?"

"You know The Legends of Ren Zu. It states that Ren Zu sighed, lamenting that as long as he had that Immortal Gu, he could conquer Reverse Flow River."

"You mean perseverance Immortal Gu? Impossible, it has never appeared. In my opinion, that story merely tells us to persevere in cultivation and never give up."

The Legends of Ren Zu, chapter four, section twenty-six —

Ren Zu's daughter, Boundless Forest Samsara, was trapped inside Ordinary Abyss.

She befriended a miniman, who brought Boundless Forest Samsara to see his home—City Well.

"I have decided, I will work hard and get out of this abyss to reunite with father!" Boundless Forest Samsara raised her fists, resolute.

The miniman was overjoyed: "Sure! I also want to leave Ordinary Abyss and see the outside world. With so many trees here, we can chop them down to build a ladder and climb out."

Boundless Forest Samsara gasped at the miniman: "Miniman, don't you have wings? Why can't you fly out?"

The miniman smiled bitterly: "Human, my wings are flimsy and weak, carrying me only short distances. Even when leaving City Well, I used a ladder."

Over the following days, she joined the miniman in chopping trees to build ladders.

Trees were chopped down one by one, wisdom Gu flew out from them.

Boundless Forest Samsara was shocked: "Wisdom Gu, why are you here?"

"Wisdom is hidden in the ordinary, of course I can be here." Wisdom Gu answered.

Wisdom Gu added: "To leave Ordinary Abyss, each of you must build and complete your own ladder alone; otherwise, you cannot leave."

As the ladders grew taller, Boundless Forest Samsara's soon surpassed the miniman's.

Boundless Forest Samsara teased: "Miniman, the ladder I build in half a day matches what you make in half a month. At this rate, when will you ever finish a ladder to escape Ordinary Abyss?"

The miniman said helplessly: "I am doing my best, but carrying this wood takes me half a day, while you carry it with one hand. It takes me ages to fell a small tree, but only three swings for you. I am already exerting all my effort."

Trees fell one by one, from within, strength Gu flew out.

Boundless Forest Samsara was shocked: "Oh strength Gu, why are you here?"

"Strength is hidden in the ordinary, of course I can be here." Strength Gu answered.

Boundless Forest Samsara thought and asked: "Strength Gu, can you give us advice like wisdom Gu?"

Strength Gu answered: "I have no advice, but I can grant you great strength if you give me your youth."

Boundless Forest Samsara thought about it and nodded: "You are right, strength Gu, I will rely on you."

Obtaining strength Gu, Boundless Forest Samsara built her ladder at great speed, felling multiple trees at once. A year later, her ladder was extremely tall.

Descending the ladder, Boundless Forest Samsara laughed: "Miniman, stop wasting your effort. Lacking strength, you won't finish that ladder even in a lifetime. You might as well use this time to enjoy life."

"Compared to other minimen, you are already amazing for leaving City Well—you should just enjoy life now."

The miniman shook his head: "I refuse to settle for the ordinary. To be discontent with being ordinary turns it into an abyss; I must escape. Even if I fail, I must try with all my might, or I will not be happy."

Thus, the miniman continued building his ladder.

The third year passed.

Boundless Forest Samsara sighed, she felt lonely.

When the wind blew, she shuddered, feeling cold.

Strength Gu asked: "Look at the miniman, giving his all and never stopping. If you continue being lazy, he will surpass you one day."

Boundless Forest Samsara laughed: "How is that possible? One day of work for me is a month of his. How could he ever surpass me?"

Like this, years passed without stopping.

One day, the miniman approached Boundless Forest Samsara resting under a tree: "Friend, my ladder has reached the edge of Ordinary Abyss. Tomorrow, I will step out and leave Ordinary Abyss."

Boundless Forest Samsara laughed: "Oh miniman, don't lie to me, this is too funny."

The miniman shook his head seriously: "Only an inch separates the laughable from the grand. I am grand now, and can finally leave Ordinary Abyss. Watch as I depart."

Thus, the miniman started to climb his ladder.

Boundless Forest Samsara watched in shock; the miniman was truly at the abyss's edge, ready to escape.

Boundless Forest Samsara shouted: "Oh miniman, do you not feel cold?"

The miniman replied: "Of course, but I must build my ladder and climb out."

Boundless Forest Samsara shouted again: "Oh miniman, do you not feel lonely?"

The miniman replied: "Of course, but I must build my ladder and climb out."

Boundless Forest Samsara shouted again: "Oh miniman, do you not feel afraid?"

The miniman replied: "Of course, but I must build my ladder and climb out."

After those three lines, bright light flashed across his body, rapidly coalescing into a Gu worm.

"My name is Perseverance. Miniman, thank you for giving me life," Perseverance Gu thanked him.

The miniman laughed: "Great! Though I lack strength, I possess perseverance."

So speaking, the miniman climbed out of Ordinary Abyss into the outside world.

It was Ren Zu.

Seeing the miniman, Ren Zu sighed: "Is this perseverance Gu? What a pity—had I possessed it, I could have conquered Reverse Flow River."

# Chapter 1277: Meeting of Ma and Zhao

Flood Extremity believed perseverance Gu existed only in The Legends of Ren Zu.

Black Extremity shook his head: "Perseverance Immortal Gu is no myth; it truly existed before."

"The one who refined perseverance Immortal Gu was Genesis Lotus Immortal Venerable. He entered the door of life and death, brought Reverse Flow River into the world, and became its first owner."

Inside the fate reversing refinement sub-formation, several mortal Gu exploded.

Disrupted by the sudden tremor, a nervous Flood Extremity asked: "Part of the Gu formation was destroyed—aren't you repairing it?"

Black Extremity shook his head: "The sub-formation cannot endure Reverse Flow River's might and will be destroyed. Furthermore, once activated, it cannot be repaired."

Flood Extremity frowned deeply: "Reverse Flow River has not reached here yet, what do we do now?"

"Every ten percent destroyed reduces our influence. The rear section will return to normal, displaying its original might to wash away everything behind," Black Extremity explained.

"Incredible!" Flood Extremity clapped, his eyes shining. "With Ma Hong Yun and Zhao Lian Yun at the front, they will be the last to be washed away."

Inside Reverse Flow River.

"Lord Bi Chen Tian!" Three Central Continent Gu Immortals greeted Bi Chen Tian.

"Lord, he is not in our records—is he an ally or foe?" someone asked.

"He is a strong foe. Be very careful if you meet him—I only fought him to a draw in physical brawling."

"With our superior numbers, swimming upstream to eliminate our enemies along Reverse Flow River would be the best outcome!" Bi Chen Tian declared, killing intent surging.

"Hmm? What is going on?" A water path Gu Immortal among the Central Continent group suddenly sensed a change in the river.

The Central Continent Gu Immortals then saw the turbulent waters around them rapidly calm down.

"How can this be?" Caught off-guard, several Central Continent Gu Immortals were swept away, instantly ending up three hundred steps from Bi Chen Tian.

"Quick, swim, do not stop for a moment! Reverse Flow River has returned to normal; if we stop, the currents will sweep us away!" he called out.

"The higher we swim up Reverse Flow River, the harder every step becomes! We must persevere; we do not need to reach the upper river, only kill any enemies we encounter. If we kill even one rank eight Gu Immortal, we will secure victory later!" Bi Chen Tian rallied their morale.

Fang Yuan swam onward, continuing his pursuit of Ying Wu Xie, but found no trace.

However, he found many Gu Immortals, including Central Continent immortals and Snowy Mountain's peak lords.

Swimming with all his strength, Fang Yuan moved agilely like a fish, his sovereign immortal body granting him incredible stamina and recovery speed.

Zhao Lian Yun was a false immortal created with a phantom aperture, she had low foundation and barely any dao marks. Without Gu worms, she was as weak as a mortal.

Covered in water path dao marks, Mu Ling Lan breathed freely underwater and swam adeptly, protecting Zhao Lian Yun and resolving crises as he pulled her forward.

"Look, there's a mound ahead!" Mu Ling Lan's eyes shone, spotting a mound floating in the river.

"It's made of float soil—we'll rest there!" Mu Ling Lan dragged Zhao Lian Yun onto the floating mound.

"Wait, someone is on the mound!" Mu Ling Lan stood with a ruthless expression.

"Calm down, calm down!" A figure walked out from the mound's forest.

Zhao Lian Yun was frozen like a statue.

The person appearing before them was Ma Hong Yun!

While the immortals were in terrible shape, Ma Hong Yun wore clean clothes, chewing a half-eaten fruit.

Ma Hong Yun took a step back: "Are you also here to capture me?"

Zhao Lian Yun struggled to her feet, standing shakily.

She looked at Ma Hong Yun, throat moving soundlessly—she had relied on Gu worms to speak, but none functioned inside Reverse Flow River.

She was an elderly woman now, with white hair, deeply wrinkled skin, and a frame dry as a twig.

Lowering her head, she dared not meet Ma Hong Yun's gaze.

As Zhao Lian Yun hesitated, Ma Hong Yun called out: "You, you are Lady Xiao Yun?"

Raising her head, she saw Ma Hong Yun toss his fruit aside and run toward her.

"Lady Xiao Yun, Lady Xiao Yun! I miss you so much!" Ma Hong Yun shouted loudly.

# Chapter 1278: Dog Tail Life Extending Ferret

"This Gu formation is quite interesting." A voice suddenly entered Flood Extremity's ears.

"Who is it?!" Shocked, Flood Extremity released his Gu Immortal aura, preparing his methods.

Unimaginably powerful, the entity completely suppressed Flood Extremity before he could even react!

"You are master's descendant; as long as you don't attack, I won't eat you. Hehehe," the voice added.

A massive, hill-like beast then revealed itself before Flood Extremity.

South Desolation Immortal sent a message: this giant beast was dispatched to crush any enemies obstructing Longevity Heaven!

"You, you are the dog tail life extending ferret? Ancestor Giant Sun's steed?" Flood Extremity stammered.

The giant beast nodded and spoke: "Stop calling me a steed, I have a name. I am Mao Li Qiu; call me Grandpa Mao."

"Forget this Gu formation. Let's retrieve Ma Hong Yun and love Gu!" Mao Li Qiu slashed its claws.

Intense winds blew, countless Gu worm auras were exposed, forming an immortal killer move.

The fate reversing refinement sub-formation Black Extremity painstakingly built shattered into rubble.

"Stop stammering! Do you enjoy waking me? Finish this quickly, your Grandpa Mao needs to sleep!"

This breath flew rapidly, tying up Flood Extremity and Black Extremity.

The giant ferret leaped into the sky.

"Reverse Flow River returned to normal?" Fang Yuan's eyes gleamed as the river's pressure intensified.

"The situation looks bad." Having not found Ying Wu Xie's gang, Fang Yuan pressed forward.

Bi Chen Tian could hold on, but the other Central Continent Gu Immortals drifted downstream, exiting Reverse Flow River to take to the skies.

Bi Chen Tian soon found Fang Yuan, who was inside Reverse Flow River.

"Our fight can be set aside if you hand over affection Immortal Gu," Bi Chen Tian told Fang Yuan.

"Before worrying about me, you should worry about yourselves. This isn't Central Continent," Fang Yuan replied fearlessly.

His core concern struck, Bi Chen Tian's face darkened; ignoring Fang Yuan, he began moving upstream.

With the sub-formation destroyed by the dog tail life extending ferret, the river's surface became clear and easily observable.

Mu Ling Lan, Zhao Lian Yun, and Ma Hong Yun were at the front.

The second group were Old Ancestor Xue Hu, Purple Mountain True Monarch, and Lady Wan Shou.

The third group comprised rank eight Gu Immortal Wei Ling Yang and other Central Continent Gu Immortals.

The fourth group consisted of Ying Wu Xie's gang and several Snowy Mountain peak lords.

The fifth group was Fang Yuan alone, lagging behind as he swam upstream against competitors pushing just as hard.

"Quick, swim forward!" Mu Ling Lan urged anxiously, seeing Old Ancestor Xue Hu and Purple Mountain True Monarch close behind.

"Quickly look, to the back!" Hei Lou Lan suddenly alerted.

Ying Wu Xie looked back, heart jumping: "He chased us even here!"

With the river calm and cleared of debris, Ying Wu Xie easily spotted Fang Yuan.

Seeing Ying Wu Xie, Fang Yuan's eyes shone as he swam even faster toward him.

"Is he an enemy?" A Snowy Mountain peak lord sneered at Fang Yuan. "Let's kill him together! Outside, he has numerous Gu Immortal methods, but here, he is completely alone!"

Killing Fang Yuan now and obtaining his sovereign immortal body would be an immense opportunity.

"However... the sovereign immortal body isn't simple. I must meet Lord Purple first!" Ying Wu Xie chose to play it safe.

"Come, let's meet Ancestor Xue Hu. Our greatest enemy is Central Continent." Without exposing Fang Yuan's foundation, Ying Wu Xie diverted their attention.

"Ma Hong Yun... you cannot escape." Old Ancestor Xue Hu gazed coldly while Lady Wan Shou smiled.

"I've finally caught up, you little rats." Old Ancestor Xue Hu reached right behind Zhao Lian Yun's group.

Knowing her strength was exhausted, Zhao Lian Yun realized continuing would only burden Ma Hong Yun.

Giving Ma Hong Yun a final loving look, she mustered her strength, broke free, and swam toward Old Ancestor Xue Hu instead.

# Chapter 1279: Fervently Approaching Death!

"Mu Ling Lan!" Behind Old Ancestor Xue Hu, Wei Ling Yang shouted angrily.

Mu Ling Lan gritted his teeth, shoving Zhao Lian Yun into Ma Hong Yun's arms.

"You have to live well!"

Saying this, he turned around and grabbed Old Ancestor Xue Hu's waist.

Despite struggling violently, Old Ancestor Xue Hu was halted and pushed back by the river.

"Quick, go!" Ma Hong Yun held Zhao Lian Yun, his heart pounding rapidly.

"Meddlesome fool!" Infuriated, Old Ancestor Xue Hu repeatedly kicked Mu Ling Lan's chest in the water.

Broken-boned, Mu Ling Lan spat blood, dyeing the water crimson.

A dozen breaths later, Mu Ling Lan ceased breathing, his life ended.

"Central Continent will remember your sacrifice!" Wei Ling Yang shouted, charging at Old Ancestor Xue Hu.

Stalled by Mu Ling Lan, Old Ancestor Xue Hu fell back to the third group.

The furious Central Continent Gu Immortals immediately attacked him.

Clashing briefly, both sides drifted backward and soon collided with Ying Wu Xie's fourth group.

Consequently, numerous Gu Immortals fought in the river in absolute chaos.

"Where is our lord?" Ying Wu Xie called loudly upon finding Old Ancestor Xue Hu amidst the chaos.

Purple Mountain True Monarch had already swum upstream to capture Ma Hong Yun and Zhao Lian Yun.

Ying Wu Xie quickly swam away with his group toward Purple Mountain True Monarch.

Fang Yuan called out: "Ying Wu Xie, where are you going?"

Ying Wu Xie, Hei Lou Lan, and Bai Ning Bing managed to escape.

Fang Yuan's powerful strikes soon left Tai Bai Yun Sheng fractured and broken.

Yet the resolute Tai Bai Yun Sheng clung tightly to stall Fang Yuan, biting and headbutting desperately.

In this urgent situation, he exclaimed: "Old Bai, do you still remember Imperial Court blessed land?"

Tai Bai Yun Sheng was stunned, he exposed a flaw.

Eyes gleaming ruthlessly, Fang Yuan mercilessly drove his fingers into Tai Bai Yun Sheng's eyes.

Seizing the opening, Fang Yuan delivered a fatal blow; Tai Bai Yun Sheng stopped moving entirely.

"Hmph!" Fang Yuan shoved Tai Bai Yun Sheng's corpse aside and resumed chasing Ying Wu Xie.

Meanwhile, the fierce battle between Old Ancestor Xue Hu and Wei Ling Yang's groups finally ended, both sides suffering heavy losses.

Without any choice, Bi Chen Tian could only approach Fang Yuan.

"Protect the two in front, and you'll earn the friendship of Central Continent and Heavenly Court!"

"This again..." Fang Yuan heard this and sighed internally.

Fang Yuan kept swimming silently, bent on eliminating Ying Wu Xie's gang.

But what followed was a long stalemate.

Stamina and dao marks were secondary to this test of willpower.

"Lady Xiao Yun, persevere! I believe there will be a chance!" Ma Hong Yun urged, encouraging Zhao Lian Yun.

"Catching them will let me force Old Ancestor Xue Hu to deal with Southern Border's dream realm," Purple Mountain plotted.
