Heavily injured, Lady Wan Shou finally lost consciousness.

Old Ancestor Xue Hu was flustered.

Gritting his teeth, Xue Hu let Reverse Flow River sweep them away.

Exiting Reverse Flow River, Old Ancestor Xue Hu immediately used Gu Immortal methods to stabilize Lady Wan Shou.

Bi Chen Tian was nervous; he could not face Old Ancestor Xue Hu alone.

"I will kill you first!" Old Ancestor Xue Hu carefully placed the unconscious Lady Wan Shou in his immortal aperture.

Next, he charged at Bi Chen Tian.

"At worst, it's death." Resigned to die, Bi Chen Tian stood his ground without dodging.

Just as the two rank eights were about to fight, an overwhelmingly powerful aura surged.

Carrying Flood Extremity and Black Extremity, the hill-like purple ferret arrived at Reverse Flow River's bank.

# Chapter 1280: Perseverance

Outside Reverse Flow River.

As Old Ancestor Xue Hu moved to kill Bi Chen Tian, the dog tail life extending ferret, Mao Li Qiu, appeared.

This ferret was Giant Sun Immortal Venerable's steed, subdued in his later years.

Old Ancestor Xue Hu's gaze focused on Black Extremity.

He sneered coldly: "As expected, Sun Ming Lu, you are from Longevity Heaven! To think Longevity Heaven targeted me so long ago."

Black Extremity greeted Old Ancestor Xue Hu respectfully: "We meet again. Sun Ming Lu was merely my alias in Northern Plains."

Old Ancestor Xue Hu understood the crux lay within Reverse Flow River, not their standoff.

"Grandpa Mao, the two in front are our targets!" Black Extremity reminded the ferret.

Mao Li Qiu nonchalantly curled its lips with a human-like expression: "No rush! Let them decide a victor. Outside Reverse Flow River, our Gu worms cannot affect the river itself. I would not do something so time consuming and pointless!"

"The further they swim, the harsher the test of will. Thoughts of perseverance are reversed until the river sweeps them away."

Inside the river.

Purple Mountain True Monarch was second, closing in.

"I must persevere and capture those two to control Old Ancestor Xue Hu and deal with Central Continent!"

"Ninety thousand years ago, I sealed myself in purple-gold rock, yet heaven's will still afflicted me with bouts of madness."

Purple Mountain True Monarch's eyes were shining, he was extremely close to the two.

"Ah——!" But right then, Purple Mountain True Monarch clutched his head and screamed, writhing in intense agony.

"At this very moment, damn it!" Ying Wu Xie internally cursed heaven's will.

At the crucial moment, Purple Mountain True Monarch succumbed to madness, drifting downstream with the current.

Grabbing the mad Purple Mountain True Monarch, Ying Wu Xie's group swam upstream together.

Though countless thoughts were washed away, one remained deeply rooted in Wei Ling Yang's mind!

"I am Central Continent's sole remaining hope. If we capture Ma Hong Yun and save Zhao Lian Yun, we will return victorious!"

Fang Yuan stared at Ying Wu Xie: "That mad miniman Gu Immortal must belong to Shadow Sect. This river is my chance to eliminate them!"

# Chapter 1281: Washed Away

Reverse Flow River acted like a torrential tide, subverting every advance.

In the past, even Ren Zu failed in Reverse Flow River; now, these Gu Immortals were repeating his struggle.

"Damn it, I can't go on!" Reaching his limit, Yu Yi Ye Zi could endure no more and was washed away by the tides.

Soon, only rank eight Wei Ling Yang remained among the Central Continent Gu Immortals.

Swimming forward, Ma Hong Yun choked on river water and was nearly swept away.

At the crucial moment, Zhao Lian Yun supported Ma Hong Yun and steadied him.

Upstream, the river grew shallower, but its reflective power against willpower and mental energy became even stronger.

"Hong Yun, we cannot be separated anymore."

"No matter how bad it gets, I must persevere. Every minute and second spent fighting alongside him brings me unparalleled bliss!"

"Even my immortal zombie body is feeling tired?" Ying Wu Xie smiled bitterly.

Perched on his head, Purple Mountain True Monarch pulled Ying Wu Xie's hair maniacally.

"Lord Purple is mad; I cannot leave him—I am Shadow Sect's only hope."

"Even if I die of exhaustion, I cannot give up. Only by capturing Zhao Lian Yun and Ma Hong Yun can I stall until Lord Purple awakens!"

Bai Ning Bing gritted her teeth, her chest heaving.

"Hehehe," she gave a light laugh, her face contorted with excitement.

"This is truly exciting!"

"In Reverse Flow River, I have experienced unprecedented thrill—the path Ren Zu walked!"

"Even if I fail, the trip was worth it; even if I die, this life was worthwhile!"

Hei Lou Lan was filled with anger.

"How can I stop here?"

"Mother, I have not avenged you yet!"

Hei Lou Lan was trembling, she was showing indomitable willpower.

Exhausted, Bai Ning Bing and Hei Lou Lan were washed away.

"There is still hope!" Old Ancestor Xue Hu's hopes now rested entirely on Ying Wu Xie.

"Ah! The glory of Heavenly Court..." Reaching his limit, Wei Ling Yang sighed aloud and was reluctantly swept away by Reverse Flow River.

"Is it finally ending? Ying Wu Xie, die!" Fang Yuan shouted internally, having waited all along for this moment.

He collided heavily with Ying Wu Xie.

Consequently, Fang Yuan, Ying Wu Xie, and Purple Mountain were swept downstream together.

Sovereign immortal body versus the strength path immortal zombie.

Ying Wu Xie was disadvantaged, suffering bone fractures from Fang Yuan's strikes.

Yet an immortal zombie body was already dead; its sole weakness was the brain, not even the heart.

Knowing an immortal zombie's weakness, Fang Yuan attacked, but Ying Wu Xie protected his skull.

Once Fang Yuan was swept out of Reverse Flow River, Ying Wu Xie could counterattack.

Fang Yuan needed to kill both foes before exiting Reverse Flow River.

# Chapter 1282: Surpassing Ren Zu?

Fighting in water severely hindered Fang Yuan's consecutive attacks.

"Hmph!" Unable to land a decisive blow, Fang Yuan switched targets to Purple Mountain True Monarch in Ying Wu Xie's arms.

Then Fang Yuan shifted targets again, poking at Ying Wu Xie's eyes.

Purple Mountain True Monarch suddenly rose and lunged at Fang Yuan's face.

Fang Yuan easily defended himself, grabbing Purple Mountain True Monarch to crush him.

Yet slippery as an eel from dense wisdom path dao marks, Purple Mountain squirmed free.

Purple Mountain True Monarch then grabbed Ying Wu Xie's shirt and swam desperately, breaking free from Fang Yuan.

Overjoyed to see clarity in Purple Mountain's eyes, Ying Wu Xie knew his lord had regained sanity!

"Quickly leave!" Purple Mountain True Monarch carried Ying Wu Xie downstream, rapidly escaping.

"Lord Purple!" Ying Wu Xie realized what happened as Purple Mountain True Monarch promptly lapsed back into madness.

"Who is this Northern Plains Gu Immortal that dares foil my plan?" Old Ancestor Xue Hu seethed with killing intent toward Fang Yuan.

Hei Lou Lan could not expose Fang Yuan's identity, stating instead: "He is Liu Guan Yi."

"Liu Guan Yi? The demonic path Gu Immortal who killed Ye Lui Qun Xing and cultivates the ancient sword dragon transformation?" Old Ancestor Xue Hu asked, stunned.

"If I leave Reverse Flow River, these three rank eights will attack, leaving little hope of escape."

"Capturing Ma and Zhao will give me the best bargaining chips to negotiate with all three rank eight forces!"

He swam upstream, charging towards the two of them.

Seeing Fang Yuan approaching as the only ones ahead of him, Ma and Zhao recognized his obvious hostility.

"Hmm?" At this time, Zhao Lian Yun's expression suddenly changed.

While swimming, her legs had touched the ground.

Subconsciously finding her footing, she stood up in Reverse Flow River, head and shoulders rising above the water.

Mao Li Qiu yawned: "Ignorant fools! Upstream gets shallower. Ren Zu tried to walk out, failing only at the final step."

"Will Ma Hong Yun and Zhao Lian Yun achieve what Ren Zu could not, forcefully breaking out of Reverse Flow River from the front?!"

While Fang Yuan was still swimming after them, Ma Hong Yun and Zhao Lian Yun were already walking through the river.

Supporting each other, Ma Hong Yun and Zhao Lian Yun staggered forward with determination.

As the turbulent currents subsided and Ma Hong Yun and Zhao Lian Yun neared the river's end, everyone held their breath in anticipation.

# Chapter 1283: Immemorial Secrets of Reverse Flow River

"Am I going to fail... No, until the final moment, I still have a chance!"

For ahead, Ma Hong Yun held Zhao Lian Yun's hand, taking the final step.

His left leg remained in the shallow water while his right foot hung in the air.

Ma Hong Yun took a step forward!

He stepped on water.

"Why is there water?" Ma Hong Yun was stunned, Zhao Lian Yun was also dazed.

They saw clearly that as Ma Hong Yun took the final step, the river water extended forward slightly.

"Hahaha!" Mao Li Qiu burst out laughing: "Look at your faces—too funny!"

"Reverse Flow River itself is like this!"

He shouted to Ma and Zhao: "Walk slowly, don't rush! As long as you maintain your pace, you can stay in Reverse Flow River!"

Compared to Ma and Zhao's crawling pace, Fang Yuan advanced swiftly.

Soon, he too stood on the riverbed, barely a hundred steps away from Ma and Zhao.

Old Ancestor Xue Hu called out: "Very good, Liu Guan Yi! Capture them and I will grant any request. You are wanted by both the Liu and Ye Lui tribes, but hand them over and I will be your ally! Anyone who tries to deal with you will have to face me, Xue Hu!"

Wei Ling Yang chimed in: "Liu Guan Yi, we represent Central Continent and Heavenly Court. If you protect them, you can join Central Continent; we will modify your immortal aperture to adapt to Central Continent's heaven and earth qi, making you a true Central Continent Gu Immortal! For this merit, Central Continent will reward you with several or even ten times whatever Old Ancestor Xue Hu offers!"

"Hmph! Liu Guan Yi, though you lack Huang Jin blood, protect Ma Hong Yun and Zhao Lian Yun and hand them to Longevity Heaven, and we will make you an external supreme elder! Joining Longevity Heaven grants unthinkable benefits: you will enter Northern Plains' righteous path, your warrants will vanish, and all Huang Jin tribes will welcome you," Flood Extremity added.

# Chapter 1284: Ma Hong Yun's Death

Despite attractive offers from all three sides, Fang Yuan did not immediately respond.

Only by capturing Ma and Zhao would he gain leverage to negotiate with the three forces.

"I must live, I want to be with Hong Yun!" Zhao Lian Yun sobbed inwardly, struggling through every difficult step as she inched forward.

"I'm here, Xiao Yun..." Deathly pale, Ma Hong Yun held her arm, teetering on the verge of collapse.

"Where are you two going?" Fang Yuan's voice sounded behind Ma Hong Yun.

Fang Yuan's hands were already on Ma Hong Yun and Zhao Lian Yun's shoulders.

"No—!" Ma Hong Yun shouted loudly, shoving Zhao Lian Yun aside and charging at Fang Yuan.

In a blur of motion, Fang Yuan swiftly subdued and immobilized both.

As Ma and Zhao struggled intensely, Fang Yuan spoke in a chilling voice: "Move and I will kill the person you love!"

Ma and Zhao shuddered instantly, staring at Fang Yuan in sheer terror.

Fang Yuan exhaled and walked forward, carrying the two captives.

He looked outside the river, saying: "We can negotiate now!"

Ma Hong Yun suddenly stopped breathing!

"I didn't even use force—Ma Hong Yun died of exhaustion! Once caught, his tension collapsed and his life ended immediately."

"Liu Guan Yi, you killed him! I will tear out your bones and tendons!" Xue Hu screamed in fury.

Ma Hong Yun died, the effect of Fortune Rivalling Heaven also completely dissipated.

"Ma Hong Yun actually died? Never mind, I still have Zhao Lian Yun." Fang Yuan suppressed his shock.

Zhao Lian Yun was covered in tears.

Rank nine love Immortal Gu!

Mao Li Qiu rolled its eyes: "Reverse Flow River's dao marks normally suppress all Gu worms. But rank nine Immortal Gu are fragments of the Great Dao, which cannot be suppressed by secluded domains!"

The uncontrolled blue light carried Zhao Lian Yun out of the river, darting toward Wei Ling Yang and Bi Chen Tian.

Meanwhile, Ma Hong Yun's corpse remained.

Even though Ma Hong Yun died, his soul was still in his body.

"Such a mishap, it is definitely heaven's will!"

Fang Yuan had no way, he could only continue moving in Reverse Flow River.

Already at the front, every step he took caused Reverse Flow River to extend forward slightly, keeping him trapped in the river.

"In my life, I have experienced far too much despair," Fang Yuan sighed internally.

His gaze was clear, he was still expressionless.

"I must wait for the three sides to clash before escaping. Until then, I will persevere."

# Chapter 1285: Fang Yuan's Perseverance!

"If you think there will be a chance to escape when we fight, forget it! Today, I have only one target: you. Do you know what a price I paid to refine fortune rivalling heaven Gu? You ruined my cultivation plan; you are the person I hate most in my life. If I do not kill you, I will never be appeased!" Old Ancestor Xue Hu glared with venomous hatred, his words chilling as an icy river.

But Fang Yuan was still expressionless.

At this moment, the expressions of Old Ancestor Xue Hu, Bi Chen Tian, and Wei Ling Yang changed.

Suddenly, Yu Yi Ye Zi's eyes lit up as he realized the truth: "This situation... he is refining Gu!"

Gu worms could not be used in Reverse Flow River, unless they were rank nine Immortal Gu.

Though expressionless, Fang Yuan was inwardly shocked: "I am really refining Gu? Every step I take, the aura strengthens."

Even without understanding why, Fang Yuan knew this was a turning point!

"Why is Liu Guan Yi able to persevere for so long? He looks as though he could keep going forever!"

Soon, a brilliant pure white light began shining from inside Fang Yuan's body.

Gazing at Fang Yuan bathed in white light, Mao Li Qiu sighed helplessly: "Indeed. At this rate, he will refine Perseverance Immortal Gu and become the second Reverse Flow River Lord!"

Expressionless, no matter how many steps he took, Reverse Flow River remained beneath his feet, as though fate were mocking him.

But he continued walking.

Having traveled through five hundred years in his previous life, he knew not how much farther he would have to walk.

But he knew where he needed to go.

As if... nobody could stop him.

At least... inside this river, nobody could stop him.

In the five hundred years of his previous life.

Sitting inside the bamboo house, Fang Yuan looked at the village and Qing Mao Mountain.

"Transmigrating here is my greatest opportunity! Here, I can attain eternal life."

"I must seize this rare opportunity! Otherwise, how can I live with myself if I give up this chance?"

After the aperture awakening.

Fang Yuan turned around and left, he was filled with determination.

"Since the village refuses to nurture me and my aunt and uncle push me aside, what is the point of staying here?"

Inside the caravan.

Gu Master Big Beard was dead; Fang Yuan stood before his grave.

"You said: As a child, you wanted to be a grand hero like the righteous path's legends. In your youth, a clan leader. As an adult, you were content with clan elder. In middle age, exiled from the clan, you felt you could live fine alone, content just raising yourself and your Gu worms."

"But I am not like this, I will not forgo my dreams just because of age."

"This world is too vast, and we are minor characters... but I will work hard and do my absolute best!"

Childhood, adolescence, adulthood.

Qing Mao Mountain, caravan, he walked all along.

Middle age, old age, and eventually, lifespan Gu.

Southern Border, Western Desert, Eastern Sea, and Central Continent.

Reborn via Spring Autumn Cicada: Qing Mao Mountain, Three Kings blessed land, Hu Immortal blessed land, Imperial Court blessed land, Yi Tian Mountain, and Reverse Flow River!

Step by step, through difficulties and ordeals.

Old Ancestor Xue Hu snorted coldly with solemn eyes, no longer looking down on this rank seven Gu Immortal: "Genesis Lotus three hundred thousand years ago, and now Liu Guan Yi... the Reverse Flow River Lord."

Zhao Lian Yun awoke, tears streaming as she looked at Ma Hong Yun's corpse in Fang Yuan's arm.

She wept inwardly: "Hong Yun, Hong Yun, how could you leave me? Without you, I am alone in this world. What is the point of living? One person's perseverance is so difficult!"

Among them, some persevered for responsibility, some for hatred, some for excitement, and some for love...

And Fang Yuan's answer?

He was still expressionless, he continued to move forward relentlessly.

I had once screamed, gradually, I lost my voice.

I had once cried, gradually, I lost my tears.

I had once grieved; gradually, I learned to withstand everything.

I had once rejoiced, gradually, I became unmoved by the world.

And now!

All I have left is an expressionless face, a gaze tough as a monolith, and perseverance remaining in my heart.

This is an insignificant character, Fang Yuan's own — Perseverance!

A dazzling light erupted out.

Perseverance Immortal Gu, at this moment, was refined successfully!!

# Chapter 1289: Reverse Flow Protection Seal

A moment later, Fang Yuan opened his eyes, activating the killer move again.

This time, he moved a segment of Reverse Flow River's water, stirring huge waves.

The next moment, Old Ancestor Xue Hu shouted and erupted with even stronger attacks.

With a loud crash, Fang Yuan was sent flying like a cannonball.

But Mao Li Qiu was furious: "Little lad, you are courting death, you dared to make me lose face!!"

The immemorial desolate beast attacked Fang Yuan furiously.

Yet after dozens of blows, Fang Yuan remained unharmed and pristine, while Mao Li Qiu panted heavily, bleeding profusely.

Seeing Mao Li Qiu at a loss against him, Fang Yuan laughed and charged toward the Central Continent Gu Immortals.

Central Continent's Gu Immortals scattered at once like frightened birds.

The two Central Continent rank eights stayed and attacked Fang Yuan.

Reverse flow protection seal reflected their attacks right back, hitting the pursuing Mao Li Qiu.

Suffering and near bursting with rage, Mao Li Qiu spat out an immense deluge of purple light, engulfing the surrounding area.

The battle descended into chaos as immortals from all three sides attacked.

Over ten days later, a bedraggled figure crossed the regional wall and arrived in Eastern Sea.

"Time to return to Southern Border." Without lingering, Fang Yuan flew into the clouds.
