"A single activation produces thousands of vajra thoughts; firing them simultaneously would be quite a spectacle."

A flash of inspiration appeared in Fang Yuan's mind.

"With Vajra Thought Immortal Gu, why not imitate myriad star fireflies to create a new killer move?"

Ceasing activation of Vajra Thought, Fang Yuan pondered and began deducing an immortal killer move.

After a day and night deducing tirelessly as a divination tortoise, Fang Yuan completed the immortal killer move.

Fang Yuan left the killer move unnamed, having struck upon a new inspiration.

"With only rank six Vajra Thought as the core, this killer move lacks sufficient power. Perhaps I can integrate Divination Tortoise Transformation to enhance its strength!"

Three days later, with modifications only thirty percent complete, Wu Yong summoned Wu Yi Hai.

In the hall, Wu Yong offered to let Fang Yuan exchange Vajra Thought for another rank six Immortal Gu from the clan treasury.

Wu Yong hinted that obtaining Vajra Thought was due to his own efforts as elder brother, using the exchange offer to express goodwill.

"Wu clan is in trouble and short on Gu Immortals, so Wu Yong wishes to utilize me." Fang Yuan saw through his intentions immediately.

Recently, several super forces had cooperated to exert subtle pressure on Wu clan.

At the giant dream realm, Ba clan led other Gu Immortals in causing trouble for Wu clan.

Wu Yong had originally intended to send Fang Yuan there, but rising pressure from Ba clan at the super Gu formation made him hesitate to swap personnel, stalling Fang Yuan's deployment.

"Thank you for your concern, brother; I would like to inspect the inner treasury." Though he had already built a killer move around Vajra Thought, Fang Yuan still wished to browse the treasury's Immortal Gu.

# Chapter 1306: Immortal Gu Reputation Restriction

After weighing his options, Fang Yuan decided against the exchange, retaining Vajra Thought Immortal Gu.

This choice surprised Wu Yong a little.

"Having made gains in Eastern Sea, I intend to make the wisdom-path-aligned divination tortoise transformation my primary cultivation," Fang Yuan explained.

Wu Yong nodded: "I also summoned you for another matter."

Wu Yong gave a bitter smile: "Xia clan is targeting our Frosty Peak over historical disputes recorded in this information path mortal Gu. Brother, I hope you can defend Frosty Peak for our clan."

"I am willing to resolve this for you, brother." Fang Yuan accepted and inspected the information path mortal Gu.

Frosty Peak was not originally Wu clan's resource point, having belonged to a lone Gu Immortal.

After arduous negotiations, the lone immortal had leased the peak to Wu clan for several centuries.

Over a century later, the lone immortal perished in tribulation, making the highly productive Frosty Peak Wu clan's official property.

Xia clan staked their claim after locating a descendant of that lone immortal.

Backed by undeniable evidence, the descendant demanded that Wu clan return Frosty Peak.

"A mere mortal Gu Master dares challenge Wu clan as the lone immortal's descendant."

"Xia clan possesses numerous wisdom path Gu Immortals skilled at plotting."

"Defending Frosty Peak is my best chance to display my strength. Wu Yong hesitated to send me to the super formation out of concern that I lack the power to control the situation."

Fang Yuan received the mission, but he did not set off urgently.

Divination tortoise excelled at defense but lacked offense; with Vajra Thought in hand, Fang Yuan needed to finish deducing a killer move first.

For the next ten-plus days, Fang Yuan remained indoors deducing and modifying the immortal killer move.

Seeing Wu clan make no move, Xia clan repeatedly urged them while publicizing the matter.

Under mounting pressure, Wu Yong urged Fang Yuan to move, but Fang Yuan continued stalling.

Only after deducing and successfully testing the immortal killer move did Fang Yuan set off for Frosty Peak.

"Wu clan sent Wu Yi Hai this time." Rank six wisdom path Gu Immortal Xia Zhuo Mo spoke.

"Frosty Peak matches Moon Bowl in value, yet Wu clan sent neither Wu Yu Bo nor Wu Zhen? What a terrible move," rank seven Gu Immortal Xia Fei Kuai remarked incredulously.

Xia Zhuo Mo pondered: "His battle strength is unclear with little information from his secluded days in Eastern Sea, but escaping danger to return to Wu clan proves he can defend himself. Recently, he rescued Wu Yu Bo using a divination tortoise transformation that coincidentally countered Lord Xia Qing Cang's scattering mind."

Xia Fei Kuai laughed: "Wu Yi Hai's stalling shows his lack of confidence. I will suppress him and seize Frosty Peak!"

# Chapter 1307: Four Seasons Tea

Amid a sea of greenery, the stark white and towering Frosty Peak stood out distinctly.

At the peak's summit stood a mortal Gu House, where Xia clan Gu Immortals Xia Zhuo Mo and Xia Fei Kuai had already detected Fang Yuan's arrival.

"He is finally here. Wu Yi Hai took half a month for a three-day journey," Xia Fei Kuai frowned deeply.

The Xia clan Gu Immortals ushered Fang Yuan inside.

"The tea is not bad." After one sip, he praised.

Xia Zhuo Mo smiled: "This four seasons tea was crafted by our first supreme elder. A single sip evokes four flavors corresponding to spring, summer, autumn, and winter, hence its name."

"An excellent tea. If you have extra portions, may I request a few?" Fang Yuan smiled, squinting.

As Xia Zhuo Mo prepared to answer, Xia Fei Kuai cut in: "Whatever! We have plenty of four seasons tea—take as much as you like."

With that, he handed over ten portions of four seasons tea.

"Then I accept." Fang Yuan laughed heartily, taking the tea leaves.

Xia Fei Kuai quickly added: "Let's talk about Frosty Peak."

Xia Fei Kuai spoke rapidly: "This matter is a long story, but since we know the background, let us cut to the chase. Little Zhang, come out."

At his call, a rank five Gu Master stepped out from a room in the Gu House.

"Zhang San Feng's descendant, Zhang Kai Zui, greets the three immortals." The elderly, white-haired Gu Master greeted them without excessive reverence.

"Little Zhang's bloodline is genuine. Come, Wu Yi Hai, test it quickly." Xia Fei Kuai left his seat and pulled Zhang Kai Zui over to Fang Yuan with an impatient expression.

He waved his hand, feigning confusion: "Wait, who is this Gu Master?"

Before Zhang Kai Zui could speak, Xia Fei Kuai cut in: "He is Zhang Kai Zui; he already introduced himself."

"I know he is named Zhang Kai Zui." Fang Yuan nodded.

Pausing to sip tea, Fang Yuan asked: "What does this mortal Gu Master have to do with Frosty Peak?"

"His ancestor Zhang San Feng once..." Xia Fei Kuai began.

"Wait." Fang Yuan stopped him: "Who is Zhang San Feng?"

Xia Fei Kuai was stunned: "Wu Yi Hai, after so long, you have no idea who Zhang San Feng is?"

Fang Yuan smiled embarrassedly: "The clan sent me to protect Frosty Peak in a rush, so I know nothing of the background. Please excuse my ignorance."

Xia Fei Kuai spoke rapidly, explaining the historical background in moments.

Xia Fei Kuai said: "Are you clear now?"

Setting down his cup, Fang Yuan stood up and cupped his fists at Xia Fei Kuai.

Fang Yuan said: "Thank you for the explanation, but you spoke too quickly for me to understand much. Could you repeat it?"

"Again?" Xia Zhuo Mo, who was beside him, frowned.

Refusing to repeat everything, Xia Fei Kuai said: "Which part are you unclear about? I can explain that."

His tone was unhappy.

# Chapter 1308: Shameless!

Seemingly oblivious, Fang Yuan smiled: "I didn't hear the first line clearly."

Xia Fei Kuai explained it.

"It's clear now. Thank you for explaining, everything makes sense." Fang Yuan patted his forehead and sat down.

"Thus, your clan must return Frosty Peak. Xia clan is upholding justice, and Zhang Kai Zui is indisputably Zhang San Feng's descendant. Please test him," Xia Fei Kuai urged again.

Fang Yuan merely glanced at Zhang Kai Zui before waving with a smile: "No rush, no rush."

Fang Yuan chuckled and clapped: "You are straightforward. I will verify this with my clan."

With that, he shut his eyes to use information path methods.

After a long time, Fang Yuan did not open his eyes.

Xia Fei Kuai urged him: "Wu Yi Hai, are you done?"

Opening his eyes, Fang Yuan smiled sheepishly: "My brother is too busy right now; let us wait a while."

Unable to question a rank eight, Xia Zhuo Mo interjected: "Lord Wu Yong is busy indeed, but you could ask other Wu clan Gu Immortals."

Fang Yuan laughed, giving Xia Zhuo Mo a thumbs-up: "As expected of a wisdom path Gu Immortal, great idea!"

Fang Yuan added: "However, I know no other Gu Immortals well. Do you have any recommendations?"

"Recommend your sister!" Xia Fei Kuai shouted angrily from the side.

"My sister? I only have an elder brother, no sister. You must have remembered wrong?" Fang Yuan smiled, squinting.

"..." Xia Fei Kuai was speechless.

Fang Yuan smiled: "Your tongue is dry and chest heaves—signs of a fever. Drink some of this four seasons tea so you don't fall ill."

Xia Fei Kuai roared: "Drink what? We are discussing serious business!"

Fang Yuan's expression turned sincere: "What do you mean? I am innocent. We must follow rules for Frosty Peak. It belonged to Zhang San Feng; if Zhang Kai Zui is his true descendant, we will return it. On Wu clan's behalf, we will act fair and square, refusing to break righteous path rules for mere profit!"

"Forget it, he is clearly stalling for time," Xia Zhuo Mo transmitted.

"Wu clan lacks justification and is at a disadvantage, so Wu Yi Hai must stall with endless excuses. Once Wu clan's manpower frees up, dealing with them will be far harder. For one, once the phoenix birds lay their eggs, Wu Zhen can come here, which will change the situation entirely."

Xia Fei Kuai turned to Fang Yuan: "Wu Yi Hai, as the glory of Wu clan, on behalf of Xia clan, I challenge you to a spar!"

# Chapter 1309: Spar

Stalling on Frosty Peak was Fang Yuan's deliberate ploy to force Xia clan to resolve the dispute through combat.

Xia Fei Kuai's words were clever—by representing Xia clan and hailing Wu Yi Hai as Wu clan's glory, he turned this spar into a contest between both clans.

Disguised as Wu Yi Hai and needing to reach the super Gu formation, Fang Yuan had to accept the challenge.

After brief thought, he said: "If both of you fight me together, I am outnumbered and will certainly lose."

Xia Fei Kuai had no intention of ganging up anyway, saying: "I will fight you alone, don't worry."

Fang Yuan said reluctantly: "Since you are so eager, I cannot refuse. But we cannot fight endlessly."

Fang Yuan said: "You attack and I defend; if you breach my defense within ten moves, I lose."

Xia Fei Kuai's eyelids were twitching, he said: "Okay."

Both sides flew to a desolate valley.

Fang Yuan quickly stood opposite Xia Fei Kuai.

"Start." Xia Fei Kuai could not wait, he wanted to teach Fang Yuan a lesson.

"Wait." Fang Yuan gestured with his hand.

Primed to fight, Xia Fei Kuai was irritated by the interruption: "Wu Yi Hai, what else do you want?"

"I almost forgot, since this is a spar, we can't do it so casually, right?" Fang Yuan smiled.

"Simple: if I win, the status quo remains and Frosty Peak stays with us," Fang Yuan said.

"How can we do that?!" An anxious Xia Zhuo Mo rushed to Xia Fei Kuai and shouted.

"In that case, I cannot fight. The spar is voided." Fang Yuan waved, turning to walk away.

Xia Fei Kuai's face darkened: "Wu Yi Hai, leaving without fighting—is this Wu clan's courage and glory?"

Fang Yuan turned back solemnly: "You refused my condition. A failed negotiation is not running away—look, I even chose the battlefield."

Fang Yuan muttered thoughtfully before adding: "How about this: if I win, we maintain the status quo for five years and you drop the Frosty Peak dispute until then?"

Fang Yuan's sudden condition was far more acceptable than his previous one.

Xia Fei Kuai spoke: "Okay, I agree."

"I take full responsibility! The less time I spend with this bastard, the better," Xia Fei Kuai replied resolutely to Xia Zhuo Mo.

"Are you two sure?" Fang Yuan asked.

"We are sure," Xia Zhuo Mo answered this time instead of Xia Fei Kuai.

Before he finished speaking, Fang Yuan glowed and transformed into a divination tortoise.

Xia Fei Kuai was stunned by the contrast; after endless stalling, Fang Yuan had transformed in an instant.

The divination tortoise stood on four pillar-like legs, its massive body filling the entire valley.

The pitch-black divination tortoise bore tens of thousands of eye-catching shell markings. Xia Zhuo Mo stared at them until dizziness forced him to look away.

"That tough shell proves its defensive power—no wonder he chose this sparring format." Xia Zhuo Mo's frown deepened.

Xia Fei Kuai only hesitated for a moment, before attacking.

Floating in midair, he raised a clenched fist and punched toward the valley's divination tortoise.

Dazzling, pure white light gathered around Xia Fei Kuai's fist, forming a massive sphere of light that crashed downward.

This was an immortal killer move — Soaring Essence Strike.

# Chapter 1310: So Embarrassing

The wine-vat-sized light sphere slammed onto the divination tortoise's back like a mountain, smashing it into the ground.

Unlike typical swift light path moves, Xia Fei Kuai's soaring essence strike was a heavy fist of immense destructive power.

However, Fang Yuan's divination tortoise was perfectly unharmed.

Cored on change form Immortal Gu and divination tortoise shell Immortal Gu, Fang Yuan's rank seven transformation granted a defense surpassing a genuine ancient divination tortoise.

Just then, Fang Yuan activated a second immortal killer move.

As Immortal and mortal Gu auras surged, Fang Yuan breathed out countless small tortoise shells.

He punched forward with soaring essence strike again.

Yet this time, the heavy, wine-vat-sized light sphere never even reached the divination tortoise.

Like bees drawn to honey, the fist-sized tortoise shells swarmed toward the soaring essence strike.

The hard tortoise shells shattered into hundreds of pieces upon collision.

Yet the soaring essence strike was completely consumed, fading into dim specks of light that dissipated harmlessly.

Immortal killer move — Vajra Shell!

The killer move's core was the rank six Immortal Gu Vajra Thought.

"These tortoise shells are thoughts!" Xia Zhuo Mo's eyes flashed as he unraveled the mystery.

"Xia Zhuo Mo, you are knowledgeable; the two of you make quite a pair," the divination tortoise mocked sarcastically in human speech.

"Little Mo, be quiet, I will break his shell." Xia Fei Kuai said.

Light fountained from him, gathering between his palms.

Fang Yuan lowered his head and rooted his limbs like a silent dark mountain, while the surrounding tortoise shells multiplied with extreme speed.

From nearly ten thousand, the count swiftly passed twenty, thirty, and forty thousand...

Xia Fei Kuai and Xia Zhuo Mo could only stare wide-eyed as the dense mass of tortoise shells carpeted the valley like locusts and ants, spreading ever outward.

Light path immortal killer move — Saw Light Wheel!

His two hands, that were above his head, chopped down at once.

A dazzling wheel of light flew from Xia Fei Kuai's palms.

Countless tortoise shells flew over.

Under the tortoise shells' self-destructive charge, the saw light wheel flew only a short distance before being destroyed completely.

Fang Yuan praised loudly: "An extraordinary killer move—it actually destroyed over six thousand of my thoughts!"

# Chapter 1311: Xia Clan Retreats

Xia Fei Kuai was already preparing his killer move.

"Take this — Thirty-three Heavenly Lights!"

It was one of Xia Fei Kuai's trump cards, famous across Southern Border.

Upon activation, intense light radiated outward from Xia Fei Kuai at the center.

The blinding light flickered thirty-three times with ever-expanding range, resembling beams descending from heaven—hence the name Thirty-three Heavenly Lights.

Thirty-three heavenly lights was somewhat impractical: the user had to remain completely stationary, as any movement would immediately abort the move.

Soon, the light burst forth!

Fifth flicker, hundreds of thoughts collapsed into nothingness.

By the sixth flicker, a thousand thoughts were destroyed, and peripheral tortoise shells began collapsing.

Swoosh!

Seventy-eighty thousand small tortoise shell thoughts suddenly surged towards Fang Yuan like a tide.

As a wisdom path ancient desolate beast, its vast mind easily accommodated all the thoughts.

Xia Zhuo Mo smacked his forehead, realizing in frustration: "That explains my unease! Those tortoise shells are fundamentally thoughts, so he can retract them into his mind at will."

In the air, Xia Fei Kuai's immortal killer move still continued.

Without any thoughts to strike, the blazing lights were completely meaningless.

Yet the killer move was underway and could not be safely aborted.

Xia Fei Kuai had to maintain the move: tenth flicker, eleventh, twelfth...

After the thirty-third flicker, Xia Fei Kuai had burned massive immortal essence, while the divination tortoise stayed tucked motionless in its shell.

The surrounding valley had been leveled into flat ground.

"This killer move is truly powerful," Fang Yuan praised readily.

Speaking, he extended his head, tail, and limbs from his shell.

"Too shameless!" Xia Zhuo Mo gritted his teeth, looking at Fang Yuan hatefully.

Seeing over a hundred thousand thoughts pour out to surround the tortoise once more, Xia Zhuo Mo's fury deepened.

"You have used three moves." Fang Yuan indifferently reminded.

Xia Fei Kuai shouted: "Then take my following move!!"

Transforming into a ray of light, Xia Fei Kuai pounced forward, attacking the divination tortoise from all angles while shattering countless defending tortoise-shell thoughts.

Seeing Xia Fei Kuai strike at full power, Fang Yuan withdrew his head, tail, and limbs into his shell.

After the tenth move, Xia Fei Kuai's efforts yielded nothing, leaving only slight marks on Fang Yuan's tortoise shell.

"You win this time," Xia Fei Kuai conceded before taking to the sky.

Left behind, Xia Zhuo Mo sighed, having to clean up the mess and retrieve Gu Master Zhang.

"Five years. In five years, I will return for you," Xia Zhuo Mo said indignantly as he left.

# Chapter 1312: Ransacking Frosty Peak

Defeated in the spar, Xia clan's Gu Immortals departed quietly.

Fang Yuan reverted to human form and returned to Frosty Peak.

"Such an easy victory occurred because I held the advantage."

The Xia immortals could only guess his strength, while Fang Yuan knew their moves and temperaments through Wu clan's intelligence.

Using superior information and layered schemes, Fang Yuan had advanced step by step to force Xia clan's retreat.

"And the best way to raise attainment is through dream realms." Fang Yuan's thoughts inevitably turned back to that giant dream realm.

"Unfortunately, I only recently joined Wu clan; demanding to go to the super Gu formation would arouse suspicion."

"Though Frosty Peak is settled, who knows when I can return to the giant dream realm. I should focus on the present and go with the flow."

Fang Yuan pondered while landing on Frosty Peak.

This mountain peak was abundant in ice path resources, he still had not properly searched it.

"Frost jades." Fang Yuan soon had harvests.

"Frost jades are only rank five materials, but they contain frost jade essence, a rank six immortal material."

Without any hesitation, Fang Yuan began collecting them!

Enormous frost jades were dug out one after another; the smallest was elephant-sized, while the largest matched large ships.

Some frost jade essences were larger, including thousand year frost jade essences, which were rank seven Gu materials.

Wu clan had intentionally left these frost jades untouched to preserve Frosty Peak's foundation; without them, it would cease to be such a remarkable resource point.

Fang Yuan took away most of the frost jades.

Not only this, he also plundered many wild Gu worms.

Most were ice path Gu, especially cold wave Gu, which caused severe cold waves to spread from the peak.

After finishing his plunder, Fang Yuan flew into the air and took a final glance at Frosty Peak.

The scenery was ruined, Frosty Peak's resource value had plummeted by over half, and its foundation was severely damaged by the deficit.

"Unfortunately, I can't do that at the moment. My identity is Wu Yi Hai, a Wu clan member, I made huge profits this time by embezzlement, this has already reached the limits of the righteous path's unwritten rules and cannot be continued. If I really pulled the mountain, not to mention exposing my true identity, I definitely cannot justify my actions to Wu clan."

Fang Yuan sighed inwardly and flew away rapidly without dwelling on it.

Several days later, Fang Yuan returned to Wu clan's headquarters and met Wu Yong.

"Thank you, brother, for protecting Frosty Peak for the clan and deterring those thieves." Wu Yong gave Fang Yuan an appreciative look.

"You flatter me, it was only a fluke." Fang Yuan replied modestly.

"Elder Wu Fa, have you evaluated it? My brother's contribution was significant; we must look at the bigger picture." Wu Yong turned toward another Wu clan Gu Immortal.

Wu Fa frowned slightly: "We have seen Lord Wu Yi Hai's bravery. This battle will surely spread lord's name throughout Southern Border's Gu Immortal world. However, regarding rewards, Lord Wu Yi Hai only established a five-year agreement rather than fully resolving the issue. Furthermore, Frosty Peak was heavily plundered, damaging its foundation and drastically reducing its value..."

"Oh? Such a thing happened to Frosty Peak?" Wu Yong turned towards Fang Yuan with a surprised look.

Fang Yuan sighed: "I also did not expect Xia clan's Gu Immortals to be such horrible people!"

Wu Yong frowned slightly: "Brother, did you personally see Xia clan's Gu Immortals looting Frosty Peak?"

"I did not, it is just my guess. Maybe it was other lone cultivators?" Fang Yuan replied with no flaw in his argument.

Wu Yong nodded, speaking after a brief silence: "In that case, Elder Wu Fa shall make the final decision."

Elder Wu Fa calculated for a while before handing Fang Yuan a detailed list.

# Chapter 1313: Dragon Scale Sea Area

Fang Yuan skimmed through the list; it was filled with various Gu materials, mostly mortal materials with a few immortal materials.

Wu Yong and Wu Fa were putting on an act, offering him a graceful way to resolve the matter peacefully.

Seemingly unaware, Fang Yuan remained silent for a moment before asking: "Could I exchange these rewards for the mortal Gu material, dragon scale soil?"

Wu Yong was slightly stumped, and looked at Wu Fa.

The latter thought briefly and nodded.

Returning to his home, Fang Yuan continued to cultivate.

Imbued with dragon aura from desolate dragons, dragon scale soil stimulated dragonfish to propagate.

"The time rate in the sovereign immortal aperture has slowed down greatly, leading to a huge decrease in resource production."

"My immortal essence and immortal essence stone reserves are low, but expanding resource production can relieve this pressure."

After thinking it over, Fang Yuan chose dragonfish as the first resource point to expand.

Desolate beast and ordinary dragonfish were always traded in massive numbers in treasure yellow heaven.

Over the following period, Fang Yuan focused primarily on creating a sea area.

Fang Yuan laid out the dragon scale soil and constructed a mortal Gu formation to establish this sea area.

Then, he led his dragonfish group to this sea area.

The dragonfish thrived in this new sea area, mating far more frequently.

Next, Fang Yuan started to prepared an immortal killer move — Bountiful Year!

This was a rare immortal killer move specially used for managing the immortal aperture, possessing no offensive capability.

As Gu worms rose one after another, a mysterious aura swelled and gradually thickened.

The original Bountiful Year cored on Year Gu, but Fang Yuan ingeniously incorporated rank seven Perseverance Immortal Gu as the primary supplementary Gu.

More than ten days later, bountiful year was fully activated.

A mysterious power spread throughout the dragon scale sea area, though its effects would take time to manifest.

"Even Hei Fan needed two to three days to activate the original Bountiful Year. Adding Perseverance Immortal Gu extended the activation time to nearly half a month. Fortunately, it succeeded without backlash."

With Perseverance Immortal Gu's support, Bountiful Year's duration had doubled!

While the original Bountiful Year lasted only a year, Fang Yuan's activation would endure for two, covertly saving him substantial red date immortal essence.

With the matter settled, Fang Yuan's first major project was complete.

In Mini Eastern Sea, his first special sea area—dragon scale sea area—was now completely formed.

Large numbers of dragonfish lived here, including one or two conspicuous desolate beast dragonfish.

Fang Yuan's bountiful year's effect only covered a portion of Mini Eastern Sea.

Adding Perseverance Immortal Gu reduced its effective range, and the sovereign immortal aperture was too vast to cover entirely.

Following this project, Fang Yuan's immortal essence stones and immortal essence reserves were nearly depleted.

To be safe, Fang Yuan began selling all unnecessary resources in his possession.

These included the frost jades, frost jade essences, and numerous ice path mortal Gu plundered from Frosty Peak.

After selling some resources, Fang Yuan gritted his teeth and used part of the gains to buy more dragonfish from treasure yellow heaven.

With his immortal essence depleted, Fang Yuan could not freely cultivate, deduce, or practice killer moves.

After half a month, the first batch of dragonfish was sold, and the situation began to improve.

After over a month, Fang Yuan sold the second batch of dragonfish directly to Wu clan!

"Who knew you were so proficient in managing dragonfish!" Even Wu Yong was slightly surprised.

Wu clan regularly traded dragonfish; while they previously bought from outside, these were now internal transactions.

Fang Yuan's third batch of dragonfish was sold.

Leveraging Wu Yi Hai's identity and low prices, Fang Yuan's dragonfish smoothly entered Southern Border's Gu Immortal market.

Selling the third batch eased his financial strain and replenished his immortal essence, allowing him to resume cultivation in high spirits.

# Chapter 1314: Purchasing Divine Deer Fruits

Inside his cultivation room at Wu clan, after resting for a while, Fang Yuan activated his Gu worms and sent his divine sense into treasure yellow heaven.

"I will pay one thousand three hundred immortal essence stones for all your divine deer fruits." Fang Yuan spoke.

The Gu Immortal's will shook its head helplessly: "My quoted price is already low. You've come three times; add two hundred immortal essence stones and you can take them."

Divine deer fruits were rank six immortal material.

Fang Yuan, however, needed it to feed vajra thought Immortal Gu.

Having obtained Vajra Thought Immortal Gu, he needed to solve its feeding problem.

After browsing treasure yellow heaven several times, Fang Yuan found that the divine deer fruits at this stall were of top quality.

About the size of a baby's fist, divine deer fruits grew not on plants, but on the antlers of desolate beast fruit deers.

It was a deer that bore fruit.

"I should buy a batch of divine deer fruits for now to handle Vajra Thought Immortal Gu's first feeding."

"When I have sufficient funds, I can raise fruit deers to become self-sufficient in feeding Vajra Thought Immortal Gu."

"Whether I can develop divine deer fruit production into another income source will depend on future opportunities."

Fang Yuan pondered while communicating with that Gu Immortal will: "Then, let me check again."

Suddenly, the Gu Immortal's will shook and spoke: "My main body's divine sense has entered and can negotiate the price. You should talk directly."

"How about it? I offer thirteen hundred immortal essence stones."

The Gu Immortal hesitated: "This is our first deal; how can I trust empty promises? Heh, forget it—fourteen hundred immortal essence stones and it's a deal."

"After three such transactions, the price can be lowered to thirteen hundred. What do you think?"

Fang Yuan refused: "If I had ample funds, I wouldn't haggle like this. How about thirteen hundred and fifty?"

The Gu Immortal forced a smile: "Alright. Were it not for my urgent need for funds and slow sales, I wouldn't have agreed."

One gave the money and the other handed the goods.

With the transaction completed, Fang Yuan sighed in relief; Vajra Thought Immortal Gu's feeding was settled for now.

Now, it was divination tortoise shell Immortal Gu's turn.

This Immortal Gu fed on kelp.

Naturally, this was not ordinary kelp, but ancient ink kelp, a rank six immortal material.

Short on funds, Fang Yuan intended to buy and store some ancient ink kelp for Divination Tortoise Shell Immortal Gu's feeding.

"Fortunately, dragon scale sea area is completed; as long as it continues developing like this, I will have abundant funds ahead."

"Next is constructing coiling thread caves to mass-produce regretful spiders."

Fang Yuan had considered it: the market for regretful spiders was huge, particularly in Western Desert. Though demand lagged behind dragonfish, it was still substantial.

"At this rate, it will take over a month to amass the funds needed to begin constructing coiling thread caves."

"Hopefully, Wu clan will stabilize by then and allow me to return to the giant dream realm."

Wu Yi Hai's identity restricted Fang Yuan's freedom; given Wu clan's current situation, voicing his intentions was unwise.

Fang Yuan's idle cultivation lifestyle did not last for long.

Some days later, he received another task from Wu Yong.

"Mount Snail? Mountain Moving Old Monster?"

Fang Yuan's brows slowly started to furrow.

He did not lack confidence in completing the task, but the current trend of events was concerning.

At Frosty Peak, Fang Yuan had withheld his strength to produce a mediocre result, merely securing a five-year agreement while plundering the peak's resources.

Though common under righteous path conventions, his actions had touched the bottom line.

Fang Yuan had deliberately left a poor impression so higher-ups would avoid using him and send him off to the super Gu formation sooner, matching his wish.

Yet Wu clan was severely short-handed across its vast territory. When the Mount Snail issue erupted suddenly, Wu Yong had no choice but to deploy Fang Yuan.

# Chapter 1315: Convincing Old Monster

Southern Border.

Light rain was drizzling on a range of verdant mountains.

Robed in blue, Fang Yuan stood atop a rock gazing across the grand landscape before fixing his eyes on a particular mountain.

This was Mount Snail.

An immemorial desolate beast, it was a colossal river snail with a towering spiral shell drenched in green moss.

There were seven known Mount Snails in Southern Border. Super forces had long agreed that any wild, uncontrolled Mount Snail belonged to whichever clan's territory it inhabited.

Living within Wu clan's territory, this Mount Snail naturally belonged to them.

Now migrating, the Mount Snail was departing Wu clan's territory for other lands.

Mount Snail was heading toward an area without other righteous path super forces.

This meant the Mount Snail would become wild once more.

Unwilling to let this happen and lacking manpower, Wu Yong had no choice but to assign this task to his brother, Wu Yi Hai.

"Wu Yi Hai? I am Qin Jin Sheng, I am also called Mountain Moving Old Monster." A Gu Immortal flew over from another mountain peak.

Clad in rocky grey armor, the slovenly old immortal had messy straw-like hair of mixed black and white, with frayed, shredded robes.

Yet his rank seven aura was majestic and forceful, his eyes shining with sharp light as he sized up Fang Yuan like a junior.

Hearing Mountain Moving Old Monster introduce himself, Fang Yuan bowed slightly with righteous path etiquette: "Wu Yi Hai greets Senior Mountain Moving." Fang Yuan bowed slightly with righteous path etiquette.

"Hehehe, it was about time your Wu clan sent someone. Let's sit and talk." Mountain Moving Old Monster laughed, sitting on a rock.

Fang Yuan smiled and also sat down.

Seeing that Fang Yuan sat without objection or arrogance, Mountain Moving Old Monster's impression improved: "I almost forgot you were a lone cultivator. Though you joined Wu clan, you lack the hypocrisy of the righteous path."

Mountain Moving Old Monster laughed heartily: "I hear you chased away Xia clan's two Gu Immortals, yet plundered the resources of Frosty Peak."

He laughed loudly, then sighed deeply: "Righteous path Gu Immortals cannot understand you, but I do. How difficult is it for lone cultivators to become immortals? We must earn every cultivation resource ourselves. Without future guarantees, we must grasp present benefits with all our might. Who knows what tomorrow brings?"

Fang Yuan knew these words were not mere pleasantries, but an expression of resolve: as a lone cultivator, Mountain Moving Old Monster's present benefit was Mount Snail. His resolve was unshakable, as former lone cultivator Wu Yi Hai should understand.

"I understand senior's intention, but please have some understanding; I have my own difficulties coming here," Fang Yuan said.

Mountain Moving Old Monster snickered: "Everyone has their own difficulties."

Sometimes, silence was a useful tactic in verbal confrontations.

Sure enough, Mountain Moving Old Monster grew restless and handed an information path mortal Gu to Fang Yuan: "Take a look."

The contents listed in this mortal Gu had high value. If Fang Yuan obtained them, he could directly construct coiling thread caves!

"We will cooperate: I take Mount Snail and you get these, what do you think?" Mountain Moving Old Monster smiled.

"Senior wants to exchange these for an immemorial desolate beast?" Fang Yuan held the information path mortal Gu, smiling faintly.

"The resources inside are very valuable! Mount Snail is an immemorial desolate beast, but who can control it? As its owner, I will only take its resources. We can talk if you have conditions." Mountain Moving Old Monster's eyes brightened, his attitude warming.

"The contents of this list must be doubled at least." This was Fang Yuan's first condition.

"Mount Snail cannot be yours in name, it will still belong to Wu clan." This was Fang Yuan's second condition.

"In truth, senior will be its owner and take most benefits, but you must hand over a portion of resources to Wu clan annually." This was Fang Yuan's third condition.

Mountain Moving Old Monster sneered with a darkening expression: "Wu Yi Hai, are you playing with me?"

"Of course not." Fang Yuan stood up with a sober expression, meeting his gaze fearlessly: "Senior, may I ask three questions?"

Mountain Moving Old Monster barely restrained his anger: "Speak."

"First, senior is unaffiliated with any super force; how could Wu clan leave Mount Snail in your hands? Yielding to a super force is one thing, but letting a lone cultivator take benefits damages Wu clan's prestige."

"Second, even if you take Mount Snail now, how long can you defend it? Even if Wu clan does not interfere, what about other super forces?"

"Third, senior, do you think bribing me alone will make all of Wu clan simply watch from the sidelines?"

Mountain Moving Old Monster fell into silence.

After a long while, he sighed hoarsely: "Under your plan, wouldn't I become a mountain guard for Wu clan?"

Fang Yuan smiled faintly: "That is merely minor reputation. How could everything be perfect? These conditions are reasonable only because I was once a lone cultivator myself. Consider properly whether you want face or real benefits."

This silence lasted even longer; only as the drizzle ceased did he speak: "Alright, we will go according to your plan."

# Chapter 1316: Moon Festival

A few days later.

Watching Mount Snail rumble away with Mountain Moving Old Monster standing atop it like an owner, Fang Yuan turned to leave.

"Crucially, when can I return to the dream realm? Wu Yong's attitude is key!"

While he traveled back, two Gu Immortals at Wu clan headquarters were discussing Wu Yi Hai.

One was Wu clan's rank eight first supreme elder, Wu Yong.

The other was Wu Yong's trusted aide, Wu Fa.

"Who would have thought my brother would resolve Mount Snail so quickly? Elder Wu Fa, as per clan rules, how should we reward him?" Wu Yong asked.

Wu Fa was silent for a moment.

Wu Fa quickly thought and replied: "Lord Wu Yi Hai has a lone cultivator background."

Wu Yong laughed heartily: "Indeed. Yi Hai retains a lone cultivator's disposition; even after returning to the clan, he is always seeking quick cash and cheap benefits."

Wu Fa disagreed: "Frosty Peak and Mount Snail are hardly small benefits."

Wu Yong ceased laughing, sharp light flashing in his eyes as he nodded: "Indeed, if everyone acted so, Wu clan could not endure. Yet he never crossed the bottom line or left any exploitable weaknesses."

Wu Yong sighed and remarked: "He does have some ability."

Fang Yuan successfully returned to Wu clan.

He met Wu Yong, briefly recounted the matter, and received another reward from Wu clan.

Days passed by, Fang Yuan started to feel somewhat impatient.

"The issues at the giant dream realm have settled, yet Wu Yong shows no sign of letting me return. What I worried about has happened after all. Sigh!"

After all, hadn't Fang Yuan disguised himself as Wu Yi Hai and entered Wu clan solely for the dream realm?

"It seems I need to make a move."

On this day, Fang Yuan left his residence.

Twelve days later, several Gu Immortals sat around a stone table in a pavilion on Yue Hua Mountain.

"Today is Southern Border's annual moon festival; it is my pleasure to enjoy it with all our honored guests," Qiao Si Liu said with a smile.

"Receiving Fairy Si Liu's invitation to enjoy the moon festival is my, Luo Mu Zi's, honor," spoke a young-looking Gu Immortal.

Among the six Gu Immortals present—two women and four men—aside from one couple, Luo Mu Zi and Lun Fei were Qiao Si Liu's pursuers.

Yet Qiao Si Liu addressed another male Gu Immortal: "Yi Hai, you wished to integrate into Southern Border; tonight's moon festival is one of our customs."

"Though Southern Border's many mountains isolate us, the moon festival is a shared tradition. Every year at this time, we appreciate the moon."

Luo Mu Zi and Lun Fei frowned instantly, glaring at Fang Yuan with burning eyes.

Qiao Si Liu sat in the main seat, with Fang Yuan on her right and her best friend Fairy Tian Lu on her left.

"Moon festival?" Fang Yuan feigned ignorance with an indifferent look. "Interesting, what do we do besides admiring the moon?"

"We drink tea, recite poems, and dissect rocks," Qiao Si Liu explained with a smile.

"Dissect rocks?" Fang Yuan looked puzzled.

Without replying, Qiao Si Liu handed Fang Yuan a cup of fragrant tea: "First, please taste my personally brewed tea."

Fang Yuan took a light sip and commented: "This tea is not bad."

"Only not bad? This is Fairy Si Liu's renowned willow spiral tea!" Luo Mu Zi almost yelled.

"Is there something special I am unaware of?" Fang Yuan looked at Qiao Si Liu.

Fairy Tian Lu chimed in: "If you gently shake this willow spiral tea, a whirlpool shaped like a willow leaf forms on the surface. Only drinking it then reveals its extraordinary flavor."

"Oh? Is that so?" Fang Yuan gently shook his cup, and the tea's surface immediately shifted.

Drinking it, fragrance overflowed in his mouth, leaving a pleasant, satisfying aftertaste.

"Great tea." Fang Yuan praised.

"Earning your praise means Si Liu's efforts were not wasted. Brewing this tea takes six hours without the slightest carelessness throughout," Fairy Tian Lu said.

# Chapter 1317: Tea Competition

Fang Yuan's expression showed flattered joy, but his mind remained tranquil without a ripple.

"A pity. No matter how beautiful you are, without eternal life, you will just be a pile of bones in the end."

"Beauty is superficial, but people cannot stop indulging in it."

"Fairy Tian Lu is indeed Qiao Si Liu's best friend; their coordination is remarkable."

Qiao Si Liu sighed deeply: "Oh, I wonder when I will meet someone who creates a tea for me?"

There was a sense of dejectedness in her soft query.

Luo Mu Zi and Lun Fei felt their bodies heat up. Luo Mu Zi stood up: "Fairy Si Liu, I created a tea called nine recollecting fragrances. I would like to offer it to you on this auspicious occasion."

Not to be outdone, Lun Fei chimed in: "I also prepared tea—this is yin-yang tea, with clear separation between yin and yang. Fairy, please have a taste."

Qiao Si Liu tasted both teas and smiled: "Nine recollecting fragrances is aptly named—fragrance coils on the tongue and intensifies at nine distinct moments. Truly extraordinary."

"Haha, it is hardly worthy of such praise, Fairy." Luo Mu Zi laughed heartily, his foul mood completely swept away.

Qiao Si Liu then said to Lun Fei: "Though yin-yang tea is not a unique creation, I have heard of it. Brewing it has three levels: first, yin and yang are obscure; second, yin and yang separate; achieving the second level proves your skill, Lun Fei—fewer than ten people in Southern Border can manage that, truly worthy of a food path Gu Immortal."

"Lun Fei's main cultivation is food path?" Fang Yuan glanced at him, inwardly surprised.

"What is his origin? I have many Immortal Gu; obtaining his food path inheritance could help me immensely." Malice instantly sprouted in Fang Yuan.

"I must first check Lun Fei's background to see if I can make a move against him."

But Fang Yuan could kill Lun Fei and capture his soul, to obtain the food path inheritance by soul searching.

"I brewed this tea for seven days and seven nights, Fairy. Earning your praise makes it all worthwhile," Lun Fei said, his voice shaking slightly with excitement.

He looked at Fang Yuan, challenging: "I wonder what tea Lord Wu Yi Hai will present to us?"

He had no idea Fang Yuan was already harboring thoughts of killing him.

"Eastern Sea is richest in resources. Having lived there for years, any tea Wu Yi Hai presents will surely surpass all others," Luo Mu Zi remarked enthusiastically, sitting back.

He took out five cups of tea and indicated: "Please enjoy."

Fairy Tian Lu's eyes brightened as she picked up a cup first: "I am very curious about Lord Wu Yi Hai's tea."

Yet the first to drink was not her, but Lun Fei.

Taking just one sip, he frowned and spat it out: "Pshaw, what rotten tea is this?"

"Awful, too awful." Luo Mu Zi took a sip and set his cup down. "This is the most revolting tea I have ever tasted—perhaps even worse than mortal tea."

Hoping to mediate, Fairy Tian Lu drank it, but smiled helplessly: "This tea is salty and bitter, just like seawater."

Fang Yuan smiled and unexpectedly admitted: "It is seawater."

Fang Yuan's smile vanished into solemnity: "I do not like drinking tea; if forced to choose, seawater is my tea."

"You do not understand."

"Living as a secluded cultivator in Eastern Sea, I was an orphan with no one to rely on, constantly pressured by calamities and tribulations."

"Every morning, I drank a bowl of salty seawater to remind myself never to slacken and to keep persevering."

The pavilion immediately fell into silence.

Amidst the silence, Qiao Si Liu slowly raised her cup, took a sip, and set it down.

Smiling brightly under the moonlight, she said: "This is the most special tea of my life. Thank you, Yi Hai. It is good, and I am truly moved."

# Chapter 1318: Story of the Moon Festival

Fairy Tian Lu smoothed over the mood: "The moon is high, and we have shared tea; without poems, this festival would be incomplete."

Fang Yuan feigned confusion: "Are we really going to recite poems?"

He looked like he had heard it for the first time.

Competing in poetry?!

Hailing from Earth, Fang Yuan had a vast mental stockpile of famous poems and masterpieces; reciting just one would easily humiliate them both.

"Yes, poetry recitation has a story behind it," Qiao Si Liu answered him.

"Oh? Please explain." Fang Yuan continued to ask.

"This legend has been passed down in Southern Border as the origin of the moon festival," Qiao Si Liu explained eloquently.

Once upon a time, at a certain village in Southern Border.

"You are a mere mortal while my daughter is a Gu Master with a bright future—how could you be worthy of her? Get lost!"

As the youth begged, the old Gu Master sneered: "You daydream if you think I will let her marry you! A mortal who cannot even brew tea—what use do you have?"

The youth retorted: "Is brewing tea so difficult? If I brew it, will you marry your daughter to me?"

"If you brew a cup of tea meeting my expectations, I will give you a chance."

Overjoyed, the youth agreed at once: "Sir, I will definitely make it."

The youth replied: "Do not worry. Who says mortals cannot brew tea? Let me explain three principles."

"First principle: the law of the jungle—big fish eat small fish, and small fish eat shrimp."

With that, he caught a big fish from a stream, cut it open to retrieve a small fish inside, then sliced the small fish to take out a shrimp.

"The second principle: humans must eat and defecate."

The youth then ate the shrimp and excreted a pile of feces.

"The third principle: faeces can nourish vegetation to grow better."

The youth buried his feces under the soil, and sure enough, plants and flowers began to flourish.

Plucking a flower from among them, he steeped it in the stream, turning the entire stream into tea.

Taking a sip, the old Gu Master was left speechless for a long time.

His daughter said, "Father, you are not thinking of reneging on your promise, right?"

Only then did the old Gu Master nod reluctantly: "Boy, you passed the first test. But you are still an uncultured mortal who cannot recite poems; you cannot marry my daughter."

The youth scratched his head apprehensively: "Although I haven't recited poems before, I can try."

"Try then, so you cannot say I gave no chance. If you fail, leave and never see my daughter again."

He began reciting: "Sparrows fly low and snakes slither around, ants move their homes as it rains down."

Just as he finished speaking, light rain began to fall from the sky.

The youth continued: "A drop of spring rain is like oil, too much sends us into turmoil."

Scratching his head and cheek, the youth added: "Elm trees droop as farming commences, hair falls as seeds scatter."

The youth's eyes brightened, pointing at the old Gu Master: "Lord took away all the grains, our hungry stomachs are all in pain."

The old Gu Master stomped angrily and stood up, shattering his teacup.

Pointing at the youth, he shouted: "A mere mortal dares to be so audacious!"

His daughter clapped and laughed: "Amazing, this song moved heaven and earth, even making father dance."

Furious to see his daughter side with the youth, the old Gu Master could not retort.

"Good, you passed the second test, but the final one remains. You want to marry my daughter—can you provide a betrothal gift that satisfies me?"

"I will offer all my assets as the betrothal gift," the youth said seriously.

"Let me see them!" The old Gu Master said.

The young man led the old Gu Master to his dilapidated thatched cottage.

He then said: "These are all my assets."

"This leaky old hut?" the old Gu Master pointed disdainfully.

"This tattered straw mat?" The old Gu Master tossed it aside.

"These stone stools?" The old Gu Master kicked and shattered them.

Just then, from a shattered rock, a beautiful moon-like Gu worm flew out leisurely, shining brightly.

The old Gu Master was stunned.

The youth was equally stunned, having casually picked the rock from the mountain base.

His daughter cheered: "This Gu worm is surely enough for the betrothal gift, right?"

Speechless, the old Gu Master could only rub his nose and marry his daughter to the mortal lad.

Fang Yuan had heard this story before; it was indeed amusing.

It portrayed a conflict between a mortal and a Gu Master that ended in the mortal's victory.

The youth overcame three hurdles to win the Gu Master beauty. That the old Gu Master never used brute force defied logic, yet reflected a mortal's longing for happiness and a better life.

"An interesting story. Thank you, Fairy Si Liu, for answering my doubts," Fang Yuan said politely.

Qiao Si Liu smiled: "No need to be so polite, just call me Si Liu."

"Having enjoyed our tea, let us recite poetry," Lun Fei said, his gaze and tone turning chilly toward Fang Yuan.

He rose and walked outside the pavilion, reciting:

Stepping into society as an ignorant youngster, step by step I walk by myself.

But tonight I do not drink alone, because my dream beauty is here under the moon.

Yet Fang Yuan neither looked at her nor showed hostility to Lun Fei, quietly sipping tea.

A trace of disappointment flashed past Qiao Si Liu's eyes.

# Chapter 1319: Poem Competition

"You are too modest, Lun Fei. I also have a poem," Luo Mu Zi said.

"Oh? We would love to hear it," Qiao Si Liu smiled with anticipation.

Luo Mu Zi fell silent briefly before reciting:

Climbed mountains to seek immortality, Danger present in every step.

Dust specks float like light, dark Gu lurk in heart.

A dream like golden jade, thousands of years of loneliness.

Five regions and nine heavens, everything is in one breath.

The five-character poem's profound conception immediately moved the Gu Immortals.

Silence filled the pavilion as the immortals quietly ruminated over the poem.

She then turned her sight towards Fang Yuan.

Fang Yuan's expression was unexpectedly strange!

"Qi Jue's Five Character Poem? How? Demon Immortal Qi Jue's grotto-heaven shouldn't appear until dream realms flourish in the chaotic war!"

Demon Immortal Qi Jue was an Olden Antiquity rank eight powerhouse who had fought Limitless Demon Venerable three times, achieving a win, draw, and loss.

"That shouldn't be."

"Qi Jue's Five Character Poem is engraved inside his grotto-heaven. How could Luo Mu Zi know it now?"

'Could it be, he has already entered Qi Jue grotto heaven?!'

Qi Jue's grotto-heaven held his true inheritance. On par with Sword Immortal Bo Qing, he far outclassed even Hei Fan!

Intense killing intent rose in Fang Yuan's mind once again.

Oblivious to Fang Yuan's thoughts, Luo Mu Zi cast him a challenging look: "I wonder what masterpiece Wu Yi Hai has? We eagerly anticipate it."

"Naturally," Lun Fei chimed in. "Lord Wu Yi Hai has noble origins and rich Eastern Sea experiences. I cannot match his scholarly attainment."

Knowing their intent, Qiao Si Liu did not protect Fang Yuan, encouraging him instead: "I also look forward to your poem; it will surely be unique."

Pressured by everyone, Fang Yuan rubbed his nose with a forced smile: "You overestimate me, friends. I don't know how to compose poetry."

Unfortunately, the one she was facing was Fang Yuan.

Fang Yuan remained unmoved, fully aware of the relationship between Wu and Qiao clans and their higher-ups' schemes.

Possessing this insight, Fang Yuan held the strategic high ground, viewing Luo Mu Zi and Lun Fei as mere clowns.

Smiling inwardly at these thoughts, Fang Yuan said: "Then I shall recite one; please don't laugh."

At the next moment, the immortals heard Fang Yuan's poem —

"Oh great sea, you are made of water."

"Oh horse, you have four legs."

"Oh beauty, you have large eyes and a mouth!"

The poem ended.

The entire pavilion was silent!

All smiles, Fang Yuan looked at Qiao Si Liu: "Is Fairy Si Liu satisfied?"

"Heh... hehe..." Qiao Si Liu gave a forced laugh. "Truly a special poem... I have never heard anything like it. It is worthy of your creation... and quite amusing upon reflection."

# Chapter 1320: Please 'Evaluate'

Fang Yuan looked at the two: "How was it? Not bad, right?"

"Not bad?!"

Fang Yuan smiled: "Though born of sudden inspiration, true masterpieces are made this way. I still welcome your constructive feedback."

"This poem is... clear, accessible, and easy to read..." Luo Mu Zi stammered, his face twisting as if he might vomit.

Fang Yuan nodded smilingly, turning to Lun Fei: "What do you think?"

Under Fang Yuan's mocking gaze, Lun Fei's lips twitched as he forced out: "It is a good poem."

Raising his brows, Fang Yuan refused to let him off: "What is good about it?"

Qiao Si Liu smoothed things over with a smile: "Next is rock dissecting; perhaps you will reap great gains."

The Gu Immortals selected from Qiao Si Liu's varied rocks, dissecting them on the spot to search for Gu worms.

Vying secretly against Fang Yuan, they nearly coughed blood in frustration as he held first place throughout.

When the moon festival concluded, night had grown deep.

"Wu Yi Hai is a complete boor! Can that garbage even be called a poem?!" Luo Mu Zi fumed.

"Yet Fairy Si Liu favors him!" Lun Fei gritted his teeth.

"Hmph, what favor? His only worth is his identity," Luo Mu Zi said enviously.

Lun Fei sneered with a sinister glint: "We needn't act ourselves. Fairy Si Liu has many pursuers. Inform that person—he will be enraged she didn't invite him."

"You mean that Chi clan fellow?" Luo Mu Zi's expression turned complex.

Though Luo Mu Zi loathed Chi Shang, Qiao Si Liu's foremost pursuer, he was willing to borrow his strength against Wu Yi Hai.

"Although Wu Yi Hai won against Xia Fei Kuai, it was because he relied on his knowledge of the enemy. If he was strong, why would he have to discuss any conditions with that Mountain Moving Old Monster, he could have directly seized back Mount Snail. That guy from Chi clan is definitely stronger than Wu Yi Hai, moreover, he hates it when others have any desire towards Fairy Si Liu." Lun Fei continued.

Luo Mu Zi resolved: "Alright, we will inform Chi Shang!"

Qiao Si Liu escorted Fang Yuan a short distance before reluctantly bidding him farewell.

Instead of returning to Qiao clan headquarters, she headed back to the pavilion.

Inside, a Gu Immortal sat on a stone chair, quietly sipping bewitching tea.

Qiao clan's first supreme elder set down his teacup: "Though raised in Eastern Sea, Wu Yi Hai is Wu Du Xiu's son after all. What do you think?"

Her eyes dimming, Qiao Si Liu softly replied: "I agree."

The elder sighed: "For our clan's future, Wu Yi Hai is our greatest opportunity. Do you understand?"

Biting her lip with lingering reluctance, Qiao Si Liu nodded: "I understand."

# Chapter 1321: Can Be Used, But Unreliable

After the festival, Fang Yuan continued roaming outside.

He actively courted Qiao Si Liu, who, despite lingering annoyance over the festival, could not refuse due to clan orders.

Gradually, rumors began to spread —

Wu clan's Wu Yi Hai and Qiao clan's Qiao Si Liu were close, often touring scenic spots together.

Half a month later, Wu Yong summoned Fang Yuan.

"Brother, I have several tasks here—choose one," Wu Yong said straightforwardly.

"Please instruct me, Brother; contributing to the clan is my duty," Fang Yuan replied calmly.

An information path mortal Gu flew from Wu Yong's sleeve, recording three tasks.

The first task was related to Xuan Ming Mountain.

The second task concerned Red Dragon River, whose rapidly rising waters threatened severe flooding if left unchecked.

A section of Red Dragon River flowed through Wu and Qiao clan territories.

The third task was attending Yi clan's second supreme elder's twelve-hundredth birthday banquet.

"Have you decided?" Wu Yong asked after a moment.

Fang Yuan nodded: "I choose the second task. Xuan Ming Mountain likely means clashing with Yang clan Gu Immortals; my strength is modest and I lack counters to their specialized soul path."

"Why not the third?" Wu Yong smiled. "As my brother, your status is ideal, and Yi clan would receive you warmly."

Fang Yuan shook his head, giving a bitter smile: "Brother, spare me. Although it is a birthday banquet, there will definitely be representatives from other super forces. With our Wu clan's current situation, if I go to the banquet, the other Gu Immortals will definitely create difficulties for me. I won't be able to deal with all of them, my own embarrassment is nothing, but more importantly, I would be losing face for Wu clan, that would be too big of a sin."

Wu Yong laughed: "Since you have considered everything, I won't insist. Let us proceed with your choice."

"Brother, if there aren't other matters, I will bid farewell."

As Fang Yuan reached the entrance, Wu Yong asked: "When do you plan to leave?"

Fang Yuan turned at the door: "If Red Dragon River floods, countless lives will suffer. I dare not delay such urgent business; I will pack and depart shortly."

He did not see Wu Yong's confident smile fade once he departed.

"Success." Fang Yuan rejoiced inwardly while maintaining an impassive front, quickly packing and flying north as promised.

Speeding north, he had just crossed Yellow Dragon River when Gu Immortal Wu Fa halted him: "Lord Wu Yi Hai, slow down! I bring new orders from the first supreme elder."

"Oh!" Wu Fa heaved a deep sigh, his aged face filled with anxiety: "There is truth in the saying, when it rains, it pours, there has been an accident over on the super Gu formation's end. Ba clan has been creating difficulties for our clan, Elder Wu Bei, who was stationed there, is injured and is unable to stabilize the situation. Lord, didn't you want to be sent back there? The opportunity is here!"

"The first supreme elder decided to recall Elder Wu Bei to recuperate and send you to take command of the super Gu formation."

Fang Yuan frowned in apparent surprise: "How could this happen? I still..."

Subconsciously glancing northwest, he hesitated: "But Red Dragon River's crisis is severe and requires urgent handling."

"First supreme elder has already made proper arrangements for this matter, Lord Wu Yi Hai, you do not need to worry. Lord, you need to quickly go and stabilize the situation over there. This is a letter Gu that Lord Wu Yong has personally sent you, you can directly go to Yi Tian Mountain without returning to Wu clan." Wu Fa handed an information path mortal Gu to Fang Yuan as he spoke.

Wu Yong's voice confirmed the severe situation at the giant dream realm, ordering Fang Yuan to deploy there immediately.

Fang Yuan sighed deeply: "Looks like I have no choice."

"Please make haste, Lord Wu Yi Hai." Elder Wu Fa looked anxious.

Fang Yuan shook his head, casting another glance northwest before veering northeast.

He sneered toward the northwest, where Qiao clan's headquarters, Da Peng Mountain, lay.

Elder Wu Fa returned to Wu Yi Mountain and reported to Wu Yong: "First supreme elder, Lord Wu Yi Hai is heading to the super Gu formation."

In his study, Wu Yong stood upright, wielding a calligraphy brush with vigorous strokes.

He nodded slightly to Wu Fa and paused his brush.

Five large words were written on the paper: Can be used, but unreliable.

"When I was young, Mother asked my opinion of Qiao clan, and I gave those five words—I still recall her smile," Wu Yong sighed. "Pity my brother hasn't realized this."

# Chapter 1322: Restrictions of the Righteous Path

Southern Border, Yi Tian Mountain, inside the super Gu formation.

"Wu An (Wu Liao) pays respects to Lord Wu Yi Hai." Wu clan Gu Immortals Wu Liao and Wu An bowed respectfully.

Fang Yuan nodded: "Sit and explain. Elder Wu Bei was injured so heavily?"

Ba clan had long been eager to challenge Wu clan amid its troubles; their leader here, Old Treeman Ba De, finally made his move.

Refusing to back down, Wu Bei stepped forward, only to be baited into a spar by Ba De.

The spar ended predictably in Ba clan's victory and Wu clan's defeat.

Fang Yuan sneered inwardly while maintaining a concerned look: "I see. With Wu Bei gone and me here, we will maintain the status quo—I won't move unless provoked."

"If there is nothing else, you may leave. I am fatigued from the journey," Fang Yuan waved them off.

Wu Liao departed immediately, but Wu An lingered, whispering: "Lord, I have something to report..."

As Fang Yuan expected, Wu An brought up the dream realm business shared between Wu clan and the other super clans.

"Tensions are high and other clans are uneasy—should we pause this business temporarily?" Wu An asked worriedly.

Fang Yuan paused: "No need to worry, things continue as before. If that is all, you may leave."

"Yes, Lord." Relieved joy flashed across Wu An's face as he bowed out.

Ba De was shrewd; despite striking out, he avoided targeting the dream realm business, knowing its profits were shared with other clans.

Having secured his position, Fang Yuan turned to the dream realm. Fang Yuan sighed inwardly, but quickly composed himself and inspected the dream realm before him.

After inspecting it, Fang Yuan entered the shining bright-blue dream realm.

His vision changed.

On a gentle slope, a middle-aged Gu Immortal stood with his back to Fang Yuan: "My son, do you know why our Tu clan dominates this mountain range?"

Inspecting himself, Fang Yuan found he had turned into a child.

"Father, I don't know." He replied after giving it a thought.

"Formation path!" The middle-aged Gu Immortal's voice rose with immense pride.

Turning around, he revealed resolute eyes: "Right! Formation path."

"Among the numerous paths, formation path may be the most complicated. Son, starting today, I will impart its essence and guide your cultivation," he said with a burning gaze.

He shook his head: "Studying is not enough; you must excel and surpass all your peers and even young Gu Immortals. Because you are my, Tu Shi Cheng's son, and the clan's future leader!"

# Chapter 1323: Formation Path Contains Countless Paths

"Tu Shi Cheng? I have never heard of this name..." Fang Yuan thought.

The middle-aged Gu Immortal sat down and patted the ground beside him. "Come, sit by me."

Tu Shi Cheng continued: "Son, I tell you all this because formation path is one of history's longest-standing paths. Though not as ancient as space path and time path, it arose alongside qi path and wisdom path, pre-dating transformation path in seniority."

Tu Shi Cheng then asked: "The essence of transformation path is projecting countless paths; son, what do you think is formation path's essence?"

Though Fang Yuan's formation path attainment was ordinary, he knew the answer to this simple, common question.

He replied: "Formation path contains countless paths."

"Haha, good answer!" Tu Shi Cheng praised him lavishly and explained further: "Formation path constructs Gu formations using Gu worms from space and time path, as well as metal, wood, water, fire, and others. Because of this, formation path is arguably the most complex of all paths."

"Setting up a Gu formation is difficult because it may require Gu worms from many other paths. Thus, cultivating formation path requires understanding other paths; even if not deep, basic knowledge is necessary, and at minimum, thorough mastery of the Gu worms used."

"Son, since you became a Gu Master today, I will give you your first Gu worm." Tu Shi Cheng opened his palm, revealing a small Gu.

Resembling a ladybug the size of a little finger, it had a round, glossy carapace with a cute, glistening yellow shine.

"This is formation heart Gu. Refine it first," Tu Shi Cheng said.

With Tu Shi Cheng's help, Fang Yuan readily refined this rank one Gu.

Formation heart Gu opened its wings, flapping merrily as it circled Fang Yuan.

"Alright, let's play a game." Tu Shi Cheng smiled, producing four Gu worms.

"They are all rank one Gu on temporary loan. Use your formation heart Gu as the core, select Gu worms from these, and arrange them into a Gu formation."

Fang Yuan's eyebrows slightly rose, glancing at Tu Shi Cheng in surprise.

They were of earth path, water path, wind path and fire path.

The unrecognized one was the earth path Gu worm.

"To construct a Gu formation, I must understand these Gu worms first. Formation heart Gu is clear, but what does this earth path Gu do?" Fang Yuan prepared to test its ability.

But this action was stopped by Tu Shi Cheng.

Tu Shi Cheng solemnly intervened: "Sense it with your heart, listen to your instincts, and rely on your feelings. Construct the Gu formation by intuition. Remember, you only have one chance."

Fang Yuan was immediately dumbfounded.

# Chapter 1324: Fang Yuan's Two Trump Cards

Though Tu Shi Cheng was the boy's father, he was utterly unreliable.

Yet since the dream realm was structured this way, Fang Yuan calmed himself and considered how to proceed as Tu Shi Cheng instructed.

Fang Yuan asked: "Must I use all four Gu worms?"

"Of course not, but you must select at least two to set up a Gu formation," Tu Shi Cheng replied.

"I know nothing about this earth path Gu, so it is better to skip it." Fang Yuan thought, narrowing his choices to three.

"Hurry, don't overthink—rely on your feelings!" Seeing Fang Yuan hesitate, Tu Shi Cheng frowned and urged: "You have three breaths of time."

A thought crossed Fang Yuan's mind: "Must I use unravel dream?"

Though he had more uses of unravel dream now, he chose not to squander them on the first layer.

Having refined the yellow ladybug, he channeled primeval essence into it; it hovered before him, glowing with pale-yellow light.

He chose the rank one water path Gu worm.

The reason was simple: while his fire and wind attainments were ordinary, he was a grandmaster in water path!

The water path Gu activated smoothly, bathed in yellow light as it circled the formation heart Gu, swooping up and down.

Fang Yuan chose wind path.

The wind path Gu worm joined in, circling the formation heart Gu along the outer perimeter while the water path Gu stayed closer to the core.

However, a trace of gloominess and disappointment flashed past Tu Shi Cheng's eyes.

Focused on setting up the formation, Fang Yuan did not notice.

"Rely on your feelings, stop hesitating," Tu Shi Cheng urged impatiently.

Fang Yuan gritted his teeth; even without the urging, he knew he had to act.

As a newly awakened Gu Master in this dream, even with A grade aptitude, activating three Gu simultaneously severely drained his primeval essence.

"Let's try this, then." Gritting his teeth, Fang Yuan activated the fire path Gu and added it into the budding structure.

But soon, his hope was ruined.

The addition of the fire path Gu triggered an immediate chain reaction.

The fire path Gu fused with the wind path Gu, surging in power and clashing violently with the inner water path Gu, causing an explosion.

Formation heart Gu was instantly destroyed, while the rest were severely damaged—water and fire path Gu were near death, and wind path Gu was heavily injured.

"You have failed!" Tu Shi Cheng said coldly, his expression darkening. "You truly disappoint me."

Fang Yuan's vision shifted as he was expelled from the dream realm.

Returning to his physical body, Fang Yuan shook slightly as his complexion paled.

Inspecting himself, Fang Yuan found his soul injuries far more severe than anticipated.

Fang Yuan crushed a guts Gu, greatly relieving the trauma. After crushing a second, his soul was fully healed.

With guts Gu, Fang Yuan feared neither dream realm failure nor soul damage.

Unrushed, he used connecting heaven Gu to send his divine sense into treasure yellow heaven.

Fang Yuan soon bought The Encyclopedia of Earth Path Gu Worms from an earth path Gu Immortal.

He also purchased additional reference materials and several mortal formation path inheritances.

From these materials, he identified the earth path mortal Gu: an early Late Antiquity Era worm that had gone extinct once its refinement materials were depleted. The records outlined its abilities, and from another source, Fang Yuan even acquired the earth path mortal Gu's recipe.

# Chapter 1325: Four Elements Concept

Next, Fang Yuan read those mortal formation path inheritances.

This enriched some of his formation path foundation.

His search had been targeted, and he discovered that a prevailing concept existed in the Late Antiquity Era's formation path.

This concept held that the four basic elements—earth, water, wind, and fire—offered the greatest stability and inclusivity for constructing basic Gu formations.

This valuable information gave Fang Yuan the direct key to clearing the dream realm's first stage.

He sighed inwardly: "Tu Shi Cheng was deceitful, claiming I only needed at least two when all four were required."

Even so, he did not know how to arrange the four Gu around formation heart Gu to create an effective formation.

On his second attempt, Fang Yuan activated all four mortal Gu simultaneously alongside formation heart Gu.

All four mortal Gu self-detonated, injuring Fang Yuan and expelling him from the dream realm.

On the third attempt, Fang Yuan activated the earth path Gu first and water path Gu second, but failed again.

After a fourth, fifth, and sixth attempt... Fang Yuan finally succeeded on the seventh.

The four mortal Gu orbited formation heart Gu: water and fire followed an elliptical path, weaving near and far, while earth hovered stationary below and wind stayed motionless above.

Under formation heart Gu's control, the four Gu generated a mysterious force radiating hazy rainbow light.

The hill, sky, and land slowly faded from Fang Yuan's vision.

The first stage ended and the second began.

Inside sat a gaunt, pitch-black panther, its eyes gleaming with feral hunger.

Standing outside, Tu Shi Cheng said: "I give you five minutes to arrange these Gu worms into a Gu formation. When time is up, the panther will be released. I will not intervene; you must rely on your Gu formation to resist it."

With time limited, Fang Yuan calmed himself and inspected his Gu worms.

Though only an ordinary beast, the caged panther was lethal against his frail child's body.

He had five rank one Gu: formation heart Gu, plus one each from earth, wind, water, and fire paths.

Fang Yuan began to try.

Aided by his experience from the first stage, Fang Yuan worked proficiently.

The first attempt failed quickly; backlash made Fang Yuan cough up blood in the dream, but fortunately the Gu were unharmed.

"It seems I can keep trying until the five-minute limit expires?"

The second attempt also failed.

Though time remained, he could not continue because a Gu worm perished in the second failure.

Had it been another mortal Gu, he could adapt, but it was formation heart Gu.

"Father, my Gu worm was destroyed. Can you give me another formation heart Gu?" Fang Yuan asked.

Tu Shi Cheng shook his head ruthlessly: "In battle, who would give you a substitute? Son, you disappoint me; you have no chances left."

When time expired, the small cage opened and the panther sprang, biting instantly into Fang Yuan's throat.

Tu Shi Cheng shook his head, sighing: "You are unworthy of being my son."

"Refusing to give the solution even at the end—is Tu Shi Cheng righteous or demonic?" Returning to his body after being expelled, Fang Yuan felt deeply gloomy.

Healing his soul with guts Gu, he resumed his exploration.

With each failure, Fang Yuan was killed by the panther, enduring the excruciating agony of being eaten alive.

"At this rate, the cost will grow too steep—must I use unravel dream?"

He entered the dream realm and continued to attempt it.

There was a way!

# Chapter 1329: Fang Yuan Admitting Defeat

Chi clan's area, in the study room.

Fang Yuan remained wary of Black Tigress's trump card.

Countless tortoise shell thoughts circulated without gaps, forming a tight defense.

Forced to retreat before so many tortoise shells, Black Tigress heaved with rage.

"This tortoise transformation really suits you, Lord Wu Yi Hai." She grinned with cruel killing intent.

"However, don't think my methods are just these. Take this!"

With that, Black Tigress opened her mouth toward Fang Yuan and stuck out her tiny tongue.

But Fang Yuan felt a chill down his spine, he suffered a heavy injury.

Turning to look, he saw a tiny hole in his shell.

Though small, the hole was deep; the wound spread outward, hissing with rising black smoke.

# Chapter 1353: Tiger Lick

Black Tigress's bizarre method bypassed even the divination tortoise's defense.

Thinking of this, Fang Yuan did not hold back, quickly activating rank seven Immortal Gu Precaution.

Fang Yuan had already incorporated this rule path Immortal Gu into vajra shell.

The tortoise shell thoughts hardened while the divination tortoise's body darkened with a metallic sheen.

Black Tigress saw this and her expression changed, she licked again.

Though they were far apart, Fang Yuan still suffered injuries.

Another fist-sized hole appeared on the tortoise shell; the injury was minor and emitted no black smoke.

Unresigned, Black Tigress snorted: "In that case, I will attack there!"

Fang Yuan immediately felt his tortoise head go numb.

Fang Yuan quickly placed his head into the shell.

"Damn it!" Black Tigress's eyes flared with rage at the sight.

Shamelessly, Fang Yuan pulled his head, limbs, and tail entirely into the shell.

Multiplying tortoise shell thoughts continued spinning, expanding his defensive range.

Black Tigress licked the tortoise shell continuously, to little effect.

He was thinking rapidly about Black Tigress' killer move.

Thinking of this, Fang Yuan activated his Gu worms, shrouding the divination tortoise in thick fog.

Suspecting a trick, Black Tigress lashed her tongue toward Fang Yuan.

Fang Yuan was hit again.

After a moment's hesitation, Black Tigress extended her tongue and licked again.

Another hole appeared on Fang Yuan's shell.

As the tortoise's redness faded, a strange scent filled the air.

Black Tigress licked again and nearly gagged in disgust, frowning: "So salty!"

Black Tigress stopped, fuming: "He is probing to counter my move, not fighting back. Damn it!"

Realizing this, Black Tigress abandoned the move and switched to other long-range methods.

Though Fang Yuan had offensive moves, using them under Wu Yi Hai's identity would risk exposure.

Ba De's expression chilled further as he transmitted: "Wu Yi Hai, I heard you have two more transformations. Why hold back? Kill her and reinforce the others! Or do you truly have a relationship with White Rabbit and can't bear to strike?"

Fang Yuan heard Ba De's transmissions but ignored them completely.

"Purple Mountain True Monarch must have trump cards, and the righteous path is far from desperate."

"I should conceal my identity and await an opportunity. Perhaps I can reap immense gains!"

# Chapter 1355: Crucial Traitor

# Chapter 1356: Fang Yuan Salvages The Situation!

Earth, water, wind, fire—a Gu formation constructed from earth, water, wind, and fire path Immortal Gu.

Because he was a formation path grandmaster!

# Chapter 1360: Fang Yuan's Desperate Situation

# Chapter 1361: Purple Mountain True Monarch versus Duke Long

Killing intent surged, two figures flew rapidly between dream realms.

Purple Mountain True Monarch against Duke Long!

The two rank eight Gu Immortals clashed: one a first-generation split soul of Spectral Soul Demon Venerable cultivated for a hundred thousand years, the other a legendary Heavenly Court figure possessing quasi-rank nine power.

Thousands of fiery rocks charged at Duke Long like a meteorite storm.

Duke Long took the attack head on, not dodging.

The cloud light held steady, but Duke Long soon discovered a fire burning in his mind.

The flames consumed his thoughts as quickly as they arose.

Without thoughts to sustain his cloud light, his defense vanished.

Fiery rocks struck Duke Long's towering, iron-like frame with resounding crashes, shattering like eggs into explosions of sparks and stone fragments.

Radiating an overwhelming aura like a humanoid dragon, Duke Long advanced relentlessly through Purple Mountain True Monarch's barrage.

"Consecutive move."

He asked Purple Mountain True Monarch: "You once said the sovereign immortal body possessed a huge flaw. What is it?"

Inside Shadow Sect's blessed land.

"Hope, huh..." Purple Mountain True Monarch knew he could not survive this battle. In his final moments, his gaze grew hazy.

More than a hundred thousand years ago.

That year, Shadow Sect was established, the first generation split souls were known as Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Azure, Blue, and Purple.

Many years passed again.

"The higher our cultivation and the stronger Shadow Sect becomes, the more heaven's will targets us. At this rate, we will face huge problems."

"Resolving Azure's matter is not hard; I can refine wisdom sword Immortal Gu. As for heaven's will... I will find a way," Purple said, squinting.

Purple entered deep seclusion, trying his best to find a way.

Finally, he found a method.

"Assimilate with heaven's will? Temporarily become part of heaven's will?"

"Though dangerous, the idea is sound—we will infiltrate the enemy and learn parts of heaven's will's plans."

"However, prolonged assimilation risks heaven's will taking me over, making me truly become entirely part of it."

After a long and difficult deduction.

The purple gold rock broke as Purple woke up.

A young girl wearing elegant clothes along with a muscular female servant.

Purple looked at himself, smiling bitterly.

Even without these clues, just Spectral Soul's own true inheritances were an enormous gain.

Spectral Soul Demon Venerable had slaughtered five regions' life forms with soul path methods. His soul devouring absorbed a prey's memories and experiences, while his split soul technique created generations of Shadow Sect members. # Chapter 1382: Wu Yong's Anger and Hatred

# Chapter 1383: Hidden Confrontation

Western Desert held the bulk of Shadow Sect's remaining resources, as the other four regions had already been plundered clean.

# Chapter 1384: Respective Trials

# Chapter 1385: Fang Yuan's Judgment

It was Hei Lou Lan.

Beyond Southern Border's righteous path, we must watch out for Heavenly Court immortals lying in ambush!" Fang Yuan warned heavily.

# Chapter 1386: Wu Yong's Arrival!

"Heaven's will can actually infiltrate externally manifested dream realms."

However, when Fang Yuan's group reappeared, their expressions turned extremely unsightly.

# Chapter 1387: Heavenly Eagle's Escape

"Air lock?!"

Fang Yuan frowned deeply.

As Fang Yuan gritted his teeth, Wu Yong's voice came: "You must be thinking of how to break my killer move, right? No harm in telling you: once set, it cannot be moved, but it spans a hundred thousand li around us. It also has a time limit—as of now, eight minutes remain."

Fang Yuan's heart sank at this information.

Bombarding relentlessly, Clear Jade Dripping Wind Tiny Bamboo Building finally caught up.

Immortal killer move — Finger Wind Dragon!
