Wu Yong recognized the killer move: reverse flow protection seal!

This revealed the secret to him: Fang Yuan was Liu Guan Yi!

Seeing Wu Yong's shock, Fang Yuan thought: "Heavenly Court hasn't informed Wu Yong of my Liu Guan Yi identity—or perhaps they aren't aware either?"

Against a rank eight great expert, only reverse flow protection seal allowed Fang Yuan to stand his ground; any other method meant death.

Although Wu Yong suffered a setback, his gaze towards Fang Yuan became incomparably fiery.

"Good, mobilizing the entire righteous path so I could fight you alone was not wasted," Wu Yong muttered, controlling the Immortal Gu House to bombard Fang Yuan in pursuit.

Although air lock's effect on Fang Yuan had reflected back to Wu Yong, the eagle remained burdened, while Wu Yong inside the bamboo building was completely unaffected.

Wu Yong then directed the Immortal Gu House to ram the upper extreme heavenly eagle.

Fang Yuan sighed and moved forward to intercept the Immortal Gu House.

Wu Yong chuckled, and flew out of the Immortal Gu House to face Fang Yuan.

Simultaneously, Clear Jade Dripping Wind Tiny Bamboo Building targeted the upper extreme heavenly eagle.

The upper extreme heavenly eagle quickly fell into a disadvantage against the Immortal Gu House.

Wu Yong divided his focus, suppressing Fang Yuan while bombarding the eagle with killer moves.

Wu Yong charged forward: "With me here, don't even think of releasing them to use Omni-directional Travel!"

Fang Yuan's vision shifted, trapping him inside a strange battlefield unable to escape.

"Surrender and offer all your cultivation accumulations, and I can spare your life, Fang Yuan," Wu Yong gave his ultimatum.

# Chapter 1388: This is Feng Jiu Ge!

Dressed in a red and white robe, he stood straight as a sword. With sword-sharp brows, flashing eyes, and a gentle smile, he radiated an elegant yet invincible aura.

He was the renowned Central Continent Gu Immortal, pillar of Spirit Affinity House, and rank seven sound path expert capable of battling rank eight—Feng Jiu Ge!

Restraining his surprise, Wu Yong sneered at Feng Jiu Ge: "A Central Continent Gu Immortal actually dares appear before me. Good, good!"

In that peculiar space within Luo Po Valley's Thieving Heaven true inheritance, a twist of fate had led Fang Yuan to save Feng Jiu Ge.

Immortal killer move — Ancient Year Beast Transformation!

Transforming into an ancient desolate beast, he watched the formation unleash brilliant light to blast an opening into the tributary.

Fang Yuan went in immediately.

The opening closed behind him within breaths.

# Chapter 1431: Wild Gu Come

"I am in the River of Time again." Fang Yuan sighed.

Opening his immortal aperture, he released the immemorial year monkey.

Fang Yuan transformed into an ancient year monkey, floating beside his far larger companion. Though his dao marks had converted to time path to adapt, he still avoided direct contact with the River of Time's water.

"Let's go," Fang Yuan ordered, and the immemorial year monkey began swimming.

However, despite using hundred and eighty slaves, Fang Yuan's diminished soul foundation made commanding the beast difficult.

"Even in calm conditions, enslavement strains my soul heavily. In an intense battle, I might lose control over it."

This was Fang Yuan's first time entering in his physical body.

Previously, he had only sent his will via Spring Autumn Cicada; witnessing the river in full was eye-opening.

Physical entry typically required deep time path attainment, but Fang Yuan managed it using transformation path and his inheritances.

Guided by Purple Mountain True Monarch's inheritance, an intensifying resonance led Fang Yuan straight toward Red Lotus's true inheritance.

Aside from the treacherous river itself, Heavenly Court's pursuit and ambushes posed the greatest threat.

A violent current erupted from the river.

"This is a sudden spring." Fang Yuan's pupils shrunk slightly.

A direct hit from a sudden spring carved time path dao marks onto the victim, risking death or drained lifespan.

Lacking methods to handle sudden springs, Fang Yuan shifted behind the immemorial year monkey's head for shielding.

While Fang Yuan navigated the river, three Gu Immortals arrived at the Western Desert tributary.

They were Feng Jiu Ge and two rank eight Gu Immortals from Heavenly Court.

Fairy Zi Wei planned to use Fang Yuan to find Red Lotus's true inheritance.

"Dream realms!" Feng Jiu Ge and the others landed, staring helplessly at the dream realm defensive line.

"Dream realms shift constantly; a gap will open soon for us to enter."

"Besides, Lord Huang Shi is inside the River of Time. As the most skilled aquatic combatant there in ten millennia, Fang Yuan is no match for him."

The immemorial year monkey growled, its body covered in wounds.

The sudden springs packed immense power, rivaling rank seven to eight killer moves, with some even carrying rank nine might.

"The monkey is heavily injured, yet my methods cannot heal it," Fang Yuan sighed inwardly.

Healing methods from other paths were restricted here, while Fang Yuan's sole time path option, Man as Before, only worked on humans.

Sudden springs were merely the first hurdle; Fang Yuan still faced dark web spiders, one finger flow sharks, and a blade river segment before reaching Red Lotus's true inheritance.

"Sudden spring river segment?" Lord Huang Shi frowned at the waters ahead.

"Lady Zi Wei says Fang Yuan is right ahead." Eyes gleaming, Lord Huang Shi flew resolutely into the sudden spring river segment.

# Chapter 1432: Huang Shi's Pursuit

A massive spring erupted from the tranquil river surface.

"Hmph." Unfazed, Lord Huang Shi let brilliant light shine from his head at the crucial moment.

Instantly restored to peak condition, he retreated and caused the sudden spring to miss completely.

"This sudden spring packs the power of a rank eight killer move; even I would suffer heavy injuries if struck."

"Fang Yuan chose this route to trouble me—a good plan."

"However..." Lord Huang Shi frowned. "No matter how lucky Fang Yuan is, he cannot avoid every sudden spring. How did he pass them? Did he use reverse flow protection seal constantly?"

Lord Huang Shi never expected Fang Yuan to enslave an immemorial year monkey as a shield.

Hei Fan had concealed his weakness, so Heavenly Court never deduced that Fang Yuan could lure immemorial year beasts.

Minutes later, Lord Huang Shi flew out of the sudden spring river segment.

Lord Huang Shi shifted direction, accelerating toward Fang Yuan.

"Dark web spider!" Lord Huang Shi muttered grimly.

Before him sat a huge, pale-white spider, motionless on a massive web.

"Fang Yuan wants to use this danger to force my retreat?" Snorting coldly, Lord Huang Shi flew into the huge crystal nest.

Any existence at rank seven or below touching the thread had their time frozen, paralyzed until devoured by the approaching dark web spider.

"As long as I avoid the peaceful time threads, I can pass safely," Lord Huang Shi thought, just as a deafening explosion shattered the air like collapsing heaven and earth.

Alerted, the dark web spider fixed its hundred and eighty compound eyes on Lord Huang Shi!

"It must be Fang Yuan's trap!"

Yet his path was obstructed by traps of sound waves, frost, and flames.

Greatly hindered, Lord Huang Shi was soon overtaken by the spider, locking them in intense combat.

After an intense battle, Lord Huang Shi broke free from the dark web spider and left its territory.

"Damn Fang Yuan, how many traps did he set?! Such meticulous planning!"

Not long after, he entered a weird river segment.

"What is this? A strong sword and blade path aura in this river segment?" Lord Huang Shi frowned in surprised suspicion.

"Traveling upstream into the past, I have gone back a hundred thousand years—to the Late Antiquity Era!"

"I know! Western Desert's Xi Yuan cultivated sword path, created sword abyss, and slew three rank eight Gu Immortals. Then there was the blade path demonic immortal Dao Jiu Lang, whose overwhelming might rampaged through Western Desert and shattered the expulsion formation. Their legendary duel wrought massive destruction!"

Lingering killer moves from their duel still echoed across the waters, ready to strike without warning.

"Fang Yuan's group actually came here? Are they seeking death?!" Gritting his teeth, Lord Huang Shi entered.

The immemorial year monkey battled amid turbulent waves, covered in wounds and staining the surrounding water red with blood.

Astride the immemorial year monkey, Bai Ning Bing, Fairy Miao Yin, and the others defended themselves.

"I finally found you all!" Lord Huang Shi charged ahead without hesitation.

# Chapter 1433: How Shameless Could It Get?!

Seeing Bai Ning Bing and the others trapped helplessly in the blade river segment, Lord Huang Shi would not let such an opportunity slip by.

Immortal killer move — Sun Moon Divine Shuttle.

Lord Huang Shi thrust both palms forward, unleashing a tempest of arrowhead shuttles at the immortals.

Sun moon divine shuttle was immensely powerful; despite defending themselves, Bai Ning Bing and the others were heavily suppressed.

Enraged, the immemorial year monkey growled and launched itself from the river, leaping into the sky.

Sun moon divine shuttles pierced its flesh with bleeding holes, but to the colossal beast, these were merely superficial wounds.

Its massive hands swiped at Lord Huang Shi, whipping up fierce gales.

Feeling that terrifying power, Lord Huang Shi's eyelids twitched in shock.

"This immemorial year monkey is real, not Fang Yuan's transformation?!"

Lacking melee strength, even as a Heavenly Court rank eight Gu Immortal, Lord Huang Shi was forced to retreat before the beast.

A yellow soil rock appeared above his head, moving sluggishly and slowing the flow of time around him.

Dust and sand drifted from the rock, instantly settling upon the immemorial year monkey.

Under the yellow dust's influence, the monkey's time slowed rapidly, drastically extending its leap.

A massive wave surged skyward, heading directly for Lord Huang Shi.

From within the pale river wave, a blinding blade light burst forth.

The blade light struck Lord Huang Shi, jarring his body and making him spit blood!

As Huang Shi was injured, the dust shook while the monkey struggled within.

Holding his breath, Lord Huang Shi intensified his killer move, thickening the dust to trap the monkey.

At the crucial moment, a grim Ying Wu Xie prepared to unleash the invincible lead soul into dream.

"Hmm?" But suddenly, Ying Wu Xie lost his target.

"Has Lord Huang Shi already found a way to conceal himself from my soul path senses?"

"Oh? Lady Zi Wei's defensive killer move activated… hehe." Lord Huang Shi snickered coldly.

Sending Lord Huang Shi alone to pursue Fang Yuan, Fairy Zi Wei had naturally prepared countermeasures against lead soul into dream after Heavenly Court's past suffering.

But where was Fang Yuan?

Fang Yuan had not appeared since battle commenced; possessing reverse flow protection seal, he remained Huang Shi's greatest concern.

Just then, another massive wave from the River of Time swept toward him.

"Again?!" Lord Huang Shi was stifled.

The colossal wave struck Lord Huang Shi, forcing him to spit blood once more and worsening his injuries.

"I hold the advantage; Fang Yuan cannot watch from the sidelines forever!" Lord Huang Shi resolved.

Three waves swept towards Lord Huang Shi.

"What? At me again?!" Lord Huang Shi's eyes widened in near disbelief.

"Wait." Lord Huang Shi shook: "Is this the effect of Fang Yuan's luck path methods?"

"Just as sect leader predicted… continue attacking, don't expose any flaws."

Though maintaining grim expressions, Bai Ning Bing and the others conversed in secret.

At the same time, on an island deep under the river.

An image shifted before Fang Yuan, displaying Lord Huang Shi battling the immemorial year monkey.

This was the stone lotus island where Spectral Soul Demon Venerable had obtained the Red Lotus true inheritance—and Fang Yuan had arrived long ago!

Fairy Zi Wei's investigative killer move on Fang Yuan was already dispelled, but Bai Ning Bing and the others could not finish cleansing in time.

Had he brought them, Fang Yuan's traces would be exposed even inside the sovereign immortal aperture.

Having used his companions to deceive Fairy Zi Wei, Fang Yuan had already obtained Red Lotus's true inheritance and exploited this advantage fully.

Red Lotus' true inheritance had the ability to manipulate the nearby river segment.

However, using this ability depleted the stone lotus island's foundation; after this battle, the tattered island would crumble entirely.

"Spectral Soul's will, let me assist you." Seeing the faded will struggling to control the waves, Fang Yuan lent his aid.

A surge of will poured out, infusing into Spectral Soul's will.

Simultaneously, a colossal wave surged across the battlefield.

"This, this, this!" Lord Huang Shi's eyes nearly popped out.

The wave was unprecedentedly vast; even before the blade light and sword qi burst forth, Lord Huang Shi felt mortal danger.

Huang Shi gritted his teeth, expecting the colossal wave to hit the monkey as well and force Fang Yuan out.

"Let's see who lasts longer!" But just as Lord Huang Shi thought this, the wave parted to let the monkey through before crashing entirely toward him.

How shameless could it get?!

# Chapter 1434: Huang Shi's Death

Bypassing the immemorial year monkey, the enormous wave engulfed and attacked Lord Huang Shi.

As an elite rank eight Heavenly Court Gu Immortal, he finally realized the truth.

"Fang Yuan and these people can actually control this river segment?!"

With the towering wave bearing down upon him, Lord Huang Shi's expression turned resolute.

Roaring at the sky, Lord Huang Shi released dazzling yellow light as his auras surged.

The yellow soil rock above him expanded into a hill, suppressing the waters of the River of Time.

Simultaneously, countless ripples of time surged from his body toward Bai Ning Bing's group, deceptively slow yet terrifyingly swift!

"Amazing! He activated four immortal killer moves in an instant," Fang Yuan marveled inwardly.

"He is forcing me out," Fang Yuan murmured, glancing at Spectral Soul's will.

Moreover, Fang Yuan had intentionally left the split soul Ying Wu Xie among them as a precaution against Spectral Soul's will.

Spectral Soul's will laughed heartily: "Fret not, Fang Yuan. This island also conceals supreme sword and blade path killer moves."

"Look—this was Dao Jiu Lang's greatest offensive killer move: Nine-Nine Reincarnation Blades. The nine layers of blade light cycle to attack eighty-one times, possessing the power to slaughter ghosts and deities. Even Dao Jiu Lang used this terrifying move only thrice in his life, each costing a century of lifespan! What I am triggering now is his pinnacle masterpiece from his duel with Xi Yuan!"

Yet he found himself locked down by the sword qi, unable to budge.

"This is Xi Yuan's signature killer move, sword burial abyss! Damn it, damn it!!"

"Am I going to perish here?" Lord Huang Shi felt a strong sense of death.

Spectral Soul's will called out: "Slaying Lord Huang Shi will exhaust the island's foundation, but sparing him allows it to last years."

"Kill him." Fang Yuan's eyes flashed eerily as he commanded without hesitation.

"My sacrifice matters not, but I have failed Heavenly Court's plan and allowed the otherworldly demon Fang Yuan to roam free!"

Lord Huang Shi, Heavenly Court's rank eight time path Gu Immortal, was dead!

# Chapter 1435: Spectral Soul's True Inheritance!

"The Demon Venerables were bound by fate, but an otherworldly demon is free from fate Immortal Gu's shackles. Fang Yuan, as a complete otherworldly demon, you are the greatest hope to destroy fate Immortal Gu—the very inheritor Red Lotus Demon Venerable anticipated most!"

"You have only ten years, Fang Yuan. Do not let Heavenly Court restore fate Immortal Gu, or rescuing our main body will become impossible."

# Chapter 1436: Return

"While I still have strength left, let me speed up your time as a final contribution."

Tang clan.

# Chapter 1437: This Man is Going Against Heaven

"Farewell." Fang Yuan's group bid farewell to the two Tang clan Gu Immortals.

Fang Yuan smiled: "You have escorted us ten thousand li, no need to see us off further."

But our factions differ, and Heavenly Court's pursuit brings tremendous pressure."

"Then I wish you a safe journey." Tang Fang Ming bowed slightly.

"Farewell." Fang Yuan nodded and departed indifferently, the other immortals following behind.

Standing atop the sand dune, Tang Fang Ming and Tang Lan Ke watched Fang Yuan's group shrink into distant dots on the horizon.

Flying onward, Fang Yuan was also thinking about Tang Fang Ming.

In his five-hundred-year memories, Tang Fang Ming was a legendary Western Desert figure!

In Fang Yuan's first life, Shadow Sect successfully defied heaven—Spectral Soul Demon Venerable revived and infiltrated Heavenly Court.

"But what do I do against fate Gu?"

With Spectral Soul's main body captured, Zombie Alliance destroyed, and many fate-defying entities eliminated, restoring fate Gu had become far easier.

Fate Immortal Gu was the executioner's blade hanging above Fang Yuan's head.

"Heaven's will chose me as a tool, but by claiming sovereign immortal fetus Gu, I chose to defy heaven."

Going against heaven?

"Interesting." Fang Yuan smiled silently.

… Western Desert, Tang clan's headquarters.

# Chapter 1440: Great Dream Immortal Venerable Feng Jin Huang

"Hello, call me Lou Lan." Hei Lou Lan smiled, her gaze flickering as she subtly assessed Xue Er.

She thought: "A snowman Gu Immortal? Why approach us? What is Fang Yuan planning?"

Unaware of the marriage proposal, Hei Lou Lan only knew they were ordered to guide Xue Er through Tai Qiu.

"Hei Lou Lan, carry on with your work; I'll take Xue Er to the others."

"Wait, I'll join you. I need to hunt a sharp tusk boar," Hei Lou Lan said, flying over.

Spotting a sharp tusk boar, Hei Lou Lan attacked fiercely with heaven blazing flames.

Under Hei Lou Lan's terrifying assault, the furious sharp tusk boar went into a frenzy before fleeing in defeat.

"Alright, let's continue." Moments later, Hei Lou Lan collected the sharp tusk boar's corpse and its ancient desolate soul.

"Sister Lou Lan, you are amazing!" Xue Er looked at Hei Lou Lan in disbelief.

Hei Lou Lan smiled bitterly: "This is really nothing, in Shadow Sect, I am very ordinary."

Soon, they met up with Fairy Miao Yin and Lady White Rabbit.

"Hello Xue Er." Fairy Miao Yin smiled kindly.

"You are a snowman Gu Immortal? This is the first time I'm… seeing one," Lady White Rabbit said faintly.

Southern Border's renowned Fairy Miao Yin looked enchanting, possessing an alluring face and graceful figure.

Not that she had become scheming, but surrounded by so many beauties, Xue Er felt immense pressure.

"You have met all of us Shadow Sect Gu Immortals. Aside from us, there is one final, special person," Ying Wu Xie said.

"Bai Ning Bing is an ally, not a member, but she possesses the highest battle strength among us."

Soon, they arrived at Bai Ning Bing's location.

"This, this is!" Arriving, Xue Er was shocked to see Bai Ning Bing standing alone on the battlefield, surrounded by a ring of ancient desolate beasts.

"You came just in time, I found a good place." Deactivating the killer move Bai Xiang, Bai Ning Bing approached the immortals.

Bai Ning Bing's beauty and aura was simply breathtaking.

Xue Er thought: "Why is Fang Yuan surrounded by so many talented beauties? No wonder he thinks so little of me."

Lang Ya blessed land, Cloud Cover Continent.

# Chapter 1466: A Bit Weak

A thunderous roar exploded around the hairy man Gu Immortals.

Simultaneously, a hill-sized dragon head charged toward them.

"We're finished!" Drenched in sweat, three hairy man Gu Immortals panicked, one collapsing on the ground.

As death loomed, the three hairy men heard a cold voice: "Useless."

Overjoyed despite the insult, the hairy men cried: "We are here, Fairy Ning Bing, save us!"

In the nick of time, the dragon lady Bai Ning Bing arrived in a flash of white.

An ice wall instantly emerged, shielding the three hairy man Gu Immortals.

Pulling the three hairy men back in retreat, Bai Ning Bing shot cold light from her eyes onto the dragon head.

From that brief clash, she deduced the dragon head was only rank seven level, well within her power to handle.

"The myriad head coiling dragon has countless heads. If more awaken, I will be overwhelmed."

This was not ordinary Tai Qiu, but a dark formation path space.

At this moment, in the outside world of Tai Qiu.

In the skies above, Hei Lou Lan and the others bombarded the hundreds of dragon heads below with relentless attacks.

These dragon heads shared a single body rooted deep underground.

"Aside from the one engaging Bai Ning Bing, there are three rank seven dragon heads! The rest are rank six."

En route, Fang Yuan ordered Ying Wu Xie's group to intervene and stall for time.

"Oh no! More and more dragon heads are awakening."

"When will sect leader arrive?"

"We're deep in Tai Qiu, far from the teleportation formation. He needs time—be careful!"

As Hei Lou Lan narrowly dodged an attack, Ying Wu Xie told Lady White Rabbit and Xue Er: "Stay back and support from range."

Fortunately, the myriad head coiling dragon was immobile and could only defend its territory.

Inside the formation path space, Bai Ning Bing fought desperately, severely restricted by having to protect the three hairy man Gu Immortals.

Just then, an overwhelming aura permeated the area.

A colossal dragon head towering over all others slowly rose.

The immemorial dragon head opened its mouth and inhaled deeply.

Instantly, the world shifted as Ying Wu Xie's group was dragged helplessly into the formation path space.

"The immemorial head!" Bai Ning Bing shuddered, turning to the newcomers with a frown: "Where is Fang Yuan?"

Fortunately, the immemorial dragon head merely trapped the immortals without attacking, fading into the space within moments.

A thousand dragon heads encircled the Shadow Sect immortals.

One hairy man Gu Immortal was the first to die.

Unable to escape in time, Xue Er gasped as several dragon heads surrounded her.

"To think I'd die here!" Powerless, Xue Er closed her eyes for death, only for a dark figure to yank her away.

Mortal peril forced Lady White Rabbit to transform into Black Tigress, saving Xue Er.

"I am not that weakling," Black Tigress sneered, eyeing Xue Er with disdain.

With Black Tigress' help, the scene finally stabilized.

Gradually, Ying Wu Xie and the others noticed the number of dragon heads in the space was dwindling.

"Fang Yuan is here!" Realizing this, the immortals' morale surged.

Suddenly, the formation path space shattered, returning everyone to the outside world.

Rivers of blood soaked the ground, strewn with the corpses of countless fallen dragons.

The immemorial dragon head growled in agony, its former imposing aura shattered.

And Fang Yuan was… everywhere.

"Single thought endless clones." Ying Wu Xie muttered, recognizing Fang Yuan's immortal killer move.

Ignited thought flying rock!

Countless flaming rocks rained onto the myriad head coiling dragon, felling dozens of dragon heads.

Single thought flower blossom!

At Fang Yuan's thought, radiant flowers bloomed across the dragons' bodies.

Spotting Ying Wu Xie's group, the immemorial dragon head redirected its assault toward them.

Fang Yuan's true body emerged, intercepting the dragon head.

Sent flying by the massive force, Fang Yuan rebounded immediately.

Conversely, the battered immemorial dragon head was drenched in blood.

Seizing the chance, the Shadow Sect immortals retreated to safety.

Free of burdens, Fang Yuan clashed directly with the immemorial dragon head.

"This immemorial beast is a bit weak," Fang Yuan sighed, looking down at the severed dragon heads.

# Chapter 1467: The View of a Rank Eight

Fang Yuan stared at the dragon corpse and fallen heads, tallying his gains and losses.

Though possessing rank eight battle strength, immemorial desolate beasts varied in tier; this myriad head coiling dragon was among the weaker ones.

"How should I handle this dragon? Severed of its immemorial head, it is only ancient desolate level, but given time, it will regrow."

Such a rare formation path beast tempted Fang Yuan to relocate it into his developing sovereign immortal aperture.

Regrettably, once rooted, the beast could not be moved—it drew nutrients directly from the earth vein deep underground.

As thoughts clashed, Fang Yuan realized the best solution: Lang Ya Sect!

Just as he prepared to reach out, Lang Ya land spirit contacted him via information path mortal Gu.

Lang Ya land spirit was dazed before shouting: "Great idea!"

Having depleted his contribution points refining numerous Immortal Gu earlier, Fang Yuan needed to replenish them for future refinements.

After settling his loot, Fang Yuan led the immortals back victoriously.

Unfortunately, Fang Yuan's own strength path development conflicted with hers.

"However, I can modify her fire path killer moves for better compatibility, or even adapt strength path killer moves for her," Fang Yuan mused.

Over the next few days, Shadow Sect's immortals recuperated, and Hei Lou Lan's minor injuries steadily healed.

Once successful, Fang Yuan would reward her with the modified immortal killer moves.

Returning to his cloud city, Fang Yuan focused on his primary tasks. Refining heavenly secret Immortal Gu was priority, alongside developing his aperture to feed his Immortal Gu, which nearly exhausted his finances.

In so little time, his ten million immortal essence stones were already dwindling.

"My soul foundation has reached ten million man soul; let's maintain this momentum."

"Having mastered Purple Mountain True Monarch's wisdom path killer moves, next I will modify Bo Qing's sword path methods."

"While modifying Bo Qing's sword path moves, I will also adapt some for Hei Lou Lan. The only issue is that basic development will deplete my finances."

This third gift was the most valuable of the three.

With this, Fang Yuan's basic immortal aperture development temporarily had no lack of funds.

# Chapter 1468: Ice Path Crystal Essence

Southern Border.

A mild rain drizzled amidst chilly winds at dusk over the green mountain ridge.

On a nameless mountain, a massive cone-shaped pine tree had grown for six years.

"Soon, in an hour, I will refine rank seven pine needle Immortal Gu. Six years of hard work…" Rank seven secluded cultivator Zheng Qing thought with anticipation.

Suddenly, a loud sound erupted from deep underground, like the shrieks of countless beasts.

A terrifying earthquake shook the world as if apocalyptic, ripping open huge trenches that spanned millions of li.

As the mountain collapsed, Zheng Qing reached his limit and was forced back into human form.

Within the trench lay a mountain-sized orange crystal rock, riddled with holes ceaselessly spewing yellow smoke.

Breathing heavily, Zheng Qing recognized it immediately through his Genesis Lotus true inheritance.

"This is earth path crystal essence from 'Hu' Land! A rank eight immortal material… wait!" Zheng Qing's investigative killer move looked further.

His eyes widened as he shouted: "Did I see wrongly? Beyond earth path crystal essence, there are jade scales, earth hole traveling flame, spring thunder condensed dewdrops…"

Northern Plains, Lang Ya blessed land.

Fang Yuan cultivated his sword path killer moves.

Sword path killer move — Triple Layered Sword Wave!

Dazzling silvery waves crashed relentlessly, three layers sweeping forward with unparalleled sharpness and power.

Finally, the immortal killer move — Five Finger Fist Heart Sword!

Fang Yuan pressed his palms before his chest, then curled his right fingers as if grasping endless sword light and raised his hand overhead.

First his thumb straightened; with a swoosh, an extremely sharp sword light pierced through Cloud Cover Continent.

Next, his index and middle fingers extended, shooting two sword lights of terrifying power.

Unable to extend his last two fingers, Fang Yuan had to halt the move after three sword lights.

After practicing, Fang Yuan stood in place, collating his experiences.

"I have finished modifying five sword path killer moves; aside from Lang Ya Sect's Triple Layered Sword Wave, the rest originated from Bo Qing."

"Sword path is inferior to wisdom path. With fewer sword path Immortal Gu and far lower attainment, my modifications are limited, yielding power roughly equal to Bo Qing's originals. Especially the renowned Five Finger Fist Heart Sword, which once shocked the world; currently, unleashing three finger sword lights is my limit. Furthermore, its power only reaches the peak of rank seven."

"If I could also use rank eight Wisdom Sword Immortal Gu, the killer move would reach rank eight power."

Unfortunately, Wisdom Sword Immortal Gu was difficult to use, requiring rank eight immortal essence.

Thus, though Fang Yuan had ample room for improvement in sword path, he had reached his current limit of development.

Having finished practicing his killer moves, Fang Yuan wasted no time returning to cloud city to resume developing his immortal aperture.

Sovereign immortal aperture, at the extreme north of Mini Northern Plains.

This blue crystalline rock was riddled with holes of varying sizes, ceaselessly spewing icy smoke that drastically transformed the environment.

Ice path crystal essence!

Originating from the secluded domain of heaven and earth, 'Hu' Land, this rank eight immortal material was exceedingly rare.

Upon first seeing this ice path crystal essence, Fang Yuan had marveled: "To think the snowman tribe had such a treasure in their treasury!"

The ice path crystal essence was the centerpiece of the snowmen's third gift.

Their sincerity stemmed from Xue Er reporting his victory over the immemorial myriad head coiling dragon.

"With this ice path crystal essence, I can establish a snow monster production line, creating a new source of revenue in time!"

As he planned ahead, Sixth Hair transmitted: "Sect leader, Heavenly Secret Immortal Gu's refinement has reached the critical step. Please come refine it personally!"

Fang Yuan was instantly alerted.

Refining Heavenly Secret Immortal Gu would allow him to foresee upcoming calamities and tribulations in advance.

# Chapter 1469: Too Weak

The Gu refinement hall was filled with bright white light.

An intense aura hovering between mortal and Immortal Gu indicated the refinement had reached its most crucial step.

"Now is the time!" Sixth Hair called out, dispelling the entire refinement path Gu formation.

At this final step, the formation had to be shut down so the Gu Immortal could personally complete the process.

Generating countless thoughts with wisdom path methods, Fang Yuan seamlessly took over the immortal formation's workload.

Within a dozen breaths, the hall's light normalized, revealing a fully materialized, house-sized white-gold ring.

Sixth Hair held his breath: "Heavenly Light Ring has formed! But it must rotate seven times to refine rank seven Heavenly Secret."

The first rotation.

Fang Yuan willed as the ring started to rotate slowly.

Second rotation.

The paused ring began rotating again following his gaze.

Third rotation.

Resonating with his breath, the ring spun again.

The fourth rotation.

Spurred by his voice, the ring spun violently.

"Past half of the seven rotations! But it will get harder as the ring spins faster and becomes difficult to control," Sixth Hair thought, sweating profusely.

The fifth rotation.

From their naturally lowered position, Fang Yuan slowly raised his arms.

The ring began rotating on its own, ascending into the air as it spun.

Rising further from the ground, it paused abruptly upon reaching Fang Yuan's shoulders!

"Oh no!" Sixth Hair's expression changed as the ring suddenly exploded.

At the center, Fang Yuan suffered the full brunt of the explosion.

Fang Yuan immediately activated Man as Before, reducing his heavy injuries to light wounds, though he was not fully healed.

Injured while refining rank seven Heavenly Secret, rank six Man as Before could not fully eliminate the backlash.

Heavenly secret Immortal Gu's refinement failed.

Despite extensive practice and utilizing numerous luck path methods beforehand, he still did not succeed.

Crucially, with impending tribulations, failing to refine Heavenly Secret in time meant he could not use it before they arrived.

"No worry, even without Heavenly Secret, I am confident of passing." Fang Yuan waved his hand, instantly regaining his calm.

Several days later, Fang Yuan teleported to a desolate area via immortal formation to undergo his tribulation.

Placing his immortal aperture, he opened the immortal aperture door.

Vast heaven and earth qi rushed in like a waterfall, replenishing the sovereign immortal aperture.

To ensure the tribulation went smoothly, Fang Yuan brought the Shadow Sect immortals and Bai Ning Bing along, leaving Xue Er in Lang Ya blessed land.

Fang Yuan did not trust Xue Er, whereas the others had all entered the sovereign immortal aperture before.

They could assist during his tribulation and block any hostile Gu Immortals attracted to the area.

Once the aperture finished absorbing heaven and earth qi, the tribulation began forming in Mini Red Heaven.

He chose Mini Red Heaven because the barren site of his battle with the immemorial year monkey held no resources, minimizing collateral damage.

A dense poisonous fog soon swirled around Fang Yuan.

"Or rather, the five poison tribulation!" remarked the knowledgeable Ying Wu Xie.

Just as he said, the five-colored poisonous fog condensed into five giant monsters: a snake, scorpion, spider, toad, and centipede.

The five monsters encircled Fang Yuan menacingly without attacking yet, gathering strength and growing larger over time.

He waited until the five poisonous beasts reached peak strength.

All five pounced towards Fang Yuan with bodies like mountains!

Enhanced by heaven's will, this was no ordinary rank seven tribulation, bearing the maximum power allowed by the world.

"Just this?" Fang Yuan sneered, vanishing on the spot.

Bai Ning Bing and the rest watched with pin-sized pupils as Fang Yuan rampaged, completely suppressing the five poisonous beasts beneath relentless attacks.

When the poisonous fog faded, only Fang Yuan remained standing on the battlefield like a demonic god.

Surveying the battlefield and his hands, he muttered: "Rank seven heavenly tribulation… is too weak."

# Chapter 1470: Intention to Trade

This tribulation was not hard for Fang Yuan.

Fang Yuan had waited merely to probe the tribulation's limits; rank seven heavenly tribulations posed him no threat, leaving only grand tribulations uncertain.

Afterwards, Fang Yuan used perceivable dao Immortal Gu to deduce that he obtained a thousand poison path dao marks from this heavenly tribulation.

While heavenly tribulations averaged around seven hundred and fifty dao marks, Fang Yuan gained a thousand because heaven's will had maximized its power.

He had no poison path resources, very low poison path attainment, and only one poison path Immortal Gu, Woman's Heart.

Evidently, heaven's will had purposely chosen poison path to slow Fang Yuan's growth.

"This means my future tribulation dao mark gains will be minimal; annexing apertures is the true way forward," Fang Yuan realized.

Annexing apertures was the sovereign immortal aperture's core advantage, but lacking the Upper Extreme Heavenly Eagle and cultivating in seclusion, he had no such opportunities currently.

Time flowed rapidly, and a month soon passed.

During this period, Fang Yuan underwent an earthly calamity, gaining very few dao marks as expected.

His soul foundation reached fifty million man soul, condensed to the point of showing signs of solidifying.

Most importantly, his immortal killer move Ghost Official Garment thickened, shielding Fang Yuan with even greater power.

Hei Lou Lan had refined the star. Testing Star Eyes Immortal Gu, Fang Yuan found its investigative effect remarkable, greatly supplementing his reconnaissance.

In terms of immortal aperture management, basic development was now complete.

Expending nearly all his immortal essence stones, the snowmen's gifts, and borrowed sect resources, he completed his foundations.

There were seven levels of immortal aperture development.

The first level was to create mortal resource points.

The second level was producing immortal material resources to feed Immortal Gu.

The third level was to raise and produce immortal beasts and plants, completing the ecosystem.

The fourth level was producing resources for external trade and profit.

… Fang Yuan had previously stepped into the fourth level, while still keeping one foot in the second.

With the second level complete, Fang Yuan stepped into the third.

Currently, his two largest beast groups—the eagles and year beasts—were not fully assimilated into the immortal aperture.

Year beasts consumed year Gu, which Fang Yuan produced himself. Rank eight Immortal Gu Years Flow Like Water was crucial here; without it, raising such a vast population was impossible.

"Third-level development must wait." Lacking funds to proceed, Fang Yuan had to focus on the fourth level to expand his trade revenue.

Right now, Fang Yuan had nine sources of revenue.

First was guts Gu. Though a lucrative monopoly, it required heavy investment and split revenue with Lang Ya Sect; currently, all guts Gu went toward cultivating his soul path, yielding zero profit.

Next was year Gu. Fang Yuan had not yet cornered the market, and his earlier actions meant year Gu revenue would remain terrible for the next few years.

Yet the year Gu market held huge potential because Fang Yuan possessed rank eight Immortal Gu Years Flow Like Water.

Next were dragonfish and regretful spiders, which Fang Yuan had painstakingly developed back in Southern Border using Wu clan's resources.

But now, the dragonfish business was heavily affected. Because his Wu Yi Hai disguise had been exposed, his dragonfish business—which relied on Wu clan to sell to Southern Border's righteous path—had naturally halted. Thus, regretful spiders became his largest revenue source, with Western Desert's Xiao clan serving as increasingly stable buyers.

After dragonfish and regretful spiders came eerie fire dragon pythons, star path resources (star dart Gu, star fragment grass, etc.), spirit snakes, snow monsters, and light shine fungi.

Finally, snow monsters and light shine fungi were future projects; the former utilized ice path crystal essence to transform Mini Northern Plains, while the latter was too crucial to sell.

With his earlier year Gu profits depleted, Fang Yuan urgently needed to promote other businesses.

Though basic development was complete, his aperture was only four percent developed; advancing further, modifying moves, and soul cultivation demanded massive capital.

To improve further or increase earnings, he needed capital—the more he invested, the faster his growth.

# Chapter 1471: Split Soul

Lang Ya blessed land, inside a secret room in a cloud city.

Fang Yuan's soul came out of his body.

Reaching seventy million man soul through guts Gu, Shadow Sect's farming, and the two soul path secluded domains, his progress was astonishingly rapid.

"I am thirty million man soul away from hundred million man soul!"

Clear and lifelike, with an exquisite face and normal proportions, a light from deep within made his soul feel solid and pure.

The rank nine killer move ghostly concealment clung like a silk inner garment to his soul, overlaid by ghost official garment.

The modified ghost official garment used change soul and cleanse soul Immortal Gu as cores; once a thin loose shirt, it had grown far more substantial. As his soul foundation grew, the ghost official garment thickened.

Now, the ghost official garment had transformed: the loose shirt had become a martial uniform overlaid with battle armor, presenting a grand scene.

This was the true appearance of the rank seven ghost official garment — Ghost General Garment!

Though his soul had left, wills remaining in his physical mind activated an immortal killer move—

Split Soul!

Originating from Spectral Soul's true inheritance, Fang Yuan had modified it for his use.

An intense pain assaulted Fang Yuan's soul.

Fang Yuan gritted his teeth and his soul entered his body again.

This was the first time he was activating the killer move split soul.

Unlike ordinary killer moves, split soul required the Gu Immortal's soul to leave the body while leaving behind thoughts, wills, or emotions to manipulate Gu worms, making it harder to execute.

After the activation failed, Fang Yuan wordlessly used guts Gu to heal himself.

Having modified and mastered his sword path killer moves, he turned to modifying and practicing soul path killer moves.

And for his immortal aperture development, Fang Yuan decided his focus.

He thought about it and chose the dragonfish.

First, the dragonfish business had an existing foundation, and Fang Yuan had accumulated substantial stock in his immortal aperture.

Finally, dragonfish possessed transformation path and food path dao marks, rumored to be created by a food path Gu Immortal.

Fang Yuan held an authentic food path inheritance containing numerous methods to breed dragonfish on a massive scale.

Dragon scale sea area.

Fang Yuan expanded the sea area again and modified its immortal Gu formation.

The new formation used Snack, Dragon Scale, Dragon Breath, and Dragon Strength as cores, supported by over a hundred thousand mortal Gu.

Fang Yuan spent three days without sleep or rest modifying this giant immortal formation, bathed in the light of wisdom.

Half a month later, Fang Yuan successfully upgraded this dragonfish resource point from a large to a giant resource point.

This allowed the dragonfish to breed faster, multiplying rapidly under the sovereign immortal aperture's fast time flow.

Fang Yuan started to find new sellers for the dragonfish business.

Lang Ya Sect was easily convinced, and the snowman tribe agreed to purchase dragonfish regularly.

Western Desert's Xiao clan also became a major customer due to their regretful spider relationship.

As for Northern Plains' Chu tribe, Chu Du secretly negotiated a ten-plus-year business agreement with Fang Yuan.

The start was good, but next was the main activity.

Fang Yuan placed these dragonfish into treasure yellow heaven.

Deploying different wills and changing identities, he kept his true identity concealed.

This time, Fang Yuan used a different strategy from the year Gu business.

For dragonfish, however, his rearing costs were no cheaper despite good methods; thus, he only increased sales gradually.

Fang Yuan cultivated as he quietly observed the market trend.

Eastern Sea.

Gu Immortal You Chan was holding onto a dragonfish and observing it.

Under the lantern, her beautiful face was solemn as she frowned.

"Who knows where this person came from—their dragonfish are outstanding, and their supply is endless."

You Chan was the leading dragonfish seller in treasure yellow heaven.

While the year Gu market had three major sellers, dragonfish was dominated solely by You Chan, far surpassing competitors for decades.

A water path Gu Immortal, she held a natural advantage, controlling the famous dragonfish sea area as a massive breeding ground.

Producing dragonfish in both her immortal aperture and Eastern Sea, her dual production grounds yielded insurmountable stock.

Paying close attention, You Chan immediately attempted to probe Fang Yuan's background.

Though she disguised herself to probe for information, Fang Yuan's will revealed nothing and refused all requests to communicate.

After several days, You Chan felt mounting pressure as Fang Yuan's stock steadily increased.

"I cannot continue like this." You Chan could not wait anymore, she left the dragonfish sea area.

Instead of flying, she swam several hundred li until finding an undercurrent.

Entering the undercurrent, You Chan used the natural phenomenon to accelerate her journey.

# Chapter 1472: Fang Yuan's Engagement

Seeking Hua An's assistance, You Chan arrived at Nan Gong clan territory. "Fairy You Chan, Master Hua sent me to welcome you; he is waiting at Hua Qiao Pavilion." The Nan Gong clan Gu Immortal was respectful, showing none of a super force's usual arrogance.

Following him through the undercurrents, You Chan soon saw an Immortal Gu House in the sea.

The man inside smiled: "Fairy You Chan, you came from afar; forgive me for not welcoming you."

You Chan smiled: "Hua An, as one of Eastern Sea's three wisdom path experts, how could I fault your arrogance?"

You Chan sat without ceremony, drank tea, and sighed: "The tea is good, but my heart is full of worries; I cannot appreciate it fully."

You Chan was drinking tea, while Fang Yuan drank wine.

"Congratulations Lord Fang Yuan and Fairy Xue Er, it is wonderful that you two lovers are united! Hahaha!" Bing Zhuo laughed loudly as he toasted.

With Fang Yuan's rank eight battle strength and prominent status in the Northern Plains variant human alliance, nearly all their Gu Immortals attended his engagement ceremony.

This was merely an engagement, not the wedding she desired. Bing Yuan acutely felt Fang Yuan's shrewdness, as the ceremony alone had cost the snowmen dearly.

Only after many difficult negotiations with Fang Yuan had they reached this result.

Both sides conceded a little: Fang Yuan gained new resources, while the snowmen could finally leverage his authority.

"Tying our tribe to someone like Fang Yuan... did I do the right thing?" Recalling their discussions, Bing Yuan began doubting the decision.

Eastern Sea.

Hua An looked ashamed as he told You Chan: "Fairy, I have disappointed you; I could not deduce this person's background."

"Even you, Master Hua, could not?" You Chan felt very surprised.

Hua An had a solemn expression: "First, dragonfish clues alone are hard to deduce from. Second, this person has a concealment killer move that resists wisdom path deductions."

Hua An suggested: "We must probe further. With more clues, I will have a better chance of penetrating his defenses; even minor clues will eventually bring success."

You Chan nodded: "Wait a moment."

She immediately sent her consciousness into treasure yellow heaven as she looked for Fang Yuan's will.

"You Chan, stop trying to test me. I am determined to enter the dragonfish business," Fang Yuan's will told her immediately.

Her expression changed, her consciousness returned to her body and she informed Hua An.

Hua An's expression changed too: "This… I'm afraid he has a huge background!"

"I am the number one seller in dragonfish; how could a competitor have no background?" You Chan rolled her eyes at Hua An.

Hua An shook his head solemnly: "I refer to his wisdom path attainment. He noticed my deduction and reverse-deduced your identity. Despite my caution, he deduced your identity with such limited information. His wisdom path attainment is not lower than mine—in fact, it could be higher!"

She never expected that seeking Hua An's help would not only fail to uncover her rival's background, but expose her in advance!

# Chapter 1473: Myriad Gold Wondrous Essence Physique

The banquet was extremely lively, this engagement ceremony had an extremely heavy political impact.

Not only for the variant human alliance, but also for Fang Yuan.

Fang Yuan accepted every toast, using his interpersonal skills to greatly improve relations with the variant human Gu Immortals.

His engagement to Xue Er changed everything, integrating him directly into the variant human Gu Immortal circle rather than just Lang Ya Sect.

"If she knew I had rank eight battle strength, would You Chan back off?" Fang Yuan pondered.

The dragonfish business was Fang Yuan's next focus in his immortal aperture development.

If You Chan backed off now, it would be ideal, but she was unlikely to do so.

"You Chan... Eastern Sea's six beauties... Myriad Gold Wondrous Essence Physique..." Fang Yuan entertained the guests while deep in thought.

Shadow Sect's inheritance revealed to Fang Yuan that You Chan possessed the Myriad Gold Wondrous Essence Physique, an extreme physique.

She cultivated water path solely because, as a lone cultivator, she had only ever obtained a water path inheritance.

Later, the severe risks of changing paths forced her to continue until now.

Fang Yuan deduced she was deducing him because he had ample intelligence on her and knew she was his biggest dragonfish competitor. Furthermore, Fang Yuan possessed ghost official garment, Purple Mountain True Monarch's killer moves, and various wisdom path defenses.

The Myriad Gold Wondrous Essence Physique was recorded in The Legends of Ren Zu, chapter four, section twenty-seven—

The first level established mortal resources: mortal Gu, mortal materials, and ordinary beasts and plants.

The second level produced immortal material resources to feed Immortal Gu.

The third level cultivated immortal beasts and plants, completing the ecosystem.

The fourth level traded surplus immortal materials, beasts, and plants for profit.

The sixth level raised variant humans and humans to produce Gu Immortals among them.

The seventh level was to produce lifespan Gu.

The wolf pounced, claws piercing Fang Yuan's right shoulder and tearing flesh.

By then, the first and second desert wolves had regained their footing and caught up.

At this critical juncture, Fang Yuan put all his primeval essence in chimney smoke Gu.

The dense smoke blinded and choked the three wolves, allowing Fang Yuan to pull away.

The three desert wolves soon broke through the smoke and caught up to him.

A lightning chain suddenly brushed past his cheek, instantly roasting the three wolves.

"The clansmen!" Fang Yuan rejoiced, recognizing the reinforcements.

Young Thieving Heaven reached his physical limits and fainted once more.

The expected darkness never appeared; Fang Yuan found his soul floating in the air outside the dream realm.

Stunned for a moment, Fang Yuan quickly realized: "I successfully cleared the first stage of the dream realm!"

"Amazing, my theft path attainment soared straight to grandmaster level!!"

# Chapter 1495: Resting

Inside the immortal Gu formation, Fang Yuan sat cross-legged with closed eyes, quietly cultivating.

"Beyond successfully testing heaven's will dissipation, my theft path attainment reached grandmaster level!"

"However, my ten million man soul plummeted to one million—a heavy price."

Fang Yuan opened his eyes and used guts Gu immediately.

Tang Fang Ming watched the guts Gu with envy.

Though still radiating blue light, a large portion of the dream realm's base had vanished.

Consuming guts Gu recklessly, Fang Yuan's soul recovered to ten million.

Realizing the second stage would be far more difficult, Fang Yuan resolved to elevate his soul foundation further.

Thus, over the following days, he quietly concentrated on cultivating soul path.

While Fang Yuan cultivated soul path in preparation for the second stage, Qing Yue Zhi Cheng met Qing Yue clan's first supreme elder in Eastern Sea to request help.

Advised to seek a wisdom path expert, Qing Yue Zhi Cheng traveled to Nan Gong clan and met Hua An. Hua An said: "Frankly, Fairy You Chan requested my help not long ago, but unfortunately I could not assist her."

Hua An and Qing Yue Zhi Cheng exchanged information, naturally suspecting Fang Yuan first.

"Their situation is likely grim," Hua An said heavily. "I plan to ask Eastern Sea's other wisdom path experts to deduce the culprit together."

Changing the topic, he said: "We might as well spread news of the two fairies' deaths. If alive, they will know we are seeking to help them. If hunted by the culprit, these rumors will confuse him and draw his attention toward us."

Time passed, soon, half a month went by.

Fang Yuan's soul foundation had increased to ninety million man soul, just shy of hundred million.

Despite heavy guts Gu expenditure, dragonfish sales steadily bolstered his finances.

"Notably, news of You Chan and Qin Bai He's deaths has already spread across Eastern Sea; someone is plotting from the shadows."

"Regardless, the priority now is Thieving Heaven's dream realm."

Confident with ninety million man soul, Fang Yuan entered the second stage.

# Chapter 1496: Blurred Grey Eyes

Fully rested and prepared, Fang Yuan entered Thieving Heaven's dream realm.

People clamored around the pool where a market gathering was underway.

Young Thieving Heaven roamed through the crowd, observing transactions while edging toward the central pool.

"Stop! Unauthorized people are not allowed entry here."

He sighed inwardly: "That pool is heavily guarded. Even during the market, I cannot slip past the guards."

Sha Xiao's sinister voice echoed in his mind: "Find a way in. We have barely a month left. If you make no progress, you die."

Young Thieving Heaven soon learned the clan was holding a competition, with the victor rewarded a Gu worm from the pool.

"I must enter this competition and win!" young Thieving Heaven told Sha Xiao in his mind.

Sha Xiao snickered: "Foolish boy, do you think I don't see your scheme? You want to gain strength and overthrow my control?"

Young Thieving Heaven sneered, frankly admitting: "So what? Who doesn't crave freedom?"

"Good!" Sha Xiao praised instead. "You're straightforward. Call me grandpa, and I'll help you seize victory."

"You!" Young Thieving Heaven stiffened, his eyes revealing anger.

"Unwilling? Think carefully. With your strength and aptitude, how can you win without my help?" Sha Xiao sneered.

"I was born a noble, yet now I must beg! This is a disgrace to Sun clan."

"I am too weak, and returning home is uncertain. If I cannot overcome this hurdle, there is no future to speak of."

"Grandpa…" he finally yielded, squeezing the word through clenched teeth.

Sha Xiao laughed crazily: "Good grandson! Take this method and make it your strength; you will definitely win."

As Sha Xiao finished, a vast amount of information flooded young Thieving Heaven's mind.

It contained exquisite combat techniques, Gu recipes, usage methods, and a killer move.

Mortal killer move — Blurred Grey Eyes.

Using sandpit Gu, chimney smoke Gu, and clear water Gu, this move puffed blinding white smoke.

"This move is so insidious; it's not my style." Young Thieving Heaven's heart sank with displeasure.

"Blurred grey eyes requires three Gu worms, exactly the Gu I possess."

Unwilling to practice blurred grey eyes, young Thieving Heaven focused entirely on the combat techniques.

A warrior in his past life, he possessed a solid foundation and deep battle attainment.

Confident in his abilities, he soon entered the clan's small competition.

When he stepped onto the stage, the audience thought little of him.

His opponent pointed arrogantly: "Surrender now, trash, and I won't break your leg."

Young Thieving Heaven stood dazed and motionless.

The next moment, he clenched his fists, feeling the strength in his fingers.

"I finally have control again." Fang Yuan was inwardly happy.

Now that he came to his senses, he immediately attacked.

Mortal killer move — Blurred Grey Eyes!

Whoosh, a clump of white ash puffed into his opponent's face.

Caught off guard, his opponent stumbled back, crying: "Ahhh! I can't see anything!"

"Get lost!" Striding forward, Fang Yuan kicked his opponent fiercely in the face.

His opponent was directly kicked out of the stage.

Victory!

# Chapter 1497: Deep Pain Despite Victory

"Despicable, too despicable, he is actually sneak attacking!"

Scrambling up, the opponent stuttered in rage, pointing at the air: "Shameless! Fight me again!"

Blinded, he pointed in completely the wrong direction, creating a hilarious spectacle.

Fang Yuan sneered: "Winner takes all, what is there to dispute? Eh…"

Fang Yuan fell silent, once again reduced to an observer after losing control of the body.

Gazing at the crowd below, young Thieving Heaven went pale, trembling all over.

"Why? Why did I use that killer move blurred grey eyes?"

"I clearly had the strength to beat him fairly and throw him off the stage. Why did I sneak attack?!"

Sha Xiao laughed madly: "Entertaining! You executed blurred grey eyes flawlessly and ambushed him perfectly. Very good!"

"Hahaha, good grandson, that is simply your true nature. Don't restrain yourself; let it out," Sha Xiao laughed loudly, adding insult to injury.

Deeply shaken, young Thieving Heaven's eyes suddenly flashed: "No, this wasn't me. It was you, right? You controlled my body!"

"Hehe, though I could, I didn't. This was entirely your own choice, as you well know."

Maintaining a composed expression on the surface, young Thieving Heaven stepped off the stage while arguing inwardly.

It was the observer Fang Yuan's turn to feel shaken.

He had controlled the battle, but the outcome directly influenced the dream realm's subsequent events.

Young Thieving Heaven's shock and the audience's shifting attitude would inevitably alter the dream realm's progression.

Fang Yuan had never encountered such a situation while exploring dream realms.

"Yet this dream realm feels truly lived-in. This is extraordinary!"

By classification, this was a realistic dream realm that reenacted Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable's life. But with Fang Yuan's ongoing participation, deviations might accumulate—would the final outcome differ from the original?

Soon, it was his turn to battle again.

"You don't look vile. Why did you use despicable methods against my cousin last round?" His next opponent was a girl radiating heroic spirit.

Young Thieving Heaven frowned, reluctant to explain yet saying: "It was a misunderstanding."

The girl frowned: "Misunderstanding or not, I will avenge my cousin. I'll not only defeat you, but make you suffer! Come!"

The young girl charged forward.

"Wait a moment." Young Thieving Heaven raised his hands: "Hear me out before you strike."

"Speak up; I will make you concede completely." The girl snorted, halting her charge.

At that moment, young Thieving Heaven's eyes gleamed sinisterly as he raised his hand.

Mortal killer move — Blurred Grey Eyes!

Though on guard, the girl found her defenses bypassed as the white ash covered her eyes.

By then, young Thieving Heaven had closed in, raising his right leg to kick her out of the ring.

Experienced in combat, the blinded girl twitched her ears, tracking his position through the wind.

With a soft cry, she punched directly at young Thieving Heaven instead of retreating.

Yet at this moment, Fang Yuan had taken control of young Thieving Heaven.

With sinister cunning, Fang Yuan's incoming kick was merely a feint.

Scoffing, Fang Yuan pulled back his leg to dodge, smoothly catching her hand and dragging her aside.

Seizing the chance, Fang Yuan drove his knee fiercely into her abdomen.

Before she could react to the pain, Fang Yuan chopped the back of her neck.

In an instant, the young girl lost her consciousness.

Fang Yuan won.

"What have I done? Was it me again?!" Fang Yuan returned to observing, while young Thieving Heaven stood stunned.

"Hahaha, it was all you," Sha Xiao laughed freely. "I did nothing. You realize that, right? The entire battle was your own choice."

"No, impossible. How could I be such a... scumbag?!" Young Thieving Heaven squeezed his eyes shut in agony, his eyelids twitching.

Thus, young Thieving Heaven continued his winning streak in the competition.

In every match, Fang Yuan took over and controlled the entire battle.

Yet for young Thieving Heaven, it was an agonizing ordeal.

# Chapter 1498: Desire To Lose

Controlling young Thieving Heaven on stage, Fang Yuan fought an arduous battle.

His opponent was a sturdy youth whose knife-hand strikes unleashed flashes of lightning with every chop.

Young Thieving Heaven lacked the methods to dodge the lightning, but Fang Yuan's experienced eyes tracked the opponent's every movement.

By observing posture and gaze, Fang Yuan deduced attack trajectories before the strikes landed.

After prolonged fighting, the youth gasped for breath, having largely depleted his primeval essence.

"Time to counterattack." Seizing his chance, Fang Yuan immediately went on the offensive.

With only D-grade aptitude, young Thieving Heaven's primeval essence reserve was meager.

By now, his remaining primeval essence was even lower than his relentlessly attacking opponent's.

"The top eight, four, two, and champion clearly receive tiered clan rewards."

# Chapter 1499: Thieving Heaven's Bottom Line

Sha Xiao's gloomy voice came: "Grandson, you refuse to obey grandpa? Do you want to live or not?"

Young Thieving Heaven persisted: "This recipe is too vile; I refuse. Sha Xiao, didn't you want me near the pool? Now that I made top eight and qualified to enter, wouldn't killing me now be a waste?"

"Hahaha." Sha Xiao laughed, "Yeah, it is a pity."

The words barely landed before intense pain wracked young Thieving Heaven's body, causing his pupils to shrink.

Sha Xiao sneered: "You think reaching top eight lets you negotiate? You are just a pawn!"

Refining Gu for the first time, young Thieving Heaven struggled until Sha Xiao provided timely guidance.

Displaying immense talent, young Thieving Heaven quickly progressed until he handled the later stages with ease.

"The fire's intensity is too high, lower it quickly!" Sha Xiao said in alarm.

# Chapter 1500: Sneak Attack Gu

"No, grandpa, you misunderstand! I truly can't control this fire's intensity." Young Thieving Heaven continued his act.

"You dare deceive me? Let this fire devour you as well! Intentionally failing Gu refinement is seeking your own doom! Die, this is the result of your foolish persistence." Sha Xiao snickered.

Before he finished speaking, the fire soared and engulfed young Thieving Heaven.

"Why did this happen?" Young Thieving Heaven tried to charge out, but the fire's enormous attraction held him in place.

Just as he was about to be engulfed in flames, Fang Yuan found he could control young Thieving Heaven's body once again.

The fire's pull plummeted, allowing Fang Yuan to leap out.

Ignoring his injuries, Fang Yuan focused entirely on the fire.

Young Thieving Heaven was not yet out of danger, as the Gu refinement had not truly stopped.

Fang Yuan activated chimney smoke Gu, unleashing smoke that blanketed the basin-sized fire.

However, a change occurred right at this moment.

The smoke was suddenly absorbed into the fire.

The fire surged again as the baby phantom leaped about and pounced toward young Thieving Heaven.

After finishing off the chimney smoke Gu, the baby charged at Fang Yuan again.

Fang Yuan laughed: "Come, there is also clear water Gu!"

Clear water Gu was thrown out, and was also devoured by the baby.

The fire dimmed as clear water Gu transformed into unevaporated emerald-green water.

The red fire shifted to an orange-yellow glow, its former ferocity deeply concealed.

Emerald-green water and orange-yellow fire circulated around each other in the air.

Advancing instead of retreating, Fang Yuan moved young Thieving Heaven before this strange water and fire.

"Sandpit consolidates. Chimney smoke restrains. Clear water topples. Blood integrates yin and yang. Wonderful!"

Fang Yuan bit his tongue and spat blood into the strange water and fire.

"Eeeek." Touched by blood, the strange water and fire transformed into a shrieking blue baby phantom that pounced at Fang Yuan.

Fang Yuan did not dodge, letting it attack.

The blue baby phantom entered young Thieving Heaven's aperture, turning into a rank two Gu worm.

"What is this?" Young Thieving Heaven regained his senses, thoroughly baffled.

"Again?!" Fang Yuan was speechless—the moment young Thieving Heaven was safe, he was shoved aside into an observer.

"You actually refined a completely new Gu worm through a series of coincidences?!" Sha Xiao shouted in shock.

"No," Sha Xiao realized. "You have a hidden nature that takes control during fatal danger to make the best choice."

"You are foolish, but this hidden nature is pragmatic, cunning, and far more talented! Very impressive!"

"Go on, try it. This rank two Gu seems completely novel—even I can't make out its effect."

So young Thieving Heaven dumbly activated this Gu worm.

Upon activation, the Gu turned back into a shrieking blue baby phantom, shooting out of young Thieving Heaven's aperture to charge ahead.

The blue baby phantom passed straight through a stone stool ahead, then returned to young Thieving Heaven's aperture, resuming its Gu form.

The stone stool looked undamaged.

Young Thieving Heaven walked to the stool and touched it.

With a crisp sound, the stone stool shattered into rubble.

"Wonderful!" Sha Xiao praised. "A top-tier rank two Gu that bypasses defenses to destroy from within."

Sha Xiao inspected his aperture and praised again: "Amazing! Activating this Gu cost only ten percent primeval essence. A potent rank two Gu needing merely ten percent of rank one green copper primeval essence is unimaginable!"

"With only D grade aptitude, my primeval essence is barely over twenty percent. I can only use it twice," young Thieving Heaven worried.

"You know nothing. With this Gu worm, first place in the competition is yours—no one can defend against it," Sha Xiao scoffed.

"When activated, it becomes a blue baby phantom to attack the enemy. You saw its speed—it is extremely fast. Rank three Gu Masters might dodge it with difficulty, but against rank one and two Gu Masters, closing distance ensures they have no time to dodge."

Sha Xiao continued analyzing, mumbling: "Hmm... judging by its power and effect, we might as well call it sneak attack Gu."

"Sneak attack Gu..." Young Thieving Heaven frowned, wanting to object.

"Yes, sneak attack Gu! Hahaha!" Sha Xiao laughed domineeringly while young Thieving Heaven rolled his eyes.

# Chapter 1502: Lacking Souls

Western Desert, inside Tang clan's immortal formation.

Fang Yuan was sitting cross-legged with closed eyes.

# Chapter 1503: Soul Beast Army

Fang Yuan steered the auspicious cloud through the sky.

Rather than following Fang Yuan's will, the auspicious cloud moved according to luck path profundities.
