"Once I secure this place, I can station Ying Wu Xie here to command the soul beast army and supply soul cores."

"The important point is Fang clan."

"This Western Desert super force is closest to green ghost desert. If I take control here, neighboring Fang clan will be an unavoidable barrier."

"Disguise as a lone cultivator, get close to the righteous path, then build a good relationship with Fang clan…"

"People ahead?" Fang Yuan's expression shifted. With his improved investigative methods, he sensed Old Ghost Bai Jun and the others the moment they entered range.

"Is the benefactor coming?" Fang Yun was inwardly going crazy with excitement.

Soon, the three Gu Immortals sensed the ground starting to softly tremor.

Dust clouds surged on the horizon as soul beasts emerged one after another into view.

"This!" Old Ghost Bai Jun gasped. He had thought his own soul beast group sizable, but it paled before Fang Yuan's vast soul beast army.

The Shadow Sect immortals had already entered Fang Yuan's immortal aperture, while Fang Yuan had changed into another appearance.

He appeared as a gaunt, middle-aged man with long grey hair and dark eyes radiating ruthless ambition.

Dressed in black robes with hands clasped behind him, Fang Yuan stood proudly atop a soul beast, commanding his army with an imposing demonic aura.

Fang Leng glanced dubiously at Fang Yun—why did this 'benefactor' feel even more demonic than Old Ghost Bai Jun?

Awed by Fang Yuan's aura, Old Ghost Bai Jun coughed and cupped his fists: "Greetings, how should I address you?"

Fang Yuan's chilling gaze swept over the three immortals. Without a word, he merely waved his hand.

Like a surging tide, the vast army charged toward Old Ghost Bai Jun's group with the momentum of countless stampeding warhorses.

Fang Leng glared at Fang Yun again: "Is this not a demon? Your 'benefactor' is about to kill us!"

Old Ghost Bai Jun thought: "I sought peace to avoid disrupting master's plan, yet this madman attacks without a word! When did such a lunatic emerge in Western Desert? I'll show you I'm not to be trifled with!"

Old Ghost Bai Jun shouted and shot into the sky like lightning.

"Come, let us battle!" Spreading his arms, his sleeves expanded like black holes as countless dark currents surged out.

Fang Yuan pointed his finger.

Wisdom path immortal killer move — Ignited Thought Flying Rock!

Clashing offense against offense, the dark currents resisted briefly before dispersing.

Though halved in power, the red meteorites still crashed downward; Old Ghost Bai Jun's soul beasts wailed under the bombardment, suffering heavy casualties.

"He is a wisdom path Gu Immortal?" Fang Leng was astonished.

"Don't kill us! We are Fang clan Gu Immortals—Old Ghost Bai Jun's enemies, not friends!" Fang Yun shouted.

# Chapter 1506: Soul Explosion!

"Fang clan's Gu Immortals?" Fang Yuan's ears twitched at Fang Yun's shout.

Though he had detected tension among them, Fang Yuan had not expected outright hostility, nor that the Fang clan immortals were captives.

"Spontaneous auspicious cloud is remarkable indeed. Just as I thought of befriending Fang clan, it immediately delivers such an opportunity!"

"Save the two Fang clan Gu Immortals and capture Old Ghost Bai Jun!" Fang Yuan's eyes flashed sharply.

"Fang clan? Your clan once aided my cultivation, so I shall repay that kindness." Though spoken coldly, the two captives were overjoyed.

Fang Leng thought: "This mysterious Gu Immortal has no match in my memory. If he truly wanted to save us, why declare it openly instead of acting covertly? or he is genuinely aloof and supremely confident, fully assured he can rescue us despite alerting the enemy!"

"Rescuing them from me won't be so easy!" Enraged, Old Ghost Bai Jun erupted with powerful aura, brushing aside the flying rocks as he charged toward Fang Yuan.

"Commendable courage, but foolish foresight," Fang Yuan sneered, taking to the sky and pointing a finger.

Dozens of strange lights instantly riddled Old Ghost Bai Jun with holes.

Bleeding no blood, Old Ghost Bai Jun's body dissolved into nothingness.

"Hahaha, you fell into my trap!" Old Ghost Bai Jun's true body appeared elsewhere, having hidden while using an illusion as bait.

Rather than attacking Fang Yuan, Old Ghost Bai Jun lunged toward the captives.

"Crap!" Looking at Old Ghost Bai Jun approaching them rapidly, Fang Yun shouted in dismay.

But right at this moment, a figure appeared before the two immortals from the thin air.

"Old Ghost Bai Jun, who is the one in a trap?" Fang Yuan's lips curled into a demonic smile.

"Oh no!" Realizing he had been trapped, Old Ghost Bai Jun panicked and scrambled to flee.

About ten soul beasts suddenly appeared in the air, surrounding Old Ghost Bai Jun.

"Detonate." Fang Yuan commanded with a thought.

The soul beasts self-detonated, their terrifying blast shocking Fang Leng and Fang Yun.

As the dust settled, Old Ghost Bai Jun hovered weakly; most of his body was gone, limbs destroyed save for a solitary left arm, teetering on death's brink.

"I cannot expose my true methods before Fang clan." Fang Yuan swiftly weighed the situation.

Fang Yuan said: "You have skill to survive my trap. I, Suan Bu Jin, leave room for reconciliation. Take your life and scram; I will not strike again today."

Poised to fight to the death with rank eight Immortal Gu Soul Beast Token, Old Ghost Bai Jun was stunned when Fang Yuan spared him.

"Is he tricking me to lower my guard?" Having already fallen into one trap, Old Ghost Bai Jun doubted everything.

Reading his thoughts from his expression, Fang Yuan snapped: "Still here? I gave you a chance—are you courting death? Hmph."

Standing spear-straight atop the soul beast with hands clasped behind him, Fang Yuan looked down arrogantly, his gaze sharp as cold lightning. He radiated supreme confidence, showing no fear of any future trouble his spared enemy might bring.

Even with Soul Beast Token, Old Ghost Bai Jun lacked confidence and feared revealing it would provoke Fang Yuan to kill him.

After weighing his thoughts, Old Ghost Bai Jun scoffed and took his leave.

Moving swiftly, his battered body shot like an arrow into the dark clouds, vanishing from sight.

Dazed for a moment, Fang Yun cried in shock: "Benefactor, you are really letting him go? He has a rank eight Immortal Gu!"

# Chapter 1507: Qing Clan's Inheritance

"Oh? It seems he had a fortuitous encounter. But having given my word, would you have me break it?" Fang Yuan's expression shifted slightly, his gaze turning piercing and cold upon the two.

Fang Leng felt reassured: "This man honors his word even against the immense temptation of a rank eight Immortal Gu. He is exceptionally conceited, but only because of that do we have a chance to survive."

Thinking of this, Fang Leng struggled to get up: "I am Fang Leng and this is my junior brother Fang Yun, we thank senior for saving us."

Reaching out, Fang Yuan easily dispelled their immortal bindings using his killer move, purple thought perception starlight.

Little did they suspect Fang Yuan had orchestrated everything to cement an arrogant image.

"You can address me as Suan Bu Jin." Fang Yuan said, introducing himself.

Yet Fang Yuan promptly drove them off: "I cultivate wisdom path and inherited Zheng Jing Shen's inheritance, which is why I saved you. Leave now."

Tugging Fang Yun's sleeve, Fang Leng inquired respectfully: "We will remember senior's kindness and report it to our clan. Will senior remain in green ghost desert?"

"I have use for these soul beasts and did not save you for rewards. Begone." Fang Yuan waved coldly with visible impatience.

Not daring to disturb him further, Fang Leng and Fang Yun bowed respectfully and flew away.

"To think Old Ghost Bai Jun possessed a rank eight Immortal Gu. What Gu was it, and did he use it before them?" Fang Yuan pondered.

Fang Yuan lowered his brows as a mental sensation revealed Old Ghost Bai Jun's location.

While flying, Fang Yun asked, "Senior brother, do you think our benefactor knew Old Ghost Bai Jun had a rank eight Immortal Gu, and saved us quickly before going after him?"

Fang Leng glanced at Fang Yun: "A rank eight Immortal Gu is indeed a huge matter, but senior is proud and aloof. Furthermore, we never told him what that Gu was. If senior truly wanted to go capture Old Ghost Bai Jun, wouldn't he have asked us about what this rank eight Immortal Gu is and what its ability is?"

Fang Leng shook his head: "Soul Beast Token commands soul beasts; senior would suffer heavy losses fighting it. Let the supreme elders decide."

Using the immortal formation, they teleported straight to clan headquarters.

The two parted: Fang Leng reported to first supreme elder, while Fang Yun reported to second supreme elder Fang Di Chang.

Second supreme elder asked: "Does first supreme elder know of Zheng Jing Shen?"

First supreme elder nodded: "He was a legendary lone cultivator tens of thousands of years ago, with close ties to our Fang clan. In his earlier years of cultivation, he had received financial support from our clan, and he even had a love affair with a clan ancestor. Unfortunately, the ancestor died in a battle and Zheng Jing Shen did not join Fang clan."

"Zheng Jing Shen's history is obscure; few even know of him. Suan Bu Jin is likely not lying," first supreme elder added.

Second supreme elder frowned: "Nothing is certain until verified. He could also be colluding with Old Ghost Bai Jun."

First supreme elder looked grave: "If so, Suan Bu Jin likely collaborated with Old Ghost Bai Jun to approach Fang clan for Qing clan's legacy."

Qing clan was also a super force, long since exterminated.

The young Spectral Soul Demon Venerable had slaughtered the entire Qing clan.

The dao marks of Spectral Soul's killer moves, the Gu Immortals' corpses, and their destroyed apertures transformed the battlefield into green ghost desert.

Although Qing clan was exterminated, rumor held that their first supreme elder sealed and buried all clan resources in green ghost desert as an inheritance.

The sole condition for the inheritance was avenging Qing clan by killing Spectral Soul—or his family, friends, and disciples if he were already dead.

As the nearest super force, Fang clan was well-informed; since Qing clan's extermination, their ancestors had actively searched for clues to the inheritance.

Now, the clues were complete, and using a vague responsive method, the clan began searching green ghost desert.

First supreme elder sighed: "We lack the strength to control green ghost desert, have no way to restrict soul beasts, and can mobilize few Gu Immortals. If not for this, we would have no need to let Fang Leng and Fang Yun take the risk. Who could have expected their adventure would involve people like Old Ghost Bai Jun and Suan Bu Jin."

"I know of Old Ghost Bai Jun, and he actually possesses rank eight Soul Beast Token! Meanwhile, Suan Bu Jin appeared suddenly, with mysterious origins and formidable methods. Regardless of what the relationship of these two is, they are obstacles that our Fang clan needs to go through to search for Qing clan's inheritance."

Fang clan's Gu Immortals had to defend their extensive territories. Yet Qing clan's inheritance was enticing, especially since clues pointed to Divine Bean Palace, an Immortal Gu House created by Genesis Lotus Immortal Venerable and left in Western Desert!

Famous for Gu houses, Fang clan prized Divine Bean Palace immensely. Generations of resolve drove their determination to explore Qing clan's inheritance and obtain it!

# Chapter 1508: Divine Bean Palace

Old Ghost Bai Jun flew in fury: "Suan Bu Jin! You didn't even chase me, such arrogance! I will settle this debt with you!"

Filled with hatred, he gritted his teeth: "My soul beasts were not easy to gather, but now they're all dead. Damn it! The loss is huge, and the delay is worse—what if master blames me?"

Just as he thought this, a female figure suddenly appeared before Old Ghost Bai Jun.

"Eagle Concubine! Why are you here?" Old Ghost Bai Jun panicked upon seeing her.

She sneered: "Old geezer, you still don't understand? You ruined master's plan and returned in defeat; master ordered me to bring you back for questioning!"

Eagle Concubine sneered: "You think master handed you a rank eight Immortal Gu without monitoring methods? You underestimate him."

"Fine, I will return with you." Old Ghost Bai Jun gave a dispirited smile, harboring no thought of rebelling against his master.

After traveling an immense distance, the two immortals entered a quicksand pit.

Descending nearly a thousand li through the sandpit, they entered a mysterious space filled with green light.

Lofty as a mountain, the solemn palace's green bricks and golden tiles emitted a rich botanical fragrance.

Carved on the door's plaque were three large words—Divine Bean Palace!

It was the Immortal Gu House of Genesis Lotus Immortal Venerable that Fang clan had sought for generations!

The palace doors slowly opened, revealing a vast hall.

Inside lay an enormous soul beast with a tortoise shell, four tiger paws, dragon tail, snake neck, and a human head.

Seeing this monster, both Gu Immortals hurriedly bowed: "Bai Jun (Eagle Concubine) greets master."

Ignoring his plea, the soul beast raised a huge paw and grabbed Old Ghost Bai Jun.

"This smell, it is him! Yes, it's him!!" The soul beast sniffed with closed eyes, then snapped open bloodshot eyes.

"Spectral Soul Demon Venerable… the enemy who destroyed my clan, I finally have you. Though you are dead, this scent undeniably belongs to your inheritor or descendant. Hahaha!" The soul beast laughed madly.

Suddenly, Divine Bean Palace erupted with glaring rays of green light.

The green rays pierced the soul beast's body like countless sharp arrows.

The soul beast's crazed laughter stopped abruptly with a muffled groan: "This damned Divine Bean Palace!!"

Calming down, the soul beast muttered: "I must preserve my body to slaughter every inheritor of Spectral Soul and avenge our hatred!"

In Heavenly Court, Fairy Zi Wei deduced from the shifting phenomena: "This involves Genesis Lotus Immortal Venerable."

Opening her eyes with joy, she noted: "Divine Bean Palace, left in Western Desert by Genesis Lotus Immortal Venerable. It is a rank eight Immortal Gu House of outstanding might. It is about to appear in the world, we can't let it fall into Western Desert's hands."

"Chen Yi, Divine Bean Palace is appearing in Western Desert. Follow my plan and subdue it," Fairy Zi Wei instructed.

"Understood." Chen Yi bowed slightly, expression unchanged.

Several days later, Western Desert.

"From phantom to solid, interfering with the material world—haha, I have finally reached hundred million man soul!" Fang Yuan rejoiced inwardly.

# Chapter 1509: Third Entry to Thieving Heaven's dream realm

"Dang Hun Mountain and Luo Po Valley are indeed sacred lands of soul cultivation. Combined with the top techniques in Spectral Soul true inheritance, my soul foundation has soared rapidly."

Instead of leaving after reaching hundred million man soul, Fang Yuan stayed to capture soul beasts.

Dozens of days passed, and his soul foundation soared to two hundred million, growing increasingly solid and lifelike.

"Two hundred million man soul should suffice to explore the third stage of Thieving Heaven's dream realm." Fang Yuan was eager to return.

Storing the soul beast army in his sovereign immortal aperture, he concealed his tracks and quietly left green ghost desert.

Hurrying back, he soon stood before Thieving Heaven's dream realm once again.

After greeting Tang Fang Ming, Fang Yuan released the Shadow Sect immortals to control the formation as before, then entered Thieving Heaven's dream realm.

An oasis in the desert.

Fang Yuan was once again an observer.

"This is the place!" Sha Xiao's voice trembled with excitement.

Through investigative methods on young Thieving Heaven, Sha Xiao sensed an inexplicable aura near the pool, knowing he had found it.

"Quick, throw that sheepskin map into the pool!" Sha Xiao commanded with clear impatience.

Young Thieving Heaven was doubtful: "Didn't you take my sheepskin map? How would I have it?"

Sha Xiao laughed darkly: "I already stitched the map into your clothes. Good grandson, just take off that clothing and throw it into the pool!"

"Do I abandon my morals to return home? No. Sha Xiao may be formidable, but I will fight to the end and never bow to evil! I won't disgrace Ben Jie Sun's name!"

"Grandpa, the timing isn't right. Clan Gu Masters are watching, and guards will intercept my clothes before they hit the water. This pool is our clan's vital water source after all," young Thieving Heaven transmitted inwardly.

Sha Xiao paused, then replied slowly: "I was hasty, grandson; you're right. But find an opportunity to finish the task. Fail, and you die! Succeed, and Grandpa will give you unimaginable benefits!"

Clan Gu Masters led young Thieving Heaven to the underground cavern: "As competition victor, choose your Gu. Remember, you only have fifteen minutes."

Entering the smaller inner cavern, he found square recesses housing rank two Gu worms.

"Hmm?" Young Thieving Heaven's expression turned to surprise.

"I am in control of young Thieving Heaven's body again, but unlike previous emergencies, I have some leisure now." Fang Yuan took charge of his actions.

"How to deal with Sha Xiao? This demon is at least rank four, likely rank five." Scanning the numerous Gu worms, Fang Yuan thought: "The breakthrough lies in the Gu worms here."

Though young Thieving Heaven did not recognize these Gu worms, Fang Yuan's vast knowledge let him identify almost all of them, deducing the rest through testing.

"Furthermore, Sha Xiao's investigative methods stopped working once young Thieving Heaven entered the underground cavern."

With two hundred million man soul, he was confident no injury could directly destroy his soul.

Struck by inspiration, Fang Yuan decided to test how much deviation Thieving Heaven's dream realm could withstand!

# Chapter 1510: Fang Yuan Gets Captured

"The Gu worms are selected. Now, let's see." Fang Yuan took a deep breath, controlling young Thieving Heaven's body.

He first activated sneak attack Gu.

Fang Yuan sighed mentally: "Sneak attack Gu is top-tier; powerful for rank two and completely silent. According to the dream realm, this cavern definitely has defenses, But sneak attack Gu simply did not touch the defenses. I might as well refine some sneak attack Gu in the future."

Finding the rank two Gu unsuitable, Fang Yuan combined three rank one Gu into a killer move.

Already compromised by sneak attack Gu, the wall collapsed loudly under the rhino's impact.

As water surged in, a glowing membrane appeared on the wall, blocking most of it.

"What use is noticing now?" Fang Yuan sneered, combining sneak attack Gu with two others into a killer move.

The rank two killer move cloaked him in blue light, sharply increasing his speed.

Fang Yuan darted through the light membrane and plunged directly into the pool!

When the two guards arrived, they only saw Fang Yuan disappearing into the pool.

"Repair the defenses, I will capture this thief!" A guard shouted, chasing Fang Yuan through the light membrane.

Young Thieving Heaven was only rank one, his limited primeval essence nearly exhausted after repeated activations.

Within three moves, the guard captured him.

Full of hatred and seeing Fang Yuan resist, the guard struck his chest with a heavy palm.

Blood poured from Fang Yuan's seven orifices, spreading into the pool.

"Of course it had to be a rank three water path Gu Master." Fang Yuan smiled bitterly; immobilized, he took the palm strike head-on, suffering unprecedented soul damage.

Enduring the pain until his soul stabilized, Fang Yuan inspected it and was astonished.

"So powerful! This one strike cut down my soul foundation by fifty million!"

Thinking rapidly, he guessed: "Western Desert has few water path Gu Masters; was this person sent by the dream realm to target me? Fifty million man soul was wiped away—anyone else would be dead! Even if it were me previously, with ninety million man soul foundation, over half of my soul would have been destroyed instantly in this situation. And this third stage has just started, the later events definitely look like they will be more problematic!"

He speculated: "Following the dream realm's path might have avoided this attack, but charging in skipped many intermediate steps. This dream realm behavior is worth studying."

The pool's spirit spring burbled as if boiling.

"What's going on?" The rank three guard wondered as he surfaced holding Fang Yuan in one hand.

"My actions greatly reduced the steps—I've already reached the crucial juncture of the third stage!" Fang Yuan rejoiced, eyes shining at the changes in the pool.

# Chapter 1511: Theft Path Great Grandmaster!

The pool water burbled, its temperature rising rapidly.

"Traitor, what did you do?!" The rank three guard glared and grabbed Fang Yuan's neck.

"As I guessed, that sheepskin map is processed immortal material. Undetectable before, it reacted immediately upon soaking in this pool water."

Holding Fang Yuan by the neck, the rank three Gu Master floated to the surface and jumped ashore.

Clan higher-ups had gathered on the shore: the elders, the rank four clan leader, and even the retired previous leader.

Soaked and powerless, Fang Yuan was immediately restrained upon landing and subjected to harsh interrogation.

Fang Yuan only coughed, remaining silent.

"The pool is boiling, and red light is emerging!" someone cried out in surprise.

Breaths later, red light broke through the surface and soared into the sky, dyeing the clouds crimson for a hundred li around.

The clan leader scowled, about to interrogate Fang Yuan again, but was suddenly stopped.

His legs lost to battle injuries, the old clan leader's upper body floated before Fang Yuan.

He sighed deeply and persuaded kindly: "Child, you were likely enticed. If the clan has wronged you before, I apologize and will agree to whatever compensation you want. This matter concerns the lives of all our clansmen! Tell us everything you know. If an accident occurs, many families will die."

"Hehe." Fang Yuan snickered.

Now outside the cavern and no longer hidden, he knew Sha Xiao was aware of this situation.

"Damned bastard! How could the clan produce such a vile spawn?!" Furious at Fang Yuan's attitude, the clan leader immediately kicked him down.

Fang Yuan chuckled coldly: "Yes, kill me! Kill me and you'll learn nothing!"

"Kekeke! My good grandson, grandpa likes this nature of yours." Sha Xiao's mad laughter rang in Fang Yuan's ears.

"It can't be helped." The old clan leader stopped the current leader, his earlier affability replaced by a cold, cruel expression: "This kid is unrepentant; soul search him. No one will be blamed even if his soul is destroyed."

"Yes!" A rank three elder immediately stepped forward and grabbed Fang Yuan's head, soul searching him without hesitation.

In moments, Fang Yuan's soul foundation fell to ninety million, dropping below the hundred million mark.

Glaring red light erupted from the pool, completely evaporating the water and forming a colossal pillar of light that surged into the sky.

"Heaven qi surges and earth qi rises—this is the phenomenon of an Immortal Gu's creation. Whoever arranged this, it is no small matter." Fang Yuan was surprised.

The other mortal Gu Masters were terrified, completely forgetting young Thieving Heaven.

Relying on his experience, the old clan leader decisively ordered: "Retreat! Leave everything and save your lives!"

Only Fang Yuan remained behind in the pool.

Soon, Fang Yuan lost control and became an observer once again.

Young Thieving Heaven slumped to the ground in fright, weeping tears of regret.

Instantly, enchanting red light spanned thousands of li, engulfing both the stupefied clansmen and those fleeing.

In an instant, everyone touched by the light—mortal or Gu Master—aged drastically.

Young Thieving Heaven was no exception, transformed from a boy into an old man with a wrinkled face and grizzled hair.

"I should die; all my troubles will end with death!" Young Thieving Heaven closed his eyes awaiting death, but Sha Xiao's voice rang out.

"Hahaha, you want to die? As the owner of steal life Immortal Gu, how could you die?"

As young Thieving Heaven cried out mentally, the red light condensed into a scarlet bee that flew before him.

He involuntarily opened his palm; as the bee entered his hand, his extracted lifespan returned.

Sha Xiao laughed sinisterly: "My good grandson, this rank six Immortal Gu is grandpa's gift. Take it and roam the world. You are insignificant in this vast world; if you truly want to return home, make good use of this opportunity!"

"Immortal Gu?! Who are you? What are you trying to do?" Young Thieving Heaven felt no joy in gaining an Immortal Gu, only cold sweat soaking his body.

Sha Xiao's voice faded: "When the time is ripe, you will know…"

The third stage of the dream realm concluded.

Fang Yuan returned to reality, his soul returning to his body.

Inspecting himself, he had indeed become a theft path great grandmaster!

# Chapter 1512: Fallen Flower Hall

"Theft path great grandmaster attainment level…" Fang Yuan inhaled deeply, wearing a complex expression.

He had finally reached great grandmaster attainment. To think it was neither blood, strength, wisdom, nor time path, but theft path instead.

Having reached theft path great grandmaster, the remainder of Thieving Heaven's dream realm was useless to him.

"What a pity," Fang Yuan bade farewell to Tang Fang Ming regretfully. "An urgent matter has arisen that I must settle. I will explore Thieving Heaven's dream realm next time!"

Tang Fang Ming asked earnestly: "What is the matter? Can my Tang clan assist you?"

"It is fine, I can settle this myself." Fang Yuan nodded. Tang Fang Ming looked downcast in disappointment.

Soon, Fang Yuan handed an information path mortal Gu to Tang Fang Ming.

"This is...?" Sensing what it was, Tang Fang Ming excitedly received the mortal Gu with both hands.

"This Gu worm contains shallow insights I gained from exploring dream realms; I hope it helps you." Fang Yuan smiled and departed as Tang Fang Ming sighed in admiration.

"Still, my tactics cannot match Heavenly Court after all." Leaving, Fang Yuan sighed toward Central Continent.

"Even united, we are no match for Heavenly Court. My only hope is Red Lotus' true inheritance."

"I must raise my strength until I can navigate the River of Time alone." This was his plan.

He planned to cultivate in green ghost desert for the time being.

"Having saved Fang Yun and Fang Leng, I've interacted with Fang clan. As a super force, they will surely investigate and test me. Because I concealed my traces to explore Thieving Heaven's dream realm, Fang clan likely found nothing. The time is now ripe for them to send an envoy."

By disguising himself and befriending Fang clan, he could manage green ghost desert as his soul core farming ground.

Several days later, in green ghost desert.

As his soul beast army rampaged, Fang Yuan sat relaxed atop an ancient soul beast's back.

As a theft path great grandmaster, deducing rank five and six sneak attack Gu recipes was instantaneous and effortless.

He handed these theft path recipes to Lang Ya Sect for refinement.

Besides acquiring these Gu, Fang Yuan hunted soul beasts, restoring his soul foundation to hundred million man soul.

As Fang Yuan prepared to refine his killer moves further, an Immortal Gu House descended from the clouds toward him.

"Fang clan's Fallen Flower Hall." Fang Yuan smiled faintly; just as expected, they had come.

# Chapter 1513: Immortal Gu Reward

Fang Yuan restrained his soul beast army and watched motionlessly.

The door of Fallen Flower Hall opened, as three Gu Immortals came out.

The first was Fang clan's rank seven Fang An Lei, plump and smiling amiably.

"I am Fang An Lei, greetings."

"Fang Yun (Fang Leng) thanks senior for saving our lives!"

Fang Yuan nodded, replying coldly: "I saved you on a whim, but I know how you righteous path people think."

"You understand us well. Representing Fang clan, I come not only to thank you, but to propose cooperation." Fang An Lei smiled.

"Oh, cooperation?" Fang Yuan acted slightly surprised.

Fang An Lei stepped back and invited: "We have prepared tea in the hall; shall we discuss this inside?"

"Alright." Storing his soul beast army away, Fang Yuan strolled into Fallen Flower Hall.

Taking a sip of the served tea, Fang Yuan asked directly: "What does your clan wish to do?"

"You want me to collect impermanence rocks?" Fang Yuan tapped the table, considering the project.

"With my soul beast army, collecting impermanence rocks is easy, though gathering scattered deposits requires time."

Fang Yuan had to consider Fang clan's true motive behind this cooperation.

In exchange for delivering the impermanence rocks, Fang Yuan would receive a rank six Immortal Gu.

An alliance agreement with Fang clan would ensure his operations in green ghost desert were officially recognized.

"Once allied, Suan Bu Jin will explore green ghost desert under the guise of harvesting impermanence rocks. If he discovers Qing clan's inheritance, our trailing immortals will locate it too."

"Even if he encounters Old Ghost Bai Jun, Suan Bu Jin will have to fight him. And should he discover Qing clan's inheritance, the alliance agreement prevents him from competing with us."

"Alright, I agree." Fang Yuan agreed after consideration.

Lacking sufficient information to deduce Fang clan's true objective, Fang Yuan still wanted to cooperate.

"Friend, you are very decisive. You will not regret cooperating with our Fang clan," Fang An Lei laughed. "Next, let us discuss the specific terms… hmm?"

"We are encircled by soul beasts," Fang An Lei said. "Old Ghost Bai Jun has attacked with multiple immemorial soul beasts!"

"Immemorial soul beasts?" Fang Yuan was slightly surprised, not yet knowing that the rank eight Immortal Gu was Soul Beast Token.

Fang An Lei's eyes glinted faintly; after brief thought, she shared this information with Fang Yuan.

"Soul Beast Token is a rank eight enslavement path Immortal Gu—magnificent, this will be extremely useful for my soul core harvesting plan!"

At this thought, Fang Yuan felt a strong urge to design a theft path killer move to steal this rank eight Immortal Gu!

Controlling himself, he told Fang An Lei: "Old Ghost Bai Jun is bold to challenge an Immortal Gu House. Next, it is time for your clan's Immortal Gu House to shine!"

Fang An Lei was dazed; wishing to see Fang Yuan fight, she found her intentions preempted.

"You offended him to save our juniors. We will fight him, but should the battle go awry, we hope you assist us against these immemorial soul beasts," Fang An Lei said.

Fang Yuan laughed: "Of course!"

# Chapter 1514: Simultaneous Ambush

An immemorial soul beast with a bull's body and leopard's tail charged like a mountain.

Simultaneously, a shrill screech pierced the sky as a winged black python immemorial soul beast descended amid a powerful gale.

The ground shook as three colossal monstrous fingers erupted from the earth, grabbing toward Fallen Flower Hall.

"Rise!" Fang An Lei shouted, sending the Immortal Gu House soaring into the sky like a rainbow.

The monstrous hand grabbed thin air, colliding with the bull-bodied leopard-tailed immemorial soul beast.

Though it evaded two immemorial soul beasts, the winged black python still loomed in the air.

The black python hissed and pounced at Fallen Flower Hall.

Fang An Lei maneuvered Fallen Flower Hall to ram directly into it instead of dodging.

Cracks covered Fallen Flower Hall as the flowers on its exterior shed rapidly.

Meanwhile, the winged black python crashed into the ground, creating a huge crater upon impact.

Pale, Fang An Lei quickly stabilized Fallen Flower Hall mid-air, casting a brilliant light around the structure.

Once the light faded, Fallen Flower Hall was fully restored, its cracks gone and flowers reborn.

"Rapidly repairing an Immortal Gu House? Impressive—did they replace the Gu worms or refine them on the spot?"

"Hehehehe!" Old Ghost Bai Jun's laughter filled the battlefield: "So what if you have an Immortal Gu House? Obediently surrender, I might spare your lives!"

Old Ghost Bai Jun made a sharp noise, drawing the two immemorial soul beasts to his side.

"A chance!" Fang An Lei's eyes flashed sharply as she prepared to bypass the winged black python and ram Fallen Flower Hall into Old Ghost Bai Jun.

Against three immemorial soul beasts, her best strategy was eliminating their controller, Old Ghost Bai Jun.

Fang Yuan sneered: "Don't be hasty. I've deduced that this is a trap."

"Forget it! Activating Soul Beast Token drains my soul foundation rapidly; I must end this battle quickly!"

Growling ruthlessly, Old Ghost Bai Jun dispatched the fourth immemorial soul beast to attack Fallen Flower Hall.

This fourth immemorial soul beast was a spiked flying spider, the smallest among them at the size of a normal tiger.

Yet it was extremely fast, shooting through the sky like an arrow.

The heavy winged black python and lightning-fast flying spider coordinated seamlessly, relentlessly suppressing Fallen Flower Hall.

Fang Yuan chuckled: "He is at his limit. Controlling four immemorial soul beasts with rank seven cultivation exceeds his abilities. The situation will turn around shortly."

On the desert ground, Old Ghost Bai Jun turned pale and trembled as his aura weakened drastically.

"I will spare your lives today! Next time, I will tear you to pieces!" he threatened, retreating with his soul beast army.

"Where are you going?" Having taken a beating for so long, Fang An Lei refused to let him off.

In the chase that followed, Fallen Flower Hall attacked, slaying countless soul beasts.

"Wait, something is wrong." Fang Yuan frowned lightly.

An eagle's screech tore through the sky, piercing the ears of the four immortals within the Immortal Gu House.

Dressed in tight black with eagle claws for hands, she charged forward, trailing black smoke.

Rank seven demonic path Gu Immortal — Eagle Concubine!

Eagle Concubine slashed past Fallen Flower Hall without slowing down.

Fallen Flower Hall suffered heavy damage, three claw marks nearly piercing its roof.

She said to Fang Yuan: "Friend, I need your assistance; I cannot handle this alone."

To secure cooperation with Fang clan, Fang Yuan could not remain idle.

He nodded immediately: "I will deal with Old Ghost Bai Jun; please stall this eagle-claw female immortal."

The Immortal Gu House's door opened, and Fang Yuan stepped onto the battlefield.

Immortal killer move — Ignited Thought Flying Rock.

Long prepared, Fang Yuan pointed his finger, raining down an incredible barrage of meteors from the sky.

Squinting with a weak aura, Old Ghost Bai Jun shielded himself behind the two immemorial soul beasts to block Fang Yuan's killer move.

The ground cracked open as monster growls thundered in their ears.

A huge palace shining in green radiance flew out, crashing fiercely toward Fang Yuan.

Rank eight Immortal Gu House — Divine Bean Palace!

# Chapter 1515: Exposing His True Body

"Rank eight Immortal Gu House!" Facing Divine Bean Palace's assault, shock appeared on Fang Yuan's face.

"Descendant of Spectral Soul, die!" Within Divine Bean Palace, the immemorial soul beast roared, its killing intent filling the surroundings.

This mountain-sized beast, master of Bai Jun and Eagle Concubine, possessed a tortoise shell, tiger claws, dragon tail, snake neck, and human head.

Though it controlled Divine Bean Palace, the palace's shining green light suppressed it instead.

Divine Bean Palace crashed toward Fang Yuan, while the rank seven demonic path female immortal Eagle Concubine charged at him from behind.

Old Ghost Bai Jun screeched as he went all-out, summoning the two immemorial soul beasts.

The flying spider immemorial soul beast shot out like lightning, while the winged black python immemorial soul beast crashed down like a mountain.

Vigilant by nature, he had prepared myriad self clones in his aperture and shortened reverse flow protection seal's activation time.

"Hahaha." At the crucial moment, Fang Yuan laughed loudly.

Immortal killer move — Single Thought Endless Clones!

Dozens of blue light silhouettes emerged from his body, scattering to the surroundings.

Multiplying from one to four and four to ten, they formed a massive blue silhouette army.

Hidden among the silhouettes, Fang Yuan's true body could not be discovered.

Divine Bean Palace crashed towards him like a meteor.

Wherever it went, the blue shadows shattered helplessly like bursting bubbles.

Hiding nearby rather than fleeing far, Fang Yuan watched Divine Bean Palace charge straight for him.

Fang Yuan's eyes flashed brightly as he spewed dense fog across the area.

Immortal killer move — Directional Confusion Fog!

The Gu Immortals within the battlefield were enveloped by it.

Divine Bean Palace plunged into the fog and chased down Fang Yuan, completely unaffected by the directional confusion fog.

Though lightning-fast, Fang Yuan could not outpace Divine Bean Palace; he could only watch the looming Immortal Gu House fill his vision, poised to crash into him.

Fang Yuan's lips curled up.

With a loud sound, an intense collision occurred.

Yet Fang Yuan was spared; Divine Bean Palace collided directly with the immemorial soul beast winged black python.

"Even though I cannot confuse you, I can confuse others!" Eerie light shined in Fang Yuan's eyes, he used this chance to activate reverse flow protection seal!

In a flash, he cast single thought endless clones again while activating familiar face, disguising himself as a blue shadow to blend in.

Divine Bean Palace snapped the winged black python's body in two upon impact—a testament to the rank eight Immortal Gu House's power.

Chipped by the impact, Divine Bean Palace slowed significantly, yet under the mysterious soul beast's control, it still pursued Fang Yuan's true body.

"What is going on? Even with familiar face, the enemy can still sense me?" Fang Yuan was deeply shocked.

"Ghost official garment protects against deductions. Anyone deducing matters about me must bypass it first, yet there are no signs of deductions."

# Chapter 1516: Karma Divine Tree

As Divine Bean Palace pursued Fang Yuan, a youthful Gu Immortal sat cross-legged atop a distant mound.

Dispatched by Fairy Zi Wei, he was Chen Yi, first supreme elder of Heavenly Lotus Sect.

As he maintained his immortal killer move, green smoke rose from his head and shoulders.

Gathering six feet above his head, the circulating smoke gradually coalesced into the shape of a tree.

A moment later, Chen Yi ceased his killer move, and the smoky divine tree faded away.

He opened his eyes slowly and thought with certainty: "So that's it."

Three hundred thousand years ago during Medieval Antiquity, Genesis Lotus journeyed in the west.

An invincible Immortal Venerable, he traveled the world disguised as a mortal Gu Master.

Seeing that he was a Gu Master, a child he met begged him to revive his deceased mother.

"People cannot be resurrected after they die." Genesis Lotus Immortal Venerable refused, preparing to console the child.

"Forget it if you won't help!" The child turned around and left with hatred.

Genesis Lotus paid it no mind, but green smoke suddenly surged above his head, nearly erupting.

Shocked, he thought: "Karma divine tree uses fate as soil and luck as water to nourish its leaves. It ignores all worldly confusion to reveal the root cause and effect of matters."

"Rejecting that child seemed a trivial cause, but karma divine tree's reaction shows this small cause will yield a disastrous effect."

Even knowing this, Genesis Lotus Immortal Venerable did not strike down the child.

"Once the tree develops bad fruit, we must pluck it to stop evil from spreading. We immortals are merely the world's pesticide."

Sighing, Genesis Lotus Immortal Venerable left behind his Immortal Gu House Divine Bean Palace.

Buried by sandstorms, Divine Bean Palace eventually passed into the hands of Qing clan.

Qing clan's arrogance with the palace enraged Spectral Soul before his venerableship, leading him to slaughter the entire clan.

On the brink of destruction, Qing clan's first supreme elder concealed their inheritance within Divine Bean Palace and set up a revival method in hopes of survival.

Though Qing clan was wiped out, their bitter hatred and countless Gu Immortal soul fragments were drawn into Divine Bean Palace.

Over time, the trapped soul fragments gradually fused into an unprecedented legendary immemorial soul beast.

Endowed with human nature and deep wisdom, the soul beast sought revenge against Spectral Soul, adopting the surname Qing and naming itself Chou—Qing Chou!

Pity that by Qing Chou's birth, Spectral Soul had already become a venerable and vanished.

Qing Chou sought revenge against Spectral Soul Demon Venerable's family and friends, but remained imprisoned inside Divine Bean Palace.

Old Ghost Bai Jun and Eagle Concubine had unluckily entered Divine Bean Palace, only to be suppressed and enslaved by Qing Chou.

"This Qing Chou is truly fortunate; as a legendary immemorial soul beast, it naturally nurtures many wild Immortal Gu, including the rank eight Soul Beast Token."

"It refined this Gu and gave it to Old Ghost Bai Jun, wanting to use the soul beast army to help suppress Divine Bean Palace."

"Unfortunately, Old Ghost Bai Jun clashed with Fang clan's immortals and Suan Bu Jin right away, failing and exposing the matter."

Chen Yi sighed before he concealed his figure, vanishing on the spot.

Born within Divine Bean Palace, legendary immemorial soul beast Qing Chou absorbed part of karma divine tree's power, embedding it into its deep-rooted thirst for revenge.

Thus, Qing Chou could easily discern anyone closely tied to Spectral Soul.

Yet though Fang Yuan failed to deceive Qing Chou, he remained hidden from Chen Yi outside the battlefield.

Concealing reverse flow protection seal and shielded by ghost official garment, Fang Yuan remained undetected by Chen Yi.

The immediate problem was that Divine Bean Palace still pursued Fang Yuan.

Having crashed into the winged black python, Divine Bean Palace slowed considerably, allowing Fang Yuan to pull far ahead.

"There is no need to keep fighting. The enemy is after Fang clan, and I have already shown sufficient sincerity." Eyes shining brightly, Fang Yuan flew toward Fang clan's rank seven Immortal Gu House, Fallen Flower Hall.

With a resolute expression, she instructed the two beside her: "Fang Yun and Fang Leng, help me control Fallen Flower Hall. We will save Suan Bu Jin first, before fighting Divine Bean Palace!"

Qing Chou wanted to kill Fang Yuan, who remained unaware.

Fang Yuan thought that Qing Chou was after Fang clan.

Fang clan likewise assumed Qing Chou targeted them. Suan Bu Jin had proven his sincerity, so duty demanded they stand against Divine Bean Palace!

Even Heavenly Court's rank eight Gu Immortal Chen Yi thought the same, deeming Suan Bu Jin simply unlucky to be caught in the crossfire!

# Chapter 1517: Fallen Flower Hall versus Divine Bean Palace (1/2)

Seeing Fang Yuan enter Fallen Flower Hall, Qing Chou roared furiously with surging killing intent.

Flickering green light inside Divine Bean Palace suppressed Qing Chou, but it ignored the suppression and drove the palace straight at Fallen Flower Hall.

"Master, I can't continue anymore…" Old Ghost Bai Jun screamed in agony.

"Kill, kill him, otherwise, you can all die!" Qing Chou roared.

Enslaved by Qing Chou, Bai Jun mobilized his immemorial soul beasts while Eagle Concubine attacked Fallen Flower Hall.

Facing the imposing onslaught, Fang An Lei steered Fallen Flower Hall in retreat.

The winged black python fell behind, but the swift flying spider immemorial soul beast tried to enter through Fallen Flower Hall's roof.

Simultaneously, Eagle Concubine screeched and lashed out with her claws, raining countless marks upon Fallen Flower Hall.

She told Fang Yun and Fang Leng: "Fly Fallen Flower Hall, I will unleash a killer move."

Immortal killer move — Mirror Flower!

As the frenzied claw strikes neared Fallen Flower Hall, the rooftop mirror flower unleashed a powerful suction.

At this moment, Divine Bean Palace got close.

The mirror flower bloomed anew, discharging all the absorbed claw marks.

Halting Divine Bean Palace's advance, Fallen Flower Hall used the recoil of the attack to accelerate away.

"Oh no, that immemorial soul beast flying spider is about to get in!" Fang Yun shouted.

Though the others were repelled, the smaller flying spider clung to a corner, trying to squeeze inside.

At the crucial moment, Fang An Lei made her move.

Immortal killer move — Fleeting Bloom!

Where the rooftop mirror flower had wilted, another blossom grew.

Its mysterious power locked onto the flying spider, drastically reducing its speed.

Fang Yuan's gaze flickered, recognizing that Fang An Lei had achieved this by burning her lifespan.

"Fallen Flower Hall ranks among the finest rank seven Immortal Gu Houses, but two immemorial soul beasts, Divine Bean Palace, and two rank seven demonic immortals are too much! Going all out only bought temporary defense!"

Fang An Lei looked toward Fang Yuan, thinking: "His methods are formidable. We need his help, or I won't last long."

With that in mind, Fang An Lei sent a transmission to Fang Yuan.

Receiving the message, Fang Yuan saw that Fang An Lei proposed a formal alliance against this powerful enemy.

"I can escape, but Fang An Lei cannot. This alliance favors me greatly; without this ambush, Fang clan would never ally with me so readily and on such lenient terms."

Fang clan's proposed impermanence rock project was still included in the alliance agreement.

Beyond the rank six Immortal Gu, Fang An Lei promised Fang Yuan substantial immortal materials as compensation.

"A rank six Immortal Gu is of little use to me, but demanding rank seven would seem like extortion. Forget it! This is a prime opportunity; I do not need to let greed ruin it."

Having settled on his plan, Fang Yuan replied: "I will join this alliance!"

Having prepared the required Immortal Gu and methods, Fang clan concluded the alliance pact swiftly.

But now, Fallen Flower Hall was encircled heavily.

As Divine Bean Palace crashed in, Fallen Flower Hall was cut off from dodging and plummeted toward the ground like a shooting star.

"Kill! Kill! Kill!" Inside Divine Bean Palace, Qing Chou roared in vengeful joy, ignoring the solidified green light piercing its body.

# Chapter 1518: Fallen Flower Hall versus Divine Bean Palace (2/2)

Inferior to Divine Bean Palace, Fallen Flower Hall suffered a massive breach in its western wall from the impact.

Simultaneously, the flying spider breached Fallen Flower Hall's surface, plunging Fang clan into mortal danger.

In this crisis, Fang An Lei shrieked as she unleashed her strongest method.

Immortal killer move — Empty Valley Orchid!

The entire Immortal Gu House shrank, becoming as small as a child's toy in the blink of an eye.

Sweat rolled down Fang An Lei's pale face as she strained to sustain the spatial distortion.

"Amazing! I will handle the flying spider," Fang Yuan praised, exiting through the breach.

Shielded by empty valley orchid, Fang Yuan was temporarily safe without risking exposing reverse flow protection seal.

Immortal killer move — Hundred and Eighty Slaves!

Upon activation, the immemorial flying spider shuddered, its infiltration into the Immortal Gu House drastically slowing.

The flying spider struggled violently, rendered helpless as control was contested between Fang Yuan and Old Ghost Bai Jun.

Inside Fallen Flower Hall, Fang An Lei frowned deeply with closed eyes, trembling intensely on the verge of collapse.

"The battle is really disadvantageous to our side." Fang Yuan's eyes flashed.

"I need to disguise my identity while resolving this crisis, what should I do… hmm?" Suddenly, Fang Yuan had a sensation.

"What is going on?" Fang Yuan looked over ten li away and saw Old Ghost Bai Jun coughing blood.

Laughing heartily, Fang Yuan swiftly subdued the flying spider, securing the immemorial soul beast.

Obtaining the flying spider, Fang Yuan commanded it to attack Divine Bean Palace.

Sensing something, he turned around to see two Immortal Gu Houses flying toward them!

Eagle Concubine shouted in shock: "Master, let's retreat!!"

At the crucial moment, Fang clan's reinforcements arrived.

"Kill, kill him!" Consumed by rage, Qing Chou ignored Eagle Concubine's warning, wanting only Fang Yuan dead.

Far away, Heavenly Lotus Sect's first supreme elder Chen Yi had been observing secretly, but grew worried now.

"Fang clan's reinforcements—Chicken Dog Coop and Inquiry Dock! Combined with Fallen Flower Hall, they will form peach blossom maze. Trapped inside, I cannot escape, nor can Qing Chou unleash Divine Bean Palace's full power."

Chen Yi sighed helplessly: "To think my first action here is not to deal with Qing Chou, but to help it."

Immortal killer move — Karma Divine Tree!

The fruits on the karma divine tree shook, Divine Bean Palace shone with green light, turning the sky jade green.

Inside the palace, countless green lights transformed from twigs into spears, stabbing Qing Chou from all directions!

"I feel anger, hatred, and unwillingness—I want him dead!!!"

Frenzied, it erupted with power as countless Immortal Gu auras surged from its body, mixing into an immortal killer move.

This terrifying killer move destroyed several huge pillars within Divine Bean Palace and blasted its doors wide open!

Qing Chou roared, finally glimpsing the outside world through the doorway.

Mustering its strength to rise, its snake neck stretched out and its mouth opened terrifyingly wide, almost splitting its head.

With a soft sound, its purple tongue shot out like a sharp blade, stabbing rapidly toward Fang Yuan.

Piercing unobstructed through the distorted space, the purple tongue sword reached Fang Yuan's forehead in an instant.

"I'll dodge it!" Sinister light flashing in his eyes, Fang Yuan slipped into Fallen Flower Hall through the breach.

The purple tongue sword pursued him, breaching Fallen Flower Hall.

Without slowing down, it extended further and pierced into Fang An Lei's chest.

Fang An Lei's eyes widened and her body stiffened as she slowly looked down at her chest.

"Friend!" Fang Yuan cried out in dismay.

# Chapter 1519: Finding Trouble After Plotting Against Them

Hit by the purple tongue sword, Fang An Lei turned stiff as stone while her face began turning purple.

Having pierced her body, the agile purple tongue sword whipped around toward Fang Yuan.

By now, Fang Yun and Fang Leng reacted, controlling the Immortal Gu House's profound lights to suppress and slow the purple tongue sword.

Vines coiled around Fang An Lei amid fragrant blooms; petals adhered to her flesh as luminous healing light flowed into her body through the vines.

Fang Yuan appeared grim, but cold calculation hid in his eyes as he thought rapidly.

With reinforcements present, Fang clan now possessed three Immortal Gu Houses: Fallen Flower Hall, Chicken Dog Coop, and Inquiry Dock. Together, they could form the formidable battlefield killer move peach blossom maze.

From the prolonged fight, Fang Yuan could tell Divine Bean Palace was acting strangely.

An immemorial soul beast seemed to be controlling this rank eight Immortal Gu House, merely flying it around without unleashing its true power.

Yet if Fang clan suppressed or captured this rank eight Immortal Gu House, what would Fang Yuan gain?

Under their alliance agreement, he would only receive a rank six Immortal Gu and some immortal materials.

Furthermore, once Fang clan secured the rank eight house, all four Immortal Gu Houses might coerce Fang Yuan into a new agreement!

With such an Immortal Gu House before him, how could Fang Yuan not scheme for profit?

To do so, he had to balance both sides, thus improvising with the purple tongue sword to incapacitate Fang An Lei and weaken Fang clan.

Chicken Dog Coop and Inquiry Dock rushed into the battlefield like meteors.

Before they could act, Divine Bean Palace radiated dazzling light.

Failing to kill Fang Yuan, the extremely weakened Qing Chou was forcefully suppressed by Divine Bean Palace.

Activating on its own, Divine Bean Palace spread green light, sweeping the unconscious Old Ghost Bai Jun, pale Eagle Concubine, and surviving soul beasts inside before soaring into the sky.

As Divine Bean Palace sped away, Fang clan hesitated briefly; Chicken Dog Coop stayed behind while Inquiry Dock gave chase.

A Fang clan Gu Immortal flew out and rushed into Fallen Flower Hall, shouting anxiously: "An Lei, An Lei!"

But Fang An Lei's face was purple, she was unconscious.

Just then, an orange profound light shot from Chicken Dog Coop into Fang An Lei's forehead.

The purple miasma on her face eased, saving her life, though she remained unconscious and barely hanging on.

A solemn, white-haired Gu Immortal in yellow robes entered: "This soul path move carries poison effects; I can only suppress her condition, not heal it!"

"Greetings, third supreme elder." Fang Yun and Fang Leng quickly greeted.

"Fang clan's third supreme elder, Fang Hua Sheng…" Fang Yuan recalled his intel.

"It's you! You hid inside Fallen Flower Hall and lured the attack here, hitting An Lei—you are the culprit!!" screamed the Fang clan Gu Immortal holding Fang An Lei.

Fang Yuan looked at him coldly, snorting: "Who are you?"

Before he finished, Fang Yuan waved his sleeves: "I don't care who you are. If you're unhappy, we can fight—martial or literary duel, I accept either. If you want to use Fang clan's forces to deal with me, Suan Bu Jin, hehe, go right ahead."

With cold eyes and an imposing demeanor, Fang Yuan's aura overpowered the room.

"Fang Chen, watch your words! Friend Suan Bu Jin is our ally bound by agreement who fought hard earlier—how can you slander him?" Fang Hua Sheng reprimanded.

Turning to Fang Yuan, he said sincerely: "Fang Chen is Fang An Lei's husband; frantic with worry, he didn't mean offense. Please forgive him, friend."

Fang Yuan thought: "Fang Yun and Fang Leng are anxious, Fang Hua Sheng is a sly fox, and Fang Chen is simply playing his part as an in-law after his wife was gravely injured. But it is a pity, I do not fear them."

Fang An Lei had signed the alliance agreement on Fang clan's behalf and interacted most with Fang Yuan.

If Fang clan breached it, Fang An Lei would suffer information path backlash—which she could never survive now.

The unconscious Fang An Lei was practically Fang Yuan's greatest shield.

Fang Yuan sneered fearlessly: "Friend Fang Hua Sheng, Fang clan must give me an explanation, or I will not let this drop!"

Fang Hua Sheng feigned confusion and coldness: "What do you mean, friend? Does my Fang clan owe you something?"

# Chapter 1520: Negotiation Fails

Fang Yuan snorted, meeting Fang Hua Sheng's gaze coldly and unyieldingly.

Under everyone's gaze, he said: "As a wisdom path Gu Immortal, would I be fooled so easily? Why did your immortals fall into Old Ghost Bai Jun's hands? And your reinforcements arrived so conveniently with two rank seven Immortal Gu Houses and multiple immortals. Since when could Fang clan mobilize such forces at will?"

Fang Hua Sheng laughed: "Friend, you're right. To be blunt, our clan has plotted for generations to obtain this rank eight Immortal Gu House. If you lend a hand, we will reward you handsomely. Look at this."

He handed an information path mortal Gu to Fang Yuan.

Fang Yuan took a look, it was another alliance agreement.

The rules were: As long as Fang Yuan helped Fang clan to take the rank eight Immortal Gu House Divine Bean Palace, Fang clan would compensate him with a rank seven Immortal Gu, he would be allowed to choose one from their treasury. There would also be a lot of rank six and seven immortal materials given to him.

Presently, Fang Yuan's concern was not confidentiality, but what benefits he could reap.

The greatest prize was naturally Divine Bean Palace itself!

Yet souring ties with Fang clan for an uncaptured palace was too costly a gamble.

Thus, Fang Yuan remarked: "If your clan obtains Divine Bean Palace, your strength will top Western Desert. With conquest in sight, isn't offering me peanuts too little?"

Fang Hua Sheng smiled: "Oh? So friend wishes to participate and help us? That is even better!"

"Divine Bean Palace comes from Genesis Lotus Immortal Venerable; how could I miss this? Besides, would Fang clan truly trust me if I stood aside?" Fang Yuan countered.

Fang Hua Sheng laughed: "You are very understanding. We can negotiate conditions, but compensation must match your contribution—surely you agree?"

Fang Yuan smiled: "Of course. First, even if I stay idle, keeping this secret is already a contribution requiring compensation. Second, saving Fang Yun and Fang Leng aided your plan for Divine Bean Palace. Though done on a whim, I now demand a reward. Third, I helped defend Fallen Flower Hall against formidable foes in a perilous battle, which also deserves compensation. Finally, your clansman slandered my goodwill and ruined my mood, which must be compensated as well."

"I cannot accept these terms. Consider it, friend Suan Bu Jin; I will be in Chicken Dog Coop when you are ready to sign." With a dark expression, he flicked his sleeves and left.

Fang Yuan smiled faintly. Fang Hua Sheng's departure was merely a tactical retreat after losing the verbal duel, not Fang clan's final word on such a crucial matter.

"Fang clan's first supreme elder is rank eight, while second supreme elder Fang Di Chang is a rank seven wisdom path great grandmaster. He will likely come next."

As expected, Inquiry Dock soon appeared.

Soon, Fang Hua Sheng entered Inquiry Dock: "Second supreme elder, how did it go?"

Fang Di Chang said: "Divine Bean Palace accelerated beyond pursuit, but our tracking method holds. Now we must repair Fallen Flower Hall and unite all three houses to trap it within peach blossom maze, ensuring victory."

Fang Hua Sheng reported: "Suan Bu Jin is difficult and demanding; our negotiation failed."

"Not yet?" Fang Di Chang smiled, bright light flashing in his eyes.

Fang Hua Sheng smiled bitterly: "His words are full of traps; I was no match. Yet by remaining inside Fallen Flower Hall, he purposely dispels suspicion of leaving. Though his conditions are absurd, his willingness to make an agreement shows sincerity."

Fang Di Chang pondered: "He may simply be fearless. Fang An Lei's injury makes him suspicious, but we can tolerate him for the clan's plan. Impatience spoils great plans. Remaining in Fallen Flower Hall means he is likely waiting for me. Fine, I will meet him."

Inquiry Dock landed, and Fang Di Chang emerged to meet Fang Yuan inside Fallen Flower Hall.

Assessing Fang Di Chang's plain appearance, Fang Yuan was inwardly shocked: "This is Fang Di Chang? His immortal aura is completely concealed—truly worthy of a wisdom path great grandmaster!"

# Chapter 1521: Peach Blossom Maze

Fang Di Chang and Fang Yuan clashed with words like two master swordsmen in close quarters.

Fang Yuan was suppressed gradually, it was a troublesome opponent.

"Impressive, as expected of a wisdom path great grandmaster." While Fang Hua Sheng was helpless against Fang Yuan's rhetoric, Fang Di Chang easily neutralized every argument.

"If I fight Fang clan in the future, I must kill this person first!"

"Hahaha." While debating, Fang Yuan suddenly laughed.

Fang Yuan bowed to Fang Di Chang: "Senior truly lives up to your renowned reputation; I have learned much."

"Earlier, I was merely testing your clan. Outmatched by senior's skill, how could I continue?" Though apologizing, Fang Yuan maintained an arrogant look.

Half a day later, Fang clan's Gu Immortals worked together and repaired Fallen Flower Hall completely.

After resting briefly, Fang clan's Gu Immortals set out.

The truth is, our Immortal Gu Houses develop as our clan progresses, they continuously get stronger."

Fang Yuan was moved: "I have learned about Fang clan's style of doing things today."

"We have arrived." After flying further, Fang Di Chang fixed his gaze and ordered the three Immortal Gu Houses to stop.

Fang Di Chang squinted: "Divine Bean Palace is deeply concealed indeed. Set up the formation!"

Immortal battlefield killer move — Peach Blossom Maze!

The surrounding thousand li instantly turned into a peach forest of towering, dense trees, completely bare of leaves, flowers, or fruit.

"Oh? They are here?" Deep underground, Chen Yi's heart also jumped.

At this moment, he had actually infiltrated Divine Bean Palace!

# Chapter 1522: Green Armor Vegetable Garden

As Heavenly Lotus Sect's first supreme elder possessing Genesis Lotus' true inheritance, Chen Yi could heavily influence Divine Bean Palace.

"Due to Spectral Soul Demon Venerable, Qing Chou formed in Divine Bean Palace, possessing some power of karma divine tree. It senses anyone tied to Spectral Soul Demon Venerable. Capturing it will deepen my grasp of karma divine tree and locate Shadow Sect!"

"Peach blossom maze is truly profound! Divine Bean Palace should be buried deep below the desert, yet this maze exposed it entirely." Inside Inquiry Dock, Fang Yuan's eyes shone as he inwardly praised the move.

Emerging from Divine Bean Palace, the soul beasts did not charge Fang clan, instead encircling the palace in a quiet defensive ring.

Their powerful attacks struck the soul beast army, but the beasts suffered little damage and healed rapidly.

Chen Yi shouted within Divine Bean Palace as green light erupted from deep within the soul beasts.

With crisp sounds, the green light formed wooden armor over the soul beasts, shielding them from head to toe.

Fang Yuan was puzzled, but Fang Di Chang exclaimed in shock: "This is Divine Bean Palace's immortal killer move — Green Armor Vegetable Garden!"

"Green armor vegetable garden?" Fang Yuan asked.

# Chapter 1523: Extorting Fang Di Chang

"Though a few soul beasts fell, the overall effect is minimal. Their green armor links together to split damage evenly—truly amazing!"

Inside Inquiry Dock, Fang Di Chang frowned: "Poison path has no effect; green armor vegetable garden seems to have no weaknesses."

"Oh?" Fang Yuan's eyes shone. "Each warrior can store a killer move to unleash upon self-detonation."

Immortal killer move — Hundred and Eighty Slaves!

Upon activation, the immemorial soul beast froze under a formless force.

Three flowery wind warriors exploded, all imbued with enslavement path killer move hundred and eighty slaves, striking the winged black python immemorial soul beast.

# Chapter 1538: Fetus Earth Maze

# Chapter 1539: Reforming Fang Yuan

Tie Mian Shen flew down, greeting Lu Wei Yin: "Senior, how will we kill this demon Fang Yuan?"

In immemorial white heaven, Chen Yi flew like lightning through the clouds.

# Chapter 1541: Fang Yuan's Love

Give up, please give up!"

Fang Yuan looked at Xiu Niang closely, feeling as though he were seeing her for the first time.

Crying in distress, Xiu Niang clasped Fang Yuan's hands and spoke of the past, trying to stir his memories.

Love slowly awakening within him, Fang Yuan looked into Xiu Niang's eyes and caressed her tender cheek: "Xiu Niang…"

# Chapter 1542: Merely Amounted To This

A night later.

The well held a Gu Immortal's inheritance known as the Virtue true inheritance, heavily incomplete due to its long history.

Inheriting it, Fang Yuan awakened his aperture, became a rank one Gu Master, and obtained several mortal Gu, completely changing his life.

"Yet this true inheritance requires a heart of justice. The more virtuous I am, the easier cultivation becomes."

During his cultivation, the old lady fell gravely ill.

He sought a healing Gu Master, but the rank two refused, looking down on his meager fees.

The old lady recovered, and Fang Yuan's joy multiplied when he discovered a rank two accumulate virtue Gu in his aperture.

Accumulate virtue Gu refined itself whenever Fang Yuan performed good deeds; greater kindness yielded higher-ranked Gu. A core foundation of the Virtue true inheritance with many uses, its greatest effect was altering Fang Yuan's aptitude into the Righteous Virtue Physique.

Henceforth, Fang Yuan accumulated virtue through good deeds, never passing up an opportunity to refine accumulate virtue Gu.

With improving aptitude, his cultivation soared, reaching rank two within two years.

Saving a drowning child during an incident, he exposed his identity as a Gu Master.

A Shu clan elder witnessed this, uncovering Fang Yuan's secret.

Deducing that a mere mortal reaching rank two must harbor a massive secret, the Shu clan elder attacked him.

Surpassing his limits, Fang Yuan unleashed the mortal killer move Virtuous Submission!

Uninjured by the move, the Shu clan elder knelt weeping and slapped himself: "I am not human! To harbor such evil thoughts and attack someone as virtuous as you! I am a beast! Please forgive me and give me a chance to redeem myself!"

As their conflict peaked, Shu clan's young master challenged Fang Yuan to a death match.

On the eve of the duel, Shu clan Gu Masters ambushed Fang Yuan.

Heavily injured, Fang Yuan fled into the mountains, filled with fury and hatred.

"How can I let Xiu Niang marry that scoundrel? Even if I die, I will... what is that sound?" Shocked, Fang Yuan turned to see an enormous beast tide approaching.

"Good! Heaven is not blind! Let this beast tide destroy the city and crush the unprepared Shu clan—I will be avenged!"

Resolute, Fang Yuan ran toward the city.

Years with the Virtue true inheritance had ingrained virtue into his mindset, making him feel a deep responsibility to act!

Fang Yuan returned to the city and warned everyone of the beast tide, drawing great attention.

The beast tide was sudden and stealthy, but thanks to Fang Yuan's warning, the city's Gu Masters prepared and successfully defended themselves.

During the defense, Fang Yuan saved countless people, refining numerous accumulate virtue Gu and drastically growing in strength and renown.

In this life-and-death battle, Fang Yuan achieved absolute victory.

"Shen San, you repaid hatred with kindness! From today on, I will follow your lead—please accept my submission!" Shu clan's young master knelt.

Three years later, the aging city lord passed his position to Fang Yuan.

Now a rank five city lord, Fang Yuan married Xiu Niang on his inauguration day.

Auspicious red characters, lively guests, delicious food and wine, and a comfortable wedding room.

Xiu Niang gazed at Fang Yuan lovingly: "Darling San, we are finally married. I knew I chose the right person."

Fang Yuan laughed heartily: "Of course, but…"

Xiu Niang was worried: "But what? Are you feeling unwell?"

Fang Yuan shook his head: "I feel a little empty inside."

Xiu Niang smiled like a blooming flower: "Why feel empty? Darling San, do you know how many people admire you?"

Fang Yuan stiffened: "Admire me? They merely admire my wealth, authority, strength, and romance."

His tone turned cold as a sharp gleam flashed in his eyes.

Xiu Niang faltered: "Darling San, what's wrong? You're making me uneasy."

Fang Yuan gazed intently at the beautiful face he had yearned for day and night, unable to stop loving her.

Shaking his head, Fang Yuan sighed: "Everything that happened... merely amounted to this."

At the next moment, everything collapsed!

# Chapter 1543: Humanity's Righteous Path

# Chapter 1544: Boring

"I must have it—I have a reason to live!" Fang Yuan pleaded stubbornly.

"Everyone has a reason to live; why should I die for your sake?" The Gu Immortal smiled. "I know you seek vengeance against that demon. But he is my enemy too, and I must have my revenge as well. Why sacrifice myself for you? Find lifespan Gu elsewhere."

Unable to refute the Gu Immortal's sound logic, Fang Yuan left empty-handed.

Fang Yuan knelt at his parents' grave, wailing until dawn before finally standing with a dangerous resolve.

To obtain the lifespan Gu, he took a gamble and murdered his benefactor.

"Even if I become a demon, I will do anything for revenge!"

Thus, Fang Yuan targeted those close to the demon.

Among his children, the demon most doted on a daughter, elevated to Gu Immortal at sixteen.

Scheming deeply, Fang Yuan staged an encounter to approach her.

"You can call me Little Shang. Thank you for saving me." Innocent and grateful, Little Shang quickly gave him her trust.

Though initially intending to kill her, spending time with Little Shang slowly awakened long-buried emotions in Fang Yuan's heart.

Yet when Little Shang confessed her feelings, a panicked Fang Yuan fled.

Ultimately, he spared Little Shang and focused solely on vengeance against the demon.

Disguising himself to pillage cultivation resources, he cultivated beside his parents' graves and pushed for rank eight.

While recuperating, Little Shang tracked him down.

Indignant that he had fled from her very first confession, she demanded an explanation.

Unable to explain, Fang Yuan led her to his parents' graves: "This is the grave of my former lover."

Turning pale, Little Shang apologized and asked: "Why are there no words on this tombstone?"

He sighed: "Because I never learned her name."

Determined to help him heal, she stayed by his side, insisting: "What's wrong with helping the one I love?"

That night, the demon appeared before Fang Yuan.

Putting Little Shang to sleep, the demon dragged Fang Yuan away by force.

"With rank eight cultivation, you are worthy enough of my daughter. Treat her well—she truly loves you," the demon said before leaving.

The demon indeed failed his breakthrough and hid in a valley to recuperate.

Before Fang Yuan could pinpoint him, the demon's trusted aide leaked his location.

Hearing this, the resentful Gu Immortals across the five regions rallied together and surrounded the valley.

Worried for her father's peril, Little Shang rushed to his aid; deeply moved, she was accompanied by Fang Yuan.

Reaching the demon's side as battle erupted, Fang Yuan watched the clearly weakened demon still slaughter many Gu Immortals.

Seeing hope, the immortals fought to the death, while Fang Yuan secretly plotted, leaking vital openings to push the demon into mortal danger.

In the final clash, both sides exhausted their strength, allowing Fang Yuan to seize control of the decisive immortal formation.

The Gu Immortals shouted at Fang Yuan: "Quickly kill this demon, uphold justice and save this world!!"

Little Shang was in a desperate situation, Fang Yuan was her only hope.

The demon urged Fang Yuan: "Kill these Gu Immortals! I will make you second only to me, grant you boundless wealth, and give you my daughter's hand forever!"

Under everyone's gaze, Fang Yuan's hesitation and struggle abruptly vanished.

# Chapter 1609: Three Plans

Inside the sovereign immortal aperture.

Fang Yuan's time path clone immediately attracted the attention of countless year beasts the moment he appeared.

Moments later, an immemorial year rooster flew over gallantly as the surrounding desolate and ancient year beasts scrambled out of its way.

Reaching Fang Yuan's time path clone, the immemorial year rooster lowered its head obediently.

Smiling, Fang Yuan stroked its bright red crown and waved his sleeve, scattering countless mortal year Gu.

Before long, all the year beasts, including the immemorial rooster, ate their fill. Their hungry agitation gone, they slumped lazily onto the white clouds to rest.

Mini Red Heaven held seven such year beast communities; this was already the third Fang Yuan had fed.

Beyond the captives, Fang Yuan's greatest spoils from ambushing Southern Border's forces were the year beasts subdued in battle.

These year beasts were of high quality—all at least desolate level, including numerous ancient year beasts and seven immemorial year beasts.

After rapid breakthroughs in soul cultivation, Fang Yuan's foundation could easily control seven immemorial year beasts.

Notably, three of the seven immemorial year beasts were roosters, while the other four were a tiger, dragon, rabbit, and horse.

Feeding the year beasts, Fang Yuan thought: "Food expenses have soared dozens of times over! Without the extorted immortal essence stones, I wouldn't have been able to feed them."

Higher-ranking year beasts had larger appetites, and year beasts fed exclusively on year Gu.

Fang Yuan used rank eight Immortal Gu Years Flow Like Water to refine countless mortal year Gu, barely filling the bellies of these year beasts.

Since he needed these year beasts for the impending battle in the River of Time, he had to resolve their feeding issue.

Possessing Spectral Soul's and Lang Ya's true inheritances, Fang Yuan had methods to solve this.

Currently, he could select from three plans.

The first plan was to construct a year essence pool.

This was a resource point functioning as a mini River of Time, mimicking its environment to provide a place for year beasts to live and procreate.

A year essence pool varied in size and was classified into rank six, seven, eight, and nine tiers.

The advantage was space efficiency; furthermore, year beasts dwelling within would naturally produce a steady amount of year Gu.

To house seven immemorial year beasts, Fang Yuan needed a rank eight pool!

The second plan was Golden Age Platform.

This stationary rank seven time path Immortal Gu House would transform into a bright moon floating in the immortal aperture's sky.

Golden Age Platform could store vast numbers of year beasts in deep sleep, sharply reducing their food requirements.

Golden Age Platform drew upon the year beasts' strength without consuming immortal essence, putting them to productive use.

First, constructing this rank seven Immortal Gu House required many time path Immortal Gu that Fang Yuan needed for self-defense.

Second, Golden Age Platform's fixed position inside the aperture meant it could not assist Fang Yuan in the River of Time. Moreover, it was not proficient in offensive methods.

The third plan was Twelve Zodiac battle formation.

Twelve Zodiac battle formation used twelve different species of immemorial year beasts as cores.

Unlike Golden Age Platform, this formation specialized in offense and was completely mobile despite its scale.

Its twelve immemorial year beast cores remained sealed without needing food when inactive, releasing only during battle.

This plan's advantage was that it truly saved feeding expenditure.

Furthermore, Fang Yuan would need to hunt down more immemorial year beasts of distinct species.

After deep consideration, Fang Yuan chose the first plan.

Though requiring the highest investment, the first plan yielded the greatest benefits.

"With my capital, building a rank eight year essence pool would endanger my finances before I could even complete thirty percent."

"But now is the best time for me to construct a year essence pool."

"Xia clan, you want to negotiate with me? First, send three portions of spiral dawn light." Fang Yuan threw an information path mortal Gu to Xia clan's stall.

Xia clan quickly replied: "Fang Yuan, our clan produces spiral dawn light, but the production ground is inside our first supreme elder's immortal aperture. None remains in storage."

Fang Yuan sneered: "Send ten portions of spiral dawn light as proof of your clan's sincerity, then we can talk. Or else..."

"Spiral dawn light is exceedingly rare, with none even in treasure yellow heaven. Three portions is possible, but where could we find ten?"

"I don't care. That is your problem, not mine," Fang Yuan replied coldly.
