# Chapter 1618: Do You Believe In Fate?

Fang Yuan entered the dream realm.

"Do you believe in fate?"

Fang Yuan was a rockman Gu Immortal in this dream realm, though he could not control it.

The rockman Gu Immortal spoke in a muffled voice: "I, Tu Ji, cultivate rule path and believe in fate. Fairy Ruo Li, since first seeing you, I knew we were fated!"

Fairy Ruo Li smiled slightly, her brow furrowing as she looked at the rockman beside her: "You are right, we are fated to be an immortal couple."

He mumbled: "Twelve years have passed, yet it still feels like a dream! Ruo Li, my wife, I swear to love and protect you. Name any wish, and I will fulfill it."

"Is that so?" Ruo Li asked softly.

"Of course!" Tu Ji replied without any hesitation.

Ruo Li hesitated for a long while before saying with difficulty: "Then kill someone for me."

"Who? Even if a rank eight, I will stake my life to kill them," Tu Ji agreed.

"A newborn infant." Ruo Li gave a bitter smile.

Tu Ji was stunned: "An infant?"

Ruo Li took a deep breath: "Do you believe in fate?"

"I cultivate rule path, so I believe in worldly rules. All things have an ordained path—that is fate," Tu Ji replied.

Ruo Li continued: "This baby will become a Gu Venerable named Reckless Savage. And in the future, I will die at his hands."

"What?!" Tu Ji was shocked: "Ruo Li, how many times have you checked this prophecy?"

Ruo Li gave a bitter smile: "Wisdom path prophecies are accurate because fate is fixed. Dying at Reckless Savage's hands is my fate."

Surging killing intent erupted as Tu Ji stood up: "Then I shall kill him! Fate or not, I refuse to believe that I, the grand Tu Ji, a rank eight Gu Immortal, cannot kill an infant!!"

Fang Yuan's soul foundation fell as the third scene began.

Tu Ji appeared before Fairy Ruo Li heavily injured, his trembling expression filled with shame and shock: "I…"

Fairy Ruo Li smiled: "I know—you ran into your fated enemy on the way, and he happened to make a breakthrough."

Ruo Li shook her head: "This is fate's arrangement. Had I not told you, you wouldn't have encountered your old enemy. Anyone attempting to change fate faces its punishment—these injuries are yours. Had I gone to help, another obstruction would have appeared."

Ruo Li smiled bitterly: "You understand fate's power now? Don't try anymore—just accompany me in my final moments."

"No!" Tu Ji trembled, speaking resolutely: "Never! I will not watch this happen, nor let you die. I promised to love and protect you with my life."

"Yet my death is ordained by fate. Tu Ji, my husband, you said yourself that you believe in fate," Ruo Li said meaningfully.

"Then… I will stop believing in it!" After struggling in hesitation, Tu Ji roared, his anger soaring to the skies.

No matter how they pursued the infant, mishaps and strange coincidences always allowed the child to escape.

That infant was gradually growing up, becoming a Gu Immortal.

Events unfolded strictly along fate's path, finally nearing the day of Fairy Ruo Li's death.

Tu Ji blocked the fatal attack with his body and counterattacked, forcing back their great enemy.

On the verge of death, Tu Ji collapsed into Fairy Ruo Li's arms, saying joyfully: "We… won against fate. Ruo Li… my wife… I did it, I really did it, cough cough cough…"

Grasping Fairy Ruo Li's hand with deep love, he whispered: "After I die, you must continue living on… live well…"

Embracing him tightly, she whispered in his ear: "Though I cultivate wisdom path, I never believed in fate. I deduced what fate arranged for me, but who wants to die? So I sought you out; our marriage was never part of fate's arrangements. I did not love you—I only wanted to use you."

Tu Ji smiled, whispering weakly: "I knew, but so what? I love you… I am fully willing to be used by you. Thank you for letting me be of use… I once believed in fate, but no longer. Look, you are alive—fate has changed, this is wonderful…"

Tu Ji's heavy eyelids closed, unable to open again as he ceased responding.

Fairy Ruo Li wept, losing her composure for the first time: "I never used to believe in fate, but now I do!"

Pure-white light radiated from her body, slowly entering the rockman Gu Immortal Tu Ji.

Tu Ji's weakened aura gradually revived, while Fairy Ruo Li's body became increasingly frail and illusory.

Opening his eyes, Tu Ji shouted in shock and panic: "No, stop! I don't want to be healed—you will die, you will die!!"

Now nearly illusory, Fairy Ruo Li smiled with warmth and a trace of craftiness: "You know my killer move cannot be stopped once activated."

"I want to tell you one last thing—what you wanted to hear most."

"You silly rock… I…"

"I love you."

With those words, Fairy Ruo Li faded like an illusion, vanishing from the world.

"No! No——!" Tu Ji roared like a wounded beast, racked with rage, sorrow, and helplessness.

# Chapter 1619: I Do Not Believe!

Myriad Gold Wondrous Essence added: "Fate Gu, you aren't even palm-sized, why would the feathermen fear you?"

Fate Gu chuckled: "Because they pursue freedom, but I, Fate, bind and restrict them."

Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance grumbled: "So you wanted the same thing. You failed to capture even one featherman, while hindering us as well."

Fate Gu laughed: "Who says I failed? The feathermen pursue freedom, but their escape was arranged by me. You are no different; look at yourselves."

Ren Zu, Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance, and Myriad Gold Wondrous Essence looked at their bodies.

White spider silk had already bound their limbs and bodies unnoticed.

"This is the all-encompassing web I have woven. Everything in the world is bound and arranged by me, Fate," Fate Gu said.

Chilled to the heart, Ren Zu and his children began struggling fiercely.

Fate Gu smiled: "It is useless, you cannot escape. Fate cannot be altered."

Ren Zu glared furiously at Fate: "Why do you toy with us? So all the hardships and misfortunes I faced were your doing, and the loss of my children was caused by you!"

Fate Gu said calmly: "Human, you wish to save your eldest son Verdant Great Sun, but he is dead. Death is humanity's inevitable fate; you cannot save him. Nor can wealth Gu save your daughter Boundless Forest Samsara."

At Fate's will, a thread of spider silk ensnared Ren Zu's wealth Gu and dragged it before fate Gu.

Fate Gu laughed: "Life and death are decreed by fate. Human, you are fated to die in madness. Though you refined wealth Gu, you lack the fate to enjoy it. If fated to be poor, even unearthing gold turns it to copper; if fated to be rich, picking up paper turns it to silk. All these things are under my control."

Fate Gu suddenly moved its spider silk, flinging Blazing Glory Lightning Brilliance and Myriad Gold Wondrous Essence far beyond Ren Zu's sight.

"My children!" Ren Zu howled.

Fate Gu said coldly: "Loneliness is everyone's fate. Even your children must leave you; separation is normality."

Just then, self Gu's voice spoke from deep within Ren Zu's heart: "Human, believe in your own strength rather than blaming fate!"

Ren Zu stopped crying, suddenly realizing: "Right, though I lack strength Gu, self Gu bit it, giving me my own strength. Self Gu, I must rely on you."

Self Gu erupted with dazzling light, attempting to break the spider silk.

Some spider silk tore, but even more bound Ren Zu.

"My own strength is not enough?" Anxious, Ren Zu said: "Right, self Gu, you also bit love Gu. If strength fails, let us rely on love instead."

Fate Gu said: "Human, love is merely a type of fate. Their love and deaths were all orchestrated by me."

Ren Zu lost the strength to cry, mumbling powerlessly: "I understand now why feathermen pursue freedom."

Fate Gu smiled: "Human, you also want to pursue freedom?"

Ren Zu nodded: "Yes. With freedom, I will no longer be bound by you."

Fate Gu said: "Yet despite pursuing freedom, aren't those feathermen still under my control?"

Ren Zu shook his head: "My freedom is different. I will pursue absolute freedom."

Fate Gu laughed loudly: "Absolute freedom is insanity. Human, in seeking freedom you are moving toward madness. As I said, you will lose your mind—that is the path I arranged for you. You cannot escape my control."

"No! I will use my own strength and wisdom to obtain freedom," Ren Zu retorted. "I don't believe you; I will escape your control!"

Fate Gu laughed: "Did you forget? Your self Gu bit strength and love, but not wisdom. When you think you are intelligent, that will be the sign you are going crazy."

"Hahaha!" Ren Zu laughed in turn. "I don't believe you, Fate Gu! I don't believe fate exists in this world!"

Fate Gu was silent briefly before replying: "Even if you don't believe, I still exist."

Ren Zu rebuked: "No! When I stop believing in you, you cease to exist. I refuse to believe in fate—fate does not exist! Hahaha!"

Fate Gu shook its head, sighing: "Truly pitiful human, you have fallen into madness."

… Time flew by as a scene from the past surfaced in Duke Long's mind.

A million years ago.

"Do you believe in fate?" Duke Long asked, looking warmly at his disciple.

His disciple was a handsome youth with bright eyes and waist-length black hair, bearing a lifelike red lotus birthmark on his forehead.

Duke Long continued: "Red Lotus, as the future Immortal Venerable, you will lead humanity to supreme prosperity and glory. You will join Heavenly Court, lead humanity, and bless all beings, your glory shining throughout time and space."

Young Red Lotus blinked and smiled with dazzling teeth: "There's nothing bad about that. I believe in fate!"

He looked solemnly at Feng Jin Huang: "Huang Er, understand that you are the future Great Dream Immortal Venerable who will surpass all past venerables! You will create dream path and reign invincible. Your glory will endure for ages as humanity's eternal pillar. Do not fear or hesitate; press forward indomitably until you reach the world's supreme peak!"

Feng Jin Huang said: "If all this is predestined, then… I do not believe in fate!"

"What?" Duke Long's smile froze on his face.

# Chapter 1632: You Lied!

Immortal killer move — Myriad Dragon!

At once, myriad silvery dragons flew forward, engulfing the old man like a tidal wave.

The old man's verdant sun flame cloak blazed, completely covering him like a giant fireball.

Time passed, at the first breath.

First finger!

A sword light shot out from his aloft right fist.

The old man shuddered as his verdant sun flame cloak weakened by half.

Second breath.

Second finger!

The old man roared, reigniting his verdant sun flame cloak.

Third breath.

Third finger.

Fourth breath, fourth finger!

Fifth breath.

# Chapter 1633: Cutting Edge Slays Enemies

Heavenly Court's three Immortal Gu Houses struggled to pursue him.

Upon entering the segment, Eternal Yacht and Three Autumn Yellow Crane Platform were struck by sudden springs and forcefully pushed upward.

While Fang Yuan only met small to mid-sized rank six and seven springs, Heavenly Court faced massive rank eight eruptions.

Fang Yuan escaped the sudden spring river segment without much danger.

Immortal killer move — Time Cutting Edge!

"Let me!" At the critical moment, Xun Guo Zi jumped in front of Qing Ye.

Qing Ye shook his head grimly: "I understand some profundities of your method, but I fear it will not work this time."

Shocked, the three Xunzi asked: "Lord, what do you mean? Please explain."

"This is the Bo clan killer move that once threatened all of Central Continent—time cutting edge," Qing Ye said with a complex expression, unable to hide his fear.

"Such is the truth. Stop the pursuit," a pale Qing Ye said, inhaling deeply.

# Chapter 1636: Demon King!

Immemorial white heaven.

# Chapter 1637: He Cheated!

Fang Yuan gradually stopped attacking.

Bathing in the blue light once more, Fang Yuan easily gained acknowledgement and landed beside Bai Ning Bing.

# Chapter 1638: Ultimate Treasure of the Bet

# Chapter 1641: Very Interesting

After a pause, she continued: "Qi clan fled only because they don't know you. Knowing you from Qing Mao Mountain, I know I cannot escape. Instead, I will join Shadow Sect."

Fang Yuan snorted in displeasure: "I am not you, Bai Ning Bing."

Bai Ning Bing's smile faded, brilliance flashing in her dragon eyes: "Indeed, I pursue excitement. That is why I admire you, Fang Yuan—your life is so thrilling! Every time you plot, succeed, or even fail, it is filled with excitement. Especially fleeing Heavenly Court's ambush like a dog—it was truly the most thrilling experience!"

"Other Shadow Sect members cannot understand: some seek only to rescue Spectral Soul, others feel fear or immense pressure, but I feel pure thrill. The greater the danger and trouble, the more exciting life is, isn't that right?"

"Others might not know me, but surely you understand me, right?"

"Hahaha!" Bai Ning Bing laughed. "I can give you all of Bai Xiang grotto-heaven's resources, but I want the Gu worms from Bai Xiang's true inheritance. Facing Heavenly Court is thrilling—your excitement shall become mine as well!"

"In that case, there are three possible outcomes," Bai Ning Bing squinted, her eyes flashing with manic excitement.

"First, Heavenly Court kills you. With your strength, your death struggle will definitely be a magnificent climax, and witnessing your death will be the greatest experience of my life."

"Second, you defeat or even destroy Heavenly Court. The foremost force in human history falling like a crashing meteor will create the greatest sparks in this world."

"And the third possibility, the most thrilling one I anticipate most: you and Heavenly Court reach a deadlock with heavy losses. Staying by your side, I will have the supreme chance to find an opportunity. I might even emerge victorious, with both you and Heavenly Court becoming my stepping stones."

Fang Yuan regarded her calmly and expressionlessly: "If I kill you now, all three possibilities vanish."

"Yes, yes..." Bai Ning Bing frowned, slightly dejected: "That is true. If I die now, the vast gap in our strength leaves little excitement despite my utmost resistance."

"But if that is your choice, I accept it." She smiled, shrugging: "Being too weak, I must accept that fate. This cruelty of life is also exciting, isn't it? Hehehe."

Fang Yuan smiled as he laughed "Very interesting."

Regardless of her words, Fang Yuan knew he needed all available strength to face Heavenly Court and obtain Red Lotus' true inheritance. Bai Ning Bing was valuable battle strength—even if she might betray him, so what?

"If she succeeds in betraying me, I have only my own incompetence to blame, isn't that right?"

Fang Yuan laughed: "Bai Ning Bing, I truly admire you; I will not kill you now. Follow me, witness my success or failure. Dying at your hands would indeed be quite a show. Now, prove your worth: bring me the heads of Qi clan's Gu Immortals, and also… their Qi Sea grotto-heaven."

# Chapter 1642: Blood Revenge

Inside rank nine killer move heaven form.

"Though I seized the core area, this place is filled with the wills of the Five Xiangs' descendants. Only after exterminating them all can I truly activate this rank nine killer move."

Affected by the rank nine killer move, this colossal sea of wills was sturdy as rock, rendering most methods useless.

With a sudden thought, Fang Yuan sent in a new tide of will.

The will gathered into countless swords that rained down, stabbing into the sea of wills and gouging out huge pits.

Fang Yuan sighed in admiration: "As expected of rank eight Immortal Gu Wisdom Sword!"

Using it as the core, Fang Yuan deduced a simple move to summon a vast amount of sword will.

Besides eliminating the sea of wills, Fang Yuan broke the Five Xiangs' seal, claiming the mountaintop Immortal Gu House and the public grotto-heaven.

The huge explosion tore Bai Ning Bing to pieces.

The next moment, her Bai Xiang form gathered again and charged at Qi clan's Gu Immortals.

Qi clan's Gu Immortals looked grim, witnessing the terrifying power of the killer move Bai Xiang.

With this move active, Bai Ning Bing was practically unkillable, and Ying Wu Xie and Hei Lou Lan were also aiding her.

Though Fang Yuan tasked Bai Ning Bing to kill them, she lacked an immortal battlefield killer move.

Thus, Fang Yuan had laid an immortal formation in ambush to trap them.

Once inside, the Qi clan Gu Immortals were trapped by the formation, unable to flee and forced to fight Bai Ning Bing.

With a painful scream, the youngest Qi clan Gu Immortal was fatally injured by Bai Ning Bing and died.

"My turn." Fully prepared, Ying Wu Xie immediately captured the dead Gu Immortal's soul and sealed it in the formation.

"What do we do?"

"Bai Ning Bing is too troublesome, and Fang Yuan is far too vicious—he actually set this formation right outside our Qi Sea grotto-heaven's entrance!"

They did not know Fang Yuan had killed Qi Zai, learning the details of Qi Sea grotto-heaven without even stepping into the Five Xiangs' grotto-heaven.

At the same time.

In Central Continent, a young man stood quietly, gazing at the Immortal Gu before him.

This was none other than Gu Yue Fang Zheng.

"If I am not mistaken, this is a blood path Immortal Gu?" Fang Zheng smiled mockingly. "You want me to cultivate blood path and deal with Gu Yue Fang Yuan? Is this the decision of a righteous path sect?"

Immortal Crane Sect's rank six Gu Immortal Fan Xi Liu frowned slightly, then chuckled: "Power is righteous when used righteously, and demonic when used for evil. Don't you understand this? For example, I cultivate poison path, yet I still help the world. You can do the same with blood path."

Gu Yue Fang Zheng shook his head: "I am being made to cultivate blood path solely to deal with Fang Yuan, because we are blood brothers!"

Although Fang Yuan possessed the sovereign immortal body, his time path clone remained blood-related to Fang Zheng.

Fan Xi Liu nodded: "Indeed. Don't you want revenge? He slaughtered all your clansmen in Gu Yue village, after all."

"So many years have passed. Truthfully, though I still hate him, I understand him now."

"In my youth, I was ignorant, while my uncle and aunt merely used me as a pawn. Why should I avenge people like that? I don't want to."

"Of course, the clan leader and Gu Yue Qing Shu nurtured and cared for me—I would gladly avenge them."

"But I am tired now... sigh, this endless cycle of slaughter... I no longer seek revenge."

Fang Zheng smiled bitterly. "When I wanted revenge, the sect refused and wanted to eliminate me. Now that I gave up, you saved me and support my revenge."

Fang Zheng stared at the blood path Immortal Gu with an eerie gaze. "And I know I have no choice but to accept."

Fan Xi Liu appraised him anew, surprised, then smiled faintly. "Is it really wise to speak so openly?"

"Does it matter? With your methods, I can't hide anything from you anyway, right?" Reaching out to hold the Gu, Fang Zheng asked, "What is this Gu's name?"

"Blood Revenge."

# Chapter 1643: Grotto-Heaven Changes Owners

"Bai Ning Bing, don't go too far!" Qi clan's leader Qi Fa roared in fury.

Bai Xiang flashed past Qi Fa, leaving behind Qi Jin's frozen corpse, his dying expression of terror vividly preserved in ice.

A barrage of qi path killer moves erupted; Bai Xiang dodged some, the formation intercepted others, and the rest tore Bai Xiang to shreds.

After an intense battle, three of the five Qi clan Gu Immortals were dead, leaving only Qi Fa and Qi Cai.

They called rank six Qi Ping Su from Qi Sea grotto-heaven, hoping to breach the formation and escape.

Already on standby, Qi Ping Su opened the immortal aperture's entrance the moment he received the order.

Bai Ning Bing was overjoyed: "They finally did it!"

Using the formation, she teleported straight into the immortal aperture's entrance.

"Oh no!" Just as Qi Ping Su prepared to exit, Bai Ning Bing charged in, forcing him to retreat.

Vast Qi Sea grotto-heaven was shrouded in white clouds and swept by fierce winds.

Upon entering, Bai Ning Bing felt immense pressure, her strength heavily suppressed by the dense qi path dao marks.

Yet Bai Xiang remained formidable; after a brief, intense clash, Bai Ning Bing quickly overpowered Qi Ping Su.

Injured and outmatched, Qi Ping Su swiftly used his territorial advantage to retreat into the clouds.

"Hmm?" Bai Ning Bing looked up to see a dense sea of clouds gathering above her.

Fierce winds howled as the cloud sea expanded to the horizon, brewing a tremendously powerful killer move within.

In the cloud sea, Qi Ping Su rejoiced upon seeing the heavenly spirit: "Qi Sea heavenly spirit, you're awake! Perfect timing!"

The Qi Sea heavenly spirit resembled a snow-white fawn with dazzling golden eyes.

"I sensed a powerful, malevolent existence targeting the grotto-heaven and had to awaken, but this intruder is not that entity."

The heavenly spirit was shocked: "Even Heavenly Court? It must be him, then."

Killing intent surged in the heavenly spirit's golden eyes: "Since she killed Qi clan bloodlines, she must die!"

With a deafening roar, a colossal white qi pillar crashed down toward Bai Ning Bing from the cloud sea.

Just then, a jade light flashed, bursting into countless dancing jade fireflies.

Facing the white qi pillar, an impassive Fang Yuan merely pointed a finger.

With a shrill shriek, a massive, razor-sharp sword will surged upward, severing the qi pillar in two.

"What move is this?" Bai Ning Bing looked up, hesitating. "Could it be..."

"It must be Qi Xiang's signature killer move, Unlimited Qi Sea—vast, versatile, and balanced in offense and defense, the very move that made him famous," Fang Yuan said solemnly.

Unlimited Qi Sea was a rank eight killer move capable of absorbing all varieties of qi to bolster its might.

"Powerful as it is, Qi Xiang is long dead; how much power can a mere heavenly spirit unleash? Heh." Fang Yuan sneered, rocketing straight into the cloud sea.

"Life qi, death qi, sword qi, blade qi, dusk qi, dawn qi..." Bai Ning Bing was dazzled as all varieties of qi condensed into weapons, beasts, birds, and flora, swarming Fang Yuan in fierce combat.

Bathed in wisdom Gu's light, Fang Yuan's time path clone rapidly unraveled Unlimited Qi Sea's mechanics, launching a swift counterattack.

Shattering every obstacle in his path, he charged forward unstoppably until he reached the heavenly spirit.

Unable to fulfill the heavenly spirit's harsh ownership conditions, Fang Yuan directly killed the Qi Sea heavenly spirit.

With the heavenly spirit dead, the unmanned Unlimited Qi Sea immediately collapsed.

"I surrender!" Qi Ping Su trembled, completely overwhelmed by Fang Yuan's demonic aura.

Fang Yuan eyed him coldly: "Wise choice. If you want to live, get Qi Fa and Qi Cai to surrender too. Otherwise, you can all die together."

"Yes, yes." Bowing to the pressure, Qi Ping Su was sent into the formation.

Upon learning Qi Sea grotto-heaven had fallen, Qi Fa and Qi Cai lost all will to fight and surrendered pale-faced.

Thus, the rank nine killer move heaven form, the public grotto-heaven, and Qi Sea grotto-heaven all fell to Fang Yuan.

# Chapter 1644: Big Family Qi

Inside Qi Sea grotto-heaven, Fang Yuan rested, cataloged spoils, and forced enslavement agreements on the Qi clan captives. While Ying Wu Xie's group relocated movable resources into the sovereign immortal aperture, Fang Yuan focused on the killer move Unlimited Qi Sea.

As a qi path move unusable to him, dismantling it would yield a vast, valuable amount of qi.

Six Immortal Gu formed this move, with rank eight Big Qi serving as the core.

Among the remaining rank six and seven Gu, Fang Yuan paid closest attention to the rank seven Immortal Gu, Big Family Qi.

This qi path Gu could store all varieties of qi, even tribulation qi!

"With this Immortal Gu, I can store and release tribulation qi—a superb method for handling tribulations."

"I can also store outside heaven and earth qi and release it whenever the sovereign immortal aperture needs stabilizing, avoiding the need to place down my aperture."

Backed by his supreme attainment and Great Thief Ghost Hand, the task posed no difficulty.

Within a few days, Fang Yuan absorbed and stored all the qi, selling whatever he could not keep in treasure yellow heaven.

He also sold surplus resources from Qi Sea and the Five Xiangs' public grotto-heavens to exchange for materials he needed.

While Fang Yuan focused on refining the qi path Immortal Gu, Ying Wu Xie approached him in secret.

Ying Wu Xie asked cautiously: "Sect leader, refining the Qi clan immortals' Gu and renting them back is a great way to control them. But why not do the same to Bai Ning Bing? Her usefulness is only temporary until your ice and snow path attainment grows. Moreover, her killer move Bai Xiang is extremely powerful and dangerous. She could easily break Shadow Sect's alliance agreement. Pardon my boldness, but you seem too... lenient with her."

"She does not fear death. If I try that, she would rather die than submit."

"Even if I can seize most of her Immortal Gu, what good would that do?"

"As shown at Reverse Flow River, I need experts to hold off Heavenly Court. None of you currently have that strength."

"With the killer move Bai Xiang, Bai Ning Bing is invaluable."

"Her background prevents her from siding with Heavenly Court, and she needs me to refine Yin Yang Rotation Immortal Gu to restore her male body."

"We are too useless." Ying Wu Xie lowered his head.

Fang Yuan chuckled: "I know what you're getting at. I will help raise all your battle strength."

Ying Wu Xie obtained Fang Yuan's promise and left happily.

Afterward, Fang Yuan summoned Hei Lou Lan.

"Let me show you someone." Fang Yuan brought out the captive Hei Cheng.

Suppressing her rage, Hei Lou Lan watched Fang Yuan put Hei Cheng away and gritted her teeth: "So Hei Cheng was in sect leader's hands all along!"

Fang Yuan chuckled: "Don't worry, I value you far more. Cultivate hard and earn contributions, and your revenge will come."

"I understand!" Hei Lou Lan looked at him, feeling utterly helpless at how vastly he had surpassed her.

# Chapter 1645: Rank Seven Spring Autumn Cicada

Inside the sovereign immortal aperture.

The giant cicada hovered about five feet off the ground.

Fang Yuan took a deep breath, activating his long-prepared killer move.

Winds howled around the cicada as dark clouds coalesced overhead, dimming the surroundings.

Amid ghostly wails, thick dark ghost hands emerged from the ground, clutching the cicada.

Hundreds of dark hands grabbed the cicada, purging the impurities within.

This unique method was his own creation, centered on the rank eight Immortal Gu Soul Beast Token.

Fang Yuan took out a huge lump of fire calmly.

This was the rank eight Phoenix Song Flame, singing a crisp, melodious tune as it burned.

"Go!" Fang Yuan tossed a basin-sized Phoenix Song Flame onto the cicada's surface.

With a soft sound, flames engulfed the entire cicada.

Traces of ghost qi seeped from the cicada's surface, only to be incinerated by the flames.

With a dragon's roar, a massive dragon-shaped blizzard descended upon the cicada.

Though the flames resisted, the dragon blizzard, backed by Fang Yuan, overpowered and encapsulated the cicada.

Once the blizzard ceased, Fang Yuan retrieved the frozen cicada and gently breathed warm air to melt the ice.

Exquisite as a work of art, Fang Yuan gently pinched the cicada with his fingers.

Its surface cracked open, and a rank seven Spring Autumn Cicada awakened and took flight.

"After so many failures, I've finally refined Spring Autumn Cicada to rank seven."

"With rank seven Spring Autumn Cicada and my time path great grandmaster attainment, I can deduce an immortal killer move centered on it to avoid Heavenly Court's trap!"

"Using rank seven Spring Autumn Cicada with rank eight spring Gu, I can create a rank eight killer move to enter the River of Time without fearing Heavenly Court."

"Besides nurturing them, I must refine Immortal Gu next!"

Most importantly for now: Landscape as Before, Man as Before, and day Gu.

Advancing these three time path Immortal Gu would greatly surge Fang Yuan's time path battle strength.

Though sword, soul, and wisdom paths had huge room for improvement, fighting in the River of Time required time path methods.

"It's a pity Lang Ya Sect went to Longevity Heaven; hairy man Gu Immortals would have saved much time and energy."

# Chapter 1646: Fang Zheng's Immortal Ascension

Standing at a mountain peak and looking at the sky, Gu Yue Fang Zheng felt nervous about his upcoming immortal ascension tribulation.

Fang Zheng laughed to himself: "Why am I nervous? Immortal Crane Sect and Heavenly Court should be the anxious ones."

"Only one Gu Immortal guards me openly, but many watch in secret. What is there to worry about?"

Though Fang Zheng did not know why Central Continent supported him, he was certain of his value and usefulness to them.

Being used as a pawn at least proved his worth; lacking value as a tool meant being discarded like trash.

"We can begin," Fan Xi Liu's voice resounded in Fang Zheng's ears.

Fan Xi Liu, a rank six Gu Immortal, was sent by Immortal Crane Sect to assist Fang Zheng's tribulation.

Fang Zheng nodded, he calmed down and looked inside him.

His aperture brimmed with primeval essence reflecting his A grade talent, but its walls were covered in severe cracks.

"Goodbye, my aperture." Fang Zheng muttered.

At his will, the primeval essence surged and crashed into the aperture walls.

Already fragile and cracked, the aperture soon fractured further as holes formed.

Simultaneously, a formless heavenly power lifted Fang Zheng into the sky.

"Heaven's will!" Watching in concealment, Fan Xi Liu sensed abundant heaven's will.

Vast heaven and earth qi converted into blood qi, swiftly dyeing the dark clouds red across the sky.

"Blood path tribulation…" Joy flashed in Fan Xi Liu's eyes; this was precisely what the higher-ups wanted.

Heaven qi rained down while earth qi bubbled up, intertwining in the air with human qi.

With a solemn expression, Fang Zheng worked to control and balance the three qi.

Just then, the tribulation finished forming and heavy rain poured down.

Fang Zheng raised his defenses and activated Gu worms to resist the blood rain.

Fan Xi Liu began disrupting the blood clouds, diminishing their size and influence.

In time, the three qi condensed into a lump of qi.

Fang Zheng opened his eyes, took a deep breath, and tossed a rank five blood path Gu into the qi lump.

With a shocking explosion, the qi lump burst and formed an immortal aperture.

Regaining his senses, he placed Blood Revenge Immortal Gu and numerous blood path mortal Gu inside.

Inside the immortal aperture, the three qi balanced and the world gradually stabilized.

A large amount of heaven and earth qi still remained.

Fang Zheng was overjoyed; this remaining qi could advance his vital blood path mortal Gu into an Immortal Gu!

Despite the danger of drawing a subsequent tribulation, Fang Zheng boldly chose this option.

"Fang Zheng, let me in quickly, I'll help you with the tribulation!" Fan Xi Liu transmitted.

"Hmm?" Fang Zheng frowned. An immortal aperture was a private domain; Fan Xi Liu's intrusion angered him.

Relaxing his brow immediately, Fang Zheng opened his aperture door and said flatly, "Sure, Fan Xi Liu, please enter."

Several hours later, Fang Zheng passed the tribulation, reawakening Fan Xi Liu's envy.

Fang Zheng's vital Gu had successfully refined into his second blood path Immortal Gu:

Immortal Crane Sect soon announced Fang Zheng's immortal ascension, declaring that, saved from the demon Fang Yuan, he would become a vanguard against him.

Heavenly Court spread the news everywhere, highlighting Fang Yuan's betrayal by kin while promoting their own magnanimity.

# Chapter 1647: Joint Suppression

Fang Zheng blessed land.

Covered in bizarre, rugged rocks, this completely blood-red valley was filled with blood flower trees.

These blood flower trees had all been provided by Immortal Crane Sect through Fan Xi Liu.

"My Immortal Gu Cold Blood and Blood Revenge need mortal blood path Gu to form immortal killer moves."

Fang Zheng focused on refining mortal blood path Gu and practicing the immortal killer move.

Following his ascension, he had received Heavenly Court's detailed intelligence on Fang Yuan.

Knowing his brother had survived, learning the full truth strangely brought him no rage over being deceived.

Instead, the more he learned, the more sadness he felt in his heart.

"It turns out, I have never truly understood you… Fang Yuan."

"Otherworldly demon… Spring Autumn Cicada… rank eight cultivation level…"

He felt utterly minuscule before Fang Yuan's terrifying strength.

Facing such a person in the future filled him with depression and despair.

"As a Gu Immortal, I am a pawn trapped between Fang Yuan and Heavenly Court, facing mortal danger at every step."

Soon, he thought of Zhao Lian Yun.

Since most gifts came from Immortal Crane Sect, Zhao Lian Yun's stood out.

"You are also an otherworldly demon, although not completely."

"Seeking me out so proactively, you likely want to join forces against Fang Yuan…"

Zhao Lian Yun had gifted him cultivation methods for blood path plants along with her personal insights.

"In Gu Immortal cultivation, combat is the path of domination while aperture management is the path of supremacy; both are complementary and necessary. Yet having great battle strength without aperture foundation is like a blazing flame; burning brightly for a time, it turns to smoke once the firewood runs out."
