Heavenly Court.

Fairy Zi Wei smiled: "Fang Zheng must raise his cultivation to effectively counter Fang Yuan."

Fairy Zi Wei understood Zhao Lian Yun's intentions; though Ma Hong Yun was dead, Fang Yuan still held his soul.

Fairy Zi Wei frowned: "The true problem remains Fang Yuan himself."

Since breaking out of the River of Time's encirclement, Fang Yuan had vanished from public view.

Fairy Zi Wei preferred he scavenge resources openly, leaving traces for her to deduce valuable clues and breach his wisdom path defenses.

To Fairy Zi Wei, Fang Yuan's management skills and explosive growth during seclusion were truly terrifying.

"Spectral Soul is slowly losing control, yielding us more and more critical intelligence."

"We now have four time path Immortal Gu Houses ready, but the river formation must be modified further."

"At the same time, we cannot let Fang Yuan live comfortably, I should contact Wu Yong."

Some days later.

Fang Yuan pushed his palm forward, sending the killer move's immense force through the entrance into Lou Lan blessed land.

Hei Lou Lan's tribulation was destroyed instantly.

With an impassive face, Hei Lou Lan stood in her aperture and thanked Fang Yuan.

"No need." Looking at Lou Lan blessed land, Fang Yuan noted its lack of development despite her aptitude.

Providing resources kept Hei Lou Lan dependent on his control.

"Leave quickly. Each tribulation disrupts my concealment, allowing wisdom path deductions to reach us."

"Okay." Hei Lou Lan nodded without hesitation, quickly retrieving her immortal aperture and entering the sovereign immortal aperture.

Fang Yuan activated Fixed Immortal Travel and vanished, evading Wu Yong and the others rushing at full speed.

"This is the fourth time Fang Yuan has helped a subordinate pass tribulations. This cannot continue."

Wu Yong said coldly, "Fang Yuan flees with Fixed Immortal Travel. We must build Beacon Towers and cooperate in treasure yellow heaven to restrict his businesses and slash his profits."

Jade light flickered in Qi Sea grotto-heaven as Fang Yuan materialized.

"They're beginning to target my businesses in treasure yellow heaven…" Fang Yuan snickered.

Having recently devoured two grotto-heavens, Fang Yuan possessed vast resources capable of withstanding initial suppression.

Yet with Heavenly Court and Southern Border joining forces, Fang Yuan could not endure prolonged containment.

Having seized captive resources, his businesses were easily targeted by Southern Border and Heavenly Court.

"I need to think of a plan." Fang Yuan gaze flickered with consideration.

# Chapter 1648: Conflict Between Miao and Ren

Eastern Sea.

An unremarkable uninhabited island in Eastern Sea hid four Gu Immortals.

"Ren Xiu Ping, you are too much!" Injured and bloodshot-eyed, Miao Ming Shen shouted in intense anger and hatred.

A famous space path lone cultivator, he earned widespread popularity by expanding other immortals' apertures.

Charismatic and ambitious, Miao Ming Shen led three lone immortals who followed him faithfully: Immortal Hua Die, Feng Jiang, and Gui Qi Ye.

Now, Gui Qi Ye lay unconscious and tainted purple with deadly poison, in grave danger.

"Lord Miao Ming Shen, what do we do? Gui Qi Ye was struck by the ice poison starfish, and we have no way to heal him," Immortal Hua Die said worriedly.

Ren Xiu Ping had ambushed them with an ice poison starfish, and Gui Qi Ye took the fatal blow for Miao Ming Shen.

Reacting swiftly, Miao Ming Shen fought fiercely to escape the trap with the unconscious Gui Qi Ye, Feng Jiang, and Immortal Hua Die.

Miao Ming Shen shook his head: "I won't turn to either. Su Chen is from Su clan, and I know for certain Fairy Jiu Yue has ties with Ren Xiu Ping. I strongly suspect Fairy Jiu Yue is a trap set by that old scoundrel Ren Xiu Ping!"

Miao Ming Shen said, "Ice poison starfish's poison can be removed with underworld yellow water."

Feng Jiang stared wide-eyed: "Underworld yellow water is a rank eight immortal material, rare even in Eastern Sea. Lord, you have it?"

Miao Ming Shen shook his head: "Of course not, I will exchange the extreme time pole for it."

"Yet Heavenly Court and Southern Border are currently buying up time path materials to suppress Fang Yuan, driving demand and prices sharply upward. Heavenly Court has a deep foundation and surely possesses underworld yellow water. Offering the extreme time pole will definitely secure it."

Miao Ming Shen laughed: "How could I let him die? Sacrificing an immortal material matters little."

Just as Miao Ming Shen predicted, Heavenly Court noticed his extreme time pole and promptly traded him a large amount of underworld yellow water.

After meticulous cleansing, the ice poison starfish's poison was fully neutralized.

Before long, Gui Qi Ye woke and opened his eyes.

Keeping his gratitude inside, Gui Qi Ye said, "Lord, Ren Xiu Ping attacked us because he seeks the blue dragon whale."

Miao Ming Shen sighed: "He wanted to explore the blue dragon whale for Paradise Earth's true inheritance. What should we do?"

Gui Qi Ye said: "Since our secret is exposed, we cannot guard it alone. We should invite reinforcements to explore it together. Once we obtain the inheritance and grow stronger, we can deal with Ren Xiu Ping. He has allies and might spread the news to lure even more rivals!"

Miao Ming Shen agreed: "Seeking reinforcements now is our best choice. If only we had rank eight cultivation to explore it alone."

Miao Ming Shen nodded and asked the three immortals, "Naturally. What recommendations do you have?"

Immortal Hua Die suggested: "Lord, do you remember Chu Ying?"

"Chu Ying." Miao Ming Shen's eyes shone: "Brilliant. He is a transformation path cultivator with grudges against Ren Xiu Ping, though exceedingly secretive."

# Chapter 1649: Regret

"Paradise Earth's true inheritance?" Inside Five Xiang grotto-heaven, Fang Yuan received Miao Ming Shen's invitation.

Miao Ming Shen had clashed with Ren Xiu Ping and decided to explore the blue dragon whale ahead of time, which was unexpected for Fang Yuan.

"Perhaps due to the increasing influence of my rebirth, their conflict occurred earlier than expected."

"Or Heavenly Court deduced my connection with Miao Ming Shen to plot against me."

Calming his mind, Fang Yuan closed his eyes and began his deduction.

After deduction, he concluded: "Heavenly Court did not plan this against me. I must head to Eastern Sea."

Fang Yuan was troubled as Heavenly Court and Southern Border's righteous path obstructed his businesses in treasure yellow heaven, impeding his profits.

A monopoly like guts Gu required immense quantities, but lacking souls, Dang Hun Mountain could not raise production.

Fang Yuan's income dwindled, and worse, Central Continent's Heavenly Court was buying all the time path immortal materials they could find.

"I need time path immortal materials to refine Immortal Gu. Even if Paradise Earth's true inheritance lacks them, I must go regardless!"

Even without time path immortal materials, the Paradise Earth true inheritance was sure to contain treasures.

"Southern Border's rank eight Gu Immortal Lu Wei Yin is the current inheritor of Paradise Earth; if I can obtain this true inheritance, I might find a way to deal with him."

"More importantly, my memories indicate the blue dragon whale contains rank eight Immortal Gu Regret, which Miao Ming Shen uncovered in my previous life. Because many Gu Immortals participated, rumors of Immortal Gu Regret spread."

Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable had used Regret Gu as the core of Regret and Repent to reform numerous demonic immortals.

"If this Paradise Earth true inheritance contains rank eight Immortal Gu Regret, I can replicate part of Regret Pool's power to aid Gu refinement!"

Several days passed in an instant.

Eastern Sea.

Miao Ming Shen looked around, surrounded by eight Gu Immortals.

"Everyone," Miao Ming Shen said solemnly, "I have explained this expedition and given you time to consider. This is my first trip too; the risks are unknown and potentially fatal. Anyone wishing to withdraw may leave now. I will not stop anyone; I understand completely."

Miao Ming Shen looked around again, nobody moved.

Paradise Earth's true inheritance was far too valuable for anyone to give up the opportunity.

Furthermore, Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable was history's kindest venerable, having never harmed a single life, and his inheritances were famously safe.

"Since everyone agrees, let us make the alliance agreement," Miao Ming Shen said excitedly.

"Zeng Luo Zi, please proceed," Miao Ming Shen said, cupping his fists.

Zeng Luo Zi stepped forward and said, "Everyone, take a look at the alliance agreement we will set."

As he spoke, several Gu Immortals stirred in mild surprise.

The alliance agreement's information had appeared in their minds simultaneously.

Zeng Luo Zi's display of skill asserted his superior standing within the group.

# Chapter 1650: Chu Ying's Death

Miao Ming Shen's expression remained unchanged, though his eyes observed carefully.

"Besides myself, Gui Qi Ye, Feng Jiang, and Immortal Hua Die, we have Zeng Luo Zi, Tu Tou Tuo, Tong Hua, and Chu Ying."

Miao Ming Shen was wary of Chu Ying and had initially hesitated to invite the secretive cultivator. However, because Chu Ying opposed Ren Xiu Ping, had saved his companions, and possessed abundant lifespan Gu, Miao Ming Shen included him.

Miao Ming Shen looked around and laughed heartily: "Zeng Luo Zi, impressive methods."

After inspecting the agreement in the mortal Gu, the immortals suggested minor adjustments.

Reaching a consensus, they signed the alliance agreement through Zeng Luo Zi's method.

"It is time, let's go," Miao Ming Shen said, speeding ahead as the immortals followed.

Miao Ming Shen flew briefly through the sky before diving into the sea.

Miao Ming Shen led them to a massive undercurrent surging across deep trenches.

Before diving in, Miao Ming Shen had Zeng Luo Zi mark everyone with an information path move to stay together.

"Follow me closely; a single misstep in these swift undercurrents will leave you behind."

Fang Yuan and the rest followed after him rapidly.

Near the rear, Fang Yuan noted Immortal Hua Die staying right beside him.

Fang Yuan entertained her outwardly while secretly inspecting his information path dao marks.

These information path dao marks were easily dispelled by killer moves like self cleansing.

"We are about to exit, follow me!" Miao Ming Shen called out from ahead.

The immortals traveled covertly through undercurrents, maintaining a low profile while avoiding desolate beasts and ignoring resource points.

His smile suddenly froze as he said, "We are near!"

Fang Yuan detected nothing with his investigative moves, unable to discern Miao Ming Shen's tracking method.

Though the blue dragon whale's existence was widely known, its exact location was a mystery Miao Ming Shen possessed unique means of tracking.

Though Fang Yuan could kill Miao Ming Shen and soul-search him, unknown methods risked ruining the opportunity.

Thus, Fang Yuan continued lurking; attacking after entering the blue dragon whale would not be too late.

As they drew closer, the immortals began sensing oddities.

The seawater grew increasingly turbulent ahead, shifting from a drizzle to a storm with vastly greater obstruction.

Desolate and ancient desolate beasts multiplied, swept along helplessly by the immense storm.

Fighting as they advanced, the immortals slaughtered desolate beasts along their path.

Feng Jiang and Immortal Hua Die needed protection, while Miao Ming Shen spearheaded the vanguard.

As immemorial desolate beasts appeared, the immortals could no longer advance smoothly.

Following Miao Ming Shen, they flew out of the sea into the sky.

Fierce tornadoes surged amid flashing lightning, rumbling thunder, and horizon-spanning dark clouds.

Blue charm lightning shadows flickered in the dark clouds, hunted by an immemorial desolate beast thunder phoenix.

"Quick, follow me!" Miao Ming Shen transmitted, flying rapidly forward drenched in sweat.

Spotting Fang Yuan and the rest, the thunder phoenix screeched and dove.

Miao Ming Shen screamed, "Split and run!"

Blindingly fast, the thunder phoenix appeared before Fang Yuan in an instant.

"Chu Ying!" Immortal Hua Die screamed in terror as Gui Qi Ye dragged her along.

"Save me!" Fang Yuan shouted with apparent despair.

The thunder phoenix struck, incinerating Fang Yuan with lightning on the spot.

"Chu Ying…" Horrified by his death, the remaining seven immortals fled in greater panic.

# Chapter 1651: Merit Obelisk

A grindstone-sized lightning ball struck Miao Ming Shen's back, exploding violently.

Spitting blood, Miao Ming Shen activated a space path killer move, vanishing and reappearing several thousand steps away.

Yet even there, lightning raged amid roaring beasts in a truly dire situation.

Amid deafening roars, the immemorial thunder phoenix attacked him again.

Having lasted the longest, he alone remained after the other immortals perished.

"Come at me," Miao Ming Shen sighed in despair.

With an intense pain, his vision fell into darkness.

A voice resounded: "Lord Miao Ming Shen, wake up, quickly wake up."

Miao Ming Shen opened his eyes.

Beside him stood Immortal Hua Die, Gui Qi Ye, and even the first casualty, Chu Ying.

"You guys… what happened?" Miao Ming Shen's eyes suddenly flashed: "Wait, is this a test?"

"Indeed, we reached the same conclusion," Tu Tou Tuo laughed loudly.

"To think the test began before entering the blue dragon whale," Miao Ming Shen said.

His injuries were gone, Gu worms intact, and immortal essence fully restored.

"This?!" Miao Ming Shen looked up. "Was it all an illusion?"

"Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable is truly remarkable; we noticed nothing until dying."

Miao Ming Shen sighed: "Experiencing death was Paradise Earth's test to help us relinquish obsessions."

Tong Hua smiled: "It also tested battle strength. Miao Ming Shen, you lasted the longest."

Turning to Fang Yuan, Miao Ming Shen remarked: "Chu Ying, you saved the most energy."

Fang Yuan sighed with feigned shame: "I was terrified. Why did that thunder phoenix target me first?"

Aided by Attitude Gu, Fang Yuan's performance completely dissolved Miao Ming Shen's suspicions.

Miao Ming Shen surveyed their surroundings—a small nameless island surrounded by blue sea.

"We were about to ask you; we arrived upon waking and don't know where to go," Tong Hua replied.

Closing his eyes, he activated a mysterious immortal killer move.

"Everyone, just as I expected, this is the immortal aperture world of the blue dragon whale!" Miao Ming Shen announced.

Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable had subdued the whale and left his true inheritance here.

"Then what are we going to do now?" Tong Hua asked.

"Reaching the grotto-heaven is our first success. Next, we must find the hidden true inheritance. We do not know what lives here. For safety, we should explore together." The immortals agreed.

Fang Yuan suggested, "Since we arrived here through Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable's arrangement, this small island cannot be simple. We should search it first."

"Nobody explored this place yet?" Miao Ming Shen asked.

"Let's split up and search this island," Miao Ming Shen said, immediately assigning tasks.

Searching the island, they soon discovered a rank eight Immortal Gu House at the center.

Moments later, the eight Gu Immortals gathered before the Immortal Gu House.

This Immortal Gu House had a peculiar design, resembling an obelisk crafted from gold.

Inscriptions revealed this Immortal Gu House was a merit board; claiming the true inheritance required accumulating merit through missions.

Those who refused had to remain on this island, unable to enter other parts of the grotto-heaven.

"The inscription says we can only stay here for three hundred days," Tong Hua noted regretfully.

With only ten missions listed for three hundred days, the Gu Immortals would have to compete.

Miao Ming Shen spoke: "We cannot be certain yet. We should first test whether we can leave this island. If we can move this Immortal Gu House, claiming it would be magnificent!"

Miao Ming Shen added: "Let us decide how to split the island's resources first."

Standing only to gain, none objected, and the immortals cheered in agreement.

# Chapter 1652: Choosing Mission

Half a day later, the immortals gathered before the rank eight Immortal Gu House Merit Obelisk.

Gui Qi Ye pondered: "We have all acted, but this island cannot be breached by force."

"And we cannot unravel this Merit Obelisk with our abilities," Feng Jiang added.

"Miao Ming Shen, I wonder what insight you have?" Tong Hua asked.

Miao Ming Shen shook his head: "Like all of you, I know nothing about Paradise Earth's true inheritance. Since we cannot force through his arrangements, we have only two options. First, ignore the obelisk's missions and wait three hundred days until we are expelled. Second, accept and complete the missions on the obelisk."

… After some discussion, none of the eight Gu Immortals wanted to give up.

Following the inscriptions, the eight immortals placed their palms on the Merit Obelisk.

In a flash of bright light, the blank area turned into a list displaying all eight immortals' names.

Fang Yuan's name was listed as 'Chu Ying'.

This made Fang Yuan let out a sigh of relief.

The Merit Obelisk was beyond his deduction. Though he might destroy it by force, the risk was too high—disguising himself to explore was far wiser.

"I should not attack before understanding the situation. This is Paradise Earth's true inheritance; he valued benevolence and forgiveness. Indiscriminate killing might invite disaster."

Listed on the Merit Obelisk, the eight immortals examined the missions.

There were only ten missions written.

Each mission had a vague description, the Gu Immortal needed to explore it themselves.

Zeng Luo Zi sighed: "My information path methods are useless here; choosing is pure luck. I will take the water monster extermination mission."

Logically, harder missions yielded greater merits. As water monsters were at least desolate beasts, eliminating them was difficult and should grant high merit rewards.

Miao Ming Shen agreed with a nod: "Go ahead, I will choose last."

Miao Ming Shen waved his hand: "No need to overthink. Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable surely considered balance with deeper intentions; those simple missions might not be as easy as they seem."

Only three rank sevens remained: Miao Ming Shen, Fang Yuan, and Gui Qi Ye.

"Next… go ahead and choose, Chu Ying." Miao Ming Shen took a look and smiled.

"Wait." Gui Qi Ye suddenly interjected: "Everyone, Lord Miao Ming Shen, to speak the truth, I wanted this mission from the start."

"Picking on the weakest?" Fang Yuan chuckled inwardly, saying: "Since you like it, Gui Qi Ye, it has affinity with you; I won't contest it. I will choose the seventh mission."

Everyone looked over; the seventh mission was collecting deep-sea Earth Trench black oil, a task typically left to mortals.

Miao Ming Shen quickly added: "Chu Ying…"

"No need to refuse. Besides, without Brother Miao, how could I have entered?" Fang Yuan laughed heartily.

Once everyone chose, the Merit Obelisk shot out light pillars, teleporting the Gu Immortals away as they stepped inside.

Fang Yuan's vision shifted, and he found himself on an unfamiliar island.

"I am a rank eight, yet the Merit Obelisk transported me effortlessly. As the likely core of this entire grotto-heaven, it is truly profound—worthy of Paradise Earth!"

He shared Miao Ming Shen's conjecture regarding the missions. Yielding earlier had not been out of courtesy, but to probe Miao Ming Shen.

# Chapter 1653: Previous Life's Most Beloved

Under Fang Yuan's investigative methods, the island held no secrets from him.

He found that this island was completely ordinary, possessing scarce resources and a small fishing village with a few residents.

Having accepted the mission to collect deep-sea Earth Trench black oil, Fang Yuan soon discovered traces oozing near the island's fringe.

While others might have dived in immediately, Fang Yuan pondered Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable's intentions ever since seeing the Merit Obelisk.

Concealing himself, he entered the village, which housed only a few low-ranking Gu Masters.

Fang Yuan used his immortal method, the old village head's secrets were all exposed.

Realizing the fishing village held no traps, Fang Yuan slipped away secretly.

Fang Yuan left the island and flew to the surrounding islands.

However, he encountered the same phenomenon as on the Merit Obelisk island.

Though an island was visible on the horizon, no matter how he flew, the distance never shortened.

After using all his methods, Fang Yuan still returned helplessly.

"Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable cultivated sound path before switching to earth path; this distance-manipulation method is his signature move."

Since he could not go to the other islands, he changed directions and entered the water.

A vast expanse of darkness soon entered his vision, resembling massive seaweed sprawling endlessly in all directions.

This underwater Earth Trench was spectacular, the island sitting right at its fringe.

Earth Trenches produced black oil.

Black oil was a food path immortal material of high quality, abundant yield, and easy excavation.

"There are roughly three million kilograms of black oil here, which I could collect within half a day. But I cannot leave the island's vicinity, and black oil moves far slower than water. Once I take all the black oil here, waiting for the rest of the Earth Trench to replenish it would be far too inefficient."

A specialized profession of oil-collecting Gu Masters existed who harvested black oil from Earth Trenches. These professionals utilized a unique set of Gu worms tailored for collecting black oil.

In his previous life, Fang Yuan had been an Eastern Sea oil-collecting Gu Master. An old Gu Master had taught him the collection method and nearly made him his son-in-law.

Seeing this black oil, Fang Yuan could not help recalling memories of his previous life.

Fang Yuan had suffered black oil contamination in his past life—deliberately orchestrated by the old Gu Master to force him into marrying his daughter.

"Back then when I extracted black oil, I almost died."

"But fortune and calamity come together, I actually met Mo Er when about to die… from that perspective, the old Gu Master did something good after all."

Fang Yuan showed a complex and deep smile on his face.

The white figure appeared in his mind once again.

Her expression was both vague and clear at the same time.

Her name was Xie Han Mo.

Fang Yuan never forgot this name; she was his previous life's most beloved.

# Chapter 1654: Water Shell Gu

Several days later.

Inside the village head's house, Fang Yuan was currently fighting a rank two Gu Master.

Amid splashing water, the drenched middle-aged rank two Gu Master collapsed weakly to the ground.

Disguised as Chu Ying, Fang Yuan stood calmly with his hands behind his back, smiling lightly.

The rank two Gu Master stood up weakly as he cupped his fists: "Master Chu has incredible methods, I am in great awe, thank you for the guidance Master Chu."

After the spar, the middle aged rank two Gu Master approached the village head.

The middle-aged Gu Master remained silent with a troubled expression. The old village head smiled: "Now you understand Master Chu's strength?"

The middle-aged Gu Master nodded: "Master Chu's strength is unfathomable. Even together, we are no match for him!"

He looked indignantly at the village head: "Why must we supply his materials? He has nearly depleted our stockpiles in just days!"

The village head paused before saying meaningfully: "By custom, traveling Gu Masters often trade for materials to feed their Gu when visiting new areas. Given their strength, local forces rarely refuse them, preferring cooperation to build goodwill. We should view this as a serendipitous encounter."

"It is about time." At the other end, Fang Yuan smiled.

The next day.

Seeing Fang Yuan visit, the old village head concealed his bitterness with a bowed smile: "Master Chu, do you require more Gu materials?"

Fang Yuan smiled: "Old sir, thank you for the hospitality, I am about to leave."

Fang Yuan said calmly: "Having traveled for years, I understand your feelings. I dislike bullying the weak, so I shall leave gifts before departing."

"Call all of the Gu Masters here." Fang Yuan stopped smiling, he spoke plainly.

Shortly after, all the village Gu Masters gathered in the village head's house, barring the middle-aged Gu Master who had sparred yesterday.

"Unfortunately, he went deep into the sea for black oil and will miss out today," the village head explained.

Fang Yuan smiled meaningfully: "Village head, you worry too much. Everyone, look at this Gu worm."

Fang Yuan opened his hand, showing a rank two mortal Gu.

Colored white and blue, the seashell-like Gu worm was the size of a jade bracelet.

Fang Yuan explained: "This is water shell Gu. It coats the Gu Master in a watery shell against ocean pressure, allowing one to dive six li deep."

Fang Yuan smiled: "Try it."

Testing it out, the Gu Masters rejoiced upon discovering another advantage: it consumed very little primeval essence.

Fang Yuan laughed heartily: "Fret not, everyone gets one." He produced more water shell Gu, distributing one to each person.

Having handed out nearly ten water shell Gu, Fang Yuan passed the final one to the village head: "Give this to him."

"This is the water shell Gu recipe; take it." Fang Yuan distributed ten copies to the Gu Masters.

Examining it, someone cried out: "Heavens, the core material for water shell Gu is the spiral seashell on our island's beach?"

Fang Yuan nodded: "I observed your cultivation, searched the island for materials, and tailored this recipe for your village. Please accept it."

The village head kowtowed: "I was blind to your greatness, unaware Master Chu was a refinement genius! I am utterly ashamed for misjudging your kindness…"

Helping him up, Fang Yuan smiled: "Old sir, do not speak so. I believe a drop of kindness received in need should be repaid with a surging spring. Your Gu materials resolved my urgent need. Our meeting is a fateful fortune to be cherished."

"However, its practical efficacy remains untested. Why not select several people to dive with me to harvest black oil and test it?"

"We will do as you say!"

# Chapter 1655: Collecting Black Oil

Amidst tranquil water ripples, the group of Gu Masters dove into the sea.

Upon activation, the village Gu Masters felt the ocean pressure drop instantly, their bodies lightening.

A large number of weaving sea spiders were approaching them.

Seeing the swarm of sea spiders, the village Gu Masters turned pale, and even the rank three village head panicked.

"Do not worry," Fang Yuan transmitted, waving his hand at the critical juncture.

A massive whirlpool formed, crashing into the sea spiders and sweeping them away.

"Quickly leave, I cannot sustain it for long." Fang Yuan said purposely.

The village Gu Masters took the cue and swiftly dove deeper.

Descending in careful stages, they finally arrived at the Earth Trench.

Abundant black oil lay right at the surface, sparing them from diving inside the trench.

The village Gu Masters promptly deployed their Gu worms near the seeping black oil.

Fang Yuan did not act, he watched from afar.

Though asking about their vital Gu was taboo, Fang Yuan's keen perception deciphered their workings at a single glance.

"Black oil is this island's primary resource. Refining Gu worms for them using black oil as material will greatly boost their efficiency."

As he pondered, a large swarm of seashell sharks suddenly charged toward them.

Navigating the oily terrain with agility, they periodically sprayed collected black oil as defensive barriers.

Exploiting the environment, the village Gu Masters quickly trapped the seashell sharks within the thick black oil.

"I suggest dragging out those trapped seashell sharks; they are all usable Gu materials," Fang Yuan transmitted.

"Master Chu, these seashell sharks are polluted by the black oil." The old village head hesitated.

"Don't worry, I can remove the oil. These seashell sharks will be very useful to you." Fang Yuan smiled.

Convinced, the village head ordered: "Move quickly! But be careful not to let the black oil stick to you."

The seashell sharks were all dragged out.

"Look at what I found? A trapped mermaid." A Gu Master dragged out a mermaid corpse.

Drenched in black oil, her features were obscured, though her build indicated a young girl.

"She still has some life left…" the Gu Master said in surprise.

"Let me." Fang Yuan acted.

To their shock, the black oil peeled away from the mermaid, coalescing before Fang Yuan into a large black sphere.

Fang Yuan smiled to reassure them, but the next moment, his expression froze.

Staring at the mermaid's face, he fell into a daze.

"Mo Er?!"

# Chapter 1656: Fang Yuan Was Saved

At this depth, the sea was entirely pitch black.

Fang Yuan inhaled deeply, the gills on his face taking in oxygen to breathe underwater.

Calming down, he carefully approached and stopped several meters before the black oil, stretching out his arms.

Activating his Gu worms, bright blue light gathered in his palms, drawing droplets and lumps of black oil into his hands.

Using multiple Gu worms at once consumed much primeval essence, soon bringing him to a critical level.

But in the process of leaving, an accident happened.

Suddenly, a huge force emerged in the peaceful sea, sending Fang Yuan flying.

Several impact currents struck him, fracturing bones as blood oozed from his nose and mouth.

Having exhausted his primeval essence, an impact current from behind shoved Fang Yuan into the black oil.

"Am I going to die here?" Unable to escape, Fang Yuan watched the black oil cling to him, spreading to devour him.

As death approached, Fang Yuan felt completely peaceful.

"After so many years wandering this world, I am just too tired, too tired."

Fang Yuan shut his eyes.

After an unknown time, he slowly regained his senses.

In a daze, he heard nearby voices speaking.

"Saintess, why save this mortal Gu Master? Haven't humans bullied us enough all these years!"

A kind voice resounded: "Since we met, how can we leave him? Though human, a lone Gu Master like him is innocent. Taking such risks shows how desperate he is; why be stingy in helping him?"

Fang Yuan struggled and slowly opened his eyes.

Through his blurry vision, he saw three vague figures.

With human bodies and fish tails, he could tell they were three mermen.

"Thank you… I will repay this kindness. May I know your names?" Fang Yuan spoke with difficulty.

"You don't need our names, but the Saintess is Xie Han Mo—remember that forever! You were incredibly lucky to be saved by her."

"Alright, enough." The white figure sighed gently, telling Fang Yuan: "I have healed your injuries and left a Gu worm so you can treat the black oil corrosion."

With that, the white figure departed with her two attendants, leaving Fang Yuan's sight.

This had occurred during the five hundred years of his previous life.

Fang Yuan's gaze became clear, he returned from his recollection.

By now, he had led the village Gu Masters back to the island.

The rescued mermaid girl lay unconscious, color slowly returning to her pale face.

Looking closely, she did not resemble Xie Han Mo from his memories; their appearances were completely different, despite both being equally beautiful.

Xie Han Mo was a white-scaled mermaid, saintess of the mermen tribe, whereas this girl bore the blue scales common among mermen.

"Master Chu." The old village head and the middle-aged Gu Master arrived at the door.

Glancing at the mermaid girl, Fang Yuan walked out: "When she wakes up, have her leave. Though this is human territory and her actions amount to stealing, she has a hard life. Give me face and let her off."

"Indeed, many mermen have taken black oil over the years; sharing some is fine," the village head chuckled.

In the outside world, merfolk had lower status than humans, leading to frequent conflict. But here, both lived peacefully, interacting often and even intermarrying.

"It seems this grotto-heaven is a paradise for humans and merfolk alike."

# Chapter 1657: Clues of Regret Gu

He was refining Gu.

This basin-sized, undulating sphere was the black oil essence Fang Yuan had extracted.

With a thought, Fang Yuan opened his immortal aperture and retrieved a shiny golden scale.

The scale flew into the oil sphere, erupting with golden light before condensing into a small dot.

The black oil sphere turned black-gold, revealing numerous incomplete Gu silhouettes inside.

Fang Yuan was trying to refine gather oil Gu.

Specially created for the villagers, he developed this recipe using references from Shadow Sect and Lang Ya inheritances.

The more he considered the Merit Obelisk, the more Fang Yuan sensed Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable's underlying objective.

Thus, helping the fishing village Gu Masters served both to complete the mission and verify his conjecture.

Fang Yuan committed evil without remorse and performed good deeds without emotional fluctuation.

For the sake of Paradise Earth's true inheritance, Fang Yuan willingly performed good deeds to maximize his benefits.

Xia Lin slowly opened her eyes, she was awake.

"I… am not dead." After a momentary daze, realization struck and her eyes shone.

"You're lucky; any later and you would have corroded into black oil," the middle-aged Gu Master said.

"My name is Xia Lin, did you save me?" The mermaid girl struggled to rise.

"Not me, it was Master Chu. You should thank him—he healed your injuries." The middle-aged Gu Master smiled.

"Master Chu saved my life—how can I not repay him? Sir, please bring me to him. Whatever the price, I must repay him."

"Alright, follow me." The middle-aged Gu Master considered briefly before leading the way out.

Suddenly, black-golden light burst skyward from the small house.

Moments later, the house door was pushed open and Fang Yuan walked out.

Xia Lin looked at Fang Yuan curiously, surprised to find Master Chu so young.

She quickly knelt: "Master Chu, you saved my life. I must repay this kindness!"

"No need, it was a simple matter." Fang Yuan glanced at her; she was not Xie Han Mo after all.

Days later, Fang Yuan returned to the Merit Obelisk.

"Oh? A new mission appeared!" Fang Yuan focused on the obelisk's changes.

On another side of the Merit Obelisk, rankings had shifted too.

"I am third…" Fang Yuan soon found his ranking.

He was a little joyful, his guesses were already affirmed.

From Paradise Earth's perspective, merit meant performing good deeds. Comparing rankings, Fang Yuan was certain: collecting black oil alone would never have earned him third place.

Thus, after refining gather oil Gu, he distributed them and harvested most of the black oil, leaving only a small amount for the village Gu Masters.

At the Merit Obelisk's base lay several scattered information path mortal Gu.

As expected, Miao Ming Shen and the others had left these to record their findings.

Those who slew desolate beasts but killed humans in the process found themselves at the bottom of the rankings.

Miao Ming Shen's discovery caught Fang Yuan's eye: they were not the first group here, as other Gu Immortals had entered previously.

He discovered a forbidden area in this paradise—a sea known as Demon Suppression Regret Crying Sea.

Legend held that Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable suppressed a supreme demon here with a super immortal formation to force his repentance.

Seeing this information, the name of a Gu worm surfaced in Fang Yuan's mind—regret Gu!

# Chapter 1658: Sea Market Gambling Den

Time passed quickly, seventy to eighty days went by.

During this period, Fang Yuan completed many missions, steadily climbing the merit board rankings.

Amidst the ebb and flow, moist sea breeze on his face, Fang Yuan arrived at the sea market.

He had taken a mission to punish an unscrupulous merchant in this sea market.

Fang Yuan passed several Gu houses, heading toward the core island at the sea market's center.

The mission was merely a secondary objective; his true goal was obtaining intel.

As the market closest to Demon Suppression Regret Crying Sea, bustling with Gu Masters and factions, it gave Fang Yuan the best chance to gather intel on regret Gu.

"This should be the place." A moment later, Fang Yuan stopped.

He stood before a gambling den inscribed with three words: Golden Jade House.

"I should try rock gambling too." Fang Yuan smiled inwardly.

Punishing the merchant didn't mean killing him. Having managed gambling dens in his past life, Fang Yuan knew the perfect way to make such an owner suffer.

Memories surfaced in his mind once again…

"Hahaha, who will gamble with me? Even the Saintess is afraid—do you dare?" a muscular merman roared arrogantly.

"So what?" Xie Han Mo smiled. "Let him brag. No matter what reputation I lose, he cannot shake my foundation. This provocation only proves they are panicking. We needn't engage; continuing our original plan is enough to win."

Just as she spoke, a voice echoed: "I will gamble with you!"

The crowd turned to see a human Gu Master step forward.

Lu Da frowned grimly: "Human Gu Master, these are mermen affairs. You really wish to interfere?"

"Truthfully, your Saintess saved my life, and I must repay this debt," Fang Yuan replied firmly, facing Lu Da without fear.

Lu Da sneered: "Good! Since you seek death, pick first. Let's see who uncovers the better Gu worms!"

"You choose first." Fang Yuan smiled calmly, his gaze glinting mysteriously.

The first round was quick, Fang Yuan won.

The second round took longer, but Fang Yuan won again.

"I am Gu Yue Fang Yuan—remember that. I used to run gambling dens." Fang Yuan raised his voice: "The final round, go ahead."

After silently selecting a rock, Lu Da shattered every other rock in the den.

"You are breaking the rules!" Fang Yuan's expression changed.

Lu Da laughed: "Rules? We agreed not to attack each other, not the rocks! Mine definitely contains a Gu worm, while you have nothing. Whatever I open, you lose! You dared interfere with mere rank three cultivation in my sea market. Hehehe, you can kill yourself; I won't have to dirty my hands."

"Hold on." The crowd parted as Xie Han Mo entered the den with a cold expression.

# Chapter 1659: Xia Lin's Rock Gambling

Fang Yuan walked into Golden Jade House.

Just as Fang Yuan prepared to teach the unscrupulous merchant a lesson, a commotion broke out behind the hall.

"You are dishonest!" Xia Lin shouted in anger and shock.

"Dishonest? It's recorded in this Gu—you only repaid a portion, leaving a large sum unpaid," sneered a scarred, bear-like merman standing before her.

"You...!" Xia Lin pointed with reddened eyes. "You shamelessly changed the agreement! The contract was ten percent interest, but you raised it to sixty!"

Fang Yuan's eyes glinted as he recognized the voice of the mermaid girl from months ago.

Xia Lin attacked with a yell.

Caught off-guard, the scarred merman was swept away by a torrent, crashing into the wall and shattering decorations.

Scrambling from the rubble, the scarred merman snarled: "You dare attack me? I'll make you wish you were dead!"

As the scarred merman closed in to attack, a voice rang out: "Wait!"

Halting immediately, the scarred merman traded his ruthless fury for a respectful bow: "Shopkeeper, what brings you here?"

It was Golden Jade House's owner, a potbellied, yellow-scaled merman.

Frowning, the yellow-scaled merman shouted at him: "What are you doing? Trying to destroy my shop?"

After scrutinizing Xia Lin, the yellow-scaled merman said: "Don't worry, young lady, I'm reasonable. No one will attack you while I'm here. But your debt is written in black and white—do you intend to deny it?"

Enraged, Xia Lin retorted: "You shamelessly changed the terms from ten to sixty percent interest! I don't owe you anything; I already paid my debt!"

The yellow-scaled merman smiled brighter: "Without evidence, you cannot prove a thing. The agreement is clearly stated, and everyone can tell who is in the wrong."

He chuckled: "Forget it, I won't bully a girl. Repay half the remaining debt, and I'll let you leave peacefully."

Seeing her silence, he produced an information path mortal Gu: "This is our loan agreement. Pay up, and I will return it to you immediately."

Xia Lin froze before sneering: "I don't have enough primeval stones."

Clapping with a laugh, he replied: "No matter, you can pay with Gu worms. I know you have a gather oil Gu—use that to clear your debt."

Realization dawned upon Xia Lin: "So that's your goal—my gather oil Gu? It's a rank five Gu, are you insane? I would rather die than give it to you!"

The yellow-scaled merman clapped: "You're smart enough to know wealth attracts wolves. How can a mere rank two Gu Master hold onto a rank five Gu? Hand it over. Even if I let you go, others will target you. Surrender it and live in peace—isn't that better?"

Unflustered, having expected this reaction, the yellow-scaled merman took a step back rather than pushing her too hard.

"How about this: I'll give you a chance, if you give me one. We gamble."

"Gamble?"

"We will gamble on rocks to see who excavates better Gu worms, best two out of three."

Xia Lin sneered: "You broke your word and altered the terms—how can I trust you?"

The yellow-scaled merman added: "I can swear an oath to the Sea God."

As she hesitated, a voice echoed in her mind: "Don't be afraid, gamble with him—I am here!"

"Master Chu!" Instantly, Xia Lin almost screamed from joy.

Fang Yuan added: "Change the gambling terms, this is too mild. If you trust me, we will make this a huge gamble!"

"I trust you, Master Chu!" Xia Lin replied without hesitation.

# Chapter 1660: Mastermind

Having analyzed and chosen rocks with great precision in Golden Jade House for years, he was confident in this gamble.

But in the first round, he tasted defeat.

Xia Lin opened a rank three Gu worm superior to his.

He had suggested a best-of-three earlier, but Xia Lin changed it to five contests with higher stakes: he wagered the entire Golden Jade House, while she had to surrender gather oil Gu if she lost even once.

The second round.

"I choose this." She suddenly stopped and pointed at a weird rock.

This distorted rock had multiple holes, barely compact and crumbly like sand.

Normally, such a sandy rock would contain no Gu worm.

He paced about, touching and knocking rocks before picking a huge one: "This is my choice."

Meanwhile, Xia Lin instructed: "Use the grey soil method."

"Give it to me, I will dissect it myself," Xia Lin added.

Xia Lin bit her tongue, spat blood onto the rock, and used gather oil Gu to apply suction.

Crack.

The rock cracked, a rank three Gu worm was exposed.

With a dark expression, the yellow scaled merman halted his dissection.

Among the crowd, Fang Yuan smiled lightly.

There was no Gu in this sandy rock, only Gu material.

Fang Yuan guided Xia Lin to manipulate the dissecting Gu Master into refining the material, completing the final step with her blood and gather oil Gu.

Though newly refined Gu were normally active, Fang Yuan forced it into hibernation with a unique method, flawlessly deceiving everyone.

"Who sent you here?!" the yellow scaled merman shouted, losing all composure.

Having made many enemies over the years, he suspected Xia Lin was bait in a trap using a rank five Gu to ruin him.

The third round, defeat.

The fourth round, defeat again!

Pale and gritting his teeth, ruthless light flashed in his eyes like a cornered jackal.

His trump card was formidable: he hid a rank five Gu carcass in a fake rock, which by gambling rules could only be beaten by a living rank five Gu.

Both sides chose their rocks and dissected them.

Snap.

Fang Yuan snapped his fingers, activating a time path immortal killer move!

The entire Golden Jade House and the island froze into absolute stillness.

Fang Yuan stepped before the frozen shopkeeper dissecting his rock over the flame.

Squeezing the rock lightly, Fang Yuan saw the rank five Gu carcass.

He transferred the carcass into Xia Lin's rock and returned to the crowd.

At the next moment, time resumed.

# Chapter 1661: Repaying a Debt of Gratitude

The fifth round's outcome left the yellow scaled merman dazed on the spot.

Pointing at Xia Lin, he screamed shrilly: "You cheated!"

Unaware of Fang Yuan's methods, Xia Lin shouted: "You lost fair and square in front of everyone!"

Xia Lin pursued: "Let's transact, you did not win a single round, this Golden Jade House is mine."

"This mermaid girl is just a pawn for a terrifying mastermind. Fighting now would be courting death!"

The yellow scaled merman loathed parting with Golden Jade House, but his life was far more important.

Prostrating himself, he conceded: "I admit defeat! But please enlighten me: when did I offend you?"

"It is time." Fang Yuan smiled, guiding Xia Lin.

Xia Lin added: "Do you want this Golden Jade House back?"

Xia Lin looked at the yellow scaled merman, saying slowly: "This outcome is your just deserts for committing too many sins. Turn over a new leaf and do good deeds, and I will return Golden Jade House. If you revert to your old ways, you will lose far more next time."

Surprised but not daring to show it, the yellow scaled merman thanked her profusely: "I will definitely turn over a new leaf! Revered lady, you are my lifesaver and have reformed my ways. You are like a saintess guiding people towards kindness and away from evil. I was truly wrong! Thank you, Saintess, for this chance—from now on, I will dedicate my life to doing good deeds!"

Xia Lin flushed: "I am no saintess. Remember your promise—we will be watching. If you are caught again, you will regret it."

Saying so, Xia Lin turned around and left.

The next moment, Fang Yuan teleported her to the island's edge.

"It's safe here, you can go back now," Fang Yuan transmitted, not showing himself.

"We will meet again if we are fated to," Fang Yuan smiled as past memories resurfaced.

On the beach, Fang Yuan chased after Xie Han Mo and the rest who were leaving: "Please wait!"

Fang Yuan smiled at Xie Han Mo: "You are the Merman Imperial Court's saintess, here to uncover evidence of Frost Tide tribe's corruption. Having run gambling dens, I know their workings—Frost Tide tribe's main money laundering avenue must be that gambling den."

Xie Han Mo looked at him with crystal-clear eyes, then nodded: "I thank you in advance, human Gu Master. What is your name?"

"My name is Gu Yue Fang Yuan—call me Fang Yuan," he laughed heartily.

# Chapter 1662: Competition for Saintess

Time passed quickly, more than twenty days passed again.

Standing before the Merit Obelisk with arms behind his back, Fang Yuan saw his rank had fallen to fifth.

Immortal materials, Immortal Gu, recipes, killer moves, and even an Immortal Gu House were available for exchange.

Fang Yuan ignored those; his sole goal was regret Gu.

Yet neither regret Gu nor the Merit Obelisk itself appeared among the rewards.

Fang Yuan gathered clues, took specific missions, and deduced with wisdom path methods, focusing entirely on Demon Suppression Regret Crying Sea.

His deductions indicated a high probability that regret Gu was located there.

Punishing the unscrupulous merchant twenty days ago had brought Fang Yuan closest to Demon Suppression Regret Crying Sea, yet he could not advance beyond thirty li from the island.

A change occurred three days later.

A new mission appeared on the Merit Obelisk: attend the mermen's Sea God Ceremony in Sacred City and defend it against sea beast assaults.

The Sea God Ceremony was unique to the mermen; males and females gathered to form new families and elect a new Saintess.

Once elected, the saintess's primary duty was entering Demon Suppression Regret Crying Sea to soothe the demon's killing intent with song and stabilize the waters.

"Once the new saintess enters Demon Suppression Regret Crying Sea, a corresponding mission may appear on the Merit Obelisk. Regardless, I must accept this mission and meet the saintess beforehand."

"The Sea God Ceremony is finally here!" Xia Lin opened her inn window to the bustling noise of the crowd outside.

With a soft clatter, a pearl landed on Xia Lin's window frame.

Pearls served as marriage proposals in the Sea God Ceremony; tossing one to Xia Lin expressed affection.

"Hey miss!" Someone called out to Xia Lin.

A young merman flushed: "Miss, I threw that pearl, but lacked the strength to toss it high enough. Could you please throw it back?"

Xia Lin understood immediately: the youth had aimed for Su Yi, but fell short and hit her window instead.

"A bunch of idle commoners." Su Yi frowned, a pink cloud cushioning her tail as she drifted downstairs.

Xia Lin stepped outside, bowing her head: "Sister Su Yi."

"Xia Lin, do not worry—go ahead if you have other matters, as following me to the Sea God Ceremony carries great risks," Su Yi said sincerely, taking Xia Lin's hand.

Moved, Xia Lin said: "Sister Su Yi, you've helped me so much; I will certainly support your bid for saintess. But I worry I am too weak, especially with only four follower spots."

Su Yi's eyes brightened as she clasped Xia Lin's hands excitedly: "Thank you, Xia Lin! With your help, my chances of becoming saintess are much higher."

Though only at rank two cultivation, Xia Lin possessed a rank five Gu worm.

Though lacking offensive power, gather oil Gu would be immensely helpful in one of the saintess tests Su Yi had researched.

# Chapter 1663: Fang Yuan, You Are A Good Person

Fang Yuan walked through the merman Sacred City appearing as Chu Ying, his aura completely concealed like a mortal.

With the Sea God Ceremony imminent, the entire Sacred City brimmed with festive joy.

Memories from the five hundred years of his previous life resurfaced once more.

"I am Investigator Wu De. Multiple clansmen report that Saintess Xie Han Mo is having an affair with the human Gu Master Gu Yue Fang Yuan; I am here to investigate!" The leader, an icy jade-scaled merman, declared.

Xie Han Mo remained calm, while Fang Yuan clenched his fists with a dark expression.

By uncovering corruption evidence at the gambling den, their investigation had achieved a major breakthrough.

Refusing to sit idly, the opposition spread rumors that the saintess was having an affair with a human.

"Mobilizing investigators without evidence proves Frost Tide tribe leader isn't acting alone—a higher-up must be involved!" Fang Yuan transmitted to Xie Han Mo.

Xie Han Mo frowned slightly: "I am the saintess, while you are a mere investigator. Do you have the elder assembly's token?"

The jade-scaled merman smiled, presenting an information path Gu worm.

Xie Han Mo was calm: "Just this?"

The jade-scaled merman smiled again: "While this cannot investigate the Saintess, Fang Yuan is merely a human Gu Master. I can interrogate him without any token!"

"Wait, clashing now gives the enemy exactly what they want. I will go with them—our progress at the gambling den is sufficient for you to prevail without me!" Fang Yuan transmitted.

Fang Yuan smiled: "At worst I die, repaying your life-saving grace. This scheme targets me on the surface, but the real target is you. If your reputation is ruined, your position is lost. Sacrificing me is trivial compared to protecting the saintess status!"

Composed, Xie Han Mo told the jade-scaled merman: "Return. I will not surrender him."

"Saintess, why do that?" Fang Yuan said anxiously. "This will only..."

For the first time, Xie Han Mo interrupted him: "Fang Yuan, you are a good person."

"You do not fear death largely because you find life wearying, don't you? Deep fatigue and disappointment in the world linger in your eyes, yet undeniably, you are a good person," Xie Han Mo said softly.

Xie Han Mo added: "And I am one too. How can a good person sacrifice another?"

Saying so, she winked at Fang Yuan.

Fang Yuan was dazed; this was his first time seeing Xie Han Mo look so lively, cute, and playful.

Her expression returning to aloof composure, Xie Han Mo said: "Then let them."

… Several days later, the Sea God Ceremony started.

Several mermaid candidates emerged to compete in this year's saintess selection.

To Fang Yuan's surprise, mermaids of all scale colors could vie for the saintess position in this paradise.

Among them, the mermaid Su Yi was the most dazzling.

# Chapter 1664: Saintess Test

During the Sea God Ceremony, Sacred City was flooded with people.

Amidst the crowd, Fang Yuan observed the prospective saintesses with an eerie gaze.

He planned to choose one candidate and assist her in becoming saintess.

… "They are assisting her to become the saintess?"

"That's right, Frost Tide tribe leader invested heavily to back Lady Qiu Shuang."

Xie Han Mo's refusal to surrender Fang Yuan escalated the rumors, forcing the Merman Sacred Court to hold a new Sea God Ceremony to select the saintess once again.

"This scheme exploited your kindness, knowing you wouldn't abandon me, creating this crisis," Fang Yuan sighed deeply, feeling he had implicated Xie Han Mo.

Xie Han Mo smiled at him: "Fang Yuan, do not blame yourself. Had we abandoned you, they would have smeared me as callous, damaging my reputation regardless."

"No need to console me, Saintess," Fang Yuan smiled bitterly. "The severity of each case is vastly different—having worked together this long, how could I not know?"

Xie Han Mo added: "Dragging me down the moment I investigated corruption only proves how deeply rooted the rot is among Sacred Court elders! Don't be too pessimistic; even with a new Sea God Ceremony, I haven't lost my qualification. Nurturing a new saintess is no simple task."

In underwater Sacred City, the singing faded, replaced by intense drumming.

At the square's center, the Sea God's Spring supported an elderly mermaid—the grand elder of the merman tribe.

Nodding at the seven candidates, the grand elder announced: "The first test: golden needle in black oil."

Over ten strength path Gu Masters carried massive vats into the square.

Filled with thick black oil, the test required finding a tiny golden needle within a time limit.

"I request that my follower take my place," the white-scaled mermaid Su Yi said calmly, eyeing the huge vat.

"Approved." The grand elder looked at Su Yi deeply.

"Don't be nervous, don't be nervous," Xia Lin repeated, walking into the square with unease.

"It's her?" Fang Yuan raised his brows, surprised to see Xia Lin as the favored candidate's follower.

Gather oil Gu proved its worth—the vat soon emptied, leaving only a golden needle sparkling at the bottom.

Through Xia Lin's stellar performance in the first test, Su Yi gained a massive reputation boost.

Fang Yuan watched with dark eyes: "Six out of seven passed because they came prepared. The test was leaked beforehand."

Pale green flames blazed before Xie Han Mo, forming a flaming path.

The white-scaled Qiu Shuang walked calmly to the other end of the flame road, looking mockingly at Xie Han Mo: "Former saintess, your turn."

"Damn it! This eerie fire burns the soul and requires specific Gu worms to resist. Despite our thorough preparations, this first test is far too targeted!"

"Worst of all, Qiu Shuang came prepared with Gu worms to resist the eerie fire. Luck? Hmph! She clearly knew the test—Frost Tide tribe is openly colluding and cheating!"

"Let me." Fang Yuan walked towards the frowning Xie Han Mo.

"You?" Xie Han Mo looked at Fang Yuan with crystal clear eyes.

"Trust me, I am confident." Fang Yuan looked directly at Xie Han Mo, his eyes shining brightly.

"Be careful, this eerie fire is formidable… if you can't endure it, step down," Xie Han Mo said.

Fang Yuan laughed heartily, turning and striding boldly into the eerie fire.

Intense pain originating from his soul instantly assaulted Fang Yuan's entire body.

Though the flame scorched his soul, his two lifetimes' accumulation and otherworldly demon status helped him endure it.

He refused to give up midway, knowing that having taken Xie Han Mo's place, his failure meant hers.

When he finally crossed the flaming path, the crowd erupted in shock.

Fang Yuan tried to smile, but fainted the next moment.

Just before he hit the ground, Xie Han Mo arrived and caught him in her arms.

"I won't waste your efforts." Xie Han Mo looked deeply at Fang Yuan, then turned toward Qiu Shuang with sharp, cold eyes.

The second, third, and fourth test…

She performed flawlessly while other competitors fell short, leaving only the mermaid Qiu Shuang.

Fang Yuan sobered as she said: "Be careful. The situation favors us, but the enemy won't sit idly by."

Fang Yuan expected Frost Tide tribe leader to strike, but not with such viciousness.

Inside the house, the red-scaled guard knelt with a flushed face: "Saintess, let me fight to clear this humiliating accusation. How could I possibly bully a widow?!"

Xie Han Mo sighed: "Stand up. I know your character, but this is clearly the enemy's plot. Charging out will only play into their hands."

The blue-scaled guard worried: "She is Bu Su Lian, wife of the former third elder. Investigators will soon arrest him, preventing him from participating and weakening our strength!"

Fang Yuan added: "For the former third elder's wife to sacrifice her reputation, she must be close to Frost Tide tribe leader. Such severe corruption forced her to act personally. Having set this trap, they are fully prepared. Trying to clear the matter directly will play into their hands; we must play along and find a way out."

"Simple, I'll take the blame," Fang Yuan said plainly.

"No way." Xie Han Mo rejected this instantly.

# Chapter 1665: The Story of the Sea God and Mermaid

Though taking the blame would resolve the crisis, Xie Han Mo rejected the idea without hesitation.

The turning point happened three days later, Xie Han Mo received some information.

Xie Han Mo reviewed the intel, stunned, before sighing: "Qiu Shuang is no longer pure."

She handed the intel to her guards and Fang Yuan.

Backed by Frost Tide tribe leader, Qiu Shuang was the greatest threat to Xie Han Mo's position.

Virginity was the first prerequisite for mermaids competing for the saintess position.

The blue-scaled guard noted: "How did Qiu Shuang pass inspection unless our tribe's corruption has reached the priests?"

Fang Yuan frowned: "If we announce this now, people may think we're making false accusations to protect red scale. How reliable is this intel? If it's a trap, we're in trouble…"

Xie Han Mo shook her head: "It is reliable. The grand elder gave this to me herself. Though we lack proof, having another priest inspect Qiu Shuang's background will verify whether she is a virgin."

Fang Yuan now understood that Xie Han Mo had become saintess thanks to the Merman Sacred Court grand elder's backing.

After being reported and investigated, Qiu Shuang was exposed—she had indeed lost her virginity.

The news shocked the Sacred Court, throwing Sacred City into an uproar.

Commoners and Sacred Court higher-ups alike were furious, swiftly deciding Qiu Shuang's punishment.

A few days later, Qiu Shuang was beheaded and died.

"Xie Han Mo, you went too far!" Frost Tide tribe leader growled with bloodshot eyes.

"I warned you long ago to control your drinking," Bu Su Lian said calmly, sipping tea. "After Qiu Shuang's downfall, the higher-ups will abandon her backer."

Frost Tide tribe leader gritted his teeth: "Bu Su Lian, our allies won't turn on us over this. If Xie Han Mo keeps her position, they will suffer too. So even if they despise me and hate seeing me, they must force themselves to work with me!"

"Rest assured," Frost Tide tribe leader laughed sinisterly, "I still have methods left."

"Oh? I am listening." Bu Su Lian sat up straight.

On Sacred City's square, the mermaid Dong Lei announced under everyone's watchful eyes: "I am willing to take Qiu Shuang's place and continue the Sea God Ceremony."

"By tribe rules, sisters can take each other's place. Dong Lei is fully entitled to replace Qiu Shuang and contest for the saintess position."

During the Sea God Ceremony, the mermen conducted multiple tests to choose their saintess.

That was a singing competition among mermaids.

Each contestant sang three times, with the results determining the sole saintess.

If all contestants were eliminated during the Sea God Ceremony, the saintess position remained vacant.

# Chapter 1666: Intercept

Night brought a turbulent sea of vicious waves and howling winds.

Merman warriors held up a giant white seashell as dancing mermen surrounded Xie Han Mo and Dong Lei before countless spectators.

Left behind by the desolate beast giant music shell, it was packed with sound path dao marks that amplified any voice far and wide.

Dong Lei was the first to ascend the shell.

In a boat-like Gu house nearby, Bu Su Lian watched and asked Frost Tide tribe leader: "Are you that confident in Dong Lei? The first performer has a natural disadvantage."

Frost Tide tribe leader smiled: "Just watch, words cannot explain it."

Dong Lei started to sing.

Her clear and elegant voice was mesmerizing, captivating all the mermen in this beautiful melody.

Amplified by the giant music shell, Dong Lei's beautiful singing echoed across a thousand li, suppressing even the torrential tides.

While the crowd marveled at Dong Lei's singing, Fang Yuan's group grew furious. Even Xie Han Mo's expression filled with shock and sorrow.

"What is going on?"

"Why is Dong Lei singing the song that we prepared?!"

Fang Yuan's expression turned grim: "A spy among us leaked our song to the enemy!"

Fang Yuan looked at them fearlessly: "Only the four of us knew our prepared songs. The traitor is one of you—who is it?"

Both guards flushed with anger, fiercely denying the accusation.

Xie Han Mo shook her head: "They may have learned our preparations through information path methods."

"Hahaha." Far away, Frost Tide tribe's leader laughed loudly in his Gu house.

Having observed Xie Han Mo's group, Bu Su Lian understood and said, eyes gleaming: "You planted a spy near her?"

Frost Tide tribe leader laughed: "Of course! Do you know the enormous price I paid to plant a spy so close to her?"

Bu Su Lian's eyes flickered: "Well worth it. With Dong Lei singing that song, Xie Han Mo has nothing left."

The final round required singing three songs, each needing dedicated sound path Gu worms.

The first song calmed the sea waves, the second attracted living beings, and the third repelled sea beasts.

With Dong Lei stealing the first song, Xie Han Mo's remaining two could not replace it.

"What do we do?" Both guards were extremely flustered and anxious.

"This must be Frost Tide tribe leader's scheme—we'll expose him and ruin his reputation!" red scale shouted.

Fang Yuan retorted: "Do you have proof? Without evidence, they will only accuse us instead."

Xie Han Mo smiled bitterly: "Hurry, leave now. While there's still time, get away from here."

Frost Tide tribe leader sneered sinisterly: "Though I can't touch that foolish old grand elder, I'll torture Xie Han Mo afterward to vent my hatred!"

Dong Lei stepped down, raising her eyebrows: "I have calmed the sea by five feet. I look forward to sister Xie Han Mo's performance."

# Chapter 1667: White Moonlight

Xie Han Mo looked her deeply in the eye before ascending the stage.

"Why are you…" She looked at Fang Yuan beside her in deep shock.

Fang Yuan cut in: "As your follower, I am qualified to be your accompaniment."

"Singing the same song will disqualify you. Trust me, I have a replacement," Fang Yuan transmitted.

Unable to change Gu worms now, Xie Han Mo needed a new song sharing the original's rhythm.

"I have a similar piece, but you must adapt on the spot to match your Gu worms." Fang Yuan transmitted the lyrics and tune.

Xie Han Mo was stunned before nodding: "Okay."

Fang Yuan breathed in deeply: "Then let's start."

Xie Han Mo inhaled deeply and closed her eyes, her customary habit before singing.

"Why isn't she singing yet?" Some onlookers grew impatient.

"Hahaha, how can she sing? She has nothing to sing!" Frost Tide tribe leader laughed loudly, face flushed red.

"Oh, sorry, can anyone lend me a zither Gu?" Fang Yuan broke the silence.

"I need a rank three zither Gu, can anyone lend one?" Fang Yuan added, looking toward the grand elder.

Sensing the crisis, the grand elder promptly sent over a zither Gu.

Catching it, Fang Yuan announced: "Let me refine this Gu on the spot."

The mood of all the mermen turned bad.

Instructed by Frost Tide tribe leader, a lackey shouted: "You're purposely stalling for time!"

Fang Yuan shouted back: "Does the ceremony forbid refining Gu? We will start once the refinement is complete."

The grand elder quickly added: "Indeed, no such rule exists; I permit it. Refine the Gu quickly so we can begin."

Fang Yuan retorted: "I'm refining Gu for the Sea God Ceremony. Can't you wait a moment for such an important ceremony? Whoever lacks patience can leave right now!"

"Sharp tongue! Once you fall into my hands, I'll smash your teeth and rip out your tongue," Frost Tide tribe leader snickered.

Standing beside Fang Yuan felt surreal—nothing like this had ever happened in the history of the Sea God Ceremony.

With the zither Gu's owner cooperating, Fang Yuan's refinement speed accelerated rapidly.

Obtaining the zither Gu, Fang Yuan stepped behind Xie Han Mo, saying confidently: "Alright, the real show starts now."

"Go ahead and sing, let's see what song you can muster!" Frost Tide tribe leader snickered.

At this moment, the zither started playing.

Fang Yuan activated the zither Gu, releasing a long, deep, and exquisitely beautiful melody.

Xie Han Mo shut her eyes, she started to sing —

The white moonlight is somewhere in my heart.

It is so bright, yet so icy cold.

Everyone has their own sadness.

Wanting to conceal it, but it just became more obvious.

Her beautiful voice intoxicated everyone, who savored every note.

… The white moonlight lightens the horizons of the world.

It's in my heart, but not by my side.

I could not wipe the tears off your face back then.

The road is too long, I could not seek forgiveness.

Her pure voice was gentle and clear, like moonlight that seemed cold yet carried warmth within.

The giant shell began glowing white, and the waves subsided as if unwilling to disturb her singing.

…
Engrossed, Xie Han Mo looked at Fang Yuan, who was activating the zither Gu with complete concentration.

She thought: "Is there sorrow in your heart as well?"

… As the song ended, the crowd remained silent.

In the Gu house, Frost Tide tribe leader froze like a statue, shock plastered across his face.

As the sea calmed and dark clouds scattered, pure moonlight illuminated the giant seashell, enveloping Xie Han Mo and Fang Yuan.

The two turned around slightly, looking at each other.

# Chapter 1668: Too Naive

As the music ended, the mermen began conversing among themselves.

"The song was superb, but Xie Han Mo's Gu worm manipulation was clumsy and full of errors," many mermen discussed with strange expressions.

"The sea is calm and moonlight has returned—the results are clear."

"This should be a draw—in fact, Xie Han Mo has a slight lead."

Perceiving everything, the grand elder exhaled as the worry in her heart lifted.

"What is going on?!" In the Gu house, Frost Tide tribe's leader screamed.

Bu Su Lian narrowed her eyes at Fang Yuan: "This man isn't simple—no wonder Xie Han Mo favored him. As a song expert, I can tell this is likely his own creation—this human has remarkable sound path attainment."

Yet Bu Su Lian guessed wrong in the end; Fang Yuan had not created it—the song was from Earth.

"This unique song must be your own creation. To think your sound path attainment was so high, Fang Yuan," Xie Han Mo transmitted admiringly.

Fang Yuan smiled bitterly: "You flatter me. You saw that I had to borrow a zither Gu; my sound path attainment isn't that high."

"What matters now are the next two songs. If I'm not wrong…" Fang Yuan hesitated.

They walked down the stage as Dong Lei went up.

Though Fang Yuan and Xie Han Mo's performance was impressive, Dong Lei remained calm and composed.

As she sang, her moving voice attracted schools of fish.

"Don't worry, I have a song prepared." Fang Yuan smiled confidently.

Once Dong Lei stepped down, the two took the stage.

Fang Yuan played music as Xie Han Mo sang and danced.

… When did the bright moon first appear? Raising a cup, one asks the blue sky.

In celestial palaces, one wonders what year it is tonight.

… I wish to ride the wind back, yet fear the jade towers; high dwellings cannot bear the cold.

Dancing with one's own shadow, how can it compare to the mortal world?

The moon circles the red pavilion, dipping over silk windows to shine on the sleepless.

… There should be no resentment; yet why is the moon always full at separation?

People know sorrow, joy, parting, and reunion; the moon dims, shines, waxes, and wanes.

Such flaws have reigned since antiquity. May we live long, sharing the moon's beauty across a thousand miles.

Fish, prawns, turtles, and crabs—aquatic creatures blanketed the sea's surface, scattered all around.

Looking at Fang Yuan, Xie Han Mo thought: "Did he compose this song for me?"

Resonating with the lyrics, her sadness dissolved—the rumors could no longer shake her.

"He understands me." Xie Han Mo felt an indescribable stir in her heart, deeply moved.

The outcome was clear: Fang Yuan and Xie Han Mo won again.

Dong Lei paled below the stage, knowing she had been thoroughly outmatched.

"This human is a massive threat!" Frost Tide tribe leader slammed his fist against the window.

He had to solve this immediately; at this rate, Xie Han Mo was guaranteed to win after the third song.

"Fang Yuan, I am Frost Tide tribe leader!" he transmitted directly.

Fang Yuan's expression changed but he did not reply.

Frost Tide tribe leader chuckled: "You are smart, but too young and naive."

Fang Yuan sneered in reply: "I'm not naive—this is my ideal, which you cannot understand."

"Don't think the limelight makes you anything more than pawns. A fluttering flag relies on its pole—what do you rely on?"

"The grand elder? Ask around what kind of person she is. She had the power to suppress our faction, yet made you her vanguard. Did she help when Xie Han Mo investigated the corruption case? She may have given a few clues, but trust me, it took virtually no effort on her part."

Frost Tide tribe's leader added eloquently: "Even if you win and defend the saintess title, so what? Do you think I'll die? No, Frost Tide tribe is the Sacred Court's largest faction; if I die, the entire court will fall into turmoil or fracture. The grand elder lacks the resolve for that—she only wants to keep me in check and prevent me from overstepping."

"So in the end, whatever you uncover, I remain Frost Tide tribe's leader. At worst, I'll sacrifice some scapegoats and curb my overbearing actions."

"The Sea God Ceremony is just a game for higher-ups to distribute decades of resources without internal strife. The faction with a saintess claims a bigger share, while the rest get less."

"Fang Yuan, you may detest our dark games, but understand that in this sea, darkness is the true ruler. The so-called light merely grazes the surface. Commoners indulge in its dazzling beauty, believing light is the sea's truth, but they are simply... too naive."

Fang Yuan was silent.

# Chapter 1669: Rejection

Inside the blue dragon whale grotto-heaven, the Merman Sacred City.

"What do we do?"

"Zhao Lu's follower is competing next—with his fame and strength, we have no chance."

White-scaled mermaid Su Yi sat in the center holding a cup, staring dazedly at the tea inside.

"Only Zhao Lu and our faction remain. If we pass this hurdle, we can vie for the saintess position."

Su Yi sighed: "But what can we do now?"

"Missy, didn't our tribe find a strong expert to counter the enemy?"

"Rules forbid abandoning followers, but if one commits a crime, we can expel them to free a spot for our expert."

Su Yi objected: "That's inappropriate. A scandal would ruin their reputation for life—how could I repay kindness with enmity?"

"I suggest targeting Xia Lin. She has no background and nobody cares about her; who knows what luck let her obtain that gather oil Gu." Seeing Su Yi's displeasure, Nanny Rong added: "We won't frame her, but reason with her—Xia Lin seems like an understanding girl. Leave it to me, Missy. I'll negotiate with her; paying a small price is nothing compared to the saintess position!"

"That's her—the shameless mermaid who betrayed her benefactor Su Yi to gain favor with the rich and noble!"

Nanny Rong sneered: "Still acting? Missy was deeply upset by the news, yet you come to rattle her before the competition?"

"You are forcing me to chase you away?" Nanny Rong said sinisterly.

"Need us to investigate?" A group of mermen charged into the inn, drawing everyone's attention.

The investigator said: "Xia Lin, you are reported for corruption and sabotaging the ceremony. You are under arrest."

"Wait." At this moment, Su Yi spoke.

"Sister Su Yi!" Hope shone in Xia Lin's eyes.

Su Yi shook her head: "I don't believe you betrayed me, but we must trust justice. Go with them to prove your innocence."

Xia Lin lowered her head, walking towards the investigator: "I was framed, but I will go with you."
