The investigator smiled sinisterly, pointing at the Gu worms on the table: "These contain the evidence—look closely."

Xia Lin looked into them one by one.

Shock soon covered her face: "These scenes and voices are fabricated! I never said such things!"

Raising his arm to stop Xia Lin, the investigator smiled: "I know you were framed."

"Because Lady Su Yi requested it," the investigator chuckled.

"You're truly naive. Do you know who Lady Su Yi's father is? Understand how the Sea God Ceremony really works..."

As the investigator explained, Xia Lin listened in profound shock.

Only after a long while did she react: "I don't believe this is Sister Su Yi's plot! If she wanted me to step down, I would have willingly agreed had she told me!"

The investigator mocked: "You cannot simply quit the ceremony, or it would become an open faction contest. The only way to step down is through force, allowing that vacated position to be refilled."

The investigator smiled: "Indeed, you've grown smarter. Alright, you have two choices now, the first choice is to deny this evidence and fight for your innocence. But this evidence is concrete, nobody will believe your words."

"Second, cooperate, admit to the crime, and though your reputation suffers, we will compensate you with abundant resources. Choose now."

She had neither the strength to resist nor the right to refuse!

The investigator said: "Xia Lin, continue your silence and I'll assume you accept. The facts are clear; a smart person makes the wise choice. This benefits us both, doesn't it?"

"I reject the offer," Xia Lin said, suddenly raising her head.

# Chapter 1670: Racing Heart

"Reject?" The investigator frowned, eyes flashing cold as his tone hardened: "Think carefully, girl. Don't be impulsive—the weak cannot contend with the strong, and you can't even be considered weak."

"I know I'm a nobody with no one to rely on, which is why you targeted me, right?" Looking at the investigator, Xia Lin spoke with bitter helplessness: "Don't worry, I accept your false accusation, treating it as repaying Sister Su Yi's kindness. I want no compensation; from now on, our debts are settled, and we are strangers."

Several days later.

"Lady Xia Lin, it's not that our inn refuses your business, but public outrage is fierce and many have filed reports. If you stay, they will..." the innkeeper said bitterly.

Xia Lin cut him off: "I understand your situation, I'll leave."

"How did I reach this state?" she asked herself, receiving no answer.

Leaving the inn, Xia Lin walked alone into a secluded alley. "Hello, young lady!" Three mermen suddenly stepped from an alley corner.

"What do you want?" Xia Lin took a step back.

Just then, two rank two merman Gu Masters approached Xia Lin from behind.

Gritting her teeth, her brows rose: "Come on, even if I die, I'll drag you down with me!"

Terrified, she turned to see the wall melt away as a sixth merman emerged.

"Wake up, wake up…" A deep voice lingered in the darkness.

Xia Lin opened her eyes to the alley. The throbbing behind her head alarmed her, and she quickly struggled to her feet.

She saw the six mermen lying motionless on the ground in strange postures.

A human Gu Master stood in the middle of them.

Xia Lin cried out with joy: "Master Chu, it's you!"

"It's me. I've watched the ceremony from the start and heard of your situation—tossed aside by Su Yi, right?" Fang Yuan smiled faintly.

"I'm a good judge of character; though we've met only a few times, you are not that kind of person," Fang Yuan continued.

Fang Yuan quietly watched her cry for sometime before patting her shoulder: "Let's go."

"To where?" Xia Lin was slightly dazed.

"I'm partly responsible for your predicament," Fang Yuan sighed. "Without my gather oil Gu, Su Yi wouldn't have targeted you for the Sea God Ceremony. Follow me—I'm taking you away."

"Okay." Xia Lin nodded, having lost all interest in Sacred City.

Fang Yuan led the way as Xia Lin followed obediently.

The alley opened onto another branch of the main street, crowded with bustling shops and a lion dance team at the center.

Stepping out of the alley, Fang Yuan snapped his fingers.

Xia Lin was stupefied, her mouth hanging open as the entire street froze to a standstill.

"Just a small trick, come." Fang Yuan waved and stepped into the crowd.

Xia Lin quickened her pace, following behind closely.

"Here." Fang Yuan gave her a mask.

"Master Chu, this..." Xia Lin was puzzled as Fang Yuan led her toward the lion dance troupe rather than away from the street.

Fang Yuan pointed at the troupe: "Don't you think it lacks two key characters?"

Xia Lin nodded: "They're performing the sea lion opera, lacking the fisherman and mermaid princess leads. Missing characters is normal for an impromptu troupe."

"My method only lasts briefly. Put on the mask quickly; we'll move with the crowd," Fang Yuan hurried her, giving no chance to refuse.

"Oh, okay." Xia Lin subconsciously put on the mask, her heart suddenly calming down.

Soon after, her face blushed when she saw Fang Yuan don the filial fisherman mask.

Xia Lin's heart started to race wildly!

# Chapter 1671: Life and Mask

Fang Yuan snapped his fingers once again.

"Follow me!" Fang Yuan dragged her to the lion dance team.

"You know how to dance, right?" Fang Yuan smiled and moved his legs, portraying the filial fisherman with subtle, natural grace.

He secretly used wisdom path methods; Xia Lin immediately felt nimble as the play's dance postures surfaced vividly in her mind.

The two sang and danced and moved along with the crowd.

"Time to leave." Fang Yuan shifted his movements, pulling Xia Lin from the troupe toward the street's edge.

"Here." Pulling her along swiftly, Fang Yuan turned into an alley.

Though less lively than the previous one, this street was also crowded and boisterous.

Fang Yuan stopped and turned to Xia Lin: "Have you thought it through?"

Xia Lin was stunned: "Thought… thought what through?"

Fang Yuan smiled, pointing at Xia Lin's mask: "Do you want to wear it crossing the street, or walk into the crowd showing your own face?"

Fang Yuan continued: "I took off my mask, yet you still wear yours. Afraid to face people with your real face?"

After a brief silence, realization dawned and she removed her mask, revealing her face: "Master Chu, I understand. Thank you, truly. I am only an ordinary mermaid..."

Fang Yuan raised a hand, interrupting: "As I said, your predicament is largely because of me; I must compensate you."

"Master, what are you saying? Gifting me gather oil Gu was immense kindness. You owe me nothing—in fact, I owe you everything!" Xia Lin said quickly.

"That is your interpretation." Fang Yuan's expression turned solemn: "Earlier you were jeered, yet just now you received cheers. What caused such a vast difference? Could it because of this mask? But in fact, you had been yourself all along, isn't that so?"

Fang Yuan pointed at the crowd: "These people don't care about your true self; while dancing, they didn't care about our names either. They are only expressing their attitude; the truth doesn't matter to them. Ordinary people only chase the truth out of anger at being made fools of."

"So to them, we don't matter, and to us, their attitude shouldn't matter either."

"I haven't finished. Since outsiders' attitudes don't matter, what is truly important in our lives?" Fang Yuan asked with a smile.

Xia Lin was stunned for the third time: "Master, forgive my ignorance…"

Fang Yuan pointed at Xia Lin, then himself: "It is ourselves. Our truest feelings. Ask yourself, listen to the voice deep in your heart. What do you want to do, who do you want to become, where do you want to go? You will find the answers deep within."

Fang Yuan pointed from the alley to the street: "If you want to stay in the alley, stay. If you want to join the festivities in the street, walk out. Don't mistreat your own feelings because of their attitude. If you constantly mistreat yourself, you will end up full of regrets, endlessly wearing a mask to act as someone else until you are no longer yourself."

Hearing this, Xia Lin felt enlightened, her mind clearing as all her previous worries and distress were swept away completely.

# Chapter 1672: Stop Being So Naive

"Master, I will never forget your guidance!" The mermaid stepped back and bowed solemnly to Fang Yuan.

Fang Yuan laughed heartily: "My efforts weren't wasted. But it is easier said than done. What do you want to do most right now?"

"I want to follow you!" was the first thought that sprang to mind.

Before she could speak, Fang Yuan shook his head: "You haven't thought it through yet; you have time later. Actually, I'm not concerned with what you want. Do you know what I want to do?"

Xia Lin shook her head, but the next moment her eyes widened and her body stiffened.

Fang Yuan had slowly reached out and stroked her face.

Fang Yuan withdrew his hand: "You still have a mask on."

Fang Yuan spoke: "Sometimes masks are forced upon us. Right now, I want to remove yours. Will you cooperate?"

"Mas… Master, you don't need to…" Xia Lin stuttered, vaguely sensing his intent.

Fang Yuan waved his hand: "I won't be happy unless I remove it. I refuse to betray my feelings. Since you feel indebted, cooperate with me as compensation, alright?"

She knelt, kowtowed thrice to Fang Yuan, and quietly stood up: "Master Chu, I will do whatever you ask!"

"Okay, then become the saintess."

"What?!"

Several days later.

The Sea God Ceremony's final test drew everyone's attention.

Su Yi stared at Xia Lin in shock, as if seeing a ghost.

Su Yi had expected easy victory after her rival was injured in the previous round.

The competitor's long-lost younger sister had been found—it was this mermaid, Xia Lin!

"That was a lie intentionally spread by Su Yi's supporters to free up a follower quota. That investigator pleaded guilty, and the recording of him pressuring Xia Lin is ironclad evidence!"

"Besides, we never arranged for that investigator—why did he confess for no reason?"

Su Yi looked extremely unsightly, while Xia Lin calmly observed the crowd, her spirit elevated by Fang Yuan's guidance.

Seeing Xia Lin ignore her, Su Yi felt even more stifled and snorted coldly: "Xia Lin, I never expected we'd meet again like this."

"I didn't expect this either," Xia Lin replied honestly. The dramatic ups and downs of recent days felt like a dream.

Su Yi snorted again: "Whatever your scheme, a random mermaid can't pass this final test. The saintess position is mine."

In the second round, Xia Lin narrowly defeated Su Yi.

Defying all expectations, this result stirred the crowd into a shocked commotion.

Hiding in the crowd, Fang Yuan feigned shock like the others, yet his heart remained tranquil.

Using immortal time path methods over recent days, he had gained ample time to train Xia Lin thoroughly.

He had also prepared unique songs and specialized sound path Gu worms for her.

Moreover, when they sang on stage, Fang Yuan secretly tampered with their performances, making Su Yi's singing choppy while steadily elevating Xia Lin's.

"Aside from us outsiders, there are likely no Gu Immortals in this grotto-heaven. Using immortal methods, how could I fail to control a mortal ceremony?"

"What do we do? The third round is starting!" The two nannies sweated with anxiety. Sent by the clan to assist Su Yi, they would be punished if she lost the saintess position.

Su Yi was pale as she looked at Xia Lin.

"Young miss, what should we do?" The two nannies were out of ideas.

"We can't do anything before this crowd, and time is short. There is only one option left—I will persuade her myself," Su Yi gritted her teeth after a long silence.

She transmitted to Xia Lin: "Xia Lin, I am Su Yi."

Xia Lin was surprised, but quickly regained her composure: "What is it?"

Su Yi gathered her thoughts: "Let's make a deal: throw the next round and let me be saintess. I swear by the Sea God that I will satisfy your price completely. Even if I can't alone, my family will."

Xia Lin remained silent for a moment before saying: "Sorry but I…."

"Don't refuse so quickly. The saintess position isn't about faith—it's a political game involving the interests of Sacred City's entire upper echelon."

"I know you want revenge, but your situation is already perilous. Becoming the saintess will only put you in greater danger. Your sister's faction only pushed you forward because they lacked other candidates; it's merely a front. Once you become saintess, they will do everything to turn you into their puppet and serve their interests."

"I haven't known you long, but I know you're pure and kind. As saintess, you'll probably try to fight for the common merfolk. Unless you join a faction and represent their interests, you will be ostracized as the most powerless saintess in history."

"If you deal with me, the benefits will surpass your imagination—far more than your sister's side can offer. Believe in my sincerity!"

Su Yi was remarkably persuasive, even moving Xia Lin.

Yet she replied: "Lady Su Yi, I appreciate your sincerity, but I cannot agree."

"Why?" Su Yi urged. "You think I'm lying? Cruel as it is, it's the truth. Stop being so… so naive, alright?"

Xia Lin remained silent.

# Chapter 1673: Gu Yue Fang Yuan

Fang Yuan's first life of five hundred years.

Sea God Ceremony.

Naive?

Facing the Frost Tide leader's long-winded speech, Fang Yuan fell silent.

After a brief pause, he chuckled and transmitted: "You think I don't know this? That I'm an inexperienced youth? I understand these tricks clearly. I know these truths and accept them."

Fang Yuan was forced to leave Qing Mao Mountain, wandering about in Southern Border before going to Western Desert and then to Eastern Sea. He struggled at the border of death, he had to worry about one or two primeval stones. He had groveled before the strong in destitution, yet had also held high status, sipping tea while subordinates reported to him.

Between his life on Earth and his journey in this world, his vision, experience, and knowledge far surpassed ordinary men.

Frustrated, Frost Tide's leader replied: "Then you know the risks! This is our mermen's political battle—why is a weak human Gu Master meddling? Do you like Xie Han Mo? I guarantee that once this ends, I'll gift you even more beautiful mermaids! Don't doubt my sincerity—I can swear an oath to the Sea God!"

"A merman's oath to the Sea God is indeed sincere. But…" Fang Yuan continued, "accepting these truths doesn't mean I like them. You think I like Xie Han Mo? No, I merely want to help her. Why take such risks? Because I have my own principles: favors repaid, grudges settled."

"I've lived far longer than you imagine. I once yearned for longevity, but life has grown boring. The destination often matters less than the journey itself and how one feels along the way."

The Frost Tide leader stared, struggling to comprehend Fang Yuan's mindset: "You mean the saintess position doesn't matter, only helping Xie Han Mo in this contest?"

"Correct, but more than that. The dark side of politics and promises of mermaid beauties mean nothing to me. To put it simply: I've lived long enough to grow sick of wearing a mask. Death doesn't frighten me at all. Now, I only wish to live by my truest feelings, pursuing my goals in my own way. Only then do I feel the thrill and desire of living!"

Dumbstruck, the Frost Tide leader finally understood and yelled: "You're a lunatic! All this talk just means you've lived long enough and have a death wish! Maybe if you were a Gu Immortal, but a mere rank three Gu Master living on his own terms? You're dreaming!"

Fang Yuan smiled: "You think being a Gu Immortal lets one live freely? Wherever people gather, there is conflict. How you live depends not on cultivation, but your heart."

Fang Yuan added: "Without a mask, facing reality's hardships and overcoming them makes life all the more wonderful."

The Frost Tide leader stood dumbfounded, mouth agape and unable to speak!

Looking across the crowd at Fang Yuan's faint smile, a chill gripped his heart: *This man's deviant thoughts defy all logic—he has an inclination towards self-destruction. He has truly turned demonic!*

The final song.

Xie Han Mo and Fang Yuan walked to the stage together.

Fang Yuan played accompaniment as Xie Han Mo's song echoed around them.

… The blue sea is laughing, the tidal waves are surging.

Drifting with the waves, only caring about today.

Heaven laughs, at this hectic mortal world.

Who will win, who will lose, only heaven knows.

… Human life ebbs and flows like waves. Why fret constantly over victory or defeat?

The natural romanticism intoxicated the crowd.

… The rivers and mountains laugh, the misty rain is far away.

How many great men and heroes, have the tides washed away?

Smiling at the breeze wind, lost in quiet solitude.

Heroic feelings remain, reflected in the cold night.

… Bold and unrestrained, all aspirations are washed away by the tides, and even life must end. But what does it matter?

The true self is unyielding and lonely; even like a setting sun, it shines with its own splendor.

The Frost Tide leader paled, shivering as he realized his defeat was certain!

Common people laugh, there is no more loneliness.

Yet the unyielding spirit in me is still laughing crazily.

… I struggled to survive in this mortal realm, living by my own feelings. Though tossed by the waves to the brink of death, I will never grieve, fear, or lament; I will savor every flavor and laugh wildly to the very end.

I am true to my nature.

I am a true person!

On stage, Fang Yuan closed his eyes and activated his Gu, filling the area with zither music.

The Frost Tide leader stared blankly, murmuring: "This… this demon…"

Xie Han Mo sang in a trance, eyes shining brightly as she looked at Fang Yuan: "Such a free, unrestrained life—isn't this what I yearn for? To create such a song, he truly possesses an immortal's demeanor!"

… Back to the present.

Xia Lin went on stage for the third song.

The blue sea laughs, tidal waves surge. Drifting with the waves, caring only for today.

Heaven laughs at the hectic mortal world. Who wins and who loses, only heaven knows…

The entire venue was stunned and Su Yi paled—the outcome was settled.

Xia Lin was already entranced in singing.

The familiar melody echoed in Fang Yuan's ears, intertwining with his memories.

He had once stood on stage as accompanist, eyes closed with a faint smile.

Now he stood offstage as a spectator, dark light hidden in his eyes.

Across several hundred years, time had changed him, yet changed nothing at all.

He had always been Gu Yue Fang Yuan.

# Chapter 1674: Sudden Change, Regret Gu

The Sea God Ceremony concluded with a shocking upset: the new saintess was Xia Lin.

Dazed and unfocused, she wondered: "Days have passed since the ceremony, yet Master Chu hasn't appeared since that transmission. When will he return?"

Xia Lin's elder sister Zhao Lu walked into Saintess Palace.

"Sister, have you considered what I told you days ago?" Zhao Lu asked directly.

Xia Lin shook her head: "I'm truly sorry, but I don't want to get involved. The saintess position was never my goal—if possible, I'd rather not be saintess."

"If you truly didn't want to be saintess, why participate? We both understand the reality here. State your terms—this deal will satisfy you completely!" Zhao Lu pressed frankly.

"Sister," Xia Lin replied softly, "I truly don't want to get involved. Rest assured, I won't collaborate with other factions either."

Zhao Lu's eyes widened: "You're so naive! I thought you were just holding out for a better offer. Let me be blunt: without our backing, you will die, understand?"

Xia Lin stared at Zhao Lu in shock: "Don't tell me…"

Zhao Lu shook her head: "No force dares harm a saintess recognized by the Sea God. But the danger comes from your duties, not us."

"Every saintess has a crucial duty: go to Demon Suppression Regret Crying Sea and sing for three days and nights, purifying the intensifying demonic aura with her song! It is extremely perilous with a dismal survival rate. Many saintesses perished in Regret Crying Sea, while survivors often went mad. The prestige comes with deadly risk. Without this task, ten times more mermaids would have competed for the role!"

"There is such a thing?" Xia Lin was astonished.

Zhao Lu laughed: "You think I am deceiving you? This information is hidden, but no great secret. With your current status, you can easily inquire about it, though ordinary mermen are kept in the dark."

"Among our sea areas, Demon Suppression Regret Crying Sea is a forbidden zone where Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable sealed a peerless demon. But his sins are truly too heavy and his demonic nature is too strong, the demonic aura will accumulate after a period of time and start influencing the living organisms in the sea area, making them stronger, ferocious and crueler."

"The saintess must go to the center of Demon Suppression Regret Crying Sea and sing with all her strength to dispel the demonic aura; otherwise, the growing aura will make the sea creatures increasingly tyrannical and invasive. This infectious demonic aura will also expand Demon Suppression Regret Crying Sea's area."

Surprised by this secret, Xia Lin asked: "Even with support and ample preparation, past saintesses faced extreme danger. If I go alone without your help, isn't it practically seeking death?"

"Not almost, but definitely!" Zhao Lu's tone was firm.

"Yes, I am sure, even if I die."

Zhao Lu laughed in fury: "In that case… I only wish you good luck!"

The sisters parted on a bad note.

"Haha, it finally appeared!" Before the Merit Obelisk, Fang Yuan's eyes shone brightly.

A new task had appeared on Merit Obelisk — help the new saintess complete her most important mission!

Fang Yuan had already inquired and learned the saintess's crucial mission: purifying Demon Suppression Regret Crying Sea!

Fang Yuan could only enter Demon Suppression Regret Crying Sea through such a task.

Unsure whether this task would appear on the Merit Obelisk, Fang Yuan had chosen to support a weak saintess who had no one else to rely on.

Without hesitation, Fang Yuan accepted the task and was teleported back to Sacred City.

Several days later.

Saintess Xia Lin stood atop a giant tortoise slowly advancing toward Demon Suppression Regret Crying Sea.

Behind her stood Fang Yuan.

The tranquil journey was suddenly interrupted by a gale carrying mournful wails: "I regret it so much! Why did I ever provoke Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable!"

Xia Lin jolted, quickly looking at Fang Yuan: "Master Chu…."

"No worries." Fang Yuan smiled, secretly using wisdom path methods to soothe Xia Lin and the tortoise.

… The mournful cries paled Xia Lin's face, but Fang Yuan grew excited upon sensing the vast immortal formation ahead.

"I am nearly certain regret Gu is here! But will taking it disrupt Paradise Earth's arrangements and trigger his backup methods?" Fang Yuan wondered.

Yet for Fang Yuan, it was a crucial Gu worm he was determined to risk taking.

Focusing his mind, he activated investigative methods with full power, gradually clarifying the demon suppression regret crying formation in his mind.

This time, it was Fang Yuan who became pale.

"What a vast formation! Even with my attainment, deducing its profundities would take decades!"

Cold sweat beaded on Fang Yuan's forehead when his mind suddenly jolted: "Regret Gu!"

"How do I take regret Gu? Moving rashly and triggering the formation's backlash would end disastrously!"

Releasing the demon would plunge this small world's inhabitants into extreme misery, but Fang Yuan felt neither pity nor hesitation.

Just as Fang Yuan was thinking, a change occurred.

The large formation suddenly activated, regret Gu shot out directly towards Fang Yuan.

Simultaneously, a boundless force emerged and bore down upon Fang Yuan.

"What happened?!" In the next instant, Fang Yuan vanished, ejected from Paradise Earth's grotto-heaven.

# Chapter 1675: Birth of Red Lotus

Dark clouds covered the sky and heavy rain was pouring down.

Inside Central Continent's Maple Leaf City manor, the City Lord paced anxiously outside a room.

Amid the torrential storm and thunder, his wife's pained groans mingled with the midwives' urging: "Madam, push, push harder!"

Fifty years old and devoted to his wife, the Maple Leaf City Lord was a rank five Gu Master whose only regret was being childless.

"Wa! Wawa…." Suddenly, he heard an infant's cry.

The midwives laughed joyously: "The child is born, it's a boy! Madam, you did it!!"

"I... I have a son!" Stunned, then ecstatic, the Maple Leaf City Lord impatiently pushed open the door and charged in.

Just then, a peculiar fragrance filled the room.

Gentle and refreshing, the fragrance thickened into streams of colorful light that floated through the air, blanketing the manor and surrounding hundreds of li.

The rainstorm stopped abruptly as dark clouds dissipated. Sunlight pierced through the clouds, its grandest beam illuminating the delivery room of the City Lord's wife.

The flowing lights condensed into a manor-sized red lotus that hovered vividly in the air, lingering for a long time.

"Born with a natural phenomenon!" The Maple Leaf City Lord was astounded, while his wife and midwives froze in shock.

Meanwhile, three rank eight Gu Immortals stood upon clouds in the sky, watching Maple Leaf City's manor and the newborn's phenomenon.

"He is finally born," sighed Duke Mei, the benevolent-looking Gu Immortal in the middle, whose peculiar dark brown brows hung like roots from his forehead to his chest.

"This child is truly extraordinary, blessed with humanity's destined luck so dense it formed a visible red lotus! He is undeniably an Immortal Venerable seed! It was worth it that our Heavenly Court used three wisdom path Gu Immortals to deduce him." Standing on the left, Gu Immortal Duke Tong sighed.

Duke Mei nodded: "All past Immortal and Demon Venerables shared the destined luck of humanity, though in some cases that luck was initially concealed. If nurtured properly, he will definitely become the most talented and outstanding among the venerables!"

Suddenly, Duke Mei shuddered and coughed up a mouthful of blood.

"Duke Mei." Duke Tong frowned: "We suffered heavy injuries blocking those tribulations."

"Duke Mei!" The purple-haired young Gu Immortal on the right looked concerned, dragon-shaped qi swirling around his body.

Duke Mei told him: "Duke Long, fate Gu revealed your deep affinity with this child. He will become a venerable, and you are his Dao Guardian! Go take him as your disciple, guide and nurture him. You will shape his achievements as he will shape yours; together, you are destined to shine in humanity's history for all eternity!"

"Yes, I shall go now." Young Duke Long nodded.

"Go." Duke Tong frowned. "Duke Mei and I must hibernate to recuperate. Duke Long, you will lead Heavenly Court to bring prosperity to this world."

"I will!" Restraining his excitement, Duke Long slowly descended.

The Maple Leaf City Lord and his guards knelt on the ground, many trembling like leaves.

Hong Zhu forced himself to calm down and bowed: "I, Hong Zhu, pay respects to lord immortal. What brings lord immortal to the mortal realm?"

Duke Long smiled: "Hong Zhu, your son is a blessed genius born once in a million years. If nurtured well, he will achieve greatness beyond measure. Yet without proper guidance, he could bring immense chaos to the world. Seeing his rare talent and for humanity's sake, I have come to take him as my disciple. I will raise and guide him into a righteous path leader who seeks prosperity for all humanity."

Sensing Hong Zhu's thoughts, Duke Long consoled him: "Rest assured, I will not take him yet. I shall only return to teach him when he turns ten."

Overwhelmed with excitement, Hong Zhu repeatedly expressed his gratitude.

The door opened as the City Lord's wife emerged with the newborn and three midwives, kneeling to pay respects to Duke Long.

Drawn to the baby, Duke Long laughed joyfully and stepped directly before the City Lord's wife.

The hovering red lotus descended, shrinking until it settled on the baby's forehead as a nine-petaled red lotus birthmark.

A trace of shock flashed in Duke Long's eyes: "Destined luck imprinting as a birthmark is unprecedented among past venerables. My disciple will surely be unique!"

The lightweight infant suddenly felt as heavy as a mountain to Duke Long, filling him with a profound sense of responsibility.

"No need to kneel, please rise." After inspecting the child a moment longer, Duke Long solemnly returned him to the mother.

Duke Long said: "Parents and master play distinct roles. Love each other deeply and shower him with care so he feels warmth in this world; it will greatly aid his growth. Ten years later, I will come again."

Duke Long slowly rose into the sky amid surging air currents and incessant dragon roars.

# Chapter 1676: What is Fate?

Six years passed since Hong Ting's birth.

Over these six years, Maple Leaf City flourished without calamities, expanding tenfold to become the surrounding plains' premier human city.

Ever since Duke Long accepted him, immortal phenomena frequently occurred around Hong Ting.

Duke Long had publicized his discipleship openly. Central Continent's righteous, demonic, and lone immortals alike paid close attention to Hong Ting's upbringing.

As Heavenly Court's future Immortal Venerable, Hong Ting's identity was no secret. Gu Immortals and their descendants frequently bestowed subtle benefits to forge early goodwill with him.

Having absorbed the knowledge, Hong Ting frowned: "There are eighteen exquisite weapon methods, yet not a single advanced aperture awakening technique. Father, when can I awaken my aperture and control Gu worms? No matter how excellent these fighting techniques are, they are only mortal techniques. Controlling Gu worms is the only true way."

Time passed, years passed in an instant.

Duke Long returned to formally accept Hong Ting, guiding him as they roamed the world together.

At age twelve, Duke Long awakened his aperture. Armed with peerless talent and a solid foundation, Hong Ting's cultivation progressed with shocking speed.

Returning from a hunt, Hong Ting excitedly reported: "Master, the evil Xue Tu Dao who slaughtered that village is hiding on a nearby mountain!"

Dropping his prey, Hong Ting gritted his teeth: "For over a year I've wanted to kill Xue Tu Dao, but you repeatedly forbade me. Master, if we let such an evil person run amok, who knows how many more innocent lives would be lost. Let me strike now!"

Setting down his ladle beside the simmering broth, Duke Long sighed: "Disciple, the opportunity has not arrived."

"I only know that hesitating will cost us this chance!" Hong Ting insisted firmly.

Duke Long shook his head: "It is not his time to die. Forcing the matter will not only fail, but invite tragedy."

"I don't believe it! I only need one move to take his life!" Hong Ting raised a finger, staring into Duke Long's eyes.

Duke Long paused briefly: "Then go, young man, give it a try."

"Thank you master!" Hong Ting was exulted.

Yet fifteen, thirty, then forty-five minutes passed, and Hong Ting still had not returned.

Knowing the time had come, Duke Long left the cave and crossed the forest to reach Hong Ting.

Hong Ting knelt on the ground, his face stricken with shock, fury, and deep regret.

"Master, I never imagined a Gu Immortal inheritance was here, or that Xue Tu Dao came to claim it. After I destroyed his plan, he used the inheritance's power to stop me and although I fought with all my strength, I did not think the battle would cause the mountain to crumble, unexpectedly, unexpectedly… the small village was completely buried. Master! It was me—I killed those villagers!" Hong Ting sobbed.

Without consoling him, Duke Long fell silent before saying: "Disciple, do you wish to eliminate Xue Tu Dao? The opportunity has arrived."

Hong Ting immediately hurried off and easily killed Xue Tu Dao.

"I was so close to absorbing the true inheritance! If only I had time, I could have become a Gu Immortal!" Xue Tu Dao lamented with his dying breath.

Eventually, Hong Ting looked away from the corpse and rasped: "Master, had I listened to you, would I have killed him without harming those villagers?"

Duke Long did not reply, only softly patting Hong Ting's shoulder.

Hong Ting shuddered, lapsing into silence before asking: "Master, what is... fate?"

# Chapter 1677: I Regret It

"Fate..." Duke Long sighed with a complex expression.

"Ants transporting food, bees collecting honey, wind blowing, clouds drifting—everything in this world walks its own path according to the Great Dao's rules."

"The sun rises and sets; whether an Immortal Venerable or Demon Venerable, all die in the end."

"Everything is fate."

"In your haste to kill Xue Tu Dao, you missed his value. Since heaven and earth allowed his existence, his life had purpose. This is fate. Fate already has arrangements for everything; we can only vaguely sense them, not see them clearly."

"Your parents' marriage was fate's arrangement; their greatest purpose was bringing you into this world."

"Your ascension as an Immortal Venerable is also fate's arrangement. You must accept it, lead Heavenly Court, and dedicate your life to righteousness."

"And my greatest purpose in life is guiding you to the proper path. I am your… Dao Guardian."

"Believe in fate and accept it; all its arrangements have purpose. Forcible interference only leads to tragedy and regret."

Hong Ting was dazed, he was motionless like a statue.

Tears streamed from his eyes as he choked, "Master, I was wrong."

"It is good to recognize and correct your mistakes. In truth, your error was also fate's arrangement," Duke Long said.

"Master, what do you mean?"

Duke Long looked deeply at Hong Ting. "You are talented and intelligent, my disciple, but you are too sentimental. At rank five cultivation, will you choose wisdom path for immortal ascension?"

"Master's vision is unparalleled. I indeed thought wisdom path suited me best," Hong Ting admitted.

Duke Long shook his head. "Wisdom path focuses on emotion. Since you are sentimental, studying emotion brings harm. Choose time path. When you observe history's rise and fall across past and present, you will understand all romance is washed away by time. Fate Gu has revealed that time path suits you best."

Hong Ting hesitated, then nodded. "Disciple shall follow master's teachings and choose time path."

Duke Long nodded in satisfaction. "Good. As your Dao Guardian, guiding you to the right path gives my existence meaning."

Time slowly moved forward.

Hong Ting chose time path and, under Duke Long's protection, successfully passed his tribulation to become a time path Gu Immortal.

…

"Lord Immortal Hong Ting, that demonic Gu Immortal vows to slaughter our city unless I give him my daughter! For your friendship with my father, please eliminate this demon!" An old city lord knelt and pleaded.

"Old senior, please rise. I will certainly help, but…" Hong Ting paused. "The opportunity has not arrived."

Hong Ting waited until the right moment to kill the demonic Gu Immortal.

Yet the old city lord knelt among the ruins and corpses, weeping, "The accursed demon is finally dead! My daughter, my people, rest in peace—your hatred is avenged!"

…

"Disciple pays respects to master. What has master summoned me for?" Hong Ting asked Duke Long.

"Disciple, fate reveals that Floating Flower River is flooding after its channel diverged. Go save the people, but remember: do not intervene until three days and three nights have passed," Duke Long instructed.

"Yes, master."

Arriving at the riverbank, Hong Ting saw the flood waters displacing countless lives, with drowned corpses floating on the surface.

Forcibly restraining his emotions, he waited three days and nights, only to find the flood receding on its own into swamps without requiring his intervention.

The aura of a wild Immortal Gu emerged nearby.

Hong Ting easily subdued it: "A rank seven time path Immortal Gu—perfect for me."

Concealing himself, Hong Ting waited as two ancient desolate beasts fought. Once one died and the other was injured, he stepped in and claimed both corpses.

"Wonderful, wonderful." Surveying the battlefield, Hong Ting suddenly came to a realization.

"So this was fate's arrangement. The beasts' battle widened Floating Flower River several times over, while their blood thickened the riverbed. It will likely never flood again."

…

"Bull-headed Demon Brute, release my parents, or I will make you suffer a fate worse than death!" Hong Ting glared furiously at the demonic immortal.

"What do you want?!" Hong Ting shouted.

Bull-headed Demon Brute smiled malevolently. "Now we're talking. Hand over my lifespan Gu and I will return your parents. Otherwise, with only days to live, I'll die together with them."

By fate's arrangement, those lifespan Gu belonged to Bull-headed Demon Brute. But seeing his parents dying, Hong Ting had seized them secretly, inadvertently bringing this disaster upon them.

Though he eventually forced Bull-headed Demon Brute to retreat, his parents sustained irreparable injuries beyond the power of immortal methods.

"Father, mother, I harmed you! Had I not taken lifespan Gu for you, you would still have several years left!" Hong Ting wept on his knees.

Hong Zhu smiled. "Son, life and death are fated. All mortals die eventually. Can anyone live forever? No! We are fated to die; do not grieve for us. Rather, be happy. To have a son like you, a future Immortal Venerable, is our greatest honor. History will remember us because of you."

Madam Hong added, "Listen to your father, my son. Be righteous and upright."

The old couple clasped hands and died together.

"Father, mother—!" Hong Ting howled towards the sky.

Under the setting sun, he first laid eyes on Liu Shu Xian.

Liu Shu Xian revealed a strange expression, asking softly: "Who are you?"

Unsurprised, Hong Ting smiled. "I am your fated husband, Hong Ting."

Liu Shu Xian accompanied Hong Ting all the way to rank eight, rank eight peak, and finally to rank nine venerable realm!

Despite an unimaginable tribulation, Hong Ting ultimately succeeded.

Duke Long was heavily injured, several Heavenly Court Gu Immortals perished, and Hong Ting wept over Liu Shu Xian's freezing body.

Clutching her tightly, he pleaded, "Don't leave me, please live!"

"It's no use; the tribulation struck me. Retaining enough soul to look upon you one last time is already a great blessing," Liu Shu Xian smiled.

"No, Hong Ting. Only my extreme physique could have blocked that tribulation. Meeting you was all fate's arrangement. In your fatal moment, I understood my purpose: shielding you from tribulation so you could become an Immortal Venerable! Now… I have accomplished it."

"No! Xian Er, I'd rather forsake becoming an Immortal Venerable! I only want you to live!" Hong Ting roared through trembling tears.

"Everyone and everything in this world has its fixed fate. Do not think like that, Hong Ting. You must live on. Your destiny is to become an Immortal Venerable, lead Heavenly Court, and spread righteous glory throughout the five regions… Do you know? I had always been wanting to see that scene, standing by your side and accompanying you as you bring fortune to the world with invincible might. Unfortunately, I won't be able to see it…"

Liu Shu Xian's life force gradually fell, until she died.

With his head bowed and back hunched like an old man, a heavy shadow shrouded Hong Ting's face.

In his immortal aperture, the remaining heaven and earth qi coalesced, refining a rank eight Immortal Gu shaped by his grief.

The Gu resembled a paper-white centipede, but with a hundred translucent feelers instead of legs, floating gently while stirring deep feelings of regret.

Rank eight regret Gu!

Coughing up blood, Duke Long struggled to his feet and walked to Hong Ting's side.

"Liu Shu Xian's death was worthy. Do not grieve, my disciple. This was fate's arrangement. You are now an Immortal Venerable. Your mission has just begun. I will abdicate; Heavenly Court, the five regions, and the two heavens need you. Hong Ting? Hong Ting?" Duke Long called softly.

Hong Ting raised his head slowly, keeping his eyes on Liu Shu Xian's icy corpse rather than Duke Long.

He replied lightly: "I regret it."

# Chapter 1678: Immortal Venerable Regrets, But I Do Not!

"I said, I regret it." Hong Ting said again.

Duke Long glared sternly at his disciple. "Regret? Speak no such nonsense! Countless people sacrificed themselves to support you to this summit! Does saying this do justice to those who aided you, to your parents, to your late wife Liu Shu Xian, or to the immortals who sacrificed themselves to help you cross your tribulation?"

"Red Lotus Immortal Venerable… hehe." Hong Ting sneered. "If this throne demands such sacrifices, I would rather not have it!"

"Enough!" Duke Long raged. "No more nonsense! You think the venerable throne can be taken or discarded at will? This is fate's arrangement, your life's mission—you must accept it!"

Disheveled and miserable, Hong Ting laughed aloud, looking at Duke Long. "An invincible Immortal Venerable cannot even act as he pleases, cannot even reject this throne?"

Duke Long snorted coldly. "Who in this world can do as they please? Childish! Did you think leading the righteous path required no sacrifices? What in this world comes without a price? Maintaining Heavenly Court's righteous path requires sacrifice. If you lack that mentality, you have no qualifications to enter Heavenly Court!"

Hong Ting lowered his head, clenching his fists as he said with iron resolve, "I want to revive them."

Duke Long's brows raised, his face icy. "Who do you want to revive?"

"Everyone who sacrificed themselves for me—my parents, Liu Shu Xian, and many others."

"Presumptuous!" Duke Long shouted, pointing at Hong Ting. "How dare you harbor such heresy! I have told you repeatedly: life and death are governed by the Great Dao and arranged by fate. You want to revive the dead? Do you wish to plunge the entire world into chaos? Have you not learned that such defiance only breeds crueler tragedies around you?"

"Even if crueler tragedies come, I accept them! Why must we accept fate? Without fate, could the world not become better?" Hong Ting pressed.

Duke Long trembled with rage, while the Heavenly Court Gu Immortals stepped back, staring at Hong Ting as if at a stranger.

"All of you…" Looking at the surrounding Gu Immortals, Hong Ting felt an overwhelming loneliness.

Gazing at the endless River of Time, Red Lotus Demon Venerable sighed, "It is time to leave my inheritance."

"This first stone lotus island is the most important. Using regret Gu as its core, I leave it for the otherworldly demon holding greatest hope of destroying Fate!"

Here, Red Lotus Demon Venerable left rank eight regret Gu, abundant time path materials, killer moves, and his true meaning.

An outsider charged into this stone lotus island.

Red Lotus' true meaning condensed into an illusory image, smiling at the barefoot youth. "Welcome, honored guest."

"I am Paradise Earth, I finally found this place after immense effort."

Red Lotus' true meaning directly asked: "Immortal Venerable, what is the purpose for your visit?"

Pausing, Red Lotus' true meaning continued, "I can lend you regret Gu, but stealing my inheritor will depend on your ability."

Paradise Earth looked solemn. "Though an otherworldly demon, he is not unfeeling. Put down the blade and turn back—I will try!"

Red Lotus' true meaning laughed. "Alright. With you acting, there is no worry. Here is regret Gu—catch it."

"Truly regret Gu—it constantly radiates boundless sorrow. Only someone entirely free of regret can endure it, while any other Gu Immortal would suffer agony and despair!" Paradise Earth smiled bitterly. "Without rank nine cultivation, even I might not suppress it."

"It seems you too harbor regret," Red Lotus' true meaning sighed.

Storing regret Gu in his immortal aperture, Paradise Earth bowed solemnly. "I take my leave, and will ensure he is sent here."

… Fang Yuan slowly opened his eyes, the dazed expression slowly dissipated from his eyes.

"To think I would arrive directly at the stone lotus island. Though Red Lotus and Paradise Earth have perished, their arrangements endure."

Fang Yuan sighed, then looked at Red Lotus' true meaning and the rank eight regret Gu floating before him.

Red Lotus' true meaning smiled. "You are finally here, Fang Yuan. Knowing you will strive to destroy fate Gu, take my true inheritance—it has waited over a million years for you!"

Fang Yuan nodded, reaching out to grasp regret Gu.

Red Lotus' true meaning warned quickly, "Careful! Touching regret Gu directly will drown you in endless remorse even if refined! I prepared a method, you only need—"

"No need." Indifferently, Fang Yuan grabbed regret Gu and instantly refined it.

Red Lotus' true meaning was stunned: "You…"

# Chapter 1679: Red Lotus' True Inheritance

Standing at the edge of the stone island, Fang Yuan gazed calmly into the River of Time.

Several days had passed since Fang Yuan arrived at the stone island.

Having fully absorbed Red Lotus' true meaning, his time path attainment soared to an astonishing height: quasi-supreme grandmaster!

For instance, he could now fully grasp the essence of time cutting edge and adjust its Gu worms to restore its full might.

He could likewise modify Xia Cha's time path Immortal Gu and killer moves to suit himself.

With quasi-supreme grandmaster attainment in both time and refinement paths, he held immense confidence in modifying recipes and refining time path Immortal Gu.

Red Lotus' true meaning was undoubtedly the greatest treasure, followed by the rank eight Immortal Gu, Regret.

This brought Fang Yuan's rank eight Gu worms to five: Attitude, Wisdom Sword, Years Flow Like Water, Soul Beast Token, and Regret.

Fang Yuan could now construct Regret Pool with no obstacles.

With regret Gu and these materials, constructing Regret Pool was merely a matter of time—he could even create an Immortal Gu House superior to it.

This enabled mass Gu refinement, allowing him to produce more time path Immortal Gu and advance his existing Immortal Gu in rank.

Most vital was spring autumn success, which used supplementary Immortal Gu to guarantee a hundred percent success rate with Spring Autumn Cicada!

While spring autumn success still diminished luck, its failure rate dropped to zero.

This vastly increased Spring Autumn Cicada's utility, and Fang Yuan resolved to prepare it immediately.

Red Lotus Demon Venerable had also pre-activated one time path move whose rank nine might had faded to rank seven over a million years.

The name of this time path killer move — Future Self!

Relying on the River of Time and Red Lotus' stone island, the Gu Immortal user could temporarily borrow a future state of their life.

Unfortunately, this move had weakened to rank seven and was useless to Fang Yuan.

"My cultivation is already rank eight, I can only give this future self killer move to my subordinates."

Red Lotus' true inheritance was extremely plentiful, truly worthy of a Demon Venerable, but Fang Yuan was still slightly disappointed.

What he had most anticipated was a method or shortcut to destroy fate Gu.

However, Red Lotus Demon Venerable did not leave behind such things.

Fang Yuan had inquired before he consumed Red Lotus' true meaning.

Red Lotus' true meaning had replied: There was no shortcut to destroying fate Gu. Any supposed shortcut was almost certainly Heavenly Court's trap!

"He may not have wanted to point you toward a specific direction. Whether to destroy fate Gu is your own choice."

Fang Yuan asked: Where are the other Red Lotus stone islands?

Red Lotus' true meaning did not know.

To prevent Heavenly Court or Spectral Soul from seizing them, Red Lotus Demon Venerable constructed each island separately without mutual sensing.

"Fate Gu must be destroyed!"

If Heavenly Court restored fate Gu, everyone and everything else would be manipulated by it, making the entire world his enemy.

More importantly, fate Gu's existence was the greatest obstacle to Fang Yuan's pursuit of eternal life.

Thus, Fang Yuan had to destroy fate Gu no matter what.

Red Lotus Demon Venerable had likely deduced this, unconcerned about Fang Yuan's motivation.

# Chapter 1680: Advancing Immortal Gu

Inside the sovereign immortal aperture.

Mini Central Continent.

Fang Yuan's time path clone stood high in the sky, cautiously watching the Gu refinement to prevent accidents.

Just as the time path clone thought the time was right, countless lightning bolts fused into a single colossal pillar!

Resembling a heavenly pillar, the deep blue lightning struck a white boulder at the plain's center fiercely.

The hill-sized white boulder exploded, leaving a small Gu worm floating in the air.

Shaped like a multicolored butterfly, it was Man as Before Immortal Gu.

"Finally succeeded after six failures—not bad, not bad!" Fang Yuan's time path clone exulted.

The original Man as Before was only rank six, effective for healing rank six Gu Immortals, barely passable and prone to failure on rank seven, and completely abysmal on rank eight. Although his non-conflicting dao marks allowed effective use, a rank six Gu was far too weak for a rank eight.

But now, man as before Immortal Gu was successfully advanced from rank six to rank seven!

Although rank eight Man as Before suited him best, Fang Yuan was satisfied with rank seven for now.

Harboring no extravagant hopes of refining rank eight Immortal Gu, Fang Yuan intended to advance most of his rank six Gu to rank seven.

Given the sheer quantity and high failure rate, investing all his current resources would barely suffice.

Fang Yuan had gathered immense resources from the Five Xiangs, Qi clan, and Blue Dragon Whale grotto-heavens, as well as Red Lotus' stone island.

Fortunately, Fang Yuan used Regret Gu to construct a refinement path formation that allowed failed steps of the refinement process to be redone.

As the clone took the Gu, the refinement formation and Self Cleansing erased the leftover dao marks.

"Next is Landscape as Before." The time path clone thought.

Man as Before and Landscape as Before topped his refinement plan, but many more remained.

Unravel Mystery was also important; advancing it would greatly boost Unravel Dream, vastly benefiting Fang Yuan's dream path cultivation.

Advancing his luck path Immortal Gu would also provide immense help.

Advancing Immortal Gu was handled entirely by Fang Yuan's main body, as the time path clone lacked sufficient cultivation.

After obtaining the true inheritance, Fang Yuan remained on Red Lotus' stone island.

While Fang Yuan refined Gu, Bai Ning Bing, Hei Lou Lan, and the others sparred across the island, striving to adapt to future self.

Under future self, their battle strength rose to first-rate or peak rank seven.

With their strength elevated, awkward helplessness was avoided; they now met the minimum qualifications to participate in Fang Yuan's future battles.

Gu refinement occupied most of Fang Yuan's time, though he occasionally visited the Five Xiangs grotto-heaven to refine Heaven Form.

As the owner of Red Lotus' stone island, Fang Yuan could freely travel back and forth using Fixed Immortal Travel.

Although Spring Autumn Cicada had reached rank seven and expanded its detection range, Fang Yuan did not search for other Red Lotus stone islands.

First, his battle strength had not grown significantly, requiring time to digest his gains.

Second, Heavenly Court was searching the River of Time, forcing Fang Yuan to avoid encounters.

Finally, advancing Immortal Gu heavily consumed immortal essence, requiring time to replenish his rank eight reserves.

Time passed, several months went by quickly.

Southern Border.

The earth shook and rocks flew as an Earth Trench formed, radiating the vast aura of a wild Immortal Gu.

Heavenly Court.

Fairy Zi Wei's brows rose in joy upon hearing the report.

"Dragon Palace has been found! Lord Duke Long has searched for it all along, and now Heavenly Court has discovered it."

Upon receiving the news, Duke Long immediately brought Feng Jin Huang to Heavenly Court, entrusting her to Fairy Zi Wei.

Several days later, Duke Long returned without anything.

"Dragon Palace is surrounded by a dream realm; I cannot enter," Duke Long sighed.

Understanding immediately, Fairy Zi Wei consoled him: "Do not worry, Lord Duke Long. The formation is ready to draw upon Heavenly Court's entire strength to suppress Spectral Soul. We will soon extract his dream path research."

That research referred to the Pure Dream Reality Seeker Physique. By condensing dream realms into physical bodies, Heavenly Court could easily clear the barrier surrounding Dragon Palace.

"That demon Fang Yuan has made no move recently?" Duke Long asked.

Fairy Zi Wei shook her head: "Since escaping the River of Time, he has vanished. Earth vein tremors are churning out countless resources across all five regions, especially in Southern Border. I hoped he would expose himself contesting these resources, but wisdom path deductions have yielded no trace of him."

Duke Long nodded: "Keep monitoring him. Even at rank eight, he must face far stronger calamities and tribulations, which will surely give him a headache. Though his sovereign body can annex apertures, he requires rank eight grotto-heavens to skip grand tribulations—not to mention the even more terrifying myriad tribulations!"

Fairy Zi Wei's heart palpitated at the mention of myriad tribulations. Smiling, she nodded: "Lord Duke Long is right. How many rank eight grotto-heavens exist for him to annex? His cultivation cannot advance much in the short term."

"When he undergoes tribulation, Heavenly Court will take his life!"

# Chapter 1681: Progress

Inside the sovereign immortal aperture.

Mini Central Continent.

Fang Yuan's time path clone flew slowly through the air, planting the final flower bud.

He had modified the terrain into fertile marshland layered with rich silt, submerged beneath a knee-deep, clear river.

House-sized flower buds belonging to the desolate plant extreme marsh flower appeared every few kilometers.

Fang Yuan had obtained some extreme marsh flowers from the Blue Dragon Whale's aperture, purchasing the rest from treasure yellow heaven.

Taking in the view, Fang Yuan's time path clone inhaled deeply and activated Summer Gu.

Summer Gu, along with supplementary Gu worms, triggered an immortal killer move.

The killer move was modified from Summer Hoeing, tailored to cultivate extreme marsh flowers.

With world-peak quasi-supreme grandmaster time path attainment and the light of wisdom, modifying time path killer moves was simple for Fang Yuan.

At midsummer's peak, the vigorous extreme marsh flowers absorbed nutrients from the water and soil, visibly growing and slowly blooming.

Soon, white mist began rising slowly from the pistils of the extreme marsh flowers.

"Let's name this marshland flower mist extreme marsh. The first step is complete," the time path clone observed joyfully.

"Extreme marsh flower mist at this scale will easily feed Regret Gu."

Rank eight Regret Gu required vast quantities of fresh flower mist, making external purchases impractical.

"With these flowers, aperture development reaches eighteen percent. But having slowed time flow, immortal essence production has dropped."

Fang Yuan pondered inwardly.

"Though I must accumulate immortal essence, I cannot blindly accelerate time, or tribulations will arrive too quickly."

Though at rank eight, Fang Yuan's battle strength had not grown significantly. Having exposed most of his trump cards against Heavenly Court in the River of Time, undergoing tribulations now was ill-advised.

Undergoing tribulations would fix his location and alert heaven's will, allowing Heavenly Court to besiege him.

"Though time has slowed, managing the aperture strengthens its foundation and expands its origin core to produce more white litchi immortal essence."

Fang Yuan's aperture produced one hundred beads of white litchi immortal essence annually—roughly every half-month in outside time.

As Fang Yuan cultivated in seclusion, time passed, bringing summer to the five regions.

New Earth Trenches formed constantly, spreading from Southern Border across the other four regions.

Amid swirling dust, Hong Yi collapsed in exhaustion, panting with a pale face as he stared at the massive ravine before him.

"Since when do earthquakes happen here? That almost killed me!" Hong Yi panted, looking into the dark, windy ravine.

"Eh? What is that?" A wild Immortal Gu slowly flew out of the dust and smoke.

The injured wild Immortal Gu swayed unsteadily before collapsing in exhaustion at Hong Yi's feet.

Hong Yi was dumbfounded!

Heavenly Court.

As light flared, Heavenly Court trembled, pouring an immense formless force into the grand immortal formation.

The formation rumbled, grinding down on Spectral Soul imprisoned at its center.

Despite struggling with all his might, Spectral Soul's deepest memories were forcibly extracted.

"I have finally obtained the secrets of the Pure Dream Reality Seeker Physique, hahaha!" Though pale and haggard, Fairy Zi Wei beamed with excitement.

Within the Five Xiangs grotto-heaven, Fang Yuan's laughter suddenly echoed.

"I have finally mastered Heaven Form!" Beside him, the rank nine killer move manifested as an obedient white crane.

"Who would have thought Heaven Form's effect was this?"

"With this, my cultivation can progress rapidly and resolve my calamities and tribulations!"

# Chapter 1682: Searching for Grotto-Heavens

Immemorial white heaven.

An exquisite white crane circled Fang Yuan, letting out melodious cries.

"I can finally use this rank nine killer move!" Deeply moved, Fang Yuan said softly: "Go."

Flapping its wings, the white crane flew ahead and soon began circling a patch of sky, crying constantly.

Fang Yuan's lips curled as the white crane transmitted details showing the interior of the Five Xiangs grotto-heaven.

Rank nine killer move Heaven Form was not offensive or defensive, but investigative.

Any grotto-heaven in white heaven would be detected even with closed entrances, allowing the crane to gather internal intelligence.

Detection consumed no immortal essence, functioning like an innate ability inherited from Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable.

Those absorbing nine heavens fragments avoided tribulations but became tainted by heaven's will, preventing annexation—ruling out Five Xiangs and Hei Fan.

"There are definitely grotto-heavens which suit me." Fang Yuan was confident in this.

Southern Border.

Rumble!

"Do you think that's all?" Ba De looked down expressionlessly, brimming with anticipation: "Experts are emerging everywhere—didn't Western Desert just see the rise of Gong Wu Hua?"

"Hmph, don't underestimate the world's heroes. But once I reach rank eight, Gong Wu Hua will be no threat." Ba De said proudly.

The other Ba clan Gu Immortal was shocked and overjoyed: "Lord, you are finally advancing to rank eight?"

"With the Southern Alliance formed and endless resources emerging, the time is right for me to advance to rank eight."

"Naturally, there is one main reason." Ba De turned solemn: "An unprecedented great era is descending, and I refuse to be swallowed by its tides."

# Chapter 1683: Venerable Talent

Swoosh!

Heavenly Court.

# Chapter 1684: Profound Literature Grotto-heaven

Immemorial white heaven.

Fang Yuan was moving forward on an auspicious cloud.

He split his concentration between his sovereign immortal aperture and staying on guard.

"Only two rank six Immortal Gu remain; the rest have advanced to rank seven. Eh?"

Fang Yuan's body suddenly shook.

The auspicious cloud sped up, and before long, Fang Yuan spotted heaven form.

The crane-shaped killer move circled an ordinary patch of empty air.

"It discovered a grotto-heaven." Fang Yuan was joyous.

Through heaven form's detection, the grotto-heaven's internal scenery was transmitted into Fang Yuan's mind.

"So this is Profound Literature grotto-heaven... the aperture of a rank eight information path Gu Immortal. Oh? It has a massive population and a unique cultivation style!"

Normally, methods like Luo Po seal, spring scissors, winter coat, and five finger fist heart sword maintained his upper-tier rank eight battle strength.

Becoming an immemorial year monkey elevated his battle strength to peak rank eight.

The difference was because of his dao marks!

In contending for Red Lotus' inheritance, Fang Yuan tied; in Dragon Palace, he lost. Yet Heaven Form succeeded in locating Beast Calamity grotto-heaven.

Fang Yuan annexed Beast Calamity grotto-heaven, which had passed many tribulations and neared its second myriad tribulation.

And Fang Yuan himself already had nearly a hundred thousand transformation path dao marks! He originally had fifty thousand, but he killed many Heavenly Court rank seven experts in the River of Time, he annexed a lot of blessed lands and gained a lot of dao marks from various paths.

Thus, after annexing Beast Calamity grotto-heaven, his transformation path dao marks reached two hundred thousand!

Transforming into the immemorial year monkey converted these transformation path dao marks into time path dao marks.

Annexing Xia Cha's and the three Xunzi's apertures had already pushed his time path dao marks past a hundred thousand.

Combined, transforming into an immemorial year monkey granted Fang Yuan a total of three hundred thousand time path dao marks!

In time path dao marks alone, Fang Yuan reached pseudo-Immortal Venerable level. Combined with rank eight time path Immortal Gu and killer moves, his battle strength peaked at rank eight.

"But against Duke Long, it will still be difficult." Fang Yuan's gaze was deep.

Many things influenced battle strength: dao marks, Immortal Gu, immortal aperture foundation, and variety of methods.

Fang Yuan had sufficient dao marks and Immortal Gu, but his killer moves still lacked variety.

Duke Long, as seen in his fight against Purple Mountain True Monarch, possessed at least three hundred thousand transformation and qi path dao marks.

Duke Long's immortal killer moves were numerous and profound, especially the undefendable divine technique triple qi retraction.

Because of all these elements, Duke Long had pseudo-Immortal Venerable battle strength!

"The human path killer move people's accusation is growing stronger. Even with little human path attainment, I see the situation worsening."

"Emperor yama cannot resolve people's accusation. The longer I remain in Central Continent, the stronger it becomes."

Fang Yuan made up his mind: "Troops are raised for battle; it is time to unleash them!"

"Bai Ning Bing and the others will wreak havoc while I lay low. This great battle has only begun!" Cold light gleamed in Fang Yuan's eyes.

# Chapter 1704: Chaos in Central Continent

Central Continent.

But days later, more chaos ensued.

But looting resource points while avoiding direct conflict with Heavenly Court was a temptation few could resist.

Fang Yuan changed his tactic and gained great results immediately.

Immortals from the four regions and local demonic cultivators swarmed in to loot resources.

Duke Long sighed deeply: "People's hearts are no longer what they were."

Even so, Duke Long did not waver, pushing forward with the Refinement Path Convention.

Duke Long stood firm, but Fang Yuan refused to act before the other regions entered.

Thus, Fang Yuan continued to wait silently.

# Chapter 1705: People's United Hearts

Central Continent, earth qi rock forest.

Central Continent, spirit bank spring.

A Gu Immortal walked out.

A hunched old man slowly walked out, leaning on a cane.

Yang Feng snorted: "Old man, you should treasure your remaining days. Why court death now?"

"Forgotten Daoist?!" Yang Feng shook in shock.

Then, looking dazed, he asked: "Wait, what was your name?"

Dazed, Yang Feng frowned at the old Gu Immortal: "Who are you? Why are you here?"

After Forgotten Daoist took the spirit bank spring water, Yang Feng watched him leave before reacting: "Who are you? You're suspicious, halt!"

Looking at the dried spring, Yang Feng fumed: "Who stole the spirit bank spring water?!"

Central Continent, within a mountain range.

"Scram, loser." Xiao Hu Chi laughed coldly, glancing aside with a chilly gaze.

Beside him was a Northern Plains Gu Immortal.

He was Northern Plains' demonic path rank seven Gu Immortal — Pi Shui Han.

Not long ago, they had collaborated to chase away the defending Central Continent Gu Immortal for this resource.

Pi Shui Han snorted coldly, replying without hesitation: "You scram too."

"You talk too much crap." Showing disdain, Pi Shui Han directly attacked Xiao Hu Chi.

Xiao Hu Chi's expression sank, but he fearlessly clashed with Pi Shui Han.

As they fought over ten rounds, Xiao Hu Chi slowly lost ground, but Xiao Shi Rang appeared on the horizon.

Overjoyed, Xiao Hu Chi teamed up with Xiao Shi Rang against Pi Shui Han.

Yet before long, Xiao Shi Rang and Xiao Hu Chi were forced to retreat furiously.

"If I'm not mistaken, he's Northern Plains demonic Gu Immortal Pi Shui Han," Xiao Shi Rang said plainly.

Xiao Hu Chi was dazed: "A Northern Plains brute! No wonder... Central Continent has plenty of resources, no need to compete with maniacs."

Several days later.

Heavenly Court.

"Oh? Then use it, Zheng Yuan," Duke Long said plainly.

Old Man Zheng Yuan nodded, shakily rising as a vast, majestic aura surged from him!

Immortal killer move — People's United Hearts!

The accumulated human will rapidly depleted, leaving almost nothing.

Simultaneously, all of Central Continent's people were enveloped in light.

But Central Continent's people soon found something special.

"I seem connected to those around me—I can sense their emotions directly?!"

People's United Hearts linked everyone together, sharing their emotions.

Central Continent had never been so tightly united in history.

"Who are you? Why harbor such hostility toward us?!" At a competition venue, a Northern Plains Gu Immortal was abruptly exposed.

Like a torch in the dark, his unconcealable feelings exposed him to everyone.

It was Northern Plains' rank seven demonic Gu Immortal, Unfettered Scholar!

"What an amazing human path killer move! Even concealed, I was exposed!" Suppressing his shock, Unfettered Scholar smiled viciously at the crowd.

"You exterminated my clan!" Unfettered Scholar unleashed his signature killer move—Thousand Disintegrations.

An hour later, an injured Unfettered Scholar flew off, laughing and weeping tears of joy.

Nobody in the competition ground was left alive.

People's United Hearts proved profound, enabling Central Continent to identify every intruder.

With hidden unstable elements eliminated, Central Continent's internal threats were cleared.

With Duke Long pressing ahead with his strategy, the Refinement Path Convention finals finally commenced.

"This is the final chance, why isn't anyone acting? What are they waiting for!" Fang Yuan gritted his teeth, watching Heavenly Court draw closer to success.

But Longevity Heaven did not respond.

"It's time, let's move!" In a corner of Central Continent, Wu Yong suddenly appeared.

Behind him were many Southern Alliance Gu Immortals.

Wu Yong declared: "We cannot let fate Gu be restored, or Heavenly Court will be insurmountable!"

"Follow me to destroy Infallible blessed land, seize the success dao marks, and make Heavenly Court taste defeat!"
