# Chapter 1712: Battle of Legendary Desolate Beasts

Past the destroyed Sun Palace lay Five Deity Hall, followed by Central Great Hall where Duke Long and Fairy Zi Wei waited.

"They must be stopped." Duke Long turned to Fairy Zi Wei: "Have you deployed them all?"

Fairy Zi Wei's expression was quite ugly: "Only two came."

Duke Long said: "Cang Xuan Zi has an agreement with Genesis Lotus; let it be. The other two will still stall them."

With Five Deity Hall in sight, a brewing sandstorm blocked Calamity Luck Altar behind surging sand waves.

The sand parted, revealing a tiger as massive as a hill.

Radiating an overwhelming aura, the tiger had golden skin, silver teeth, ruby eyes, and the character 'Sha' marked upon its forehead.

Five Elements Grandmaster gasped in shock: "Heavenly Court possesses legendary immemorial desolate beasts too?"

"Of course." Bing Sai Chuan replied plainly: "Heavenly Court possesses three legendary immemorial beasts. This tiger is actually a Shabi, a beast formed within fiendish qi sea springs. With qi path and fiendish qi sea springs now extinct, this is the sole surviving Shabi."

Behind them, Shabi Ninety-five whipped up a tempest, battling 'Calamity Luck Altar' with peak rank eight strength amidst massive commotion!

Bing Sai Chuan analyzed: "Heavenly Court deployed Shabi Ninety-five, and green jade crane Ruan Dan will likely arrive as well."

Five Elements Grandmaster asked: "Ruan Dan, Cang Xuan Zi, are they the remaining two legendary immemorial beasts?"

Bing Sai Chuan answered: "Indeed. Ruan Dan is an immemorial green jade crane nurtured by Immortal Crane Sect that founded pill path and cultivates in Heavenly Court. Cang Xuan Zi is that vast heaven vine. Thus, this vast heaven vine is also known as the tenth heaven of this world!"

At the moment, in the Central Great Hall.

"Oh no!" Fairy Zi Wei frowned: "This Calamity Luck Altar is fake."

"What?" Duke Long looked over.

With Heaven Overseeing Tower immobile, Fairy Zi Wei mobilized the other Immortal Gu Houses, firing a crystal rainbow light.

The rainbow light tore across the sky, striking 'Calamity Luck Altar'.

"Calamity Luck Altar' shook before it returned to its original form."

Resembling a ferret covered in glossy purple fur, it had eyes shining like purple crystals and a dog tail.

"You finally realized, Heavenly Court fools! Hahaha…" The purple ferret laughed mockingly.

"You are… Giant Sun Immortal Venerable's dog tail life extending ferret, Mao Li Qiu?!" Shocked, Shabi Ninety-five spoke human words.

The purple ferret's expression sank as it shot out like purple lightning.

Sand splattered as the dog tail life extending ferret pinned Shabi down, snarling fiercely: "Remember, call me Grandpa Mao!"

Furious, Shabi Ninety-five growled: "In terms of age, I am your grandfather instead!"

"Hahaha, stupid cat and silly ferret, you two make a good couple! What an interesting fight." Laughter resounded above the two beasts.

Mao Li Qiu sneered: "Oh, the green jade crane! Come down, let Grandpa Mao teach you how to be a proper bird!"

The laughter stopped as the green jade crane snapped furiously: "Insolent ferret, I'll tear your skin apart!"

The green jade crane turned to head for Five Deity Hall under Fairy Zi Wei's orders, but a shadow loomed above.

Mao Li Qiu had leaped into the sky, its massive form crashing down and creating a vacuum.

Shrieking, the green jade crane resumed its true form and flapped its wings, swiftly evading the shadow.

Yet in the next moment, Mao Li Qiu's claws grabbed the crane's leg.

"Come down here for your Grandpa Mao!" The dog tail life extending ferret snickered, yanking with its powerful limb.

Slam, the green jade crane landed on the ground, causing a huge pit to form.

The green jade crane screeched desperately: "Stupid cat, what are you doing? Come help me!"

"Hahaha, weren't you enjoying the show earlier? Have fun playing, I'm leaving!" Shabi Ninety-five laughed, flying toward Five Deity Hall.

"Where are you going?" Mao Li Qiu snickered as a clone shot from its body, swiftly pouncing toward Shabi Ninety-five.

Struggling beneath Mao Li Qiu, Shabi Ninety-five bared its teeth furiously: "A mere clone wants to obstruct me? You look down on—hmm?"

Shabi Ninety-five grew fearful: "How can a mere clone possess such immense strength?"

Mao Li Qiu's interference bought crucial time for Calamity Luck Altar to reach Five Deity Hall.

"I have explained Five Deity Hall's details; it's up to you now," Bing Sai Chuan told Five Elements Grandmaster.

Five Elements Grandmaster looked behind worriedly: "Can Grandpa Mao do it? How long can it last?"

"Don't worry, he is using Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable's perfect pair, summoning a clone equal to his main body," Bing Sai Chuan said.

Five Deity Hall shook as a giant five elements spirit formed and attacked Calamity Luck Altar.

Calamity Luck Altar burst with profound light, sending Five Elements Grandmaster directly into Five Deity Hall.

Enraged, the five elements giant spirit moved to defend, but Calamity Luck Altar restrained it with an immense attractive force.

# Chapter 1713: Battle Between Venerables

Amidst a chain of explosions and raging fire, Five Deity Hall was blown to smithereens.

Five Elements Grandmaster walked out on thin air, unharmed despite the soot on his face.

Next, he went inside Calamity Luck Altar.

Five Elements Grandmaster laughed: "Five Deity Hall was extraordinary, but my methods countered it directly!"

Bing Sai Chuan looked at him calmly: "Naturally. The formation path methods you use are part of Ancestor Giant Sun's arrangements."

Stunned, Five Elements Grandmaster looked at Bing Sai Chuan, his expression changing: "What do you mean?"

Bing Sai Chuan smiled: "Remember the nonsensical core text of your inheritance? Try reading the last word of each sentence in reverse."

"Hmm? Obey Bing Sai Chuan and attack Heavenly Court?!" Five Elements Grandmaster stared at him in speechless disbelief.

Bing Sai Chuan spoke slowly: "A rank nine venerable's profound comprehension makes arranging future generations effortless."

"Back then, after visiting Heavenly Court, Ancestor Giant Sun planned today's invasion. The method to destroy Five Deity Hall was one of his arrangements."

"Ancestor Giant Sun secretly left the method with a lone cultivator outside Longevity Heaven. Since you lack Giant Sun bloodline, Heavenly Court never suspected you would counter Five Deity Hall!"

Saying so, Bing Sai Chuan paused and continued: "Grandmaster, the climatic battle involving fate Gu is far more complex than you can ever imagine. Rank six and seven Gu Immortals are not even qualified to join. As for rank eight Gu Immortals, we are merely pawns. Some rank eights refuse to join because they sensed something and understand their worth; others joined, ignorant of the truth."

"The truth behind this great battle is the fight of past venerables across time and space!"

"Later venerables held an advantage in arranging plans against predecessors; that is why our invasion has succeeded thus far."

Bing Sai Chuan chuckled: "Can Duke Long match Ancestor Giant Sun? Longevity Heaven will definitely seize fate Gu!"

"Obtain fate Gu?" Five Elements Grandmaster finally realized Longevity Heaven's true objective in attacking Heavenly Court.

"That's right," Bing Sai Chuan admitted openly, no longer hiding anything. "Heavenly Court tried to snatch our fortune rivalling heaven Gu, so why can't we take their fate Gu?"

"Why is Heavenly Court humanity's number one force? Fate Gu played a crucial role. Once we claim it, Longevity Heaven will take that throne!"

In Central Great Hall.

Watching Calamity Luck Altar approach, Fairy Zi Wei said grimly: "They are coming!"

"How long until fate Gu is fully restored?" Duke Long asked.

In charge of the formation, Fairy Zi Wei answered heavily: "Six hours."

"Six hours is enough to see fate Gu restored," Duke Long said. "Leave the rest to me."

Fairy Zi Wei asked worriedly: "Lord Duke Long, your injuries…"

Duke Long smiled: "With my killer move heavenly dragon's last stand, who across the five regions can match me?"

Like a massive beast, Calamity Luck Altar charged down toward the Central Great Hall.

At this moment, a single small body appeared, blocking its path.

"Duke Long!" Five Elements Grandmaster shouted.

"Smash into him." Bull Demon said.

The hill-like Calamity Luck Altar crashed down ferociously, but halted in midair.

Floating in midair, Duke Long gripped Calamity Luck Altar with his transformed dragon claw, halting its advance.

As his dragon claws dug into Calamity Luck Altar, cracks formed and spread outward.

Calamity Luck Altar blazed with piercing light, unleashing immortal killer moves point-blank against Duke Long.

Bathed in explosions and impacts, Duke Long remained unmoved.

The qi condensed into dragons that coiled around Calamity Luck Altar, constricting it.

Five Elements Grandmaster looked for Bing Sai Chuan, but he had already vanished.

At the next moment, Bing Sai Chuan appeared behind Duke Long.

His long-prepared time path killer move struck Duke Long's head.

Duke Long did not budge as a vast wave of dragon qi erupted.

A dragon maw clamped onto Bing Sai Chuan and surged upward, restraining him in midair.

"You are clearly injured… this definitely isn't your normal battle strength!" Bing Sai Chuan gritted his teeth.

"How could you comprehend the profundity of my killer move, heavenly dragon's last stand?" Duke Long glanced at him coldly before refocusing on Calamity Luck Altar.

Constricted by endless dragon qi, Calamity Luck Altar shed countless Gu worms under immense pressure.

Bing Sai Chuan suddenly snickered: "I am not your match, but so what? I have my trump card! I respectfully request — Limitless, please turn around!"

"What?!" This time, Duke Long was shocked.

# Chapter 1714: Limitless Takes Action

A million years ago!

Limitless Demon Venerable attacked Heavenly Court and moved unhindered; Heavenly Court's Gu Immortals were powerless to stop him.

Central Heaven Gate shattered, and before Limitless Demon Venerable, the subsequent palaces proved paper-thin.

At Central Great Hall, Star Constellation's will descended, activating her arrangement—the nine-nine consecutive unceasing formation.

Trapped within the formation, Limitless Demon Venerable escaped only after destroying a hundred formations.

Below Heaven Overseeing Tower.

Limitless Demon Venerable looked at Star Constellation's will: "You spent so much effort to restrict me—I admire you. But you are dead while I live. Stopping a living Gu Venerable is impossible; rank nine venerables are invincible."

Star Constellation's will smiled bitterly, opening a path to Heaven Overseeing Tower: "I understand what you mean, but how could I give up without trying? Please enter."

Ascending Heaven Overseeing Tower alongside Star Constellation's will, Limitless saw fate Gu.

Not long after, Limitless Demon Venerable left the tower, walking out.

Astonishing Heavenly Court's immortals, Limitless Demon Venerable left fate Gu intact, none knowing what the two had discussed.

Limitless sneered: "Primordial Origin and Star Constellation, surely you left more methods. Unleash them all; I want to see them."

"Forgotten Dao Lake? The name fits; it is a fine lake. It would be a pity to destroy it." Limitless Demon Venerable grew animated: "Forgotten Dao, Forgotten Dao… but who can truly forget their Dao?"

After a silence, Star Constellation's will suggested: "Since you've already come to Heavenly Court, why not look around?"

Limitless Demon Venerable gave her a meaningful look: "Aren't you afraid I will destroy Heavenly Court?"

Star Constellation's will replied calmly: "You cannot destroy Heavenly Court, nor can you destroy fate Gu."

Star Constellation's will added: "The true Heavenly Court lies in our hearts; future generations will rebuild it."

A long while later, Limitless Demon Venerable nodded: "As expected of Star Constellation, you are absolutely right."

Ascending Star Zone Mountain, Limitless Demon Venerable saw a pavilion at the peak.

Inside the pavilion, Limitless Demon Venerable looked down upon Heavenly Court's grand vista.

Inhaling deeply, Limitless Demon Venerable felt refreshed: "A fine pavilion. What is its name?"

"Imperfection Regret Pavilion." Star Constellation's will answered.

"Failing my goal is a regret, but whose life is without imperfection or regrets?"

He clapped: "Star Constellation Immortal Venerable, truly impressive arrangements. My interest is piqued again."

Limitless looked at Star Constellation's will: "Neither of us can partake in the great era a million years from now. I have a suggestion."

"Please go ahead."

"Why not play a game of chess in this pavilion?"

"Chess?" Star Constellation's will was stunned: "Sure, both of us need this chessboard after all."

For the next few days, Limitless Demon Venerable stayed inside Imperfection Regret Pavilion, playing chess with Star Constellation's will.

When Limitless left, Star Constellation's will vanished, leaving Imperfection Regret Pavilion a forbidden ground.

These records flashed by Duke Long's mind in an instant.

"Giant Sun Immortal Venerable was very crafty; he must have noticed something back then. How can Bing Sai Chuan mobilize the power Limitless Demon Venerable left behind?"

He acutely sensed a profound aura surge from Bing Sai Chuan's body before vanishing without a trace.

Far away, at the peak of Star Zone Mountain.

Two silhouetted figures playing chess materialized in the empty Imperfection Regret Pavilion alongside their chessboard.

Star Constellation looked up at Limitless with a complex gaze: "The person you are waiting for is here?"

Limitless Demon Venerable sighed: "Not yet, but a successor from my homeland has inherited my inheritance. I must help him."

Saying so, he lifted a chess piece from the board and flicked it.

Throughout, Limitless Demon Venerable never glanced at the battlefield, much less turned around.

The chess piece flew out of Imperfection Regret Pavilion as the image of the venerables faded, leaving the pavilion empty once more.

Flying at shocking speed, the chess piece struck Duke Long almost instantly.

The next moment, Duke Long plummeted from the air, crashing onto the ground.

The chess piece materialized as silver-white chains that bound Duke Long, sealing his aperture and Gu worms.

With Duke Long forcibly restrained, his dragon qi dispersed, freeing Calamity Luck Altar and Bing Sai Chuan.

Bing Sai Chuan shouted and charged at Duke Long, but his strongest killer move was easily deflected by the silver chains.

Bing Sai Chuan's heart sank: "This rank nine move restricts Duke Long while protecting him—a battle between venerables!"

He leaped into Calamity Luck Altar, which immediately surged forward, smashing the Central Great Hall to rubble!

Fairy Zi Wei could only flee rapidly, taking Old Man Zheng Yuan with her.

# Chapter 1715: Heavenly Court Awakens

With the Central Great Hall reduced to rubble, a tall tower loomed before Calamity Luck Altar.

"Heaven Overseeing Tower!" Inside Calamity Luck Altar, Bing Sai Chuan's gaze burned.

Heaven Overseeing Tower stood motionless, enveloped in the bright light of a refinement path immortal formation.

"Fate Gu is atop Heaven Overseeing Tower, being repaired by the refinement path formation!" Bing Sai Chuan frowned.

"We cannot destroy this refinement formation directly, or the backlash might ruin fate Gu's recovery. We must enter and seize it!" Bing Sai Chuan ordered.

Bull Demon complied, while Five Elements Grandmaster hesitated: "Lord Bing Sai Chuan, what if we get a chance to seize fate Gu before it is fully repaired? What do we do?"

Bing Sai Chuan spoke plainly: "That is precisely what we want. Heavenly Court spent countless years repairing fate Gu until it is near complete recovery."

"A fully repaired fate Gu cannot be used by anyone. Even Heavenly Court can only utilize it through Heaven Overseeing Tower to observe the fate of all living beings. If someone could truly control fate Gu, they could dictate destiny and manipulate the lives of all beings. Sadly, though past venerables attempted it, none ever succeeded."

Five Elements Grandmaster was curious: "In that case, what is the point of snatching an incomplete fate Gu?"

"Heavenly Court has another method: using fate Gu as an immortal material to refine with a luck path Immortal Gu and create destiny Gu!"

Bing Sai Chuan continued: "Yet they don't know destiny Gu was first conceptualized by Ancestor Giant Sun. Heavenly Court is too ambitious, seeking to refine rank ten destiny Gu in one go. Unlike them, we only seek a rank nine destiny Gu, so the fate Gu we use does not need to be fully restored."

"With rank nine destiny Gu, Longevity Heaven can rival Heavenly Court. In the coming great era, we will replace them, reign over the five regions, and become supreme rulers of all beings!"

Five Elements Grandmaster hesitated no longer, flying toward the refinement formation alongside Bull Demon.

"They've entered the formation!" Old Man Zheng Yuan watched from afar, looking worried.

Fairy Zi Wei was unconcerned: "This refinement path formation was specially arranged, unlike the Refinement Cauldron formation earlier. Along with Yuan Qiong Du, two other rank eights are assisting the refinement."

Fairy Zi Wei thought rapidly: "Longevity Heaven is trying to snatch fate Gu, not destroy it. Only otherworldly demons can destroy fate Gu, and with Fang Yuan at Emperor City, we still have time."

Rather than joining the battle, Fairy Zi Wei moved to place Old Man Zheng Yuan under protection.

Old Man Zheng Yuan was only rank seven and unable to fight, but he was vital as the key to Primordial Origin Immortal Venerable's human path methods!

Calamity Luck Altar hovered midair, blocking the entrance to the refinement path formation.

Inside the formation space, Bull Demon and Five Elements Grandmaster were already battling Heavenly Court's two rank eights.

With a cry, Fairy Zi Wei rained countless thoughts like a meteor storm onto Calamity Luck Altar.

Amplified by Star Constellation Chessboard, even Calamity Luck Altar could not ignore this move.

Bing Sai Chuan healed his injuries while controlling Calamity Luck Altar to resist Fairy Zi Wei.

During this time, Fairy Zi Wei also wanted to save Duke Long.

Yet Duke Long was bound by Limitless Demon Venerable's silvery chains, which repelled Fairy Zi Wei and dispelled her killer moves.

"Damn it, damn it!" Duke Long gritted his teeth, struggling in vain.

Just as Fairy Zi Wei felt helpless, a corner of Heavenly Court shook violently as auras surged and expanded rapidly.

"That is… the immortal graveyard!" Fairy Zi Wei was overjoyed.

"You dare attack Heavenly Court? You are courting death!" With a booming shout, a muscular, bear-headed Gu Immortal leaped into the sky, glaring coldly at Calamity Luck Altar.

The next moment, Calamity Luck Altar crashed down like a toppling mountain, sent flying by a massive force.

A giant black bear, even larger than Calamity Luck Altar, now stood where it had been blocking.

Fairy Zi Wei's eyes brightened: "Senior Zhang Fei Xiong, Heavenly Court's transformation path expert skilled in bear transformations!"

"The juniors are so useless to let outsiders breach Heavenly Court so deeply. Hmm? Central Great Hall was destroyed?" another voice echoed.

Pale and gaunt in a wheelchair, the cold gleam in his eyes inspired dread.

As Calamity Luck Altar flew up again, Gu Liu Ru pointed a finger at it.

The rank eight Immortal Gu House's movement instantly slowed severalfold!

Laughing loudly, Zhang Fei Xiong pounced, crashing into Calamity Luck Altar and suppressing it.

"Who woke me up? Losing sleep will give me wrinkles! Little sister, don't you agree?" A beautiful figure appeared beside Fairy Zi Wei.

"Junior greets Senior Wan Zi Hong." Fairy Zi Wei bowed respectfully.

Zhang Fei Xiong, Gu Liu Ru, Wan Zi Hong… one by one, Heavenly Court's Gu Immortals woke up from the immortal graveyard.

"So many reinforcements at once? Are there more?" Inside Calamity Luck Altar, Bing Sai Chuan laughed loudly.

"Do you know why I brought Calamity Luck Altar? Because a former Demon Venerable's killer move is inside it." Bing Sai Chuan's gaze turned deep and unfathomable.

# Chapter 1716: Number One Battle Strength Among Legendary Immemorial Beasts

Hidden Dragon Cave battlefield.

The super immortal formation suppressing Di Zang Sheng had half-collapsed from Eastern Sea's assault, leaving only its central core active.

Outside the central area, Eastern Sea's rank eights completely surrounded this formation.

Just then, an earth-shattering dragon roar echoed from deep within the abyss.

Looking down into the abyss with concern, Shen Cong Sheng urged: "The half-destroyed formation can no longer suppress Di Zang Sheng. We must act now to avoid trouble."

Di Zang Sheng was a unique legendary immemorial desolate beast born from Central Continent's earth veins and fueled by endless hatred, anger, and grudges.

Bearing innate hatred and killing intent toward humans, it could never die unless its source was destroyed. Having once caused Heavenly Court great trouble, Eastern Sea's Gu Immortals had no desire to fight it pointlessly. Their goal was seizing Dragon Palace; if freed, Di Zang Sheng would only cause trouble for Heavenly Court.

"It is ready." Song Qi Yuan nodded.

Immortal killer move — Broken Mirror Shard Light.

The formation core's halo shattered like a mirror, exposing Old Man Bei Feng and Feng Chan Zi within.

"Quick, make use of the time!" Eastern Sea's rank eights attacked.

"Don't kill him, let me capture him alive." Shen Cong Sheng suddenly said.

The Eastern Sea immortals paused in surprise—could Shen Cong Sheng truly capture a rank eight alive?

Countless threads appeared around Old Man Bei Feng, wrapping him into a tight cocoon.

Shen Cong Sheng captured Old Man Bei Feng—a living rank eight was far more valuable than a corpse.

The other immortals started to look for Immortal Gu House Dragon Palace.

An Immortal Gu House appeared, hovering dozens of meters above Old Man Bei Feng.

With Dragon Palace revealed, Song Qi Yuan and the others moved to capture it.

Gradually, while trying to capture it, they realized a huge secret.

"Heavenly Court placed Immortal Gu House Dragon Palace here to tame Di Zang Sheng!"

"Di Zang Sheng is still a dragon and countered by Dragon Palace, making subduing it possible."

"Duke Long planned well indeed! As the five regions' earth veins merge, Di Zang Sheng's earth vein-derived power will surge at least fivefold!"

Already possessing peak rank eight battle strength, this boost might even elevate it to pseudo-Immortal Venerable level!

"No wonder Duke Long paid such a hefty price for Dragon Palace—he wanted a pseudo-Immortal Venerable combatant to suppress the situation."

"Right now, Dragon Palace is suppressing Di Zang Sheng, we need to wait a bit more."

Emperor City battlefield.

Immortal killer move — Great Thief Ghost Hand!

Fang Yuan activated it in succession, Heavenly Court's Immortal Gu Houses avoided them wherever the ghost hands went.

Great thief ghost hand could seize rank eight Immortal Gu even from within an immortal's grotto-heaven.

Heavenly Court's meticulously created Immortal Gu House defense line fell into complete disarray under Fang Yuan's disruption.

"Scoundrel Fang Yuan, accept your death!" Clad in verdant sun flame cloak, Li Huang pounced at Fang Yuan at the critical moment.

Seeing Li Huang approach, Fang Yuan advanced instead of retreating: "Li Huang, you finally showed up! I've been waiting for you!"

Transforming into the immemorial year monkey, Fang Yuan spat forward.

Instantly, spring scissors flew out, tearing through space toward Li Huang.

Inhaling deeply, the monkey drew out summer fan.

"What?!" Li Huang watched in shock as his cloak tore, its defense drastically weakened.

Struck by the blast, Li Huang was blown far away.

"How did his strength rise so drastically?" Li Huang looked grimly at his nearly extinguished flame cloak.

# Chapter 1717: Call of the Ancient

"Li Huang, don't tell me this is your full strength!" Fang Yuan roared, flashing across the battlefield in hot pursuit.

Li Huang retreated, repeatedly activating verdant sun flame cloak.

Spring scissors swirled around him, shredding every flame cloak on his back.

"Lord Li Huang, let us help you!" Wind Sweeping Building arrived to reinforce him.

Fang Yuan snickered with disdain: "Get lost!"

Immortal killer move — Summer Fan!

Sweeping tornadoes forced Wind Sweeping Building to a halt. Being a wind path house, it was ill-suited against summer fan's time path power.

Li Huang could only continue to escape.

Inside Emperor City, Gu Masters continued the competition, isolated from all outside noise.

"Fang Yuan, don't be too arrogant—face me instead!" Seeing the dire situation, rank eight Gu Immortal Qing Ye entered the battle.

Seeing his chance, Li Huang stopped fleeing and fought alongside Qing Ye.

Shouting loudly, Fang Yuan disregarded immortal essence expenditure and unleashed killer moves targeting Emperor City.

Li Huang and Qing Ye blocked him head-on, but Fang Yuan's barrage forced them back.

Infallible blessed land battlefield.

"Farewell friend wind! This is actually farewell friend wind!" Seeing Wu Yong strike Chen Yi, the Central Continent Gu Immortals defending the formation were gripped by terror.

Bai Cang Shui shrieked as she charged at Wu Yong.

Bai Cang Shui grabbed Chen Yi; though no longer drifting, he remained paralyzed as his skin and eyebrows began to erode.

Wu Yong appeared before the Southern Border immortals again.

The Southern Alliance immortals looked at him with complex emotions, their eyes filled with wariness, fear, and respect.

Wu Yong gazed at distant Chen Yi and praised: "As expected of Heavenly Court's Gu Immortal. Your defense is incredible—this is the slowest I've seen anyone disintegrate from my farewell friend wind."

Heavenly Court battlefield.

"Spear!" Heavenly Court's rank eight Che Wei shouted.

A gigantic black spear as large as an ancient tree shot toward Five Elements Grandmaster.

Five Elements Grandmaster stood firm under the barrage, remarking leisurely: "Impressive, Che Wei. But you cannot break my five elements ring."

"Blade." Che Wei ignored Five Elements Grandmaster, brandishing a large blade to engage him in close combat.

Bull Demon took the offensive while Heavenly Court's Gu Immortal Cong Yan defended.

Bull Demon attacked ferociously, creating phantom shadows that unleashed terrifying, unexpected assaults.

"It seems they cannot get past for now." Yuan Qiong Du's mind eased slightly as he continued refining Gu.

"Longevity Heaven chose close combat, restraining their strikes to avoid wrecking the refinement formation."

As Yuan Qiong Du pondered, Bing Sai Chuan smiled coldly: "Do you know why I brought Calamity Luck Altar? Because a former Demon Venerable's killer move is inside it."

But soon, a golden light burst out of Calamity Luck Altar.

A phantom segment of the grand River of Time manifested above Calamity Luck Altar.

As the immortal killer move activated, figures walked out of the River of Time.

Seeing Calamity Luck Altar suppressed by a giant bear, the first person to emerge roared furiously: "You have huge bear guts! Eat my exploding lightning!"

Zhang Fei Xiong's giant bear form was forced back five or six steps, his face bloody and deeply injured from the explosion!

The man laughed maniacally: "You don't even know me, Nu Er Bao Xiong? Then let my exploding lightning blow you to bits—remember my name!"

"To travel to the future and join a grand battle—I am truly fortunate," smiled the second Northern Plains Gu Immortal.

Pointing at Calamity Luck Altar, he dispelled the time path killer move on it, restoring its speed.

"You broke my killer move! Who are you?" Gu Liu Ru demanded with a dark expression.

The Northern Plains Gu Immortal smiled: "We both cultivate time path—let us fight. As for my name, I am Hei Fan."

"Wow! What a massive battle—heavens, I'd better hide!" The third Northern Plains Gu Immortal had a delicate, pale face and a crafty look.

One by one, Northern Plains Gu Immortals walked out and joined the battlefield.

Fairy Zi Wei's heart pounded: "They are all rank eight experts of Northern Plains' Huang Jin tribes! What killer move can summon people from the past?"

Seeing this, Duke Long's expression froze as his memories surfaced once more.

As the dust clouds settled, a heavily injured Red Lotus coughed blood while Duke Long remained standing.

"Red Lotus, why aren't you attacking? Even with future self, rebirth leaves you at rank eight—you are far from regaining Immortal Venerable battle strength!"

"Indeed, my future self killer move has flaws, but even without them, how could I attack Master?" Red Lotus smiled bitterly.

Red Lotus shook his head with a faint smile: "Master, after taking hits for so long, my killer move is finally ready. Please critique it."

With that, a phantom River of Time appeared behind him as Gu Immortals walked out one by one.

Duke Long's expression changed: "What killer move is this?"

"I created a pair of killer moves called 'call of the ancient, support of the future'. They summon closely related Gu Immortals from the River of Time to fight. Right now, I am using support of the future," Red Lotus smiled lightly.

Grim and trembling with rage, Duke Long snarled: "Defying heaven and earth to alter history through the River of Time—your demonic nature runs too deep! What of the first move? Go ahead and use it!"

"No, Master. The first move, 'call of the ancient', will appear before you at a certain time in the future," Red Lotus smiled.

# Chapter 1718: Heavenly Court's Chaotic Battle

Boom!

A violent explosion tore away the mountain-sized black bear's right shoulder, shattering the bone and blasting off a huge chunk of flesh.

Above, a Northern Plains Gu Immortal laughed aloud: "My twilight lightning is not so easy to deal with! I've killed countless transformation path Gu Immortals!"

Nu Er Bao Xiong's laughter cut short as a delightful female voice rang out: "Shameless words! I also cultivate transformation path on the side—come and kill me."

"Save Zhang Fei Xiong now!" Gu Liu Ru shouted from his wheelchair, pointing his finger.

Instantly, Zhang Fei Xiong's black bear form flickered with light, preserving his life.

It was the enchanting Wan Zi Hong, a wood path immortal recruited by Heavenly Court.

Stepping in, Wan Zi Hong scattered into pink petals that settled over the bloody wound.

Zhang Fei Xiong's flesh rapidly regenerated, healing at a visible pace.

"Hmph!" Nu Er Bao Xiong scowled in the sky; despite his potent lightning path killer moves, Heavenly Court's Gu Immortals were not weak either.

"Yet Longevity Heaven's killer move is still summoning more people!" Fairy Zi Wei looked anxiously toward Calamity Luck Altar.

"This is likely Red Lotus Demon Venerable's killer move; Lord Duke Long might know something." Fairy Zi Wei continued seeking an opportunity to enter the fray and save Duke Long.

"I have an important mission: providing Immortal Gu to the newly awakened immortals and protecting Old Man Zheng Yuan, a vital pillar in this battle!"

Clang!

Golden light flickered before Fairy Zi Wei, fading to reveal a Northern Plains Gu Immortal.

Dark-skinned with sharp eyes, he was Ye Lui tribe's metal path expert, Ye Lui Kou, newly emerged from the River of Time!

"This damned qi wall!" Ye Lui Kou had an irritated expression.

Yet his charge was foiled by Primordial Origin Immortal Venerable's qi wall killer move in Heavenly Court.

Discerning friend from foe, the qi wall allowed Heavenly Court members free passage while posing a massive obstacle to Longevity Heaven.

Northern Plains' Gu Immortals could only maneuver along the road Limitless Demon Venerable created to fight Heavenly Court.

On the battlefield, Northern Plains held the clear upper hand, forcing Heavenly Court's Gu Immortals to retreat behind the qi wall to sustain the fight.

# Chapter 1719: Death in Formation

# Chapter 1738: Primordial Origin Heavenly Court!

Primordial Origin said solemnly: "Without early precautions, all our hard-fought achievements and sacrifices will crumble once I die."

Primordial Origin Immortal Venerable continued in an earnest voice: "I know that the sect system will not truly be accepted at first. We painstakingly seek the way of Gu Immortal cultivation, we paid an immeasurable price to obtain success, it is okay if we leave it to our own descendants, but a sect means that we need to give them to outsiders."

"Upon my death, my immortal aperture will also be contributed as the sect's foundation rather than left to my descendants."

"What kind of sect will you create, and where should we build ours? What rules and key factors govern a sect?"

# Chapter 1742: Fate Vanquish

Inside Heaven Overseeing Tower.

After losing Fang Yuan's Dang Hun Mountain, Lang Ya land spirit had been obligated to compensate him with refinement path true meaning, though he was very unwilling.

In his previous life, Fang Yuan had obtained refinement path true meaning from Lang Ya land spirit, raising his refinement path attainment to quasi-supreme grandmaster.

That choice had been sound, as the attainment level provided him tremendous help.

Now that Fang Yuan had reborn, his refinement path attainment remained at quasi-supreme grandmaster, making refinement path true meaning useless to him.

Thus, Fang Yuan made a different choice: "I choose Steal Life, and… give me all the time path Immortal Gu."

Lang Ya land spirit was momentarily dazed before quickly agreeing: "Okay!"

# Chapter 1751: I Know What I Am Doing

Fang Yuan looked at steal life Immortal Gu closely.

This Immortal Gu resembled a fist-sized bee striped in gold and black, enveloped in a thin red radiance that brightened as it moved.

Its most eye-catching feature was a forearm-length stinger, razor-thin and sharp, surpassing the length of its body.

Rumored to be Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable's first Immortal Gu, Steal Life possessed an extraordinary origin.

Gazing at Steal Life, Fang Yuan pondered: "Though a Demon Venerable, Thieving Heaven was mild-mannered and averse to bloodshed, unlike Spectral Soul. It was precisely that nature which led him to create theft path."

Fang Yuan knew a lot about Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable.

As an otherworldly demon, Thieving Heaven disliked killing and sought only to return home, gathering resources and cultivating constantly to find a way back.

What to do?

Facing this question, theft path was the answer he created!

Suddenly, a light of inspiration flashed past Fang Yuan's mind.

"Limitless, Star Constellation, Primordial Origin, Genesis Lotus, Giant Sun, Red Lotus, and Paradise Earth all intervened in the five regions chaotic war through various methods."

"Only Thieving Heaven, Reckless Savage, and Spectral Soul made no moves."

"No, Spectral Soul was captured, leaving only a remnant soul with no power to act. By inheriting Shadow Sect's true inheritance and leading them into battle, I can be considered his move."

"Did Thieving Heaven and Reckless Savage predict the five regions chaotic war as well?"

"Both should have predicted it. If Primordial Origin and Limitless left arrangements, how could these two later rank nine venerables not have deduced it as well?"

"If they deduced this war, did they leave behind arrangements to intervene?"

"Thieving Heaven may have only cared about returning home, but what about Reckless Savage? As a Demon Venerable who attacked Heavenly Court, he must have left many arrangements."

"They stayed hidden in my previous life, but can I locate and use Reckless Savage's arrangements this time?"

Fang Yuan's eyes brightened at this thought, this was an excellent method!

Against a colossal force like Heavenly Court, short of reaching rank nine, he had to borrow external strength.

Lang Ya land spirit interrupted Fang Yuan's thoughts: "Fang Yuan, with rank eight Steal Life, you now possess five rank eight Immortal Gu! Hehe, it is truly unbelievable. Holding five rank eight Immortal Gu at rank seven cultivation is rare across all of history!"

"However, Steal Life has a flaw. When Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable left it behind, he worried it would cause catastrophe, so he permitted only three uses. In my previous life's defense of Lang Ya, those uses killed Thunder Ghost True Monarch before Chen Yi destroyed Steal Life with Karma Divine Tree."

"Nor is that its only drawback. Used alone, Steal Life cannot distinguish friend from foe, endangering the user as well as the target. Quite an awkward flaw."

"Now that I have Steal Life, I must deduce killer moves to eliminate this flaw at minimum."

"If possible, it would be even better to lift the three-use restriction on Steal Life entirely."

Fang Yuan smiled at Lang Ya land spirit: "First supreme elder, this Steal Life seems limited to three uses. Do you know why that is?"

Lang Ya land spirit blurted out in shock: "How did you discover that?"

The land spirit's expression instantly changed, realizing his outburst had confirmed Fang Yuan's words.

Coughing awkwardly, he muttered: "I didn't hide it intentionally, I was planning to tell you."

Fang Yuan smiled faintly at the land spirit: "First supreme elder, these Immortal Gu don't match the value of refinement path true meaning, especially given Steal Life's condition. You must make up the difference."

The black-haired land spirit rolled his eyes: "I know that. Speak, what else do you want?"

Fang Yuan smiled: "I have a suggestion."

He proposed deepening collaboration with the three variant human races, using Lang Ya Sect's resources to exchange for their time path Immortal Gu.

Lang Ya land spirit asked in surprise: "You want time path Immortal Gu? Are you planning to develop time path?"

Fang Yuan nodded.

Lang Ya land spirit nodded: "I'll swallow my pride and negotiate with the three races. But Fang Yuan, Heavenly Court is our priority. We must purge the harmful dao marks and relocate the blessed land swiftly."

Fang Yuan comforted the anxious land spirit: "Relax, I know what I'm doing. These time path Gu are also meant to deal with Heavenly Court. I have plans for the dao marks and will modify our super immortal formation shortly."

"That's good." The black-haired land spirit patted Fang Yuan's shoulder and departed.

Working with extreme efficiency, he soon concluded discussions and handed the time path Immortal Gu to Fang Yuan.

Between Lang Ya Sect's treasury and the variant human trades, there were five time path Immortal Gu: three rank six and two rank seven.

Among the rank seven, there was time concealment Immortal Gu and time needle Immortal Gu, among the rank six, the Immortal Gu were Yesterday, Ten Days, and Successive Years.

Time Concealment was the most helpful to Fang Yuan since it could conceal a Gu Immortal; he was overjoyed to obtain it.

A day later.

Piles of rank eight immortal materials were tossed down, forming a multicolored whirlpool.

Wisdom Gu plunged into the vortex willingly, like a cat drawn to fish.

Fang Yuan opened his sovereign immortal aperture, storing the multicolored whirlpool inside.

"Sigh, my heart feels so empty now." The black-haired land spirit sighed deeply. He had long coveted wisdom Gu, only for it to go to Fang Yuan after he had spent so much lifespan Gu feeding it.

Yet under the threat of Heavenly Court's invasion, he had to accept this regardless of his reluctance, preventing wisdom Gu from falling into their hands.

Having stored wisdom Gu, Fang Yuan handed Lang Ya land spirit a recipe: "Look at this Immortal Gu recipe, we will refine it next."

Lang Ya land spirit looked carefully: "Myriad self Immortal Gu?"

"Right. It will greatly boost my battle strength against Heavenly Court." Walking out of the valley, Fang Yuan added: "Start preparing; I will gather the eight main immortal materials."

"Wait, didn't you want to modify the blessed land's formation?"

Fang Yuan waved without looking back: "Don't worry, I know what I'm doing."

# Chapter 1752: Killing Immortals, Plundering Loot

Northern Plains.

Autumn blade plain.

He was Meng Tu.

A blade path quasi-great grandmaster with peak rank seven battle strength, he was among the top three rank seven elites of Meng tribe.

Suddenly, he opened his eyes!

He saw shrieking monsters lunging at him.

Humanoid yet horrifying, the monsters had malevolent faces, knife-like claws, and bloodshot eyes. Their intense killing intent made Meng Tu's hair stand on end.

"What in the world is this?!" Meng Tu was shocked and furious.

Clashing with them, he was shocked to realize each possessed rank seven battle strength.

Even with peak rank seven battle strength, the relentless onslaught forced him to retreat.

Yet as he backed away, the attacking monsters self-detonated.

The powerful chain of detonations forced Meng Tu back, coughing up blood.

Worried, Meng Tu was about to contact his tribe for help when the surroundings suddenly changed colors.

Before he could react, he was already trapped inside an immortal battlefield.

"An immortal battlefield formed so quickly?!" Shock flashed across Meng Tu's eyes.

"Who are you, sir, and why do you oppose my Meng tribe?" Meng Tu shouted.

Ignoring him, Fang Yuan smiled faintly and began preparing Luo Po seal.

Looking over sharply, Meng Tu saw an ordinary-looking Gu Immortal in a gray robe who resembled a common passerby.

Meng Tu was dazed: "He only has peak rank seven cultivation, how can he unleash a rank eight killer move?"

In truth, Luo Po seal was only quasi-rank eight, though its aura was immense. Lacking rank eight immortal essence, Fang Yuan had slightly modified and weakened the move.

Meng Tu gritted his teeth, charging at Fang Yuan.

With Luo Po seal fully prepared, Fang Yuan struck from afar.

Obstructed by the yama children, Meng Tu could not dodge and took the direct hit.

Instantly, he expression turned pale and ghastly.

He was dead.

Fang Yuan started collecting his loot.

Meng Tu's body and immortal aperture remained intact, containing abundant cultivation resources and three Immortal Gu.

In his previous life, Meng Tu had self-detonated, leaving only bladewing Immortal Gu; now, his gains were far richer.

Dispelling yama battlefield, Fang Yuan plundered all of autumn blade plain.

He also gathered his primary objective: the drinking blade wine buried underground.

Additionally, he harvested a vast number of mortal edge Gu.

Having taken nearly everything, Fang Yuan swept the area with a cold gaze and departed.

He did not return to Lang Ya blessed land, having more immortal materials to collect.

Refining myriad self Immortal Gu required four main materials: drinking blade wine, edge Gu, front-back divine obstruction needles, and floating life fire.

Having secured the first two, only the latter two remained.

Fang Yuan came to Divine Needle Valley.

Arriving at Divine Needle Valley without entering, Fang Yuan repeated his tactic, dispatching yama children to attack.

Soon, Sleeping Lady screamed in shock: "Such guts! You dare attack my Divine Needle Valley!"

As the yama children detonated sequentially, Sleeping Lady fled in disarray.

"Trying to regroup with the divine hedgehog?" Fang Yuan sneered, using the remaining blast force to swiftly manifest yama battlefield and trap her inside.

Sleeping Lady reacted just like Meng Tu: "What immortal battlefield is this? It forms so fast!"

Looking at Fang Yuan warily, Sleeping Lady pleaded: "Who are you, sir? What grudge do we have? Spare me, we can negotiate whatever you need!"

Fang Yuan smiled lightly: "I want your life."

As the yama children swarmed, Sleeping Lady resisted desperately and screamed: "Spare me, I will do anything! I can teach you how to control the divine hedgehog in exchange for my life!"

Fang Yuan started to prepare Luo Po seal.

Fang Yuan spoke icily: "It seems you still do not know your sin."

"Your weakness is your sin!" With that, Fang Yuan unleashed Luo Po seal.

Luo Po seal struck Sleeping Lady, shredding her defenses like paper and killing her instantly.

Fang Yuan kept her corpse and immortal aperture; regrettably, Sleeping Lady had detonated all her Immortal Gu.

Dispelling yama battlefield, Fang Yuan disguised himself as Sleeping Lady and collected all the front-back divine obstruction needles from the divine hedgehog.

With the hedgehog's strength crippled, Fang Yuan easily suppressed and stored it in his immortal aperture.

Nor did Fang Yuan spare Divine Needle Valley itself.

Using Pulling Mountain Immortal Gu, he uprooted the entire valley into his immortal aperture, leaving nothing behind.

# Chapter 1753: Retrieving Red Lotus' True Inheritance Again

Northern Plains.

They were Fang Yuan, Ying Wu Xie, Fairy Miao Yin, and Lady White Rabbit.

Following rebirth, Fairy Miao Yin, Lady White Rabbit, and the spy Sixth Hair inside Lang Ya Sect were all still alive.

"Alright, return and cultivate." Fang Yuan opened his sovereign immortal aperture, allowing the three Gu Immortals inside.

The remaining Shadow Sect Gu Immortals all cultivated within Fang Yuan's sovereign immortal aperture.

Omni-directional Travel was vital to him now, compensating for his lack of movement methods.

After losing Fixed Immortal Travel, this formation had replaced it, rescuing him from numerous perils.

"Still, Fixed Immortal Travel remains more convenient," Fang Yuan sighed internally.

He added silently: "Though it needs to be rank seven for me to use effectively."

"By now, Feng Jiu Ge should already have rank seven Fixed Immortal Travel?"

This Gu worm was very useful to Fang Yuan.

Omni-directional Travel was inferior to Fixed Immortal Travel regarding regional walls, the heavenly wind qi wall, and the manpower required to activate it.

"In my previous life, I relied on luck to steal Fixed Immortal Travel with great thief ghost hand. But that method is unreliable. How can I guarantee obtaining it this time?"

"Fortunately, both Meng Tu and Sleeping Lady were weaker than me, so my lower luck was not an issue."

Burning soul bursting luck!

"My soul foundation is weak, so I must use burning soul bursting luck sparingly. But entering the River of Time demands caution," Fang Yuan sighed internally.

Circling the plains while activating Gu worms, Fang Yuan stomped lightly to trigger the natural formation.

Stepping inside the immortal formation, he vanished on the spot.

Like in Southern Border, a natural tributary of the River of Time lay here. Shadow Sect had used formation path methods and natural dao marks to erect an immortal formation, concealing it from discovery.

Fang Yuan gazed at the tributary as time path mortal Gu emerged, floating above the water.

Calming himself, Fang Yuan carefully activated a time path immortal killer move.

Created days earlier and still unnamed, its primary purpose was concealing his existence and guarding against deductions.

With the move active, Fang Yuan took a deep breath and leapt into the tributary.

Drifting along the tributary, he swiftly entered the main River of Time.

In the distance, an Immortal Gu House floated upon the churning waves of the River of Time.

The pavilion-style Immortal Gu House was open on all four sides and rustic in design, with a thatched yellow-grass roof and unpolished grayish-white stone pillars. Its most elegant feature was a multi-paneled folding screen inside.

Four Gu Immortals occupied the pavilion: three men and one woman.

They were the close-knit Four Xunzi quadruplets from Central Continent's Spirit Butterfly Valley, all rank seven time path cultivators.

Fang Yuan's elimination of Lord Huang Shi using Spectral Soul's Red Lotus true inheritance had left Heavenly Court short on time path experts.

Though not formal members, the Four Xunzi were powerful and loyal, earning personal promotions from Fairy Zi Wei. Guarding the River of Time within Present and Past Pavilion, they would detect Fang Yuan the moment he entered.

"Oh?" At this time, Shang Xunzi gasped lightly.

"What is it?" asked Xun Guo Zi, the youngest and only sister among them.

Pointing at the folding screen, eldest brother Shang Xunzi hesitated: "I think I saw a ripple on one of the panels."

"You did?" Zhong Xunzi and Xia Xunzi looked at each other.

"Let's check it then." Though naturally cheerful, Xun Guo Zi took their critical mission seriously.

Activating Present and Past Pavilion, the Four Xunzi inspected dozens of times without finding anything amiss.

Everything was normal.

"I guess I saw wrongly, haha." Shang Xunzi was a little embarrassed.

The playful four never suspected that Fang Yuan had already slipped into the River of Time!

Post-rebirth exchanges had granted him rank seven Time Concealment to hide his presence. Using a killer move centered on it, amplified by the River of Time itself, he easily evaded Present and Past Pavilion's detection...

Fang Yuan swam in the River of Time, moving rapidly.

Thanks to burning soul bursting luck, his improved fortune allowed him to resolve most hazards smoothly.

Eventually, Spring Autumn Cicada vibrated, and Fang Yuan soon located the stone lotus island!

# Chapter 1754: Fang Yuan's Future Self

Fang Yuan ascended the stone lotus island again.

"Rebirth merely uses Spring Autumn Cicada to carry a will upstream, merging with my past self at a given moment."

"Time here is singular and absolute, without parallel dimensions. Downstream remains unaltered after my death, where Heavenly Court dominated and the four regions stood helpless."

"Upon rebirth, I am like a drop of ink in clear water. As I alter events and people, creating and erasing possibilities, the ink spreads and dyes the entire river a different color."

"By the time the ink reaches Heavenly Court repairing Fate Gu and hosting the Refinement Path Convention, the future will be entirely transformed."

Fang Yuan now realized that the ink effect best explained the repercussions of rebirth in the Gu world.

"I can effect change because Fate Gu is incomplete and, crucially, because as an otherworldly demon, I am unbound by fate."

"Had Red Lotus Demon Venerable traveled back, altering events would prove difficult, as outcomes would inevitably revert to their destined course."

"In essence, otherworldly demons are large blobs of ink, whereas native Gu Immortals are merely ripples. Though natives cause brief disturbances, Fate Gu inevitably restores everything to its original course."

Abundant time path materials remained on the stone lotus island, the vast majority being rank eight.

Red Lotus's true meaning could elevate a Gu Immortal's time path attainment to quasi-supreme grandmaster.

Various immortal killer moves centered on Spring Autumn Cicada were present as well, including spring autumn success.

Red Lotus Demon Venerable had also left behind the method Future Self, allowing a Gu Immortal to tap into their peak rank seven future state.

Fang Yuan released Ying Wu Xie and the others onto the island to cultivate and master Future Self, just as in his previous life.

Unlike last time, Fairy Miao Yin and Lady White Rabbit were alive, greatly enhancing Future Self's utility.

He himself could use future self too!

In his previous life, rank eight cultivation made Future Self useless to him; at rank seven now, the move was fully effective.

Leaving Ying Wu Xie and the others behind, Fang Yuan departed the island.

Retracing his route, Fang Yuan exited the River of Time through the tributary and returned to Northern Plains.

Exiting the formation, he activated Fixed Immortal Travel and headed toward Southern Border.

Future self created a human-shaped phantom within his sovereign immortal aperture.

The phantom also possessed a sovereign immortal aperture containing Fang Yuan's future phantom Gu worms, including Fixed Immortal Travel!

Future self allowed a Gu Immortal to enter their peak rank seven state; in his previous life, Fang Yuan's was right before the Five Regional Mountain Range battle.

Yet he avoided the Five Regional Mountain Range.

Arriving in Southern Border, he bypassed the true inheritance and visited an ordinary valley instead.

# Chapter 1755: Wild Immortal Gu

Arriving in the valley, Fang Yuan found a cave, erected a mortal Gu House, and began quiet cultivation.

Future self's greatest aid to Fang Yuan was not cultivation or battle strength, but accessing Fixed Immortal Travel.

Through future self, Fang Yuan could freely traverse the five regions and two heavens.

Bathed in the light of wisdom, Fang Yuan's time path clone deduced continuously.

One task was modifying yama battlefield with time path Immortal Gu to incorporate a time path battlefield's advantages.

And now, he brought these gains with him.

Fang Yuan could now utilize and further elevate his killer move deductions from his previous life.

"Yama battlefield encompasses both soul path and enslavement path."

"Enslavement path excels at attrition; countless fearless yama children can self-detonate before dying, draining the enemy's resources and battle strength."

"Soul path grows stronger through killing; in a normal soul path battlefield, slaying an enemy enhances the battlefield itself."

"Adding time path Immortal Gu will give yama battlefield the traits of a time path battlefield."

Time path battlefields altered the flow of time—most classically by dilating internal time so one outside day equaled a month inside, granting the user ample time to eliminate trapped foes.

If allies took fifteen minutes to arrive and rescue a trapped foe, three days would pass inside the battlefield, allowing the user to slay the enemy and leave before help arrived.

In the previous life, though Fang Yuan trapped Feng Jiu Ge with yama battlefield and stole Fixed Immortal Travel, Feng Jiu Ge's fate armor Immortal Gu stalled long enough for Fairy Zi Wei to deduce and break the battlefield.

Had yama battlefield possessed time path power, extending internal time to three days and nights would have left Fairy Zi Wei with only Feng Jiu Ge's corpse upon breaking it.

Fang Yuan waited in this nameless valley for four days and five nights before his opportunity arrived.

Rumble!

Daytime, the earth shook, a crack appeared.

The fissures widened, completely devouring the valley as a massive Earth Trench formed right before Fang Yuan's eyes.

The five regional walls were shrinking as the five regions' earth veins gradually fused.

Fang Yuan waited patiently, descending to search only after the Earth Trench stabilized.

The newly formed Earth Trench produced abundant Gu materials, and subterranean lifeforms emerged.

Fang Yuan used his investigative killer move as he searched.

He carefully approached and found an ancient desolate beast diamond head turtle.

Boat-sized and bright yellow with a flat shell, its most eye-catching feature was a massive, drill-like head tapering into a natural spiral mouth. Half the head was translucent, resembling a low-grade diamond.

He found a wild Immortal Gu on the diamond head turtle!

Fang Yuan immediately acted, using yama battlefield.

Eventually, aided by the yama children, Fang Yuan exhausted the diamond head turtle and captured it alive.

Fang Yuan also claimed its wild rank seven Immortal Gu.

"Very good! With this, I can counter Fixed Immortal Travel." Delighted, Fang Yuan stored the turtle and wild Immortal Gu into his immortal aperture, then dispelled yama battlefield.

Back in the Earth Trench, Luo clan's Gu Immortals had arrived, cursing furiously upon discovering someone had beaten them there.

After gaining some distance, Fang Yuan used future self to return to Lang Ya blessed land.

Fang Yuan's sudden appearance shocked Lang Ya land spirit immensely.

Approaching Fang Yuan, he asked in pleasant surprise: "Fang Yuan, you snatched Fixed Immortal Travel from them?"

Without Fixed Immortal Travel, Heavenly Court would struggle to invade Lang Ya blessed land.

Fang Yuan shook his head: "This is just a killer move. Are you ready to refine Myriad Self?"

Disappointed, Lang Ya land spirit replied: "The supplementary materials are ready, but have you gathered your eight main materials?"

Fang Yuan shook his head: "Only three, but there is no rush—we still have time."

Lang Ya land spirit grew anxious: "Elder Fang Yuan, that attitude won't do! Heavenly Court could invade at any moment. We are already at a disadvantage; carelessness will ruin us!"

"Understood. First supreme elder, don't worry, I know what I'm doing."

# Chapter 1757: Repaying Kindness With Enmity!

"Fang Yuan, you dare plot against me inside Lang Ya blessed land?! Your arrogance is boundless! I will make you understand the severe mistake you've made!!"

Lang Ya land spirit roared in fury, looking like a volcano about to erupt and melt Fang Yuan in lava.

Furious enough to tear Fang Yuan to pieces, the land spirit raged: "Fang Yuan, you demon! You are utterly shameless!"

# Chapter 1758: Heavenly Court's Invasion

Lang Ya blessed land, Long Hair refinement path formation.

As the blood light faded, the formation opened, and Fang Yuan walked out with Lang Ya land spirit following behind.

"With the land spirit suppressed, Longevity Heaven gains nothing." Fang Yuan looked at Lang Ya land spirit.

On Fang Yuan's orders, Lang Ya land spirit reverted to the black-haired spirit.

The black-haired land spirit smiled: "Ma... mainly thanks to the refinement path formation. We should resume refining the Gu immediately."

Second, he wanted Heavenly Court to expose star cast. This terrifying method threatened all five regions; once exposed, it would provoke the other four regions' super forces into attacking Heavenly Court.

Third, he wanted to slay several Heavenly Court Gu Immortals, never missing a chance to weaken them.

Finally, Fang Yuan intended to use Heavenly Court to eliminate the snowman, rockman, and inkman Gu Immortals, repeating his past life's method to annex all three variant human forces at once.

Central Continent, Heavenly Court.

Star Constellation Chessboard!

Immortal killer move — Star Cast!

"Fang Yuan, I am coming! Just you wait." Thunder Ghost True Monarch snickered.

# Chapter 1759: I've Been Waiting!

Heavenly Court.

The next moment, he arrived within Lang Ya blessed land's formation space.

With that, Chen Yi flashed with green light, activating his defensive killer move.

Rather than rushing to attack, he guarded the dark spiral behind him.

Instantly, Chen Yi sensed something wrong: "Hmm? Time path power is affecting me!"

His defensive killer move formed very slowly.

Heavenly Court.

"Feng Jiu Ge can defend himself with his strength. Lacking luck path methods, Heavenly Court must rely on his Dao Guardian luck to counter Fang Yuan."

But right when Fairy Zi Wei was about to move, boom!

The Heavenly Court immortals behind her: "…"

# Chapter 1760: Overwhelming Advantage

Lang Ya blessed land.

# Chapter 1786: A Match Made In Heaven!

Turning to leave, the Yao clan elder gave his parting words: "Do not research the regional walls. They will disappear on their own; your research is meaningless."

Tao Zhu stood frozen and dazed, defeat written all over his face.

"Without even this ambition, what's the point of being human? Failure is fine, just try again. Even if I never achieve my goals, so what?"

"Hahaha, hahaha!" Tao Zhu's will laughed maniacally.

Indeed.

Even if I ultimately fail and gain nothing, even if my life is a complete failure, so what?

Even if the regional walls disappear in the future, so what?

Even if my research is meaningless, so what?

That is what I want to do!

Call me crazy, an idiot, stubborn, or stupid...

But I... still want to do it regardless!

That is how I want to live!

That is how I can find meaning in my life!

Yet lingering regrets remained, so I created this inheritance.

"Then observe it yourself, Old Man Tao Zhu."

"I will make sure your true inheritance — "

Because he had just captured Ba Shi Ba.

"I intended to trade with Chi Qu You for rule path dream realms to raise my attainment."

"Now I no longer need to wait, saving plenty of effort."

"A trap!" Disguised as Suan Bu Jin, Fang Yuan sneered, his eyes gleaming as three Gu Immortals approached.

The tall, thin Wan Xiao, robed in green and enveloped by whirlwinds, spoke smugly: "Suan Bu Jin, some wisdom path Gu Immortal you are, walking so blindly into our trap!"

The second immortal, Wan Hao Guang, was completely concealed beneath blazing light armor radiating intense heat. The armor buzzed: "Suan Bu Jin, surrender peacefully! Defect to Wan clan and expose Fang clan, and we will treat you as an honored guest!"

The third was Wan Liang Han, the wisdom path immortal who had baited Fang Yuan. Though ugly with a swollen forehead, he wore a broad smile: "Friend Suan Bu Jin, as a wisdom path immortal, you should understand the situation. Even if you survive today, endless troubles await you. You shouldn't stand with Fang clan right now."

The three Wan clan immortals thought they had trapped Fang Yuan, unaware he had returned from Southern Border specifically to deal with them and stir Western Desert!

Recently, Wan Liang Han had repeatedly deduced Fang Yuan; though Emperor Yama offered flawless protection, it still drained his soul foundation annoyingly, making their elimination necessary.

Fang Yuan immediately opened his immortal aperture, releasing soul beasts.

Desolate and ancient soul beasts poured out successively, shocking Wan clan's immortals.

"No matter how many soul beasts you bring out, it is useless in this immortal battlefield!" Wan Xiao activated the immortal battlefield, sending a giant tornado slowly toward Fang Yuan.

"How can he have so many soul beasts?" Wan clan's three immortals grew shaken; Suan Bu Jin was a wisdom path Gu Immortal, yet commanded such an army—wasn't he neglecting his main path?

The tornado accelerated, nearing Fang Yuan's soul beast army.

The soul beasts roared and counterattacked, but the battlefield-empowered tornado remained exceptionally stable despite weakening.

Fang Yuan personally activated a killer move, blocking the tornado.

"This won't do, his soul beasts seem endless. I will attack!" Wan Hao Guang shouted.

"Go, we will protect you." Wan Liang Han agreed.

Wan Hao Guang carved through the soul beast army rapidly, displaying the superiority of light path.

Whenever Fang Yuan directed soul beasts to besiege him, Wan Liang Han and Wan Xiao activated killer moves to protect Wan Hao Guang.

With their excellent coordination, Wan Hao Guang broke through to the center.

Fang Yuan's expression remained unchanged as he released four more soul beasts.

"Huh?" Wan Hao Guang's momentum halted violently as he blurted in fright: "Immemorial soul beasts!"

Dazed, Wan Liang Han and Wan Xiao called out incredulously: "Four?"

# Chapter 1800: Distracting Thoughts Generation

An immemorial soul beast possessed rank eight battle strength, yet four appeared simultaneously.

Guarded by four immemorial soul beasts, Fang Yuan asked disdainfully: "You planned to trap me with just the three of you?"

They realized Suan Bu Jin had anticipated their trap, backed by such an overwhelming trump card.

"Calm down! As a wisdom path Gu Immortal, he must be forcing himself to control four immemorial soul beasts."

Stabilizing their morale, the three immortals attacked Fang Yuan again.

Fang Yuan did not attack and only defended.

Maintaining the immortal battlefield, Wan Xiao hurled wind spears that heavily injured or killed an ancient soul beast with every strike.

Clad in thick light armor, Wan Hao Guang rampaged through the soul beast army, slaughtering them as he passed.

Wisdom path Gu Immortal Wan Liang Han directed the battle while constantly deducing Fang Yuan's location within the army.

Despite suffering heavy casualties, Fang Yuan continuously released more soul beasts, troubling Wan clan's trio.

These soul beasts coordinated closely, shielding Fang Yuan from all directions in tight defensive lines.

The four immemorial soul beasts formed a core defense whose sheer resilience filled Wan clan's three immortals with growing hopelessness.

Wan Liang Han looked grim: "Had he attacked, we would have openings, but by guarding strictly, he is stalling for Fang clan reinforcements."

Though Wan Liang Han's wisdom path attainment was inferior to Fang Di Chang's, he was sharp and already intended to retreat.

However, it was not easy to retreat at this moment.

Canceling the established immortal battlefield would create a massive opening that Suan Bu Jin, a fellow wisdom path Gu Immortal, would never miss.

Wan Liang Han had a rare moment of hesitation.

Fang Yuan was calm and composed.

Wan Liang Han had to die; this rank seven wisdom path immortal had repeatedly deduced and pestered him.

As for the other two, Fang Yuan wanted them alive.

Fang Yuan secretly activated Immortal Gu Distracting Thoughts, preparing an immortal killer move.

Wan Hao Guang's vision was engulfed by assorted soul beasts.

Thrusting like a sword toward Fang Yuan through dense ranks, he repeatedly lost momentum halfway; even on near-successes, the four immemorial soul beasts blocked him.

"Right! That mantis-like ancient soul beast on the front-left has powerful offense but weak defense."

"I will charge through this side!!"

As a light path Gu Immortal, Wan Hao Guang possessed a mystical killer move that generated thoughts of light in his mind.

With it, Wan Hao Guang instantly evaluated all possibilities to choose the optimal path through the army.

Charging forward, Wan Hao Guang took a heavy strike from the mantis soul beast but avoided being pincered.

"Haha, I succeeded!"

"As the main attacker, I must pressure Suan Bu Jin from the front so we have a chance to kill him."

"That was dangerous—had that mantis soul beast not lacked defense, I wouldn't have known what to do."

"Wait! I am in battle right now, why am I distracted by personal relationships!"

"Lady Qi Qiao is really cute—not stunningly beautiful, but kind, sensible, and truly my ideal woman."

"Why doesn't she accept my love? Perhaps I should change my approach... maybe send one or two small gifts."

Boom!

A loud boom erupted as soul beasts besieged Wan Hao Guang.

Heavy attacks struck his armor from all directions.

With his thoughts turning chaotic, Wan Hao Guang lost concentration and took heavy attacks that warped his armor, leaving him muddled and dizzy.

Seeing Wan Hao Guang in danger, Wan Xiao quickly activated an immortal killer move to break the encirclement.

Just then, Wan Liang Han suddenly shouted: "Don't!"

For some reason, Wan Xiao reacted slightly slower and had already activated the immortal killer move.

The killer move failed, and a violent gale backlashed, slashing his hands to a pulp.

Shaking as if struck by lightning, blood dripped from his nostrils, his face deathly pale.

"Oh... as a wisdom path Gu Immortal, he finally reacted." Fang Yuan smiled faintly under the protection of his soul beast army.

The killer move he used was distracting thoughts generation, which caused enemies within range to develop stray thoughts.

Subtle at first, the killer move caused stray thoughts to accumulate over time, increasingly disturbing the targets' thinking process.

Sensing something amiss, wisdom path Gu Immortal Wan Liang Han resolved: "Suan Bu Jin is truly sinister with such a peculiar method. Caught unprepared without intel, we've suffered a heavy loss. With the opportunity lost, we should retreat and devise a countermeasure before facing him in the future!"

Just as he was thinking, whoosh!

Like a breached dam, the vast soul beast army rushed out in a tidal flood!

# Chapter 1801: I Have Already Taken Your Life

At the crucial moment, Fang Yuan suddenly attacked, catching the three Wan clan immortals off-guard.

"Damn it!" Wan Xiao gritted his teeth and shouted, "Quickly save Wan Hao Guang, his armor killer move won't last much longer!"

Wan Liang Han felt a chill; Fang Yuan had stayed defensive until now, directly targeting their vital weaknesses the moment he struck.

The soul beast army flooded forward, engulfing the three Wan clan immortals.

The four immemorial soul beasts formed the center, advancing toward Wan Xiao like unstoppable mountains.

Sensing Fang Yuan's sinister killing intent, Wan Liang Han quickly warned, "Wan Xiao, retreat!"

Wan Xiao said anxiously, "I must save Hao Guang! He canceled his light armor killer move to rely solely on light armor Immortal Gu."

"Damn it!" At the critical moment, Wan Liang Han cooperated with Wan Xiao, activating the wisdom path Immortal Gu Wisdom Obstacle.

Wisdom Obstacle created barriers around Wan Xiao and Wan Liang Han, offering them immense protection.

Displaying solid battle foundations in this perilous moment, Wan Xiao and Wan Hao Guang finally reunited amidst the soul beast flood.

"Good! With their combined might and my support, we have hope of breaking out." Wan Liang Han felt a trace of joy, only to hear a sneer behind him.

"Not considering your own situation? What a self-sacrificing spirit." Fang Yuan had appeared right behind him!

Wan Liang Han felt as though he had plunged into an icy abyss!

Fang Yuan had feigned killing intent toward the others, but his true target had been Wan Liang Han all along!

The four immemorial soul beasts were still far off, serving merely as bait while Suan Bu Jin slipped beside Wan Liang Han alone.

Immortal killer move — Wisdom Grasp!

Pushing his palm forward, Fang Yuan sent a 'great thief ghost hand' flying into Wan Liang Han's body.

The 'great thief ghost hand' flew back with a clenched fist, as though clutching something.

Fang Yuan smiled lightly: "I have already taken your life."

Wan Liang Han's eyes went wide; he was already dead!

"Brother Liang Han!!" Wan Xiao and Wan Hao Guang shouted in shock, grief and anger.

Killing Wan Liang Han achieved half his goal; the rest depended on the two surviving immortals' next moves.

He activated transformation path methods to weaken his aura.

Wan Xiao and Wan Hao Guang were delighted to find Fang Yuan's aura weakened and his soul beast army scattered disunited.

Soon after, Fang Yuan grabbed Wan Liang Han's corpse and retreated behind the protection of the four immemorial soul beasts.

Gritting their teeth in hatred, Wan Xiao and Wan Hao Guang realized they could not kill Fang Yuan, and dragging this out would only get them killed.

Thereupon, they removed the immortal battlefield and chose to retreat.

Wan Xiao fell unconscious from severe injuries, and Wan Hao Guang gripped him tightly as they fled rapidly.

Fang Yuan feigned pursuit, watching with satisfaction as Wan Hao Guang fled into the clouds.

"I should leave too." Gazing toward Wan clan's headquarters with a faint smile, Fang Yuan recalled his soul beast army and vanished.

When Fang clan's first supreme elder Fang Gong rushed to the place, he looked dazedly at the empty desert.

Just then, a commotion erupted in treasure yellow heaven.

Fang Yuan repeated his trick, publicizing the battle under Suan Bu Jin's identity.

Heated discussions erupted among Gu Immortals, further shaking the Western Desert Gu Immortal world.

Fang Gong only learned of treasure yellow heaven's commotion upon receiving Fang Di Chang's message.

Relieved yet puzzled, Fang Gong muttered, "So the victor was Suan Bu Jin! But why hasn't he returned yet?"

Fang Di Chang chuckled, "He is a lone immortal who joined our clan only recently. Now, he has killed Wan Liang Han, a righteous path Gu Immortal from a super force. Adding on our Fang clan's situation, he is worried our Fang clan will give him up to protect ourself. So he is staying outside and took the initiative to publicize the battle."

Fang Gong understood immediately. "Hmph, you wisdom path Gu Immortals always overthink. Suan Bu Jin is pressuring our clan by doing this, but his worries are not unfounded. Wan Liang Han was killed by him, our Fang clan and Wan clan's relationship is now almost completely broken! Sigh, the newly stabilized situation has crumbled apart, Fang clan's situation has become much more difficult."

Fang Di Chang said solemnly, "I believe protecting Suan Bu Jin is far more beneficial."

"Suan Bu Jin is proud, so it is normal he feels unattached to us. Yet his strength backs his arrogance—those four immemorial soul beasts alone surpass our imagination. He also revealed two wisdom path killer moves in this battle, both are sinister and dangerous, if the enemy is even a little careless, they will fall to his vicious methods."

"Wan clan provoked us first. If we show weakness, other forces will deem us powerless and stir up trouble, undoing the gains achieved from our theft path killer move."

"At this critical time, Fang clan must preserve our strong momentum and protect Suan Bu Jin. He may not share our heart, but he is a capable ally with whom we share a proven foundation for cooperation. Our clan even owes him remuneration which can allow us to use him further. What the other righteous path forces don't hope to see is him reinforcing our clan."

Fang Gong nodded heavily: "Protecting Suan Bu Jin is far more beneficial than appeasing Wan clan, even if it brings greater suppression!"

Fang Di Chang said, "Once Divine Bean Palace's details leaked, this was inevitable. Refining Divine Bean Palace quickly remains our solution to this crisis."

Green ghost desert.

An immemorial soul beast stood defenseless against Fang Yuan's attacks.

Before long, it lowered its head, forcibly subdued by Fang Yuan.

Ying Wu Xie was standing beside Fang Yuan.

After defeating Wan clan's three immortals, Fang Yuan bypassed Fang clan to help Ying Wu Xie directly.

"Alright, let's go to the next area," Fang Yuan was saying when his expression shifted.

Fang clan had sent a message.

"Lord Sect Leader, what is Fang clan's response?" Ying Wu Xie asked attentively, concerned for their progress in green ghost desert.

"Everything is going as planned." Fang Yuan smiled, gazing deeply toward Fang clan's headquarters.

# Chapter 1802: Fang Clan's Support

Wan clan headquarters.

"Father—! You died a pitiful death!" Weeping echoed through the discussion hall, reverberating among the gathered Gu Immortals.

This was Wan Zhui Qing, a rank six Gu Immortal and Wan Liang Han's son.

Wan clan's first supreme elder spoke, "Suan Bu Jin cannot be forgiven. Wan Zhui Qing, did your father leave you his inheritance?"

Wan Zhui Qing held back his tears and respectfully answered, "Father passed down his inheritance, killer moves, and Gu recipes. But... not even one Immortal Gu was left behind!"

First supreme elder said, "Wan Liang Han will be honored, and the clan treasury will provide materials to refine his Immortal Gu. I only hope they were destroyed."

"Thank you, first supreme elder! Thank you, esteemed elders!!" Wan Zhui Qing kowtowed repeatedly to the gathered Wan clan Gu Immortals.

First supreme elder continued in a chilling voice, "Suan Bu Jin is Fang clan's member; we will pressure them to hand him over. This battle proves he is definitely Old Man Lie Shen's inheritor—a demonic path scoundrel! The bloody debt that Old Man Lie Shen owes us will be paid by him."

However, bad news arrived in Wan clan the next day.

Fang clan declared their stance: they would protect Fang Yuan and prove his origin traced to Zheng Jing Shen.

Yet the center of this political whirlpool, Fang Yuan, was leisurely subduing immemorial soul beasts in green ghost desert with a contented spirit.

Naturally, he kept close watch on the situation's progress.

Over these days, Fang Yuan subdued several immemorial soul beasts and absorbed Wan Liang Han's wisdom path inheritance.

Wan Liang Han had died instantly against Fang Yuan's overwhelming strength, leaving him no time to destroy his Immortal Gu.

Fang Yuan obtained three Immortal Gu from him, two rank six and one rank seven.

The rank seven wisdom path Immortal Gu, Wisdom Obstacle, was dark, snail-shaped, and flashed with faint purple light.

Distracting thoughts generation was a wisdom path killer move carrying soul path traits; Fang Yuan could mask its aura using the four immemorial soul beasts upon activation.

The other move, wisdom grasp, was a wisdom path killer move Fang Yuan had deduced from great thief ghost hand and the steal life true inheritance.

Great thief ghost hand stole Immortal Gu while wisdom grasp stole lives, instantly killing enemies.

Being only rank seven, it had poor effect against rank eight Gu Immortals, but was perfect against Wan Liang Han. Fang Yuan had added transformation path Gu worms into wisdom grasp to disguise it as great thief ghost hand.

At the same time, he cleverly exposed a 'weakness'—refraining from using his methods to directly manipulate soul beasts during the fight.

Believing they still held Suan Bu Jin in their grasp, Fang clan naturally tried their best to protect him.

On the surface, this was merely a skirmish, but Fang Yuan had manipulated the conflict to influence both super forces and steer Western Desert's situation.

Fang Yuan's true goal lay far beyond, making Immortal Gu like Wisdom Obstacle mere appetizers before the feast.

Fang Yuan sat atop the head of a ferocious immemorial soul beast, surrounded by countless soul beasts.

Under Fang Yuan's control, the vast army advanced silently into boundless darkness.
