# Chapter 1803: Dragonman Clone

Sovereign immortal aperture, Mini Red Heaven.

While Fang Yuan's main body swept through green ghost desert, his subordinates inside the immortal aperture used Myriad Year Flying Warship to subdue immemorial year beasts.

Fang Yuan was familiarizing these rank seven Gu Immortals with Myriad Year Flying Warship so they could join rank eight battles.

On the other hand, he used the immemorial year beast fishing formation to lure immemorial year beasts and complete his Twelve Zodiac battle formation.

Fang Yuan had begun planning the Twelve Zodiac battle formation in his previous life.

It gathered twelve different species of immemorial year beasts as cores for the formation.

The Twelve Zodiac battle formation specialized in offense and mobility; when inactive, the immemorial year beasts could be sealed like statues, requiring no food.

In this life, Fang Yuan was so affluent that saving food costs was secondary; he prioritized the formation's formidable offensive power.

Wasting no time, Fang Yuan utilized this rare peaceful period to consolidate his gains and strengthen himself.

His soul path cultivation progress was also highly satisfactory.

Fang Yuan's soul had passed the ten million man level, reaching one hundred million man soul!

Cultivating beyond the human soul limit yielded a desolate soul!

Although capable of interfering with the real world, a hundred million man soul remained fragile.

Reaching desolate soul level brought an earth-shaking leap in battle strength, allowing Fang Yuan to rival most desolate beasts with just his soul.

In the Battle of Yi Tian Mountain, Spectral Soul had used only his soul to battle tribulations; that awe-inspiring might fueled Fang Yuan's desire for that level.

"But I still have things to do before I breakthrough to desolate soul!"

Inside the sovereign immortal aperture, Fang Yuan's split soul was put inside the Long Hair refinement path formation.

The formation activated, dyeing its surroundings bright red like blazing fire.

With previous failures behind him, Fang Yuan's movements were smooth.

"Concentrate, we are adding the main immortal material next," Fang Yuan commanded. Assisting him, Lang Ya land spirit nodded immediately and helped control the formation.

A secret room opened, and the immortal material inside entered the formation immediately.

This rank eight material was prospering spring light; though a light path immortal material, it was condensed into the form of a flower. The delicate flower bloomed open, its white petals speckled with red and green, bursting with vitality.

The moment prospering spring light entered the fire, it melted into pure white light that poured over Fang Yuan's split soul.

Gu materials were tossed in continuously while several Immortal Gu outside the formation activated ceaselessly.

The refinement was going well, Fang Yuan's spirits rose as he shouted: "Next is false pearl!"

False pearl was not a pearl but a transformation path immortal material that could transform into any gem.

The false pearl quickly integrated into the fire.

Fang Yuan called out: "Bai Ning Bing!"

Bai Ning Bing nodded from a formation core and swung her arm, sending blood flying from the wound on her hand.

The blood entered the raging blaze, instantly turning the crimson fire a bewitching blood-red.

The blood fire shrank as it burned, soon reducing to the size of a fist.

"Release the raging wave rising dragon fire!" Fang Yuan commanded.

Acting on its own, the raging wave rising dragon fire tried to escape the formation upon release, but to no avail.

The Long Hair refinement path formation firmly blocked it, forcing it to collide with the blood fire.

Though distinct, the two flames soon merged into a large lump of colorful fire.

The smoke settled around the fire into a pitch-black sphere, its bright core faintly visible from outside.

Boom!

After an hour, the smoke sphere exploded amidst surging air waves and echoing dragon roars.

A dragonman Gu Master emerged from the smoke.

He bore golden dragon scales, topaz dragon eyes, and a pair of golden coral-like dragon horns upon his head.

Seeing him, Lang Ya land spirit laughing loudly: "Success, we succeeded!"

Indeed, this young rank one Gu Master was Fang Yuan's dragonman clone.

# Chapter 1804: Breaking Through To Desolate Soul

Inside the sovereign immortal aperture.

The soul path formation was already arranged properly.

Inspecting the formation with divine sense, Fang Yuan noted, "Modified from a killer move, this formation is far more stable, precise, and easily controlled."

This unique soul cultivation technique from Shadow Sect's true inheritance allowed a human soul to break through its limit and reach desolate soul level!

Everything was ready, Fang Yuan sent his hundred million man soul into the formation.

Clutching a desolate beast soul core, Fang Yuan's soul reached the formation's center and crushed it.

Pre-processed beforehand, the soul core was weakened sharply by the formation.

The shattered soul core turned into fog and drifted out.

The formation operated rapidly, making the fog shroud Fang Yuan's hundred million man soul completely.

Over the next several hours, this fog thinned before disappearing completely.

Fang Yuan's hundred million man soul retained its original shape—identical to his sovereign immortal body, solid and lifelike.

Yet internally, Fang Yuan felt vastly different from before.

"So this is desolate soul?" Fang Yuan's soul looked at his hands.

"Time to test it in combat." Fang Yuan's soul flew excitedly from the formation.

Fang Yuan had prepared in advance, confining a desolate beast nearby.

"I really possess the strength of a desolate beast!"

"With my combat techniques, ordinary desolate beasts are no match for me one-on-one."

"The soul path dao marks on my soul have surged, actually breaking past ten thousand!"

Having broken the limit to form a desolate soul, Fang Yuan could continue cultivating his soul.

Fang Yuan's desolate soul cultivated, the time path clone deduced, while his main body researched the dragonman clone.

Though he created this clone, it still held research value.

The dragonman clone's soul originally resembled his sovereign immortal body with a thirty million man soul foundation.

Now, however, it mirrored the dragonman's body, complete with dragon tail, horns, scales, and vertical pupils.

Moreover, its soul path dao marks were reduced to single digits, and its foundation was merely a few dozen man soul.

This refinement was precisely what Fang Yuan intended to achieve.

The split souls were human; entering a dragonman body was merely soul possession, so the entity was not completely a dragonman.

Fang Yuan created the clone to contend for Dragon Palace; neither transformation moves nor soul possession provided such assurance.

Through painstaking refinement, Fang Yuan forged a matching dragonman soul.

As variant humans, dragonmen naturally possessed unique physical traits.

Rockmen possessed earth path dao marks, snowmen ice and snow path, hairy men refinement path, mermen water path, and dragonmen were born with enslavement path dao marks.

With incomparable enslavement path talent, dragonmen were natural rulers who dominated other lifeforms easily.

Fang Yuan realized: "No wonder Dragon Palace enslaved Di Zang Sheng in the previous life. This Immortal Gu House must belong to enslavement path!"

The dragonman clone was only rank one; the next step was raising it to Gu Immortal, most likely along enslavement path.

"A bit more cultivation, and it will be time to attack." Fang Yuan's eyes blazed.

"Fang Yuan captured so many Southern Border Gu Immortals, extorted countless materials, and commands Lang Ya Sect's refinement path Gu Immortals..."

Fairy Zi Wei closely monitored all news regarding Fang Yuan.

Yet Fang Yuan had gone into hiding and remained unfound.

Approximately half a month later, she obtained some battle information.

Fang Yuan had suddenly appeared in the River of Time, fighting the Four Xunzi.

He had brought a ship-shaped rank eight Immortal Gu House!

# Chapter 1805: First Battle in the River of Time

Immortal Gu House Myriad Year Flying Warship sailed through the River of Time.

Clad in a black robe with hands behind his back, Fang Yuan gazed at the river's endless waves with abyssal eyes.

Fang Yuan had his own plan.

He would keep his rank eight cultivation concealed if possible.

"The secret of my rebirth will likely be exposed after this battle," Fang Yuan estimated.

A pavilion was floating in the River of Time.

It was the rank seven Immortal Gu House Present and Past Pavilion.

Inside stood four Central Continent time path Gu Immortals: the Four Xunzi.

They detected Myriad Year Flying Warship the moment it appeared.

The Four Xunzi immediately reported this to Fairy Zi Wei without delay.

The Four Xunzi did not attack immediately.

Myriad Year Flying Warship drifted slowly as Fang Yuan surveyed all directions from the bow, searching for something.

Heavenly Court.

Fairy Zi Wei was first happy then puzzled.

Killing intent surged within Fairy Zi Wei: "Good, come! Is that rank eight Immortal Gu House your reliance, Fang Yuan?"

Regardless of its strength, Heavenly Court had to probe it and stop Fang Yuan from obtaining Red Lotus' true inheritances.

Fairy Zi Wei quickly ordered Qing Ye to rush Eternal Yacht to Present and Past Pavilion.

"Once Eternal Yacht joins Present and Past Pavilion, they will pincer Fang Yuan!" Fairy Zi Wei's gaze sharpened.

The Four Xunzi also quickly received Fairy Zi Wei's command.

Controlling Present and Past Pavilion, the Four Xunzi stirred waves in the River of Time.

Waves charged toward Myriad Year Flying Warship like countless soldiers.

"Hmm?" Fang Yuan frowned slightly, sensing the anomaly in the river.

Myriad Year Flying Warship's speed greatly shocked the Four Xunzi.

Piercing the waves like a swordfish, Myriad Year Flying Warship charged toward Present and Past Pavilion.

Cloaked in silver-white light, Myriad Year Flying Warship accelerated with each wave collision, thrusting forward like a peerless sword.

Present and Past Pavilion's radiance brightened into a vast pillar of light shooting skyward.

Under the pavilion's influence, the water around Myriad Year Flying Warship abruptly formed a giant whirlpool.

Spinning rapidly, the whirlpool barely immobilized Myriad Year Flying Warship.

The whirlpool accelerated, its waves transforming into sawteeth.

Though trapped at the whirlpool's center, Fang Yuan remained cold and indifferent.

"No, the situation is bad!" Xun Guo Zi suddenly shouted.

The other three looked ahead and saw the sawtooth whirlpool around Myriad Year Flying Warship rapidly transform into silver-white rapids.

The rapids surged beneath Myriad Year Flying Warship, expanding tenfold in seconds.

"Kill." Fang Yuan gave an indifferent command.

Boom!

Like a torrential waterfall or flash flood, the rapids surged and expanded forward.

Propelled by the rapids, Myriad Year Flying Warship shattered the whirlpool, charging toward the Four Xunzi.

# Chapter 1806: Zi Wei At A Loss

In panic, the Four Xunzi pushed Present and Past Pavilion to its limits; its screen billowed smoke and the light pillar turned nearly solid.

Myriad Year Flying Warship neared Present and Past Pavilion.

"Ram it," Fang Yuan sneered, standing arrogantly at the bow.

Swoosh!

Boom!

Myriad Year Flying Warship continued to sweep through the battlefield.

Fang Yuan's side rejoiced as their training bore fruit; this battle destroyed two Immortal Gu Houses and over ten Gu Immortals.

Heavenly Court.

"Fang Yuan controlled a rank eight Immortal Gu House, destroying Present and Past Pavilion and Eternal Yacht, even killing Qing Ye?"

"From the report, Fang Yuan's rank eight Immortal Gu House has limited methods; besides using river water for speed, its greatest asset is physical toughness."

Because during the fight, Fang Yuan instantly neutralized the killer moves and defenses of both Immortal Gu Houses!

Fairy Zi Wei stood up from her seat.

As Fang Yuan anticipated, Fairy Zi Wei was now certain of his rebirth.

"What do we do?"

"Fang Yuan commands a rank eight Immortal Gu House here, while ours are still under construction."

"Fang Yuan entered the river for Red Lotus' true inheritances. If he succeeds, the fallout will far surpass our defeat in Lang Ya blessed land!"

# Chapter 1807: Public Sentiment

Fang Yuan's group returned to Southern Border via a tributary of the River of Time.

"The gains are quite good." Fang Yuan inspected the corpses.

Aside from rank eight Qing Ye, most of these rank seven immortals belonged to Central Continent's ten great ancient sects, lacking Heavenly Court membership and retaining their apertures.

In the coming days, Fang Yuan would inspect these immortal apertures and annex them if safe.

"These spoils are only a bonus; the true value is shedding my passivity and seizing the initiative against Heavenly Court."

Fang Yuan had grasped the timing of this battle well.

"In the previous life, Heavenly Court guarded the River of Time like a fortress. But in this life... hehehe."

"The River of Time is now a must-save battleground for Heavenly Court, the perfect place to bleed and weaken them."

"The secret of my rebirth can no longer be hidden."

Boom!

Guh.

The inkman Gu Immortal sneered down at Fang Yuan: "Wei Yu Shu, weren't you wild? You never expected to fall into my hands, did you? Frankly, neither did I. You lived lavishly and enjoyed the princess's favor, yet were foolish enough to flee. You brought this upon yourself!"

The next moment, Fang Yuan's soul returned to reality, injured.

Drawing on past failures, Fang Yuan gathered the materials and activated a killer move, smoothly clearing the second stage.

In the third stage, Fang Yuan found the dream progressing automatically, beyond his interference.

Radiating rank eight aura, she gazed at Fang Yuan with a mix of anger, hatred, love, and pity.

"Wei Yu Shu, when I bought you, you were just a child ignorant of cultivation!"

"Tell me, why did you betray me?"

After a dazed pause, Wei Yu Shu spoke slowly: "I never minded it before, until I learned that Heavenly Court existed in this world for humans..."

"So you wanted to flee to Heavenly Court?" the female inkman immortal sneered. "Naive fool, you actually believed the temptations of those devils?!"

Wei Yu Shu closed his eyes, his voice hoarse: "It is not that I believe it, but that I want to believe."

She said regretfully: "Yu Shu, I pardoned you many times before, but I cannot now without disgracing my race. Had I not intervened personally, you truly would have escaped. My efforts in raising you were not in vain. In truth, this place lies very close to Heavenly Court's sphere of influence."

As if infused with sudden strength, Wei Yu Shu opened his eyes and stared at the female inkman immortal.

He pleaded: "I have no dying wish except this—please let me crawl out of this cave and look upon Heavenly Court just once."

The female inkman immortal fell silent before sighing: "Alright."

He looked ahead with hope.

However, he only saw dense mist.

Wei Yu Shu, however, seemed to have obtained utmost satisfaction.

He lay powerless on the ground, without the strength to lift his head.

But his eyes shone brightly: "No, I saw it, I saw Heavenly Court."

With those final words, Wei Yu Shu drew his last breath and died.

The female inkman immortal fell silent, gazing quietly toward Heavenly Court.

# Chapter 1811: Daybreak Sword

River of Time.

Shortly after Fang Yuan entered aboard Myriad Year Flying Warship, Gu Liu Ru intercepted him.

Myriad Year Flying Warship blocked the grey-white lights completely.

Yet the explosions shook Myriad Year Flying Warship intensely.

The silver rays condensed into sharp sword blades and shot forth violently.

It actually uses the River of Time's water to extract the sharpest time path power. Though shaped like swords, they are essentially time path dao marks. If hit, I won't escape unharmed!"

The dragonman Gu Immortal continued: "Green Ant Ascetic once lost a bet to Hong Zhen of the ten great ancient sects, agreeing to recruit a disciple to inherit his legacy. The appointed time has arrived, but the ten sects lack a suitable candidate since Hong Zhen died in a tribulation long ago."

"Green Ant Ascetic is a lone cultivator expert. If you become his sole disciple, you will not only learn enslavement path methods, but also build a relationship with the Ascetic Wine Couple. When our race faces difficulties ahead, these two rank eight experts will be a huge help!"

So that's it, I understand now." Fang Yuan paused before continuing: "I will work hard and become the disciple of Green Ant Ascetic.""

The dragonman Gu Immortal nodded: "Good. The ceremony is early next month; enter closed cultivation now so I can train you personally."

The second scene faded away, the third scene started.

Before a thatched hut in a bamboo forest clearing, younger generation members of the ten great ancient sects stood waiting.

Zhang Shuang was currently at a disadvantage against a yellow-eyebrowed girl with beautiful features and bright, double-pupiled eyes.

Having just arrived and unsure of the situation, Fang Yuan probed: "What do you think?"

The azure-scaled youth on his left said: "Wu Shuai, don't look down on us. Though we were eliminated and only you remain, it is obvious Zhang Shuang will lose in a few moves."

Fang Yuan noted: "The azure-scaled youth is Qing Suan and the yellow-scaled one is Huang Wei, while I am already in the finals."

Huang Wei said: "Brother Wu Shuai, I truly admire your enslavement path attainment. But Tai Qin is extraordinary and on par with you, whereas you've fought through many tough rounds to reach this point. Meanwhile, she was basically given free passes every round to reach this stage until she met with the strong opponent Zhang Shuang."

Fang Yuan understood that this double-pupiled, yellow-eyebrowed girl, Tai Qin, was his next opponent.

Observing her, he assessed: "Tai Qin is an enslavement path master. She mobilizes troops on instinct rather than thought, yet achieves outstanding results... a tough foe."

"I lost." A moment later, a pale Zhang Shuang shakily cupped his fists.

"It was an honor." The girl responded coldly, before fixing her gaze on Fang Yuan.

Fang Yuan slowly walked up.

After resting for a while, both sides started to fight.

Ants started to emerge from the ground one by one.

# Chapter 1830: Battle Using Ants

Fang Yuan immediately used his full strength to enslave these ants.

Tai Qin did the same.

After controlling thirty-eight worker ants and six soldier ants, Fang Yuan commanded them to assault Tai Qin with full force.

Tai Qin, commanding over thirty worker ants and five soldier ants, took a different approach, having her workers construct an ant nest while soldier ants guarded them.

Suffering greater losses, Tai Qin retreated slightly under the pressure of Fang Yuan's advancing troops.

By the time she fell back into the incomplete nest, she was reduced to a pitiful twelve ants.

Familiar with her nest's routes, Tai Qin stationed defenders at key positions while continuing to enslave wild ants outside.

Uncertain of the nest's design, Fang Yuan knew a direct attack would be ineffective.

He encircled the nest to guard the entrances, then used enslavement path killer moves to enslave the ants outside.

More ants emerged: first worker ants, followed by soldier ants, and finally arrow ants.

Arrow ants could shoot three sharp spikes from their mouths, after which they were too weak to fight even a worker ant.

Both went all out, but Fang Yuan still held the advantage.

Having just entered the dream realm, Fang Yuan was in prime condition—especially his soul, split from his main body.

In the battle of arrow ants, Tai Qin lost.

Fang Yuan combined his arrow, worker, and soldier ants in seamless cooperation, dividing Tai Qin's forces and forcing her into a passive position.

"Once armor ants appear, I can destroy the nest. Unless cannon ants emerge, my numerical superiority ensures victory." Fang Yuan felt assured of his win.

Tai Qin stared unblinkingly at the battlefield with a stern expression. Recognizing her impending defeat, she still refused to yield.

A few breaths later, acid rain began falling from the green clouds.

Fang Yuan had to pull back his troops and build a nest to hide from the acid rain.

Even when armor ants appeared after the rain, Fang Yuan had already lost the prime opportunity regardless of how many he enslaved.

Before long, Fang Yuan used his deep soul foundation to suppress Tai Qin, winning several skirmishes and pushing her to the brink of defeat.

As Tai Qin rallied her remaining forces for a stubborn stand before a major clash, an ant queen suddenly appeared.

Tai Qin gave her all, enduring backlash from her methods to finally subdue the queen.

Though injured, the queen boosted allied ants' speed, defense, and attack power, greatly increasing Tai Qin's overall strength.

Soon, new ant queens appeared and got captured by both sides.

As such, the battle between them went into a deadlock again.

However, with his rich experience, he gradually gained the upper hand.

Rumble!

Just as Fang Yuan prepared the decisive blow, an earthquake struck, destroying most of his nests and inflicting devastating losses.

Both sides were evenly matched again.

Fang Yuan's gaze turned colder.

Given his luck, he shouldn't be this unlucky even without a connection to his main body.

"Most likely, this dream realm requires me to lose; I cannot defeat Tai Qin."

"Whenever I approach victory, a sudden disruption occurs to strip away my chance of winning."

"Then should I hold back and just lose?"

# Chapter 1831: Heavenly Court Notices

Heavenly Court.

Qin Ding Ling hovered in the air with an extremely solemn expression.

"Go!" Golden light burst from her like a five-tailed peacock, spreading its wings in flight.

Reaching a specific area in the sky, the golden light exploded into countless glittering specks.

Within the light specks, a huge tunnel was vaguely seen.

Beside her, Fairy Zi Wei gasped in shock: "There really was a tunnel here!"

Qin Ding Ling breathed deeply and sighed: "Too close! Had I not soul-searched Zhao Lian Yun to learn of Giant Sun's All Living Beings Luck inheritance, my own attainment would never have uncovered his arrangements here."

Duke Long snorted coldly: "Giant Sun Immortal Venerable harbored ill intentions, laying this hidden path while touring Heavenly Court back then. His luck path inheritance is so profound that even Heavenly Court failed to detect it. Yet heaven's will favors us—Fairy Qin awakened at the crucial moment to expose his devious scheme."

Fairy Zi Wei's eyes shone brightly: "Now that we've discovered it early, we can dismantle it or even use it to ambush Northern Plains. That will greatly aid the upcoming Central Continent Refinement Path Convention."

Bringing up Fang Yuan, Fairy Zi Wei frowned: "Despite our heavy defenses along the River of Time, there is no sign of him. He has Myriad Year Flying Warship but does not show much interest in Red Lotus' true inheritance. Is it because we cannot detect his traces or..."

At the mention of Red Lotus's true inheritance, Duke Long frowned: "Let us assume the worst—treat it as though Fang Yuan has already obtained it."

"To subdue Fang Yuan, the focus remains on Gu Yue Fang Zheng." Qin Ding Ling smiled.

Backed by Heavenly Court's arrangements and resources, Gu Yue Fang Zheng's strength grew rapidly.

Immortal killer move — Blood Turns Cold!

Three desolate beasts slowed until they froze and collapsed to the ground, grunting.

Zhao Lian Yun fought beside him, remarking: "Blood path killer moves are truly powerful."

Fang Zheng cupped his fists: "It is thanks to your help, Fairy, that I have had so many opportunities for real combat."

While speaking, Gu Yue Fang Zheng stored the three desolate beasts into his immortal aperture.

Yet inside the desolate beasts' cave lay a secret tunnel.

Following the tunnel into an Earth Trench, "Oh, there's a blessed land here?!" Before long, Fang Zheng noticed an anomaly.

Zhao Lian Yun noticed it too and gasped: "This blessed land is facing a tribulation—damage created a loophole, exposing it to the outside world. It is so coincidental that we came at this exact moment, otherwise, if the blessed land's entrance is shut, even if it were right in front of us, we would not be able to notice it."

"Let's go take a look." Fang Zheng spoke with slight excitement.

Entering easily, they found the blessed land plunged into chaos by a grand tribulation.

Though low in cultivation, neither was an ordinary Gu Immortal; their potent methods quickly stabilized the situation.

Upon inquiry, Fang Zheng discovered that the blessed land's inhabitants were dragonmen, not humans.

"Dragonmen? What variant human race is this? I've never heard of it." Fang Zheng was puzzled.

Having served as Spirit Affinity House's fairy for some time, Zhao Lian Yun frowned: "Dragonmen are indeed a variant human race, but we are in trouble now."

As expected, Gu Immortals descended soon after.

Fang Zheng and Zhao Lian Yun recognized them as Fairy Zi Wei and Qin Ding Ling.

"Fang Zheng, you have made another great contribution. Your task here is finished; you may leave." Qin Ding Ling smiled, sending them away.

Fairy Zi Wei soon uncovered the truth: "This blessed land belongs to Duke Long's grandson, Wu Shuai. No wonder it stayed hidden so long, deceiving even Lord Duke Long."

"These dragonmen matter little, but this blessed land contains clues to the Immortal Gu House Dragon Palace! Senior Qin, Fang Zheng is truly our lucky star!"

Heavenly Court's search for Dragon Palace had yielded slow progress, but solving this crucial clue would allow them to deduce its exact location.

Qin Ding Ling warned: "Fang Zheng is heaven's will's counter against Fang Yuan. This discovery means Fang Yuan is already trying to obtain Dragon Palace."

Fairy Zi Wei dared not waste time, returning to Heavenly Court immediately to begin deductions.

# Chapter 1832: Changing Duke Long's Luck

Deep in Eastern Sea, the next scene of Dragon Palace's dream realm unfolded.

"Senior brother, here I come!" shouted the yellow-eyebrowed girl, sending her army to assault Fang Yuan's troops.

"Sigh! I lost again, senior brother, you are truly amazing!" The girl exhaled, blushing with glittering eyes.

Fang Yuan saw this and understood why.

Over subsequent scenes, Green Ant Ascetic passed down his teachings. Fang Yuan acquired numerous Gu worms while frequently sparring with Junior Sister Tai Qin.

Observing the dragonman clone's luck, Fang Yuan noted: "Good, my clone is making smooth progress in the dream realm."

The purple dragon luck had expanded severalfold, while the surrounding black clouds shrank by thirty percent.

Just then, a blood-red light swept in from the west.

Colossal in size, the blood-red light hovered over the purple dragon without merging into the black clouds.

Within the blood-red light, faint silhouettes of a golden phoenix and divine dragon radiated a threatening aura.

"What is happening? What changed?" Fang Yuan's heart sank.

"This blood light luck is over tenfold larger than before! Approaching from the west of Eastern Sea means Western Desert or Central Continent."

"Its restraint indicates the time has not come to strike. Such massive scale must belong to Central Continent's Heavenly Court!"

"How did Heavenly Court find their way here?"

"They never arrived this early in my previous life. Is this the ink effect of my rebirth?"

Heavenly Court.

Fairy Zi Wei paused, a flash of joy across her face: "I deduced it after all."

She grasped the location of Immortal Gu House Dragon Palace!

"Dragon Palace must be retrieved. This is my karma, let me take it back." Duke Long took responsibility for the matter.

Fairy Zi Wei's expression changed as she received information: "Oh no, Myriad Year Flying Warship has appeared in the River of Time, Fang Yuan is acting again!"

Qin Ding Ling first examined Duke Long; his luck was dragon-shaped, resembling a flaming cloud.

The old dragon coiled with lowered head, about to sleep—a sign that Duke Long's lifespan was ending.

Observing closely, Qin Ding Ling grunted; the old dragon's scales were turning blood-red, and its wrinkled head showed an inverted 'mountain' character—symbolizing failure!

Qin Ding Ling was shocked: "Someone in this world can make Duke Long fail?"

Her vision turned blood-red as her luck inspection killer move was forcibly stopped, the backlash making her cough up blood.

Bleeding from her eyes, Qin Ding Ling smiled bitterly: "Senior Duke Long, your dao marks are so numerous my killer move could only catch a glimpse before facing backlash."

"It was tough on you." Duke Long asked: "How is the result?"

Qin Ding Ling shook her head worriedly: "Not good, Senior Duke Long will face an intense battle if you go, with a chance of failure."

"The world is vast and unpredictable," Duke Long said. "How interesting—I wonder what could make me fail."

Qin Ding Ling added: "Luck is merely a variable. I cultivate all living beings luck and can alter your luck, Senior Duke Long, but I need a few days."

"Very well, I will wait a few days then." Duke Long decided.

# Chapter 1833: Qi Sea Ancestor

In the dream realm.

"Senior brother, was yesterday's dinner delicious?" After Green Ant Ascetic's lesson, junior sister Tai Qin approached Fang Yuan, asking expectantly.

At this time, a dragonman Gu Immortal appeared: "My son."

"Father, why are you here?" Fang Yuan was surprised.

The dragonman Gu Immortal smiled at the girl: "You must be Tai Qin. My son mentions you often; please accept this small gift."

"Take it, my father has come for important businesses, our lesson today has to end here." Fang Yuan apologized.

"Such a pure, innocent girl. Son, are you interested?" Once Tai Qin left, the dragonman Gu Immortal joked.

Realizing the dream realm had shifted again, Fang Yuan smiled cautiously: "Father, don't you understand me well enough?"

The dragonman Gu Immortal laughed: "Calligraphy Pavilion Lady's daughter, Shu Jiu Ling, is holding an open contest to find a husband. Any outstanding youth can participate—I want you to join."

Shu Jiu Ling had loved Gu Immortal Fan Ji and carried his child, but he made endless excuses and refused to marry her.

Calligraphy Pavilion Lady was a rank eight lone cultivator leader in Central Continent who owned the Immortal Gu House Calligraphy Pavilion.

He thought: "The dragonman race seeks independence and strength, possessing great ambition. This is a great opportunity. Calligraphy Pavilion Lady is a rank eight lone immortal opposing Black Heaven Temple. If I become her son-in-law, I can draw her to the dragonman race's side."

"Yet junior sister Tai Qin's affection for me is growing; doing this would let her down and deeply upset her." Fang Yuan felt guilty.

Suddenly jolting, he realized: "Wait, what happened to me? This is a dream realm—I am Fang Yuan, not Wu Shuai. Why am I feeling guilt?"

"What a powerful dream realm, it actually affected my emotions!"

"The last few scenes were stable and safe, yet they subtly influenced me until I was actually affected."

Normally, Fang Yuan kept his body outside while his soul entered dream realms, maintaining a clear distinction as he moved between them.

Now, however, the clone had entered with body and soul. Though clarity returned, his emotions had genuinely been affected.

This was a forewarning of danger.

The greatest danger in dream realms was losing oneself. Emotions were the deadliest snare, dragging the dreamer deeper until the realm devoured him.

River of Time.

Riding the massive wave, a flying boat sped like a silver ray of light at lightning speed.

And behind Myriad Year Flying Warship, five Immortal Gu Houses chased relentlessly.

As Moment Stage and four rank seven Immortal Gu Houses joined the assault, Bai Ning Bing's side fought while retreating.

A few days later.

As Duke Long prepared to set out, a pale Qin Ding Ling and Fairy Zi Wei saw him off.

Weakened from altering Duke Long's luck, Qin Ding Ling remained behind to recuperate.

Fairy Zi Wei stayed in Heavenly Court to oversee the situation and guard against a sneak attack by Longevity Heaven.

"The battle in the River of Time has lasted days without Fang Yuan appearing. With Feng Jiu Ge's Dao Guardian luck offsetting our luck disadvantage, we hold the upper hand."

"Yes." Fairy Zi Wei said solemnly: "Fang Zheng is ready inside Immortal Crane Sect's Pine Crane Pavilion, already stationed along Lord Duke Long's route."

"Good." Duke Long nodded, transforming into purple dragon-shaped qi and vanishing on the spot.

Fang Yuan inspected his clone's luck again.

The clone's purple dragon luck had multiplied, swimming freely within the black clouds.

Half the black cloud had turned azure-purple, indicating a much higher chance that Fang Yuan would become Dragon Palace's Lord.

Above the black cloud luck, massive blood-light luck was already bearing down in close proximity.

Within the blood light, the golden phoenix phantom had vanished, leaving only a huge, menacing purple dragon.

"It seems only my main body can stop this variable," Fang Yuan realized.

"Oh? He's here." The next moment, his eyes gleamed brightly.

In immemorial white heaven, an Immortal Gu House flew closer—Immortal Crane Sect's Pine Crane Pavilion!

Inhaling deeply, Fang Yuan activated his battlefield killer move.

"What?!" Inside Pine Crane Pavilion, Fang Zheng was shocked as his vision warped and he was instantly trapped.

"A rank eight killer move!" Fang Zheng paled; Pine Crane Pavilion was merely rank six—how could it block such an attack?

At the crucial moment, a figure appeared.

Instead of meeting Fang Zheng, Duke Long had followed secretly while directing him toward Eastern Sea in Pine Crane Pavilion.

Duke Long pushed with his palms, shattering the surrounding qi currents.

"Who is it? Come out!" Duke Long shouted.

"I am Qi Sea Ancestor." Fang Yuan appeared under a transformed guise.

# Chapter 1834: Fang Yuan Fights Duke Long

Fang Zheng stared at the person who had nearly taken his life—Qi Sea Ancestor.

The old man wore fluttering white robes, his beard reaching his feet, exuding a grand, transcendent aura amid drifting clouds.

Failing to recognize Fang Yuan's disguise, Fang Zheng wondered: "This old man is rank eight, yet isn't any known great expert of Eastern Sea. Who is he?"

Duke Long smiled: "Qi Sea Ancestor... as a rank eight, calling yourself ancestor is fine. But claiming 'Qi Sea' before me is far too arrogant."

Duke Long demanded: "You clearly harbor ill intent. What is your motive for ambushing us here, and what is your relationship with Fang Yuan?"

Fang Yuan was slightly surprised, thinking: "How did he connect my identity to Fang Yuan in this situation?"

Fang Yuan smiled coldly: "I am a secluded Eastern Sea cultivator, but Heavenly Court seeks to unify the five regions and will try to kill me in the future."

Duke Long frowned slightly: "Qi Sea Ancestor, you must have been deceived by that demon Fang Yuan. We bear no grudges and have never met—why would Heavenly Court attack you?"

Fang Yuan snorted: "He revealed my secrets with concrete proof. He comes from the future—should I believe him or you?"

Duke Long's frown became even deeper.

Had Fang Yuan targeted Heavenly Court's past or present actions, Duke Long could counter with evidence. But regarding future actions, even Duke Long could not be certain!

Duke Long reasoned: "Since Fang Yuan convinced Qi Sea Ancestor to obstruct us, Heavenly Court likely did attack him in the future. Words are useless now."

Duke Long sighed inwardly. Since Qi Sea Ancestor was sent to obstruct him, Fang Yuan was likely going after Dragon Palace right now.

"I must end this battle quickly!" Duke Long's eyes flashed with resolve.

Fang Yuan managed to deceive him after all.

The deception succeeded through Familiar Face adapted to qi path methods and a genuine rank eight aura.

Duke Long thought that Fang Yuan was a rank seven Gu Immortal.

Immortal killer move — Dragon Claw Strike!

Guarded inside his immortal battlefield, Fang Yuan easily dodged the claw mark.

As he probed, this qi path battlefield heavily suppressed transformation path methods.

Air currents moved as protective bubbles enveloped Pine Crane Pavilion.

Duke Long activated another killer move, pushing his palms forward to unleash multiple qi dragons.

The semi-transparent qi dragons moved rapidly, set to attack automatically once they located Fang Yuan.

A grand thousand-foot blade qi, thick as a deity's warblade, slammed down with force capable of cleaving the world in two!

The storm-whipping blade qi dwarfed Duke Long's qi dragons into mere earthworms, terrifying Fang Zheng.

At the crucial moment, Duke Long shouted and used his killer move.

Though qi wall was the most common qi path defensive killer move, Duke Long's method was extraordinary.

The qi wall expanded twice into a dense fusion of three qi walls, vastly increasing in thickness and toughness.

The blade qi struck the qi wall with an intense, thunderous explosion.

The qi wall collapsed while the blade qi largely dispersed, its remnants unable to cause threatening damage.

Duke Long was unscathed, but his expression grew solemn, his relaxed mood gone.

He looked up toward Fang Yuan, who stood far off high in the sky.

Duke Long called out: "An unrefined blade qi packed with raw power. But how many times can you use it?"

Fang Yuan smiled, he was calm and composed.

"Just a casual attack." Fang Yuan tapped his finger toward Pine Crane Pavilion.

Boom!

Another grand blade qi gathered and shot out with imposing might.

With two more taps of his finger, a third blade qi shot out with equal power, even larger than the previous ones.

"This..." Duke Long was stunned; unleashing such blade qi was as effortless for his enemy as drinking water.

With over a million qi path dao marks amplified by the battlefield, such devastating power was completely reasonable for Fang Yuan.

"To think Eastern Sea harbored such a character! How interesting." Fierce battle intent surged within Duke Long.

The three blade qi approached rapidly with unstoppable might.

Duke Long unleashed an overwhelming aura: "It has been so long since I had a challenging battle!"

Dragon roars sounded as he charged straight toward the blade qi!

While Fang Yuan and Duke Long clashed fiercely, the dream realm in the sea remained quiet and tranquil.

A moment later, it was time to separate.

"Junior sister, I must go. I cannot defy my father—I have a family now. It has been hard on you." The clone kissed Tai Qin goodbye.

Tai Qin shook her head: "You were forced into this, while I chose it willingly. I will always be here for you."

When dragonman clone returned to Calligraphy Pavilion, it was already midnight.

From the shadows, a dragonman Gu Immortal flew up to meet him in secret.

"Brother, sister-in-law secretly met with Fan Ji again while you were away," the dragonman Gu Immortal reported with displeasure.

"Hmph, that slut." With a grim expression, intense rage surged in the dragonman clone's heart.

# Chapter 1835: Snapped In Two

"Wait, this is just a dream realm—why should I feel hatred?" The dragonman clone quickly regained clarity.

Instead of cold sweat, he felt a pair of warm, coral-like dragon horns on his forehead.

He felt a deep chill in his heart!

"Brother, what do we do now?" the dragonman informant asked again.

Time progressed rapidly across several dream scenes; Fang Yuan was already a Gu Immortal.

Fang Yuan snorted coldly: "A little impatience spoils great plans. We will continue to pretend we know nothing."

"The higher my cultivation level, the more easily I succumb to this dream realm."

"After staying in this dream realm so long, I almost believed I was Wu Shuai."

"Or maybe... this is the true test of Dragon Palace?"

In a flash of inspiration, Fang Yuan's clone realized the truth.

The dream realm was not merely testing him—it was creating an inheritor.

After enduring such brainwashing to pass the dream realm, any candidate would emerge hating Heavenly Court and devoted to revitalizing the dragonman race.

"Those four Eastern Sea rank eights likely failed this dream realm, their minds warped into dragon generals!"

"What do I do?"

"The deeper I explore, the worse it gets! Failing makes me a dragon general; winning remolds me into Dragon Palace's Lord, prioritizing the dragonmen over my main body!"

Realizing this, Fang Yuan's clone felt his heart turn cold.

Regardless of success or failure, neither outcome favored him!

Fang Yuan's clone did not know whether to laugh or cry at falling into Dragon Palace's trap.

"I must stall for time until my main body notices and saves me." Unbeknownst to the clone, Fang Yuan's main body was currently locked in fierce combat with Duke Long.

An intense explosion whipped up a strong shockwave.

Duke Long's dragon scales shone as he shouted with blazing eyes: "Qi Sea Ancestor, attacking the weak lacks the bearing of a great expert."

Fang Yuan laughed: "Attacking weakness is my style. Furthermore, who is inside that you protect them time and again?"

At that moment, waves of dragon roars resounded within the dense fog.

Following the roars, gathering clouds transformed into giant dragon qi currents.

Spiral currents expanded like oceanic undercurrents, dividing the battlefield and devouring the surrounding fog.

Duke Long laughed heartily, his prior anger vanishing; he had merely been acting to stall for time.

"This move is called reverse worm dragon, I only succeeded after ten years of practicing it. You were wise not to attack immediately—any qi path method will only nourish them from worms to dragons, raising their power a hundredfold until they are unstoppable," Duke Long explained plainly.

He explained solely to deter Fang Yuan from attacking while charging his own powerful killer move.

"This reverse worm dragon seems created to counter battlefield killer moves. These worms are troublesome enough; evolving into dragons would make them even stronger."

"But so what?"

Thinking of this, Fang Yuan smiled arrogantly, he attacked.

Blade qi gathered and slashed down again.

As expected, the blade qi struck the spiral currents and was largely absorbed.

The currents swelled and exploded, fusing into a majestic divine dragon that filled the battlefield.

Fang Yuan spoke slowly and calmly: "So this is turning worm into dragon. It is powerful, but... not enough."

Qi path killer move — Yin-yang Great Killer Hands!

With a loud explosion, two huge hands, one black and one white, appeared out of nowhere.

The two giant hands seized the qi dragon's neck and tail.

The huge dragon growled and struggled violently, but the giant hands remained unmoving as metal.

Fang Yuan pulled with both hands from afar.

The huge dragon was snapped directly in two by him, unable to resist.

Fang Yuan flexed his fingers and looked at Duke Long, saying plainly: "Alright, I'm done warming up."

Duke Long turned solemn, his dragon pupils glowing with domineering light as he stared fixedly at Fang Yuan.

Baring sharp white teeth, he said: "Great, it seems... you are truly a worthy opponent."

# Chapter 1836: Steal Life Hits Duke Long

Dream realm.

At the same time, in immemorial white heaven.

Immortal killer move — Steal Life!

# Chapter 1837: Duke Long Recruiting Fang Yuan

Duke Long was hit by the killer move steal life!

Yet Fang Yuan's expression sank slightly when Duke Long remained completely unaffected.

Recovering quickly, Fang Yuan asked casually: "Why did Steal Life have no effect on you?"

Duke Long stated plainly: "My killer move heavenly dragon's last stand drains my lifespan for strength and prevents all lifespan alterations. Steal Life affects lifespan dao marks, hence it failed."

"I see." Fang Yuan smiled: "It remains effective against other Heavenly Court immortals. I will save it for later."

Duke Long spoke warmly: "Qi Sea Ancestor, neither of us can defeat the other—why fight so intensely?"

Fang Yuan's thoughts stirred as he asked: "Oh, Duke Long, you want a truce?"

Fang Yuan countered: "Heavenly Court provoked me first. I cultivate in seclusion, yet you greedily seek to conquer the world. You plotted and gathered numerous rank eights to besiege me in the future."

Fang Yuan laughed mockingly: "Doesn't Heavenly Court defend heaven's will and repair fate? Seeking to change the future—isn't that defying fate itself?"

Duke Long smiled: "The Heavenly Dao wills humanity to rule, and fate Gu defends the human race. Qi Sea Ancestor, we can coexist in peace. On Heavenly Court's behalf, I propose mutual non-interference!"

At the battlefield's edge, the two Eastern Sea rank eight Gu Immortals heard this, their expressions changing.

Shen Cong Sheng gasped in dismay, while Song Qi Yuan looked equally grim.

"An alliance with Heavenly Court?" Fang Yuan feigned surprise, halting his actions and suppressing his aura.

Duke Long added: "Heavenly Court can even compensate you for potential future losses."

Song Qi Yuan shouted: "Harboring grand ambitions, Heavenly Court merely wants to stabilize the situation—Senior, do not trust them!"

"Indeed, Senior! We were rash earlier and ruined your plans, which we deeply regret," Shen Cong Sheng added.

"Furthermore, alliance agreements can be broken at any price. Heavenly Court cannot be trusted," Song Qi Yuan warned.

Duke Long replied: "Friend Qi Sea holds Steal Life, our weakness. With such restriction in place, why would we break our agreement?"

The Eastern Sea immortals urgently argued that repairing fate Gu would make Heavenly Court unstoppable, warning Qi Sea not to yield.

Fang Yuan smiled inwardly, letting them speak for him while silently watching Duke Long.

Shen Cong Sheng smiled coldly: "Lord Duke Long, why not let us speak? Did we hit a nerve?"

Duke Long scoffed: "Without Heavenly Court, humanity would not exist today. If heaven's will could kill directly, we would have unified the regions long ago!"

"I might as well raise the offer: Friend Qi Sea, why not join Heavenly Court? Reaching such strength after cultivating alone shows your immense talent. Yet a lone cultivator faces terrifying tribulations. Who in Eastern Sea can match you or help you? In fact, these two even ruined your qi path battlefield earlier."

"Join Heavenly Court, and our immortal graveyard and wisdom path expert Fairy Zi Wei will assist your tribulations and deductions. Heavenly Court possesses Primordial Origin's inheritance—with contributions, you could even obtain his true inheritance!"

# Chapter 1838: Fighting For Fang Yuan's Support

Dragon Palace dream realm.

The day Wu Shuai reached rank seven, he became the dragonman race's youngest supreme elder with real authority.

# Chapter 1840: Dragon Court

Resolute and farsighted, Wu Shuai led the dragonman race to grow increasingly stronger.

On Duke Long's birthday, there was a huge celebration.

Duke Long looked at Wu Shuai coldly: "You are accomplished, but remember that going too far is detrimental."

The night of the celebration, Duke Long secretly summoned Wu Shuai to his study.

"Return that South Flower Island to them." Duke Long said openly.

Wu Shuai forced a smile: "Grandfather, I won South Flower Island fair and square as our home."

Duke Long stared piercingly at him: "Wu Shuai, do not think no one sees your tricks! South Flower Island belonged to Wind Cloud Manor, but you schemed to snatch it. What are you plotting? Isn't staying in the sect fine? Why must you relocate all the way to South Flower Island? Tell me, what is it that you want?"

Wu Shuai replied: "Grandfather, I have no grand ambition; I only want my people to live better."

"A better life? You mean a greater ambition!" Duke Long's voice resounded.

Wu Shuai shuddered: "Even if it is ambition, Grandfather, don't we have the right to strive?"

"Why stay here? Grandfather, don't you see how those human Gu Immortals ostracize and exploit us?"

"What ostracism? I have only seen your recklessness. Do you know why I like Little Seventh the most? Because he sees the world's beauty and is genuinely kind, never minding the difference between human and dragonman. But you? You use my name to seize territory and resources. Stop this immediately!" Duke Long shouted coldly.

"What human, what dragonman, dragonman is human to begin with, what difference is there?!" Duke Long chided.

"If there is no difference, what are these horns and tail?" Wu Shuai shouted. "Grandfather, you lived most of your life as a human and only became a dragonman recently."

"But us?"

"From childhood, human kids mocked my appearance, ostracized me, and pulled my scales. Everything proved to me that I am not part of this human race!"

"Man is the spirit of all living beings, but us dragonmen are not inferior. We are born with enslavement dao marks, superior physiques, and tough scales that ordinary humans cannot harm. Even more exceptional is our long lifespan—humans die so quickly compared to us."

"Many Gu Immortals become dragonmen for lifespan, yet still look down on us out of outdated prejudice."

"Enough!" Duke Long slammed the table, his face extremely dark.

Wu Shuai endured Duke Long's oppressive gaze: "Not enough. You created dragonmen, our ancestor. Why do you constantly side with humans? We are your family! I will not surrender South Flower Island. If you insist, Grandfather, end my life first."

With that, Wu Shuai turned and walked out of the room without looking at Duke Long.

With Wind Cloud Manor wary of Duke Long, the sect did not intervene, allowing Wu Shuai to relocate to South Flower Island.

"After a hundred years, my plan finally succeeds!" Looking at the Immortal Gu House before him, Wu Shuai shed tears of joy and excitement.

Wu Shuai's father stood beside him, having an incredulous expression: "You actually succeeded! My son, you are more capable than me."

"Despite sect suppression on South Flower Island, I continuously secured resources. With our immortals' contributions, this rank seven Immortal Gu House is finally created." Wu Shuai smiled: "Give me a few hundred more years, I might be able to make this a rank eight Immortal Gu House."

"I overruled all suggestions and named it—Dragon Court!" Wu Shuai's voice rose with pride.

"Dragon Court?" Wu Shuai's father heard this and his expression changed: "Isn't this too... inappropriate?"

"Hahaha, why is it inappropriate? It complements Heavenly Court!" Wu Shuai laughed loudly.

"Reconsider, son. To human Gu Immortals, Dragon Court is a blatant sign of rebellion."

"Father," Wu Shuai raised his hand: "I have decided—it shall be called Dragon Court!"

# Chapter 1841: Renowned in the World, Promising a Future

Though covered in injuries, Song Tao Zi's powerful aura firmly suppressed Wu Shuai.

Suddenly, a huge castle appeared—Dragon Court!

Dragon Court approached as Wu Shuai's voice resounded: "Song Tao Zi, kneel down and beg for mercy, I will spare your life."

Pale with rage, Song Tao Zi spat: "Don't even think about it! A mere dragonman dares humiliate me?!"

Within Dragon Court, Wu Shuai laughed coldly and drove the castle straight at him.

From hovering Dragon Court, Wu Shuai shouted: "This was a public life-and-death duel. If anyone has objections, step forward!"

"Congratulations, brother! After this, no one will contest South Flower Island," Huang Wei toasted in excitement.

Wu Shuai declared aloud: "Our duel was attested by all. Song Tao Zi died in combat—I assume Wind Cloud Manor has no objections?"

Flushing, the Wind Cloud Manor envoy stood: "Since this was agreed upon, we will not contest it!"

Calligraphy Pavilion Lady arrived with her daughter, Shu Jiu Ling.

Rank eight Green Ant Ascetic also arrived, approvingly visiting his disciple Wu Shuai.

After the banquet, Calligraphy Pavilion Lady left her daughter Shu Jiu Ling behind.

"You have been separated long; you should stay together," she said with deep meaning.

That night, Wu Shuai left her alone: "Rest first, I have work to settle."

Wu Shuai was not busy at all; he was meeting Tai Qin.

"Junior sister, I have come."

"Brother Shuai, I thought you were not coming today."

"You know your importance to me; that woman cannot compare to a single strand of your hair."

Delighted, Tai Qin asked worriedly: "Brother Shuai, you killed Wind Cloud Manor's signature expert—will they let this go?"

"Of course not, but so what?" Wu Shuai sneered. Gazing at the moon, he sighed: "I realized the truth."

"In this world, strength is everything. The rank eights attended only because I own the Immortal Gu House Dragon Court. Even though I have rank seven cultivation level, I can use this house to fight rank eight, this is my foundation, I am now qualified to talk to them."

"When I reach rank eight and elevate Dragon Court, let us see who dares look down on me!"

Wu Shuai caressed her hair gently: "Junior sister, I will give you happiness. Calligraphy Pavilion Lady is still a threat, but when I become rank eight, I will give you a proper status."

"I want to have children with you and enjoy watching our descendants grow up together."

# Chapter 1842: Uprising Plan, Stealing Fate

Over the next few decades, conflicts between dragonmen and humans intensified as they clashed more fiercely.

Duke Long learned of this and summoned Wu Shuai.

Duke Long ordered him to confess his crimes, step down as lord of South Flower Island, and rename Dragon Court to Dragon Palace.

Gu Liang came to visit.

"Wu Shuai, I heard about South Flower Island. Why admit to those crimes? Is there any way I can help?"

Wu Shuai sighed deeply: "Gu Liang, this was ordered by Ancestor Duke Long. I have no choice but to obey."

Wu Shuai said: "Truthfully, when I killed Song Tao Zi, I thought our race would rise. But decades later, I am trapped in quicksand, facing pressure from all directions with little progress."

Gu Liang said: "I have a method to solve your problem."

"It is simple. You worry about dragonman morale since South Flower Island is our banner. But what if you advance to rank eight now?"

"Advance to rank eight? Of course I want to! But even with Dragon Court, the final tribulation..." Wu Shuai hesitated.

"Hahaha, years of leadership have made you fearful. Worrying over your importance to the race has stripped away your courage. I will help you pass the final tribulation and become a true rank eight Gu Immortal!" Gu Liang said, his aura transforming from rank seven to rank eight.

Gu Liang raised a hand to stop Wu Shuai: "Let us speak as friends. Truly, I approached you with my own motives—Central Continent is too dominant, while the other four regions are weak. As an Eastern Sea Gu Immortal, I welcome internal conflict in Central Continent. Yet beyond that, I truly appreciate and admire you. In truth, we are quite alike."

With Gu Liang's extraordinary strength, Wu Shuai passed the tribulation safely.

Gu Liang shared deep secrets: "Heavenly Court's foundation is fate Gu. Two Demon Venerables attacked Heavenly Court but failed because Star Constellation's assimilation preserved its foundation."

"However, while Star Constellation's assimilation preserved Heavenly Court's reign, it infuriated the Heavenly Dao. The way of heaven is balance, yet humanity is flourishing without restraint. This defies true heaven's will!"

Gu Liang told him: "For the dragonmen to rise, you must target the source of everything!"

"The source? Fate Gu?" Wu Shuai smiled bitterly. "Fate Gu is strictly guarded by Heavenly Court; it is too difficult."

Wu Shuai was moved: "You are referring to that person... Red Lotus?"

"That's right. Heavenly Court wanted to nurture Red Lotus into an Immortal Venerable, but he chose to defy them. Your ancestor Duke Long is so troubled over this that he has relaxed control over the dragonman race. You should thank Red Lotus for reducing the pressure on you," Gu Liang said.

Gu Liang laughed: "To revive his family and lover, Red Lotus must defy the Heavenly Dao and fate. This irreconcilable conflict made him turn against his teacher, and Duke Long cannot sway him back. Red Lotus will definitely attack Heavenly Court to destroy fate Gu. When he attacks, that will be our opportunity to act."

Wu Shuai realized: "I understand. We must infiltrate Heavenly Court to gather intelligence. When Red Lotus attacks, we'll seize the chance to steal fate Gu!"

# Chapter 1843: Making Sacrifices

Wu Shuai displayed a repentant attitude, winning favor from the ten great ancient sects while seeking every opportunity to approach Heavenly Court.

A century later, despite some success, Wu Shuai still could not gain Heavenly Court's trust.

"What should I do?" an anxious Wu Shuai asked Gu Liang.

Gu Liang said: "Heavenly Court is deeply wary of variant humans and looks down on them. Our only hope is Duke Long—we must target him."

"How do I gain Duke Long's trust? His impression of me is..." Wu Shuai smiled bitterly as he shook his head.

Gu Liang looked at Wu Shuai solemnly: "It depends on whether you can make sacrifices."

Wu Shuai answered without hesitation: "I've planned for the dragonman race all along. What if I must make sacrifices?"

Gu Liang presented his plan, but Wu Shuai hesitated—Gu Liang was asking him to deliberately sacrifice Huang Wei!

Huang Wei had followed Wu Shuai since youth, laboring loyally to develop South Flower Island and never wavering in devotion.

Gu Liang urged: "If you publicly sacrifice your closest general to defend human interests, Duke Long will finally believe your loyalty!"

"You want me to kill my greatest general, the person who trusts and idolizes me most..." Wu Shuai gritted his teeth in hesitation and reluctance.

"If Huang Wei knew the purpose of his sacrifice, he would surely agree. Am I right?" Gu Liang's words eased much of Wu Shuai's hesitation.

Wu Shuai sighed deeply, eyes reddening: "I know Huang Wei. If he knew the plan, he would definitely sacrifice himself."

"No!" Gu Liang interjected. "This plan is too crucial—only the two of us can know. Even the dead can be investigated for evidence; Huang Wei cannot know our plan."

"This..." Wu Shuai closed his eyes and shook his head. "Let me think, let me think..."

He hesitated for half a year before finally making up his mind.

Wu Shuai and Gu Liang secretly plotted, killing human Gu Immortals and gathering evidence to frame Huang Wei.

Huang Wei cried out his innocence: "I didn't do this, brother! You know me, I would never do that!"

Wu Shuai initially defended Huang Wei, but as more evidence surfaced, he had to 'uphold justice' and execute him.

The ten great ancient sects praised Wu Shuai greatly. Even Duke Long nodded in approval upon hearing this: "He has matured greatly over the years; I am pleased."

Before the execution, Huang Wei's last words were etched into Wu Shuai's heart, unforgettable in this lifetime—

"Brother, I never regretted following you! Whatever your reason to execute me, I accept it! But I did not do this. You must be careful—those human Gu Immortals are deceiving you. These years, they haven't moved against you directly; instead, they framed me to eliminate me and gradually clip your wings."

"Brother, I won't live to see the future of the dragonman race. Though I die, carry on this dream—the dragonman race cannot succeed without you!"

Wu Shuai snorted coldly: "Huang Wei, you committed murder yet refuse to confess. I trusted you in vain—you have disappointed and hurt me deeply."

"Brother!" Kneeling on the cold prison floor, Huang Wei watched Wu Shuai leave and shouted: "Let me call you that one last time! Don't forget the grand aspiration of our dragonman race!"

Thereafter, Wu Shuai began entering and leaving Heavenly Court regularly.

Once, Heavenly Court decided to build Central Heaven Gate.

Duke Long's reaction was within Wu Shuai's expectations: "Wu Shuai, I appreciate your willingness. But Central Heaven Gate is an information path Immortal Gu House, while Dragon Palace is enslavement path; it is inappropriate. Furthermore, with Heavenly Court's foundation, we do not need your personal wealth."

Wu Shuai petitioned to assist with the project. Duke Long laughed: "Alright, you and your father will oversee Central Heaven Gate's construction."

As building Central Heaven Gate required vast resources, Gu Liang offered his assistance.

He told Wu Shuai: "This is our chance to install a backdoor into Central Heaven Gate while probing Heavenly Court's secrets."

Just as his hard work was yielding results, an accident occurred.

His father returned gravely injured from Heavenly Court and summoned Wu Shuai before dying.

"I contacted fate Gu, my son! I received its revelation—we dragonmen will reign supreme, dragonmen will reign supreme!!" Wu Shuai's father gripped his hand tightly in immense excitement.

"What?!" A stunned Wu Shuai asked, tongue-tied: "Father, what happened?"

His father gasped: "When discovered, I deliberately sabotaged the construction, using the backlash as an excuse to escape Heavenly Court and reach you."

"Dragonmen reign supreme! Our race is destined to hold heavenly fate and replace humanity! This is fate Gu's revelation—it is absolute truth!" Wu Shuai's father's eyes shone. "Do you realize what this means? Heal me quickly and spread the news! The dragonman Gu Immortals will be thrilled!"

"Father, rest and recuperate; I will handle this." Wu Shuai was equally thrilled. After settling his father, he left.

Through their close collaboration, Wu Shuai had learned Gu Liang's true identity—he was not human, but a variant human Gu Immortal!

After a moment of silence, Wu Shuai told him the truth.

"Wu Shuai, you did well not to announce this to the dragonmen. If Heavenly Court learns this secret, they will eradicate our entire race!"

"Your father's actions were too abnormal; they may discover he contacted fate Gu. Heavenly Court's investigators will certainly come probing."

Gu Liang hesitated before speaking: "You already know the only way, don't you? Only by sacrificing your father and claiming he died of his injuries can we escape total extinction!"

Paling, Wu Shuai stumbled backward and shook his head repeatedly: "You want me to kill my father?! No, I will never do that!"

"If Heavenly Court finds out, our race is doomed," Gu Liang sighed. "I finally understand Duke Long's suspicion—Heavenly Court already knows fate Gu's revelation."

# Chapter 1844: Killing Father, Dream Revelations

Wu Shuai frowned bitterly: "I suspect this is a plot against my father and me to harm our race. 'Dragonmen reign supreme' might be a lie concocted to find an excuse to exterminate us."

Gu Liang dismissed the doubt: "Unlikely. Your father contacted fate Gu through coincidences he chose himself rather than Heavenly Court's design."

"How did humanity receive fate Gu's revelation back then? Isn't your father in the same situation now?" Gu Liang's words left Wu Shuai speechless.

Just then, a voice echoed from the sky—Heavenly Court's Gu Immortals had arrived to investigate Wu Shuai's father's injuries.

"They're here already!" Gu Liang's expression shifted. "Wu Shuai, decide now! Any delay and our efforts are ruined—your entire race will be exterminated!"

That day, Wu Shuai's father died from the construction backlash of Central Heaven Gate, his soul entirely erased.

Finding no evidence to act against a rank eight immortal, the investigators departed.

Tai Qin consoled Wu Shuai as he wept in her arms.

Tai Qin said gently: "The dead cannot return, Senior Brother; you must move on. Uncle died constructing Central Heaven Gate, so Heavenly Court will surely compensate you."

He could only reply: "Junior Sister, after I killed Song Tao Zi back then, I often had the same recurring dream."

Tai Qin was equally sorrowful; over all these years, she had failed to bear Wu Shuai a child.

Though dragonmen were fertile among themselves, crossbreeding with humans rarely produced offspring.

Gu Liang urged him: "Do not let visible grief arouse suspicion, or your father will have died in vain."

Struck as if by lightning, Wu Shuai wiped the cold sweat from his brow and cupped his fists: "Thank you for the reminder, or I would have made a grave mistake."

Gu Liang smiled and nodded: "Grief has stalled your work on Central Heaven Gate. It is time to resume."

"Can we truly trust fate Gu's revelation that dragonmen will reign supreme?" Wu Shuai still could not let it go.

Gu Liang explained: "I have a theory. Star Constellation Immortal Venerable assimilated with heaven's will, and her will has interfered with it ever since. That is likely why your father met disaster. Yet by delivering the secret that dragonmen will reign supreme, he died for a noble cause."

Wu Shuai suppressed his sorrow and returned to work. He continued constructing Central Heaven Gate to reassure Heavenly Court.

On this day, Wu Shuai dreamed of his father again.

His father told him: "Keep working hard; I understand you. This sacrifice will lead to great achievements! The dragonman race needs your leadership, my child."

He also dreamed of finally having a child with Tai Qin using a nameless weed found deep in an Eastern Sea Earth Trench.

Wu Shuai awoke with a start: was this a heavenly revelation?

Wu Shuai immediately acted, using Gu Liang's strength to retrieve the unnamed seaweed from Eastern Sea's Earth Trench.

Following the dream's instructions, Wu Shuai and Tai Qin consumed the seaweed. Months later, Tai Qin was pregnant with his child!

Beyond gaining an heir, his suspicion was confirmed: heavenly revelations had been arriving all along, yet he had failed to recognize them.

As his dreams evolved, more revelations flowed to Wu Shuai.

He not only constructed Central Heaven Gate, but successfully installed a backdoor that went undetected during Heavenly Court's inspections.

Guided by dream revelations and aided by Gu Liang, his cultivation rose as he passed tribulation after tribulation.

The dreams shifted again, revealing how to build the rank eight Immortal Gu House, Dragon Palace!

"The core of Dragon Palace is the rank eight Dream Token!" Thrilled, Wu Shuai immediately roamed the five regions and two heavens gathering dream path materials.

Following the revelations, Wu Shuai gradually gathered and refined the materials.

# Chapter 1845: A Life of Tragedy!

During this period, Wu Shuai returned to South Flower Island.

Tai Qin finally gave birth!

"We finally have an heir to our bloodline! Tai Qin, you've suffered." Wu Shuai cradled the newborn, spinning in joy.

"What shall we name our child?" Tai Qin asked with a maternal smile.

"This child has such lively, spirited eyes—let's call him Long Ling," Wu Shuai said.

Tai Qin nodded: "Long Ling... it is a good name."

Driven by his responsibilities, Wu Shuai rested briefly on South Flower Island before traveling the five regions and two heavens again to gather dream path materials.

As materials were refined one by one, Dream Token reached the final step of completion.

"This?!" Wu Shuai was immensely shocked.

The dream's final revelation required Tai Qin to willingly sacrifice her life to complete the refinement of Dream Token.

"No, I cannot do that!" Shaken and pale, Wu Shuai refused to accept this revelation.

Wu Shuai halted the refinement of Dream Token, hoping for further dream revelations.

The next night, he received a new revelation in his dream.

This revelation was shocking: "Ancestor Duke Long has an immortal killer move that can exterminate the dragonman race?! And he has wanted to use it repeatedly?"

Guided by dream revelations, Wu Shuai gathered clues proving the dreams true, even learning the killer move's name—Dragonman Extermination!

The dream told Wu Shuai that countering dragonman extermination required refining Dream Token first.

Wu Shuai had to tell Tai Qin the truth.

Tai Qin accepted it readily, caressing Wu Shuai's face with a gentle smile: "So that is why, Brother Shuai. I love you and would sacrifice everything for you, even my life. This is nothing, but beyond you, my only concern in this life is our child."

"After I die, you must care for and nurture our child well. Promise me, alright?"

"I promise you on my life, dignity, and all that I have!" Wu Shuai wept profusely in anguish.

His child with Tai Qin grew up and would sometimes ask: "Father, where is mother? Why is she not back yet?"

Though stunned, the dragonman immortals were convinced by Wu Shuai's undeniable evidence and Gu Liang's testimony.

"The experiments require vast numbers of dragonmen. Nearly all will die, and survivors will wish for death. Yet I cannot stop this plan. If anyone objects, speak up now."

"I object!" Immediately, someone jumped out.

Everyone turned to look—it was Wu Shuai's cousin, the seventh young master whom Duke Long doted on most.

Pointing at Wu Shuai on his throne, the seventh young master scolded: "You scoundrel, you are insane!!!"

"To gain Heavenly Court's trust, you killed your most loyal sworn brother!"

"To conceal the secret of dragonmen reigning supreme, you caused your own father's death!"

"To refine dream token Immortal Gu, you used your beloved wife as Gu material!"

The time path clone continued making endless deductions under wisdom's light.

# Chapter 1853: Good Child

Dark, foul, and the size of a hut, the droppings plunged from the sky.

Numerous Combat Beast Envoys followed, instantly plunging humans and birds into a fierce aerial battle.

"The fat butt bird king has rank five battle strength. As a rank one Gu Master fused with the arrowtail eagle, I could nearly kill it. In this grotto-heaven, battle strength comes so easily that traditional Gu Master cultivation cannot prosper."

"The killer move myriad beings assimilation transformation blankets the entire grotto-heaven. Gu Masters transform using its power at the cost of positive emotions, making Combat Beast Envoys generally rich in optimism and goodwill."

"Yet the people here are far from naive; the higher-ups remain adept at scheming and manipulation."

While maintaining his benevolent persona among the citizens, Fang Yuan reflected: Working diligently, Fang Yuan reflected: "My main body should act soon. Alone, my progress is too slow; I need the main body to unleash a beast calamity that I can cooperate with."

"The main body's beast calamity won't be a minor nuisance like these fat butt birds."

# Chapter 1856: Am I, Suan Bu Jin, Such a Person?

Three large words were carved on the palace plaque—Divine Bean Palace!

One was Fang clan's second supreme elder, Fang Di Chang—a mortal-looking, bearded man in yellow robes, his forehead dripping sweat against a pale face.

"Indeed." Fang Di Chang nodded. "Worse still, any branches we destroy regrow shortly after."

Fang Yuan analyzed: "Genesis Lotus Immortal Venerable possessed boundless immortal essence and immense recovery ability, embodying wood path's essence. Second Supreme Elder, refining this wood path Immortal Gu House as wisdom path Gu Immortals is extremely difficult! Inviting a few wood path great experts to collaborate would yield far better results."

Fang clan's first supreme elder Fang Gong strode over with hearty laughter: "Brother Suan Bu Jin is entirely correct."

Fang Gong patted Fang Yuan's shoulder warmly: "Brother, it was hard on you; deducing in the formation right upon arrival without any rest. I have already arranged a welcoming banquet."

Fang Yuan smiled: "Thank you, First Supreme Elder. Deciphering the palace has invigorated me, and helping the clan is helping myself."

Fang Di Chang quickly inquired: "Brother, are you injured? Is it serious? I have already arranged treatment."

Fang Yuan coughed: "I am slightly injured, but more importantly, my immortal essence is heavily depleted. My mind is also exhausted from the grueling workload. Who knows when Divine Bean Palace will be fully refined? I feel I cannot persevere much longer."

"Brother!" Fang Di Chang smiled. "Rest assured, our Fang clan will never mistreat you."

Fang Yuan said earnestly: "Brother, please do not think I am trying to quit! I am no such person! Joining Fang clan is proof of my trust in you. Furthermore, our cooperation started long ago when fighting for Divine Bean Palace, and I have never forgotten our agreement."

He laughed: "I understand, brother, hahaha! We have not forgotten our agreement either. You helped us fight for Divine Bean Palace, and we owed you an Immortal Gu per our agreement. Delaying it until now was Fang clan's fault, and I apologize. Tell me which Immortal Gu you need, and I will have it delivered immediately."

"Sigh, that is not what I meant at all, Second Supreme Elder! You misunderstand me," Fang Yuan said.

Sensing Suan Bu Jin harbored a larger scheme, Fang Di Chang cut to the chase after several exchanges: "Brother, speak your mind directly."

Fang Yuan said righteously: "Brother, do not look down on me! How could I extort the clan during troubled times? Am I, Suan Bu Jin, such a person? Feeling that an Immortal Gu was too generous, I am willing to take a step back and forgo receiving one."

Fang Di Chang grew more uneasy as Fang Yuan continued: "Since you insist, I shall be frank. We are on the same side, so I will hide nothing. Truth be told, I am interested in Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable's theft path true inheritance. I need no Immortal Gu, only to browse its contents. Naturally, if you find this inappropriate, brother, then forget it."

Even the usually composed Fang Di Chang lost his bearing, glaring at Fang Yuan as he inwardly cursed: "So your target was our clan's Thieving Heaven true inheritance all along! What audacity!"

# Chapter 1857: Comprehending Thieving Heaven's True Inheritance

High attainment across all paths could produce premonitions about all things—a state virtually identical to omniscience.

"Though how to achieve eternal life remains unknown, omniscience and omnipotence are the foundation. First, fate Gu must be destroyed to make eternal life possible. Then, I will strive toward omniscience and omnipotence!"

"To achieve omniscience, I must explore dream realms and raise my attainment in every path."

"To achieve omnipotence, I will cultivate every path with the sovereign immortal body and master all methods."

Even venerables cultivated only two or three paths and could not achieve omniscience. Their strength was unimaginable, but without the sovereign immortal body, omnipotence remained impossible.

"Wait, the Prophecy of Three Venerables stated that Great Dream Immortal Venerable would be the strongest venerable. Could it be because she attains omniscience?"

Fang Yuan's heart jolted; he had gained a deeper understanding of the Prophecy of Three Venerables and the future!

"Such struggle and effort will make my life truly vibrant."

Lang Ya blessed land.

# Chapter 1859: Suan Bu Jin, Please Rest In Peace

Time passed. The outside five regions appeared tranquil while undercurrents surged secretly, but within the sovereign immortal aperture, rapid time flow brought noticeable daily changes.

Meanwhile, Fang Yuan's main body worked diligently on cultivating karma divine tree.

True to his wisdom path great grandmaster attainment, Fang Di Chang had devised a feasible plan: using a house to break a house!

Fang Di Chang planned to build a temporary Immortal Gu House inside Divine Bean Palace to deduce and probe before detonating, shattering Divine Bean Palace's internal defenses.

Fang Di Chang smiled bitterly: "We have no choice; Fang clan's situation worsens daily. But as long as we refine Divine Bean Palace and conceal its damage, who could tell?"

Fang Yuan frowned: "Constructing an Immortal Gu House inside Divine Bean Palace is difficult, but feasible with Fang clan's foundation. But what comes next? To probe Divine Bean Palace's deeper mechanics, a Gu Immortal must continually pilot the Immortal Gu House, actively resisting the palace and adjusting to its changes. Furthermore, while maintaining constant activation, that Gu Immortal must detonate the Immortal Gu House to destroy a portion of Divine Bean Palace and strip its defenses."

"Wouldn't the Gu Immortal inside be in grave danger then?" Fang Yuan stared fixedly at Fang Di Chang.

Sensing Fang Yuan's thoughts, Fang Di Chang smiled: "Fret not, brother. We will control the Immortal Gu House together, not leave you alone. Once finished, Fang clan will richly reward your contributions."

"I agree, but I must participate throughout the Immortal Gu House's construction."

Fang Di Chang's eyes flashed sharply. Hesitating briefly, he nodded: "It can be done! Let us begin immediately."

With Fang Yuan subtly offering valid concepts, the Immortal Gu House was successfully constructed.

Entering the dome-topped, tent-like Immortal Gu House, Fang Di Chang and Fang Yuan began probing the inner mechanics and profundities of Divine Bean Palace.

Soon, judging the timing right, Fang Di Chang told Fang Yuan: "We can start the final step. Are you ready?"

"Yes." Fang Yuan nodded.

"Good," Fang Di Chang said, activating the Immortal Gu House as chains shot out, instantly binding Fang Yuan tightly!

Fang Yuan paled in fright: "Brother, what are you doing?"

Fang Di Chang looked at him meaningfully: "Brother Suan Bu Jin, Fang clan will not forget your sacrifice."

"So that was it! You want to destroy me, not this Immortal Gu House!" Fang Yuan cried in realization.

"The Immortal Gu House must detonate as well," Fang Di Chang said, "but its explosive power alone is ordinary. Only by sacrificing a wisdom path Gu Immortal like you can I achieve an instant breakthrough to a higher level, using the grand power of detonation to subdue Divine Bean Palace!"

"Seeing Fang clan's situation, you know there is no other choice. Please die for the sake of Fang clan's future." Fang Di Chang bowed deeply to Fang Yuan.

Fang Yuan panicked and started cursing loudly.

Fang Di Chang's expression turned cold: "As a Fang clan member, you die for a good cause. Rest in peace."

Once he said that, he activated the final method.

# Chapter 1860: You Know Too Much

Hiding near Divine Bean Palace, Fang Gong felt anxious.

"What is happening? Why is there no movement from Divine Bean Palace? Did something happen?" Fang Gong tracked the time.

"First supreme elder, please be at ease. Besides, if any mishap left second supreme elder unable to control the situation, he would surely message us," third supreme elder assured from the side.

"Let's take a look!" Fang Gong immediately rushed toward Divine Bean Palace.

"Second elder, are you alright? Hold on!" Fang Hua Sheng arrived quickly, immediately administering healing methods.

"Alright." Fang Di Chang weakly closed his eyes.

After finishing treatment, Fang Hua Sheng reported to Fang Gong alone.

"How is the situation?" Fang Gong asked.
