Fang Gong nodded: "I trust second elder, but inspection is necessary. Southern Border's righteous path became a laughingstock precisely because they allowed Fang Yuan to infiltrate them. Although Suan Bu Jin is no demon Fang Yuan, caution is essential. Moreover, second supreme elder himself asked me to arrange this inspection."

Lying in bed, Fang Di Chang opened his eyes.

"A day and night have passed since Fang Hua Sheng reported. It seems I successfully deceived them!" Fang Di Chang thought.

He was not the real Fang Di Chang, but Fang Yuan's clone!

Back when Fang Di Chang first initiated his scheme:

Silence.

"Huh?" Dazed, Fang Di Chang activated the method again.

"What is going on?!" Fang Di Chang's pupils shrank as his expression changed, hastily investigating.

He stared at Fang Yuan in disbelief: "You tampered with this Immortal Gu House!"

Fang Yuan's panic vanished, replaced by a sinister smile: "Oh, damn it, you actually figured it out!"

"How is this possible? I oversaw the entire process; you only offered a few suggestions!" Fang Di Chang felt a sudden chill: "Could it be..."

"Hahaha!" Fang Yuan clapped. "Worthy of a wisdom path great grandmaster—you deduced it quickly. You accepted my suggestions, constructing an Immortal Gu House that resonated with Divine Bean Palace in many areas. You set up an outer Gu formation and an inner Gu house to forcefully infiltrate and refine Divine Bean Palace. But in turn, Divine Bean Palace also infiltrated your formation and house. And I just happen to be able to influence Divine Bean Palace."

Fang Di Chang glared at Fang Yuan: "Who are you? Accomplishing this requires extremely high formation path attainment, plus a method to influence Divine Bean Palace!"

Fang Yuan smiled. Though his wisdom path lagged behind Fang Di Chang's, he was still a grandmaster, and his formation path matched it—granting dual grandmaster attainment.

Immortal killer move — Karma Divine Tree!

Green smoke rose above Fang Yuan's head and shoulders, forming a vast, lush divine tree with several fruits scattered among its leaves.

Divine Bean Palace began to shake.

Fang Di Chang's eyes widened with shock and anger, pointing at Fang Yuan: "You sided with Heavenly Court! Despicable bastard!"

Seeing Fang Di Chang's misunderstanding, Fang Yuan ignored it, focusing entirely on karma divine tree.

Using this move openly for the first time, Fang Yuan saw Divine Bean Palace respond, gradually lowering its resistance to accept him as the killer move's owner.

Soon, Fang Di Chang was unable to even budge.

The temporary Immortal Gu House was designed to imprison Gu Immortals. Though Fang Di Chang planned to trap Suan Bu Jin, Fang Yuan's greater control and Divine Bean Palace's suppression turned Fang Di Chang into the captive.

"Good, very good, Suan Bu Jin! I admit defeat—kill me." Fang Di Chang sneered fearlessly.

Fang Yuan sneered: "You want your death to alter your life tablet Gu and alert Fang Gong outside? Praiseworthy resolve, but I will not take the bait. I will extract your soul and possess you with my split soul. With your body alive and soul intact, your life tablet Gu will show no change."

"My Fang Di Chang clone will replace you to infiltrate Fang clan. I will thoroughly search your soul, plundering all your experiences, memories, and knowledge."

"Hmph! Impossible! Forget it." Fang Di Chang snorted coldly. "You think a split soul escapes inspection? Fang clan records my soul's details; any discrepancy will expose you."

"Moreover, your time is short. I set a deadline with first supreme elder; if I fail to appear, they will immediately storm in to reinforce me!"

"Even with Heavenly Court's reinforcements, how long could you hold out? A furious first elder Fang Gong will surely smash you into meat paste!"

Fang Yuan smiled, gazing deeply at Fang Di Chang.

"You turned my own scheme against me with such confidence. To accomplish this, you need immense formation and wisdom path attainment, plus extraordinary soul path methods!"

"No, you are not sent by Heavenly Court!"

"You! You are Fang Yuan!!"

Fang Di Chang's face turned deathly pale.

Fang Yuan clapped: "Truly worthy of a wisdom path great grandmaster."

Fang Di Chang gulped nervously: "Fang Yuan, we can cooperate. There is no need for conflict—please believe in Fang clan's strength and sincerity... urgh!"

Fang Di Chang's eyes opened wide all of a sudden.

While conversing, Fang Yuan had relentlessly influenced Divine Bean Palace, finally triggering a qualitative breakthrough!

"Fang... Fang Yuan, everything... can... be discussed..."

Fang Yuan shook his head with a smile: "It is truly a pity for a wisdom path great grandmaster to die here. But you... know too much."

"Ahh." Fang Di Chang's eyes rolled back and his mouth foamed; his body twitched a few times before he died.

# Chapter 1861: Fang Gong Lifts His Suspicions

Fang clan headquarters.

Fang Yun, Fang Di Chang's adopted son, bowed with concern: "Father, you have suffered such heavy injuries. Please tell me what I can do for you."

Fang Di Chang coughed and waved weakly: "Yun Er, don't put on an act. Can father still not understand your nature? Come sit here, don't be so restrained."

Fang Yun relaxed, shrugging and raising his eyebrows as he sat by the bedside: "Father, you really gave me a scare. I didn't expect such a big move—it was truly risky! Such a pity Senior Suan Bu Jin lost his life."

Fang Yun nodded with rare solemnity: "Father, you are right. I will change to cultivating wisdom path."

"My physical body is Fang Di Chang's, so there is no flaw in the blood. Since he has not died, life tablet Gu remains unchanged. The main body handled the soul personally, modifying it within the sovereign immortal aperture's rapid time flow to match the body perfectly."

Fang Gong had been contemplating seizing this chance to demand the inheritance.

"As expected of a wisdom path great grandmaster." Fang Gong's brows relaxed, and he smiled as he waved his hand.

Fang Leng understood: "I will take my leave."

"We lost our chance this time, so forget it. After all, we are all Fang clan members on the same side." Fang Gong was not too upset, but remained somewhat worried.

"Second supreme elder acted so swiftly—his true intentions are obvious. He cannot possibly be Suan Bu Jin in disguise." The final trace of doubt disappeared from Fang Gong's mind.

# Chapter 1862: Rank Eight Ant Nest Gu

In the depths of Eastern Sea, Gu tribe headquarters.

After over half a month in the blessed land, the dusty seal was completely unlocked.

Many Gu Immortals were present: Fang Yuan's dragonman clone Wu Shuai, two dragon generals, Gu tribe's leader, and several beastman Gu Immortals.

Gu tribe's leader looked at Wu Shuai and smiled: "Please."

Wu Shuai waved his hand; a large grey rock rose into the air and was stored into his immortal aperture.

Using the correct method, Wu Shuai swiftly dissected the rock, revealing two Immortal Gu inside.

One was the rank eight Immortal Gu Ant Nest, Green Ant Ascetic's core Immortal Gu that could breed all kinds of army ants.

Army ants were extremely suitable for enslavement path Gu Immortals, and had been the historical Wu Shuai's signature method.

Beside Ant Nest was a rank seven information path Immortal Gu called Letter Seal.

Letter Seal Immortal Gu contained extensive information regarding army ants and had also been used to seal Ant Nest Immortal Gu.

However, Fang Yuan had already prepared their food and given it to Wu Shuai.

Wu Shuai fed the Immortal Gu while walking back with the Gu tribe immortals.

On the way, Wu Shuai thanked: "Your noble tribe kept your word! You preserved my inheritance until now, you are really my dragonman race's most trustworthy friend!"

Wu Shuai added: "Collaborating with Fang Yuan, I have already neutralized the dragonman extermination killer move. This move once killed me and exterminated my clan, but from now on, it will have no effect."

Gu tribe's leader's eyes brightened: "This is great news! Dragonmen reigning supreme is heaven's decree. Senior, truth be told, I have a favor to ask of you."

Fang Yuan's clone replied without hesitation: "Just speak your mind; as long as it is within my power, I will help."

"I want to transform a portion of my tribe into dragonmen. Senior, what do you think..." Gu tribe's leader asked expectantly.

Fang Yuan nodded: "My old friend Gu Liang, your former leader, had the same intention. Since I have a completely new dragonman lifespan extension method, I can naturally help you."

Gu tribe's leader was overjoyed: "Many thanks, senior! We have already prepared the raging wave rising dragon fire; please tell us what other immortal materials are needed."

Several days later, immortal materials and candidates arrived before Wu Shuai.

Wu Shuai brought out Dragon Palace to assist in executing the lifespan extension method.

Assisted by Dragon Spirit, the procedure concluded successfully, transforming most candidates into dragonmen despite the inherent risks.

Even so, Gu tribe's leader was delighted with the result: "Senior, your modified method has a much higher success rate than the original."

As he said this, he presented a batch of immortal materials.

Creating army ants with Ant Nest required specific immortal materials, which the past Gu tribe leader had gathered beforehand.

Fang Yuan's clone declined: "I transformed your tribe members as thanks; we agreed on no remuneration."

He persisted: "Surviving has not been easy for you, and you are my dragonman race's most reliable ally. How could I, Wu Shuai, treat an ally like this? Though I lack the immortal materials, I am collaborating with Fang Yuan and can ask him to provide them."

"Senior, Fang Yuan is a modern devil whom even Heavenly Court cannot handle. Sinister and vicious, he will do anything for benefits—please be vigilant."

Fang Yuan's clone nodded: "That is true, but Heavenly Court's power is immense, and Fang Yuan provides undeniable aid that cannot be neglected. Even if it means dealing with a tiger, I am willing to take the risk if it slightly increases my chances against Heavenly Court and Duke Long."

Gu tribe's leader nodded: "Though hiding here, our tribe has reliable allies, including Eastern Sea's Merman Imperial Court."

"Merman Imperial Court... this is indeed good news!" Wu Shuai's eyes brightened.

Gu tribe's leader continued: "Besides this, our tribe maintains connections across the other four regions, such as stable trade with Northern Plains' Murong tribe. Years ago, when Imperial Court blessed land was destroyed and Eighty-Eight True Yang Building collapsed, I attended Northern Plains' auction and was warmly received by Murong tribe."

"This is good news!" Fang Yuan's main body was pleased to receive this information.

He had already left Western Desert and arrived in Northern Plains.

He rapidly descended, below him was a giant pit.

It was one of Northern Plains' ten great fierce areas, Crazed Demon Cave!

# Chapter 1863: Walking Through The Seventh Layer Again

Dressed in a white robe, Fang Yuan slowly descended into Crazed Demon Cave.

Two Gu Immortals had long been waiting on the ground.

Possessing a pale face, black beard, and starry eyes, the rule path Gu Immortal Not Immortal carried an extraordinary air.

The other was wisdom path cultivator Secret Schemer, reaching only Fang Yuan's knee.

"Friends, we meet again." After Fang Yuan landed, he greeted politely with a smile.

Secret Schemer and Not Immortal returned the greeting hurriedly.

Not Immortal smiled: "Hearing Brother Liu's true identity was Gu Yue Fang Yuan after our parting brought us immense surprise and joy. Since you have come, you must have a way to break through the barrier; we have been waiting anxiously."

Under Liu Guan Yi's identity, Fang Yuan had signed the Crazed Demon Agreement, joining Crazed Demon Cave alongside Chu Du.

"Why don't I see Pang Shan?" Fang Yuan asked.

"He gained some insights exploring the seventh layer and is in closed cultivation," Secret Schemer replied.

"So that's it." Fang Yuan smiled, understanding in his head.

The Three Crazed Demon Eccentrics were taking precautions against him!

"This is already my third time in Crazed Demon Cave. I hope to gain something!" His main goal remained Limitless' true inheritance.

In the near future, Heavenly Court would hold the Central Continent Refinement Path Convention to restore fate Gu.

Acquiring venerable true inheritances would provide Fang Yuan crucial support and venerable methods to destroy fate Gu.

His strength had risen immensely. Though ostensibly rank seven, he was already rank eight; even if the Three Crazed Demon Eccentrics turned on him, he could counterattack without endangering his safety.

Not Immortal led the way while Secret Schemer conversed with Fang Yuan.

Descending the winding pathways, the three finally reached the seventh layer—the third from the bottom.

Back then, Fang Yuan's endpoint had been this layer.

The Three Crazed Demon Eccentrics had likewise been blocked here for centuries; lacking a breakthrough at this barrier, they had recruited Chu Du and Fang Yuan.

Fang Yuan's sight was filled with dazzling light.

In the seventh layer, every grain of soil and piece of rock was quasi-rank nine immortal material, but their chaotic dao marks rendered them unusable.

"Fang Yuan, after you." Secret Schemer gave way.

"Reflecting since my previous failure, I gained much insight," Fang Yuan laughed heartily, taking the lead.

Secret Schemer and Not Immortal exchanged glances and followed Fang Yuan closely.

Fang Yuan walked leisurely.

Over sixty steps, Fang Yuan stopped for a breather.

Secret Schemer and Not Immortal looked at each other, seeing mutual shock in their eyes.

Moving here required overcoming countless conflicting dao marks. While the Three Crazed Demon Eccentrics could reach ten thousand steps with frequent rests, moving continuously like Fang Yuan would limit them to forty or fifty steps at most.

"Terrifyingly, Fang Yuan walked over sixty steps with obvious ease, without even using his full strength!"

In truth, possessing the sovereign immortal body freed Fang Yuan from non-conflicting dao mark issues; his exhaustion was purely an act.

The three continued to walk forward.

The deeper they advanced, the greater the difficulty and pressure became.

"We will save effort ahead by relying on our respective paths' dao marks. Fang Yuan, let's split up for now," Not Immortal said.

Cultivating rule path, he chose the front-left route with relatively more rule path dao marks.

Soon after, Secret Schemer also departed, taking a path with denser wisdom path dao marks.

Though able to move in a straight line, Fang Yuan concealed his ability and carefully chose a specific path.

# Chapter 1864: Oh Fang Yuan, You Are Dead Meat

Fang Yuan advanced like an ordinary Gu Immortal, sympathizing with Not Immortal and Secret Schemer's situation.

"Without the sovereign immortal body, I would also have to follow a dao mark path. Yet such paths only narrow; choices abound at first, but dwindle the deeper one goes."

Feigning great difficulty and pausing at every step, Fang Yuan slowly pushed forward along his chosen path.

From afar, Not Immortal and Secret Schemer exchanged glances.

Fang Yuan's strength was still above their current estimation!

The two slowed as they walked, their hearts growing heavier.

The surrounding dao marks constantly pressured them, severely hindering their movement. Not Immortal was coughing blood while Secret Schemer's face turned yellowish-purple.

Before long, the two were forced to stop.

Ahead, Fang Yuan looked far more exhausted than before, but clearly still had plenty of strength left.

"Fang Yuan is truly a monster!"

"Then let's watch from here. I want to see how far he can go!" Secret Schemer snorted coldly.

Not Immortal hesitated before asking: "Do you think he can leave the seventh layer and enter the eighth?"

"How is that even possible?" Secret Schemer dismissed immediately, before adding heavily: "The chances are slim. It takes tens of thousands of steps to leave the seventh layer. We haven't even covered ten percent! Fang Yuan is indeed a formidable rank seven demon rarely seen in a millennium. But he is still not rank eight; I suspect only a venerable could reach the eighth layer."

Secret Schemer and Not Immortal stood in place, watching his receding figure.

When Fang Yuan surpassed Secret Schemer's record, the wisdom path Gu Immortal's eyelids twitched.

Seeing Secret Schemer's expression, Not Immortal sighed to comfort him, but his own face suddenly changed.

The demonic sounds started!

"What's going on?" Not Immortal was pale with fright.

Secret Schemer was equally horrified: "Why are the demonic sounds appearing now?"

Not Immortal said: "Your deduction was correct—the demonic sounds are erratic now! Quick, retreat! It's too dangerous here!"

Sweating profusely, Secret Schemer shouted toward Fang Yuan: "The demonic sound is here, retreat! We are only safe outside the seventh layer!"

Fang Yuan turned around to look at them two.

Lacking their usual secluded demeanor, the two eccentrics panicked and retreated rapidly.

"It doesn't look like they are trying to harm me." Fang Yuan frowned slightly.

With no time to pick a path, Not Immortal and Secret Schemer simply fled outward in the general direction.

"I cannot go on!" Not Immortal crashed onto the ground.

Sharing a close bond, Secret Schemer braved the danger to carry the unconscious Not Immortal.

"Wait, where is Fang Yuan?" Before leaving the seventh layer, he risked a backward glance.

"What?!" His eyes widened in disbelief.

Fang Yuan had not retreated, but ventured even deeper.

"You, you, you!" Secret Schemer was too agitated to form words.

Hearing him, Fang Yuan turned and smiled: "It was already too late for me to retreat. But with a lifesaving secret technique, I have a slim chance of survival. Exploration brings fatal danger, and I am prepared mentally. Secret Schemer, I hope we meet again!"

Secret Schemer fell silent, wanting to say 'Fang Yuan, you're dead meat,' but unable to voice it.

In the end, he said: "Fang Yuan, we will definitely meet again!"

Fang Yuan ruminated and smiled: "This Secret Schemer is indeed friendly and loyal."

Looking at the swaying dao marks ahead, Fang Yuan remained calm and composed.

With Not Immortal and Secret Schemer gone, Fang Yuan was actually far more relaxed.

Beholding the dazzling, grand dao mark waves ahead, he marveled at the world's most extraordinary sight.

# Chapter 1865: New Dao Mark, Venerable Paths!

Crazed Demon Cave, sixth layer.

Collapsed on the ground, the injured Secret Schemer knelt to heal Not Immortal, ignoring his own wounds.

Not Immortal slowly opened his eyes, dazed before rejoicing: "I actually escaped! Leader, you saved me once again!"

He asked doubtfully: "Where is Fang Yuan? Did he fail to retreat in time?"

Secret Schemer smiled bitterly: "No, he remains in the seventh layer. But he was right—at that distance, it was already too late to retreat."

Astonished, Not Immortal eventually sighed: "Such is life. Who could have imagined the mighty Fang Yuan would perish here?"

They were completely unaware that in the seventh layer, Fang Yuan was alive and had made a new discovery.

"A new type of dao mark?" Fang Yuan's eyes brightened in surprise.

"These dao marks were originally static, scarce, and scattered, making them quite inconspicuous. Now, driven by the demonic sounds and conflicts between different paths, dao marks of similar paths are uniting. This increased the size of these new dao marks, making them easier to spot."

As the sounds persisted, dao marks of each path congregated into unified colors, appearing far clearer and grander.

Before him, metal path dao marks wriggled like a giant golden python. To his left, soul path dao marks loomed like city-sized dark clouds, surging forward grandly. Beside his feet, that brand-new dao mark flowed gently like a brook.

Fang Yuan stopped and observed it carefully.

Not long later, his face was filled with astonishment.

Within the new dao mark, he 'saw' blades and swords, 'smelled' axes and halberds, 'felt' hammers and spears, and 'heard' darts and arrows...

Fang Yuan pondered solemnly: "This represents a grand path encompassing all weapons, uniting sword path and blade path. It will possess immense battle strength and clearly holds many human path profundities."

Fang Yuan continued moving forward.

Along the way, he saw many new dao marks.

Some dao marks gathered into smooth spheres; he detected a faint grassy scent that smelled like food upon closer inspection.

Fang Yuan guessed: was this the rumored pill path dao mark?

Another patch of dao marks carpeted the ground; though uniform, interweaving lights on its surface formed mountains, rivers, birds, and beasts.

When other dao marks flooded past, this patch drifted like leaves to lightly adhere to their surface, neither disrupting them nor crumbling apart. It was truly mystical.

Fang Yuan's heart shook at the sight: "If I am not mistaken, these are painting path dao marks!"

He intended to collect them, but with the demonic sounds ringing, he lacked the means to capture them.

"Fang clan has Thieving Heaven Demon Venerable's inheritance and the Immortal Gu House Thieves Den. Could I use it to steal these dao marks?" An inspiration struck Fang Yuan.

"With identical dao marks gathering, I could use Thieves Den to create immortal materials of respective paths."

If this worked, he would possess a method to produce endless rank eight and even rank nine immortal materials!

"However, similar dao marks only congregate while demonic sounds are active."

"Let alone Thieves Den—lacking the sovereign immortal body, it would shatter from conflicting forces the moment it was brought out!"

Fang Yuan sighed and set the thought aside for now, continuing forward.

He began to move faster.

Whatever dao marks lay ahead, they were harmless as a light breeze to him.

Not long later, he saw dream path dao marks.

Fang Yuan probed cautiously, finding that dream path dao marks were equally harmless to him.

These were merely dao marks, not dream realms; to the sovereign immortal body, they were just moving immortal materials.

Fang Yuan moved in a straight line, his path unimpeded.

Though the demonic sounds reduced his killer move's duration, it kept everything well within his tolerance.

Fang Yuan pressed deeper, reaching depths the Three Crazed Demon Eccentrics could never imagine.

Reaching the eighth layer's entrance at last, he gasped softly and paused.

He actually saw three paths!

One path glowed with golden light, luck surging around it.

One path was dark and horrifying, killing intent filled it.

One path was humble and plain, giving a virtuous aura.

Fang Yuan's eyes gleamed with understanding: "These three paths must be traces of past venerables. Filled with luck path, soul path, and earth path dao marks, they belong to Giant Sun Immortal Venerable, Spectral Soul Demon Venerable, and Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable respectively!"

These three venerables had been here!

The demonic sounds and chaotic dao marks formed a tempest potent enough to obliterate almost any Gu Immortal without a trace.

Yet the dao marks in these three paths remained solid, standing firm against the crashing dao mark currents.

He had reached this point only because his sovereign immortal body bypassed dao mark conflicts like a cheat.

Fang Yuan was not surprised to find venerable traces here; he had already predicted as much.

"But, why are there traces of only these three venerables?"

"And why do the paths left by these three venerables only appear near the eighth layer's entrance?"

Pondering these doubts, Fang Yuan did not hesitate and leaped through the eighth layer's entrance.

The momentary darkness vanished, and Fang Yuan landed on solid ground.

"How could this be?" Fang Yuan was dumbstruck.

The eighth layer showed a scene far beyond his expectations, bearing no resemblance to the seventh layer.

# Chapter 1866: Eighth Layer, Heaven Path

This was a vast grassland.

"This is Crazed Demon Cave's eighth layer?" He was astonished.

According to the Three Crazed Demon Eccentrics, the final three layers should have mirrored the seventh layer's chaotic dao marks, with the eighth layer on an even larger scale. In the ninth layer lay Limitless Demon Venerable's immortal formation, centered around the legendary rank nine Immortal Gu, Derivation!

Yet upon entering the eighth layer, Fang Yuan discovered it was actually a small world.

Inspecting his surroundings with investigative methods, his expression subtly shifted: "This world isn't a normal blessed land or grotto-heaven. It feels a little... frail."

Just as Fang Yuan was pondering, a loud crackle echoed.

A giant tear ripped across the sky like lightning, spanning the whole land.

At that instant, Fang Yuan's hair stood on end as warning alarms blared in his mind!

He felt mortal danger from the giant tear; touching it meant certain death. Even Reverse Flow Protection Seal might only last a few breaths.

Fang Yuan's pupils shrank slightly: "Phantom path power—a void tear!"

As the tear spread toward him, Fang Yuan threw himself straight in.

Flying upward along the tear, Fang Yuan soon exited the small world into the outside void.

"This is!" His body and mind shook at the sight.

Alongside him were countless worlds!

These worlds resembled multicolored bubbles: some forming, some fully formed, and others crumbling.

He suddenly realized this was the eighth layer's true appearance.

While the seventh layer held countless dao marks, the eighth layer was a vast void where countless worlds were born and destroyed!

"Eh? This!" Fang Yuan caught a strange movement.

The small world he had just left was completely destroyed, leaving behind only a long white thread.

It was a dao mark!

"What path's dao mark is this? It feels all-inclusive..." Fang Yuan wondered, before an answer struck him.

"I got it, this is heaven path!"

In the seventh layer, he had seen every variety of dao mark, including dream path and brand-new paths, yet two were missing.

"All other dao marks are destroyed, leaving only heaven path dao marks... What does this indicate?" Fang Yuan stared intently at the strand.

Exercising caution, Fang Yuan made no move on the dao mark.

Following the dao mark for a while, he noticed a sudden anomaly in the void ahead.

Currents surged into an instant vortex, swallowing the heaven path dao mark.

The dao mark resisted the void vortex briefly before collapsing.

The void returned to calm as a blue-white bubble suddenly manifested.

Initially no larger than a little finger, the bubble expanded rapidly.

Investigating it, Fang Yuan was shocked to find a newly formed small world. Land expanded and skies stretched in dramatic transformation, governed by profound laws.

Entering it, he found drifting clouds, floating islands, and colossal green vines woven into a vast net.

"Derived from the same heaven path dao mark, yet this world looks entirely different." Fang Yuan's mind jolted, sensing a profound enlightenment just beyond his grasp.

He had a strong premonition that grasping this insight would grant him a qualitative leap in strength.

"The seventh layer derives dao marks, while this eighth layer derives worlds!"

"No, deriving worlds is only superficial; it is truly deriving heaven path dao marks."

Observing closely, Fang Yuan noticed the heaven path dao mark grew slightly after each world's birth and destruction.

Fang Yuan recalled the Three Crazed Demon Eccentrics' analysis—Limitless Demon Venerable pursued eternal life, residing in Crazed Demon Cave during his later years to find the method.

"Limitless Demon Venerable pursued eternal life, yet the Heavenly Dao forbids it. The Legends of Ren Zu states that fate Gu decrees every being must die and return to the Door of Life and Death."

Fate Gu, in essence, was a fragment of heaven path!

"Unable to bypass the Heavenly Dao in his pursuit of eternal life, Limitless Demon Venerable researched heaven path directly," Fang Yuan deduced.

Limitless Demon Venerable had once attacked Heavenly Court, but lacking an otherworldly demon's nature, he could not destroy Fate.

Undeterred, he pressed onward to uncover why he could not destroy fate Gu and to grasp the truth of heaven path.

"How do I collect these heaven path dao marks?" Fang Yuan was deeply troubled.

"I should directly take the immortal formation!" Fang Yuan fell into another dilemma.

He had no idea how to reach the ninth layer.

While the seventh layer's path had been clear, the eighth layer was a boundless void without clues. How would he enter the ninth layer?

Who knew how long had passed, he discovered a world.

"This is the largest world I have seen so far, but it looks near destruction. Let's look inside." Fang Yuan entered.

"We pay respects to the sage!" This world held living creatures who excitedly kowtowed upon seeing Fang Yuan.

"Sage, did you come to create a Dao field to save this world?"

"Sage?" Fang Yuan frowned, immediately realizing the implication. "That means there are other sages like me?"

"Yes. A sage in a green robe and white headband, with lotuses blooming at every step, created the Green Lotus Dao field."

"Another compassionate sage was barefoot in yellow clothes; he saved the Yellow Earth Great World."

"Another ferocious, burly sage had beast roars echoing with his every move. He created Savage Wilderness Great World!"

# Chapter 1867: Spirit

"Genesis Lotus Immortal Venerable, Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable, and Reckless Savage Demon Venerable?" Fang Yuan's heart jolted.

From the misty natives' descriptions, Fang Yuan quickly matched these three sages with historical venerables.

All kinds of thoughts flashed like lightning in Fang Yuan's mind: "These three venerables came here? In the seventh layer, I also saw the dao marks path left by Spectral Soul Demon Venerable, Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable, and Giant Sun Immortal Venerable... that means, at least five venerables have come here."

"Now it seems other venerables like Reckless Savage and Genesis Lotus came too, but any paths they left were likely destroyed by time."

"Why did these venerables come one after the other?"

"Did these venerables go to the ninth layer after reaching here?"

"The ninth layer's formation still operates. If these venerables reached it, why didn't they destroy it and take rank nine derivation Gu?"

Fang Yuan pondered briefly and decided to explore these venerables' worlds.

"Interesting. Do you know where these Dao fields and worlds are?" Fang Yuan asked.

The mist figures shook their heads, having only heard of them without knowing the locations.

"Sage, we cannot leave this world. The outside is far too dangerous for us to set foot in."

Fang Yuan frowned: "Then how did you know this information?"

A mist figure replied: "Periodically, the sages' disciples cross the void to trade or plunder across worlds. We learned this from them."

"The venerables' disciples can travel through the void between worlds? Their strength must be extraordinary!"

Soon noticing an inconsistency, Fang Yuan asked: "If there are many disciples, why did you address me as sage at first sight?"

A mist figure answered: "Because all sages look like you, but their disciples come in all kinds of shapes."

Fang Yuan immediately understood: "So it seems there are no humans here, the so-called disciples or students of the sages are probably some other races? Like these human shaped mist people?"

"Sage, please save me!"

"Sure, sure." Fang Yuan smiled as he attacked suddenly.

Within two breaths, Fang Yuan captured the mist figures, his gaze shining with cold detachment.

How could this information gained from just questioning be reliable?

He then used soul search methods to inspect them.

These human shaped mist did not have a soul!

Fang Yuan paused before realizing: "This small world lacks soul path dao marks, so its living beings have no souls."

Fang Yuan obtained all the information grasped by these human shaped mists.

The information confirmed they hadn't lied. Their existence was monotonous, remaining here from gaining sentience until the world's verge of destruction.

Fang Yuan also discovered these mist figures were not independent entities but part of the world, unable to leave.

"These human shaped mists are quite similar to land spirits and heavenly spirits." A sudden light of inspiration flashed past Fang Yuan's mind.

Formed from fusing a Gu Immortal's obsession with heavenly power, land and heavenly spirits also lacked souls, yet were sentient and could conduct transactions.

"Are these mist figures embryonic forms of land and heavenly spirits? If I comprehend their profundities, could I mass-produce them?"

Half a day later, however, he watched the world's destruction with regret.

He wanted to comprehend how these mist figures formed, but had only made slight progress before the world was destroyed.

Fang Yuan resumed traveling through the void, searching for valuable targets.

"I found no trace of Fang Yuan," Pang Shan said, wiping blood from his lips.

The Three Crazed Demon Eccentrics reunited; previously separated to guard against Fang Yuan, they regrouped once the demonic sounds ceased.

"I know the seventh layer's state during the demonic sounds. Brothers, let it go. Fang Yuan's chances are..." Pang Shan shook his head.

With his main body remaining in the eighth layer for so long, Fang Yuan's clones grew nervous.

Fang clan headquarters.

Divine Bean Palace floated in the air, letting out dazzling jade light.

Fang clan's first supreme elder Fang Gong, third supreme elder Fang Hua Sheng, Fang Leng, and Fang Yun watched from afar.

Its smooth activation signified Fang Di Chang had gained control over Divine Bean Palace.

The palace doors opened as Fang Di Chang walked out with a smile.

"Good!" Fang Gong laughed heartily. "Second elder, you have made a huge contribution." Though this shifted the clan's internal factional balance, it was undeniably great news for the clan overall.

Fang Di Chang smiled: "With this palace, we are secure. But there is no hurry; Divine Bean Palace still has areas to improve, and the crucial divine bean soldiers must be prepared beforehand."

"Take whatever wood path immortal materials you need from the treasury," Fang Gong laughed with genuine delight.

# Chapter 1868: Respective Progress

This was a barren land with grey-white soil.

Fang Di Chang looked at this vast land and scattered yellow jade bean seeds.

Once planted and nurtured, these bean seeds would grow into various divine bean soldiers.

Under the palace's power, the yellow jade bean seeds sprouted rapidly.

"At this rate, yellow bean divine soldiers will sprout within a day and night." Fang Yuan's clone nodded, satisfied.

With a thought, he shifted back into Divine Bean Palace's main hall.

"A painting path method. Divine Bean Palace contains painting path Immortal Gu, making the mural's land real. Truly marvelous."

"The effect is great, but the cost is steep. Fortunately, I can simply bill the expenses to Fang clan." Fang Di Chang smiled.

In the depths of Eastern Sea.

Gu tribe headquarters.

"That will do." Wu Shuai slowly stopped the killer move, forehead drenched in sweat.

In front of him was another batch of new dragonmen.

These new dragonmen included not only former beastmen, but also mermen.

"Thank you for your help, Lord Wu Shuai. Please accept my tribe's gift of thanks." A merman Gu Immortal floated forward, presenting an immortal material with both hands.

"Unmoving rotten water. I happen to need it to raise army ants, so I shall accept. Thank you." Wu Shuai took it directly.

"Working with Gu tribe has gone well, even establishing ties with the merman race."

"Combined with Qi Sea Ancestor's influence, my control over Eastern Sea's Gu Immortal world deepens."

"Human forces also foresee the coming chaos and are wary of Heavenly Court; I can exploit this."

Beast Calamity grotto-heaven.

"Little Du, do you really want to do this?" Mountain Cliff City Lord looked worriedly at Zhan Bu Du.

Zhan Bu Du raised his head firmly: "Master, you are heavily injured, and if that monster runs amok, Mountain Cliff City will be destroyed! I must risk breaking through to become a Combat Beast Warrior, unleash the arrowtail eagle's strength, and slay it."

Mountain Cliff City Lord gazed at Zhan Bu Du, knowing persuasion was futile. Waving his hand, he sighed: "Go on, then."

Zhan Bu Du did not hesitate, immediately leaving to begin his immortal ascension.

This was all Zhan Bu Du's covert manipulation according to a predetermined plan.

"With my main body's foundation, ascension is certain. But I must feign taking a risk to deceive both Mountain Cliff City and the heavenly spirit!"

# Chapter 1869: Main Body's Breakthrough

Crazed Demon Cave's eighth layer was far vaster than Fang Yuan expected.

Learning that venerable Dao fields existed here, he searched for a long time to no avail.

"Without comprehending the void's arrangements, finding the venerable Dao fields may be impossible."

To find his destination in this void, Fang Yuan needed to raise his phantom path attainment.

Yet even with rule path great grandmaster attainment, Fang Yuan was far from comprehending this void.

Unable to break through directly, Fang Yuan pondered briefly and decided to try from another angle.

He activated Cooking Luck Pot, hoping luck path blessings might spur a breakthrough.

Li Xiao Bai's luck resembled a blooming flower filled with nectar, the fruit of diligent cultivation. Beside the flower, a snow-white butterfly flapped large wings, stirring cold wind as it drifted softly toward it.

"The butterfly signifies a woman bringing trouble yet opportunity; if the cold wind descends, the flower will wither."

Unlike Beast Calamity, Profound Literature grotto-heaven was guarded by a rank eight Gu Immortal, preventing Fang Yuan from acting freely.

Thus, luck support became the greatest aid Fang Yuan's main body could provide him.

Fang Yuan immediately mobilized Cooking Luck Pot to alter Li Xiao Bai's luck.

Soon, Li Xiao Bai's flower luck turned vibrant red like spring peach blossoms—peach blossom luck!

"Now it depends on whether the clone can grasp the opportunity." Fang Yuan moved forward.

"Hmm?" Shortly after altering his luck, Fang Yuan made a pleasant discovery.

He spotted a giant fish swimming through the void, swaying its tail with deceptively terrifying speed.

This was Fang Yuan's first time seeing a creature capable of roaming the void outside a world.

"This is likely a sage's disciple the mist mentioned." Fang Yuan gave chase.

Resembling a goldfish, the grey fish was shocked upon seeing Fang Yuan and hastily kowtowed: "Yellow Earth Sage's disciple Little Flower pays respects to the sage!"

"Good. I have been searching for Yellow Earth Dao field; lead the way and you will be rewarded." Fang Yuan laughed.

Unwilling to waste words, Fang Yuan immediately imprisoned the giant grey fish and thoroughly searched its memories.

"Although these venerable Dao fields exist forever, they are always moving."

Yellow Earth Dao field was vast, rivaling even the sovereign immortal aperture, packed with dense earth path dao marks alongside many other paths.

"If I can seize and devour the Yellow Earth Dao field, my assets will increase at least threefold!"

Fang Yuan's large-scale Immortal Gu refinement had consumed vast resources, severely depleting his immortal material reserves.

"Yellow Earth Dao field senses its departed beings and retrieves them once they break through their bottlenecks."

"What benefit comes from their conflict? What goal did the venerables have?"

He smiled: "Didn't you want enlightenment? Meeting me is your good fortune."

The giant grey fish trembled and stammered, terrified by Fang Yuan.

"Even if you don't speak, I know your doubts." Having searched its memories, Fang Yuan understood its bottleneck clearly.

He immediately guided it in concise and easy to understand words.

Fang Yuan patiently continued teaching it, hoping that aiding its breakthrough would trigger a response from the Yellow Earth Dao field.

# Chapter 1870: I Will Take Responsibility

Profound Literature grotto-heaven.

A five-decked warship sailed along a large river flowing eastward.

As the imperial minister's daughter, she was graceful, beautiful, and cultured, but most renowned for literary talent that put most men to shame with her vast knowledge of poetry and history.

Helpless, Su Qi Han drank the medicinal brew.

Soon after, a figure leaped from the water onto the deck.

Su Qi Han sneered: "Shark Bandit, you lost to me recently. Was that lesson not enough? You still dare return!"

Shark Bandit chuckled sinisterly: "Lady Su, I wasn't your match before you drank that medicine. Don't you feel your limbs going numb?"

"The herbs were... cough, tampered with." Another figure climbed over the rails onto the deck.

Su Qi Han's brows furrowed, her heart sinking: "Medicine Demon, you're still alive!"

Su Qi Han paled, stepping back: "What drug did you give me?"

Medicine Demon laughed loudly: "Naturally, the strongest aphrodisiac! It turns the chastest girl into the most lewd, obscene slut!"

"Young miss, run, I'll hold them back!" At the crucial moment, the maid stepped forward to stall for Su Qi Han.

Su Qi Han wept as she fled across the water: "Shark Bandit, Medicine Demon, I will never forgive you! The Imperial Court will execute your nine generations!"

In a pavilion by the river.

Inside were Fang Yuan's clone Li Xiao Bai and his master, Teacher Jiang.

Teacher Jiang gazed at the nighttime river and told Li Xiao Bai: "Compose and recite a poem for me within ten steps."

Teacher Jiang fell silent before shaking his head: "Little Bai, you've made great progress, but your talent is still insufficient to contest for great scholar."

"Teacher, I know ten-step poem composition is the first test for selecting the ten great scholars. Since I passed, Teacher, why not recommend me for the selection?" Li Xiao Bai asked, confused.

Teacher Jiang turned to his favorite student with a smile: "Little Bai, you don't understand the full picture. The ten great scholars selection appears glorious, but it actually cultivates future Imperial Court officials."

"Teacher, you mean immortal ascension?" Li Xiao Bai was astonished.

Li Xiao Bai was merely acting; he already knew everything.

Feigning reluctance, Li Xiao Bai thanked Teacher Jiang and agreed to forfeit the selection.

"This child is worth teaching!" Relieved, Teacher Jiang left with an easy heart.

Li Xiao Bai walked along the riverside toward home.

"Ascending on my own would alert that rank eight Gu Immortal and place me in fatal danger."

"Selection as a great scholar would be a great springboard. Unfortunately, I lack power and backing, having only a teacher. Entering the selection would bring no good end."

Li Xiao Bai was lamenting inwardly when his steps paused.

He saw a person lying on a bush in the riverside.

"Miss, what happened?" After checking his surroundings, Li Xiao Bai stepped forward to help.

Carrying the unconscious girl ashore, he was shocked to discover she was Su Qi Han!

"Su Qi Han is Chancellor Su's daughter and oversees this ten great scholars selection. Yet she was injured to the point of unconsciousness!"

As he pondered, Su Qi Han stirred awake with a soft sound.

"You saved me?" She looked at Li Xiao Bai with a heated look.

Su Qi Han covered his mouth and suddenly pinned Li Xiao Bai to the ground.

Sitting atop him, Su Qi Han hurriedly began removing his clothes.

Bewildered, Li Xiao Bai stammered: "Miss Su, Miss Su, please behave yourself!"

Su Qi Han paused, eyes narrowing: "You know me?"

Li Xiao Bai swallowed nervously: "Miss Su, you oversee the scholar selection, of course I know you. I am Teacher Jiang's student."

Gazing deeply at Li Xiao Bai with a flushed face, Su Qi Han sighed: "It's too late, your teacher is far away. Within ten li, there is only you and me."

"What are you doing? Ah!" Struck gently by Su Qi Han, Li Xiao Bai fell into a daze.

Waking slowly inside a cave, he found his clothes completely torn.

Beside him, Su Qi Han was getting dressed.

"Miss... Miss Su..." Li Xiao Bai barely spoke, lacking the strength to say more.

Dressing without looking at him, Su Qi Han said calmly: "Three days and three nights have passed since we met."

"Relax, I..." She paused, unable to hide her inner turmoil, her voice trembling: "I will take responsibility."

# Chapter 1871: Chicken Dinner

However, Fang Yuan's anticipated matter had yet to appear.

According to the giant grey fish, the time was not yet ripe.

Fang Yuan scoffed inwardly: "Affinity and timing are just excuses to deceive people. Either Yellow Earth Dao field acts on its own, or an autonomous will saw through my scheme and refused to reveal itself."

Crazed Demon Cave, seventh layer.

"Let's rest awhile." Secret Schemer had no other choice.

"Yes, wasn't Fang Yuan a lesson for us?"

Secret Schemer sighed and nodded helplessly: "Alright, let's leave."

Just as Secret Schemer went to turn around, he froze with wide eyes.

Not Immortal and Pang Shan watched Fang Yuan walk slowly toward them.

"It's me." Fang Yuan nodded.

"This is great, you didn't die!" Not Immortal shouted.

Fang Yuan nodded again: "Because I went to the eighth layer and received a venerable's reminder."

"A venerable's reminder?!"

"Yes. In short — Fate must be destroyed to attain eternal life," Fang Yuan lied sincerely.

Teacher Jiang nodded approvingly: "You remain humble and see reality clearly. My teachings were not wasted. However, you overthink. Now that you are chosen, the Imperial Court will protect you. Anyone harming you attacks the Imperial Court's reputation. Do you understand?"

Li Xiao Bai shook his head: "Being less renowned, I might be targeted. Furthermore, Lady Su Qi Han is extremely strict."

Teacher Jiang nodded: "I know of junior Su Qi Han—talented and prideful. Since she wants to take responsibility... she likely intends for you to marry into Su clan."

"Lady Su Qi Han has countless admirers; if word spreads, young geniuses will target me for becoming her lover. When traveling to the Imperial City to meet the Emperor, what should I do? I need your help, Teacher."

Teacher Jiang grunted: "Xiao Bai, do not underestimate yourself. Those targeting my student must reckon with my reputation. How about this... I will write several recommendation letters. Visit them along the way, and they will assist you."

Pausing briefly, Teacher Jiang resolved: "Stay here for a few days; I will teach you some of my methods."

Overjoyed, Li Xiao Bai bowed deeply: "This student thanks Teacher!"

Revealing the secret ostensibly sought help, but truly showcased Li Xiao Bai's rising value.

# Chapter 1878: World Savior Little Du

Beast Calamity grotto-heaven, Sacred Eagle City.

The entire city was a swamp kingdom, infested by prowling yellow soil crocodiles.

Eagle Warrior defended this place, but despite his strength, he was heavily injured.

An immemorial desolate eagle had wounded him and still circled overhead, diving to attack any warrior who appeared.

Bathed in blood, Eagle Warrior watched his people get slaughtered with furious shock.

As he collapsed toward the ground, a muscular young arm caught Eagle Warrior.

"Uncle Eagle, you cannot fight anymore, or you will die," a youthful voice said.

Eagle Warrior smiled bitterly: "Little Du, thanks for saving me. But as City Lord, I cannot abandon my people."

Transforming back into a wounded silver eagle, he charged at the immemorial desolate eagle overhead.

"These Gu Immortals truly differ from outsiders, sacrificing themselves for mortals," Little Du noted.

"Yet it is futile; my main body raised this immemorial desolate eagle specifically to deal with you."

With few restrictions in Beast Calamity grotto-heaven, Little Du had coordinated with the main body to orchestrate this trap.

Outmatched by the immemorial desolate eagle, Eagle Warrior quickly fell into a disadvantage.

As the immemorial eagle dove to finish Eagle Warrior, Little Du transformed into an eagle, intercepting it.

Little Du clashed with the immemorial desolate eagle, but was no match.

After a brief fight, the immemorial desolate eagle smacked him into City Lord Manor.

As planned, Little Du crashed heavily through the floor into the underground altar.

Having fainted earlier, Eagle Warrior awoke to find Little Du beside him.

Overjoyed that Little Du was alive, Eagle Warrior soon frowned: "How long was I unconscious?"

"Not long. Reinforcements haven't arrived, and the eagle is merely circling overhead," Little Du answered.

When they attempted to leave, yellow soil crocodiles blocked every exit.

"They won't," Little Du thought. "Reinforcements will be obstructed; I still have time to execute my plan."

Outwardly, Little Du frowned and slammed his fist down: "Damn it! Do we just wait for reinforcements? Where are we, and why is there an altar?"

Little Du gasped: "Wait, Uncle, isn't it strange? The crocodiles surround this area, yet avoid approaching this ancient altar."

Eagle Warrior replied: "Legends say the first generation Combat Beast King sealed power here, creating an aura that beasts cannot approach."

"First generation Combat Beast King? Why did he seal his power?" Little Du asked curiously.

"Other main cities have similar altars; gathering all these powers grants the first generation Combat Beast King's full strength!"

Little Du blinked: "Then why don't we use this power to defeat the beasts outside?"

Eagle Warrior sighed: "Countless people have tried to claim it and failed; it remains an unyielding relic."

"Alright, Uncle." Little Du strode briskly toward the altar.

Kneeling down, Little Du prayed: "First generation Combat Beast King, please help us! Beasts outside are slaughtering our people! I beg you, if you can hear me in heaven, please do something!"

White light burst from the altar, enveloping Little Du.

The white light fused into Little Du as the indestructible altar shattered.

Little Du turned joyfully: "Uncle, you were right! I inherited the first generation Combat Beast King's power!"

"A miracle! This is a miracle!" Eagle Warrior looked to the sky in sheer ecstasy.

"What?" Little Du was dumbfounded.

"You can claim all the inheritances! You are the world's savior!" Eagle Warrior shouted.

# Chapter 1879: Situation

Eastern Sea.

Dragon Palace.

Fang Yuan's clone, Wu Shuai, sat on his dragon throne manipulating army ants.

During this period, the ant army had grown considerably.

Over a hundred million ants circled in the sky like a flowing golden river.

Right at this moment, Wu Shuai's expression changed.

A Gu Immortal arrived outside Dragon Palace visiting Wu Shuai.

Wu Shuai opened the palace doors and invited them inside.

"Tang Qiong greets Lord Wu Shuai." An adorable, gentle yellow-scaled mermaid smiled, showing dimples.

As an executive elder of the Merman Imperial Court, she represented their will.

Wu Shuai laughed: "Fairy Tang Qiong, what brings you here?"

Tang Qiong turned serious: "Senior, Qi Sea Ancestor is holding an Eastern Sea banquet for all local Gu Immortals. Our Imperial Court was invited, and our grand elder asks if Senior would attend with us?"

"Oh, that matter." Hearing this, Wu Shuai's eyes shone brightly.

After snatching mutation Immortal Gu, Fang Yuan used Qi Sea Ancestor's identity to meddle in Eastern Sea politics.

The banquet was part of Fang Yuan's plan, though he had excluded Wu Shuai.

The Merman Imperial Court's invitation carried deep implications, proving the merfolk genuinely wanted closer ties with the dragonmen.

Pondering, Wu Shuai knowingly asked: "Did Qi Sea Ancestor invite Fang Yuan as well?"

Tang Qiong shook her head: "Qi Sea Ancestor announced he will not invite Fang Yuan, as the banquet is exclusively for Eastern Sea Gu Immortals."

Tang Qiong urged: "Senior Wu Shuai, pardon my presumption, but though you cooperate with Fang Yuan, you and Fang Yuan are separate entities. Though powerful, Fang Yuan is a ruthless, unpredictable human. For dragonmen to reign supreme and truly rise, you must establish an independent force and dominate your own territory."

"Haha, you are right." Wu Shuai laughed. "I appreciate your sincerity, but the time is not ripe for dragonmen to re-emerge."

"Hmm... give me time to consider." Wu Shuai pondered.

"Alright, senior, if you want to go, please contact me. I will take my leave."

Watching Tang Qiong leave Dragon Palace, Wu Shuai fell into deep thought.

The merfolk's attitude was very advantageous, offering an opportunity he could exploit.

Fang Yuan had not anticipated this; his true goal was ensuring Qi Sea Ancestor's decisions heavily swayed Eastern Sea's immortals against Heavenly Court in the future.

Even before Qi Sea Ancestor's banquet began, Fang Yuan's clone Fang Di Chang in Western Desert began similar maneuvers.

A Western Desert righteous path meeting had just ended.

Coordinating with the main body, Fang Di Chang led five righteous path clans to 'defeat' Heavenly Court. Leveraging this achievement, he invited all Western Desert super forces to a meeting.

"These guys... hmph!" Fang Gong walked out, looking unhappy as Xiao clan's Gu Immortal departed.

Fang Di Chang smiled bitterly: "First supreme elder, don't be angry. Heavenly Court retreated safely; we merely publicized their 'defeat' to boost our reputation."

"Fang clan rose too abruptly without decisive dominance. These clans simply envy our fortune in obtaining Divine Bean Palace."

"Calling a meeting now makes them think Fang clan is rushing to become leader. Consequently, they sent insignificant members instead of authoritative elders."

"Heavenly Court must be sowing discord too. Our influence can only grow gradually," Fang Di Chang said.

"Hmph, when Central Continent attacks during the five regions war, I'll see what they do," Fang Gong snorted coldly.

---

# Chapter 1880: Heavenly Court's Discussion

Heavenly Court.

Over ten Gu Immortals gathered in the discussion hall.

Duke Long took the highest seat, followed by Fairy Zi Wei and Qin Ding Ling, then Bai Cang Shui, Cong Yan, Che Wei, Yuan Qiong Du, Zhou Xiong Xin, and others.

Normally, Heavenly Court was managed by wisdom path Gu Immortals. Duke Long served as the spiritual pillar while Fairy Zi Wei handled administration, succeeding Heaven Overseeing Tower Lord.

"Yuan Qiong Du, how is the research on second aperture Gu going?" Duke Long asked.

Fairy Zi Wei interrupted calmly: "Is Fang Yuan so foolish? He expected second aperture Gu to be deduced when releasing it to Southern Border's righteous path. A second aperture is deeply meaningful, but Gu Masters possessing one would need double the cultivation time, effort, and resources."

"We cannot deduce second aperture Immortal Gu's recipe yet?" the previously silent Duke Long asked suddenly.

Yuan Qiong Du smiled bitterly, shaking his head: "We are still far from deducing the Immortal Gu recipe. With several refinement path experts of my level assisting me, I could deduce it faster. But currently, I have limited energy and time, I cannot attend to too many matters at once."

"Southern Border's righteous path has been active, beginning construction of Beacon Towers—an Immortal Gu House worth guarding against."

"Southern Border is trying to break free from Fang Yuan. Wu clan, Chai clan, and others resist him fully, joining Heavenly Court to suppress his businesses in treasure yellow heaven."

"I must remind everyone of a powerful lurking force in Southern Border's Gu Immortal world that we must guard against: Virtue Paradise. Personally established by Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable, this true inheritance possesses many Gu Immortals, including mushroommen, with Lu Wei Yin as their strongest."

"Though Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable never joined Heavenly Court, our relationship was friendly. However, we must probe further to ascertain Virtue Paradise's attitude."

"I have already considered that," Fairy Zi Wei said. "I will soon visit Virtue Paradise personally to borrow Immortal Gu."

After discussing Southern Border, Heavenly Court's immortals turned to Western Desert.

By seizing Divine Bean Palace and 'defeating' Heavenly Court, Fang clan drastically altered Western Desert's situation, foiling Heavenly Court's plans.

"Fang clan certainly has the ability to rise, but the crucial person behind this situation was their second supreme elder, Fang Di Chang!"

"Ambitious and formidable, he had allied with multiple Western Desert righteous path forces; had we not sown discord among them, Fang clan's rise would have been unstoppable."

After further discussion, Heavenly Court's immortals decided to reinforce Western Desert!

Their primary target was no longer Thousand Transformations Ancestor, but Fang clan!

Fang clan's seizure of Divine Bean Palace meant they and Heavenly Court could no longer achieve peace.

After Western Desert was Eastern Sea.

"Eastern Sea's politics are also shifting; Qi Sea Ancestor is hosting a banquet for Eastern Sea's Gu Immortals. What are his intentions?"

"Qi Sea Ancestor recently agreed with Duke Long to stop helping Fang Yuan. Though seemingly neutral, we cannot lower our guard against him."

"We have already infiltrated the banquet; if Qi Sea Ancestor makes any move, we will know quickly."

Duke Long added: "Qi Sea Ancestor possesses extraordinary strength, not beneath my own. In my view, we should actively sway him to our side to reduce threats before fate Gu is repaired."

"Despite having five time path Immortal Gu Houses, we cannot find any trace of the Red Lotus stone islands. Can anything be done?"

Qin Ding Ling also shook her head: "In terms of luck path, Dao Guardian Feng Jiu Ge is guarding there. With his immense luck, if even he fails, nothing can be done."

Duke Long was silent, he felt a little disappointed.

Just then, Fairy Zi Wei's eyes brightened, followed by surprised looks from Duke Long and Qin Ding Ling.

"A Red Lotus stone island appeared in the River of Time."

"Gu Liu Ru has confirmed that this Red Lotus stone island is undoubtedly genuine."

Duke Long nodded: "This is good. We must secure this true inheritance as soon as possible. Also... beware of Fang Yuan."

"Set up the river suppression lotus sealing formation quickly and summon reinforcements. If Fang Yuan comes, we will take his life!"

---

# Chapter 1881: Setting Up Formation

Eastern Sea.

East of the flourishing bumpy sea area and west of the barbecue islands lay a vast, unique region—Qi Sea!

Devoid of water, qi sea consisted of countless intertwined currents swirling in millions of eddies.

"Hosting this Eastern Sea banquet will make qi sea renowned across the five regions again," Fang Yuan's main body mused, gazing down at the sea area from atop a cloud.

Seen from above, qi sea surged with turbulent light-blue waves of qi currents, contrasting sharply with the surrounding dark-blue seawater.

At the center of qi sea, dragonman clone Wu Shuai transmitted: "The formation is ready."

This qi path formation had taken Fang Yuan's time path clone a month to deduce under the light of wisdom.

After checking with his divine sense and confirming no problems, Fang Yuan's main body closed his eyes to meditate.

This Eastern Sea banquet was extremely important to him.

Plotting with the world as his chessboard and arranging pawns to influence the broader situation was no easy task.

Thus, Eastern Sea was an essential part of Fang Yuan's plans.

Eastern Sea was richest in resources; succeeding here would give Fang Yuan sufficient influence to sway the other four regions once the five regions merged.

Moments later, Fang Yuan opened his eyes, gazing at the horizon as he muttered: "They are coming."

An Immortal Gu House flew across the sky, seemingly slow yet moving rapidly.

As the Immortal Gu House halted, a bright-eyed girl emerged wearing a long dress adorned with exquisite rainbow clouds.

"Hua clan first supreme elder Hua Cai Yun greets Qi Sea Ancestor." Despite her rank eight cultivation, Hua Cai Yun acted with great courtesy.

Several Hua clan Gu Immortals then emerged from the Immortal Gu House to pay respects to Fang Yuan.

"You have arrived early, please come in." Fang Yuan extended his hand, gathering qi currents into a cloud seat.

Hua Cai Yun stored her Immortal Gu House into her aperture and sat down, while the other Hua clan Gu Immortals stood behind her.

"I was eager for our first meeting; please accept this gift from Hua clan," Hua Cai Yun said, as a Gu Immortal behind her respectfully presented an item with both hands.

Fang Yuan looked and saw a ball of qi held out respectfully by the Hua clan Gu Immortal.

Lightning flashed and thunder rumbled within this qi lump, alternating between rain, sunshine, and occasional snowfall.

Fang Yuan's eyes brightened, recognizing what it was.

This was a rare rank nine heaven qi.

Gifting rank nine heaven qi demonstrated Hua Cai Yun's sincerity and Hua clan's immense foundation in cloud path.

At the same time, in the River of Time.

Four Immortal Gu Houses flew above the river.

Carrying Heavenly Court and Central Continent Gu Immortals, the four Immortal Gu Houses charged toward Red Lotus' stone island!

Inside Present and Past Pavilion, a rank eight Gu Immortal stood watching the surging river waters.

Wearing a red-and-white robe, he stood straight as a sword. With sharp brows, profound eyes, and a serene, elegant aura, he gazed afar, focused in comprehension.

It was Feng Jiu Ge!

"In the River of Time, I have observed this long river, witnessing the rise and fall of eras and the turbulence of past and present. Destiny is like a wave—rising and falling, surging and slowing. Its profound depth cannot be expressed in words; I can only sing it."

Feng Jiu Ge had been comprehending destiny song all along.

Presently, his destiny song was sixty percent complete—ten percent further along than during Central Continent's fate battle in the previous life.

"My destiny song already depicts the destiny of living beings. But the destiny of venerables cannot be described so simply."

"Back in Heavenly Court, Reckless Savage's blood capes felt incomprehensible. I hope this journey to the stone lotus island helps me advance in creating destiny song."

The four Immortal Gu Houses stopped nearby, Eternal Yacht was already waiting above the stone lotus island.

Eternal Yacht had discovered the island first, prompting its Gu Immortals to alert Heavenly Court, which sent the other four Immortal Gu Houses to join them.

Feng Jiu Ge looked over with an expectant gaze.

Sitting in his wheelchair with cold eyes, he ordered: "Set up the river suppression lotus sealing formation now. I will lead Moment Stage, while Feng Jiu Ge leads Present and Past Pavilion. Eternal Yacht will move out to the tributary's entrance and bring in our reinforcements. Shark Flow Lever and Three Autumn Yellow Crane Platform will patrol the surroundings, if anything shows up, inform me immediately."

"Yes," the immortals replied, springing into motion with great efficiency.

# Chapter 1882: Challenge

"The three supplementary formations are ready." Finishing their work, a group of Gu Immortals sat inside the Immortal Gu House to rest and recover.

The second group took over, adding rank eight Immortal Gu Suppression atop the three supplementary formations.

Gu Liu Ru and Feng Jiu Ge oversaw Moment Stage and Present and Past Pavilion respectively.

Feng Jiu Ge calmly comprehended destiny, while Gu Liu Ru watched with deep, vigilant eyes.

"This is crucial! I must make up for my mistakes and prevent Fang Yuan from succeeding!"

While thinking, a silvery light appeared on the horizon.

Gu Liu Ru's heart immediately tensed.

Patrolling outside, Three Autumn Yellow Crane Platform and Shark Flow Lever pivoted immediately to obstruct the invader.

It was Myriad Year Flying Warship!

"Gu Liu Ru, Heavenly Court dares try to take Red Lotus' true inheritance under my nose? You dream!" Fang Yuan's voice echoed as Myriad Year Flying Warship charged forward.

Gu Liu Ru snorted coldly, his voice echoing across the battlefield: "Fang Yuan, you are merely our defeated foe. Was last time's painful lesson not enough?"

"Haha, with me here, do not dream of setting any formation!" Before Fang Yuan finished speaking, Myriad Year Flying Warship began shining brilliantly.

These lights converged into countless silver flying swords, shooting straight toward the incomplete river suppression lotus sealing formation.

Boom boom boom!

Three Autumn Yellow Crane Platform arrived first to clash with Myriad Year Flying Warship, their fierce impacts splashing the waters of the River of Time.

Shark Flow Lever arrived shortly after.

While the three Immortal Gu Houses fought intensely in the River of Time, the scene above Eastern Sea's qi sea was harmonious and festive.

After Hua Cai Yun, Gu Immortals from Eastern Sea's super forces—Song clan, Su clan, and Cai clan—also arrived.

Representing Song clan was Song Qi Yuan, who attended the banquet with Song Yi Shi.

"This is my granddaughter, Song Yi Shi. Excited after hearing senior's deeds, she asked me to bring her along," Song Qi Yuan smiled, introducing her.

"This junior pays respects to Qi Sea Ancestor." Song Yi Shi said politely.

With snow-white skin, bright eyes, a blue-and-white dress, and an innocent aura, she was truly one of the six great beauties of Eastern Sea's Gu Immortal world.

Like Hua Cai Yun, Song Qi Yuan presented a gift: a valuable rank eight qi path inheritance from Song clan's treasury.

Looking at Song Yi Shi with seniorly warmth, Fang Yuan smiled: "Song clan has a fine descendant. For our first meeting, I cannot let you leave empty-handed."

With that, he sent a rank eight water path immortal material floating toward Song Yi Shi.

Well-bred, Song Yi Shi accepted the gift and promptly offered thanks.

"Take a seat." Fang Yuan waved his hand, condensing qi currents into a seat just below him to the left.

Delighted with this prominent seating, Song Qi Yuan quickly led Song Yi Shi to their seats.

Storing the rank eight water path immortal material in her aperture, Song Yi Shi acted modestly and gracefully, displaying the poise of an esteemed clan's young lady.

When Nan Gong clan's Gu Immortals arrived, Hua Cai Yun's expression darkened.

Nan Gong clan's first supreme elder had brought Hua An along.

Having defected from Hua clan to Nan Gong clan, Hua An was one of Eastern Sea's three renowned wisdom path experts.

As the saying went: Jia Dan sits in twin polar, Hua An hides in Nan Gong, and Dragon Head Tortoise dwells in adversity sea.

Eastern Sea's righteous path arrived one by one.

The last arrival was the grand elder of the Merman Imperial Court.

Fang Yuan offered comforting words and arranged her seat at the very end.

River of Time.

Myriad Year Flying Warship was already at the inner area.

Immortal killer move — Daybreak Sword!

Swords surged like an army of pythons across the battlefield, striking Three Autumn Yellow Crane Platform.

Three Autumn Yellow Crane Platform shone with bright orange light, steadily weakening the silver flying swords.

Meanwhile, Shark Flow Lever unleashed three frost waves, freezing the River of Time beneath Myriad Year Flying Warship.

Fang Yuan grunted inside Myriad Year Flying Warship as the silver flying swords wheeled around, gathering beneath the river.

Immortal killer move — Torrential Charge!

Myriad Year Flying Warship surged like a meteor, crashing toward the incomplete river suppression lotus sealing formation.

Boom!

With a crash, Moment Stage blocked Myriad Year Flying Warship as the two rank eight Immortal Gu Houses collided.

Moment Stage suffered a slight disadvantage, but Myriad Year Flying Warship's advance was halted as Shark Flow Lever and Three Autumn Yellow Crane Platform caught up.

Just then, two more time path Immortal Gu Houses arrived as reinforcements.

Eternal Yacht carried Xing Ye Wang, while Sun and Moon Temple brought Nine Spiritual Fairy.

Four rank eight Gu Immortals, six time path Immortal Gu Houses!

Eastern Sea, above qi sea.

Surging qi currents formed a vast cloud, from which exquisite dishes and fine wine materialized at Qi Sea Ancestor's will.

Just as Qi Sea Ancestor prepared to raise his cup and open the banquet, a voice resounded across the sky: "Black Soul Sea Lord requests a spar with Qi Sea Ancestor."

Immediately, his rank eight aura of dark energy blanketed the entire area.

The Eastern Sea immortals were stunned, their eyes quickly brightening.

An Eastern Sea rank eight was actually challenging Qi Sea Ancestor!
