# Chapter 1883: Ancestor's Divine Might!

Though Myriad Year Flying Warship was in a tight spot, Fang Yuan smiled calmly: "Hehehe, you want the stone lotus island? If I cannot have it, none of you will either."

Immortal killer move — Myriad Year Hunting!

A fragrance spread from Myriad Year Flying Warship, causing countless dao beasts to roar in resonance.

A wave of a year beast tide was rapidly forming.

This time, Fang Yuan targeted Heavenly Court's weakness; as they were setting up the river suppression lotus sealing formation, they had no choice but to fight the beasts.

Gu Liu Ru snorted coldly: "This scoundrel is devious, he used this move after all."

Gu Liu Ru sent Eternal Yacht and Shark Flow Lever outside, while Nine Spiritual Fairy transformed into an immemorial desolate beast to depart.

Once outside, Eternal Yacht and Shark Flow Lever shone brightly, radiating two auras resembling Years Flow Like Water Immortal Gu.

The new beast tide was instantly drawn over, with eighty percent rushing toward the two Immortal Gu Houses.

Transformed into an immemorial desolate beast, Nine Spiritual Fairy intercepted the remaining twenty percent and took control of them.

The remaining four Immortal Gu Houses tightly surrounded Myriad Year Flying Warship, unleashing a barrage of attacks.

Leading Heavenly Court's four Immortal Gu Houses, the rank eight Moment Stage, manned by time path great expert Gu Liu Ru, was fully a match for Myriad Year Flying Warship.

But at this moment, a grand aura surged from the stone lotus island.

Golden light flashed as a grey stone giant stood up slowly.

The immense giant possessed bulging muscles and ferociously shining eyes.

The giant let out a tiger's roar; sound waves spread in all directions, creating massive ripples around the island.

The river suppression lotus sealing formation shook violently, making the Gu Immortals establishing it cough up blood.

Roaring, the grey stone giant flexed its arms, its forearms and biceps ballooning to three times their original size.

Pitch-black bull horns sprouted on its forehead. Lowering its head, it brought its palms together before its chest; surging air currents coalesced between them into a swirling sphere.

The giant drew in more and more time path dao marks, condensing them into a massive silver sphere.

As the ball swelled, the giant monster growled and hurled the silver sphere forward with all its might.

Shooting out like a meteor, the silver sphere whipped up fierce gales.

"Quick, block it!" Gritting his teeth, Gu Liu Ru forcefully steered Moment Stage to intercept the silver sphere.

Boom!

The silver sphere struck Moment Stage with terrifying might, sending the Immortal Gu House tumbling away.

"We blocked it." Gu Liu Ru exhaled as Moment Stage halted, battered with cracks and many damaged Immortal Gu.

The Gu Immortals inside Moment Stage scrambled frantically to repair the battered house.

The gale damaged the lotus sealing formation, leaving the Gu Immortals scrambling to make repairs.

Gu Liu Ru frowned deeply: "This giant uses a familiar time path method! To think Red Lotus Demon Venerable left this behind."

Gu Liu Ru's objective was to protect the formation, which would isolate the area and suppress the stone lotus island.

Fang Yuan attacked aggressively, pushing the remaining rank seven Immortal Gu Houses to their limits.

With Heavenly Court's situation deteriorating, Gu Liu Ru snorted coldly, exiting Moment Stage to join the encirclement against Myriad Year Flying Warship.

Eventually, the river suppression lotus sealing formation was completed, forming a massive sphere enclosing both the stone lotus island and Myriad Year Flying Warship.

As the formation activated, the grey stone giant grunted under its intense suppression.

Myriad Year Hunting was also restricted; with the fragrance contained, no beast tide could form.

"Eliminate Fang Yuan first, then explore the stone lotus island!" Gu Liu Ru shouted.

Free from the beast tide threat, Eternal Yacht, Shark Flow Lever, and Nine Spiritual Fairy returned to join the encirclement of Fang Yuan.

"Fang Yuan, this will be your final resting place!" Gu Liu Ru declared coldly, his eyes flashing.

"Don't wait, kill him!" Xing Ye Wang charged with Shark Flow Lever, brimming with killing intent.

Silently and swiftly maneuvering behind Myriad Year Flying Warship, Nine Spiritual Fairy unleashed her aura to prepare a killer move.

Just then, Fang Yuan sneered from within Myriad Year Flying Warship: "Heavenly Court, you've already walked into a trap, can't you tell?"

Before he finished speaking, the stone lotus island erupted with radiant light as dozens of water pillars surged around it.

The light and water pillars hijacked the formation, dumbfounding Central Continent's Gu Immortals: "We lost control of the formation!"

Though in utter disbelief, Heavenly Court's four rank eights faced the undeniable truth: this was all Fang Yuan's trap!

"It seems sacrificing a stone lotus island was worth it—this is not my grave, but yours." The stone giant sprouted beast features, soaring up to smash through the encirclement for Myriad Year Flying Warship.

Gu Liu Ru finally recognized the giant, shouting in shock and fury: "The Twelve Zodiac battle formation! To think Fang Yuan possessed this method!"

"We cannot stay here, we need to retreat!"

The four Heavenly Court rank eights quickly resolved to retreat.

Ironically, the river suppression lotus sealing formation they had painstakingly erected now became their greatest obstacle.

"Leaving so soon? Too late!" Fang Yuan laughed as Daybreak Swords flew toward Heavenly Court's houses.

Growling loudly, the grey stone giant pounced toward Present and Past Pavilion.

Ignoring the torrential waves surrounding Present and Past Pavilion, the grey stone giant charged forward and slammed its fist down.

Boom!!

Present and Past Pavilion crumbled under the giant's fist.

Casualties were severe, with Feng Jiu Ge barely escaping in a wretched state.

Moment Stage!

At the critical juncture, Moment Stage teleported over and rescued Feng Jiu Ge.

Ignoring the nearby Moment Stage, the grey stone giant turned toward Sun and Moon Temple.

Boom!!

A second explosion shattered Sun and Moon Temple completely.

"No!!" Gu Liu Ru gritted his teeth, eyes bloodshot with rage and body trembling with hatred.

Eastern Sea, above qi sea.

The Gu Immortals watched with excitement as Qi Sea Ancestor faced Zhang Yin.

Under everyone's gaze, Qi Sea Ancestor smiled faintly: "Gu Immortal Zhang Yin, you are brave, but can you withstand a single move of mine?"

Zhang Yin smirked arrogantly: "Ancestor underestimates me, not just one move—ugh."

He suddenly stopped as the other Gu Immortals' expressions changed.

Instantly, the world buzzed as countless qi currents gathered from all directions.

The immortals broke into cold sweat under the crushing pressure, helpless as insects.

Zhang Yin's face flushed red; frozen midair with bulging eyes, he struggled and trembled, unable to break free.

The Eastern Sea immortals looked up, their faces turning paper-white.

A colossal, translucent hand made of qi currents blotted out the sky!

As the giant hand descended, the Eastern Sea immortals felt suffocated, as if a mountain were crushing down upon them.

Zhang Yin roared and unleashed dark energy, yet remained pinned.

The qi hand bypassed Zhang Yin to slam into the qi sea.

Without any explosion, the hand dissolved into the waters.

Regaining freedom, a sweat-drenched Zhang Yin panted in lingering terror.

"Look at qi sea!" Song Yi Shi shouted.

Looking over, everyone saw the turbulent, whirlpool-filled qi sea completely stilled like a mirror!

"I have truly experienced Ancestor's divine might." Exhaling, Zhang Yin bowed respectfully: "Thank you for sparing my life."

Sitting at the main seat with half-closed eyes, Qi Sea Ancestor lightly waved his sleeve: "Take your seat."

By subduing Zhang Yin in a single move, Qi Sea Ancestor thoroughly intimidated everyone.

"Ancestor possesses divine might!" Song Qi Yuan rose, offering respectful praise.

"Ancestor possesses divine might!" Shen Cong Sheng stood and echoed respectfully.

"Ancestor possesses divine might!" Countless Eastern Sea Gu Immortals rose in awe to pay homage.

Fang Yuan smiled faintly: "Everyone, take your seats, the banquet begins."

# Chapter 1884: Qi Spreads in Five Regions

Fang Yuan's stone lotus island ambush had concluded.

Though radiant light bathed Heavenly Court, the atmosphere inside Central Great Hall was grim.

"Gu Liu Ru risked his life blocking Myriad Year Flying Warship; I only survived thanks to him," Nine Spiritual Fairy coughed.

Heavenly Court suffered total defeat in the River of Time: six Immortal Gu Houses destroyed, with only two survivors.

Present in the hall as well, Feng Jiu Ge had lost his usual composure, his dull eyes reflecting confusion and loss.

Fairy Zi Wei sighed inwardly and sent them to recuperate.

"To think Fang Yuan secured the stone lotus island long ago without us noticing... how did he do it?" Fairy Zi Wei deduced silently, finding no answer.

Falling entirely into Fang Yuan's trap, Heavenly Court suffered a catastrophic defeat with severe losses.

Duke Long smiled bitterly: "We had already suspected Fang Yuan possessed a Red Lotus true inheritance. He deliberately drew our focus to Dragon Palace while preparing this ambush. What a devious, scheming demon!"

"When did he obtain it? If only recently, fine, but if he took the island long ago..." Fairy Zi Wei shuddered at the terrifying thought.

Duke Long said solemnly: "Even if Fang Yuan obtained a Red Lotus true inheritance and the Twelve Zodiac battle formation, we must keep deploying forces into the River of Time!"

With multiple Red Lotus true inheritances in existence, Fang Yuan would become far more terrifying if he claimed another.

To Heavenly Court, the River of Time remained vital ground to defend, and the Red Lotus true inheritances were essential to secure.

Fairy Zi Wei nodded gravely, fully in agreement with Duke Long.

Deploying time path Gu Immortals was the best way to project strength into the River of Time.

Yet due to Red Lotus Demon Venerable, Heavenly Court's foundation of time path immortals was exceedingly weak.

Lacking time path great experts, they could only compensate with time path Immortal Gu Houses.

Rebuilding the six destroyed houses required an immense number of time path Immortal Gu.

Refinement immortal materials were not an issue.

Heavenly Court lacked not immortal materials, but refinement path great experts.

Though Yuan Qiong Du was a refinement expert, overseeing Fate Gu's repair consumed him completely.

Duke Long decided: "Mobilize refinement path Gu Immortals across the ten great ancient sects to collaborate on refining time path Immortal Gu."

Fairy Zi Wei sighed internally: "Had we captured Lang Ya Sect, this wouldn't be an issue. What a pity it fell into Fang Yuan's hands."

"According to our latest reports, Qi Sea Ancestor defeated Zhang Yin in a single move; the famed Eastern Sea rank eight lone immortal couldn't even retaliate. Qi Sea Ancestor's soaring reputation has drawn even more Eastern Sea immortals to his banquet," Fairy Zi Wei said.

Duke Long nodded: "Even for me, that would be no easy feat. It seems Qi Sea Ancestor grew stronger after comprehending Primordial Origin's true inheritance, as he claims."

Fang Yuan openly claimed his strength surged thanks to Primordial Origin's qi path true inheritance from Heavenly Court.

Duke Long added: "His statement shows goodwill toward Heavenly Court while maintaining neutrality. He can be swayed to our side."

Having remained in seclusion despite matching Duke Long in strength, Qi Sea Ancestor clearly lacked ambition.

Even if ambitious now, he would naturally be drawn to Heavenly Court, which held Primordial Origin's complete true inheritance.

Qi Sea Ancestor's neutrality reassured Duke Long and Fairy Zi Wei of his stance.

Fairy Zi Wei suggested: "We can openly send envoys to his banquet; having accepted our inheritance, he cannot refuse our visit."

Duke Long agreed; even if negotiations failed, they would still probe Qi Sea Ancestor's intentions.

With unfavorable shifts across the regions, Eastern Sea remained relatively tranquil. Heavenly Court sought to capitalize on this, ensuring Eastern Sea's forces remained neutral toward them.

Eastern Sea, above qi sea.

Ever since Fang Yuan defeated Zhang Yin, visitors increased and banquet attendance multiplied rapidly.

Arriving Gu Immortals first paid respects to Qi Sea Ancestor, eager to see Eastern Sea's number one Gu Immortal.

The entire world was deceived by Fang Yuan.

Zhang Yin cooperated with Fang Yuan, while the immortal formation under qi sea amplified Qi Sea Ancestor's attack.

Nobody knew Zhang Yin was controlled, as Duke Long was unaware of Dream Token's power.

Nobody guessed Qi Sea Ancestor and Fang Yuan were the same person, since Fang Yuan was merely rank seven while Qi Sea Ancestor was genuinely rank eight. Concealing the sovereign immortal aperture allowed Fang Yuan to reap far greater rewards.

"I, Central Continent Gu Immortal Jun Shen Guang, bring a gift to meet Qi Sea Ancestor; please forgive my uninvited intrusion." Heavenly Court's rank eight Gu Immortal Jun Shen Guang arrived.

The banquet became silent, countless gazes looked towards Fang Yuan.

Fang Yuan chuckled: "An esteemed guest arrives, what forgiveness is needed? Eastern Sea embraces all. Please take a seat."

Fang Yuan formed another seat, placing it respectfully below the Eastern Sea rank eight Gu Immortals.

Seeing this, the Eastern Sea Gu Immortals' expressions relaxed.

Seeing almost everyone present, Fang Yuan looked around and began: "Everyone, I have something to say."

Fang Yuan spoke briefly, outlining his stance: peaceful coexistence, mutual understanding, upholding justice, and resolving conflicts.

Finally, he said: "This banquet is not merely a gathering; it is also a trading event, an auction, and a battle stage. Anyone with conflicts may duel, judged by me. Those wishing to trade resources may step forward and state their requests. From now on, I will host a qi sea banquet every year at this time. Naturally, I will charge no transaction fees."

"Ancestor is wise."

Jun Shen Guang was shaken: Qi Sea Ancestor was using this move to expand his influence over Eastern Sea.

Jun Shen Guang foresaw these annual banquets expanding, eventually extending Qi Sea Ancestor's influence across all five regions.

# Chapter 1885: Banquet Transactions, Heart Blood Appears

Qi sea banquet.

Transactions were undergoing.

A Gu Immortal in a black robe and disheveled hair stepped onto the stage, revealing himself as Eastern Sea lone immortal Wu Ma Yang.

Hook-nosed and dark-eyed, he appeared injured, coughing as he produced a floating shell.

Wu Ma Yang smiled coldly: "Calm down, everyone. Why would I dare embarrass myself at Ancestor's banquet? I am not selling this small music clam, but the music stored within."

Wu Ma Yang cupped his fists toward Fang Yuan: "Ancestor, please pardon my discourtesy."

Qi Sea Ancestor nodded lightly.

With Fang Yuan's approval, he opened a slit in the small music clam.

Instantly, everyone heard a crying sound emitting from within it.

Faint yet rhythmic, the sobbing melody restrained anyone who investigated it, sapping their strength until they could not resist. Mortals would surely succumb, while Gu Immortals would suffer injury or even death in severe cases.

Wu Ma Yang soon snapped the clam shut. As silence returned, many Gu Immortals sighed wistfully before turning vigilant, realizing they had been affected.

"This is rank seven immortal material ghostly wail."

"Ancestor is truly knowledgeable. I will exchange this ghostly wail for any rank seven dark path immortal material of equal value, preferably black hole wood or dark thread algae," Wu Ma Yang announced.

After a brief silence, an immortal called out: "I have dark thread algae."

Wu Ma Yang nodded joyfully, but before he could answer, another said: "I have black hole wood to exchange for your ghostly wail."

Following brief negotiations, Wu Ma Yang left the stage satisfied.

Next, another Gu Immortal took the stage to sell a cluster of flame.

The flame brimmed with death energy, turning the surrounding air dry and scorching hot.

"This is drought zombie flame," the seller smiled.

He was Su Lun, a righteous path member from Eastern Sea's super force Su clan.

Fang Yuan alternated turns between righteous and lone immortals, while excluding demonic immortals to convey his stance.

Fang Yuan waved his hand, easily compressing the rank eight flame into a ball.

The banquet's temperature steadily returned to normal.

"Many of you likely recognize this flame. Today, I am offering not just the flame, but also a drought immortal zombie lifespan extension method. This method allows an immortal near their lifespan limit to become a drought immortal zombie with rank eight strength."

Yet the Gu Immortals showed little interest.

Once Heavenly Court restored Fate Gu, the world would no longer tolerate immortal zombies.

"This drought zombie flame likely came from Eastern Sea's Zombie Alliance headquarters," Fang Yuan recognized from Shadow Sect's inheritance.

Following the drought zombie flame, another Eastern Sea Gu Immortal took the stage.

He stepped up slowly, glancing at Qi Sea Ancestor, who remained relaxed with eyes closed, offering no reaction.

Calming slightly, the Eastern Sea immortal exhaled and announced hoarsely: "I came here to exchange Immortal Gu."

With that, he opened his hand to reveal an Immortal Gu.

Instantly, a bloody stench billowed out, making many immortals' hearts pound violently.

This was the banquet's first Immortal Gu transaction!

All eyes focused on the ladybug-like Gu, which emitted a distinct, thumping heartbeat from within its crimson shell. The thumping heartbeat grew louder, disrupting the gathered Gu Immortals' own heart rhythms.

"What Immortal Gu is this? Even Gu Immortals got injured, while mortals definitely cannot approach it."

"It is clearly a blood path Immortal Gu."

"Drowning Uncle is too daring, publicly selling a blood path Immortal Gu at the qi sea banquet. Is he not afraid Qi Sea Ancestor and the Eastern Sea righteous path will strike?"

"Everyone in Eastern Sea knows Drowning Uncle is a demonic immortal. Ancestor never permitted demonic cultivators on stage, yet he walked up fearlessly."

Righteous path members scowled, though Drowning Uncle also felt trepidation before the crowd.

Regarding Drowning Uncle, all the Gu Immortals turned toward Fang Yuan.

Fang Yuan remained calm and composed, saying nothing as if resting.

Watching Fang Yuan, they realized Qi Sea Ancestor had no intention of acting.

Drowning Uncle grew excited—his gamble to attend the banquet had paid off.

"Since Ancestor permitted me into the banquet, an exalted figure like him won't bother targeting small fry like me."

Thinking this, Drowning Uncle spoke: "This is rank seven heart blood Immortal Gu, captured inside an Earth Trench. Will anyone exchange for it?"

After momentary silence, many Gu Immortals quickly bid for it.

Many Gu Immortals offered water path Immortal Gu, as water path was Eastern Sea's most common path and held the region's largest number of Immortal Gu.

Eastern Sea held many secluded cultivators, yet a single heart blood Immortal Gu drew so many blood path practitioners into the open.

But Fang Yuan was not surprised.

"This heart blood Immortal Gu would serve as the ideal core for Song Zi Xing's heart blood premonition killer move."

Zhang Yin spoke: "I want this heart blood Immortal Gu. Pick any of my rank seven water path Immortal Gu, plus a favor."

As the first rank eight Gu Immortal to speak in the auction, his voice silenced the surroundings.

# Chapter 1887: Banquet Ends, Desire to Enter Dragon Whale

Inconspicuous in the vast Eastern Sea, this uninhabited island concealed four Gu Immortals.

All four were injured; one lay motionless, life uncertain, while the other three sat healing their wounds.

Moments later, someone coughed, spitting mouthfuls of blood.

Ambitious and charismatic, Miao Ming Shen led an alliance of three fellow lone immortals: Immortal Hua Die, Feng Jiang, and Gui Qi Ye.

# Chapter 1888: Changes Midway

Miao Ming Shen led the group, joined by Gui Qi Ye, Feng Jiang, Immortal Hua Die, Zeng Luo Zi, Tu Tou Tuo, Tong Hua, and Fang Yuan.

Miao Ming Shen looked around solemnly: "The risks of this expedition are unknown and potentially fatal. If anyone wishes to back out, you may leave now. I will not stop you, and I completely understand."

The immortals then entered the sea, using a method to track each other's locations.

Miao Ming Shen led them through the undercurrents, with Fang Yuan following amidst the group.

# Chapter 1889: Entering the Aperture

"There is a traitor among us! Split up!" Miao Ming Shen shouted with an ashen expression, eyeing his companions with suspicion.

"Since you noticed me, none of you will escape," Shen Cong Sheng laughed, flicking his finger to send surging sound waves toward the group.

Surrounded by these sound waves, Miao Ming Shen's group slowed drastically.

Immortal Hua Die gasped as sound waves bound her, and Shen Cong Sheng dragged her away immediately.

"Hua Die!" Feng Jiang rushed to help, but Shen Cong Sheng easily captured him as well.

He snorted coldly: "Attack."

Ren Xiu Ping and the surrounding Shen clan Gu Immortals found their targets and attacked.

Only Shen clan's Shen Tan, an ordinary water path Gu Immortal, attacked Fang Yuan.

He shot a vat-sized water ring flying toward Fang Yuan's head.

Unwilling to fight, Fang Yuan transformed into a seahorse and darted away.

Fang Yuan pretended to be trapped while patiently observing his allies.

Moving alongside Miao Ming Shen, Gui Qi Ye shouted as two Shen clan Gu Immortals closed in: "Lord, go quickly! I will stop them."

"Old Gui, take care!" Knowing the gravity of the situation, Miao Ming Shen flew upward with tearful eyes.

Suppressing Feng Jiang and Immortal Hua Die completely, Shen Cong Sheng sneered: "Where are you going?"

Saying this, countless sound waves chased after Miao Ming Shen.

Miao Ming Shen grunted, activating a space path killer move.

He vanished instantly, reappearing a hundred steps away before blinking another hundred steps further from the group.

Flickering repeatedly, Miao Ming Shen escaped and charged out of the sea.

With Miao Ming Shen as his prime target, Shen Cong Sheng tossed the two captives to his subordinates and gave chase.

Right at this moment, there was a shrill cry resounding.

An immemorial thunder phoenix flew over and attacked Shen Cong Sheng.

The immemorial thunder phoenix attacked fiercely, forcing Shen Cong Sheng to abandon chasing Miao Ming Shen and face the beast.

With a deafening crash, the immemorial thunder phoenix blasted Shen Cong Sheng back into the sea, churning up massive waves.

While Shen Tan caught the two captives tossed to him, Fang Yuan used the distraction to destroy the water rings and aid the others.

Tong Hua, Zeng Luo Zi, and Fang Yuan escaped the sea, flying into the sky.

"All of you, scram!" An intense sound wave suddenly erupted from the ocean depths.

Shen Cong Sheng shot from the sea into the sky, unleashing two translucent sound blades across the battlefield.

Immortal killer move — Aerial Sound Blades!

The sound blades sliced through lightning and eagles, forcing even the immemorial thunder phoenix back.

One sound blade curved around Tong Hua and swiftly slit Zeng Luo Zi's throat.

Zeng Luo Zi's eyes widened as his severed head fell.

A sound blade went after Fang Yuan.

Fang Yuan sighed inwardly, bursting with speed to charge straight toward the immemorial thunder phoenix.

Charred by lightning in the next instant, he died on the spot.

Fang Yuan opened his eyes as he woke up.

"I arrived here after all." He stood up and looked around.

The sea was blue with white waves, the sandy beach golden, and the surroundings warm and serene.

"Hmm?" Fang Yuan saw Zeng Luo Zi here as well.

Though beheaded by Shen Cong Sheng's sound path killer move, Zeng Luo Zi lay unconscious on the beach with normal breathing and his head intact.

"As expected," Fang Yuan thought calmly. "The illusion started long ago; deaths within it are not real."

Thus, Fang Yuan hadn't acted earlier. Killing Shen Cong Sheng wouldn't have been fatal, only transporting him here sooner while needlessly exposing Fang Yuan's identity.

Fang Yuan waved his hand as a qi blade flew towards Zeng Luo Zi.

Though Zeng Luo Zi was defenseless, the qi blade vanished right before striking him.

Fang Yuan snorted coldly, turning around and leaving.

Shen Cong Sheng awoke with blurry vision to a joyful cry beside him: "First supreme elder, you finally woke up!"

As his vision cleared, he saw his Shen clan subordinates and Miao Ming Shen's group locked in a tense standoff.

"What happened? Didn't I die!" Shen Cong Sheng was inwardly shocked, feeling it was unreal.

"First supreme elder, this is Paradise Earth's arrangement, similar to the Reincarnation Battlefield," Shen Tan said.

Shen Cong Sheng calmed down and nodded: "This is indeed Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable's style."

His eyes flashed as he glared at Miao Ming Shen's group, asking directly: "How long have you been awake?"

# Chapter 1890: Where is Chu Ying?

However, his killer move vanished upon activation, and Shen Cong Sheng grunted as blood trickled from his nose from the backlash.

# Chapter 1891: Who Else Could It Be But Me?

The island was small; finding nothing from their exploration, the immortals quickly gathered at its center.

A huge golden obelisk radiated with a mild crystalline light.

Rank eight Immortal Gu House — Merit Obelisk!

To obtain the true inheritance, one had to complete missions on the Merit Obelisk, earning merits to exchange for rewards.

Those who refused could only wait on the island, unable to leave for other parts of the grotto-heaven.

Paradise Earth had provided the island's immortal materials for explorers to share, preventing anyone from leaving empty-handed.

Three hundred days later, everyone would be transported away.

Help South Coast City's merfolk excavate golden lotuses on silver lake.

Round fish island was drying up and needed wells built.

A large amount of immortal materials and Immortal Gu could be exchanged with merits!

Despite his dense rank eight dao marks, a grand, mystical power transported him instantly and unhindered.

For instance, he could not leave the area, restricted solely to this desert.

Communication was restricted; he could not even message treasure yellow heaven or his clan members.

He could not attack the villagers either; any offensive method failed and caused backlash.

He could open his immortal aperture to retrieve items, but could not store anything from round fish island into it.

In short, Dragon Whale Paradise granted inhabitants great freedom while heavily restricting Gu Immortals on missions.

# Chapter 1893: Saving Xia Lin Again

This time, Fang Yuan intended to take Dragon Whale Paradise; regret Gu was only part of a greater plan.

He breathed out lightly as a bubble surrounded Xia Lin.

"Controlling this force will be quite helpful to my plans ahead."

# Chapter 1894: Going Down, Going Up

Simultaneously, his ranking on the merit board skyrocketed back to the top.

Chu Ying, ninety-eight merit points!

# Chapter 1895: Mid-sized Missions

Small missions awarded one to ten merit points, while mid-sized missions gave eleven to a hundred.

Mid-sized missions were Gu Immortal level; this tiger king salamander was a rank six desolate beast whose battle strength had reached rank seven.

Let us make another deal: what do you want for the information to unlock these missions?"

Fang Yuan shook his head: "I won't sell this information; you can test it yourselves."

Shen Cong Sheng glared: "Chu Ying, I hope you think carefully!"

Ignoring him, Fang Yuan vanished again in a flash of white light.

# Chapter 1898: Accumulated Soil Mountain

He quickly told Shen Cong Sheng about this discovery.

Soon, Shen clan's Gu Immortals began showing rising merit points.

Followed by Ren Xiu Ping, Tong Hua and the rest.

After completing another mission, Fang Yuan's merit points rose past one thousand.

He spent a thousand merit points in exchange for the 'really good person' title.

With this title, he could finally accept large sized missions.

# Chapter 1900: Super Good Person

The island resembled a massive dark yellow beehive, pitted with surface holes and honeycombed with tunnels inside.

Inside was a rank six Gu Immortal with broad shoulders, a narrow waist, and jade-green battle armor.

Dense clusters of red thread earthworms shot violently at Feng Jiang from all directions.

Feng Jiang fought as he retreated.

Though his battle strength surpassed desolate beasts and he possessed many killer moves, his mission was to quell the red thread earthworm calamity and restore the island's ecology.

"There are too many red thread earthworms, and likely desolate beasts inside. After all, this is a mid-sized mission."

Opening his immortal aperture, he summoned a swarm of elite wild bees with rank five battle strength, led by a desolate beast bee.

This was the yellow gyro bee.

Under Feng Jiang's command, the yellow gyro bees buzzed like a yellow cloud and burrowed into the hive.

Aided by the yellow gyro bees, the native swarm overcame brief confusion to fiercely attack the earthworms entrenched in the island's lower depths.

Prepared to act, Feng Jiang immediately deployed methods to repair the island.

Fortunately, once the earthworms suffered heavy casualties, their sole desolate beast leader retreated, guiding the survivors away from the hive.

Besides fully repairing and reinforcing the island's weaknesses, he released bees from his immortal aperture and planted special flowers to restore the local ecology.

Beehive island was fully revitalized, not only regaining balance but gaining greater potential for future development.

Returning to the Merit Obelisk, Feng Jiang checked his score and saw he had gained over eighty merit points.

Feng Jiang stared blankly with regret: "Less than a hundred points—my actions weren't perfect. I should have eradicated the earthworms; letting them escape means they might attack again."

Days ago, after returning to the Merit Obelisk and reading the board, Fang Yuan had shared the secret of the 'good person' title with Miao Ming Shen's group.

Thus, Feng Jiang exchanged for the 'good person' title to accept mid-sized missions.

Beyond misunderstanding the mission's full requirements, he had also invested heavily in it.

To secure those merit points, he had sacrificed his yellow gyro bees.

Because white light flashed as Fang Yuan appeared beside him.

His score surged from last place, overtaking nearly everyone to enter the top three again.

"Five hundred merit points in one go?!" Feng Jiang's heart shook.

"I spent a thousand merit points on the 'really good person' title, unlocking higher-tier missions," Fang Yuan explained with a smile.

Fang Yuan walked to the obelisk's other side and exchanged for his third title, 'super good person', his score plummeting by five hundred back to last place.

"They should be back by now." Fang Yuan walked toward Feng Jiang without immediately taking a new mission.

As expected, Miao Ming Shen and the others soon returned to meet Fang Yuan.

Feng Jiang quickly shared the secret of the 'really good person' title with Miao Ming Shen's group.

Miao Ming Shen thought: "'Good person' unlocks mid-sized missions, while 'really good person' unlocks large-sized ones. With this clear series of titles, anyone who found 'good person' could easily connect the dots to 'really good person'."

"Brother Miao, don't fear Shen Cong Sheng. I have a way to teleport us far away from him outside to ensure our safety," Fang Yuan lied, leaving Miao Ming Shen's group deeply shocked.

Gui Qi Ye raised his brows: "A reward from the Merit Obelisk?"

"Indeed." Fang Yuan nodded, but he had no idea if that existed.

Fang Yuan continued: "I can accept large-sized missions now, but I need everyone's help to complete them."

He accepted a large-sized mission from the obelisk and shared its details with Miao Ming Shen and the others.

Miao Ming Shen's group was shocked, their expressions shifting as they reviewed the mission details.

The 'super good person' title allowed one to share missions.

Mid-sized missions were arduous for solo Gu Immortals. Though sharing them divided the merit points, the boosted completion efficiency far outweighed the costs.

After brief consideration, Miao Ming Shen accepted the mission.

# Chapter 1901: Formation Calms Sea Area

Five flashes of white light transported Fang Yuan, Miao Ming Shen, and the others from the Merit Obelisk to the area.

The raging sea churned up thousands of fierce waves, so turbulent that countless sea beasts were reflected in the swells.

In this sea, there were five small islands.

First was jade shaking island, its countless jade pillars tinkling in the powerful winds.

Second was white bone island, pale white and strewn with beast corpses.

Third was hidden space island, appearing illusory as if nonexistent.

Fourth was sword wind island, swept by three perpetual tornadoes.

Fifth was crescent-shaped treasure moon island, perpetually shrouded in night, every inch of its sand glowing with faint moonlight.

Three of the five islands were drifting with the current, with sword wind island moving fastest in erratic directions.

Of the remaining two, jade shaking island was in peril; its subterranean pillars had broken, and it would soon drift away like the others.

Hidden space island remained completely stable and firmly anchored in the distance, owing to its dense phantom path dao marks.

The islands drifted primarily because of deep underwater impact currents.

These massive currents endangered the entire sea. The large-sized mission required suppressing them, restructuring the ecology, and restoring the five-island chain.

"This is a large-sized mission? It's several times harder than a mid-sized one!" Hua Die's heart sank.

Feng Jiang grimaced, thinking: "Improving beehive island's ecology was already difficult and imperfect. This mission requires complete restructuring, and each island is in greater danger than beehive island was. Plus, the five islands are just part of it—we still have the vast sea area and underwater impact currents to resolve."

"Brother Chu, let's plan together." Miao Ming Shen could only smile bitterly and consult Fang Yuan.

Light flashed in Fang Yuan's eyes; deducing simultaneously alongside his time path clone, he had already arrived at a perfect plan.

Cupping his fists, he replied: "Brother Miao, I already have a plan. Follow my instructions and we will definitely complete the mission."

"Brother Miao, occupy jade shaking island to guard against the impact currents. Have Gui Qi Ye station at sword wind island to keep it from drifting away. Have Feng Jiang and Fairy Hua Die guard treasure moon island and white bone island respectively. I will deal with hidden space island first."

With the four immortals acting, the drifting islands were quickly suppressed and brought under controllable speeds.

Fang Yuan touched down on hidden space island and swiftly flew out, his speed astonishing Miao Ming Shen's group.

Fang Yuan went to white bone island.

Under Hua Die's watch, Fang Yuan retrieved immortal materials from his aperture and casually scattered them.

"Chu Ying is setting up a formation with immortal materials! Does he possess formation path grandmaster attainment?"

With white bone island ready, Fang Yuan activated the sub-formation, linking it to the main formation on hidden space island.

Under the immortal formation's power, white bone island shuddered intensely before anchoring firmly to the sea, completely immobile.

Hua Die realized his intention: "He used hidden space island as the base to stabilize the surrounding islands!"

Hua Die soon noticed a flaw: "The formation anchors the other islands, but impact currents will still batter them over time. As the formation sustains damage and eventually breaks, they will still drift away."

Offering no explanation, Fang Yuan quickly visited the remaining three islands to set up formations and stabilize them all.

Just then, Fang Yuan soared into the sky and activated the entire Gu formation.

Towering multicolored pillars of light erupted from all five islands, surging the Gu formation's power well beyond its original limits.

The islands' dense dao marks served as gigantic immortal materials, which the immortal formation naturally incorporated.

"I am drawing in the impact currents now. Keep defending your islands and stop any beasts or waves that endanger them," Fang Yuan's voice resounded across the sea area.

Stirred by the illusory white light like a whale provoked by minnows, the impact current accelerated and surged toward the nearest island, jade shaking island.

Stationed on jade shaking island, Miao Ming Shen gritted his teeth under immense pressure, tensing on high alert.

If the formation's defense failed, a direct hit from such a current would completely obliterate jade shaking island!

The impact currents struck the formation with a startling explosion.

A ten-foot wave slammed violently into jade shaking island.

Miao Ming Shen shouted and flew up, deploying a killer move to resist it.

Deflected to the left of jade shaking island, the currents were swiftly pulled toward white bone island by its sub-formation before they could disperse.

"Chu Ying is insane!" Hua Die had no time to ponder as the currents slammed into white bone island, the formation groaning terrifyingly beneath a colossal wave.

With numerous sea beasts swept up in the waves, Hua Die fought desperately to hold them back.

Under Fang Yuan's continuous manipulation, the impact currents struck each of the five islands in turn.

With each collision, the currents weakened a tier before circling the island and being guided to the next.

By the time they struck the final island, the currents had lost more than half their power and momentum.

Fang Yuan activated the immortal formation again, forcing the currents to turn back and strike the second-to-last island.

After five more rebounds, the currents returned to jade shaking island with virtually no destructive force, behaving like ordinary sea currents.

The five islands trembled slightly as the immortal formation fully stabilized, and the calmed currents settled into a steady flow.

The tamed impact currents formed a protective barrier around the five islands, shielding them while reinforcing the immortal formation.

Fang Yuan's method ingeniously harnessed the impact currents, turning a calamity into a blessing that greatly reinforced the sea area's natural foundation.

"The main hurdle is cleared. Next, you only need to repair the formation and restructure the islands' ecology; ignore anything beyond the currents," Fang Yuan smiled.

Should new impact currents form, the existing currents would absorb them under the formation's guidance, shielding the islands.

Fang Yuan left behind a will and abundant immortal essence, ensuring the five-island chain remained perfectly secure.

# Chapter 1902: Bullying Rank Eight

After discussing with Miao Ming Shen, Fang Yuan left Feng Jiang and Fairy Hua Die behind while the rest returned with him.

White light shined, Fang Yuan, Miao Ming Shen, and Gui Qi Ye returned to the starting island.

Ren Xiu Ping was currently inspecting missions at the Merit Obelisk.

As an enslavement path Gu Immortal commanding numerous desolate and ancient desolate beasts with diverse abilities, his methods were versatile.

Yet even Ren Xiu Ping felt the difficulty of mid-sized missions.

Seeing the trio suddenly materialize beside him, Ren Xiu Ping started: "Why did all three appear together? A coincidence?"

As Fang Yuan approached, the obelisk transformed to display its large-sized missions.

Fang Yuan scanned the list and quickly accepted a mission.

Next, he shared this with Miao Ming Shen and Gui Qi Ye.

With another flash of light, the three vanished.

Ren Xiu Ping's expression darkened: "Chu Ying took a large mission. He must have spent points on the 'really good person' title!"

"Large missions must be even harder than mid-sized ones," Ren Xiu Ping thought gloomily. "Did Miao Ming Shen and Gui Qi Ye receive the same mission?"

This discovery was quite alluring to Ren Xiu Ping.

Mid-sized missions were difficult, but having help would shift the burden.

"Dividing merit points among multiple people raises efficiency and overall gains. Chu Ying is doing the exact same thing!"

Being savvy, Ren Xiu Ping quickly understood Fang Yuan's intentions upon reflection.

Fang Yuan never intended to hide it; he had purposely released the information.

Though harder than mid-sized missions, the second large mission posed no problem for Fang Yuan.

With some effort, Fang Yuan resolved the major issues, leaving Miao Ming Shen and Gui Qi Ye to settle minor problems.

Returning to the Merit Obelisk, he waited briefly before Hua Die and Feng Jiang arrived.

Their return meant the first large mission was completed.

Fang Yuan earned five hundred merit points, while Miao Ming Shen's group gained around eighty each.

"Join Miao Ming Shen for the second mission. I suggest we all exchange for group titles to communicate," Fang Yuan said.

A group title was not cheap, costing a hundred merit points.

Without hesitation, Feng Jiang and Hua Die followed Fang Yuan's advice and exchanged for the title.

Fang Yuan accepted the third large mission and went ahead to handle it.

After completing the second mission and returning to the starting island, the four immortals saw their earned merit points listed on the board.

Miao Ming Shen and Gui Qi Ye also spent merit points for a group title, enabling the four immortals to communicate constantly with Fang Yuan.

While their cooperation was mutually beneficial, it troubled Ren Xiu Ping and Shen Cong Sheng.

Watching Miao Ming Shen's group surpass them into the top rankings was infuriating, but they were powerless to stop it.

Fang Yuan's merit points had reached several thousand, leaving all other immortals far behind.

"Immortal Gu require ten thousand merit points, and Chu Ying is nearly there." Seeing this, many felt deep dejection.

Shen Cong Sheng sighed; he had sighed more over the past ten days than in the preceding years combined.

The rankings were glaring; Shen Cong Sheng stood even lower than Hua Die and Feng Jiang.

He was a great rank eight Gu Immortal, he actually was losing to two rank six Gu Immortals, how could he allow this? It was too embarrassing.

"If I can receive a large sized mission, my rank eight strength will be fully utilized, I will definitely gain a lot of merit points. But how can I let others receive the same mission as me?"

While the 'really good person' title was obvious, which title allowed sharing missions?

"I can order Shen clan's immortals to spend their merit points, but what about Ren Xiu Ping and Tong Hua? If I do that, will I just push them toward Chu Ying?"

At the Merit Obelisk, a new large mission appeared: execute the mad demonic immortal in regret crying sea alongside the formation!

"Regret crying sea appeared?" Fang Yuan was slightly stunned before accepting this mission.

Fang Yuan's rebirth had significantly altered the missions appearing on the Merit Obelisk.

With this mission, Fang Yuan could retrieve Regret Gu earlier.

This was a great thing!

With Regret Gu, advancing his Immortal Gu to higher ranks would be much faster.

# Chapter 1903: Response Gu

The sky was cloudy, with vicious winds and choppy waves.

This was regret crying sea area, Fang Yuan and Miao Ming Shen's group had already been here for some time.

"I regret it! I should not have killed so many people."

Cries echoed in the immortals' ears like killer moves disrupting their emotions.

Despite little formation path foundation, they spotted the grand formation on the seafloor.

This grand formation left by Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable made the immortals feel minuscule.

In his previous life, Fang Yuan had estimated it would take decades to comprehend this formation.

"I need about eight years to fully comprehend this formation," Fang Yuan thought.

"Regret Gu shows no movement." Fang Yuan stared at a specific area on the seafloor.

"In my past life, Regret Gu transported me away. Showing no movement now, it seems I must take action myself," Fang Yuan realized.

Contemplating briefly, he said to Miao Ming Shen: "We must use the formation to eliminate this demonic immortal. However, when Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable set up this formation, even though it has unparalleled power, it can only suppress and seal, it has no offensive power. My idea is, we will set up a supplementary formation outside and activate it to kill the demonic immortal trapped within the formation."

"Does Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable have Heavenly Court's lifespan extension method? According to Heavenly Court's method, not only a hundred thousand years, they can hibernate for millions of years."

Fang Yuan looked toward Miao Ming Shen: "To set up the supplementary formation, I need a Gu Immortal guarding each formation core. When the supplementary formation is activated, the more Gu Immortals there are and the more formation cores there are, the greater the power of the supplementary formation will be. And in my plan, I need at least eight Gu Immortals to suppress the formation cores."

However, Miao Ming Shen smiled sincerely: "Brother Chu, securing the Paradise Earth true inheritance is paramount—we must seize this once-in-a-lifetime opportunity! What hatred do we have that we can't put aside for a while? If we want to settle the score, we can do it after we leave. In my opinion, Zeng Luo Zi and Tu Tou Tuo can be invited, Ren Xiu Ping and Tong Hua can also be invited, and it will be even better if Shen clan's Gu Immortals can also come."

Miao Ming Shen added: "Of course, the decision rests entirely with you, Brother Chu."

Fang Yuan smiled: "Brother Miao's magnanimity is admirable. Guard the initial cores while I set up the formations and invite the others."

Recruiting Tu Tou Tuo and Zeng Luo Zi went very smoothly.

When Fang Yuan invited Tong Hua next, she hesitated, asking for time to consider.

Ren Xiu Ping agreed instantly upon invitation, even faster than Tu Tou Tuo and Zeng Luo Zi.

Ren Xiu Ping also brought surprising news: Shen clan's Gu Immortals wished to join as well.

Thus Fang Yuan met with Shen Cong Sheng soon after.

"Chu Ying." Shen Cong Sheng acted warmly this time, treating the rank seven Chu Ying as a rank eight equal.

"Heavenly Court provided vital intelligence about Dragon Whale Paradise in exchange for Gu Yue Fang Zheng."

"Dragon Whale Paradise contains rank eight Response Immortal Gu, a treasure my Shen clan has sought for years."

"Shen clan is willing to cooperate. If you see this Gu on the Merit Obelisk's reward list, please pass it; if encountered in a mission, capture it for us in exchange for a massive reward!"

Fang Yuan's expression changed: "Response Gu? It enslaves anyone who hears and answers its call. A rank eight response Gu can enslave rank eight Gu Immortals, this is such a precious Gu that your clan is unable to obtain, if you want to work with me, what rewards are you offering me? After all, within this Dragon Whale Paradise, we cannot set an agreement."

Shen Cong Sheng laughed: "I stake Shen clan's reputation on this. Accept these materials as a token of sincerity."

Shen Cong Sheng then handed a set of immortal materials to Fang Yuan.

With Regret Gu in reach, Fang Yuan needed abundant resources to advance his Immortal Gu; Shen Cong Sheng's materials met this exact need.

Fang Yuan nodded as he accepted the immortal materials.

Shen Cong Sheng added: "Response Gu might be inside that super formation; Shen clan will assist your mission fully."

Fang Yuan pondered briefly before nodding: "It is my honor to receive Lord Shen Cong Sheng's assistance."

# Chapter 1904: Territory Gu

Within the regret crying sea area, immortals were present.

Stationed in their respective supplementary formations, Miao Ming Shen's group channeled power continuously into the underwater formation.

Fang Yuan was setting up his immortal formation now.

With a wave of his hand, swarms of mortal Gu circled in the sky, outlining a supplementary formation.

Fang Yuan then added immortal materials and activated killer moves to complete the formation.

"This formation is ready; Ren Xiu Ping, please defend it," Fang Yuan instructed.

Like the previous formations built in the sky, it sank into the sea once completed.

"Sure." Ren Xiu Ping smiled and flew down, entering the formation without close inspection.

Fang Yuan continued to set up formations.

As Gu Immortals entered one by one, the supplementary formations grew stronger.

With time and effort, all supplementary formations were finally completed.

The formations occupied by Shen Cong Sheng and the others surrounded the underwater formation like a peacock's tail.

Resembling the eyes on peacock feathers, each supplementary formation gathered strength and channeled it into the underwater formation.

Though similar in appearance, the supplementary formations possessed distinct effects.

Fang Yuan tailored each formation: space path materials boosted Miao Ming Shen's efficiency, while desolate beasts enhanced Ren Xiu Ping's enslavement path power.

Weaker immortals guarded the periphery, while Shen Cong Sheng took the position closest to the underwater formation.

Fang Yuan also created a supplementary formation for himself.

This refinement path formation served solely to amplify Fang Yuan's refinement path killer moves.

Inside his formation, Fang Yuan activated the killer move Refinement Formation Rain.

Raindrops penetrated the underwater formation, refining its Gu worms one by one.

"Such formation path attainment, such ambition... he wants to take the entire formation for himself!"

"Chu Ying..." Shen Cong Sheng wore a solemn expression, secretly engraving the name into his heart.

With the extraordinary power of a rank eight killer move, Fang Yuan steadily refined the underwater formation bit by bit.

As his control grew, the supplementary formations enabled him to progress rapidly without issue.

Yet after refining thirty percent, Refinement Formation Rain's effectiveness dropped sharply, slowing his progress.

"The killer move's effectiveness depends on my understanding of the formation." Unsurprised, Fang Yuan remained patient.

He was willing to spend time here; obtaining Regret Gu and other Immortal Gu in the formation made the investment worthwhile.

The refinement slowed continuously until Fang Yuan finally hit an obstacle.

This was a rank seven earth path Immortal Gu—yellowish brown and disc-like, with four hooked tentacles.

"Territory Gu. Planted in soil, it grants control over a thousand li of domain," Fang Yuan recognized.

Regardless of its utility, refining this earth path Immortal Gu was essential; it was the primary obstacle halting his progress.

# Chapter 1905: Demonic Immortal Breaks Free

Territory Gu blocked all the Gu Immortals; no matter how they drove the supplementary formations, they could no longer penetrate the formation.

Reentering his formation, Fang Yuan instructed the immortals to activate their formations according to his precise methods.

Fang Yuan needed to capitalize on this change.

He promptly activated refinement formation rain, soon refining territory Gu!

After all, this earth path formation was created by Paradise Earth, whose earth path attainment was supreme grandmaster!

Fang Yuan tried using the refined sixty percent to interfere with the remaining forty percent.

Fang Yuan coughed blood as soul backlash struck him; supplementary formations shattered, dumping the shocked Gu Immortals into the water.

He immediately ordered the Gu Immortals to attack while he and several others manipulated the supplementary formations.

Under the combined assault of the immortals and Shen Cong Sheng, the damaged formation faltered and revealed flaws.

Overjoyed, Fang Yuan swiftly used the supplementary formations to infiltrate through these loopholes.

Immortal killer move — Grand Collision!

Boom!

# Chapter 1906: He Is Actually Fang Yuan!

The sudden change occurred in front of all the immortals.

"Father, the situation is under control, let's rest below," Zhan Bu Du said.

# Chapter 1952: Responsibility and Sacrifice

"Senior sister." A young Yuan Qiong Du opened his eyes to see a smiling girl leaning over him with bright eyes.

Glancing at Little Du's hands, the girl gasped: "Wow, Little Du, you refined another rank three Gu! You're really amazing."

"I'm not happy though. You know I don't like cultivating refinement path," Yuan Qiong Du mumbled, standing up.

"Haha, I'll share a secret then. A few days ago, I found clues to an inheritance hidden on the mountain. Want to go search for it?" his senior sister asked.

Finally, the two found the inheritance inside a mountain cave.

"A fire path inheritance." Yuan Qiong Du inspected it carefully: "Will flame? A fire using will as fuel—what an ingenious method! Wait... why is Master's name on it?"

"I set up this inheritance in my youth," Yuan Qiong Du's master said, slowly walking into the cave before him.

"Hahaha, clever brat!" The fat sect uncle pointed at Yuan Qiong Du. "Your master and I were returning from Spirit Resonance Peak when we spotted your trail. I can guarantee that your master left this inheritance in his youth. He loved fire path back then, spending five painstaking years saving primeval stones to buy a rank three fire path Gu."

"But Master cultivates water path!" Yuan Qiong Du's eyes widened, never expecting his master had also loved fire path in his youth.

"There was no choice," his master sighed. "Our sect's water path inheritance needed a successor. Personal preferences cannot outweigh the sect's needs. Every inheritance must be passed down. Each inheritor builds upon their predecessor's foundation. This is our responsibility. When I gave up fire path, I arranged this inheritance. I was there at that time and saw him crying his eyes out."

He opened his eyes again.

Yuan Qiong Du saw that he was still inside Heaven Overseeing Tower.

"Damn it! I suffered refinement backlash and fainted!" Yuan Qiong Du's heart pounded madly as memories returned.

A blazing fire had taken his place in the refinement; Fate Gu rested quietly within the flames, merely half a step from complete recovery.

This was his will flame!

A fire fueled by will, obtained in his youth. Though he cultivated refinement path, he refined will flame until it reached immortal level.

Thinking of his master, he smiled: "Responsibility... Master, it seems I haven't disappointed you."

Knowing his injuries were fatal, yet seeing hope before him, Yuan Qiong Du poured his remaining life into stoking the will flame.

"Burn, burn higher," Yuan Qiong Du murmured, fueling the will flame with his very life!

The will flame burned quietly, growing brighter and remarkably stable.

Within the fire, Fate Gu finally completed the final step, achieving full restoration!

While Yuan Qiong Du was already lifeless.

Like countless Heavenly Court predecessors, he gave his life to build Heavenly Court's foundation!

"Hehehe," Cong Yan chuckled weakly on the quiet top floor of Heaven Overseeing Tower. "Yuan Qiong Du accomplished his task; now it's our turn."

Cong Yan replied nonchalantly: "There is still a way. The immortal essence in my aperture is just enough to activate my trump card—coincidental, isn't it?"

As a close friend, Che Wei instantly realized his intent: "Don't! If you absorb my injuries, you will die immediately!"

"What is there to fear in death? Our comrades outside fight desperately. Brother Che Wei, your talents far exceed mine. Your journey is not over—you are about to create your own path. Sadly, I won't live to see it."

Speaking softly, Cong Yan enveloped Che Wei in a light blue radiance.

Under the blue glow, Che Wei began to heal while Cong Yan's condition deteriorated drastically.

"My friend..." Che Wei closed and opened his eyes, silent tears streaming down his face.

With Cong Yan dead, Che Wei crawled toward Fate Gu with all his remaining strength.

"Activate, activate... I beg of you." As darkness overtook his vision, Che Wei poured in all his immortal essence and prayed silently.

# Chapter 1953: Fang Yuan Falls

# Chapter 1954: Pursue — Freedom!

Bathed in blood and heavily injured, Fang Yuan snorted coldly and rose, gazing at Embroidered Tower before him.

Reckless Savage Demon Venerable had suffered losses at Embroidered Tower to Dao Embroidery, forced to shed three pieces of skin before passing.

These three bloody skins were sewn into the air by countless dao mark threads.

One was a glowing, mountain-sized yellow bird with six thick, coarse legs and a long, hard beak, but no wings.

Another was a pot-bellied azure leopard sprawled on the ground, yawning repeatedly to reveal not a single tooth.

The third was a dark-green scaled fish floating midair without gills, motionless like a jade statue.

The immortals were shaken; even Duke Long turned solemn and halted his assault.

"Wait, why do these three monsters resemble those recorded in The Legends of Ren Zu?"

The Legends of Ren Zu, chapter four states —

Fate Gu's manipulation had separated him from his children and cost him wealth Gu, driving Ren Zu mad.

One morning, a group of birds ran past Ren Zu.

Wingless, these birds sprinted across the ground on six alternating legs, kicking up clouds of dust.

The birds growled: "You are human, not a bird. Leave us alone—we are pursuing freedom Gu to reclaim our freedom."

Ren Zu asked: "Why are you all searching for freedom Gu?"

The birds replied: "Without freedom Gu, we are wingless and unable to fly. Once we regain freedom, we can soar again."

Ren Zu realized: "I understand, humans need freedom too. Without it, we are like birds that have lost their wings."

"Right!" Ren Zu clapped and laughed madly. "I must seek freedom to escape fate's shackles and be with my loved ones forever."

One afternoon, a leap of blue leopards passed by him.

The leopards shoved him away: "You are human, not a leopard. Leave us alone! We are pursuing freedom Gu."

Ren Zu asked: "Why are you searching for freedom Gu?"

The blue leopards sighed: "Without freedom Gu, we are toothless and unable to hunt. Once we regain freedom, we can feast again."

Ren Zu realized: "I see, humans need freedom too. Without it, they are like toothless beasts."

"Right!" Ren Zu laughed madly. "I must seek freedom to escape fate's shackles and enjoy boundless wealth!"

One evening, a school of fish swam past him.

The fish shoved Ren Zu away: "You are human, not a fish. Leave us alone! We are pursuing freedom Gu."

Ren Zu asked: "Why are you searching for freedom Gu?"

The fish sighed: "Without freedom Gu, we are gill-less and unable to breathe. Once we regain freedom, we can swim again."

Ren Zu realized: "I understand, humans need freedom too. Without it, they are like gill-less fish unable to breathe."

"Right!" Ren Zu clapped and laughed madly. "I must seek freedom to cast off fate's shackles, breathe freely, and live forever—I want eternal life!"

One day, freedom Gu flew towards Ren Zu on its own accord.

Ren Zu was joyous as he grabbed it.

"I have finally obtained freedom!" Ren Zu asked freedom Gu: "The wingless birds, beasts, and fish pursue you, yet you flew to me. Why?"

Freedom Gu replied: "I did not fly to you, human. I despise you! I only came because I was drawn to your cognition Gu."

Cognition Gu floated from Ren Zu's body, explaining with a smile: "Ren Zu, in your madness, you think delirious thoughts constantly. A mortal desiring eternal companionship, yearning for a carefree life, and pursuing eternal life—what else could that be but a lunatic?"

Freedom Gu sighed: "Cognitive freedom empowers me. Ren Zu, though you caught me, I will never serve you. Release me!"

Ren Zu shook his head and grasped even tighter: "Freedom Gu, I will not let you go."

Freedom Gu sneered: "Then prepare yourself, don't collapse from the pressure."

The moment it finished speaking, responsibility Gu flew over, pressing on Ren Zu's shoulder.

"Heavy, so heavy!" Ren Zu almost bent over from the pressure.

Cognition Gu sighed: "Freedom and responsibility coexist, Ren Zu. To gain freedom, you must bear responsibility—at least, responsibility for yourself."

Fate Gu's spider silk wrapped around his body, trapping him beneath responsibility's crushing weight.

Fate Gu's spider silk constricted tightly, opening bloody wounds across Ren Zu's body.

Cognition Gu explained: "Human, the more freedom you experience, the more restricted you will feel."

Silk threads pierced Ren Zu's flesh, yet howling in agony, he never loosened his grip.

In the end, he fainted from the pain.

Fate Gu's silk no longer bound him, responsibility Gu's pressure had lifted, and cognition Gu had vanished.

"Wait, where is freedom Gu?" Unable to sense it, Ren Zu opened his hands in panic.

The moment an opening appeared, freedom Gu flew away, leaving Ren Zu behind.

"I am better off dead!" Overcome with grief, Ren Zu cried: "I would rather lose love or life than lose freedom!"

The reason why he felt a vague unease when he traveled around the world.

No longer seeking mere survival, humanity's desires had grown increasingly insatiable.

He could not stop the desires that emerged in people's hearts!

Duke Long was beaten to a pulp by Fang Yuan!

Destroyed!

# Chapter 1961: So What If It Was Destroyed?

Red Lotus did not dodge, taking Duke Long's strike directly.

"You?!" Shocked, Duke Long realized Red Lotus had deliberately provoked him to land a fatal blow.

In his final moments, Red Lotus smiled at Duke Long: "Master, I have always respected you; even after countless rebirths, my admiration has never waned."

"Fate gave me preferential treatment, arranging great status and achievements, yet I still rebelled in unhappiness. Then what of the countless people in this world living far worse lives—what do they think of Fate?"

"People are not rocks or ripples; we possess cognition. In truth, cognitive madness is the most terrifying and powerful force!"

Saying so, Red Lotus handed fate Gu to Duke Long.

"Love Gu can damage Fate. Hehehe, Master, are you shocked?"

"A pity I am not an otherworldly demon."

"Neither you nor Heavenly Court can stop it, because you cannot stop people from exercising free will!"

# Chapter 1965: He Was Still Feng Jiu Ge

On stone lotus island, Feng Jiu Ge reviewed Red Lotus's memories.

Vivid as a living person, Red Lotus's will stated: "Besides my memories, I offer you two things: rank eight future self killer move, and destiny Gu's Immortal Gu recipe."

Red Lotus's will explained: "Rank eight future self grants you instant pseudo-venerable battle strength. After all, you are the Dao Guardian of the destined Great Dream Immortal Venerable. Throughout history, mature Dao Guardians reached this level. Future self allows you to utilize your peak future state at this very moment."

"As for destiny Gu's Immortal Gu recipe, though incomplete, it was created based on the destiny song you will compose in the future, sharing the exact same origin."

"I converted it into a rank nine recipe to help you comprehend destiny song's initial form."

"However, be warned: as long as fate Gu exists, your destiny song will remain suppressed and sealed."

Feng Jiu Ge shook his head: "Red Lotus Demon Venerable, thank you for the true inheritance. Fang Yuan already reminded me repeatedly, but I will not defy Heavenly Court or destroy Fate solely because of this inheritance."

Red Lotus's will smiled: "I ask for nothing. I merely gave you the strength to break free from fate. In the end, the choice is yours, isn't it?"

Feng Jiu Ge left stone lotus island with a heavy heart.

"Is this Dao Guardian status truly something I desire?" Feng Jiu Ge asked himself.

The truth was, nobody had ever asked him about it.

Stepping back, he asked himself honestly: "For what purpose do I live?"

Having loved music in his youth, he had unhesitatingly cultivated sound path.

From the start of his journey, he aspired to create nine songs expressing himself, all living beings, and heaven and earth.

"If fate Gu arranged my entire journey, was I truly living willingly?"

Feng Jiu Ge shook his head, preferring another view: "It was all my choice! Back then, I chose to defend the two immortals, abandoning peaceful seclusion out of anger in my heart to seek justice."

"I married Fairy Bai Qing and had a child because I loved her. Teaching and raising Feng Jin Huang to adulthood was my love as a father, not decreed by Fate."

"If given the chance to destroy Fate with a single move right now, would I do it?"

Destroying Fate countered his interests, since fate Gu decreed Feng Jin Huang as Great Dream Immortal Venerable!

"Yet does Feng Jin Huang truly want to become Great Dream Immortal Venerable?"

Just as nobody had asked him about being a Dao Guardian, nobody had asked Feng Jin Huang if she truly wanted to become Great Dream Immortal Venerable.

Reality left him no time to ponder this further.

With the battle to repair fate Gu raging, Feng Jiu Ge had to join the fray.

Empowered by rank eight future self, his destiny song made even Di Zang Sheng falter.

On the battlefield, Feng Jiu Ge encountered Fang Yuan once again.

Fang Yuan transmitted secretly: "Feng Jiu Ge, you finally created destiny song. What do you think of it?"

Feng Jiu Ge was silent.

He had to admit this was truly his song, born of his personality and carrying his authentic voice.

"If fate is fixed and luck a variable, I desire that variable for all living beings—such changes should stem from one's own choice!"

Feng Jiu Ge understood the truest intention in his heart.

"I did not create fate song, but destiny song! This is the truest desire of my heart."

Now, he realized the scheme Fang Yuan and Red Lotus Demon Venerable had plotted.

Knowing his nature, they did not try to convince him, but simply passed him destiny song so his own voice would persuade him.

Destiny song empowered Heavenly Court and weakened enemies, but in truth, Feng Jiu Ge was singing for himself, seeking to understand his own heart.

This returned him to his origins: wanting to sing nine songs expressing life, heaven, and earth!

Having created nine songs, he still had not expressed everything about life and the world; he had to continue singing.

Yet fate restrained him like invisible strangling hands; how could he sing freely under such constraints?

Receiving no reply, Fang Yuan transmitted amidst fierce combat: "Feng Jiu Ge, your voice reflects your aspiration—how could the creator of destiny song align with Heavenly Court?"

Feng Jiu Ge replied calmly: "You know me well! But I will not join you unless you create an opportunity to easily destroy Fate. Heavenly Court and Central Continent treated me well, so everything depends on your own efforts."

Fang Yuan chuckled: "Then watch properly."

He deliberately took Duke Long's blow and fell toward Embroidered Tower, activating Reckless Savage Demon Venerable's hidden arrangement.

To Feng Jiu Ge's surprise, Fang Yuan harnessed Reckless Savage Demon Venerable's power to directly destroy fate Gu.

Thus, when Fang Yuan requested destiny Gu's recipe, Feng Jiu Ge finally acted.

In helping Fang Yuan, he was making his own choice!

When defending the two immortals against the ten ancient sects, he had declared: "Neither demonic nor righteous, there is only Feng Jiu Ge in this world. To leave or to stay, I decide my own life and death."

Having once crossed from the demonic path to the righteous path, it was now time to return!

For in the end, Feng Jiu Ge remained Feng Jiu Ge.

# Chapter 1966: Great Era!

"Feng Jiu Ge!" Duke Long screamed, charging towards him.

Feng Jiu Ge retreated slowly, continuously singing destiny song.

Exchanging numerous blows with Duke Long, Feng Jiu Ge proved unexpectedly evenly matched!

If Feng Jiu Ge were disrupted and destiny song interrupted, Fang Yuan and the others would lack the Immortal Gu recipe and fail.

Feng Jiu Ge stalled Duke Long, Wu Shuai's Dragon Palace guarded Fang Yuan's main body, and Calamity Luck Altar blocked Demon Judgment Board.

Heavenly Court's storm of attacks was halted by the three regions' Gu Immortals and Di Zang Sheng.

Though the battle tilted in favor of the three regions' immortals, Fang Yuan faced a severe problem.

The sea of human wills was vast and turbulent.

Under destiny song's influence, human wills and flames merged, refining into a formless, colorless mystical Gu material.

Controlling the refinement session, Fang Yuan endured terrifying waves of human wills, calming them like tides and directing them into respective tributaries.

Veins bulged on Fang Yuan's forehead as countless thoughts collided; unable to sustain such expenditure, his thought storage rapidly neared depletion!

Noticing Fang Yuan's expression, Fairy Zi Wei analyzed: "Fang Yuan is in trouble. His wisdom path foundation excels at blocking deductions and concealing locations, but this refinement rapidly exhausts thoughts and tests raw cognitive ability. The sea of human will is terrifying; even I cannot last long in it."

"I've given it my best effort... it seems I must use wisdom Gu after all," Fang Yuan sighed.

The moment Fang Yuan opened his immortal aperture's entrance, wisdom Gu flew out on its own, floating above him while emitting divine radiance.

Inspecting it closely, he realized: "Wisdom Gu is one of the materials. It expends thoughts more slowly, but my immortal essence expenditure is huge—I cannot sustain this rate."

He knew that at this point in time, the venerables would not stand idly by.

"Next, it should be your turn to take action, Giant Sun..."

Far away in black heaven, a dark-gold palace floated quietly in the sky.

In the palace, immortal zombie Giant Sun slowly opened his eyes.

"We have finally reached this moment." Immortal zombie Giant Sun smiled, sighing softly: "Red Lotus, your scheme succeeded after all."

Within Luck Suppression Heavenly Palace, immortal zombie Giant Sun slowly raised his right hand.

Boom—!

An enormous beam of light shot through the sky toward Heavenly Court at extreme speed.

Originating from black heaven above Northern Plains, the beam of light pierced the regional wall to bombard Heavenly Court directly.

Heavenly Court shook intensely, the world seemed to tremble as countless Immortal Gu Houses cracked and broke.

Within Imperfection Regret Pavilion, Star Constellation Immortal Venerable's silhouette gritted her teeth.

She watched Giant Sun's attack approach, but Limitless's silhouette drew her attention, leaving her no time to deal with it.

Giant Sun's attack landed with unstoppable might, fusing into the sea of human wills and flames.

The three sources converged, instantly forming a mountain-sized golden ball of light.

Traces of pale white light spread from his tightly clenched hands.

He was internally shaken: "Heaven path dao marks!"

Tens to hundreds of heaven path dao marks slipped through the cracks between his fingers.

Opening his hands wide, countless heaven path dao marks flew into the sky with a loud sound, entangling with one another.

Traces of dao marks went towards Fang Yuan's body.

Fang Yuan grunted as intense pain struck, shaking his body and mind!

"Newly added heaven path dao marks on my body? No, not just me..." Fang Yuan sensed countless dao marks vanishing, tracing back to the sources of human wills.

"As expected." At this moment, Fang Yuan was finally certain about Red Lotus Demon Venerable's plan.

He wanted to refine destiny Gu, but was not truly trying to refine a Gu.

Fang Yuan grasped this chance, doing his best to collect these heaven path dao marks.

Across the vast five regions, countless mortals screamed in pain as heaven path dao marks traced back to the human wills, carving themselves into their bodies.

Heavenly Court's battle ceased as the sudden influx of heaven path dao marks caught the Gu Immortals off guard, barely able to endure the pain.

"No—!" Duke Long screamed in agony, finally realizing Red Lotus's plan.

With a loud sound, like splattering water, the mountain-like human wills vanished on the spot.

Success!

"People of this world, I have entrusted fate to you. From today onwards, fate no longer exists!" Red Lotus's will resonated into the minds of everyone across the five regions.

"Red Lotus—!" Duke Long roared in anger, finally breaking free from Feng Jiu Ge to reach Fang Yuan.

But it was too late.

The last remnants of Red Lotus's will coalesced into human form, blocking the ferocious Duke Long for Fang Yuan.

"Master." The youthful Red Lotus smiled: "I have succeeded. I split Fate Gu among everyone in this world. Fused with luck, heaven's will can no longer use it."

In the next moment, he completely destroyed Red Lotus's will and arrived before Fang Yuan.

Duke Long's aura broke past its limit to an unprecedented level, his overwhelming strength threatening even Di Zang Sheng and Feng Jiu Ge's lives!

Fang Yuan did not move, nor did he put up a defense.

Duke Long charged with unparalleled might, but when still a step from Fang Yuan, his expression changed.

His aura froze at once, his advancement stopped.

His lifespan — was exhausted!

Qi Sea Ancestor's steal life in Eastern Sea had already taken effect.

The hero of a generation, Heavenly Court's pillar, master of Red Lotus, and creator of the dragonman race—Duke Long!

Finally, his life was over.

Heavenly Court's Gu Immortals wept aloud, their morale surging with the resolve of mourning troops!

Intense battle erupted again, the three regions' Gu Immortals actually suppressed by the outnumbered Heavenly Court.

Fang Yuan no longer participated in the fight.

Enduring intense pain, his gaze pierced past Heavenly Court to overlook the entire five regions.

Earth shook as it produced waves of deep, rumbling noises.

The regional walls separating the five regions had completely vanished; earth veins connected as the five regions merged into one!

As the bloody cape on his back disintegrated, Fang Yuan raised his head slightly and inhaled deeply.

Ah, the air was filled with freedom.

From now on, pursuing eternal life was finally possible.

Thinking of this, Fang Yuan's lips curled into a faint smile.

"The great era... has finally arrived!"
